We introduce GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based framework and dataset for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads. The framework supports extensible workload and fault-injection logic; based on this design, the current release targets failures visible in multi-GPU communication logs and provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA out-of-memory fail-stop failures, and persistent straggler fail-slow failures. Using GF-Bench, we evaluate three sequence-based methods (DeepLog, LogAnomaly, and LogBERT) and the LLM-based LogPrompt on parsed logs, and additionally evaluate LogPrompt on raw logs. On parsed inputs, no method reliably detects both failure classes, and the highest overall F1 score is 0.667. Raw inputs raise the overall F1 score of in-context LogPrompt to 0.983, at 9.0x its average input-token usage and 8.7x its per-run cost. These results expose a substantial trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency: generic log parsing lowers operational cost but discards the distributed execution context required for accurate failure detection. GF-Bench provides a reproducible basis for studying cost-efficient analysis methods and can be extended to additional GPU workloads and failure types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GF-Bench，一个基于 PyTorch 的框架和数据集，用于生成分布式 GPU 工作负载中的多样故障。实验表明，在解析后的日志上，现有序列方法与 LLM 方法均无法可靠检测两类故障（最高 F1 0.667）；直接使用原始日志可将 LogPrompt 的 F1 提升至 0.983，但令牌使用量和成本分别增加 9.0 倍和 8.7 倍，揭示了通用日志解析降低成本却丢失分布式执行上下文的权衡。
AI.motivation: 大规模 AI 模型越来越依赖分布式 GPU 执行，但现有的故障分析方法是否能有效迁移到该场景尚不清楚，缺乏针对分布式 GPU 通信日志的可复现基准与故障注入框架。
AI.method: 构建 GF-Bench 框架，支持可扩展的工作负载与故障注入逻辑，发布包含 220 个标记的双 GPU 执行（正常、CUDA OOM 故障停止、持久拖慢故障慢速）；在解析日志上评估 DeepLog、LogAnomaly、LogBERT 与 LogPrompt，并在原始日志上额外评估 LogPrompt。
AI.result: 解析日志输入下，所有方法均无法同时可靠检测两类故障，最高整体 F1 仅 0.667；原始日志输入使 LogPrompt 的整体 F1 达到 0.983，但平均输入令牌量增加 9.0 倍，单次运行成本增加 8.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通用日志解析虽降低运营成本，却丢弃了准确故障检测所需的分布式执行上下文，存在显著的效果与效率权衡。GF-Bench 为研究高性价比分析方法提供了可复现基础，并可扩展至更多 GPU 工作负载与故障类型。

title: Uniform Information Density-Based Preference Optimization
summary: To enable large language models to generate outputs that align with human preferences, optimization algorithms based on the comparison between chosen and rejected output pairs have been developed and been proven effective. Some recent endeavors have utilized certain linguistically-derived assumptions about the preference pairs to guide the design of more precise optimization directions. However, human preferences are complex and hard to measure by simplistic criteria, and it is important to incorporate broader and more sophisticated insights about preferred vs. not-preferred language. In this study, we adopt a well-established psycholinguistic theory, Uniform Information Density, to develop a novel preference optimization algorithm, UIDPO. The basic assumption is that humans prefer to produce language in which information is uniformly distributed, because uniformity induces less cognitive processing effort. To implement this idea into the algorithm, we derive a compound metric for information uniformity by combining the global standard deviation and the local second-order difference, and integrate it to the objective of preference optimization. We compare UIDPO with SimPO, a previous state-of-the-art method, obtaining comparable and sometimes better performance on AlpacaEval2, ArenaHard, and MT-Bench. Additional linguistic analysis on complement clauses also shows that UIDPO can better reflect the tendencies of keeping information uniform in natural language than baselines. Our results show that the subtle human preference over the information rate in language is a helpful source for achieving better human alignment for LLMs. The code repository is published here: https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于统一信息密度（UID）心理语言学理论的新型偏好优化算法UIDPO，通过结合全局标准差和局部二阶差分构建信息均匀性复合指标，将其集成到偏好优化目标中，在多个基准测试中达到或超越SimPO性能，并更好地反映自然语言中信息均匀分布的倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有基于成对比较的偏好优化方法多依赖简单的语言学假设，难以捕捉人类偏好的复杂性。人类倾向于产生信息均匀分布的语言以减少认知加工负荷，因此引入成熟的心理语言学理论UID，利用信息率方面的微妙人类偏好来指导更精确的优化方向，实现更好的LLM人类对齐。
AI.method: 基于UID理论，推导信息均匀性的复合指标：结合全局标准差（衡量整体信息分布离散度）和局部二阶差分（捕捉相邻位置信息率变化率），将该指标整合到偏好优化目标函数中，构建UIDPO算法。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard和MT-Bench三个基准上，UIDPO与SimPO相比表现相当且有时更优；针对补足从句的语言学分析显示，UIDPO比基线更能反映自然语言保持信息均匀的倾向。
AI.conclusion: 语言中信息率方面的微妙人类偏好是实现LLM更好人类对齐的有效信息源；基于心理语言学理论的UIDPO为偏好优化提供了更具认知合理性的优化方向。

title: ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Design Science Research (DSR) study
summary: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

AI.tldr: 本文基于设计科学研究（DSR）方法，将ANASSA智能体编排框架从高层架构（HLA）细化为面向实现的低层架构（LLA），构建了包含47个逻辑角色、版本化任务图、能力驱动智能体选择、类型化契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、故障恢复路径及溯源记录的可执行架构体系，并通过端到端执行轨迹演示和多维分析评估验证了需求可追溯性、内部一致性、责任边界保持及技术无关性。
AI.motivation: 现有ANASSA框架仅确立了高层组件与责任边界，缺乏将这些高层职责系统性分解为可实现的低层架构规范，导致治理型空间智能体工作流难以落地为可检查、可重构、可测试的实现，同时需避免绑定特定AI模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）范式，将HLA的职责边界映射为LLA的可执行结构：定义47个逻辑角色明确职责分工；引入版本化任务图表达工作流演进；基于能力契约实现智能体动态选择；建立类型化契约规范交互接口；设计显式运行时状态机保障可观测性；集成空间验证机制确保地理数据质量；嵌入治理控制点满足合规要求；构建故障恢复路径提升鲁棒性；生成溯源记录支持审计与复现。
AI.result: 产出完整的LLA规范，包含上述所有架构要素；通过端到端执行轨迹演示验证架构可运行性；分析评估显示：需求可追溯性覆盖HLA至LLA全链路，内部一致性通过角色契约与状态机验证，责任边界在分解过程中完整保持，技术无关性由抽象契约与角色解耦保证。
AI.conclusion: 该HLA到LLA的设计桥接了ANASSA框架与未来系统实现，使治理型空间智能体工作流具备可检查性、可重构性、可测试性，同时保持对AI模型、地理空间平台、通信协议及部署环境的技术中立，为工程落地提供了规范化架构基座。

title: KhyontekAI at CheckThat! 2026: Multilingual Dense Retrieval and Cross-Encoder Reranking for Scientific Web Claims
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Author version of the paper published in CEUR Workshop Proceedings, Vol. 4283 (CLEF 2026 Working Notes, Jena, Germany)
summary: Scientific claims shared through social media platforms frequently reference research findings without explicitly linking to the corresponding scientific publications. Automatically retrieving the correct scientific source for such claims is a challenging multilingual retrieval problem involving semantic matching, paraphrasing, noisy social media text, and cross-domain language variation. In this work, we present a multilingual two-stage retrieval framework for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 1 on Source Retrieval for Scientific Web Claims. Our system combines fine-tuned dense retrieval models with cross-encoder reranking for improving multilingual scientific document retrieval. We evaluate multiple transformer-based dense retrieval architectures including multilingual-E5, BGE, and Contriever under different metadata configurations. We further investigate multilingual joint training, retrieval depth analysis, metadata enrichment, and language balancing strategies for improving retrieval effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that metadata enrichment consistently improves retrieval effectiveness, while fine-tuned cross-encoder reranking provides additional gains in retrieval precision. Our final multilingual system achieves MRR@5 scores of 0.6222 for English, 0.5112 for German, and 0.6254 for French, with an overall average MRR@5 score of 0.5862.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个多语言两阶段检索框架，用于从社交媒体声明中检索科学来源，结合微调密集检索模型和交叉编码器重排序，实验显示元数据丰富化和重排序显著提升检索效果，在英语、德语、法语上取得MRR@5平均0.5862。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上的科学声明常引用研究发现但不直接链接原始出版物，自动检索正确科学来源是一个具有挑战性的多语言检索问题，涉及语义匹配、改写、噪声社交媒体文本和跨域语言差异。
AI.method: 提出多语言两阶段检索框架：第一阶段使用微调的密集检索模型（多语言E5、BGE、Contriever）在不同元数据配置下进行检索；第二阶段使用微调交叉编码器进行重排序。探索多语言联合训练、检索深度分析、元数据丰富化和语言平衡策略。
AI.result: 元数据丰富化持续提升检索效果；微调交叉编码器重排序进一步提高检索精度。最终系统在英语、德语、法语上MRR@5分别为0.6222、0.5112、0.6254，总体平均0.5862。
AI.conclusion: 多语言两阶段检索框架结合元数据丰富化和交叉编码器重排序能有效解决科学网络声明的源检索问题，在多语言环境下取得了较好的检索性能。

title: SIRNET: Causal Adaptation of Pretrained Embeddings for Semiparametric Treatment-Effect Estimation Under Surrogacy
summary: Modern experiments increasingly produce rich post-treatment objects---such as text, images, and video---that may provide early surrogate signals for outcomes that are delayed, expensive, or observed only for a subset of participants. A pretrained encoder can turn such an object into a strong generic embedding, but the embedding is not trained for the estimation tasks required by a causal estimator and may emphasize information irrelevant to the causal target. We propose SIRNET, a Surrogate-Informed Representation adaptation framework for neural-NETwork-based causal estimation in the presence of unstructured post-treatment surrogates. Starting from pretrained surrogate embeddings, SIRNET learns a shared adapter jointly for outcome prediction, treatment propensity, and arm-specific surrogate marginalization, beyond the generic pretraining objective. The resulting covariate and surrogate representations provide a common interface for these nuisance tasks. The final treatment-effect estimate and confidence interval are obtained from cross-fitted orthogonal scores that attain the semiparametric efficiency bound under the stated nuisance-rate conditions. We also validate SIRNET's performance in synthetic and semisynthetic experiments, as well as the Anti-Amyloid in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease (A4) trial, using frozen pretrained brain-MRI embeddings as surrogates for a long-term outcome.

AI.tldr: SIRNET 是一个代理知情表征适配框架，用于基于神经网络的因果估计。它从预训练的代理嵌入（如文本、图像、视频）出发，联合学习共享适配器，用于结果预测、处理倾向得分和臂特定代理边缘化，最终通过交叉拟合正交得分获得达到半参数效率界的处理效应估计和置信区间。
AI.motivation: 现代实验越来越多地产生丰富的处理后对象（文本、图像、视频），这些对象可作为延迟、昂贵或仅对部分参与者观测到的结果的早期代理信号。预训练编码器虽能将此类对象转化为强泛化嵌入，但该嵌入未针对因果估计任务训练，可能强调与因果目标无关的信息。
AI.method: SIRNET 从预训练代理嵌入出发，学习一个共享适配器，联合优化三个任务：结果预测、处理倾向得分估计、臂特定代理边缘化。由此得到的协变量与代理表征为这些妨碍任务提供统一接口。最终处理效应估计与置信区间基于交叉拟合正交得分，在给定妨碍函数收敛速率条件下达到半参数效率界。
AI.result: 在合成、半合成实验以及抗淀粉样蛋白无症状阿尔茨海默病（A4）临床试验中验证了 SIRNET 的性能。A4 试验使用冻结的预训练脑 MRI 嵌入作为长期结果的代理。
AI.conclusion: SIRNET 能有效将通用预训练嵌入适配至因果估计任务，利用非结构化处理后代理实现高效的处理效应估计，并在实际临床试验中展示了实用价值。

title: PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的幻觉类型——前提诱导视觉固着幻觉（PVFH），即模型因视觉混淆证据而接受错误文本前提，进而生成关于不存在但视觉上合理物体的响应。作者构建了PVFH-Bench基准，在10个最先进LVLMs上实验发现：所有模型均极易受PVFH影响，且显式思维链推理会加剧该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLMs在多模态任务上取得显著进展，但物体幻觉仍是可靠性瓶颈。受认知科学感知偏差研究启发，作者关注一种新失效模式：模型被视觉上相似但不存在的物体“固着”，在错误前提诱导下产生幻觉。现有基准缺乏系统性研究此类前提诱导、视觉混淆驱动的幻觉机制。
AI.method: 1. 定义PVFH：模型锚定于视觉混淆证据，接受虚假文本前提，生成缺席但视觉合理物体的描述。2. 构建PVFH-Bench：自动生成视觉混淆但不存在的目标，包含核心幻觉设置与诊断子集，追踪从物体识别到PVFH的推理路径。3. 在10个SOTA LVLMs上评测，并分析思维链推理的影响。
AI.result: 所有10个评测模型均高度易受PVFH攻击。显式思维链推理反而加剧幻觉，因其鼓励模型过度解读微弱视觉线索作为幻觉物体的支持证据。诊断子集揭示模型从正确识别逐步滑向前提诱导固着的完整过程。
AI.conclusion: PVFH揭示了LVLMs在前提推理与视觉证据整合中的根本缺陷：模型易被视觉相似性误导并放大错误前提。思维链推理非但不能缓解，反而可能通过“过度推理”放大幻觉。未来需开发抗前提干扰的视觉验证机制与校准推理策略。

title: Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware
summary: Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score, while changing hardware largely rescales energy without changing the relative ranking of models. These results show that capability alone gives an incomplete picture of efficiency. We argue that benchmark scores should be reported together with measured energy consumption under a specified serving regime and output budget.

AI.tldr: 本文直接测量了86个开放权重模型在七个基准和六个硬件平台上的能耗与能力的权衡，发现同等能力模型间能效差异巨大，多数配置远离帕累托前沿，推理增加能耗约3.7倍，FP8量化降低约四分之一能耗，硬件变化主要重缩放能耗而不改变相对排名，主张基准分数应伴随指定服务机制和输出预算下的实测能耗报告。
AI.motivation: 现有基准分数仅反映模型能力，未考量推理能耗，导致效率评估不完整，需要直接测量能力与能耗的权衡以指导模型选择和部署。
AI.method: 对86个开放权重模型检查点在七个基准任务和六个硬件平台（从消费级GPU到八卡服务器）上进行实测，记录能耗与分数，分析帕累托前沿、推理模式、FP8量化、硬件变化及token数作为能耗代理的效果。
AI.result: 同等能力模型间能效差异达2.6-4.8倍中位数，最高27倍；启用思考模式平均增加3.7倍能耗，收益强依赖模型家族和输出预算；生成token数误序18-24%模型对；FP8量化降低约25%能耗且分数变化小；硬件变化主要线性缩放能耗，不改变模型相对能效排名。
AI.conclusion: 能力分数 alone 无法完整反映效率，基准评测应强制报告指定服务配置和输出预算下的实测能耗，以实现真正的能效感知模型选择。

title: Personalized LLM Recommendation with Semantic IDs: Autoregressive Beam Search vs. Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Large-scale personalization is shifting from embedding-table retrieval to LLM-based recommenders that generate the Semantic ID (SID) of the item to recommend, where each SID is a short sequence of discrete hierarchical content codes. A single instruction-tuned model can then unify retrieval, content understanding, and language, and recommend brand-new titles from their content alone using SID; then, how should the model generate the SID? Traditionally, models rely on a single language modeling head that generates tokens autoregressively, typically using constrained beam search. In contrast, an emerging body of work explores multi-token prediction (MTP), where dedicated heads predict all tokens in parallel, substantially reducing the decoding latency associated with beam search. We report an industry-scale, apples-to-apples comparison of these two generation paradigms: single-head autoregressive decoding vs. MTP. We introduce a new auxiliary ranking loss, defined over the joint SID score, to train the MTP objective. We evaluate the SID training objectives on both quality and training/inference cost, inside a multi-task LLM that jointly does personalized retrieval, content question-answering (QA), and instruction following over a large streaming-media catalog. Our experiments show single-head beam search consistently beats MTP on most product-critical metrics: ranking and content QA, and trains at roughly 2.6x lower dollar cost on Qwen3-8B scale; MTP wins only on raw inference throughput. Around this finding, we detail an efficient training and inference stack and report end-to-end gains over the previous non-SID baseline equipped with an auxiliary ranking head: +77% item cold-start ranking, +22% content-QA accuracy, +2.8x faster training, with language metric regression traced to SID vocabulary expansion. We address the language regression by reinforcement learning post training.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了基于LLM的推荐系统中生成语义ID（SID）的两种解码范式：单头自回归束搜索与多token并行预测（MTP）。实验表明，单头束搜索在排序和内容问答等核心指标上持续优于MTP，且训练成本降低2.6倍；MTP仅在原始推理吞吐量上获胜。论文还提出了高效训练推理栈，在冷启动排序、内容问答准确率和训练速度上均取得显著提升，并通过强化学习后训练解决了SID词表扩展带来的语言指标退化。
AI.motivation: 大规模个性化推荐正从嵌入表检索转向基于LLM的生成式推荐，核心在于如何高效生成语义ID（SID）。传统自回归解码延迟高，MTP虽能并行预测降低延迟，但其在工业级多任务场景下的效果与成本权衡尚未充分评估。需要一套苹果对苹果的对比，确定最优生成范式，并构建端到端高效系统。
AI.method: 1. 引入基于联合SID得分的辅助排序损失训练MTP目标。2. 在统一的多任务LLM（Qwen3-8B规模）上对比单头自回归束搜索与MTP，评估排序、内容问答、指令跟随等指标及训练/推理成本。3. 设计高效训练推理栈，包含SID词表扩展、冷启动处理等。4. 通过强化学习后训练修复语言指标退化。
AI.result: 单头束搜索在排序和内容问答上持续优于MTP，训练成本降低2.6倍；MTP仅在原始推理吞吐量上胜出。相较于无SID基线：冷启动排序提升77%，内容问答准确率提升22%，训练速度加快2.8倍。语言指标因SID词表扩展退化，经RL后训练缓解。
AI.conclusion: 在工业级多任务推荐场景中，单头自回归束搜索是生成SID的更优范式，兼顾效果与成本。MTP虽推理快但牺牲核心指标且训练昂贵。配合高效栈与RL后训练，SID生成式推荐可显著超越传统检索基线，实现冷启动、内容理解与语言能力的统一。

title: Perfect Reconstruction Cannot Show Whether Two Codebooks on a VAE's Latent Space Agree
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material (per-run results, precommit documents and verification scripts) is provided as ancillary files
summary: Many systems read the latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) as discrete codes, and rely on each latent being read back as the code it was written as. Shannon (1948) took such a shared codebook as given; inside a VAE nothing enforces it. We prove that no item of a standard training report can reveal whether the written and read codes agree on encoded data. We construct two VAEs that reconstruct every input perfectly, infer exactly, and match on every per-example ELBO and every code histogram, yet agreement is one in the first and zero in the second. We then show that the ELBO's own terms bound how far a measured agreement can move: the variational gap bounds the shift to exact inference, and the rate bounds the shift to generation from the prior. For Gaussian posteriors, a mean-field encoder pays an exact price in the gap that depends on its choice of axes. On probabilistic PCA the gap certifies a trained encoder in all 75 settings we test, at agreement between 0.76 and 0.97. On 240 trained VAEs, a floor set by the rate and the dataset size rules out rate-side certification in advance for 66 models, and none of them certifies. The results yield a simple protocol, Certify-or-Measure, for any pipeline that reads a VAE as codes.

AI.tldr: 论文证明标准 VAE 训练报告无法揭示编码器写入的离散码与解码器读取的码是否一致，构建了两个在所有标准指标上完全相同但码一致性分别为 1 和 0 的 VAE；进而利用 ELBO 项（变分隙与率）给出一致性可测量范围的界，提出 Certify-or-Measure 协议。
AI.motivation: 许多系统将 VAE 的潜在空间视为离散码本，假设编码器写入的码与解码器读取的码完全匹配（Shannon 1948 的共享码本假设），但 VAE 训练目标中没有任何机制强制这种一致性，现有的训练报告（ELBO、重构、码直方图等）也无法暴露该问题。
AI.method: 1. 理论构造：设计两个 VAE，在每样本 ELBO、码直方图、重构完美、精确推断等所有标量统计量上完全一致，但码一致性分别为 1 和 0，证明标准报告无法区分。2. 界分析：利用 ELBO 分解，变分隙界定从测量一致性到精确推断一致性的偏移，率界定从精确推断到先验生成一致性的偏移。3. 高斯后验下的均值场编码器：量化轴选择对变分隙的精确代价。4. 实验：在概率 PCA 上验证变分隙能认证所有 75 个设置（一致性 0.76–0.97）；在 240 个训练 VAE 上，由率和数据集大小决定的下界预先排除 66 个模型的率侧认证，其余均未通过认证。
AI.result: 标准训练指标无法保证码一致性；变分隙提供编码器侧认证，率提供解码器侧认证但受数据集大小限制；提出的 Certify-or-Measure 协议可在部署前判断是否可认证，否则必须直接测量一致性。
AI.conclusion: VAE 作为离散码源使用时，不能盲目信任共享码本假设；必须通过变分隙和率计算的界来决定是否可以认证一致性，否则必须显式测量码一致性，这为任何读取 VAE 码的流程提供了严谨的实用协议。

title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
summary: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. The engineering application is TCM clinical decision support, particularly herbal prescription recommendation. We evaluate the models on a public benchmark containing 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 TCM knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks and on a private retrospective dataset of 4,348 spleen and stomach disease prescription cases. The 14 billion parameter reinforcement aligned model achieves a prescription generation F1 of 37.0 on the public benchmark, compared with 32.3 for DeepSeek-R1 with 671 billion total parameters, and a herb-level F1 of 52.8 on the clinical dataset with improved dosage agreement. Reinforcement post-training consistently improves prescription recommendation across all scales, while physician-source analysis shows that expert heterogeneity affects reward stability. These findings demonstrate a scalable pathway from domain grounding and reasoning supervision to clinically oriented prescription decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了中医大模型家族（4B/8B/14B参数），提出分阶段临床对齐框架：大规模持续预训练、互补推理监督、处方中心强化学习。将草药处方生成建模为结构化RL问题，实现临床决策直接优化。14B模型在公开基准上处方生成F1达37.0，超越671B参数的DeepSeek-R1（32.3），临床数据集草药级F1为52.8且剂量一致性提升。RL后训练在所有规模上稳定提升处方推荐，但专家异质性影响奖励稳定性。
AI.motivation: 中医临床推理需要整合领域知识、辨证论治、治法、方药组成与剂量确定，现有大语言模型在中医临床落地推理上仍具挑战，亟需面向处方决策的临床对齐方法。
AI.method: 构建分阶段临床对齐框架：1）大规模中医文献与临床病历持续预训练；2）互补推理监督，融合知识复现与指令跟随；3）处方中心强化学习，将草药处方生成建模为结构化RL问题，采用处方级反馈直接优化临床决策输出。训练4B/8B/14B三规模模型。
AI.result: 公开基准（25,620项，13任务）上，14B RL对齐模型处方生成F1=37.0，优于DeepSeek-R1 671B的32.3；私有脾胃病数据集（4,348例）草药级F1=52.8，剂量一致性改善。RL后训练在所有参数规模上持续提升处方推荐，医生来源分析显示专家异质性影响奖励稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了从领域注入、推理监督到面向临床处方决策支持的可扩展路径，验证了结构化RL在中医处方生成中的有效性，为中医临床决策支持提供了可落地的技术范式。

title: SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

AI.tldr: 提出SAT-RL框架，通过强化学习训练大语言模型与符号求解器（如Z3）进行多轮工具交互，结合合成数据生成、监督预热和求解器接地的强化学习，显著提升符号推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学和逻辑推理上表现强劲，但随着问题复杂度增加（约束交互多、搜索空间大）面临“复杂性诅咒”；而可满足性求解器（如Z3）虽提供可扩展且可验证的约束求解，但缺乏理解自然语言问题描述的灵活性。因此需要结合两者优势。
AI.method: SAT-RL框架包含三个阶段：1) 合成数据生成与可验证解；2) 在求解器增强的轨迹上进行监督预热；3) 基于求解器的强化学习，采用工具感知奖励。训练LLM通过多轮工具执行与符号求解器交互。
AI.result: 实验表明SAT-RL在域内和域外逻辑任务上均显著提升了带工具的符号推理性能。
AI.conclusion: SAT-RL成功融合LLM的自然语言理解与符号求解器的形式化推理能力，通过强化学习实现高效工具交互，为复杂逻辑推理提供可扩展且可验证的解决方案。

title: OT-FlowRec: Optimal Transport-Guided Multi-Bridge Flow for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
summary: E-commerce user preferences evolve dynamically within sessions, exhibiting concurrent and multi-centric interest distributions. While existing multimodal sequential recommendation methods leverage global attention to compress historical interactions, they inadequately capture the concurrent nature of multi-interest behaviors and fail to model the underlying multi-centric distribution of user intent. To tackle this issue, we propose OT-FlowRec, an optimal transport-guided multi-bridge flow matching framework that explicitly models multi-interest distributions to facilitate multimodal sequential recommendation. Unlike single-path generative models, OT-FlowRec constructs a mixture of parallel, interest-specific transport flows to model the multi-centric distribution characteristics, where each flow preserves a distinct user interest cluster via an optimal transport plan. Then, a geometric transport mechanism is designed to establish minimum-cost paths from the latent multi-interest distribution to target preference prototypes to provide multi-interest awareness. Moreover, a progressive time-sampling warmup strategy dynamically biases optimization weights toward the final states of the generation process, bridging the gap between continuous global distribution fitting and practical top-$k$ ranking metrics. This approach achieves explicit interest disentanglement, ensuring the preservation of a multi-peaked preference representation instead of collapsing it into a unimodal average. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that OT-FlowRec outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: OT-FlowRec 是一种基于最优传输的多桥流匹配框架，用于多模态序列推荐，通过并行兴趣特定传输流建模多中心兴趣分布，实现显式兴趣解缠，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 电商用户偏好在会话中动态演化，呈现并发和多中心兴趣分布；现有多模态序列推荐方法依赖全局注意力压缩历史交互，难以捕捉并发多兴趣行为及潜在多中心意图分布。
AI.method: 提出 OT-FlowRec，构建并行兴趣特定传输流混合物，每个流通过最优传输计划保持一个用户兴趣簇；设计几何传输机制从潜在多兴趣分布到目标偏好原型建立最小代价路径；采用渐进时间采样预热策略动态调整优化权重，弥合连续分布拟合与 top-k 排序指标的差距。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上进行大量实验，OT-FlowRec 超越现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: OT-FlowRec 实现显式兴趣解缠，保留多峰偏好表示而非坍缩为单峰平均，有效解决多模态序列推荐中的多中心兴趣建模问题。

title: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
summary: Accurate day-ahead photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting requires both strong temporal modeling and adherence to physical PV system constraints. Purely data-driven models often ignore the underlying PV conversion process and may produce predictions that are outside the operational range of a PV system. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed state space framework that combines a differentiable PV conversion model with a selective state space backbone (PowerMamba). Our approach follows a physics-residual decomposition. The physics module provides a structured baseline based on solar geometry, irradiance, temperature effects, and inverter limits, while the state space model learns residual corrections from numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs over a 24-hour horizon. Experiments on one year of utility-scale PV data show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting accuracy, reducing RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8% compared to a physics-only baseline, and outperforming a purely data-driven model. Results further show that incorporating system-level physics provides the largest performance gains, while additional refinements offer only marginal improvements. Beyond accuracy, the model improves robustness by constraining predictions toward physical feasibility, reducing unrealistic predictions under corrupted measurements.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种物理信息状态空间框架(PowerMamba),结合可微分光伏转换模型与选择性状态空间骨干网络,用于日前光伏功率预测。通过物理-残差分解,物理模块提供基于太阳几何、辐照度、温度效应和逆变器限制的结构化基线,状态空间模型从数值天气预报输入学习残差修正。实验表明该方法显著提高预测精度,相比纯物理基线RMSE降低38.5%,MAE降低45.8%,且优于纯数据驱动模型。系统级物理约束带来最大性能提升,同时增强鲁棒性,减少损坏测量下的非物理预测。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动模型常忽略光伏转换的物理过程,可能产生超出光伏系统运行范围的预测;准确的日前光伏功率预测需要强时序建模且遵守物理约束。
AI.method: 提出物理信息状态空间框架,采用物理-残差分解策略。物理模块包含可微分光伏转换模型,基于太阳几何、辐照度、温度效应和逆变器限制提供结构化基线预测;选择性状态空间骨干网络(PowerMamba)从数值天气预报(NWP)输入中学习24小时预测范围内的残差修正。
AI.result: 在一年效用规模光伏数据实验中,相比纯物理基线,RMSE降低38.5%,MAE降低45.8%,且优于纯数据驱动模型。系统级物理约束贡献最大性能增益,额外细化仅带来边际改进。模型通过物理可行性约束提高鲁棒性,减少损坏测量条件下的非物理预测。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息状态空间框架有效融合物理知识与数据驱动学习,显著提升日前光伏功率预测精度与鲁棒性,物理约束是性能提升的关键,为可再生能源预测提供了可物理解释且高精度的解决方案。

title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出利用真实用户行为数据作为监督信号，构建Vela框架将10万用户的匿名行为记录转化为约7.5万个训练任务，微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型显著提升用户相关任务（+11.5分）和通用基准（+4分）性能，强化学习进一步增强效果，证明真实用户行为是LLM可扩展的监督来源。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM主要在静态文本或合成数据上训练，无法捕捉用户行为随时间的演变；现实应用（个人助手、推荐系统）需要从长期行为历史推断用户偏好、意图和未来行动，而大规模真实用户行为记录已存在于内容平台和个人助手中，可作为天然监督信号。
AI.method: 提出Vela框架：从10万用户的匿名行为记录生成91个真实任务模板下的10万任务，通过难度过滤和轨迹接受标准保留约7.5万任务及选定训练轨迹；在此数据上微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型，并进一步进行强化学习。
AI.result: 微调后模型在用户相关任务上比基础模型提升高达11.5分，通用基准平均提升4分；更多用户行为数据进一步提升用户相关性能；微调后强化学习比从基础模型直接强化学习高出最多7.7分。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界用户行为是大语言模型以用户为中心能力及更广泛智能的可扩展监督来源，Vela框架有效将行为数据转化为训练任务，显著提升模型在用户建模和通用任务上的表现。

title: Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 15 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables
summary:
Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.
  We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. This agentic RAG approach is straightforward to implement (1-2 engineer days), portable across capable agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code), and performs strongly on the challenging task of CS resolution workflow generation, achieving 99.2% procedural equivalence to human-approved ground truth and 83.3% evidence sufficiency. It is also roughly an order of magnitude slower per case than our deployed production assistant (~90 s vs. ~8-9 s), so we claim no latency advantage. Our claim is scoped to that setting: a mature, well-curated corpus, a latency-tolerant workflow, and human review of every case. There, the skill did the work of a complex RAG stack, and maintenance became a matter of editing text and data rather than retraining models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种简化的企业工作流自动化方法：利用自然语言指令、轻量级工具（检索API、格式检查脚本）和LLM生成的导航层（维基百科式结构化索引）替代复杂RAG管道，在客户支持场景实现99.2%程序等价性和83.3%证据充分性，虽延迟较高（~90秒 vs ~8-9秒）但维护成本大幅降低，适用于延迟容忍且有人工审核的成熟语料库场景。
AI.motivation: 企业工作流自动化（如客服工单处理）需从大规模操作文档（SOP、策略文档）中精准检索完整信息，现有生产系统通常依赖复杂的文档分块、索引、检索管道、学习型重排序、查询重写及定制化智能体RAG基础设施，实现与维护成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出可移植技能：自然语言指令 + 轻量级工具（检索API、格式校验脚本）+ 经LLM生成导航层（结构化维基百科式索引）丰富的语料库。该智能体RAG方法仅需1-2工程师天实现，可跨智能体框架（如Claude Code）移植。
AI.result: 在客服解决工作流生成任务上，达到99.2%程序等价性（对比人工批准真值）和83.3%证据充分性。单案例延迟约为生产助手的10倍（~90秒 vs ~8-9秒），但适用于成熟精心策划语料库、延迟容忍且全程人工审核的场景。维护模式转为编辑文本与数据，无需重新训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 在成熟语料库、延迟容忍、全程人工审核的约束下，该简化技能可替代复杂RAG栈，将维护工作从模型重训练降级为文本与数据编辑，显著降低工程复杂度并保持高质量输出。

title: UniSGR-V2: Stepwise Target-Side Feature Anticipation and Crossing for Generative Recommendation
summary:
Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation unifies retrieval and ranking through autoregressive decoding but differs structurally from discriminative models, which can directly access rich target-item side features. The attributes are compressed into a finite codebook during quantization, while the target item remains undetermined during decoding and its features cannot be looked up. This target-side feature vacuum weakens generation at each semantic-ID level through high conditional entropy and cascading errors, and final ranking through missing target-side feature crossing.
  Existing methods interact with candidate representations or generate discrete attribute tokens, but none reconstructs a continuous target-side representation inside decoding to support both stepwise generation and ranking. We propose TacGR (Stepwise Target-Side Feature Anticipation and Crossing for Generative Recommendation). Before decoding each codeword, TacGR anticipates a continuous target-side feature vector and crosses it with the semantic prefix and user behavior sequence inside the decoder. The crossed representation conditions current-level generation and is directly used for ranking.
  Continuous-vector regression risks a learnable target collapsing with its prediction and prediction noise propagating into generation through attention. TacGR addresses these challenges with a semantic-anchoring auxiliary tower and a unidirectional visibility mask, respectively. For extremely long industrial behavior histories, it introduces gated convolutional denoising to suppress noise and adapts the pyramid memory funnel to reduce inference cost. Offline experiments on a large-scale Lazada dataset show significant gains over OneRec, UniRec, and UniSGR. Online A/B testing improves IPV, Order, and GMV by 0.79%, 5.55%, and 3.09%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TacGR（逐步目标侧特征预期与交叉），通过在语义ID解码每一层级前预测连续目标侧特征向量并与语义前缀、用户行为序列交叉，解决生成式推荐中目标侧特征真空导致的条件熵高、级联误差及排序特征交叉缺失问题，并通过语义锚定辅助塔、单向可见性掩码、门控卷积去噪及金字塔记忆漏斗解决训练塌陷、噪声传播及长序列推理开销，在Lazada大规模数据集及线上A/B测试中显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 语义ID生成式推荐统一了检索与排序，但自回归解码时目标物品未确定，无法直接获取丰富的目标侧侧特征，导致目标侧特征真空：量化码本压缩属性信息，解码各层级面临高条件熵与级联误差，最终排序阶段缺失目标侧特征交叉。现有方法仅交互候选表示或生成离散属性token，均未在解码内部重构连续目标侧表示以同时支撑逐步生成与排序。
AI.method: 提出TacGR：在解码每个码词前，通过目标侧特征预期模块预测连续目标侧特征向量，在解码器内部将其与语义前缀、用户行为序列进行特征交叉，交叉后的表示同时条件化当前层级生成并直接用于排序。针对连续向量回归易导致目标塌陷与预测噪声经注意力传播，引入语义锚定辅助塔（利用语义ID监督锚定预测目标）与单向可见性掩码（限制预测特征仅对当前及未来层级可见）。针对超长工业行为序列，采用门控卷积去噪抑制噪声，并改造金字塔记忆漏斗降低推理显存与计算开销。
AI.result: 离线实验在大规模Lazada数据集上，TacGR显著优于OneRec、UniRec、UniSGR等强基线。线上A/B测试中，IPV提升0.79%、Order提升5.55%、GMV提升3.09%，验证了方法在工业场景的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TacGR通过逐步目标侧特征预期与交叉，首次在生成式推荐解码过程中重构连续目标侧表示，有效缓解了目标侧特征真空带来的生成与排序性能瓶颈，并通过一系列工程化设计解决了训练稳定性、噪声传播及长序列推理效率问题，实现了离线指标与在线业务指标的双重显著提升。

title: DShuttleNet: A Badminton Doubles Dataset for Evaluating Team Coordination
summary: Most existing sports datasets are individual-centric or ball-centric, focusing on individual player actions while ignoring interactions among teammates. In badminton doubles, tactical success is governed by rapid team formation and coordination, yet standard resources for modeling these player interactions are scarce. To bridge this gap, we present DShuttleNet, a comprehensive dataset for badminton doubles curated from elite BWF World Tour tournaments. Beyond trajectory data, DShuttleNet uniquely incorporates expert-labeled "Loss Reasons," transforming the dataset into a diagnostic tool for causal tactical evaluation. We formally define two geometry-driven representations, Teammate-Relative Angle (TRA) and Vertical Shot Angle (VSA), to characterize coordination and shot aggressiveness. To quantify interpersonal synergy, we introduce novel metrics, Court Coverage Efficacy Index (CCEI) and Threat Load Asymmetry Index (TLAI), which evaluate the often-overlooked non-hitting partner's role and defensive coordination. Experimental results demonstrate that conventional models suffer from underfitting when failing to incorporate these coordination-centric features, highlighting the critical importance and potential impact of releasing DShuttleNet. Dataset is available at: https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/16097938.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DShuttleNet，一个精英级羽毛球双打数据集，包含轨迹数据和专家标注的“失分原因”，并定义了两种几何驱动表示（TRA、VSA）以及两个量化团队协同的新指标（CCEI、TLAI）。实验表明，忽略协同特征会导致传统模型欠拟合，凸显了该数据集对双打战术建模的关键价值。
AI.motivation: 现有体育数据集多以个人或球为中心，忽视队友间的交互。羽毛球双打的战术成败取决于快速的团队阵型与配合，但缺乏建模这些交互的标准资源。
AI.method: 从 BWF 世界巡回赛精英赛事构建 DShuttleNet 数据集，引入专家标注的“失分原因”作为因果战术评估工具；定义队友相对角度（TRA）和垂直击球角度（VSA）表征配合与进攻性；提出场地覆盖效能指数（CCEI）和威胁负载不对称指数（TLAI）量化非持拍方角色与防守协同。
AI.result: 实验显示，未融入协同导向特征的常规模型出现欠拟合，验证了 TRA、VSA、CCEI、TLAI 等特征对双打战术建模的必要性。
AI.conclusion: DShuttleNet 填补了双打交互建模的数据空白，其几何表示与协同指标为战术诊断提供了新范式，数据集已公开可供后续研究使用。}

title: Amharic-English Cross-Language Question Answering Using Statistical Machine Translation, Named Entity Recognition, and Semantic Indexing
summary: The predominance of English-language Web content creates an information-access barrier for speakers of low-resource languages such as Amharic. This paper presents the design, imple-mentation, and evaluation of a bidirectional Amharic-English cross-language question answering (CLQA) system that allows a user to formulate a natural-language question in either Amharic or English and retrieve an answer from documents written in the other language. The system integrates a statistical machine translation (SMT) component for query translation, a maximum-entropy named entity recognition (NER) component for Amharic text processing, semantic-based indexing, question analysis, passage retrieval, and answer extraction. A domain-diverse Amharic-English parallel corpus was used to train the SMT component, while monolingual cor-pora supported language modeling. Documents were normalized, tokenized, stemmed, indexed, and semantically enriched before retrieval. The original evaluation used precision and recall as the principal effectiveness measures. For Amharic-to-English retrieval, the system achieved 72% precision and 79% recall; for English-to-Amharic retrieval, it achieved 65% precision and 70% recall. These findings show that a modular translation-and-retrieval architecture can provide useful cross-language access even under low-resource conditions. This revised article preserves the original experimental claims while situating them in the context of subsequent multilingual transformer and Amharic QA research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个双向阿姆哈拉语-英语跨语言问答(CLQA)系统，允许用户用任一语言提问并从另一种语言的文档中检索答案。系统集成了统计机器翻译、最大熵命名实体识别、语义索引、问题分析、段落检索和答案抽取等模块。
AI.motivation: 英语网络内容的主导地位为阿姆哈拉语等低资源语言使用者造成了信息获取障碍，需要跨语言问答系统来打破语言壁垒。
AI.method: 采用模块化翻译-检索架构：使用领域多样的阿姆哈拉语-英语平行语料库训练统计机器翻译(SMT)组件用于查询翻译，单语语料库支持语言建模；集成最大熵命名实体识别(NER)处理阿姆哈拉语文本；文档经规范化、分词、词干提取、索引和语义增强后进行检索；包含问题分析、段落检索和答案抽取流程。
AI.result: 阿姆哈拉语到英语检索达72%精确率和79%召回率；英语到阿姆哈拉语检索达65%精确率和70%召回率。
AI.conclusion: 模块化翻译-检索架构即使在低资源条件下也能提供有用的跨语言访问。修订版文章在保留原始实验结论的同时，将其置于后续多语言Transformer和阿姆哈拉语问答研究的背景下。

title: AlignPoison: Conditional Targeted Poisoning of Generative Recommenders via Decoding-Aligned Prefixes
summary: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. While their modeling flexibility has been widely studied, their resilience to data poisoning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we ask: how susceptible are generative recommenders to conditional targeted poisoning? Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. We observe that short, context-aligned prefixes that are both common under the model's induced transition dynamics and strongly linked to a frequent trigger consistently amplify targeted promotion. Motivated by this analysis, we develop AlignPoison, a black-box framework that discovers and samples context-aligned prefixes from API outputs. We conduct experiments on benchmarks in unimodal and multimodal generative recommendation settings. Results show that these prefixes outperform competitive baselines, improving ASR lift by up to 16.3 percentage points and highlighting a decoding-dependent, context-sensitive poisoning vulnerability in generative recommendation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式推荐模型在自回归解码下对条件定向投毒的脆弱性，提出 AlignPoison 框架，通过挖掘上下文对齐的前缀实现高效黑盒投毒攻击，实验显示攻击成功率提升高达 16.3 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐模型虽建模灵活，但其对数据投毒的鲁棒性鲜有探索。现实场景下攻击者可注入有限恶意交互并以黑盒方式查询推荐 API，需评估此类模型在条件定向投毒下的易感性。
AI.method: 从解码对齐和前缀流行度两个视角分析恶意交互合成，发现短且上下文对齐、符合模型转移动力学且与高频触发词强关联的前缀能显著放大定向推广。据此设计 AlignPoison：利用 API 输出发现并采样上下文对齐前缀，构造投毒数据实施黑盒攻击。
AI.result: 在单模态和多模态生成式推荐基准上实验，AlignPoison 生成的前缀优于竞争基线，攻击成功率（ASR）提升高达 16.3 个百分点，揭示了解码依赖、上下文敏感的投毒漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 生成式推荐模型存在基于自回归解码机制的条件定向投毒脆弱性，少量（<1%）合成交互即可显著提升恶意目标在触发条件下的推荐概率，需关注此类模型的安全防护。

title: Recall Begets Recall: Recurrent Memory Ranking for Personalized LLMs
summary: Memory ranking is the stage in personalized Large Language Models (LLMs) that decides which of the candidate memories returned by a retriever enter the limited context, so that the answer is grounded in the right parts of the user's history. Existing memory rankers operate in a single pass, scoring each candidate once against the raw query and cutting the ranked list at a fixed top-K. The single pass misses memories that the answer needs but that look unrelated to the query on their own, and the fixed cut ignores how many memories the query needs. To address both problems, we propose ReMind, a memory ranker that runs as a recurrent and self-terminating loop, following the cognitive theory of memory search: each recalled item joins the cue for the next recall (compound cueing), and recall stops once enough has been collected for the task (metamemory monitoring). For compound cueing, ReMind adds the top-ranked memory to the query context at each step and reranks the remaining candidates under the expanded cue, so that each recall makes the cue more specific and later steps look for what is still missing rather than for what merely resembles the query. For metamemory monitoring, a sufficiency predictor estimates at each step whether the collected memories are enough to answer the query and stops the loop once they are, so that the number of selected memories adapts to each query. Experiments on public benchmarks show that ReMind achieves the best results compared to state-of-the-art memory rankers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReMind，一种基于认知理论的循环自终止记忆排序器，通过复合线索和元记忆监控解决单次排序遗漏相关记忆和固定截断忽略查询需求数量的问题，在公开基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化 LLM 的记忆排序器采用单次打分并固定 Top-K 截断，存在两大缺陷：一是单次排序会遗漏那些单独看与查询无关但回答所需的记忆；二是固定截断无法根据查询自适应决定需要多少记忆。
AI.method: ReMind 设计为循环自终止过程：1) 复合线索：每轮将当前最高分记忆加入查询上下文，重新对剩余候选打分，使线索逐步具体化，后续步骤寻找缺失信息而非仅匹配原始查询。2) 元记忆监控：引入充分性预测器，在每轮估计已收集记忆是否足以回答查询，满足即停止，实现自适应选取数量。
AI.result: 在公开基准实验中，ReMind 优于现有最先进的记忆排序器，取得最佳效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于认知理论的循环复合线索与自适应终止机制能有效解决记忆排序中的遗漏与固定截断问题，显著提升个性化 LLM 的记忆检索质量。

title: Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging
summary: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种名为“重心锚定搜索”的后处理权重空间过程，利用两个微调检查点和预训练初始化，通过无导数搜索在锚定权重空间中自适应融合模型，无需额外梯度训练或推理开销，显著提升了分布外数据上的鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有模型融合方法如Model Soup需要大量微调检查点，Model Stock采用固定几何融合规则，缺乏对分布外数据的自适应能力。需要一种轻量级、自适应的权重空间优化方法，仅用少量检查点和验证反馈即可改善分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 给定预训练初始化和两个源数据集微调检查点，构建重心候选权重，在连接候选权重与预训练模型的方向上执行无导数搜索（受Nelder-Mead和Torczon多方向搜索启发），利用少量分布外验证子集选择最佳候选模型，最后在保留的分布外基准和ImageNet验证集上评估。
AI.result: 在CLIP ViT-B/32实验中，该方法在保留的分布外数据（ImageNet-A、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-Sketch）上显著提升性能，ImageNet准确率保持竞争力；融合权重还能泛化到未参与选择的分布外数据集，优于原始微调检查点、朴素模型汤和Model Stock。
AI.conclusion: 锚定权重空间中的轻量级优化提供了一种实用的替代方案，优于固定权重平均规则、几何融合或单模型选择，能以极低成本自适应提升微调视觉模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

title: The Constitution Speaks Nheengatu: An Open MT System and Reproducible Corpus Pipeline for the Amazonian Língua Geral
summary:
Nheengatu (yrl), the Amazonian Língua Geral, has 6--10 thousand speakers and is co-official in São Gabriel da Cachoeira (Brazil), yet remains poorly served by evaluated Portuguese--Nheengatu MT resources. We present the largest parallel corpus assembled for the language (14.5k Portuguese--Nheengatu pairs), anchored by the 2023 official translation of the Brazilian Federal Constitution; the first MT evaluation set built from transcribed spontaneous speech; and, to our knowledge, the first open-weight MT models dedicated to bidirectional Portuguese--Nheengatu translation.
  Three findings organize the paper. First, translation into Nheengatu on held-out constitutional articles plateaus on development data regardless of training length or model size, and much of the remaining error sits in conventional legal terms that the written sources do not attest consistently; a terminology success rate over a frozen lexicon shows that glossary mechanisms at training time and lexical constraints at decoding each raise term realization, the latter at a cost in repetitive output that chrF++ barely registers. Second, a corpus expansion that adds transcribed conversation raises speech chrF++ by 24--27 points while leaving written domains unchanged, a register gap that written-only benchmarks cannot see. Third, a larger NLLB model helps translation into Portuguese but not into Nheengatu on legal or speech text. For Portuguese-to-Nheengatu translation, our final systems reach 31.7--32.8 chrF++ on article-disjoint constitutional text, 64.1--64.5 on the near-domain set (62.1 after removing items with target-side content overlap), and 45.2--47.5 on speech.

AI.tldr: 本文针对亚马逊语言Nheengatu（约6-10万使用者）构建了最大规模平行语料库（1.45万葡-尼对）、首个基于自发语音转录的MT评测集及首个开放权重双向翻译模型，揭示了法律术语一致性不足导致的翻译瓶颈、口语与书面语领域差距以及模型规模对低资源方向效用有限的关键发现。
AI.motivation: Nheengatu虽为巴西圣加布里埃尔-达卡谢拉市共同官方语言，但葡-尼机器翻译资源极度匮乏，缺乏经过评估的平行语料、语音领域测试集及专用模型，严重阻碍该语言的数字化保护与实际应用。
AI.method: 1. 构建以2023年巴西联邦宪法官方译文为核心的1.45万句对平行语料库；2. 采集转录自发对话构建首个语音领域评测集；3. 训练双向翻译模型，实验对比词表机制（训练时词汇表注入、解码时词汇约束）、语料扩展（加入会话语料）及模型规模（NLLB大模型）对法律文本与语音文本翻译质量的影响。
AI.result: 1. 宪法律向尼翻译在开发集停滞，法律术语错误主导；词表注入与解码约束均能提升术语命中率，但约束导致重复输出且chrF++难以捕捉。2. 加入会话语料使语音测试集chrF++提升24-27点，书面领域不变，揭示纯文本基准无法捕捉的语体鸿沟。3. 扩大NLLB模型仅助益尼向葡翻译，对葡向尼法律/语音文本无增益。最终系统在宪法离散条文达31.7-32.8 chrF++、近领域集64.1-64.5（去重后62.1）、语音集45.2-47.5。
AI.conclusion: 低资源语言MT需针对性解决术语一致性、语体差异及模型规模收益递减问题；词汇约束虽提升术语准确性但引入重复风险；语音转录语料对缩小口语翻译鸿沟至关重要；单纯扩大模型规模无法解决极低资源方向的瓶颈，未来应探索数据高效的术语注入与跨语体迁移方法。

title: HiPPT: Physiology-Grounded Wearable PPG Representation Learning via Multi-Scope Text Alignment
summary: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. Waveform-guided text modeling further recovers masked contextual concepts from PPG patch representations, providing fine-grained waveform-text supervision. Across six downstream tasks spanning blood pressure, vascular stiffness, physiological attributes, and cross-dataset heart-rate estimation, HiPPT achieves the best result on the primary linear-probing metrics. The aligned space also supports zero-shot profiling of age group, sex, and BMI category, individually and jointly, with performance improving as more recordings are aggregated. These results show that evidence-scope matching yields transferable and semantically accessible wearable PPG representations. Code and pretrained weights will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HiPPT，一种生理驱动的可穿戴 PPG 预训练框架，通过将不同监督源与其适宜的证据范围匹配，学习可迁移且语义可访问的 PPG 表示。在六项下游任务上实现最优线性探测性能，并支持零样本人口统计学画像。
AI.motivation: 现有 PPG 预训练目标多在记录级或配对级施加监督，忽略了不同生理概念在不同波形证据范围内才变得可靠这一事实，导致学到的表示难以同时捕捉局部脉搏形态与整体生理规律。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含 400 万+ 腕式 PPG 记录的 PPG-Text 语料库，配对波形派生的形态学描述与元数据派生的上下文描述。2. 记录级形态对齐：将单条记录锚定于脉搏形态特征。3. 跨记录上下文对齐：聚合共享相同元数据元组的记录，捕捉上下文一致的生理规律。4. 波形引导文本建模：从 PPG 补丁表示中恢复被掩码的上下文概念，提供细粒度波形-文本监督。
AI.result: 在血压估计、血管硬度、生理属性预测及跨数据集心率估计等六项下游任务的线性探测主指标上均取得最优结果。对齐空间支持年龄组、性别、BMI 类别的单独及联合零样本画像，性能随聚合记录数增加而提升。
AI.conclusion: 证据范围匹配策略能产出兼具迁移性与语义可访问性的可穿戴 PPG 表示，为生理信号自监督学习提供了新范式。

title: Tackling the Modality Inhibitance Effect with Wavelet-based Modality Integration in Multi-modal Recommendation
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (TKDE) 2026
summary: Harnessing rich modality features has recently gained prominence in multi-modal recommendation systems (MRSs). To delineate user modality preferences, existing works focus on modality fusion, which can be achieved via attentive summation or concatenation. In this work, we introduce the modality inhibitance effect - a phenomenon which limits existing MRSs when these models transit from dual-modal to tri-modal configurations resulting in significant performance degradation. In particular, apart from the modal-specific contamination encapsulated in the newly introduced modality, the inclusion of new features results in excessive informational redundancy, thereby severely impeding effective integration within current approaches. To address the modality inhibitance effect, we propose a new multi-scale modality wavelet (MMWave) multi-modal recommender, which aims to fully capitalize on essential modality features and suppress modal-specific noise. This is acheived by employing wavelet decomposition from a multi-scale (time \& frequency) perspective, ensuring that only essential (non-redundant) features of each modality are extracted. We then account for the latent associations between item modality features by designing a new structure-aware multi-modal graph learning module that captures high-order latent structural information pertaining to items. To modulate the relative contributions of modality features and achieve effective integration, we then propose a new adaptive modality regulator component that employs a new cross-weight integration strategy. Experiments conducted on four real-world datasets validate the efficacy of our proposed model. The source code for this work has been made publicly available at https://github.com/kennethorq/MMWave.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模态抑制效应，指出多模态推荐系统从双模态扩展到三模态时性能显著下降，并设计MMWave模型：利用小波分解从多尺度（时频）提取非冗余核心特征，结合结构感知多模态图学习捕捉高阶潜在结构信息，再通过自适应模态调节器实现跨权重融合，在四个真实数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐系统主要关注模态融合（注意力加权求和或拼接），但从双模态扩展到三模态时会出现模态抑制效应：新引入模态带来的模态特异性噪声污染与过度信息冗余严重阻碍有效融合，导致性能大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出MMWave多模态推荐器：1) 多尺度模态小波分解，从时频双视角提取各模态非冗余核心特征；2) 结构感知多模态图学习模块，捕捉物品模态特征间的高阶潜在结构关联；3) 自适应模态调节器，采用跨权重集成策略动态调节各模态贡献，实现有效融合。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上进行实验，验证了MMWave模型的有效性，优于现有基线方法；源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别并解决模态抑制效应，结合多尺度小波分解、结构感知图学习与自适应跨权重融合，MMWave成功缓解了模态特异性噪声与信息冗余问题，显著提升了三模态及以上配置下的推荐性能。

title: CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection
summary: Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. With identical training tasks, decision-record counts, and updates, perturbation-enriched judge training improves ACPBench-Hard success from 35.38% to 42.12% (+6.73 points). SWE verifier training gains 7.60-9.40 points over interface-matched untrained references. Workflow and post-training evaluations preserve task-solving topology with unperturbed inputs and no private-reference guidance. These results support designing collection conditions to obtain corrective supervision that improves collaborative decisions with frozen solving agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoEvoke 框架，通过受控扰动和受限参考引导收集多智能体协作轨迹（包含检查、反馈、修复），构建含 4,567 条可重构轨迹的数据集，覆盖 4,130 个软件工程和推理任务。实验表明：扰动显著增加反馈频率（47.72-100 百分点），扰动增强的判断器训练使 ACPBench-Hard 成功率提升 6.73 点（35.38%→42.12%），SWE 验证器训练增益 7.60-9.40 点。结论支持通过设计收集条件获取纠正性监督，从而在冻结求解智能体的前提下改进协作决策。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体协作训练缺乏包含检查、反馈、修复交互的高质量轨迹：任务求解轮次往往以即时批准或重复失败告终，缺乏有效的纠正过程。需要在轨迹收集阶段主动诱导这些协作交互。
AI.method: CoEvoke 跨域框架：1) 受控扰动制造可恢复的困难；2) 受限基于参考的引导导向调查。两者结合生成包含证据、决策、任务原生结果的可重构轨迹数据集。
AI.result: 数据集含 4,567 条轨迹覆盖 4,130 任务。2,287 同任务对实验显示：七组扰动使反馈增加 47.72-100 百分点；引导效果较小且依赖模型。相同训练任务、决策记录数和更新下：扰动增强判断器训练提升 ACPBench-Hard 成功率 +6.73 点；SWE 验证器训练比界面匹配的未训练基线增益 7.60-9.40 点。工作流和后训练评估在无扰动输入、无私有参考引导下保持任务求解拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计收集条件（受控扰动+受限引导）获取纠正性监督数据，可在冻结求解智能体的情况下显著改进协作决策质量。该方法跨领域有效，且保持原始任务求解能力。

title: Who Receives Respect? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Honorific Allocation Bias in Bengali
summary: Bengali has no grammatical gender, but honorificity is obligatory: every third-person reference must choose ordinary or respectful register. English has no such signal, so the system must choose a level of deference that the source never specified. We use this property to measure how large language models (LLMs) allocate respect in English--Bengali translation. Our evaluation set contains 2{,}016 sentences across 72 occupations. Each appears in seven sentence frames under four pronoun conditions. Masculine and feminine versions differ by one word, forming counterfactual pairs. We report a single Honorific Bias Score (HBS) for each model on a 0--100 scale, covering both the gender and occupation axes. A lower score means that respect is allocated more evenly. For the occupation analysis, we compute each occupation's honorific rate across the seven no-pronoun sentence frames. The standard deviation of these 72 occupation-level rates ranges from 17.2 to 35.5 percentage points across models, showing substantial variation in how honorifics are allocated across occupations. Occupation is associated with 3.2\% to 51.5\% of the variance in register choice, compared with at most 1.2\% for gender. Gender effects are much smaller overall: only two of the nine models show significant directional gender gaps, and they favor opposite genders. HBS ranges from 19.9 to 70.1 across the nine models, showing substantial variation in how evenly the models allocate respect.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种荣誉偏见分数(HBS)来衡量大语言模型在英译孟加拉语时如何分配敬语，发现职业对敬语选择的影响远大于性别，且不同模型间存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语强制要求第三人称指代选择普通或敬语语域，而英语无此信号，导致翻译系统必须在源文未指定的情况下选择敬语等级，这为测量LLM在翻译中如何分配敬语提供了天然实验场景。
AI.method: 构建包含72个职业、7个句式框架、4种代词条件的2016个句子评测集，阳性/阴性版本仅差一个词形成反事实对。计算每个模型的荣誉偏见分数(HBS，0-100分，分数越低表示敬语分配越均匀)。职业分析基于无代词句框架下的72个职业级敬语率，性别分析基于反事实对。
AI.result: 职业导致的敬语率标准差跨模型为17.2-35.5个百分点，职业解释了3.2%-51.5%的语域选择方差，而性别最多仅解释1.2%。仅9个模型中有2个显示显著性别方向性差距，且偏向相反性别。HBS在9个模型间范围为19.9-70.1，显示模型间在均匀分配敬语上存在巨大差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM在英译孟加拉语时主要根据职业而非性别分配敬语，不同模型的荣誉偏见程度差异巨大，揭示了当前模型在跨语言礼貌规范迁移中的系统性偏见模式。

title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code, rules, lessons, data and evolve reports: https://github.com/agentic-loops-x/Reels-RSI
summary: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reels-RSI系统，将解释性视频视为可读、可审计的程序而非像素序列，在程序层面实现自我改进：通过代码快照记录修订、回顾生成带单元测试的静态规则、基准门控的剧本重写需通过人工决策，实验表明规则能捕获潜在缺陷并作为强/弱导演的审计与护栏，但经验教训不复利，且偏好信号存在位置偏见等四种失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成将解释性视频视为像素生成目标，忽略其程序本质（脚本、分镜、逐帧动画代码）。程序可读、可差分、可测试、可审计，而像素只能观看。需在程序层面而非权重或提示词层面实现自我改进，并建立可追溯、可验证的记忆机制。
AI.method: 开发Reels-RSI开源导演系统：1) 修订记录代码快照；2) 回顾将检查发现与修复差分配对，生成含must-fail/must-pass示例的静态规则（单元测试化）；3) 规则回溯应用于历史作品；4) 基准门控步骤允许代理重写导演手册，仅当盲测成对判决在保留主题上偏好且经人工决策才入库。实验涵盖111条短视频：实地研究、两次手册演化、2×2记忆消融、弱导演对比、48条学习曲线、评判可靠性研究。
AI.result: 1) 实地学到的规则捕获4个规则前存在的潜在缺陷，规则后零缺陷；2) 规则对强导演是审计（8条无护栏短视频零违规），对弱导演是护栏（无护栏30违规vs有护栏5违规）；3) 教训缩短修订循环但不复利、不推动评判分；4) 首次重写11:1大胜实为位置偏见（评判选第二个短视频62-81%），掩盖了用13个事实换取工艺的剧本；5) 记录偏好信号四种失效模式、对应检查与修复。
AI.conclusion: 程序级自我改进配合静态规则记忆、基准门控与人工闸控，能有效捕获缺陷、审计强导演、护栏弱导演，但需警惕偏好信号的位置偏见等失效模式；经验教训虽加速迭代但不累积增益。代码、规则、教训、数据已开源。

title: From a Large-Scale Teacher to Efficient Multimodal Students for Search Relevance Prediction
summary:
Relevance prediction between user queries and items is a fundamental component of e-commerce search systems. Traditionally, high-quality relevance labels are obtained through human judgment, which is reliable but expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable automated relevance judgment at scale, achieving performance comparable to human annotators. However, such systems often rely on large commercial LLMs with complex prompts, resulting in high inference costs and limited throughput.
  In this work, we propose a framework that bridges this gap by distilling a high-performing LLM-based relevance judgment system into efficient multimodal student models. We first curate a small, high-quality human-annotated dataset to serve as ground truth. Using this dataset, we develop a reliable LLM-as-a-judge pipeline through careful prompt engineering and iterative refinement. This pipeline is then used to generate large-scale relevance labels, which serve as training data for compact multimodal models. Our distilled models achieve performance close to the teacher system while significantly improving latency, cost, and scalability. This approach enables practical deployment of high-quality relevance prediction systems in production environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种框架，将基于大语言模型（LLM）的相关性判断系统蒸馏为高效的多模态学生模型，以解决商业LLM推理成本高、吞吐低的问题，实现高质量相关性预测的生产部署。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索中用户查询与商品的相关性预测依赖高质量标签，人工标注虽可靠但昂贵、缓慢且难扩展；LLM虽能自动判断且性能媲美人工，但大型商业LLM配合复杂提示词导致推理成本高、吞吐受限，难以大规模落地。
AI.method: 1. 精选小规模高质量人工标注数据集作为真值；2. 通过精心提示词工程和迭代优化，构建可靠的LLM-as-a-judge流水线；3. 利用该流水线生成大规模相关性标签作为训练数据；4. 训练紧凑的多模态学生模型，实现知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的多模态学生模型性能接近教师LLM系统，同时显著降低延迟、成本并提升可扩展性，适合生产环境部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM标注辅助的知识蒸馏，可将高性能但昂贵的LLM相关性判断能力迁移至轻量级多模态模型，兼顾质量与效率，为电商搜索相关性预测提供实用的大规模部署方案。

title: OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model by supervising a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy, but its supervision remains confined to the output space. Consequently, OPD transfers what a teacher predicts without supervising the intermediate computation that produces those predictions. Simply distilling intermediate representations like representation matching is insufficient since teacher and student representations may differ geometrically, and even well-aligned hidden states need not be usable by the student's subsequent computation. We introduce On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD), which transfers teacher-derived intermediate computation while explicitly accounting for its compatibility with the student. OPMD first constructs a student-compatible teacher that transforms teacher representations into intermediate states usable by the student's downstream computation, then it internalizes these states from on-policy trajectories. OPMD achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated distillation baselines in all three teacher--student settings, and generalizes to multi-teacher distillation and cross-family supervised fine-tuning. Further analyses show that mechanism supervision yields more effective reasoning and meaningfully alters the student's intermediate computation and solution strategies, supporting that it transfers information beyond output supervision alone. Together, these results establish mechanism-level supervision as an effective way to move on-policy distillation beyond output supervision, enabling students to learn inner mechanisms they can use and internalize.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD)，通过构建学生兼容的教师模型将教师的中间表示转换为学生可用的中间状态，并在 on-policy 轨迹上内化这些状态，从而超越输出空间监督，实现机制层面的知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有的 on-policy distillation (OPD) 仅在输出空间监督学生，无法迁移产生预测的中间计算过程；单纯的表示匹配因教师与学生表示的几何差异及下游计算兼容性问题而不足。需要一种能显式考虑教师中间计算与学生兼容性的机制蒸馏方法。
AI.method: OPMD 分两步：1) 构建学生兼容教师，通过变换教师表示使其成为学生下游计算可用的中间状态；2) 在 on-policy 轨迹上内化这些学生兼容的中间状态，实现机制层面的蒸馏。
AI.result: 在三种教师-学生设置中，OPMD 平均准确率最高，优于所有蒸馏基线；泛化到多教师蒸馏和跨模型家族监督微调。进一步分析显示机制监督带来更有效的推理，并有意义地改变学生的中间计算与解题策略。
AI.conclusion: 机制层面的监督是让 on-policy distillation 超越输出监督的有效途径，能使学生学习并内化可用的内部机制。

title: Training-Free BioNEL-RAG: Advancing Biomedical Entity Linking through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model
summary: Biomedical Named Entity Linking (BioNEL) is the task of mapping mentions extracted from biomedical texts to canonical entities or concepts in the standardized knowledge base. Although existing methods have achieved remarkable performance in mapping accuracy, most rely on training with domain-specific datasets, which fundamentally limits their cross-domain adaptability. To address this limitation, we propose BioNEL-RAG, a novel training-free framework that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs). Within this framework, the RAG module focuses on retrieving candidate entities, while the large language model module plays the role of selecting the most appropriate candidate for entity normalization, which is based on the analysis of the mention's context, with the aid of its remarkable text comprehension capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that BioNEL-RAG achieves performance comparable to existing methods without requiring training on subdomain datasets, whereas these methods necessitate fine-tuning on specific subdomains such as genes, diseases, or chemical compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BioNEL-RAG，一个无需训练的生物医学实体链接框架，结合检索增强生成（RAG）与大语言模型（LLM），在不依赖特定子领域训练数据的情况下实现了与现有方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的生物医学实体链接方法虽然准确率高，但大多依赖特定领域数据集训练，导致跨域适应性受限，无法直接应用于新的生物医学子领域（如基因、疾病、化学化合物等）。
AI.method: 提出BioNEL-RAG框架：RAG模块负责检索候选实体，LLM模块利用其强大的文本理解能力，结合提及词的上下文信息，从候选实体中选择最合适的实体进行规范化。该框架完全无需训练，即插即用。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，BioNEL-RAG在不进行子领域微调的情况下，性能与现有需针对特定子领域（基因、疾病、化合物等）微调的方法相当，展示了优秀的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: BioNEL-RAG通过RAG与LLM的协作，成功解决了生物医学实体链接的跨域适应性难题，为无监督、免训练的实体链接提供了新范式，具有广泛的实际应用价值。

title: MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation
summary: Generative modeling offers a promising solution to the scarcity of labeled clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data under strict privacy constraints. Although recent generative models report substantial improvements in generation fidelity, we show that these gains conceal a categorical failure. EEG is not an arbitrary multichannel signal: each channel records the voltage difference between two scalp electrodes. So, real recordings satisfy exact linear identities among their channels. Current generators invariably violate these identities, yet this has gone unnoticed. We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them. We find that ensuring validity improves fidelity too. Furthermore, to retain the EEG characteristics that oversmoothing washes out, we also condition the model on a physiological state vector encoded from the whole EEG window. For generation, this vector is drawn from a prior fitted in latent space. Across 3 large-scale benchmarks, our model improves TS-FID by 1.6-3.6$\times$ over the closest rival while ensuring validity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对临床EEG数据稀缺和隐私限制问题，提出MontageFlow生成模型，通过强制满足EEG导联间的线性恒等式（物理约束）并引发生理状态向量条件，实现了有效且高保真的EEG信号生成，在三个大规模基准上TS-FID提升1.6-3.6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型虽在生成保真度上有所提升，但忽略了EEG信号的物理特性：各导联记录的是两个头皮电极间的电压差，真实EEG需满足通道间的精确线性恒等式。当前生成器普遍违反这些约束，导致生成信号物理无效，且过度平滑丢失了关键EEG特征。
AI.method: 提出MontageFlow流匹配模型：1) 将输出空间限制在满足导联线性恒等式的有效信号子空间，强制物理约束；2) 引入从整个EEG窗口编码的生理状态向量作为条件，保留被过度平滑冲淡的EEG特征；3) 生成时从潜在空间拟合的先验分布采样该生理状态向量。
AI.result: 在三个大规模EEG基准测试中，MontageFlow的TS-FID较最强竞争对手提升1.6-3.6倍，同时保证生成信号满足物理有效性约束。实验表明强制有效性反而提升了生成保真度，生理状态条件有效缓解了过度平滑问题。
AI.conclusion: 在EEG生成中显式建模物理约束（导联线性恒等式）不仅确保信号有效性，还能提升生成质量；结合全局生理状态条件可保留精细EEG特征。该工作揭示了领域知识约束对生成模型的双重益处，为临床EEG数据增强提供了可靠方案。

title: WeGR: Unified Generative Retrieval for Industrial Search Systems in WeChat
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) offers a promising paradigm for industrial search by unifying candidate generation within an autoregressive framework. However, its effectiveness is limited by two key challenges. First, existing Semantic ID (SID) tokenizers struggle to incorporate collaborative signals while maintaining effective codebook utilization, limiting their ability to distinguish items and achieve high-quality retrieval. Second, existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods suffer from severe reward sparsity under exact SID matching, leaving many sampled trajectories without effective learning signals and hindering preference optimization. To address these challenges, we propose WeGR, a unified generative retrieval framework consisting of two complementary components. Specifically, the Collaborative and Collapse-free Tokenizer (CoCo-VAE) incorporates query-to-item and item-to-item collaborative signals while mitigating codebook collapse through codebook refresh and complementary regularization, enabling more informative and balanced SID representations. Building upon these SIDs, Dynamic Horizon Policy Optimization (DHPO) progressively expands both reward evaluation and policy optimization horizons, reducing learning difficulty while leveraging behavioral reward signals at different levels of the SID hierarchy, without relying on auxiliary reward models. Extensive offline experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WeGR in improving retrieval and ranking performance. Moreover, a two-month online A/B test in WeChat E-commerce Search demonstrates relative improvements of 2.539% in orders, 1.508% in click-through rate, and 1.381% in conversion rate, while reducing online CPU and GPU usage by 25.5% and 26.1%, respectively. The system has been successfully deployed across multiple search scenarios in WeChat, serving billions of users, generating tens of millions of PVs daily.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WeGR 框架，包含 CoCo-VAE 分词器和 DHPO 策略优化，解决生成式检索中语义 ID 分词器难以融合协同信号及代码本利用率低、强化学习奖励稀疏等问题。离线实验与微信电商搜索在线 A/B 测试均显著提升检索排序指标并降低算力消耗，已大规模部署。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索（GR）虽统一了候选生成，但面临两大挑战：1) 现有语义 ID（SID）分词器难以同时融合查询-物品与物品-物品协同信号并保持代码本有效利用，导致物品区分度不足；2) 基于精确 SID 匹配的强化学习方法存在严重奖励稀疏，大量采样轨迹缺乏有效学习信号，阻碍偏好优化。
AI.method: WeGR 由两部分组成：1) 协同免崩塌分词器：引入查询-物品和物品-物品协同信号，通过代码本刷新与互补正则化缓解代码本崩塌，学习更具信息量且平衡的 SID 表示。2) 动态视野策略优化：逐步扩展奖励评估与策略优化的视野，利用 SID 层级不同层级的行为奖励信号，无需辅助奖励模型即可降低学习难度。
AI.result: 离线实验验证 WeGR 有效提升检索与排序性能。在微信电商搜索为期两个月的在线 A/B 测试中，订单量相对提升 2.539%、点击率提升 1.508%、转化率提升 1.381%，同时在线 CPU 与 GPU 使用率分别降低 25.5% 和 26.1%。系统已在微信多个搜索场景部署，服务数十亿用户，日均产生数千万 PV。
AI.conclusion: WeGR 通过 CoCo-VAE 解决 SID 分词器的协同建模与代码本利用问题，通过 DHPO 缓解强化学习奖励稀疏，实现了工业级生成式检索的显著性能提升与算力节省，已在微信大规模落地，证明了该统一框架的实用性与可扩展性。

title: Historical Anchors for Scientific Forecasting on Human-Aware Knowledge Graphs
summary: Predicting which scientific connections will form next can point researchers toward the most promising leads. One successful approach learns representations by sampling paths through publication networks, represented by a hypergraph, that connect scientific entities, concepts, and researchers, approximating how knowledge and expertise move through the literature. Sampled paths are then used to train an embedding model to forecast scientific connections such as a property of a material. Performance, however, depends strongly on how many paths are sampled: too little sampling yields incomplete representations, while further sampling can eventually weaken prediction quality. The best sampling budget is therefore often identifiable only after future discoveries are known. We introduce Query--Anchor Agreement (QAA), a diagnostic requiring no future labels or separately trained model. QAA can be used to select a sampling budget, and refine or re-rank the resulting forecast to improve forecasting scientific connections. QAA compares the candidates a model predicts for a target with those most similar to the target's known historical examples, and identifies when these two views converge. Across thermoelectric-material and COVID-19 drug-repurposing benchmarks, repeated random-seed runs, and three sampling policies, QAA-selected budgets fall on average 1.86 percentage points below hindsight-optimal selection for broad candidate recovery. Further, promoting candidates supported by both views, under a capped fusion that bounds the anchor contribution, improves broad recovery across all six benchmark-policy settings, which define the types of network walks used for sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Query-Anchor Agreement (QAA)诊断方法，用于在无需未来标签的情况下选择超图路径采样预算，并融合模型预测与历史锚点相似候选以提升科学连接预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于超图路径采样的科学知识表示学习方法，其预测性能高度依赖采样预算：采样过少导致表示不完整，过多反而降低预测质量；而最优预算通常只能事后确定，缺乏无需未来标签的自适应选择机制。
AI.method: 提出QAA诊断，对比模型预测的候选集与目标历史实例最相似的锚点候选集，识别两者收敛点以确定采样预算；并设计上限融合策略，将两视角一致支持的候选提升排名，同时限制锚点贡献权重。
AI.result: 在热电材料和COVID-19药物再利用两个基准上，QAA选定预算平均比事后最优选择仅低1.86个百分点；融合策略在所有六个基准-采样策略设置下均显著提升广义候选召回率。
AI.conclusion: QAA提供了一种无需外部监督的自适应采样预算选择与预测优化框架，通过双视角一致性有效缓解采样预算敏感性问题，为科学发现预测提供实用工具。

title: Dependency Reasoning for Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction
summary: Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction (ASQP) is fundamentally a relational reasoning problem: identifying aspect-opinion-category-sentiment quadruples requires modeling structured dependencies, not merely sequential co-occurrence. Existing LLM-based approaches incorporate syntactic information indirectly, via retrieval-based demonstration selection or multi-stage training, rather than as unified, single-pass generation-time context. We present DRIFT, which linearizes dependency parse trees and injects them directly into LLM prompts as explicit relational context, enabling the model to reason over aspect-opinion dependencies rather than infer them from token proximity alone. DRIFT further integrates retrieval-augmented in-context learning and a syntax-aware LLM-based adjudication mechanism that complements exact-match evaluation under span-boundary variation. On SemEval Rest15, Rest16, and ACOS, DRIFT achieves the strongest performance among compared generative ASQP methods, reaching 54.47% and 64.10% F1 on Rest15 and Rest16, with consistent gains across short- and medium-distance aspect-opinion configurations; adjudication further shows exact-match metrics systematically underestimate semantically correct predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRIFT框架，通过将依存句法树线性化并直接注入LLM提示词，解决方面情感四元组预测(ASQP)中的关系推理问题，在Rest15、Rest16和ACOS数据集上达到生成式ASQP方法的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的ASQP方法仅通过检索式演示选择或多阶段训练间接融入句法信息，缺乏统一的单轮生成时上下文，无法显式建模方面-观点-类别-情感四元组间的结构化依赖关系。
AI.method: DRIFT将依存句法树线性化并作为显式关系上下文直接注入LLM提示词，结合检索增强的上下文学习和句法感知的LLM裁决机制，实现对方面-观点依赖的显式推理，并解决跨度边界变化下的评估偏差。
AI.result: 在SemEval Rest15、Rest16和ACOS数据集上，DRIFT在生成式ASQP方法中表现最优，Rest15达到54.47% F1，Rest16达到64.10% F1，在短距离和中距离方面-观点配置上均有稳定提升；裁决机制揭示精确匹配指标系统性低估语义正确预测。
AI.conclusion: 显式注入句法结构作为生成时上下文显著提升ASQP的关系推理能力，且基于LLL的语义裁决比精确匹配更能反映模型真实性能，为结构化情感分析提供了新范式。

title: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
comment: 17 pages, 17 figures, 19 references. Public-data component audit; recursive improvement is specified as a protocol and not experimentally demonstrated
summary: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

AI.tldr: ScienceBuddy-PV将ScienceBuddy的递归设计应用于全血管介入研究，审计了固定组件（而非完整智能体系统），在ARCADE语法和狭窄任务上评估了共享任务掩码卷积模型，结果显示语法Dice为0.475，狭窄Dice为0.231，支持门控接受76.7%输出，构建掩码审计中接受44.3%参考候选。该研究提供可复现的组件审计协议，但未演示递归改进、患者级有效性或临床设备推荐。
AI.motivation: 旨在将ScienceBuddy的递归递归设计适配至全血管介入研究，通过结构化证据台账、器械-血管本体、弃权契约和保留失败库等机制，建立可测量、可复现的组件审计协议，为未来协作智能体研究提供基准。
AI.method: 采用固定组件审计而非完整智能体系统，使用ARCADE语法任务和狭窄任务（各1000训练/200验证/300测试图像）。训练共享任务掩码卷积模型，固定参数和启发式支持门控，在验证集选定狭窄阈值。评估指标包括Dice系数、AUROC、AUPRC、门控接受率及构建掩码审计。
AI.result: 锁定测试集上语法Dice 0.475（95% CI 0.459-0.490），狭窄Dice 0.231（95% CI 0.214-0.249）。狭窄像素AUROC 0.957，AUPRC 0.180（患病率0.00975）。支持门控接受76.7%狭窄帧输出（评分仅比较器100%）。构建掩码审计中接受44.3%参考候选，拒绝55.7%，暴露弃权成本。接受不代表正确性或临床安全。
AI.conclusion: 该公开数据组件审计使支持与弃权可度量，提供可复现的协作智能体研究协议。但未演示递归改进、患者级有效性或临床设备推荐，接受输出不等同于正确性或临床安全。

title: HASTE: Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation models have shown promising results by representing items as semantic IDs and generating these IDs autoregressively.
