title: Variance Fingerprints: Component-Wise Identification of Content Factors by Augmentation Design
summary: Augmentation-based self-supervised learning can recover the content shared across views without separating its underlying factors into individual coordinates. We ask whether augmentations can be designed to make those factors identifiable. Our approach allows content factors to fluctuate across augmented views while preserving their mean for each source instance. Each instance receives a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths that controls how much its factors fluctuate. When factors respond differently to changes in these strengths, their patterns of variation provide information that distinguishes them. Under suitable decoder and support assumptions, we prove that these differences identify individual factors in a conditional Gaussian model, up to permutation, scaling, and translation. We then develop a learner that uses the recorded strengths to estimate these patterns jointly across instances, enabling learning from few views per instance. Synthetic experiments demonstrate near-perfect factor recovery through nonlinear mixing. Controlled dSprites experiments show improved coordinate alignment using augmentations that target known factors, even without telling the learner which augmentation corresponds to which representation coordinate. These results suggest a route to component identification in self-supervised learning: augmentation design can supply identifying information beyond shared content alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于增强的自监督学习方法，通过设计可控的增强强度使潜在因子可识别。核心思想是让内容因子在增强视图间波动但保持均值不变，利用不同因子对增强强度的差异响应模式来区分因子，在条件高斯模型下证明可识别性（至排列、缩放、平移），并开发了联合估计学习器，实验验证了在非线性混合和dSprites数据上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于增强的自监督学习仅能恢复视图间共享的内容，无法将底层因子分离到独立坐标。作者探讨能否通过设计增强策略使这些因子可识别，即利用增强强度的变化提供超越共享内容的识别信息。
AI.method: 1. 设计增强策略：为每个实例分配固定的增强强度集合，控制因子波动幅度但保持因子均值不变。2. 利用因子对增强强度的差异响应模式区分因子。3. 在条件高斯模型假设下，证明因子可识别至排列、缩放、平移。4. 开发学习器：使用记录的增强强度联合估计跨实例的因子变化模式，支持少视图学习。
AI.result: 合成实验展示非线性混合下的近完美因子恢复。受控dSprites实验显示，使用针对已知因子的增强可改善坐标对齐，即使未告知学习器增强与表示坐标的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 增强设计可提供超越共享内容的识别信息，为自监督学习中的成分识别提供了一条可行路径。通过精心设计的增强强度变化，可使潜在因子在无监督条件下实现可识别性。

title: MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

AI.tldr: 提出MHWA（多时间尺度层级世界-动作模型），通过步进高层语境通道降低全局语境更新频率，并采用语境感知路由动态重配低层专家混合，有效抑制自回归世界模型的漂移累积，在Atari离线RL基准上以77M参数达成0.884 IQM HNS，超越同参数量基线且性能逼近双参数量模型，训练FLOPs降低70.88%。
AI.motivation: 自回归世界模型在开环推演中存在漂移累积问题，限制了规划时界。层级时序抽象虽能缩短有效预测时界，但现有层级设计引入结构与概念复杂度，难以控制且收益有限。需要一种既能抑制漂移又保持灵活高低层协调的层级架构。
AI.method: MHWA包含两大创新：1) 步进高层语境通道，以更低频率更新全局语境，减少复合漂移传播；2) 语境感知路由门控网络，结合全局语境与当前观测动态重配低层专家混合，实现灵活高低层协调，缓解静态层级的干扰问题。
AI.result: 在14个Atari游戏10%离线数据子集上，MHWA（77M参数）三种子实验IQM人类归一化分数达0.884，显著优于JOWA-70M基线（0.529），性能数值上逼近JOWA-150M，同时参数量减半、训练FLOPs每序列降低70.88%。
AI.conclusion: MHWA通过步进高层语境与动态专家路由，在保持模型简洁的前提下有效解决自回归世界模型的漂移问题，实现了参数效率与样本效率的双重提升，为层级世界模型提供了新的设计范式。

title: Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions
summary: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. Adding a second indexed description improves character TF-IDF by 7.0 percentage points on matched queries. These results quantify the influence of reference wording and representation choice on instruction-to-task retrieval under a consistent evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在RLBench操作基准中，从短指令识别机器人任务对参考描述措辞和检索表示方法的敏感性。通过比较五种无训练词法排序器，发现字符n-gram TF-IDF在top-1准确率上达到61.3%，显著优于BM25（55.6%）和词级TF-IDF（54.9%）。增加第二个索引描述可使字符TF-IDF性能提升7.0个百分点。结果量化了参考措辞和表示选择对指令到任务检索的影响。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务识别对可用描述的检索高度敏感，现有工作缺乏系统性量化评估不同词法表示和参考措辞对检索性能的影响。本文旨在建立一致的评估协议，量化这些因素在RLBench基准上的具体影响。
AI.method: 从62个公开任务文件中提取296个固定描述，排除分配给冲突任务标签的完全相同字符串。在80次随机选择的单索引描述每任务的实验中，比较五种无训练词法排序器（字符n-gram TF-IDF、词级TF-IDF、BM25等）。评估指标为top-1准确率，并分析不同画廊选择下的性能分布及增加第二个索引描述的效果。
AI.result: 字符n-gram TF-IDF在保留指令上达到61.3%平均top-1准确率，优于BM25（55.6%）和词级TF-IDF（54.9%）。跨画廊选择时，字符TF-IDF范围55.2%-66.8%，第5-95百分位区间为56.9%-64.8%。增加第二个索引描述使字符TF-IDF在匹配查询上提升7.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 参考措辞和表示选择对指令到任务检索有显著影响。字符n-gram TF-IDF是当前无训练词法排序器中的最佳选择，且通过增加索引描述可进一步大幅提升性能。这些结果为机器人任务检索系统的设计提供了量化依据。

title: The RNN Homunculus: Learning to Gate Long-Term Memory
summary: Learning long-range dependencies with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is difficult because of the vanishing gradient problem. Gated recurrent neural networks like GRUs and LSTMs address this problem and are commonly explained by their ability to create additive copy paths through time. This explanation is correct, but incomplete: useful RNN gate values must themselves be learned, which is typically done with another RNN. We study this gate-learning problem through carefully controlled sequence classification tasks. Our analysis shows that gated architectures struggle when all training samples require long-range memory and thus equally suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. We intervene by adding short-dependency samples which let gated models learn solutions that capture long-dependency samples, but also generalize across different class labels. When properly learned, gated RNNs match or even exceed the test accuracy of modern architectures like Mamba and xLSTM. Overall, our results highlight gate learning as a central part of learning long-range memory and show how training data can support this process by exposing the same task over shorter dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究门控循环神经网络（GRU/LSTM）学习长距离依赖的核心问题——门控值本身的学习过程。实验表明：当所有训练样本都需要长距离记忆时，门控架构因梯度消失而难以学习门控值；引入短依赖样本可帮助模型学习可泛化的门控策略，从而解决长依赖任务，性能可媲美或超越Mamba和xLSTM等现代架构。
AI.motivation: 现有解释认为门控RNN通过加性复制路径解决梯度消失，但忽略了门控值本身需要通过另一个RNN学习，这同样面临梯度消失问题。本文旨在系统分析门控学习这一核心瓶颈，并探索训练数据如何辅助这一过程。
AI.method: 设计受控的序列分类任务，系统变换训练样本中长短依赖的比例。对比纯长依赖训练与混合长短依赖训练下门控RNN的学习动态、泛化能力及最终性能，并与Mamba、xLSTM等现代架构对比。
AI.result: 纯长依赖训练导致门控RNN完全失败；引入短依赖样本后，模型能学习到可跨标签泛化的门控策略，成功解决长依赖任务。充分训练后的门控RNN在测试准确率上匹配甚至超过Mamba和xLSTM。
AI.conclusion: 门控值的学习是长距离记忆习得的核心瓶颈。训练数据若包含同一任务的短依赖实例，可为门控学习提供梯度信号，从而支持长距离记忆的形成。这揭示了数据课程设计对门控架构的关键作用。

title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
summary: We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%. It also reduces average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k. Sequent-Prover agents give answers backed by executable formal artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sequent-Prover，一系列使用验证器的语言模型智能体及其后训练框架。智能体在可执行的 SMT-LIB 临时板中推理：编写完整的 SMT-LIB 程序，多轮查询 Z3 求解器，检查求解器反馈，修复形式化，最后给出明确答案。核心方法是“验证器条件轨迹蒸馏”：从噪声教师策略采样多轮轨迹，保留正确、非平凡、有依据且可执行的成功尾部，再进行监督微调和轨迹级偏好优化。实验表明，后训练将 4B 模型的单次尝试准确率从 85.6% 提升至 97.0%，四样本全正确可靠性从 64.1% 提升至 91.7%，同时平均 SMT 调用次数从 4.10 降至 2.52，每次尝试 token 数从 18.97k 降至 12.72k。Sequent-Prover 智能体能给出由可执行形式化工件支撑的答案。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型在形式化推理任务中常缺乏可靠的验证机制，且单纯依赖求解器成功不能保证语义忠实性。需要一种能将自然语言推理与形式化验证紧密结合、并能通过后训练显著提升准确性、可靠性和效率的智能体框架。
AI.method: 提出验证器条件轨迹蒸馏框架：1) 从噪声教师策略采样多轮交互轨迹，智能体在 SMT-LIB 临时板中编写程序、调用 Z3、根据反馈修复；2) 筛选保留正确、非平凡、有依据且可执行的成功轨迹尾部；3) 对筛选轨迹进行监督微调；4) 再应用轨迹级偏好优化进一步对齐。评估指标包括任务准确率、k-样本可靠性和 SMT 程序质量。
AI.result: 在 37 个基准、7,254 道题目上，后训练使 4B 模型单次尝试准确率从 85.6% 提升至 97.0%，四样本全正确可靠性从 64.1% 提升至 91.7%。平均 SMT 调用次数从 4.10 降至 2.52，每次尝试 token 数从 18.97k 降至 12.72k。智能体输出的答案附带可执行的形式化工件。
AI.conclusion: Sequent-Prover 展示了将语言模型与 SMT 求解器深度集成、通过验证器条件轨迹蒸馏进行后训练，能大幅提升形式化推理的准确性、可靠性和效率，生成的答案具有可验证的形式化支撑，为可信 AI 推理提供了切实可行的路径。

title: Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems
summary: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA)，一种工具增强的策略智能体，通过总结优化轨迹并规划策略，解决 OPRO 优化过程难以追踪的问题，提升基于 LLM 的优化解质量与可追踪性。
AI.motivation: OPRO 直接利用 LLM 通过自然语言提示生成候选解，但其优化过程难以追踪，导致 LLM 无法捕捉前序迭代积累的有用信息，从而限制了解的质量。
AI.method: 提出 TASA：基于优化轨迹为每一步规划策略，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择；利用 LLM 构建问题特定工具，并引入策略引导的自适应工具规划器，高效利用轨迹信息更新解。
AI.result: 在共享候选评估预算下评估完整框架，结果支持其解质量和策略引导搜索的可追踪性；同时在持久探索条件下建立了局部收敛性。
AI.conclusion: TASA 通过轨迹总结与策略规划，有效解决了 OPRO 的可追踪性缺陷，显著提升了基于 LLM 优化的解质量与可解释性。

title: Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made
comment: A timestamp theory of LLM decision validity with a decision ledger
summary: Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger's index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.

AI.tldr: 论文提出时间戳决策有效性理论和决策账本，通过六个时间戳定义决策，引入新鲜度上界，将准确性分解为路由和时间判断两项能力，实验在五个LLM上验证四个预测，表明新鲜度使决策在制定时正确，路由和时间判断使其在执行时保持正确。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM决策在制定与执行之间时间间隔内世界状态变化导致的决策失效问题，建立形式化理论量化新鲜度对决策有效性的保障，并设计机制在执行时维持决策正确性。
AI.method: 1) 提出时间戳理论：六个时间戳定义决策，新鲜度上界界定行动时刻最新证据保证。2) 设计决策账本：持久化存储决策时间、证据、背景知识，按决策时编写的观察条件索引。3) 将准确性分解为路由（在修订截止前将信息送达受影响决策）和时间判断（为行动时刻解读信息）。4) 构建受控决策流与精确标签，在五个规模LLM（8B至前沿）上实验验证四个预测。
AI.result: 实验确认四个预测：1) 仅新鲜度即产生上界预测的准确性；2) 模型在关键新闻到达时采取行动，准确性随路由变化；3) 账本索引决定路由覆盖范围，观察条件以低暴露触达间接依赖；4) 剩余错误集中在变化生效时刻的判断上。
AI.conclusion: 新鲜度保证决策在制定瞬间正确；路由与时间判断协同保证决策在后续执行时保持正确。决策账本通过观察条件索引实现了高效的信息触达与依赖追踪，为时变环境下的LLM决策提供了理论与工程框架。

title: Layer-wise Input Recoverability in Deep Neural Networks
summary: The inner workings of deep neural networks are still not well understood. The information bottleneck framework, which characterizes deep networks by the mutual information between their hidden representations and the network's input, has been used to identify compression of input information with respect to an input image and output labels. We instead study how much of a layer's own input is recoverable from the layer's output in convolutional neural networks (CNNs). A convolutional layer applies its filters to one input patch at a time, so we evaluate recoverability on sampled input patches with a reconstruction-based probe and not on the entire feature map. The probe's size thus depends on channels and kernel size and not on feature map size, which lets our method scale to deep CNNs with wide feature maps. For each layer, we compare pretrained, random, and reconstruction-optimized encoders, using linear and linear-plus-residual-MLP decoders. We measure recoverability as $R^2$ between input patches and their reconstructions on a held-out set. Across nine ImageNet CNNs, recoverability generally decreases with depth but is more consistently predicted by the compression of the layer. Learning-attributed recoverability, the difference between pretrained and random encoders, is not uniform across architectures. We introduce single-property random controls, which transfer one pretrained property onto a random encoder, and find that each control changes recoverability with a consistent sign across models: copying pretrained singular vectors tends to raise recoverability, while copying the pretrained singular-value spectrum or activation sparsity lowers it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究卷积神经网络中各层输入从输出中恢复的程度，提出基于重建探针的可恢复性度量，发现可恢复性随深度下降且与层压缩率相关，学习带来的可恢复性增益因架构而异，并通过单属性随机控制实验揭示奇异向量、奇异值谱和激活稀疏性对可恢复性的不同影响。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络内部机制尚未完全理解，现有的信息瓶颈框架关注隐藏表示与输入/标签的互信息，但忽略了层级输入从输出中恢复的局部特性。作者旨在从层输入恢复的角度量化CNN各层的信息保留能力，并探究预训练、随机初始化及重建优化编码器的差异，以及特定预训练属性对可恢复性的因果影响。
AI.method: 采用基于重建的探针方法：从卷积层输入中采样补丁，用线性解码器及线性加残差MLP解码器从层输出重建输入补丁，以R²衡量可恢复性。对比预训练、随机、重建优化三种编码器；引入单属性随机控制，将预训练的奇异向量、奇异值谱、激活稀疏性分别迁移到随机编码器上，观察可恢复性变化。实验覆盖九个ImageNet预训练CNN模型。
AI.result: 可恢复性普遍随网络深度降低，但更稳定地由层压缩率预测。学习归因的可恢复性（预训练与随机编码器之差）在不同架构间不一致。单属性控制显示：复制预训练奇异向量提升可恢复性，复制奇异值谱或激活稀疏性则降低可恢复性，且方向在各模型中一致。
AI.conclusion: 层输入可恢复性是理解CNN信息流的有效视角，其受层压缩率主导而非单纯深度。预训练赋予的可恢复性增益依赖架构，奇异向量促进信息保留，而奇异值谱和稀疏性可能引入压缩损失。单属性随机控制为离散预训练属性因果效应提供了新工具。

title: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
summary: Large language models are typically evaluated in terms of the correctness of their output. However, output correctness alone does not confirm whether the latent knowledge supporting an answer has stable internal representations. We therefore propose latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) to investigate the stability of individual knowledge states and their relational structure, respectively. Specifically, we first separately average the model's internal representations of the same knowledge under each elicitation condition. Using the mean representation under the baseline condition as a reference, we remove shared shifts to obtain corrected representations. We then formulate LSS as the distance between each corrected representation and its reference representation, normalized against the typical distance between knowledge items of the same type. We formulate KTS as the cross-condition consistency of the ordered pairwise representation distances among knowledge items of the same type. Next, we construct EpiStableBench, which comprises 4,411 items spanning factual knowledge and mathematical reasoning, with 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs from four families, representation stability varies substantially even among items answered correctly under the base condition. Within models, higher stability generally corresponds to higher accuracy under held-out elicitation conditions; across models, stability does not consistently increase with model size or overall accuracy. Meanwhile, we present LatentDPO to learn a knowledge-editing policy that accounts for the stability of latent knowledge. Experimental results show that integrating LatentDPO with multiple existing editing methods consistently improves editing success and generalization across different expressions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出潜在状态稳定性（LSS）和知识拓扑稳定性（KTS）两项指标，量化大语言模型内部知识表示的稳定性；构建EpiStableBench基准，在16个LLM上发现：即便基线条件下回答正确，表示稳定性差异巨大；模型内部稳定性与泛化准确率正相关，但跨模型稳定性不随规模或整体准确率单调增加；提出LatentDPO知识编辑策略，结合现有编辑方法可提升编辑成功率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅关注输出正确性，无法确认支撑答案的潜在知识内部表示是否稳定；需从单个知识状态（LSS）及知识间关系结构（KTS）两个层面，系统度量内部表示在不同激发条件下的稳定性，以更全面地评估模型知识的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 提出LSS与KTS指标：对同一知识在各激发条件下的内部表示分别求均值，以基线条件均值为参考去除共享偏移得到校正表示；LSS定义为校正表示与参考表示的距离，并按同类知识典型距离归一化；KTS定义为同类知识项两两表示距离序在跨条件下的一致性。2) 构建EpiStableBench，包含4,411个知识项（事实与数学推理）及76,766个受控查询。3) 在四大家族共16个LLM上实证分析。4) 提出LatentDPO，纳入潜在知识稳定性的知识编辑策略，并与多种现有编辑方法结合。
AI.result: 实验显示：(1) 即使基线条件下回答正确，不同知识项的表示稳定性差异显著；(2) 同一模型内，稳定性越高的知识项在保留条件下的准确率越高；(3) 跨模型比较中，稳定性不随模型规模或整体准确率单调提升；(4) 将LatentDPO与现有编辑方法结合，能一致提升编辑成功率及对不同表达形式的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 潜在知识表示的稳定性是评估LLM知识可靠性的关键维度，超越单纯的输出正确性；显式优化内部表示稳定性（如LatentDPO）可有效增强知识编辑的成功率与泛化性能，为构建更鲁棒的模型知识系统提供了新路径。

title: SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability
summary: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE (Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy)，一种用于极低比特权重量化的向量量化方法。通过能量分层分组 (ESG) 保护敏感通道，以及自适应比特分割 (ABS) 优化方向码本容量与半径精度的分配，在2-bit量化设置下实现SOTA性能，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上保留95.3% BF16基准分数，并通过自定义CUDA内核实现高达2.55倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有向量量化 (VQ) 方法在3比特以下量化时仍存在显著精度下降，两大设计挑战未被充分探索：(1) 如何在联合编码的向量中保护敏感权重通道；(2) 如何在固定比特预算下，为不同权重矩阵最优分配表示组件（如方向与半径）的比特。
AI.method: 提出SAGE框架，包含两大核心组件：1) 能量分层分组 (ESG) - 将通道按激活加权能量分层，跨层级混合分组以优先保护敏感通道；2) 自适应比特分割 (ABS) - 在固定比特预算下，为每个权重矩阵搜索最优的方向码本比特与半径精度比特分配，最小化激活加权重构误差。
AI.result: 在知识、数学、代码生成、指令遵循和工具使用等多项基准测试中，SAGE在2-bit量化设置下达到最先进性能。在Qwen3-30B-A3B模型上，保留95.3% BF16模型的平均基准分数。配合自定义CUDA内核，相较FP16实现高达2.55倍非流式端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过能量感知的通道分组策略和自适应的比特预算分配机制，有效解决了极低比特向量量化中的敏感通道保护与表示组件比特分配两大核心挑战，显著提升了2-bit权重量化的精度与部署效率，为大语言模型的低比特量化部署提供了实用的高性能方案。

title: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
summary: Autonomous research agents must acquire and reason over evidence within a limited budget. Yet relevant sources can remain uninspected or unused, leaving a gap between retrieval coverage and the evidence that informs research. The challenge is to align fast local judgments with changing evidence needs and feed their findings back into research decisions. We introduce JevGPT, a dual-system architecture for autonomous research that couples fast evidence processing with deliberative research planning. System Two sets evidence objectives and integrates findings, while System One locates support, assesses relevance, and guides further inspection. Independent source judgments run in parallel; selected original passages inform the next research step. Experiments on fixed-corpus question answering and document ranking show that JevGPT achieves leading task performance, with faster completion and lower cost than comparably effective research agents. Evidence analysis shows broader source inspection and greater coverage of supporting documents in the research loop, highlighting efficient evidence processing as a route to more capable autonomous research.

AI.tldr: JevGPT 是一种用于自主研究的双系统架构，结合快速证据处理（系统一）与审慎研究规划（系统二），在固定语料库问答和文档排序任务中实现领先性能，同时具有更快的完成速度和更低的成本。
AI.motivation: 自主研究代理需要在有限预算内获取和推理证据，但相关来源常被遗漏或未被利用，导致检索覆盖率与实际用于研究的证据之间存在差距。核心挑战在于将快速的局部判断与不断变化的证据需求对齐，并将发现反馈到研究决策中。
AI.method: 提出 JevGPT 双系统架构：系统二负责设定证据目标并整合发现，系统一定位支持、评估相关性并指导进一步检查。独立源判断并行运行；选定的原始段落为下一研究步骤提供信息。
AI.result: 在固定语料库问答和文档排序实验中，JevGPT 达到领先任务性能，完成速度更快、成本更低。证据分析显示其在研究循环中实现更广泛的源检查和更高的支持文档覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 高效的证据处理是通向更强大自主研究的关键路径，JevGPT 通过双系统协作有效解决了证据覆盖与利用的差距问题。

title: Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots
summary: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DySCOVER框架，通过结合重建误差（视觉好奇心）和世界模型预测误差（预测好奇心）作为内在奖励，使机器人主动收集经验进行自监督视觉学习。实验证明预测好奇心能持续提升视觉学习效果，优于仅使用重建好奇心。
AI.motivation: 人类和动物不是从固定数据集学习视觉，而是通过移动、交互并从行动的视觉后果中学习。受此发育视角启发，研究机器人能否通过好奇心驱动的主动交互来改进视觉学习。
AI.method: DySCOVER框架：机器人观察RGB帧，学习视觉自编码器进行编码重建，训练循环世界模型预测下一视觉潜在状态（条件为当前状态和动作）。策略仅用内在奖励训练：重建误差鼓励视觉新颖观察，世界模型预测误差鼓励后果不可预测的转移。预测误差使策略偏向更复杂轨迹，丰富经验集合。
AI.result: 在机械臂实验中，加入预测好奇心显著提升视觉模型性能，优于仅用视觉好奇心。跨初始条件、经验容量、具身形式和场景内容等变化，预测好奇心始终稳定改善视觉学习。
AI.conclusion: 预测好奇心能在重建好奇心基础上进一步提升主动视觉学习效果，验证了结合预测误差的内在奖励机制对机器人自监督视觉学习的有效性。

title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 19 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project liberal-democratic assumptions, or rely on coarse stereotypes. Our results demonstrate that linguistic similarity alone does not guarantee sociocultural or domain-specific understanding, highlighting the critical need for grounded evaluation resources for underrepresented cultural and political contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LENS基准，评估大语言模型在朝鲜语言、社会文化视角和领域知识上的表现，发现模型在朝鲜语言输入上性能略有下降，在社会文化视角对齐上差距较大，在领域知识上严重不足，表明语言相似性不保证社会文化或领域理解。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多语言问答上取得进展，但对低资源社会语言学语境的理解仍未充分探索。以朝鲜为独特测试平台，因其与韩国数十年分裂导致词汇、正字法、规范和意识形态话语的显著差异，亟需针对性评估资源。
AI.method: 构建LENS基准，包含1,765个人工验证的问题，覆盖语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域特定知识三个维度。对多种近期大语言模型进行评测，并进行定性分析。
AI.result: 模型在朝鲜语言输入上性能略有下降；在社会文化视角对齐上存在较大差距；在领域特定知识上表现严重不足。定性分析显示模型常将正式机构与生活现实混淆，投射自由民主假设，或依赖粗糙刻板印象。
AI.conclusion: 语言相似性 alone 不足以保证社会文化或领域特定理解，强调为代表性不足的文化和政治语境构建基于实况的评估资源的关键必要性。

title: Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning
summary: Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估框架，用于解决模块化金融强化学习中的信用分配评估难题。框架结合等信息重构控制、固定效用比较和预设下游护栏，在归因引导的模块化交易架构中实例化，通过三项受控研究（更新分配、监督目标表示、组合风险控制）揭示了三种评估失效模式：冗余归因信号、表示诱导的预测权衡、组件监督与下游风险结果的错位。同时强调模块级学习声明需要运行级溯源。贡献在于为在部分可观测性、延迟反馈和经济风险约束下运行的专家系统提供可复用的信用分配评估方法论。
AI.motivation: 模块化金融强化学习中的信用分配难以评估，因为归因信号可能在不增加决策相关信息或改善经济结果的情况下改善组件损失。现有评估方法缺乏对决策相关性和经济结果的严格把控，导致模块级学习声明不可靠。
AI.method: 提出结合等信息重构控制、固定效用比较和预设下游护栏的评估框架。在归因引导的模块化交易架构中实例化，开展三项受控研究：1) 更新分配研究，对比残差分配与普通损失预算控制；2) 监督目标表示研究，测试直接短缺监督与解码结果保持；3) 组合风险控制研究，对比组件级评论家监督与标量监督在固定效用下的风险条件确定等价和回撤表现。并保留历史工程案例进行溯源分析。
AI.result: 1) 残差分配在披露接口下完全可由普通损失预算控制复现，揭示冗余归因信号。2) 直接短缺监督虽改善组件预测，但未能保持解码结果，显示表示诱导的预测权衡。3) 组件级评论家监督在固定效用下使风险条件确定等价和回撤恶化，暴露组件监督与下游风险结果的错位。历史案例证实模块级学习声明需运行级溯源。
AI.conclusion: 该评估框架有效识别信用分配中的三种评估失效模式，为部分可观测、延迟反馈和经济风险约束下的专家系统提供了可复用的方法论。强调模块级学习声明必须基于运行级溯源，避免因评估不当导致的虚假改进声明。

title: SimInter: Evidence-Grounded User Simulation with Interview-Based Profile Enrichment for Conversational Recommender Systems
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 12 tables. Erfan Shahabi and Amirhossein Roshandel contributed equally
summary: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) require reliable user simulators for cost-effective evaluation. LLM-based simulators have made realistic simulation possible but typically condition on profiles derived from explicit ratings, demographics, and static sources capturing surface preferences while omitting implicit behavioral characteristics such as decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, and domain expertise. We propose SimInter, a pipeline that elicits these attributes via synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, grounded in the user's statistical profile and historical conversational evidence. Before profile enrichment, an audit agent explicitly flags potential fabrication and stereotyping at the turn level. We instantiate and evaluate SimInter on movie recommendation. We simulate 300 ReDial users and, on a matched subset of 100 users, compare SimInter with a statistics-only baseline: SimInter significantly increases the diversity of expressed preference aspects (filtered aspect entropy: 1.619 vs. 0.859; paired d = 0.96, Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). This gain persists when the simulator converses with two trained recommenders, KBRD and UniCRS, under two independent evaluation judges (+0.28 to +0.56 nats; all p < 0.001). Human evaluation finds 94.3% of enriched-attribute claims supported or partially supported, while human judgments agree with 95.2% of the auditor's binary filtering decisions on a stratified sample.

AI.tldr: SimInter 通过合成访谈丰富用户模拟器的隐性行为特征，显著提升偏好表达多样性，并通过审计机制减少捏造和刻板印象。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的用户模拟器主要依赖显性评分、人口统计等静态画像，忽略了决策风格、层面偏好、领域专长等隐性行为特征，导致模拟不真实。
AI.method: 提出 SimInter 管道：利用两个 LLM 代理进行合成访谈，基于用户统计画像和历史对话证据挖掘隐性属性；引入审计代理逐轮标记潜在捏造和刻板印象；在电影推荐任务上实例化并评估。
AI.result: 在 300 个 ReDial 用户模拟中，SimInter 显著增加表达偏好层面的多样性（过滤后层面熵 1.619 vs 0.859，p < 0.001）；与两个推荐器交互时增益持久（+0.28 至 +0.56 nats，p < 0.001）；人工评估显示 94.3% 的丰富属性声明被支持或部分支持，95.2% 的人工判断与审计决策一致。
AI.conclusion: SimInter 有效挖掘隐性用户特征，提升模拟器真实性和多样性，审计机制可靠，为 CRS 评估提供更高质量的用户模拟器。

title: Decentralized Bandit Learning of Markov Perfect Equilibria
summary: We study decentralized bandit learning in discounted infinite-horizon, general-sum Markov games with continuous actions. Agents observe the public state, but only their own realized rewards, and use simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation to update their actions. Under strong monotonicity of the negative running-reward gradients and sufficiently small time steps, we prove that the fully decentralized procedure converges almost surely to the unique stationary Markov perfect equilibrium. We obtain an $O(n^{-1/2})$ convergence rate and present a natural extension to episodic finite-horizon learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究去中心化强盗学习在折扣无限时域、一般和马尔可夫博弈中连续动作的问题，证明在负运行奖励梯度强单调且步长足够小的条件下，完全去中心化的同时扰动随机近似算法几乎必然收敛到唯一平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，并给出O(n^{-1/2})收敛速率，还扩展到情节有限时域学习。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习多假设智能体能观测全局奖励或协调动作，但实际分布式系统中智能体仅能观测自身奖励且无法协调，因此需要研究完全去中心化、仅基于自身奖励反馈的学习算法。
AI.method: 采用同时扰动随机近似（SPSA）方法，每个智能体仅观测公共状态和自身实现奖励，通过梯度估计更新连续动作空间中的策略，无需知晓其他智能体动作或奖励函数。
AI.result: 在负运行奖励梯度强单调和步长足够小的条件下，证明算法几乎必然收敛到唯一平稳马尔可夫完美均衡；建立O(n^{-1/2})收敛速率；并将框架自然扩展到情节有限时域设置。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为连续动作空间下的去中心化马尔可夫博弈学习提供了理论保证，SPSA方法在仅有自身奖励反馈的情况下实现了均衡收敛，具有实际分布式系统应用潜力。

title: A Sovereign, Indic-First, Reasoning Model
summary:
Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B is a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for reasoning, instruction following, and tool use in English and eight Indian languages. Starting from NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint, it retains the 52-layer backbone and changes the vocabulary, training data, and post-training objectives. An in-place expansion from 131,072 to 163,072 tokens reduces mean Indian-language fertility by 38.6%. The new embedding rows are initialized from their upstream decompositions and warmed before the backbone is updated. Continual pretraining then adds broad English-Indic data, high-quality annealing, and direct training at a 131,072-token sequence length.
  The central result appears after post-training. Reinforcement learning across four verifiable task environments improves mathematics, graduate-level science, and instruction following, but degrades Indic extractive question answering because the rewards do not require an answer in the requested language. The share of Indic extraction items answered in English rises from 8.7% to 91.7%. Accuracy conditional on answering in the target script roughly doubles, which is consistent with preserved reading ability but is measured on a self-selected subset.
  Two unreleased studies test repairs. A scoped Indic reward restores the language convention. A 26B-A4B generative judge outperforms a 235B-parameter model on RM-Bench, and distillation restores 81% of the capabilities displaced by optimizing against it.
  Relative to the architecture-identical starting checkpoint, the released model gains 5.2 points on an Indic aggregate while giving up 1.7 points of English retention. The unreleased Indic-aware branch trades further, gaining 14.6 Indic points at a cost of 5.4 in English. A planned FP8 release reduces the artifact to 32GB with near-zero mean change across 32 paired benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B模型，这是一个长上下文混合Mamba-Transformer专家混合模型，支持英语和八种印度语言的推理、指令遵循和工具使用。基于Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B检查点，通过词表扩展、持续预训练和强化学习后训练，在印度语言任务上显著提升，但强化学习导致印度语言抽取式问答退化（模型倾向用英语回答）。后续未发布实验表明，加入印度语言感知奖励和蒸馏可修复该问题。最终发布模型在印度语言聚合指标上提升5.2分，英语保持仅下降1.7分；计划的FP8量化版本将模型压缩至32GB且性能几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个高效的长上下文多语言大模型，兼顾英语和印度语言的推理、指令遵循及工具使用能力，同时解决现有模型在低资源语言上的生成质量和语言一致性问题。
AI.method: 1. 从Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B（52层Mamba-Transformer MoE骨干）出发，替换词表、训练数据和后训练目标。2. 就地将上下文窗口从131,072扩展至163,072 token，利用上游分解初始化新嵌入行并预热。3. 持续预训练：加入大规模英印双语数据、高质量退火数据，直接在131,072 token序列长度上训练。4. 后训练：在四个可验证任务环境中应用强化学习（RL），优化数学、研究生级科学和指令遵循。5. 针对RL导致的印度语言回答语言偏移，后续尝试限域印度语言奖励、26B-A4B生成式裁判模型（RM-Bench超越235B基线）及蒸馏恢复被置换能力。6. 计划发布FP8量化版本（32GB）。
AI.result: 1. 词表扩展使印度语言平均生育率下降38.6%。2. RL后数学、科学、指令遵循显著提升，但印度语言抽取式问答严重退化：英语回答占比从8.7%飙升至91.7%；若限定目标脚本回答，准确率约翻倍（自选子集）。3. 限域印度语言奖励可恢复语言惯例；26B-A4B裁判模型在RM-Bench超越235B模型，蒸馏恢复81%被置换能力。4. 发布版模型在印度语言聚合指标+5.2分，英语保持-1.7分；未发布的印语感知分支+14.6印语分，英语-5.4分。5. FP8量化使模型体积降至32GB，32项配对基准平均性能变化近乎为零。
AI.conclusion: 通过词表扩展、持续预训练和强化学习，可在保持英语能力的同时大幅提升多语言（特别是印度语言）性能，但需注意RL奖励设计对目标语言生成一致性的影响。引入语言感知奖励和高效蒸馏可有效修复语言偏移。FP8量化提供了无损部署路径。未来工作包括发布印语感知分支和量化版本。

title: GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs
summary: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GateSight，利用Gated DeltaNet (GDN)层在预填充阶段发出的写门、衰减和写幅度信号，通过轻量级逐头MLP预测KV缓存条目的未来效用，从而在服务时仅保留约1/10的注意力KV缓存即可实现最优的无查询感知压缩精度。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型中，全注意力层的KV缓存随上下文增长主导服务内存，而GDN层具有固定大小的循环记忆。研究旨在探究GDN的循环记忆是否已隐含注意力层未来所需的KV信息，从而在不依赖查询的情况下实现极致的KV缓存压缩。
AI.method: 1. 定义KV条目未来效用：移除该条目对模型自身生成续文的注意力输出改变量。2. 发现GDN层预填充时的写门、衰减、写幅度可预测该效用。3. 提出GateSight：各头独立的轻量级MLP读取GDN信号预测效用，无需注意力分数。4. 由模型原生注意力输出门的均值（跨层差异超数量级）决定各层保留比例。5. 服务时预填充后一次性打分并物理释放低效用KV条目。
AI.result: 在SCBench和RULER-4096基准上，使用Qwen3.8-27B和Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（至262K token），仅保留1/10注意力KV缓存时，GateSight在4个模型-基准对中有3个成为最准确的无查询感知方法，全面超越KVzip（领先9.5-47.2分），且全长上下文评分开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: GDN层的循环记忆信号天然编码了注意力KV的未来效用，GateSight通过非线性逐头映射高效挖掘这一先验，实现了极低开销、高精度的无查询KV缓存压缩，为长上下文服务提供了实用的内存优化方案。

title: Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
comment: NeurIPS workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST), 2026
summary: Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions. However, they only evaluate strategic performance across individual fixed models. In parallel, contemporary LLM routers pick models under quality-cost trade-offs, but with no notion of a strategic structure. They do not account for an opponent that might be unknown, and that can adapt over time and shift the feedback signal. To address this, we extend the game-theoretic evaluations and define strategic selection as the meta game layered on top of the base game. In each round, a strategic selector fields an LLM from a portfolio of models to navigate a game payoff matrix that is latent and learned online. We find that the evaluation signal is game-specific, and that extracting a reliable signal requires a much higher number of seed runs $N$ compared to traditional benchmarking setups. Evaluating across 5 games and 10 LLMs, we show a model's strategic competence varies significantly depending on the game setup and the opponent faced. Building on this, we implement a suite of selector methods and find that approaches that rely on query embeddings or LLM self-reflection do not consistently capture the underlying strategic signal. A lightweight multi-armed bandit algorithm performs more reliably across games, though it still falls short of the best fixed model. Finally, we show that simple non-stationary and adversarial bandit variants fail to outperform a stationary bandit baseline, pointing to a gap in how current methods handle a shifting opponent in strategic settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“战略选择”作为元游戏，在多模型组合中在线选择LLM应对隐性博弈，发现评估信号随博弈类型变化，需更多种子运行；轻量级多臂老虎机算法表现较稳健但仍不如最佳固定模型，非平稳/对抗性老虎机变体未超越平稳基线，揭示当前方法处理动态对手的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有博弈论基准仅评估单一固定模型的战略表现，而LLM路由器虽考虑质量成本权衡，却忽略战略结构（未知对手、自适应、反馈信号漂移）。需将战略选择形式化为元游戏，研究如何在线选择模型应对隐性收益矩阵。
AI.method: 定义战略选择为元游戏：每轮从模型组合中选一LLM参与基础博弈，收益矩阵隐性且在线学习。在5种博弈、10个LLM上实验，比较固定模型表现；实现多种选择器：基于查询嵌入、LLM自我反思、多臂老虎机（平稳、非平稳、对抗性变体），评估其跨博弈鲁棒性。
AI.result: 战略能力随博弈设置和对手显著变化；评估信号具有博弈特异性，需大量种子运行N才能获得可靠信号。查询嵌入和自我反思选择器无法稳定捕捉战略信号；轻量级多臂老虎机算法跨博弈表现最稳健，但仍不及最佳固定模型；非平稳和对抗性老虎机变体未能超越平稳基线。
AI.conclusion: 战略选择作为元游戏揭示了LLM战略能力的情境依赖性；简单老虎机算法虽相对有效，但处理动态对手仍有显著差距，未来需开发能适应非平稳对手的选择机制。

title: Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs
summary: We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

AI.tldr: ContinuousCloth 是一种连续时间、物理信息神经求解器，用于可变形布料动力学，将弹簧-质量 ODE 嵌入神经轨迹模型，支持任意时间戳查询并通过自动微分计算位移、速度、加速度。在纯物理设置下，其轨迹精度与高精度求解器相当，运行时间减少达 17.4 倍；结合稀疏噪声观测时，ODE 作为强先验显著提升插值与参数估计性能，插值误差在仿真中降低 7.3 倍、真实数据中降低 2.4 倍，参数估计误差在高噪声下比可微分求解器基线降低 2.6 倍。
AI.motivation: 传统布料模拟依赖离散时间步积分，仅能在固定网格上输出轨迹，难以在任意时刻查询状态且难以融合稀疏噪声观测。需要一种连续时间、物理一致的神经求解器，既保持高精度物理仿真，又能利用 ODE 作为归纳偏置处理下游任务（插值、参数估计）。
AI.method: 构建神经轨迹模型，强制其满足弹簧-质量 ODE；利用自动微分在任意时间点输出位移、速度、加速度；在纯物理训练中仅最小化 ODE 残差；在观测融合阶段联合优化 ODE 损失与观测拟合损失，实现插值与参数估计。
AI.result: 六种边界条件下轨迹精度媲美高精度求解器，推理加速达 17.4 倍；插值任务中，仿真数据误差降低 7.3 倍，真实布料序列降低 2.4 倍；高噪声下参数估计误差比可微分求解器基线降低 2.6 倍，展现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ContinuousCloth 通过将物理 ODE 嵌入连续神经表示，实现了高精度、高效率的布料动力学求解，并为稀疏噪声观测下的插值与参数估计提供了强有力的物理先验，适用于仿真与真实世界场景。

title: In-Place Indic Tokenizer Expansion and Continual Pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone. Continual pretraining then progressed through broad training, high-quality annealing, and long-context training over approximately 1.27 trillion tokens. The annealed checkpoint gained 12.9 points on the Indic MILU benchmark but lost 3.4 on English MMLU. We also report practical negative results. Direct token addition underperformed continued byte-pair encoding. AdamW weight decay changed rows intended to stay fixed. Perplexity on an Indic-heavy holdout did not select the learning rate that best preserved English performance.

AI.tldr: 本文将Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B模型适配至八种印度语言，通过扩展词表、继续预训练等方法，在Indic MILU基准上提升12.9分，但英语MMLU下降3.4分，并报告了若干负面实验结果。
AI.motivation: 旨在不改变主干架构的前提下，将大语言模型高效适配到低资源印度语言，解决词表不足导致的编码效率低和多语言性能平衡问题。
AI.method: 1. 使用继续字节对编码（continued byte-pair encoding）和AdaptMix重平衡将词表从131,072扩展至163,072，使每词token数减少38.6%。2. 新增输入/输出行通过平均原有成分行初始化，先在90%印度语言+10%英语数据上训练新行，再更新主干。3. 持续预训练分三阶段：广泛训练、高质量退火、长上下文训练，共约1.27万亿token。
AI.result: 退火检查点在Indic MILU上提升12.9分，英语MMLU下降3.4分。负面结果包括：直接添加token效果不如继续字节对编码；AdamW权重衰减导致本应固定的行发生变化；基于印度语言为主的保留集困惑度无法选出最能保留英语性能的学习率。
AI.conclusion: 通过词表扩展和分阶段持续预训练可显著提升印度语言性能，但需权衡英语性能损失；词表构建方法、优化器超参数选择及验证指标设计对多语言适配效果有关键影响，需谨慎调整。

title: CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CUSE框架，通过反事实引导和在线策略自蒸馏实现多模态大语言模型的精细粒度遗忘，既能有效移除目标信息又能保留非目标内容，在MLLMU-Bench上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型遗忘方法通常对完整回复应用统一遗忘目标，依赖固定的离线策略监督，导致token级控制粗糙且与模型当前行为不匹配，难以在同一回复中同时实现目标信息移除和非目标内容保留。
AI.method: CUSE包含两步：1)构建反事实输入（移除目标相关证据），利用token概率变化识别需强遗忘的token；2)从当前策略采样回复，冻结原始模型作为教师模型并增强遗忘/保留导向的特权上下文，进行token级遗忘和保留目标的在线蒸馏，联合决定遗忘内容和保留内容。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench基准上，CUSE将遗忘集ROUGE-L降低33.6%，同时使保留集ROUGE-L比最强基线提高1.2%。
AI.conclusion: CUSE通过反事实引导的token级遗忘识别和在线策略自蒸馏，实现了细粒度、自适应的多模态大语言模型遗忘，有效平衡了遗忘效果与知识保留。

title: Retrieval Disagreement as a Signal: Diagnosing and Steering Multilingual Dense Embedders
summary: Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多语言密集检索器中共享索引导致的跨语言检索不一致问题，提出基于分歧引导的查询引导方法，有效缓解同语言挤占现象，同时保持召回率竞争力。
AI.motivation: 多语言密集检索器将所有语言映射到共享空间，但相同问题用不同语言查询时检索到的文档差异大。这种分歧非因语言理解薄弱，而是共享索引导致正确答案被同语言或英语非相关文档挤下排名。需解决跨语言一致性与检索质量的权衡。
AI.method: 提出分歧引导引导：对比其他语言一致同意的文档与该语言独有检索文档的表示差异，得到语言特定方向，在推理时加到该语言查询向量上。对比基线包括语言均值移除、子空间移除、逐语言旋转。
AI.result: 该方法最强烈减少同语言挤占，在召回率上保持竞争力，但与均值移除相比在排名质量保持上有所权衡。
AI.conclusion: 分歧引导引导能有效缓解共享索引中的语言特有偏见，为多语言密集检索提供新思路，但需在挤占缓解与排名保真度间平衡。

title: On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness
summary: Scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. Establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models, avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. Existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic: hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks, and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics, a specific initialization, and feature-learning criteria. Building on $L$-smoothness framework of Xu et al. (2026), we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the Lipschitz and $L$-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth $K$? We show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling $α=Θ(1/K)$ is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width, uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary $p\to q$ geometries. Because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its Lipschitz and smoothness constants, the argument applies to general residual networks (including branches of block depth $\geq 2$ such as transformer and ResNet blocks) without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. Since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality, our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. This provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with AdamW, Muon, and MOGA. Learning-rate sweeps on GPT-2 (depths 2--128) and CIFAR-100 ResNets (8--32 residual blocks) confirm that Muon and MOGA exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions, with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于 L-光滑度框架，证明了反深度残差分支缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 能使损失函数的 Lipschitz 常数和 L-光滑常数在固定宽度下与深度无关，从而为超参数迁移提供了几何解释，并在 GPT-2 和 ResNet 实验中验证了 Muon 和 MOGA 优化器在 64 倍深度范围内的稳定学习率迁移。
AI.motivation: 高效扩展深度学习模型需要跨算力规模的可预测性能迁移。现有的深度迁移分析依赖于特定架构、启发式玩具模块、无限深度动力学、特定初始化和特征学习标准，缺乏通用的理论保证。论文旨在建立统一的几何框架，解释反深度残差缩放如何实现超参数（特别是学习率）的稳定迁移。
AI.method: 基于 Xu 等人 (2026) 的 L-光滑度框架，分析损失函数的 Lipschitz 常数和 L-光滑常数随深度 K 的缩放行为。证明在残差分支上采用 α=Θ(1/K) 的反深度缩放，足以使这两个常数在固定宽度下与深度无关，且该结论在有界参数域上一致成立，适用于任意 p→q 几何，无需假设初始化或层间权重相关性。进而推导出不需要额外深度相关曲率修正的学习率缩放规则，并解释了其在 AdamW、Muon、MOGA 等算子范数几何中的应用。
AI.result: 理论上证明了反深度残差缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 能使 Lipschitz 和 L-光滑常数深度无关，适用于一般残差网络（包括 Transformer 和 ResNet 块）。实验上，在 GPT-2（深度 2-128）和 CIFAR-100 ResNet（8-32 个残差块）上，Muon 和 MOGA 优化器在该缩放规则下表现出稳定的学习率迁移，跨越 64 倍深度增长共享同一最优学习率。
AI.conclusion: 反深度残差缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 提供了超参数迁移的几何基础，统一解释了多种优化器（AdamW、Muon、MOGA）在算子范数几何下的学习率缩放行为。该理论不依赖特定初始化或架构细节，为大规模训练中的可靠超参数迁移提供了原则性指导。

title: From Candidate Tokens to Final Outcomes: Decoding Relative Long-Horizon Candidate Value from Reasoning Model Representations
summary: Large reasoning models generate reasoning trajectories token by token. At a given prefix, multiple next-token candidates may be plausible, yet shape subsequent reasoning and differ in their chances of leading to the correct answer. Whether these differences are reflected in internal representations remains unclear. To study this question, we define relative long-horizon candidate value to quantify within-prefix differences and construct the Reasoning Candidate-Token Value (RCTV) dataset, pairing mathematical reasoning prefixes with plausible next-token candidates and their empirical long-horizon candidate values. Using RCTV, we examine hidden states, multilayer perceptron outputs, and attention outputs at candidate positions with sparse linear probes. Experimental results provide evidence that relative long-horizon candidate value is linearly decodable from these representations at multiple layers. Candidate-value probes can also outperform probability- and embedding-based baselines. Furthermore, a controlled online intervention experiment shows that using the decoded signals to guide token selection during generation can improve the chances of eventual success. Our findings provide evidence that internal representations encode information about relative long-horizon candidate value, offering insights into how local candidate-level representations relate to long-horizon reasoning outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型推理模型内部表示是否编码了下一个候选token的长期价值，构建了RCTV数据集并使用稀疏线性探针证明了相对长视野候选价值可从隐藏状态、MLP输出和注意力输出中线性解码，且基于该信号的干预能提升推理成功率。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型逐token生成推理轨迹，同一前缀下多个候选token虽看似合理，但会塑造后续推理并以不同概率通向正确答案。现有研究尚不清楚这些差异是否反映在模型内部表示中，因此需要量化候选token的长期价值并探测其在表示中的可解码性。
AI.method: 1. 定义相对长视野候选价值指标量化前缀内差异；2. 构建RCTV数据集，包含数学推理前缀、合理的候选token及其经验长视野价值；3. 使用稀疏线性探针在候选token位置检查隐藏状态、MLP输出和注意力输出；4. 进行受控在线干预实验，利用解码信号指导生成时的token选择。
AI.result: 实验表明：相对长视野候选价值可从多层内部表示中线性解码；候选价值探针优于基于概率和嵌入的基线方法；在线干预实验证实利用解码信号指导token选择能提高最终推理成功的概率。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部表示编码了关于相对长视候选价值的信息，为理解局部候选token级表示如何关联长视野推理结果提供了实证洞见。

title: How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Position/contract paper on time-critical camera-first agents (systems/timing).Primary cs.AI;
summary: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) 问题，指出摄像头优先智能体的核心瓶颈是时间而非识别能力，设计了双截止期架构：快速非语义记忆通路 + 事件驱动的主动记忆写入 + 延迟推理层，实验在 MOT17 真实轨迹窗口验证，前沿模型单路径延迟 1.2-9.3 秒，强调“答案可以晚，证据不能丢”。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态模型在语义推理上泛化良好，但摄像头优先智能体面临转瞬即逝的视觉目标：目标出现、与查询相关、随即消失，单一端到端流水线推理完成时证据已被覆盖。需将记忆写入与推理解耦，建立硬性记忆截止期与软性推理截止期分离的感知契约。
AI.method: 提出双截止期架构：(1) 始终开启、有界、非语义的快速通路负责实时感知；(2) 事件驱动的主动记忆机制在证据被覆盖前将其提交至持久记忆；(3) 延迟审议层（多模态模型+工具）在软截止期内完成复杂推理。在 MOT17 真实轨迹窗口上实例化契约，并通过一致性检查与前沿模型实测延迟校准基线。
AI.result: 单路径基线延迟：短答案 1.2-9.3 秒，智能体式识别并搜索更长。双截止期架构成功在硬截止期内保存证据，软截止期内完成推理，验证了“答案可以晚；证据不能丢”的设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 摄像头优先智能体的关键挑战在于时间约束而非识别能力。通过将记忆写入（硬截止期）与语义推理（软截止期）解耦，双截止期架构有效解决了转瞬即逝目标的交互问题，为实时视觉智能体提供了可落地的系统范式。

title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
summary: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出直接知识图谱交互（DKGI）框架，让语言模型代理直接编写Python代码操作完整的节点和边文件，实现工具创建与工具使用的协同进化，在三个领域的基准测试中比最强基线高出至少6.7个Hit@1点。
AI.motivation: 现有的预定义图接口限制了代理可访问的证据范围，即使代理能编写代码组合工具调用或处理检索子图，也无法灵活地在大规模节点集上批量处理并精选文本证据。
AI.method: DKGI提供一个极简的 harness，代理直接编写Python代码遍历完整的节点和边文件，执行关系追踪、节点集合合并、文本证据筛选，并与shell搜索、文件检查交替进行。执行反馈指导工具的创建与修订，工具演进决定下一步收集什么证据，实现工具创建与使用的协同进化。
AI.result: 在跨越三个领域的基准数据集上，无需训练的DKGI在每个图上都比最强已发布基线高出至少6.7个Hit@1点。消融实验表明多轮编程优于仅shell访问和预定义图工具；轨迹分析显示代理会修订代码以扩展搜索或修复错误。
AI.conclusion: 允许工具创建与工具使用在图搜索过程中协同进化，能显著提升代理在文本丰富知识图谱上的检索与推理能力，DKGI展示了这一范式的有效性。

title: Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction for Signal Temporal Logic Inference with Many Classes
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference provides interpretable formulas for time series classification. For multiclass classification, however, accurate predictions do not necessarily ensure that the inferred formulas are satisfied consistently with the true class. We introduce the positive satisfaction rate and codeword satisfaction rate to quantify satisfaction of required formulas and consistency with the complete class codeword, respectively. We develop a two-stage procedure that first learns discriminative formulas using a margin-based objective and then refines predicate thresholds toward a small positive robustness target while fixing the formula structure and temporal intervals. Satisfaction and ranking penalties discourage violations of required formulas and loss of class separation. The decoding loss is used as a nonconformity score and calibrated separately for each class, providing finite-sample class-conditional coverage under intra-class exchangeability. Experiments on naval, synthetic, and robot manipulation trajectories demonstrate discrepancies between classification accuracy and formula satisfaction. The results further reveal a data-dependent tradeoff between robustness tightness and satisfaction, while class-conditional calibration mitigates undercoverage that can be hidden by pooled calibration.

AI.tldr: 论文针对多类别时间序列分类中的信号时序逻辑（STL）推断问题，指出分类准确性不保证推断公式与真实类别一致。提出正满足率和码字满足率量化指标，开发两阶段学习流程（基于间隔的判别式公式学习 + 谓词阈值精炼），引入满足惩罚和排序惩罚，并将解码损失作为非一致性得分进行逐类校准，实现有限样本类条件覆盖。实验揭示分类准确率与公式满足度的差异、鲁棒性紧度与满足度的数据相关权衡，以及类条件校准相较于池化校准能缓解隐性欠覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有 STL 推断方法在多类别分类中仅关注分类准确率，忽视推断公式是否真正被真实类别样本满足，以及不同类别公式间的一致性（码字一致性），导致模型虽准确但解释性不可靠。
AI.method: 1. 定义正满足率与码字满足率作为评价指标。2. 两阶段学习：第一阶段用基于间隔的目标学习判别式 STL 公式结构与时间区间；第二阶段固定结构，将谓词阈值向小正鲁棒性目标精炼，引入满足惩罚抑制必需公式违例、排序惩罚保持类别分离。3. 以解码损失为非一致性得分，按类别分别校准，在类内可交换性假设下给出有限样本类条件覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在海军、合成及机器人操作轨迹数据集上验证：分类准确率与公式满足度存在显著差距；鲁棒性目标越紧、满足率越低，呈数据相关权衡；逐类校准有效缓解了池化校准掩盖的类条件欠覆盖问题。
AI.conclusion: 准确分类不等于公式满足一致，需显式优化满足率指标。两阶段学习结合类条件一致性预测，能同时提升 STL 公式的判别性、满足可靠性与统计覆盖保证，为可解释时间序列分类提供更严谨的框架。

title: Sensitivity or Criterion? Measuring and Moving When Language Models Act
summary: Before an agent acts, it must decide whether action is warranted. A single accuracy cannot distinguish failure to recognize a warranted action from reluctance to act. Signal-detection theory separates sensitivity from criterion, but criteria estimated from authored binary labels depend on each benchmark's example mix. We introduce FlipAct, a diagnostic of tool use in physical states. A rule over annotated tool properties computes each answer and a graded evidence score, fixing the Yes/No boundary at zero across models. Questions form 2-by-2 quads that hold required knowledge fixed while the state flips. The slope of the fitted Yes-rate curve measures sensitivity; its crossing at one half measures criterion. Across 44 open models, sensitivity rises with size within a family, and its ranking agrees with three of four external when-to-act benchmarks. Models respond to evidence sign rather than magnitude, accepting actions that leave the state no better about as often as helpful ones. When Yes means act, most models are conservative across rephrasings; in some, this partly reflects a preference for No. Criterion is not determined by size. Activation steering shifts criterion with weights fixed; distillation from a model's own steered copy puts the shift into its weights without a significant sensitivity change. The distilled shift transfers to six external benchmarks, including two without Yes/No answers, while criterion-free AUC is preserved on the five benchmarks where it is available. Accuracy improves where models start conservative and declines or remains within error where they start permissive. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/flipact

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlipAct诊断工具，用于评估语言模型在物理状态下的工具使用决策能力。通过信号检测理论分离敏感度与判决准则，发现模型敏感度随规模增长而提升，但判决准则不由规模决定。激活引导可调整判决准则，蒸馏后可迁移至外部基准且保持AUC不变。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法区分模型未能识别需行动的情况与不愿行动的情况。单一准确率指标混淆了敏感度与判决准则，且基于人工二元标签的准则估计依赖于基准的样本分布。需要一种固定Yes/No边界、能独立测量敏感度与判决准则的诊断方法。
AI.method: 构建FlipAct基准：基于标注工具属性的规则计算答案与分级证据分数，将Yes/No边界固定在零点。问题组成2×2四元组，保持所需知识不变而翻转状态。拟合Yes率曲线，斜率测量敏感度，在二分之一处的交点测量判决准则。在44个开源模型上评估，并结合激活引导与蒸馏实验。
AI.result: 1. 模型家族内敏感度随规模上升，排名与4个外部when-to-act基准中的3个一致。2. 模型对证据符号而非幅度敏感，对无益动作与有益动作的接受率相当。3. 大多数模型倾向保守（倾向拒绝行动），部分源于对No的偏好，判决准则不由规模决定。4. 激活引导可在固定权重下移动判决准则；从引导后副本蒸馏可将偏移固化到权重中，且不显著改变敏感度。5. 蒸馏后的偏移迁移至6个外部基准（含2个非Yes/No基准），在5个有AUC的基准上保持AUC不变。6. 保守模型准确率提升，宽容模型准确率下降或维持误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: FlipAct提供了一个固定决策边界、分离敏感度与判决准则的工具使用诊断框架。研究揭示模型敏感度随规模增长但判决准则独立，且可通过激活引导与蒸馏调整判决准则而不损害敏感度，该调整能泛化至多样基准。这为改进模型在物理推理中何时行动的决策提供了可控路径。

title: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProgAgent，一种完整的程序化工具调用（PTC）训练栈，通过合成可验证的长时任务、轻量级PTC运行时和两阶段训练配方，在仅使用215个任务的情况下，显著超越同规模基线，在LOCA-bench上实现30.7%通过率（基线为零），且跨接口实验表明PTC训练的优势泛化至DTC评估接口。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体主要采用直接工具调用（DTC），导致上下文累积引发‘上下文腐烂’和编排崩溃；程序化工具调用（PTC）虽作为推理时优化被探索，但其对智能体训练的益处尚不明确，且缺乏适合训练的可验证长时任务。
AI.method: 构建ProgAgent全栈：1) 可验证长时任务合成管道，跨四种环境规模实例化215个任务；2) 轻量级PTC运行时，通过可执行代码调用工具，中间结果存储在运行时变量而非上下文；3) 两阶段训练配方（具体细节未在摘要中展开）。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，ProgAgent以同等模型规模获得更高通过率；LOCA-bench上，ProgAgent-14B在64k-token环境状态下达30.7%通过率，基线为零；跨接口实验显示PTC训练模型在PTC和DTC两种评估接口下均优于DTC训练模型。
AI.conclusion: PTC训练不仅解决了上下文腐烂问题，其收益还能泛化到直接工具调用接口，证明了程序化工具调用作为训练范式的优越性，为长时工具编排任务提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report
summary: Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KSA V2，改进混合 KSA-Full 架构，使摘要令牌同时充当 KV 内存与稀疏索引器，实现逐层可变的 KV Cache 压缩粒度，并在全注意力层中利用稀疏索引跳过摘要令牌的二次计算，从而兼顾显存压缩灵活性与预填充算力降低。
AI.motivation: 现有混合 KSA-Full 架构存在两大瓶颈：(1) 所有层必须共享相同的摘要压缩块大小，难以实现逐层差异化的 KV Cache 压缩策略；(2) 全注意力层虽然引入了摘要令牌，却仍按二次复杂度处理它们，带来额外算力开销却无增益。
AI.method: 设计 KSA V2，赋予摘要令牌双重角色：作为 KV 内存存储压缩上下文，同时作为稀疏索引器指示关键位置。在摘要注意力层按块压缩生成摘要令牌；在全注意力层利用稀疏索引机制仅对原始令牌计算全注意力，跳过摘要令牌的二次计算，从而支持各层独立设定压缩窗口并降低预填充开销。
AI.result: KSA V2 实现了更灵活的逐层 KV Cache 压缩配置，并显著削减全注意力层的预填充计算量，在保持模型性能的同时提升显存与算力双重效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将摘要令牌重构为“KV 内存 + 稀疏索引器”的双重角色，KSA V2 从根本上解决了混合架构中压缩粒度固化与冗余计算并存的问题，为长上下文大模型提供了一种可扩展、高效率的注意力机制范式。

title: The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration with an ERM Oracle
summary: A predictor is multicalibrated with respect to a class of subpopulations (formally, of functions on the inputs, called auditors) if, for every subpopulation in the class and every value the predictor outputs, the average outcome among the members of that subpopulation who receive that value is close to the value itself. For finite classes, about $\varepsilon^{-3}$ samples are necessary and sufficient to learn a predictor with multicalibration error $\varepsilon$, but the algorithms that attain this rate enumerate the class, which is impossible for the large classes of interest. We ask how many samples suffice when the learner accesses the class only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples and polynomially many ERM calls, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the class. Its dependence on $\varepsilon$ is optimal for all learners. When $d$ is at least about $1/\varepsilon$, every learner that can only access the class through polynomially many ERM calls needs $\tildeΩ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples. Learners with unlimited computation need only $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-3}+d\varepsilon^{-2})$ samples, so the extra factor $1/\varepsilon$ on the dimension term is the price of oracle efficiency. For swap multicalibration, which allows a different function from the class for each predicted value, $\tildeΘ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient. For estimating the error of a given predictor, the ordinary notion is the harder one: the swap error can be estimated with an ERM oracle, whereas the ordinary error is NP-hard to approximate even for classes with linear-time ERM. Consequently, there are classes for which it is computationally easier to learn a multicalibrated predictor than to compute the multicalibration error of a given predictor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多重校准学习中仅通过经验风险最小化(ERM)预言机访问假设类时的样本复杂度。给出算法实现Õ(d/ε³)样本量(其中d为VC维度)，证明此ε依赖最优；展示当d≥1/ε时，多项式ERM调用的学习者需要Õ(d/ε³)样本，而无限制计算仅需Õ(ε⁻³+dε⁻²)，额外1/ε因子为预言机效率代价。对交换多重校准，Õ(d/ε³)为紧界。估计给定预测器误差时，普通多重校准误差NP-hard，交换误差可用ERM估计，故存在类别使学习多重校准预测器比计算其误差更易。
AI.motivation: 多重校准要求预测器在每个子群体和每个输出值上校准。有限类别需ε⁻³样本但枚举不可行。现实中假设类大且仅可通过ERM预言机访问，故需研究仅用ERM预言机时的样本复杂度与计算效率权衡。
AI.method: 设计基于ERM预言机的多重校准学习算法，利用VC维度d表征类别复杂度，通过多项式次数ERM调用实现Õ(d/ε³)样本复杂度。同时证明下界：当d≥1/ε时，任何仅用多项式ERM调用的学习者需Õ(d/ε³)样本。对交换多重校准给出匹配上下界。误差估计方面，证明普通多重校准误差近似NP-hard，而交换误差可用ERM高效估计。
AI.result: 1. 给出算法实现Õ(d/ε³)样本量和多项式ERM调用，ε依赖最优。2. 证明当d≥1/ε时，多项式ERM调用学习者需Õ(d/ε³)样本，无限制计算仅需Õ(ε⁻³+dε⁻²)，额外1/ε为预言机效率代价。3. 交换多重校准样本复杂度紧界为Õ(d/ε³)。4. 普通多重校准误差估计NP-hard，交换误差可用ERM高效估计，存在类别使学习比验证更易。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了多重校准学习中预言机效率与样本复杂度的根本权衡：ERM预言机访问引入额外1/ε维度因子。交换多重校准在样本复杂度上无额外代价。误差估计的计算难度反转显示学习可能比验证更易，对可靠机器学习系统设计有重要启示。

title: AlphaPilot: Multi-Turn Tool-Using LLM Agents for Adaptive Alpha Mining with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks interpretable expressions that rank assets by future returns. The task is challenging because it demands simultaneous processing of unstructured market descriptions, historical data, and quantitative evaluation of candidate factors, yet most existing methods exploit only a subset of these signals. We introduce AlphaPilot, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains multi-turn tool-using LLM agents for adaptive alpha mining. The agent conditions on market descriptions, proposes factor expressions, queries real-data evaluator feedback, and updates a retained factor pool across turns. This design jointly leverages market text, LLM financial knowledge, real data, and evaluation feedback. At inference time, AlphaPilot performs day-by-day search and pool updates to adapt to shifting market regimes. Across three independent runs in out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, AlphaPilot achieves mean total returns of 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86, respectively. It attains the highest mean total return, Sharpe, and RankIC among the evaluated methods on both universes.

AI.tldr: AlphaPilot是一个基于强化学习的多轮工具使用LLM代理框架，用于公式化Alpha挖掘，结合市场文本、LLM金融知识、真实数据和评估反馈，在CSI300和CSI500上实现最高平均总收益和夏普比率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅利用非结构化市场描述、历史数据、量化评估等部分信号，难以同时处理这些多模态信息，导致Alpha挖掘效果受限。
AI.method: 提出AlphaPilot框架：采用强化学习训练多轮工具使用LLM代理，代理基于市场描述提出因子表达式，查询真实数据评估器反馈，并在多轮中更新保留因子池；推理时逐日搜索并更新因子池以适应市场机制变化。
AI.result: 在CSI300和CSI500的滚动回测中，三次独立运行平均总收益分别为42.93%和54.19%，平均夏普比率为2.46和2.86，在所有评估方法中均达到最高平均总收益、夏普比率和RankIC。
AI.conclusion: AlphaPilot通过整合文本、知识、数据和反馈，实现了自适应Alpha挖掘，显著优于现有方法，为量化投资提供了新范式。

title: LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement
summary: LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LYNX，一种面向 LLM 驱动数据分析的多智能体框架，将自然语言转代码任务重构为受模式与知识约束的闭环分析问题，通过规划、生成、验证、修正四阶段协作及 SSD-SAA 机制，显著提升执行准确率并降低 Token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有将 LLM 视为意图到代码翻译器或独立分析引擎的方法，难以可靠地对齐领域语义与复杂模式、异构元数据，导致真实负载下执行脆弱、语义不一致。
AI.method: LYNX 采用三个角色专用智能体协作的闭环工作流（规划、生成、验证、修正），引入语义-结构蒸馏与阶段感知分配（SSD-SAA）解决领域歧义与模式错位，并通过增量引导的迭代修订持续诊断修复语义与执行层面的失败。
AI.result: 在 BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev 与 Spider 2.0-Lite 基准上，执行准确率达 10.66%–59.54%（跨轻量级至商业模型），Token 消耗较前最高效方法降低 70.53%，框架对不同骨干模型表现出高泛化性；量化金融与多关系 SQL 案例进一步验证鲁棒性、可扩展性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: LYNX 通过模式与知识约束的多智能体闭环范式，有效解决了 LLM 数据分析中的语义对齐与执行正确性难题，实现了高准确率、低资源消耗与强泛化能力，为真实世界分析场景提供了可落地的解决方案。

title: ConformalGuard: False-Positive-Controlled Action Gating for LM Classifiers
summary: Language model classifiers are increasingly deployed for high-stakes decisions such as phishing screening, content moderation, and fraud triage, yet validation-set thresholds provide no finite-sample control of deployment-time false positives. We present ConformalGuard, a model-agnostic calibration layer that wraps a fixed scoring function with finite-sample control over the rate at which legitimate inputs trigger an intervention tier. Our contribution is empirical and operational, not a new conformal theorem: zero-shot LM API scores can be coarse enough (10--11 unique values here) to make temperature scaling and isotonic regression operationally identical to raw thresholding for low-FPR action gating. We compare these methods with conformal calibration for fine-tuned BERT, Claude Sonnet 4, and GPT-4o on public email corpora. For Claude, conformal calibration reduces FPR from 0.040 to 0.008 while recall falls from 0.938 to 0.875. For deterministic GPT-4o scores, the 1% operating point is too conservative to deploy (recall 0.564); three-run stochastic averaging raises recall to 0.732 at FPR 0.005. At 2% prevalence with BERT, conformal calibration removes 25 false-positive reviews per 10,000 emails (95% CI [10, 43]). The guarantee is legitimate-event-rate control under exchangeability; discrimination, workload effects, and robustness to shift remain empirical.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ConformalGuard，一种模型无关的校准层，为语言模型分类器在部署时提供有限样本的假阳性率控制。实验表明，在Claude Sonnet 4、GPT-4o和微调BERT上，共形校准能显著降低假阳性率，同时保持可接受的召回率，且在低假阳性率操作点下优于温度缩放和等渗回归等传统校准方法。
AI.motivation: 语言模型分类器越来越多地用于高风险决策（如钓鱼检测、内容审核、欺诈分流），但基于验证集的阈值无法提供部署时的有限样本假阳性控制。现有校准方法（温度缩放、等渗回归）在零样本LM API评分粗糙（仅10-11个唯一值）时，对低FPR动作门控实际上等同于原始阈值，无法满足实际需求。
AI.method: 提出ConformalGuard：一种包装固定评分函数的模型无关校准层，利用共形预测提供有限样本保证，控制合法输入触发干预层的比率。在公开邮件语料库上对比微调BERT、Claude Sonnet 4和GPT-4o，评估共形校准与温度缩放、等渗回归、原始阈值的性能。针对确定性GPT-4o评分，采用三次运行随机平均提升召回。
AI.result: Claude上共形校准将FPR从0.040降至0.008，召回从0.938微降至0.875。确定性GPT-4o在1%操作点过于保守（召回0.564），三次随机平均将召回提至0.732（FPR 0.005）。BERT在2%流行率下，共形校准每10,000封邮件减少25次误报（95% CI [10, 43]）。共形校准在低FPR下显著优于传统校准方法。
AI.conclusion: ConformalGuard提供基于可交换性的合法事件率有限样本控制保证，实现了操作层面的假阳性率控制。歧视性、工作负载影响和分布偏移鲁棒性仍需实证研究。共形校准是解决粗糙评分下低FPR操作点校准问题的实用方案。

title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Quantifying Sharedness and Idiosyncrasy of Meaning
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Preprint under review at Open Mind: Discoveries in Cognitive Science. Data, code and pre-registration: https://osf.io/dc6an
summary: Concepts are the basic units through which we navigate the world and communicate meaning. But do you and I really mean the same thing when we think or speak about a concept? The present study develops a measurement framework for modeling and analyzing interindividual variation in concept representations through sentence embeddings, dense vector representations mapping entire utterances into a shared geometric space. The framework is developed in a theoretical argument and validated, demonstrated, and subjected to robustness checks in a pre-registered study. Short personal definitions, elicited from $N = 125$ participants, are encoded as sentence embeddings and submitted pairwise to a crossed random effects model yielding two concept-level quantities: sharedness ($S_b$), the expected dissimilarity between two randomly drawn individuals, and idiosyncrasy ($I_b$), the person-specific share of total dyadic variance. Two validity tests support the approach: the embedding space fully recovers concept and domain organization from participant definitions even with the target word excluded, and a parameter-free classifier achieves 0.630 accuracy in a within-participant extensional prediction task against a chance baseline of 0.500 and a consistency ceiling of 0.893. The framework finds theoretically interpretable variation in $S_b$ and establishes $I_b$ as a reliable source of dyadic variance across concepts. Results replicate across three encoders varying in architecture and capacity, providing a reproducible and scalable instrument for the empirical study of meaning variation.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于句子嵌入的测量框架，用于建模和分析概念表征的个体差异，通过交叉随机效应模型量化概念的共享度（S_b）和独特性（I_b），并通过有效性测试和跨编码器复制验证了框架的可靠性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 探究不同个体在思考或谈论同一概念时是否具有相同含义，即概念表征的个体差异问题。现有研究缺乏定量测量工具来系统建模和分析这种差异。
AI.method: 从N=125名参与者收集简短个人定义，将其编码为句子嵌入向量，提交至交叉随机效应模型，提取两个概念层面量：共享度（S_b，两随机个体间的预期不相似性）和独特性（I_b，个体特有的双人变异占比）。通过两个有效性测试验证：1) 嵌入空间在排除目标词条件下完全恢复概念和领域组织；2) 无参数分类器在参与者内外延预测任务中达0.630准确率（机会基线0.500，一致性上限0.893）。在三种架构和容量不同的编码器上进行复制。
AI.result: 框架发现S_b存在理论可解释的变异，确立I_b为跨概念的可靠双人变异来源。有效性测试均支持方法：嵌入空间保留概念结构，分类器显著超越随机基线。结果在三种编码器间稳健复制，证明框架的可复制性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个可复制、可扩展的实证工具，用于量化和分析概念表征的个体差异（意义变异），为认知科学、语言学及相关领域研究意义表征的共享与独特性提供了严谨的度量框架。

title: Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees
summary: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

AI.tldr: 该论文解决了反思语言智能体在资源约束下长期性能保证的理论缺失问题，建立了从局部生成/部署保证到次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并通过Lean形式化验证了所有13个理论结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的反思语言智能体能够通过反馈和记忆跨任务适应而无需更新模型权重，但现有的策略选择和动作生成保证无法单独确立局部反思何时能为完整智能体在资源约束下提供长期性能保证。这构成了理论上的关键缺口。
