AI.method: 论文通过以下方法填补该缺口：1) 推导从局部生成和部署保证到次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，同时保留原生控制器；2) 建立资源敏感的迁移界限，约束实际执行路径上的全状态部署差异，并保持学习者和比较者的自历史规律；3) 利用局部生成可靠性获得累积生成机会界限，将策略获取与长期性能通过显式的质量-覆盖-硬预算权衡联系起来；4) 在Lean中形式化所有13个编号理论结果的条件证明链，包含一个具有重复策略增长和不完美验证的原生实例。
AI.result: 论文获得了以下理论成果：1) 充分条件：局部生成/部署保证可推导出次线性反事实遗憾；2) 资源敏感迁移界限：约束实际执行路径上的全状态部署差异；3) 累积生成机会界限：建立策略获取与长期性能的质量-覆盖-硬预算显式权衡；4) 形式化验证：在Lean中完成所有13个理论结果的条件证明链验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为反思语言智能体在资源约束下的长期性能提供了首个完整的理论框架，连接了局部反思保证与全局长期性能，并通过形式化验证确保了理论结果的正确性。这为构建可靠的自适应语言智能体奠定了坚实的理论基础。

title: History, Adaptation, and Hidden Gain: Two Prospective Tests of Learned Predictive Control in a Synthetic Neural Population
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Synthetic closed-loop neural rate-control study; code, frozen protocols and results at https://github.com/lonewolf15116/NeuroLight-AI (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23263620)
summary: We study learned one-step predictive control of a synthetic population of 64 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons whose light sensitivity is scaled by a hidden factor s, using two prospective confirmations on plants simulated only after the analysis was frozen. In the first (50 plants, 11 conditions), removing the 200-ms input-output history substantially worsened a parameter-count-matched neural predictor at low and moderate gain (s = 0.6, 0.8; RMSE rose by 2.47 Hz at s = 0.6, 97.5% CI 2.43-2.51). In secondary comparisons, recursively adapted ARX had the lowest mean error of the deployable controllers in 10 of 11 conditions, tuned PI with anti-windup matched or beat the network for s >= 0.7, and training for 10,000 rather than 900 epochs lowered prediction error but worsened control. Development work suggested the network's learned action sensitivity did not track the hidden gain. A second protocol (50 new plants, 9 sensitivities, 2 noise levels) confirmed three pre-specified predictions at the primary noise level. Re-estimating a single multiplicative input gain recovered 87% (95% CI 86-88%) of the benefit of full adaptive ARX. Supplying that online estimate to the network as an extra input reduced high-gain tracking error by 1.84 Hz [1.81, 1.88]. Longer training worsened the plain network by 1.09 Hz but improved the gain-input network by 1.07 Hz, a differential of 2.16 Hz [2.13, 2.20]. Under high process noise (sigma = 2.0) the effects shrank to about 0.04 Hz or less and gain-only adaptation recovered only 24% of the adaptive-ARX benefit. In this synthetic plant, at the primary noise level, one-parameter online gain estimation accounts for most of the gap between a history-based network and full adaptive ARX, and for its prediction-control mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在隐藏增益因子 s 下，针对 64 个 leaky integrate-and-fire 神经元合成群体的单步预测控制。通过两个预注册确认实验，发现一参数在线增益估计能在主要噪声水平下弥补基于历史的神经网络与全自适应 ARX 之间的大部分差距，并解释了其预测-控制不匹配现象。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解神经网络预测器在存在隐藏增益变化时的控制表现，以及简单的自适应增益估计能否弥合固定网络与全自适应控制器之间的性能差距。
AI.method: 采用两阶段预注册实验：第一阶段（50 株植物，11 条件）比较移除 200ms 历史对参数量匹配的神经预测器的影响，并对比递归自适应 ARX、带抗积分饱和的 PI 控制器及不同训练轮数的效果；第二阶段（50 株新植物，9 个灵敏度，2 个噪声水平）验证三个预先指定的预测，测试单一乘法输入增益重估计、将增益估计作为额外输入、延长训练等干预措施。
AI.result: 主要噪声下：移除历史使 RMSE 在 s=0.6 时上升 2.47 Hz；递归 ARX 在 11 个条件中 10 个表现最佳；PI 控制器在 s≥0.7 时匹配或超越网络；延长训练降低预测误差但恶化控制。单参数增益估计恢复了 87% 的自适应 ARX 收益；将增益估计输入网络使高增益跟踪误差降低 1.84 Hz；延长训练使普通网络恶化 1.09 Hz 但改善增益输入网络 1.07 Hz，差异 2.16 Hz。高过程噪声（σ=2.0）下效应收缩至 ≤0.04 Hz，增益仅自适应仅恢复 24% 收益。
AI.conclusion: 在该合成植物中，主要噪声水平下，单参数在线增益估计解释了基于历史的神经网络与全自适应 ARX 之间大部分性能差距，以及网络的预测-控制不匹配；高噪声下该机制失效。

title: REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary:
Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis.
  We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REPRO（Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization），一种纯黑盒对抗提示词发现框架，仅需单张消费级 GPU 上的压缩 7B 反思模型，通过进化优化结合语义交叉与 Thompson Sampling 策略选择，在 AdvBench、JailbreakBench、HarmBench 上对 36 个目标模型（含 GPT-5-nano、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Grok-4.1 等）单轮攻击均达 100% ASR，中位数仅 24 次查询。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队方法要么依赖生产环境不可用的特权访问，要么依赖人工设计的逐模型模板，要么仅优化单一目标缺乏种群级多样性，亟需一种无需特权、无需手工模板、且具备多样化搜索能力的纯黑盒框架。
AI.method: REPRO 采用进化优化循环，核心创新为：1) 语义交叉——由 LLM 引导的多父代重组算子，实现语义层面的提示词融合；2) 基于结构化失败分析的 Thompson Sampling 贝叶斯策略选择，动态平衡探索与利用。整个搜索过程仅由一个压缩的 7B 开源反思模型驱动，无需目标模型梯度或架构信息。
AI.result: 在统一评估协议下，REPRO 对 11 个模型家族共 36 个目标模型均实现单轮 100% 攻击成功率，中位数目标查询次数为 24 次。需注意：报告的 ASR 由优化过程中的裁判模型同时给出，搜索在裁判接受时停止，因此 ASR 反映的是在迭代预算内搜索是否成功，而非固定预算下的成功率；基线数据均引用自原论文，裁判、预算、模型版本均不一致，故本文呈现为单一协议下的模型覆盖图谱而非直接对比排名。
AI.conclusion: REPRO 证明了纯黑盒、低算力条件下即可高效发现针对主流安全对齐 LLM 的通用对抗提示词，其语义交叉与贝叶斯策略选择机制显著提升了搜索效率与多样性。但评估协议的特定设定（裁判即优化目标、提前停止）意味着报告的 100% ASR 需结合预算上下文解读，未来工作应建立更标准化的固定预算评测基准。

title: GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions
summary: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于GREAT神经求解器的动态定价与路由框架(GREAT-ESDD),用于在线即日配送中结合家庭配送和自提点(OOH)选项的决策,通过Thompson采样在线学习客户偏好,实验显示利润提升约11%,且5天内即能超越静态定价策略。
AI.motivation: 在线即日配送要求不断更新路线,配送成本随客户数量增加;自提点(OOH)配送可帮助公司在保持低成本的同时处理更多客户,但需要动态定价与路由优化来引导客户选择OOH,并需在线学习客户偏好。
AI.method: 1) 基于Graph-Edge-Attention-Network(GREAT)开发CVRP神经求解器,支持变长实例和部分执行路线的重新优化;2) 并行批量求解候选路由问题,估算家庭配送和OOH配送的成本增量,据此制定动态价格;3) 采用带拉普拉斯近似后验的Thompson采样在线学习客户偏好;4) 整合为GREAT-ESDD框架,实现定价与路由的联合决策。
AI.result: 与传统路由求解器相比,在相似定价决策时间预算下利润提升约11%;客户偏好估计有效,模拟运营5天后即超越静态定价策略。
AI.conclusion: GREAT-ESDD框架通过快速神经路由求解器与在线偏好学习相结合,有效解决了即日配送中的动态定价与路由联合优化问题,显著提升利润并快速适应客户偏好,为OOH配送选项的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: When More Memory Fails: Hidden Feasibility Holes in Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Simulator study. Code and execution records: https://github.com/lonewolf15116/dtr-stability
summary: Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization (DTR) trains neural networks under a memory budget by evicting tensors and recomputing them on demand. A natural expectation is that a budget large enough to complete training stays sufficient when it is increased. Using DTR's reference simulator, simrd, to replay the public DTR training traces, we show that this expectation fails. We call the exceptions feasibility holes: memory budgets at which an eviction policy runs out of memory although both a smaller and a larger budget complete, a form of non-monotone feasibility. Under a written sweep protocol with dated amendments, a 0.01-step budget grid shows no such hole for DTR on any of six confirmatory traces, although unresolved timeouts prevent it from establishing monotonicity. Finer sampling finds holes on InceptionV4 (three regions) and U-Net (two regions), in addition to one on the ResNet-32 development trace. Every hole is reproduced by three repeats and by unmodified simrd. For one InceptionV4 pair (0.2343 versus 0.235 of peak memory) we trace the failure to individual allocations. The larger budget avoids one eviction at an operator where the smaller budget was 173,479 bytes short. The extra data it carries forward forces a later eviction of a tensor needed three operators afterwards, and rebuilding that tensor triggers a recomputation cascade that cannot fit. Keeping that one tensor resident under the same budget prevents the failure. The two simple score changes we tested do not remove holes across traces; both add failing budgets on some traces. All results are from simulation, with no allocator model; behaviour on GPU hardware is untested.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动态张量重实化（DTR）在内存预算下的非单调可行性问题，发现存在“可行性洞”：某些内存预算下训练失败，而更小和更大的预算却成功。通过模拟器 simrd 复现公开训练轨迹，在 InceptionV4、U-Net 和 ResNet-32 上发现多个可行性洞，并追踪到具体分配决策导致的级联重计算失败。测试的两种简单评分修改均未消除所有轨迹上的洞，甚至引入新的失败预算。结果仅基于模拟，未在 GPU 硬件上验证。
AI.motivation: DTR 通过驱逐张量并在需要时重计算来在内存预算下训练神经网络。直觉上认为足够大的预算若能完成训练，增加预算应保持可行性。本文旨在验证这一单调性假设，发现其失效，即存在非单调的可行性洞，这对内存管理策略设计有重要启示。
AI.method: 使用 DTR 参考模拟器 simrd 重放公开的 DTR 训练轨迹，在 0.01 步长的预算网格上搜索可行性洞，再以更细粒度采样确认。对发现的洞进行三次重复实验和未修改 simrd 验证。对 InceptionV4 上的一对预算（0.2343 与 0.235 峰值内存）进行逐算子分配追踪，分析失败根因。测试两种简单的评分函数修改，评估其对消除洞的效果。
AI.result: 在六个确证轨迹上，0.01 步长网格未发现洞，但更细采样发现 InceptionV4 三个区域、U-Net 两个区域、ResNet-32 开发轨迹一个区域存在可行性洞。所有洞经三次重复和原版 simrd 复现。对 InceptionV4 一个具体案例追踪发现：较大预算避免了一次驱逐，但携带的额外数据导致后续必须驱逐一个三个算子后需要的张量，触发无法容纳的重计算级联。保持该张量驻留可避免失败。两种评分修改均未跨轨迹消除洞，反而在某些轨迹上增加失败预算。
AI.conclusion: DTR 的内存可行性具有非单调性，存在可行性洞，这源于驱逐策略在特定预算下的决策导致后续级联重计算超出内存。简单的评分启发式调整不足以消除所有洞，甚至可能恶化。需设计更鲁棒的驱逐策略或引入全局规划。结果仅限模拟环境，实际 GPU 分配器行为尚待验证。

title: A Step in the Right Place: Understanding and Optimizing Timestep Placement in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models represent an emerging paradigm for language modeling. They generate text in parallel by iteratively refining continuous representations and mapping them back to tokens through a decoder. However, realizing the efficiency advantage of parallel generation requires maintaining generation quality with only a few denoising steps. Even when the number of steps is fixed, their placement along the denoising trajectory remains flexible. In this paper, we demonstrate that changing timestep placement alone can substantially alter the final latent representations and thereby affect the decoded token distributions. Building on these findings, we introduce StepTune, an algorithm that searches for timestep placements that improve generation quality. The search is conducted on a small calibration set and guided by a language-aware objective, with the model and sampling budget fixed. Once calibrated, the timestep placement is fixed and reused across inputs. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in unconditional generation perplexity and conditional task metrics across all evaluated sampling budgets. In particular, StepTune enables 16-step sampling with a frozen model to outperform its native 64-step baseline on both XSum summarization and WMT14 translation and reduces end-to-end latency by approximately $3.8\times$. These results establish timestep placement as a practical means of improving the quality-efficiency trade-off in continuous diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 StepTune 算法，通过在校准集上搜索最优时间步放置位置，显著提升连续扩散语言模型在少步采样下的生成质量，使 16 步采样超越原生 64 步基线，将端到端延迟降低约 3.8 倍。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型通过并行迭代细化连续表示生成文本，但要发挥并行生成的效率优势，需在极少去噪步数下保持生成质量。即使步数固定，时间步在去噪轨迹上的位置仍可灵活调整，而这单方面的改变即可显著影响最终潜在表示和解码后的 Token 分布。
AI.method: 提出 StepTune 算法：在小规模校准集上，固定模型与采样预算，以语言感知目标为指引搜索最优时间步放置位置；校准完成后，该时间步序列固定并复用于所有输入。
AI.result: 实验显示，StepTune 在所有评估采样预算下一致改善无条件生成困惑度及条件任务指标。特别是冻结模型下，16 步采样在 XSum 摘要和 WMT14 翻译任务上超越原生 64 步基线，端到端延迟降低约 3.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 时间步放置是改善连续扩散语言模型质量-效率权衡的实用手段，StepTune 无需修改模型参数即可大幅提升少步采样性能。

title: CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection
summary: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. The dataset provides a definitive longitudinal benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in both operational management and security monitoring. We demonstrate that annual seasonality is the dominant periodic component. Moreover, we show that a forecasting model can exploit the annual component only when its training window covers at least one complete annual cycle, which no sub-year dataset provides.

AI.tldr: 论文发布了长期网络流量时间序列数据集CESNET-TimeSeries26（含995天连续流量及约4.5年单子网数据），填补了长时段预测基准空白；实验表明年度季节性为主导周期成分，预测模型需训练窗口覆盖至少一个完整年度周期才能利用该成分，现有亚年度数据集无法满足。
AI.motivation: 现有公开网络流量数据集时长过短，无法支持长时段预测任务的评估；长期评估需要多年数据以捕捉年度季节性和行为漂移，从而考察预测模型对意外现象和底层模式变化的适应性。
AI.method: 从CESNET3网络收集995天连续流量时间序列及单子网约4.5年数据，涵盖278,466个IP地址、285个机构、566个机构子网，提供三种聚合间隔，构建纵向基准数据集CESNET-TimeSeries26。
AI.result: 年度季节性是主导周期成分；预测模型仅当训练窗口覆盖至少一个完整年度周期时才能利用年度成分，而所有亚年度数据集均无法提供完整年度周期。
AI.conclusion: CESNET-TimeSeries26为运维管理和安全监控中的预测模型评估提供了权威的长期纵向基准，强调了完整年度周期数据对模型捕捉年度季节性的必要性。

title: DPAL: A Test-Time Adaptation Loss for Financial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables time series forecasters to update after deployment as new observations become available. However, adaptation objectives that focus primarily on prediction errors at individual time steps do not fully address the needs of financial time series forecasting. In addition to pointwise return fitting, return direction and the price trajectories reconstructed from sequences of returns are also important. To better account for these properties, we introduce Direction- and Price-Aware Adaptation Loss (DPAL), which combines pointwise return fitting with directional and price-calibration terms. We apply DPAL within existing TSF-TTA frameworks without modifying the source forecaster or the adapter architecture. Across a diverse collection of financial datasets, DPAL reduces reconstructed-price mean squared error in most evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DPAL（Direction- and Price-Aware Adaptation Loss）的新型测试时自适应损失函数，针对金融时间序列预测的特殊需求，将点-wise收益率拟合与方向性及价格校准项相结合，在不修改原预测器或适配器架构的前提下，显著降低了重构价格的均方误差。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时自适应（TTA）方法主要关注单个时间步的预测误差，但金融时间序列预测不仅需要准确拟合点-wise收益率，还需要捕捉收益率方向（涨跌）以及由收益率序列重构的价格轨迹。传统损失函数忽略了这些金融特有的属性，导致重构价格轨迹偏离真实值。
AI.method: 引入DPAL损失函数，包含三个组成部分：1) 点-wise收益率拟合项；2) 方向感知项，约束预测收益率与真实收益率的符号一致性；3) 价格校准项，通过累积收益率重构价格轨迹并最小化重构价格与真实价格的均方误差。DPAL可直接集成到现有的TSF-TTA框架中，无需修改源预测器或适配器架构。
AI.result: 在多个多样化的金融数据集上进行实验，DPAL在大多数评估设置下均降低了重构价格的均方误差（MSE），验证了其在金融时间序列测试时自适应中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DPAL通过显式建模收益率方向和价格轨迹重构，解决了金融时间序列预测中传统TTA损失函数的不足，提供了一种即插即用的改进方案，能显著提升重构价格的准确性，具有实际应用价值。

title: Apertus 1.5: From Open Text Models to Open Multimodal Reasoners
summary: Language models are becoming infrastructure, and infrastructure built in the open, by public institutions, on documented data, is the alternative to dependence on a few providers; Apertus shows this is viable at scale. Apertus 1.5 extends the fully open Apertus family from text to multimodal reasoning. Continued pretraining of the Apertus 1.0 models, on 4T additional tokens for the 8B and 2T for the 70B, adds image and audio understanding and extends the context window fourfold to 262,144 tokens; multimodality enters through the tokenizer, the language-model head remains restricted to text, and the architecture is unchanged. Supervised finetuning, long-context finetuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and preference alignment complete the released models. Thinking is a flag of the chat template rather than a separate model, and lifts mathematical reasoning by up to 20 points on the 8B model. The released models improve over their predecessors on nearly every benchmark; among fully open models of its class, the 8B leads on knowledge, instruction following, and cultural benchmarks, and its instruction following surpasses all compared models, including open-weight ones. On image and audio understanding, a first for the family, the models are competitive with fully open multimodal models, strongest on document understanding and long-form and lower-resource speech recognition, while specialized vision and audio models remain ahead on perception and transcription of English and other high-resource languages. As in Apertus 1.0, we train only on openly available data, respect crawler opt-outs retroactively, and exclude restrictively licensed material. We release the model weights, data preparation and training recipes, and evaluation suites under permissive licenses; openness extends to values, with the Apertus charter guiding alignment stages published alongside the models.

AI.tldr: Apertus 1.5 将完全开放的 Apertus 模型家族从纯文本扩展为多模态推理模型，通过在 Apertus 1.0 基础上继续预训练（8B 增加 4T token，70B 增加 2T token）引入图像和音频理解，将上下文窗口扩展 4 倍至 262,144 tokens，架构保持不变，多模态通过 tokenizer 注入，语言模型头仍限于文本。经过监督微调、长上下文微调、可验证奖励强化学习及偏好对齐后发布。思考模式作为聊天模板标志而非单独模型，使 8B 模型数学推理提升高达 20 分。模型在几乎所有基准上超越前代；在完全开放模型中，8B 版本在知识、指令跟随、文化基准上领先，指令跟随甚至超越所有对比开放权重模型。图像和音频理解上与完全开放多模态模型竞争，在文档理解、长文本及低资源语音识别最强，但专业视觉/音频模型在高资源语言感知和转录上仍领先。坚持仅使用公开数据、尊重爬虫退出请求、排除限制性许可材料；发布模型权重、数据准备与训练配方、评测套件，并公开 Apertus 宪章指导对齐价值观。
AI.motivation: 语言模型正成为基础设施，由公共机构在公开文档数据上构建的开放基础设施，是避免依赖少数供应商的替代方案；Apertus 旨在证明这种完全开放的大规模构建是可行的。
AI.method: 1. 继续预训练 Apertus 1.0：8B 模型额外 4T tokens，70B 模型额外 2T tokens，引入图像和音频理解，上下文窗口扩展至 262,144 tokens。多模态通过 tokenizer 注入，语言模型头保持仅文本输出，架构不变。2. 后训练流程：监督微调（SFT）、长上下文微调、基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）、偏好对齐。3. 思考机制：作为聊天模板标志而非单独模型，显著提升数学推理。4. 数据策略：仅使用公开可用数据，追溯尊重爬虫退出，排除限制性许可材料。
AI.result: 发布模型在几乎所有基准上优于前代。8B 模型在完全开放模型中知识、指令跟随、文化基准领先，指令跟随超越所有对比开放权重模型。多模态方面：与完全开放多模态模型竞争，文档理解、长文本及低资源语音识别最强；专业视觉/音频模型在高资源语言感知和转录上仍领先。思考标志使 8B 数学推理提升高达 20 分。
AI.conclusion: Apertus 1.5 验证了完全开放、公共构建、文档化数据的大规模多模态语言模型可行性。模型在核心文本任务和新增多模态任务上均达到同类开放模型最优或竞争水平，且坚持开放数据、开放权重、开放配方、开放评测及开放价值观（Apertus 宪章），为开放基础设施提供了可复现的范式。

title: ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Project website: https://asigameworld.github.io/
summary: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍ASIWorld，一个生存沙盒环境，用于评估自主智能体在持久环境中执行持续目标的能力，该环境结合持久世界/角色状态、角色范围观察和可编程异步接口。
AI.motivation: 现有自主智能体评估缺乏对持久环境中跨长期交互持续执行目标能力的评估，特别是在不完整观察下协调相互依赖的动作、处理延迟效应、以及适应早期决策塑造的后续机会等方面。
AI.method: 构建ASIWorld生存沙盒：持久世界与角色状态、角色范围观察、可编程异步接口。智能体通过直接动作或智能体编写的程序（在模型调用间持续运行）追求相互依赖的生产和探索任务。评估指标包括任务成功率、发展成就达成、生存成本，并辅以执行行为分析。对九种智能体配置进行探索性研究。
AI.result: 八种配置完成生产任务，六种完成两项任务。执行轨迹和难度级别分析显示，任务结果相似的配置在准备、战斗、恢复行为上存在差异。准备不足导致进展停滞；完成任务的配置在生存成本和额外成就达成上有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 评估持续目标执行需要同时考察任务结果及达成过程中的行为和成本。ASIWorld为这种综合评估提供了有价值的框架。

title: Clinical value claims in multimodal AI outpace supporting evidence
summary: Multimodal prediction models add a data source, such as imaging or an assay, to clinical information, and health systems must decide whether that added test is worth acquiring. We audited 177 studies comparing multimodal with unimodal models: 81 from a systematic review and 96 from a probability sample of 2025-2026 PubMed records. Gains in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) were smaller when a study fitted a separate model for every data source (adjusted difference, -0.030; 95% CI, -0.056 to -0.005). Within 78 such studies, leaving out the strongest source's model would have raised the average gain from 0.046 to 0.108. This complete benchmarking fell from 69.1% of review studies to an estimated 46.0% of recent ones. An estimated 22% assessed decision utility and none evaluated a model prospectively, yet most claimed potential clinical usefulness or improved care (84.0% and an estimated 87.7%).

AI.tldr: 该研究审计了177篇对比多模态与单模态预测模型的研究，发现当研究为每个数据源分别拟合模型时，AUROC增益更小；完整基准测试比例下降，决策效用评估和前瞻性验证严重不足，但大多数研究仍声称临床有用性。
AI.motivation: 卫生系统需要决定是否值得获取额外的检测数据（如影像或检验）来构建多模态预测模型，因此需要系统评估现有研究中多模态模型相对于单模态模型的实际增益及评估质量。
AI.method: 从系统综述中纳入81项研究，并从2025-2026年PubMed记录的概率样本中纳入96项研究，共177项研究。比较多模态与单模态模型的AUROC差异，分析是否为每个数据源单独拟合模型、完整基准测试比例、决策效用评估、前瞻性验证及临床有用性声称情况。
AI.result: 为每个数据源单独拟合模型的研究，AUROC增益更小（调整后差异-0.030，95% CI -0.056至-0.005）。在78项此类研究中，若排除最强数据源的模型，平均增益从0.046升至0.108。完整基准测试比例从综述研究的69.1%下降至近期研究的估计46.0%。仅约22%研究评估决策效用，无研究进行前瞻性验证，但84.0%和估计87.7%的研究分别声称潜在临床有用性或改善护理。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态预测模型研究存在评估方法学缺陷：基准测试不完整、缺乏决策效用分析和前瞻性验证，导致报告的增益可能被高估，临床实用性声称缺乏充分证据支持。

title: An Interpretable Linguistically-Grounded Analysis of Scene Saliency in Movie Screenplays
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Track, Long Paper
summary: We investigate the factors affecting salience in movie screenplay by posing two research questions: 1. {\em Does Uniform Information Density (UID) predict salient scenes?} 2. {\em What other linguistic properties distinguish salient scenes from non-salient background?} We answer both questions through a controlled corpus study on the MENSA corpus, paired with a Linguistically-Grounded Salience Model (LGSM), a dual-stream classifier that fuses a frozen BERT encoder with explicit linguistic features through adaptive gating. The UID picture is layered in long-form discourse. Per-scene UID summaries carry no independent signal once length is controlled, but at the token level salient scenes match non-salient material in the bulk while specifically suppressing the rarest, hardest-to-predict tokens in the upper tail. UID therefore lives at the within-scene token level rather than as a per-scene aggregate. Salient scenes also show a moderate and sustained cast of central characters (following an inverted-U pattern), strong third-person usage, syntactically simpler language, and more abstract vocabulary about motivation and conflict. LGSM exploits this signature and improves recall on salient scenes over a strong semantic baseline while yielding better downstream summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电影剧本中显著场景的预测因素，提出双流分类器LGSM融合冻结BERT与显式语言特征，发现UID在场景级无独立预测力但在token级有效，显著场景具有中等规模核心角色阵容、第三人称主导、句法更简单、词汇更抽象等特征，LGSM提升召回率并改善下游摘要。
AI.motivation: 探究电影剧本中显著场景的预测因素，特别是均匀信息密度（UID）是否能预测显著场景，以及还有哪些语言学属性能区分显著与非显著场景。
AI.method: 在MENSA语料库上进行受控语料库研究，构建语言学奠基显著性模型（LGSM），一种融合冻结BERT编码器与显式语言特征的双流分类器，通过自适应门控机制整合特征。
AI.result: 场景级UID摘要在控制长度后无独立信号，但token级UID显示显著场景抑制最难预测的稀有token；显著场景呈现中等且持续的核心角色阵容（倒U模式）、强第三人称使用、句法更简单、更多关于动机冲突的抽象词汇。LGSM在强语义基线上提升显著场景召回率，并产出更好的下游摘要。
AI.conclusion: UID的预测作用体现在场景内token层面而非场景级聚合；显著场景具有独特的语言学特征组合，显式建模这些特征并融合语义表示可有效提升显著场景识别与摘要生成质量。

title: A Reference Architecture for Integrating Agentic AI into Enterprise Software: Responsibilities, Interactions, and Variability
summary: Agentic AI moves generative AI applications toward systems that coordinate reasoning, enterprise context, model inference, and external actions. Integrating these capabilities into enterprise software introduces diverse architectural concerns, from orchestration, knowledge and memory, and model access to tools and actions, security, runtime infrastructure, and evaluation. Existing research and industry architectures address many of these concerns but differ in scope, abstraction, responsibility organization, interaction representation, and assumptions about which capabilities are required. This paper presents a technology-neutral reference architecture for enterprise agentic AI integration. We synthesize architectural capabilities from research publications, industry architecture guidance, and interoperability specifications by architectural purpose, organize them into ten responsibilities, and define boundary invariants, typed cross-responsibility interactions, and variation points that distinguish responsibilities from condition-dependent capabilities and replaceable realization mechanisms. We instantiate the architecture as an ESG portfolio-analysis and pre-trade compliance agent over an existing service-oriented ESG metric computation and reporting system, and complement the case with a mapping of an independently published agentic architecture. The case realizes seven of the ten responsibilities; different questions take different interaction paths, controls activate only under their conditions, and the probed boundary invariants hold. The independent architecture maps onto the proposed responsibilities without requiring an additional one. These results provide initial evidence for the architecture's organization and applicability rather than its completeness. The deployment and recorded results are available as a replication package.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种技术中立的企业级Agentic AI参考架构，综合了研究文献、行业指导和互操作性规范，将架构能力组织为十大职责，并定义了边界不变量、类型化跨职责交互和变化点。通过ESG投资组合分析与合规前置代理的案例研究，验证了架构的组织合理性和适用性，但非完整性验证。
AI.motivation: 企业软件集成Agentic AI面临编排、知识记忆、模型访问、工具动作、安全、运行时基础设施和评估等多样化架构关注点，现有研究和行业架构在范围、抽象层级、职责组织、交互表示和能力假设上存在差异，缺乏统一的参考架构。
AI.method: 从研究出版物、行业架构指导和互操作性规范中综合架构能力，按架构目的组织为十大职责，定义边界不变量、类型化跨职责交互和变化点。将架构实例化为基于现有服务导向ESG指标计算报告系统的ESG投资组合分析与合规前置代理，并映射独立发布的Agentic架构进行对比验证。
AI.result: 案例实现了十大职责中的七个；不同问题采取不同交互路径，控制仅在条件满足时激活，边界不变量成立。独立架构能映射到所提职责且无需新增职责。结果为架构的组织和适用性提供初步证据，部署和记录结果作为复现包公开。
AI.conclusion: 提出的参考架构有效组织了企业级Agentic AI集成的核心关注点，通过案例研究和外部架构映射验证了其结构合理性和实用性，但尚未证明完整性，后续工作可扩展职责覆盖和完整性验证。

title: Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations
summary: Successor-feature-based zero-shot reinforcement learning methods pre-train a task encoder and successor-feature predictor on offline, reward-free data, then recover a policy at test time by solving a closed-form linear regression over a small labeled dataset. We identify an underexplored limitation of this approach: when the task encoder produces dense representations, the inferred reward signal becomes diffuse across the state space, reducing the contrast between goal-relevant states and the background and providing a weaker signal for the policy to follow. We address this limitation by introducing an l1 sparsity penalty that concentrates reward-predictive structure into a smaller effective subspace of the task encoder's latent space. The penalty is applied only during training and requires no architectural change or modification to the closed-form inference procedure. We instantiate this approach as Sparse-TD-JEPA, a single-line of code addition based on Temporal-Difference Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (TD-JEPA) that significantly improved its performance in zero-shot reinforcement learning. We evaluate Sparse-TD-JEPA on 65 tasks across the DeepMind Control (DMC) Suite and OGBench, covering locomotion, navigation, trajectory stitching, puzzle solving, and robotic manipulation. Sparse-TD-JEPA improves over TD-JEPA in all 13 domain-level comparisons. On DMC, it increases the average return from 661 +- 6 to 714 +- 3. On OGBench, it increases the average success rate from 38.0 +- 0.8 to 48.4 +- 2.3, with improvements of 13.4-18.0 percentage points on the evaluated antmaze navigation and stitching domains. Overall, Sparse-TD-JEPA achieves the highest mean performance among established zero-shot baselines in nine of the 13 domains. Analysis further shows that sparsity produces a sharper and more task-informative inferred reward landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文针对后继特征零样本强化学习中任务编码器产生稠密表示导致推断奖励信号扩散的问题，提出在训练阶段引入L1稀疏惩罚，将奖励预测结构集中到潜在空间的较小有效子空间中。该方法实现为Sparse-TD-JEPA，仅需单行代码修改TD-JEPA，在DMC和OGBench的65个任务上全面超越基线，平均回报和成功率显著提升，且在13个域中有9个达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 后继特征零样本强化学习方法在测试时通过闭式线性回归恢复策略，但当任务编码器产生稠密表示时，推断的奖励信号会在状态空间中扩散，降低目标相关状态与背景的对比度，为策略提供的指导信号变弱。这一限制尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在训练阶段引入L1稀疏惩罚，将奖励预测结构压缩到任务编码器潜在空间的较小有效子空间中。该惩罚仅在训练时应用，无需架构变更或修改闭式推断过程。基于TD-JEPA实现为Sparse-TD-JEPA，仅需单行代码添加。
AI.result: 在DMC Suite和OGBench的65个任务（涵盖运动、导航、轨迹拼接、谜题求解、机器人操作）上评估。Sparse-TD-JEPA在所有13个域级比较中均优于TD-JEPA。DMC上平均回报从661±6提升至714±3；OGBench上平均成功率从38.0±0.8提升至48.4±2.3，蚂蚁迷宫导航和拼接域提升13.4-18.0个百分点。在13个域中有9个达到已建立零样本基线中的最高平均性能。分析显示稀疏性产生更锐利、更具任务信息量的推断奖励景观。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单的L1稀疏正则化，可有效解决后继特征零样本强化学习中奖励信号扩散的核心问题。Sparse-TD-JEPA以极低的实现成本（单行代码）实现了显著的性能提升，验证了稀疏潜在表示对零样本策略推断的关键价值。

title: The Fragility and Dynamics of LLM Pruning-Recovery Steps
summary: Structural pruning followed by a recovery stage is the standard recipe for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet the two stages are typically designed and tuned in isolation. In this work, we study how their interaction shapes the compressed model, sweeping ordering, the data that drives each stage, and the alignment of their training objectives. We find that instruction-following is the first capability to collapse under pruning, well before knowledge, reasoning, or core language modeling, and that much of the pruning in-domain loss is likely not knowledge loss but a domain-agnostic failure to respond coherently to the prompt. We find in our setting that in-domain data is the strongest pruning signal, whereas instruction-style data recovers the most. Stage order matters little, but only marginally. We further analyze how the importance ranking drifts before and after pruning. Together these results give practitioners a concrete recipe for composing pruning and recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究结构化剪枝与恢复阶段的交互对大语言模型压缩的影响，发现指令跟随能力最先崩塌，域内数据是最强剪枝信号，指令风格数据恢复效果最好，阶段顺序影响微小，重要性排名在剪枝前后会漂移，为实践者提供了剪枝与恢复组合的具体方法。
AI.motivation: 结构化剪枝后接恢复阶段是压缩大语言模型的标准流程，但两个阶段通常孤立设计和调优，缺乏对其交互作用的系统研究。
AI.method: 通过实验扫描阶段顺序、驱动各阶段的数据、训练目标的对齐方式，分析剪枝前后重要性排名的漂移，评估不同能力（指令跟随、知识、推理、核心语言建模）的崩塌顺序。
AI.result: 发现指令跟随能力在剪枝下最先崩塌，远早于知识、推理或核心语言建模；剪枝域内损失主要非知识丢失，而是域无关的无法连贯响应提示词的失败；域内数据是最强剪枝信号，指令风格数据恢复效果最好；阶段顺序影响微乎其微；重要性排名在剪枝前后会发生漂移。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为实践者提供了组合剪枝与恢复的具体配方，指导如何选择数据、顺序和目标对齐以实现高效压缩。

title: EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks
summary: Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. In static evaluations of two models and four harnesses, the best configuration scores 42.25 overall and 30.62 on cross-office tasks. Starting from the same MSA harness with GLM 5.3, ACE and AHE improve in-domain scores by 4.90 and 2.64 points, respectively, but change cross-office scores by only +0.03 and -1.72. Thus, gains on the file types that provide feedback do not necessarily transfer to coordinated workflows. EvoCowork makes this distinction explicit while recording the capability, transfer, and cost of harness evolution. Code and task packages: https://github.com/DeepThinkingZhouLiu/cowork-evolution-benchmark.

AI.tldr: EvoCowork是一个包含240个任务的基准测试，用于评估办公工作流中自递归自我改进的能力，涵盖演示文稿、文档、电子表格和跨办公工作流四种模态。实验显示，在提供反馈的文件类型上获得的性能提升不一定能迁移到协调工作流中。
AI.motivation: 办公工作流要求交付成果必须正确、原生可编辑且相互一致。核心问题是：在反馈任务上的收益是否反映了可复用的程序，而非特定任务的修复。现有基准缺乏对跨模态协调工作流中自我改进迁移能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建EvoCowork基准，包含四种办公模态的240个任务。协议分离反馈、修订选择和最终测试：方法在单模态任务上学习，然后在未见的单模态任务和跨办公工作流上评估，使用共享初始框架和显式预算。评估指标涵盖内容、原生结构、公式、跨文件一致性和视觉质量。
AI.result: 最佳配置总分42.25，跨办公任务得分30.62。从同一MSA框架配合GLM 5.3起步，ACE和AHE在域内分别提升4.90和2.64分，但跨办公分数仅变化+0.03和-1.72。表明反馈文件类型上的收益不一定迁移到协调工作流。
AI.conclusion: EvoCowork明确区分了域内改进与跨模态迁移能力，记录了框架演化的能力、迁移性和成本。实验证明单模态反馈驱动的改进难以泛化到复杂的跨办公协调工作流，揭示了当前自我改进方法在可复用程序学习上的局限性。

title: PotentialEP: Backprop-Free Training of CIFAR-Scale Generative Models via Equilibrium Propagation
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. Code: github.com/alexgower/EnergyMatchingEqProp
summary: Generating an image with a diffusion or flow-matching model typically involves integrating a velocity field for hundreds of sequential steps. That computation suits a GPU poorly and an analog neuromorphic substrate well, where one fast, low-power physical relaxation could replace the whole sequence. Two things are needed: a generative algorithm whose computation is a relaxation, and a way to train it without backpropagation, whose global gradient transport is hard to realise in analog. Energy Matching supplies the first, sampling by gradient-descent relaxation on a time-independent potential - but obtaining the gradient that descent follows is itself a backward pass, once per integration step. We prove that a predictive coding network with a single linear injection term added to its energy relaxes to a state whose visible layer carries that gradient inherently, with an error that vanishes for small injection strengths. An Energy Matching model trained by backpropagation can therefore be loaded into this network unchanged and sampled by relaxation alone, matching the original model's FID to within 0.04 at CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-32 scale. The network can also be trained without backpropagation: Equilibrium Propagation reproduces backpropagation's parameter updates to a cosine similarity of 0.9998, and training end to end with those updates reaches an FID of 3.64 on unconditional CIFAR-10 against 3.54 for backpropagation. To our knowledge this is the first CIFAR-10 generative model trained with Equilibrium Propagation, and the first at competitive quality by any backpropagation-free rule. This quality does not require group normalisation or attention: an architecture of only convolutions and pointwise nonlinearities, both native to an analog crossbar, reaches an FID of 3.51 when trained by backpropagation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预测编码网络的能量匹配方法，使得扩散/流匹配模型能在神经形态模拟硬件上通过单次物理松弛完成采样，并实现了无需反向传播的Equilibrium Propagation训练，在CIFAR-10上达到具有竞争力的FID（3.64），且架构仅包含卷积和逐点非线性，适合模拟交叉阵列实现。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流匹配模型通常需要数百步序列积分，不适合GPU并行，但适合模拟神经形态底层进行快速低功耗物理松弛。需要一种计算即松弛的生成算法，以及无需反向传播（全局梯度传输在模拟电路难以实现）的训练方法。
AI.method: 1. 引入能量匹配：在时不变势能上进行梯度下降松弛采样。2. 证明带单一线性注入项的预测编码网络，其可见层松弛后天然携带所需梯度，误差随注入强度消失。3. 可将预训练的能量匹配模型直接加载并仅通过松弛采样。4. 使用Equilibrium Propagation进行无反向传播训练，复现反向传播参数更新（余弦相似度0.9998）。架构仅含卷积和逐点非线性，原生支持模拟交叉阵列。
AI.result: • 松弛采样下FID与原模型相差≤0.04（CIFAR-10、ImageNet-32）。• Equilibrium Propagation端到端训练在无条件CIFAR-10上达FID 3.64，反向传播基线为3.54。• 这是首个用Equilibrium Propagation训练的CIFAR-10生成模型，也是首个由任何无反向传播规则训练且达到竞争力质量的模型。• 纯卷积+逐点非线性架构经反向传播训练可达FID 3.51。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在模拟神经形态硬件上高效部署扩散/流匹配生成模型提供了完整方案：推理仅需一次物理松弛，训练可完全避免反向传播，且模型质量逼近反向传播基线，架构完全兼容模拟交叉阵列原语，为大规模低功耗生成式AI硬件铺平道路。

title: Towards Robust Calibration Dataset for Domain-General Mixture of Experts Pruning
summary: Post-training expert pruning is a promising deployment technique for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The calibration set is an integral part of the pruning process, however, its correlation with evaluation performance is largely misunderstood and unintuitive. In this work, we present an empirical study of the robustness of calibration perturbations, specifically in MoE models. Showing how calibration size, language, and data distribution affect layer-wise expert pruning for gpt-oss-20b. Our findings reveal that (1) domain-general pruning quality receives minimal benefit from scaling calibration data beyond small sample sizes, (2) cross-lingual calibration transfers effectively, with English-only calibration maintaining strong performance across seven languages of varying typologies and scripts, and (3) a diverse calibration data resembling the pretraining distribution can yield comparable or superior performance to test-distribution data. Ultimately, we provide practical insights as a recipe for better understanding calibration for more effective domain-general expert pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文对MoE模型中校准数据对专家剪枝的影响进行实证研究，发现小规模校准数据即足够，跨语言校准有效，且类似预训练分布的多样化校准数据优于测试分布数据。
AI.motivation: 探究校准集与评估性能的关联，解决校准扰动对MoE模型专家剪枝鲁棒性的未知问题。
AI.method: 在gpt-oss-20b上开展层级专家剪枝实验，系统变换校准数据的规模、语言和分布，评估剪枝效果。
AI.result: 1) 域通用剪枝质量在小样本校准数据后不再显著提升；2) 英文校准数据可有效迁移至七种不同类型语言；3) 类似预训练分布的多样化校准数据表现优于或相当于测试分布数据。
AI.conclusion: 提供校准选择的实用指南，助力更有效的域通用专家剪枝。

title: Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime
summary: Claims of recursive self-improvement are easy to make and hard to falsify: did improvement come from re-using designer-provided mechanisms, or from mechanisms the system authored itself? We introduce a pre-registered, two-tier accounting: M1 counts machine-generated content instances within a designer-provided vocabulary, while M2 counts machine-authored mechanism types (new operators registered into the runtime's own vocabulary, with a held-out-validation certificate). We report the first audited M2 genesis events. In the primary event, depth-limited compositional search over elementary operators, judged by held-out R^2 on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, produced the operator sq(inv(n)) = 1/n^2 -- the Rydberg-level form -- which no standard-library transform could express (held-out R^2: -0.546 best standard transform vs. 1.0000000 composed). A protocol flaw (independent variable built by inverting the very law under test) was caught in audit and repaired via an independent-label protocol; extrapolation to unseen levels (n=8,9 trained on n<=7) attains relative error ~10^-6, four to six orders beyond the best standard operator. A second event independently recovered sqrt(inv(a)) -- Kepler's velocity law -- from JPL ephemeris vectors. Also incorporated: an audited compounding channel (first domain-level measurement: 1.109x accuracy ratio on a real held-out domain) and blind, decurated genesis exams whose honest tally is zero. The Kepler event passes line audit; the hydrogen gap reproduces on He II; the certificate is threshold-stable. Against eleven prior systems, the contribution is the measurement and governance of machine-authored mechanisms, not the search algorithm or rediscovered physics. Limitations: exams were curated by agents who knew the textbook answer, triggers manual, grammar observer-injected; both events demonstrate capability to author, not yet autonomous genesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双层审计框架（M1与M2），用于量化机器自主编写新机制的能力，并报告了首个经审计的M2起源事件：通过组合搜索在氢巴尔末谱数据上自主发现了里德伯公式 1/n²，并在开普勒速度定律上独立复现。实验表明机器能在受限条件下创造超越标准库的新算子，但目前仍依赖人工触发与语法注入，尚未实现完全自主起源。
AI.motivation: 现有的递归自我改进声称难以证伪，无法区分改进是来自设计者提供的机制还是系统自行编写的机制。本文旨在建立可审计的度量标准，量化机器自主编写机制类型（而非仅生成内容实例）的能力，并引入证书机制确保泛化性能。
AI.method: 引入双层核算：M1 统计设计者词汇内的机器生成内容实例；M2 统计机器自行编写并注册到运行时词汇的新算子类型，并要求持有外部验证证书。采用深度受限的组合搜索在基本算子空间探索，以保留集 R² 为评价指标，在 NIST 氢巴尔末谱实测数据与 JPL 历表向量上进行实验。引入独立标签协议修复协议缺陷，并进行盲去策展起源考试。
AI.result: 主要事件：在氢巴尔末谱上发现 sq(inv(n)) = 1/n²（里德伯形式），保留集 R² 从最佳标准变换的 -0.546 跃升至 1.0000000；外推至 n=8,9 相对误差 ~10⁻⁶，超越标准算子 4-6 个数量级。次要事件：从 JPL 历表独立复现 sqrt(inv(a))（开普勒速度定律）。复合通道在实保留域获得 1.109 倍准确率提升；盲考诚实计数为零。开普勒事件通过行审计，氢谱间隙在 He II 上复现，证书阈值稳定。对比十一先行系统，贡献在于机制编写的度量与治理，而非搜索算法或物理重发现。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供了经审计的 M2 起源证据，证明机器能在受控条件下自主编写超越标准库的新算子并通过外部验证。但当前实验存在人工触发、语法观察者注入、考题策展者知晓教科书答案等局限，展示了编写能力而非完全自主起源。

title: Coarse-Graining Recursive Expert Computation: Continuation-Relative Interfaces and Failure Modes
summary: Computational coarse-graining aims to replace a sequence of updates with a cheaper module while preserving task performance. We present a continuation-relative evaluation framework that assesses replacements through the computation that follows them, using downstream task quality and total execution cost as joint criteria. The framework distinguishes boundary representations, summaries of skipped computation, executed operations, and downstream loss. It makes interfaces and permitted deployment information explicit, combines fine-path references with directly trained controls using the same shortened architecture, and accounts for selection overhead. An exact loss decomposition separates replacement effects at a fixed downstream action from effects of changing that action. A finite construction shows how retained information can reduce the stipulated cost of zero-error prediction under fixed information and controller restrictions. Experiments in two frozen pretrained language models show that representation fidelity and task loss can favor different fitting objectives. In a prespecified comparison on a 1.7-billion-parameter model, next-token-loss training lowers in-distribution negative log-likelihood by 0.1901 nats per scored token compared with reconstructing the skipped blocks' output, using the same optimizer and update count. This ranking reverses in all nine paired comparisons under distribution shift. In a recursive expert prototype, the jointly adapted candidate lowers task error relative to frozen-bank and router-only baselines, but trails directly trained controls, and the tested input-only selectors fail the joint quality-cost criteria. Together, the protocol and studies provide explicit criteria and diagnostics for distinguishing useful computational replacement from local approximation gains within specified interfaces and evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于续评估的计算粗粒化框架，用于评估将一系列更新替换为更廉价模块的效果，联合考虑下游任务质量和总执行成本，并通过实验表明表示保真度与任务损失可能偏好不同的拟合目标，且在分布偏移下排名会反转。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算粗粒化方法往往只关注局部近似增益，缺乏统一的评估协议来区分有用的计算替换与单纯的近似改进。需要一个显式的框架，结合下游任务质量和执行成本，并考虑接口约束、选择开销及分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出续相对评估框架，区分边界表示、跳过计算的摘要、执行操作和下游损失；显式化接口和允许的部署信息；结合细路径参考与直接训练的控制器；引入精确损失分解，分离固定下游动作下的替换效应与动作变化效应；给出有限构造说明保留信息如何降低零误差预测的规定成本；在冻结的预训练语言模型上进行实验，对比下一词预测损失训练与重建跳过块输出的方法。
AI.result: 在17亿参数模型上，下一词预测损失训练比重建跳过块输出在分布内将负对数似然降低0.1901 nats/token；但在所有九个配对分布偏移比较中排名反转。递归专家原型中，联合自适应候选优于冻结库和仅路由基线，但落后于直接训练的控制器；纯输入选择器未通过联合质量-成本标准。
AI.conclusion: 该协议和实验为在指定接口和评估设置下，区分有用的计算替换与局部近似增益提供了显式标准和诊断工具，揭示了表示保真度与任务损失的不同偏好以及分布偏移下的性能反转现象。

title: Feedback as an Interface: Controlling Form and Detail in LLM Translation Refinement
summary: Feedback presentation shapes how LLMs use evaluator judgments during translation refinement. We introduce a machine translation protocol that keeps the evaluator score, main issue, and recommendation fixed while varying feedback form and supporting detail. Across seven models and six translation directions, low-load feedback outperforms high-load feedback in all 42 translator-direction settings under xCOMET. On the 29,400-record rewriting subset, mean xCOMET scores multiplied by 100 are 83.30 for low-load feedback and 80.67 for high-load feedback; the full-matrix original-translation reference mean is 83.46. MetricX-24 supports the low-load advantage on a stratified subset. A no-feedback second pass yields a small improvement over the original translations, and direct evaluator prompting reproduces the low-load advantage without a separate rewriting stage. These results show that compact feedback limits the quality loss from evaluator-guided refinement in the evaluated high-resource MT settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨反馈呈现方式对LLMs在翻译润色中利用评估器判断的影响，发现低负载反馈在所有42个模型-方向设置下均优于高负载反馈，紧凑反馈能限制评估器引导润色在高资源机器翻译中的质量损失。
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少系统研究反馈呈现形式（如负载高低、细节多少）如何影响LLMs根据评估器判断进行翻译润色的效果，亟需量化不同反馈形式对翻译质量的实际影响。
AI.method: 设计机器翻译协议，固定评估器分数、主要问题和建议，仅变化反馈形式与支持细节；在7个模型、6个翻译方向上实验，采用xCOMET和MetricX-24指标评估，对比低负载、高负载、无反馈二轮及直接评估器提示等设置。
AI.result: 低负载反馈平均xCOMET得分（×100）为83.30，显著高于高负载反馈的80.67，接近全矩阵原译参考均值83.46；MetricX-24在分层子集上验证低负载优势；无反馈二轮略优于原译，直接评估器提示可复现低负载优势且无需额外重写阶段。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的低负载反馈能有效减少评估器引导润色带来的质量损失，在高资源机器翻译场景中实现接近原译参考的翻译质量，且可通过直接评估器提示简化流程。

title: PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration
summary: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. In the rule-generation phase, which is performed when the device is idle, such as overnight, PEAM analyzes historical network-configuration records in batches and reflects across batches to consolidate consistent evidence, reduce local bias, and derive robust configuration rules. To enable more accurate and stable rule generation over time, PEAM further constructs a user profile from high-confidence rules to capture the user's network preferences and incorporates this profile into each rule-generation cycle. In the rule-execution phase, PEAM is invoked when the communication context changes, such as when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, and searches the rule library to identify and execute the appropriate rule. Experiments demonstrate that PEAM, based on a fine-tuned 4B model, achieves 99.13% correct network configuration decisions, while 92.50% of the rules generated by PEAM are valid, outperforming the traditional expert-rule based method by 4.41% and 84.50%, respectively.

AI.tldr: PEAM 是一种基于设备端大语言模型的通信代理，能在毫秒级延迟内自主生成个性化网络配置规则，基于微调的 4B 模型实现 99.13% 的正确配置决策率和 92.50% 的规则有效率，显著优于传统专家规则方法。
AI.motivation: 随着紧凑型大语言模型在智能手机上的部署，设备端自主决策成为可能，但移动网络配置决策（如应用切换或连接条件变化时）需满足严格的低延迟约束以保障用户体验。现有专家规则方法缺乏个性化和自适应能力，难以满足实时性与准确性的双重要求。
AI.method: PEAM 首先用人工标注的真实用户数据微调设备端 LLM，注入通信知识。随后分两阶段运行：1) 规则生成阶段（设备空闲时，如夜间）：批量分析历史网络配置记录，跨批次反思以整合一致证据、减少局部偏见，生成鲁棒配置规则；并从高置信度规则构建用户画像，捕捉网络偏好，融入后续生成循环。2) 规则执行阶段：通信上下文变化时（如切换应用、连接条件变化），检索规则库并执行匹配规则。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于微调 4B 模型的 PEAM 实现 99.13% 的正确网络配置决策率，生成规则有效率达 92.50%，分别比传统专家规则方法高出 4.41% 和 84.50%。
AI.conclusion: PEAM 证明了设备端 LLM 可在毫秒级延迟内实现高精度、个性化的网络配置决策，通过离线批量反思与用户画像机制有效提升规则质量与稳定性，为移动 GUI 代理等设备端智能应用提供了可落地的通信管理范式。

title: Design Choices for Multimodal Transformer Learning with Missing and Longitudinal Healthcare Data
summary: Multimodal learning offers the potential to improve predictions by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous data sources. However, multimodal datasets are frequently incomplete, raising important questions about how models should handle missing information. Although recent approaches increasingly rely on Transformer-based architectures for multimodal fusion, incomplete multimodal data introduces challenges such as missing modalities and intra-modal missingness, which motivate key architectural design choices, such as tokenization granularity. In addition, many datasets are longitudinal, with observations collected across multiple time points. The sequential nature of the Transformer architectures provides a natural framework for modeling such data, but introduces additional considerations, such as how temporal information should be represented. In this study, we systematically investigate these design choices using three different cancer datasets. We compare modality-level and feature-level tokenization and evaluate attention masking and imputation as strategies for handling missing information, both naturally occurring in the datasets and synthetically induced. We further investigate approaches for incorporating temporal information in our training process and how to model it. Experiments are conducted with unimodal and multimodal configurations, as well as different levels of missingness for binary survival classification and multiple time encoding strategies for discrete-time survival prediction. Our results show that while multimodal outperforms unimodal results, missing data heavily impacts predictions and thus effective design choices such as tokenization granularity, and intra-missing handling is essential for reliable prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了处理不完整多模态纵向数据的Transformer架构设计选择，包括tokenization粒度、缺失数据处理策略和时间编码方法，在三个癌症数据集上验证了多模态优于单模态，但缺失数据严重影响预测性能，合理的架构设计对可靠预测至关重要。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习虽能整合异构数据提升预测，但实际数据集常存在模态缺失和模态内缺失问题；且许多数据集具有纵向性质，需建模时间信息。现有基于Transformer的多模态融合方法在面对这些挑战时缺乏系统性的架构设计指导。
AI.method: 在三个癌症数据集上进行系统实验：1) 对比模态级与特征级tokenization粒度；2) 评估注意力掩码与插值作为处理自然缺失和合成缺失的策略；3) 探索多种时间编码策略建模纵向信息；4) 在单模态/多模态配置、不同缺失率下进行二分类生存预测和离散时间生存预测实验。
AI.result: 多模态方法优于单模态，但缺失数据严重降低预测性能；tokenization粒度选择和模态内缺失处理策略对预测可靠性有关键影响；有效的架构设计选择对于处理不完整多模态纵向数据至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 针对不完整多模态纵向数据，Transformer架构需精心设计tokenization粒度（模态级vs特征级）、缺失数据处理机制（注意力掩码vs插值）和时间信息建模方式，这些设计选择直接决定模型在真实临床场景下的预测可靠性。

title: Rate-Resolved Text Evaluation with Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: A single evaluation score can rank generation systems but rarely reveals what failed. We propose rate-resolved text evaluation, which turns the masking rate of masked diffusion language models into a diagnostic axis. By reconstructing text under different fractions of masked tokens, one diffusion score becomes a vector of band-conditioned scores that reflect reconstruction difficulty at varying levels of visible context. On SummEval, preserving this rate structure yields complementary signal: the best masking-rate band improves fusion with autoregressive likelihood over a collapsed diffusion scalar, survives a sample-shuffle control that breaks rate ordering, and adds residual signal to a fixed prompted judge. A second diffusion model reproduces the effect more weakly. On WMT MQM zh-en, roundtrip mask-and-reconstruct probing produces a tunable localization curve in which ranking-oriented AUROC and span-detection F1 peak at different masking rates. Factuality benchmarks bound the interpretation: band semantics are model- and task-dependent, so each application requires empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出率解析文本评估（rate-resolved text evaluation），利用掩码扩散语言模型的掩码率作为诊断轴，将单一扩散分数转化为不同掩码率下的条件分数向量，捕捉不同可见上下文下的重构难度。在摘要评估和翻译质量评估任务中，保留掩码率结构提供了互补信号，优于坍缩的标量分数，且不同掩码率下的峰值性能因任务而异，需经验验证。
AI.motivation: 单一评估分数虽能对生成系统排序，但难以揭示具体失败原因。现有扩散模型评估通常将掩码率固定或平均，忽略了不同可见上下文比例下重构难度的差异，无法提供细粒度的诊断信息。
AI.method: 提出率解析评估：在掩码扩散语言模型中，系统性地变换掩码token的比例（掩码率），对每个掩码率带独立计算重构得分，形成向量化的带条件分数。实验包括：在SummEval上融合自回归似然与扩散分数，进行样本打乱控制实验，对比不同扩散模型；在WMT MQM zh-en上进行往返掩码-重构探测，分析不同掩码率下的排序AUROC和跨度检测F1。
AI.result: SummEval上，最佳掩码率带显著提升与自回归似然的融合效果，通过打乱控制实验验证了率序列的必要性，第二扩散模型复现效果较弱。WMT MQM上，往返掩码-重构产生可调节的定位曲线，排序AUROC和跨度检测F1在不同掩码率达到峰值。事实性基准表明带语义依赖模型和任务，需各应用实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 率解析评估将掩码率转化为诊断轴，提供比单一标量更丰富的评估信号。不同掩码率捕捉不同粒度的质量方面，最优掩码率因任务和模型而异，实际部署需针对具体应用进行经验校准。

title: WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models
summary: Data-driven weather forecasting models are commonly trained on ERA5, yet operational deployment must use timely initial states from physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems whose distributions differ substantially from ERA5. Direct initialization with these states can degrade autoregressive forecasts, motivating input adaptation that keeps the pretrained forecasting model unchanged. Here, we introduce WeatherBridge, a unified, source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model. WeatherBridge predicts the structured residual corrections with a Swin-UNet and injects source embeddings across multiple spatial scales, allowing the model to capture shared atmospheric structure and source-specific discrepancies. Its training objective combines latitude-weighted ERA5 reconstruction with One-step Rollout Alignment (ORA), which backpropagates one-step forecast error through a frozen FuXi model to optimize the adapted states for both initial state fidelity and downstream forecast compatibility. We evaluate WeatherBridge using daily GFS, HRES, and CMA initializations from 1 January to 22 November 2025 across six variables and lead times up to 240 hours. Relative to raw source initialization of FuXi, WeatherBridge reduces the mean RMSE of FuXi over the 6- 240-hour rollout for 17 of 18 source-variable combinations, with a median reduction of 10.2% and a maximum reduction of 46.3%. The adapter trained with frozen FuXi also improves FengWu forecasts on GFS inputs without retraining either the adapter or FengWu. These results demonstrate that forecast-aware input adaptation can improve forecasts from heterogeneous operational NWP inputs and transfer across pretrained ERA5-based forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WeatherBridge，一种统一的、以数据源为条件的适配器，将异构的业务数值天气预报（NWP）初始场映射为 ERA5 参考场，从而在不更新预训练预报模型的情况下，提升基于 ERA5 训练的数据驱动模型在真实业务初始场上的预报技巧。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动天气预报模型通常在 ERA5 再分析数据上训练，但业务部署必须使用来自物理模式 NWP 系统的及时初始场，其分布与 ERA5 存在显著差异。直接使用这些初始场会导致自回归预报性能下降，因此需要输入适配方法，在保持预训练预报模型冻结的前提下弥合分布差距。
AI.method: WeatherBridge 采用 Swin-UNet 预测结构化残差修正，并跨多个空间尺度注入数据源嵌入，以捕捉共享的大气结构和数据源特有的系统性偏差。训练目标结合纬度加权的 ERA5 重构损失与 One-step Rollout Alignment (ORA)，后者通过冻结的 FuXi 模型反向传播一步预报误差，同时优化初始场保真度和下游预报兼容性。
AI.result: 在 2025 年 1 月 1 日至 11 月 22 日期间的 GFS、HRES、CMA 三种业务初始场、六个变量、最长 240 小时提前期的评估中，WeatherBridge 相对于直接使用原始初始场驱动 FuXi，在 18 个数据源-变量组合中的 17 个上降低了 6-240 小时滚动预报的平均 RMSE，中位数降幅 10.2%，最大降幅 46.3%。且在冻结适配器和 FengWu 模型的情况下，该适配器亦能提升 FengWu 在 GFS 输入上的预报性能，展示了跨模型迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 预报感知的输入适配能够有效改善异构业务 NWP 初始场驱动的预报质量，且适配器可在不重新训练预报模型的前提下迁移至不同的 ERA5 预训练预报模型，为业务化部署提供了通用、轻量的解决方案。

title: From Transfer Probes to Expert Grouping: Evidence from LoRA Post-Training
comment: Technical report for training resources allocation for specialization of LLMs
summary: A platform that post-trains one base model for many business lines often has more lines than experts it can maintain, so lines must share experts, yet lines seldom come with a taxonomy saying which should share. We ask whether transfer probes (train on one source, measure paired changes on all sources) can discover a grouping when the standard one is unknown. To test probes against a reference, we use seven public sources that do have a label tree (five mathematics subfields and two kinds of programming, standing in for business lines) and treat the tree's grouping as a label reference that the evaluator holds and the method does not. With four LoRA experts under fixed per-source exposure and per-expert budgets, we compare a purely probe-derived grouping and an uninformed uniform default (whose tied routing serves every line from one expert) against this reference. Trained once for one interval from a shared warm-up state and routed by a rule fixed by each allocation, neither reached the prespecified practical gain of 2 percentage points, and both had lower overall utility than the reference ($-2.43$ and $-2.54$ pp; 95\% intervals below zero). In a post hoc comparison, the probe-derived grouping was indistinguishable from the uniform default ($+0.11$ pp, $[-1.25,+1.54]$). In fixed-budget LoRA post-training, a grouping built from initial-state single-source probes thus did not deliver the advantage predicted from the probes once carried to a later training state, a finite budget, and specified routing.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨在多业务线共享少量专家模型的场景下，是否可以利用迁移探针自动发现业务线分组。实验在七个有标签树的公开数据源上进行，对比基于探针的分组、均匀默认分组与参考分组。结果显示，探针分组未达到预设的 2 个百分点增益，且整体效用均低于参考分组；事后对比中探针分组与均匀分组无显著差异。结论：基于初始状态单源探针构建的分组，在后续有限预算、固定路由的 LoRA 后训练中，未能实现探针预测的优势。
AI.motivation: 实际平台常面临业务线数量超过可维护专家模型数量的问题，业务线间缺乏明确分类学指导共享策略，需要一种无监督方式自动发现哪些业务线适合共享专家。
AI.method: 使用七个具有标签树的公开数据源（五个数学子领域、两类编程任务）作为业务线代理，以标签树分组为参考。在固定每源曝光和每专家预算下训练四个 LoRA 专家，从共享暖启动状态出发训练一个区间，采用固定路由规则。对比三种分组：参考分组、基于迁移探针（单源训练、测量所有源配对变化）得出的分组、无信息均匀默认分组（所有源共用一个专家）。
AI.result: 探针分组与均匀分组均未达到预设的 2 个百分点实际增益，整体效用分别比参考分组低 2.43 和 2.54 个百分点（95% 置信区间均在零以下）。事后两两对比中，探针分组与均匀分组差异为 +0.11 个百分点（95% CI [-1.25, +1.54]），无统计学差异。
AI.conclusion: 在固定预算的 LoRA 后训练设定下，基于初始状态单源迁移探针构建的业务线分组，无法在后续训练状态、有限预算和指定路由条件下兑现探针阶段预测的优势。

title: The Mathematical Collective Unconscious: Jungian Archetypes within the Latent Space
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 22 tables. Investigating Jungian archetypes in transformer latent spaces across synthetic baselines, Shmoop literature, DreamBank dreams, and Andrew Lang folklore corpora
summary: Carl Jung theorised that the human psyche contains an inherited framework, the collective unconscious, populated by universal archetypes. As large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast corpora of textual data, this paper investigates whether they spontaneously construct distinct archetype-like regions within their high-dimensional latent spaces. The paper proposes that these regions function as spatial constraints that naturally organise semantically related narratives. To evaluate this, we applied cosine similarity and angular distance metrics across thirteen experiments utilising OpenAIs text-embedding-3-small model. The paper contains two experimental sections the first section explores these ideas using synthetically constructed narratives, the results of which act as a baselines for experiments conducted in the second section where the synthetic data is replaced by human-authored literature (Shmoop corpus), unedited dream reports (DreamBank corpus), and culturally distilled folklore (Andrew Langs Fairy Books). The results show that archetypal roles occupy distinct, measurable regions in the latent space. Crucially, these regions remain compact and consistent because of narrative structure rather than simple word overlap. Additionally, text category dictates spatial distribution: dream reports concentrate within Trickster and Shadow regions, while traditional folklore distributes evenly across all tested archetypes. We conclude that transformer latent spaces encode stable regions which appear to correspond to recognised Jungian archetypes.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究大语言模型（LLM）的高维潜在空间中是否自发形成荣格原型般的区域，通过实验发现原型角色在潜在空间占据独特、紧凑且稳定的区域，且分布受叙事结构而非词汇重叠驱动；梦境报告聚集于骗子与阴影原型，童话故事则均匀分布于所有测试原型。
AI.motivation: 基于卡尔·荣格的集体无意识与原型理论，研究者假设经过海量文本训练的LLM可能在其潜在空间内自然涌现出类原型的语义区域，旨在验证Transformer模型是否隐式编码了跨文化的普遍叙事原型。
AI.method: 采用OpenAI text-embedding-3-small模型，利用余弦相似度与角距离指标，设计13组实验分两阶段：首阶段用合成叙事建立基线，次阶段替换为人类创作文学（Shmoop语料）、未编辑梦境报告（DreamBank语料）与文化提炼的民间故事（Andrew Lang童话集），对比不同文本类别在潜在空间中的原型分布。
AI.result: 实验表明：原型角色在潜在空间形成可度量的离散区域，区域紧凑性源于叙事结构而非词汇重叠；文本类别决定空间分布——梦境报告高度集中于骗子与阴影原型区域，而传统民间故事均匀覆盖所有测试原型。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型的潜在空间编码了稳定且可识别的区域，这些区域与荣格理论中的原型高度对应，提示LLM通过大规模文本训练隐式捕捉了跨文化的普遍叙事模式。

title: Beyond Outcome Feedback: Trajectory-Quality-Guided Experience-based Learning
summary: Experience-based learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve over time by reusing knowledge from past executions. However, existing methods typically rely on final task outcomes as feedback for experience learning, overlooking the execution process and limiting their ability to evaluate and optimize experience based on trajectory quality. To address this limitation, we propose TQG-Exp, a trajectory-quality-guided experience-based learning framework that introduces process feedback. Specifically, we introduce Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL), which jointly considers task completion and process quality to provide a learning signal beyond final task outcomes. Based on this signal, we employ paired rollouts with and without retrieved experience to guide experience optimization. Representative trajectories are selected based on their outcomes and trajectory quality to extract task-level and task-type-level experiences. Meanwhile, differences in trajectory quality between the paired groups are used to estimate the contribution of retrieved experience and update its utility. The learned utility is then combined with semantic relevance to guide subsequent experience retrieval. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with two backbone LLMs show that TQG-Exp outperforms existing experience-based methods, improving Avg.@3 over the strongest baseline by 4.50 and 8.55 percentage points on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen3.5-Flash, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TQG-Exp框架，引入轨迹质量损失(TQL)和配对rollout机制，利用过程反馈指导LLM代理的经验学习与检索，在三个基准上显著超越现有基于经验的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于经验的学习方法仅依赖最终任务结果作为反馈，忽视了执行过程的质量，导致无法根据轨迹质量有效评估和优化经验，限制了经验学习的上限。
AI.method: 1) 提出轨迹质量损失(TQL)，联合考虑任务完成度与过程质量提供学习信号；2) 采用有/无检索经验的配对rollout指导经验优化；3) 基于结果与轨迹质量选择代表性轨迹，提取任务级和任务类型级经验；4) 利用配对组间轨迹质量差异估计检索经验贡献并更新效用；5) 将学习到的效用与语义相关性结合，指导后续经验检索。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld三个基准上，分别使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash和Qwen3.5-Flash作为主干LLM，TQG-Exp的Avg.@3指标比最强基线提升4.50和8.55个百分点，显著优于现有基于经验的方法。
AI.conclusion: TQG-Exp通过引入过程反馈和轨迹质量引导，解决了现有方法忽视执行过程的局限，有效提升了LLM代理的经验学习与检索能力，验证了轨迹质量作为学习信号的重要性。

title: Target-ESS Tempered Policy Optimization (TETPO): Smooth Variance Control via Bridge Importance Sampling
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models is computationally efficient but inherently off-policy: the learner updates on rollouts generated by a stale policy, while correcting this mismatch requires importance weights that can be extremely heavy-tailed. A small number of trajectories may then dominate an update, collapsing the effective sample size (ESS) and increasing the variance and instability of the resulting gradient estimates. Existing stabilizers apply fixed interventions regardless of the realized severity of weight concentration, either discarding selected samples or reweighting them without adapting the correction strength. We introduce \emph{Target--ESS Tempered Policy Optimization} (TETPO), which replaces each importance weight $ρ$ by $ρ^α$ for a data-adaptive exponent $α\in[0,1]$: $α=1$ preserves the original importance weights, whereas $α=0$ assigns uniform coefficients. For each prompt group, TETPO selects the largest $α$ whose tempered weights satisfy a target ESS fraction $κ$, applying little tempering to healthy groups and stronger tempering when weight degeneracy is severe. At the population level, the tempered coefficients are exact importance weights for a geometric bridge between the sampler and learner policies. The exponent is efficiently found by one-dimensional bisection, while the resulting weights satisfy deterministic bounds on normalized-weight dispersion and weighted-gradient norm that are independent of policy drift, together with a fixed-$α$ bound on bridge-target discrepancy. Power tempering also introduces no explicit zero-weight mask. On mathematical-reasoning benchmarks under high staleness, TETPO outperforms strong on- and off-policy baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出目标 ESS 温和策略优化 (TETPO)，通过数据自适应的幂次温和调整重要性权重，解决异步强化学习后训练中因策略陈旧导致的权重退化与高方差问题。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习后训练虽计算高效，但固有离策略特性导致学习器基于陈旧策略生成的轨迹更新；重要性权重呈重尾分布，少数轨迹主导更新，导致有效样本量 (ESS) 崩塌、梯度估计方差大且不稳定。现有稳定器采用固定干预，无法根据权重集中程度自适应调节修正强度。
AI.method: TETPO 将每个重要性权重 ρ 替换为 ρ^α，其中自适应指数 α∈[0,1]：α=1 保留原权重，α=0 赋予均匀系数。对每个提示词组，通过一维二分搜索选取满足目标 ESS 分数 κ 的最大 α，健康组轻度温和、退化组强度温和。种群层面上，温和系数构成采样策略与学习策略几何桥接的精确重要性权重，且具备与策略漂移无关的确定性归一化权重离散度和加权梯度范数界，以及固定 α 的桥接目标差异界，且不引入显式零权重掩码。
AI.result: 在高陈旧度下的数学推理基准测试中，TETPO 超越了强大的同策略与离策略基线方法。
AI.conclusion: TETPO 通过自适应幂次温和实现了对重要性权重退化的精细控制，兼顾理论保证与实验性能，为异步大语言模型后训练提供了稳健高效的离策略修正方案。

title: Towards Autopilot Labeling for Short Video Content Governance
summary: The explosive growth of short videos has presented significant challenges to content governance. Traditional manual labeling is inefficient, slow to iterate, and costly. Therefore, we explore and develop a multi-stage autopilot labeling framework aimed at progressively increasing the level of automation in short video content annotation. To move beyond the heavy reliance on human expert labeling at the initial L0 stage, we first introduce a discriminative MLLM labeler at the L1 stage, which is fine-tuned with supervised data to directly predict labels for short videos. Advancing to the L2 stage, we shift to a domain-adaptive MLLM pretrained on short video data and use it for zero-shot labeling, enabling flexible generalization without task-specific supervision. In the L3 stage, we propose an agentic annotation workflow, and equip the agent with several key tools, which empower the agent to handle complex, unfamiliar, or vaguely defined cases, significantly reducing the need for human intervention. We conduct extensive experiments across various content issues, and results demonstrate that each stage of the autopilot labeling framework progressively improves labeling accuracy, and has significantly reduced manual labor costs in real-world applications by up to 85%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多阶段自动驾驶标注框架，旨在逐步提升短视频内容标注的自动化水平，从L0阶段的人工专家标注进化到L1判别式MLLM标注器、L2领域自适应MLLM零样本标注、L3智能体标注工作流，实验表明各阶段逐步提升准确率，实际应用中人工成本降低高达85%。
AI.motivation: 短视频爆发式增长给内容治理带来巨大挑战，传统人工标注效率低、迭代慢、成本高，亟需探索自动化标注方案以逐步减少对人工专家的依赖，提升标注效率与泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建四阶段自动驾驶标注框架：L0为人工专家标注基线；L1引入判别式多模态大语言模型（MLLM），经监督微调直接预测标签；L2采用在短视频数据上预训练的领域自适应MLLM，实现零样本标注，具备灵活泛化能力；L3设计智能体标注工作流，配备关键工具使智能体能处理复杂、陌生或定义模糊的案例，大幅降低人工干预需求。
AI.result: 在多种内容问题上的大量实验表明，框架各阶段依次提升标注准确率，且在实际应用中将人工标注成本降低高达85%。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段自动驾驶标注框架通过逐步引入判别式MLLM、领域自适应MLLM及智能体工作流，有效解决了短视频内容治理中人工标注效率低、泛化差、成本高的问题，实现了标注自动化水平的显著跃升与大幅降本增效。

title: MARL-BattleGrounds: A Novel JAX-native Benchmark for Heterogeneous and Competitive Multi-agent RL
comment: 34 pages, 14 figures, 18 tables. Project website: https://marl-battlegrounds.com
summary: We present MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs), an easy-to-use JAX-native benchmark for heterogeneous and competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), designed to be sample-efficient, computationally efficient, and researcher-centric. MARL benchmarks are typically simple and efficient, like SMAX, where winning reduces to unit micromanagement, or rich and costly, like Dota 2. MARL-BGs fills this missing middle. Its first mode, Team Deathmatch, is a simultaneous turn-based game between two teams of five heterogeneous agents. The five classes have distinct basic, passive, and ultimate abilities designed to synergize with allies and counter enemies. Our 52 hand-designed maps with diverse obstacles include a 12-map curriculum and ten held-out validation and test maps. MARL-BGs provides two canonical evaluation modes. First, eight endgame scenarios form a hard generalization challenge: each asks a team to win an unseen, nearly lost position against a strong reactive controller within 5-10 ticks. Second, a monthly round-robin tournament retrains each submission on equal compute, plays it against every member of the current "Big Nine" field, and publishes the Elo results on the official leaderboard. All entrants are publicly released as downloadable opponents. MARL-BGs records 11,192 metrics per game in 28 topics. We also include three strong scripted opponents, an analytical replay viewer, and off-the-shelf tools for self-play, cross-play, curriculum learning, and zero-shot coordination evaluation. We even provide an API for LLM-based agents and use it to evaluate Qwen3.5-9B against our strongest policy. In our BattleClient, humans can play alongside or against any mix of policies, enabling human-AI evaluation. We benchmark MARL-BGs with six additional deep MARL baselines, which we release. On one RTX 5090 with 1,024 parallel games, the simulator runs 50,000 5v5 game steps per second.

AI.tldr: MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs) 是一个基于 JAX 的异构竞争多智能体强化学习基准，填补了简单高效（如 SMAX）与丰富但昂贵（如 Dota 2）基准之间的空白，提供 Team Deathmatch 模式、52 张地图、课程学习、端局泛化挑战、月度 Elo 锦标赛、11192 项指标、脚本对手、回放查看器、自博弈/跨博弈工具、LLM Agent API 及人机对战客户端，单张 RTX 5090 可跑 50k 5v5 步/秒。
AI.motivation: 现有 MARL 基准两极分化：要么过于简单（如 SMAX，胜负取决于微操），要么计算成本极高（如 Dota 2），缺乏既具策略深度又样本/计算高效的中间地带，且缺乏标准化的泛化评测、长期竞技排位与人机交互评测工具。
AI.method: 设计 5v5 同步回合制 Team Deathmatch，包含 5 个具有基础/被动/大招技能的异构职业；手工制作 52 张多样地图（含 12 张课程图、10 张留出验证/测试图）；提供 8 个端局泛化场景与月度循环赛 Elo 评测；记录 28 类 11192 项指标；内置 3 个强脚本 AI、分析型回放器、自博弈/跨博弈/课程/零样本协作工具链；开放 LLM Agent API 与 BattleClient 人机混战界面；发布 6 个深度 MARL 基线算法。
AI.result: 在单张 RTX 5090、1024 并行环境下，模拟器吞吐达 50,000 5v5 游戏步/秒；端局场景对强反应式控制器构成困难泛化挑战；月度锦标赛已建立“Big Nine”排行榜；Qwen3.5-9B 通过 LLM API 完成对战评测；人类可通过 BattleClient 与任意策略混战；基线算法已开源供复现。
AI.conclusion: MARL-BGs 以 JAX 原生高性能、异构职业设计、丰富地图与课程、双轨评测体系（端局泛化+长期 Elo 赛）、全链路工具链（回放、自博弈、LLM API、人机客户端）确立了新一代竞争型 MARL 研究标准基准，兼顾样本效率、计算效率与研究者易用性。

title: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
summary: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\times$ cumulative rollout speedup and $1.27\times$ cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching $1.97\times$ rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.

AI.tldr: 论文提出KV4-RL方法，结合无需校准的INT4 KV缓存量化与注意力汇聚点及近期上下文的选择性INT8保护，解决异步推理中KV集中导致的INT4量化性能下降问题，在Qwen3模型GRPO训练中实现1.80倍累积推理加速且精度损失仅0.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 异步推理虽提升RLVR效率，但会导致KV缓存工作量集中到更少解码步骤（KV集中现象），使KV缓存量化成为关键加速手段。然而直接使用INT4 KV量化即使配合截断重要性采样仍会损害学习性能，需要在保持加速效果的同时控制量化误差对训练的影响。
AI.method: 提出KV4-RL：1) 采用无需校准的INT4 KV缓存量化；2) 选择性保护固定数量的注意力汇聚点和近期上下文位置使用INT8量化；3) 这种有界位置保护策略减少采样器不匹配，同时保留大部分INT4加速收益。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO训练400迭代中：累积推理加速1.80倍，累积完整迭代加速1.27倍，最后50迭代推理加速达1.97倍。在BF16评估器下，Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base六项基准平均精度与BF16推理训练相差0.5个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: KV4-RL通过有针对性的混合精度量化策略，成功解决了异步推理场景下KV集中导致的INT4量化精度损失问题，实现了显著的推理加速同时保持了训练质量，为大规模RLVR训练提供了实用的系统优化方案。

title: Do LLM Tutors Actually Teach? A Process-Centered Synthesis of the Tutoring Loop
summary: Large language models can produce fluent tu- toring dialogue, but whether they actually help students learn remains unclear. We present a process-centered synthesis of LLM tutoring that follows the path from learner-state infer- ence to pedagogical action, tutor training, eval- uation, and student simulation. This view ex- poses a central gap: implementing a tutoring component does not establish that it works or that its outputs meaningfully affect later stages. A structured study-level audit shows that peda- gogical evaluation is common, while evidence becomes much thinner for learner-conditioned intervention, human learning gains, and espe- cially transfer or delayed retention. Human studies nevertheless provide a conditional posi- tive result: LLM tutors can improve learning, but benefits depend on pedagogical structure, learner engagement, and how learning is mea- sured. We argue that progress requires validat- ing the interfaces between tutoring stages, not only improving individual components.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LLM辅导的过程中心综合框架，揭示核心鸿沟：实现辅导组件不等于有效；结构化审计显示教学评估常见，但学习者条件干预、人类学习增益、迁移/延迟保持的证据稀薄；人类研究表明LLM辅导可提升学习，但收益取决于教学结构、学习者投入度和测量方式；主张进展需验证辅导阶段间接口而非仅改进单一组件。
AI.motivation: 探讨大语言模型在辅导对话中是否真正帮助学生学习，而非仅产生流畅对话。
AI.method: 采用过程中心综合方法，追踪从学习者状态推断到教学行动、导师训练、评估、学生模拟的全链路；并进行结构化研究级审计，系统考察不同阶段的证据厚度。
AI.result: 教学评估环节证据较充分，但学习者条件干预、人类学习增益、迁移或延迟保持的实证显著不足；人类实验给出有条件的正面结论：LLM辅导能改善学习，但效果受教学结构、学习者参与度和学习测量方式调节。
AI.conclusion: 推动LLM辅导实质性进展，关键在于验证辅导各阶段之间的接口有效性（如状态推断→教学行动→学习增益），而非仅优化单个组件。

title: Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables. Code, raw model outputs and tables are available from the corresponding author on request
summary: Language models are increasingly used to create synthetic survey samples, also called silicon samples. Decision models are a new class of language models that return a probability for each point of a rating scale instead of text. We ask whether these models, or the newest generative LLMs, can stand in for human respondents on a psychometric survey. We test fourteen decision models from eleven providers and 47 generative LLMs on an open Lithuanian organisational-psychology survey (n=263, 68 items), with 100 real respondent profiles, the Psychometric Similarity Score (PSS) and statistical baselines. The best generative model, MiniMax M3, reaches PSS 0.813. This is level with a Gaussian copula fit only on other respondents (0.824) and below a copula fit in sample (0.927). A second sample of 100 real people scores below the best models, so at this size PSS cannot rank them against real respondents. In 5 of 10 product lines the newest generative release scores below an earlier release of the same line beyond resampling noise, and none gains beyond it. With the default rounded readout, 13 of 14 decision models score below the generative reference gpt-5.4-mini. Of the 47 generative models, 33 reproduce the pattern of item correlations better than any decision model. Averaged over respondents, the probability vectors are much closer to the human item marginals than rounded answers. They also rank respondents about as well as a profile regression fit on 163 real people. As forecasts of each person's own answers, however, every decision model is worse than the answer frequencies of other respondents, mainly because its average vector differs from them. The profile regression improves on these frequencies by only 1.0%, so the profile fields say little about how a person answers. Synthetic respondents built on such profiles should therefore aim at sample-level fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了14个决策模型和47个生成式LLM在立陶宛组织心理学调查（n=263，68项）上作为合成受访者（硅样本）的心理测量相似度。最佳生成式模型MiniMax M3的PSS达到0.813，接近仅基于其他受访者的高斯Copula拟合（0.824），但低于样本内Copula拟合（0.927）。生成式模型整体优于决策模型：33/47个生成式模型在项目相关模式复现上超越所有决策模型。决策模型的概率向量虽比四舍五入答案更接近人类边际分布，且能像基于163真人档案的档案回归那样给受访者排序，但在预测个体自身答案时均劣于其他受访者的回答频率，档案回归仅改进1.0%，说明档案字段对个体回答解释力极低。结论：合成受访者应以样本级保真度为目标。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型越来越多地用于创建合成调查样本（硅样本），需要系统评估决策模型（输出评分量表概率）和最新生成式LLM能否在心理测量调查中替代人类受访者，并量化其样本级与个体级的保真度。
AI.method: 在公开的立陶宛组织心理学调查（263名受访者，68个项目）上，选取100个真实受访者档案，测试来自11家提供商的14个决策模型和47个生成式LLM。使用心理测量相似度分数（PSS）和统计基线（高斯Copula拟合、档案回归、其他受访者回答频率）进行对比，考察项目相关模式复现、边际分布拟合、受访者排序及个体答案预测等多维指标。
AI.result: 最佳生成式模型MiniMax M3的PSS为0.813，与仅基于其他受访者的Copula拟合（0.824）持平，低于样本内Copula拟合（0.927）。第二批100名真人的得分低于最佳模型，说明此时PSS无法将模型与真人排序。10条产品线中有5条的最新版本得分低于早期版本（超出重采样噪声），无一显著提升。默认四舍五入读出下，13/14个决策模型低于生成式基准gpt-5.4-mini。33/47个生成式模型在项目相关模式复现上优于所有决策模型。平均后的概率向量比四舍五入答案更接近人类项目边际分布，且受访者排序能力相当于基于163真人的档案回归。但作为个体答案预测，所有决策模型均劣于其他受访者的回答频率，档案回归仅改进1.0%。
AI.conclusion: 生成式LLM在样本级心理测量保真度上已接近统计基线，显著优于决策模型。决策模型虽提供概率向量，但在个体预测上无优势，档案变量对个体回答解释力极低（仅1.0%改进）。因此，基于此类档案构建的合成受访者应以样本级保真度为目标，而非个体级预测。

title: Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers
summary: Looped transformers reuse a single block across iterations, raising a natural question: how far can a block trained at one depth be safely extrapolated to greater depths? We study this question for all-pairs graph connectivity, where harder graphs require longer-range information propagation. We show that under exchangeability and symmetric positive initialization, population training at depth K converges to an update rule governed by a single effective parameter that balances graph propagation against fitting structure unresolved at training depth. This trade-off creates a finite extrapolation window: too few test-time loops provide insufficient propagation, while too many eventually create false connections. We derive explicit endpoints for this window and bound the graph hardness solvable beyond training as a function of training depth and hardness. In particular, a test depth chosen solely from the training distribution can guarantee recovery on substantially harder graphs, with a certified depth gain that grows exponentially as training depth outpaces training hardness. Experiments validate the predicted windows and show how compute budget and initialization affect the optimal training depth.

AI.tldr: 论文研究循环Transformer在图连通性任务中的外推能力，证明在交换性和对称正初始化下，训练深度K的模块存在一个由单一有效参数控制的有限外推窗口，测试深度可从训练分布中选择以解决更难的图问题，且认证深度增益随训练深度超越训练难度呈指数增长。
AI.motivation: 探究循环Transformer（复用单一模块跨迭代）能将训练深度外推多远，特别是在需要长程信息传播的全对图连通性任务中，理解外推的理论极限和最优训练深度选择。
AI.method: 在交换性和对称正初始化假设下，分析深度K的总体训练动态，推导出由单一有效参数控制的更新规则，该参数平衡图传播与训练深度未解决的结构拟合。显式推导外推窗口的端点，并给出可解图难度随训练深度和难度的界。
AI.result: 存在有限外推窗口：测试循环太少导致传播不足，太多产生虚假连接。从训练分布选择的测试深度能保证在显著更难的图上恢复连通性，认证深度增益随训练深度超越训练难度指数增长。实验验证预测窗口，展示计算预算和初始化对最优训练深度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 为循环Transformer在图连通性任务中的深度外推提供了理论保证，明确了外推窗口边界及其对训练参数的依赖，指导实际部署中测试深度和训练深度的选择。

title: bharatSetu: a 1M x 22 bridge for indic translation
