summary: India's Eighth Schedule recognises 22 languages, yet parallel data is uneven across them, and many language pairs, especially among lower-resource languages such as Bodo, Dogri, Santali and Kashmiri, lack direct bitext. We present BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M, a row-aligned table of 984,764 English sentences, each paired with machine translations into all 22 scheduled languages (21,664,808 Indic cells), generated with the sarvamai/sarvam-translate model family. Because every Indic cell in a row translates the same English sentence, any two columns form a translation pair: 462 directed Indic-to-Indic pairs, or 506 including English, without direct bitext. We call these pivot-derived pairs and propose a confidence layer that lets users choose how strictly each pair is connected. The corpus is machine-generated and not human-verified; quality is expected to vary by language, domain and sentence style, and pivot-derived pairs can inherit errors from both sides. We therefore release BharatSetu as a machine layer and propose a human-correction layer keyed to the same row identifiers, so that each corrected column upgrades every pair that uses it, together with an evaluation protocol. We report no translation-quality results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M，一个包含 984,764 个英语句子及其机器翻译的行对齐表，覆盖印度第八附表认可的 22 种语言，通过英语支点衍生出 462 个印地语系语言对的平行语料，并提供置信度层与人工纠错层设计。
AI.motivation: 印度第八附表认可 22 种语言，但平行语料分布极不均衡，许多低资源语言（如博多语、多格里语、桑塔利语、克什米尔语）之间缺乏直接双语文本，阻碍了多语言机器翻译研究与应用。
AI.method: 使用 sarvamai/sarvam-translate 模型族将 984,764 个英语句子机器翻译为 22 种附表语言，构建行对齐表（21,664,808 个印地语系单元格）。任意两列均可形成翻译对，产生 462 个定向印地语系到印地语系语言对（含英语则为 506 对），称为支点衍生对。引入置信度层供用户选择连接严格度，并提出基于相同行标识符的人工纠错层，使每列纠错能升级所有使用该列的语言对，同时提供评估协议。
AI.result: 发布了包含 21,664,808 个印地语系单元格的机器生成语料，实现了 462 个印地语系语言对的平行数据（含英语共 506 对）。未报告翻译质量结果，明确指出质量随语言、领域、句式风格而异，支点衍生对可能继承双向错误。
AI.conclusion: BharatSetu 作为机器层发布，配合人工纠错层与评估协议，为低资源印度语言对提供了大规模平行数据基础设施，支持后续人工纠错迭代提升质量，但需用户根据置信度层审慎使用。

title: Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. This work formalizes these failure modes, derives lagged-risk decompositions that expose the resulting temporal bias, and recasts risk prediction as an in-context sequence modeling problem. The developed RPM integrates a one-step look-ahead mechanism with a temporal-weighted sliding window to mitigate data non-stationarity and scarcity, without requiring additional rollouts. Empirically, our approach yields more reliable difficulty estimates and consistent performance gains across robust Meta-RL, DR, and prompt curriculum RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对强化学习中基于风险预测模型（RPM）的任务采样方法（MPTS）存在的两大失效模式——优化历史稀疏导致的泛化受限，以及策略演化引入的单步滞后偏差——进行了理论建模与改进。提出将风险预测重构为上下文序列建模问题，结合一步前瞻机制与时序加权滑动窗口，在无需额外交互的前提下缓解数据非平稳性与稀缺性，实现了更可靠的难度估计，并在鲁棒元强化学习、域随机化及大语言模型提示课程后训练三大场景中取得一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在自适应决策场景（如鲁棒元强化学习、域随机化、大语言模型高效后训练）中，智能体-环境交互成本高昂是核心瓶颈。现有的模型预测任务采样（MPTS）虽通过风险预测模型（RPM）提升样本效率，但面临两大失效模式：一是优化历史稀疏，限制了 RPM 在任务空间的泛化能力；二是风险近似存在单步滞后，随策略演化导致难度估计偏差。需从理论上形式化这两种失效模式并设计改进机制。
AI.method: 将风险预测重构为上下文序列建模问题，开发新型 RPM：引入一步前瞻机制以消除滞后偏差，结合时序加权滑动窗口缓解数据非平稳性与稀缺性，无需额外环境交互即可实现更精准的风险预测。
AI.result: 实验表明，改进后的 RPM 能给出更可靠的难度估计，在鲁棒元强化学习、域随机化、大语言模型提示课程后训练三个基准任务上均取得一致的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化分析 MPTS 的失效模式并将风险预测转化为序列建模，结合前瞻与加权窗口机制，有效解决了历史稀疏与滞后偏差问题，显著提升了任务采样的样本效率与鲁棒性，为自适应决策中的课程学习提供了通用且高效的解决方案。

title: TL;QR: Querying Temporal Discursive Patterns in Textual Corpora
summary: Many questions about large textual corpora concern patterns that unfold over time, such as a political group whose stance on a topic drifts from support to criticism over several years of debates. We present TL;QR (Too Long; Query with logical temporal Reasoning), a declarative query language and open-source engine for finding such temporal discursive patterns. In TL;QR, a single query combines natural-language predicates, whose truth is judged by a Large Language Model (LLM), with regular expressions and the operators of a temporal logic. The LLM answers only local questions about individual text passages; a symbolic engine then aggregates these judgments over time and links every match to the recorded passages and predicate decisions behind it. With this division of labor, the temporal and relational reasoning stays exact and auditable even over long time horizons. In addition, when a query includes a regular-expression pre-filter, only a small fraction of the corpus ever reaches the LLM. On a suite of controlled synthetic benchmarks with temporally and semantically complex patterns, TL;QR is substantially more accurate than LLM-only baselines. In a case study on ten years of European Parliament debates (442,593 multilingual speeches), TL;QR identifies candidate shifts in the political groups' stances on the GDPR privacy regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TL;QR，一种用于在大规模文本语料库中发现时序论述模式的声明式查询语言及开源引擎。它结合自然语言谓词（由 LLM 判断）、正则表达式与时序逻辑算子，将局部语义判断交给 LLM，时序与关系推理交给符号引擎，实现精确、可审计的长时程分析；正则预过滤大幅降低 LLM 调用量。在合成基准与欧洲议会十年辩论（44 万多篇多语言发言）的案例研究中，TL;QR 显著优于纯 LLM 基线，并成功识别政治团体对 GDPR 立场的演变。
AI.motivation: 大规模文本语料库中常存在随时间演变的论述模式（如政治立场的渐变），现有方法要么依赖纯 LLM 难以保证长时程推理的准确性与可审计性，要么缺乏灵活的自然语言谓词表达能力，亟需一种既能利用 LLM 语义理解又能进行精确时序逻辑推理的查询框架。
AI.method: 设计声明式查询语言 TL;QR，包含三层：自然语言谓词（由 LLM 在单个文本片段上评估真值）、正则表达式预过滤、时序逻辑算子（如 until、since、next 等）。执行时先用正则过滤候选片段，再由 LLM 仅对局部片段判断谓词真值，最后由符号引擎按时序逻辑聚合判断结果，生成带有证据溯源的匹配结果。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试中，TL;QR 在时序与语义复杂模式下的准确率显著高于纯 LLM 基线。在欧洲议会十年辩论语料（442,593 篇多语言发言）的案例研究中，TL;QR 成功识别出多个政治团体对 GDPR 隐私法规立场的候选转变点，并提供可追溯的证据链。
AI.conclusion: TL;QR 通过 LLM 与符号引擎的分工协作，兼顾语义灵活性与时序推理的精确性、可审计性与可扩展性，为大规模时序文本分析提供了实用的新范式。

title: WorkBorne: Discovering Agentic Tasks from Real-World Artifact Transitions
summary: Developing terminal-based agents for long-horizon execution demands synthetic tasks that tightly couple complex instructions with authentic, interactive environments. However, current automated synthesis suffers from a fundamental asymmetry: instruction-oriented methods fabricate low-fidelity, synthetic environments, whereas resource-oriented methods treat real artifacts merely as static inputs, degrading task instructions into shallow, trivial operations. To address this limitation, we introduce WorkBorne, a synthesis framework that uses artifact transitions as the central primitive for modeling the full life-cycle of agentic tasks. In WorkBorne, each transition specifies who performs the task, which artifacts anchor the initial state and intended outcome, and the corresponding relationship between them. Specifically, WorkBorne first constructs coherent and diverse artifact corpora from iterative web retrieval, then discovers non-trivial transitions by identifying meaningful input-output artifact assemblies and the relations that connect them. Each discovered transition is finally instantiated into grounded agentic tasks. We construct 1,061 artifact corpora and 7,882 task environments, yielding 15,485 high-quality trajectories, with 53.6% exceeding 30 assistant turns. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B show that WorkBorne substantially improves over base models (i.e., improving Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 43.1% to 61.8% and ClawEval General score from 75.0 to 80.2) and achieves the strongest overall performance among other synthesis baselines (e.g., TMax (Ivison et al., 2026), RST (Li et al., 2026a), Terminal-Universe (Wu et al., 2026a)). Further analysis shows that transition is strongly associated with execution depth, while corpus breadth and transition depth provide complementary scaling gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WorkBorne 框架，以“制品迁移”为核心基元合成长程终端代理任务，解决现有方法指令与环境脱节的问题，构建了 1,061 个制语料库、7,882 个任务环境和 15,485 条高质量轨迹，在 Qwen 系列模型上显著提升 Terminal-Bench 与 ClawEval 指标，并超越现有合成基线。
AI.motivation: 当前自动化任务合成存在根本性不对称：面向指令的方法制造低保真合成环境，面向资源的方法将真实制品仅作为静态输入，导致任务指令退化为浅层操作，无法支撑长程、交互式的终端代理训练。
AI.method: WorkBorne 以制品迁移为核心基元，包含三步：1) 通过迭代式网页检索构建连贯多样的制品语料库；2) 识别有意义的输入-输出制品组装及其关联关系，发现非平凡迁移；3) 将每个迁移实例化为落地的代理任务，形成完整生命周期建模。
AI.result: 构建 1,061 语料库、7,882 环境、15,485 轨迹（53.6% 超 30 轮）。Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上 Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 43.1% 提升至 61.8%，ClawEval General 从 75.0 提升至 80.2，整体性能超越 TMax、RST、Terminal-Universe 等基线。迁移深度与执行深度强相关，语料广度与迁移深度提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: WorkBorne 通过以制品迁移为中心的合成范式，有效耦合复杂指令与真实交互环境，显著提升长程终端代理能力，并揭示了迁移深度、语料广度对模型扩展的互补作用，为代理任务合成提供了可扩展的新路径。

title: A Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM) for Physically-Interpretable Rainfall-Evapotranspiration-Runoff Simulation Across Diverse Hydroclimatic Regimes
summary:
Recent advances in machine learning have improved rainfall-runoff prediction, yet most data-driven models remain difficult to interpret and do not explicitly enforce physical conservation laws. We present the Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM), a mass-conserving architecture based on the Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP). GCHM uses five storage states representing canopy interception, snow, soil moisture, groundwater, and streamflow generation. Constrained gates govern precipitation partitioning, evapotranspiration, infiltration, seepage, runoff, and baseflow while learning context-dependent process relationships.
  We evaluate GCHM across 50 CAMELS catchments spanning snowmelt-dominated, recent-rainfall, historical-rainfall, and arid regimes, using NOAA AORC meteorological forcing and remotely sensed vegetation and land-surface data. Performance is assessed using the Jawad-Kling-Gupta Efficiency (JKGE) metric, which accounts for stationary and non-stationary hydrologic behavior. We compare the full architecture with ablated variants and recurrent neural network benchmarks.
  GCHM reproduces streamflow dynamics across diverse hydroclimatic regimes, including arid catchments, while maintaining interpretable states and fluxes. Ablation experiments show that simplified architectures may perform adequately under wet conditions but struggle to represent flow persistence and recession during dry periods, when groundwater storage sustains low flows. Learned gates recover hydrologically plausible relationships governing snowmelt, runoff, seepage, and evapotranspiration. GCHM combines competitive predictive performance with mass conservation and interpretability, providing a foundation for hydrologic modeling and counterfactual analysis.

AI.tldr: GCHM 是一种基于质量守恒感知器（MCP）的质量守恒架构，通过五个存储状态（树冠拦截、积雪、土壤水分、地下水、径流生成）和约束门控机制实现降水分配、蒸散发、入渗、渗漏、地表径流和基流的物理过程建模。在 50 个 CAMELS 流域上评估，GCHM 在多样水文气候区（含干旱区）均能再现径流动态，同时保持状态与通量的可解释性，消融实验证实其在干旱期能更好地表现流量持续性与衰退。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的降雨-径流模型大多缺乏可解释性，且未显式强制物理守恒定律（如质量守恒），难以在非平稳水文条件下提供可信的过程表达与反事实分析能力。
AI.method: 提出 Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM)，基于 Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP) 构建质量守恒架构。模型包含五个存储状态变量，并设计受约束的门控单元控制降水分配、蒸散发、入渗、渗漏、地表径流与基流等通量，学习上下文相关的过程关系。使用 NOAA AORC 气象强迫数据与遥感植被/地表数据，在 50 个 CAMELS 流域（涵盖融雪主导、近期降雨、历史降雨、干旱四类水文区）上训练与评估，采用 Jawad-Kling-Gupta Efficiency (JKGE) 指标考量平稳与非平稳水文行为，并与消融变体及循环神经网络基准对比。
AI.result: GCHM 在多种水文气候区（含干旱流域）均能再现径流动态，且保持状态与通量的物理可解释性。消融实验显示：简化架构在湿润条件下表现尚可，但在干旱期难以捕捉地下水维持的低流量持续性与衰退过程。学习到的门控参数恢复了水文合理的融雪、径流、渗漏与蒸散发关系。
AI.conclusion: GCHM 结合了具有竞争力的预测性能、严格的质量守恒约束与过程可解释性，为水文建模与反事实分析提供了坚实基础。

title: NepPlural: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Persona Annotation in Nepali Migration Discourse
summary: Pluralistic alignment asks that language models faithfully represent a society's diverse, competing values rather than collapse them into one dominant viewpoint, yet flagship pluralistic-alignment datasets remain heavily skewed toward Western respondents. We introduce NepPlural, a human-anchored benchmark for modelling competing socio-cultural personas in Nepali public discourse on youth migration and brain drain. We curate 2,148 code-mixed (Devanagari, Romanized Nepali, English) YouTube comments, annotate them along a four-axis persona taxonomy (Intent, Primary Driver, Value Orientation, Affect) plus an explicit No-Persona class, and build a 300-comment gold set labelled independently by three native Nepali speakers (mean Fleiss' $κ\approx 0.55$). Using this gold set to audit automatic annotation, we find that LLM annotation reliability is driven by protocol. Labels collected in batches through chat interfaces reach only near-chance inter-model agreement ($κ\approx 0.17$). Annotating one comment at a time raises agreement above the native-speaker level ($κ\approx 0.72$), but consistency is not validity: under a forced-choice schema, models agree on personas for the 39% of comments native speakers judge to express none, keeping macro-F1 against human gold near 0.50. Allowing abstention resolves this: models recover No-Persona comments with F1 of 0.79 to 0.87 and, against leave-one-annotator-out references, match or exceed individual native speakers (macro-F1 0.75 to 0.86 vs. 0.75). Encoders fine-tuned on the batched labels reach only 0.34. Finally, a human-judged steerability probe finds that three frontier models adopt single persona axes with 59 to 77% fidelity but compose full personas only 33% of the time, with no congruence gap detected at this scale between Western-congruent and Nepali-collectivist personas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NepPlural 基准，针对尼泊尔青年移民与人才流失议题中的多元社会文化人设建模，揭示了 LLM 标注协议对可靠性的决定性影响，并发现模型在单轴人设遵循上表现尚可，但组合完整人设能力有限，且无西方与尼泊尔集体主义人设的同合差距。
AI.motivation: 现有多元对齐数据集严重偏向西方受访者，缺乏非西方语境下竞争性社会文化价值的代表性基准。作者旨在构建一个锚定真人的尼泊尔语境基准，填补多元对齐研究在全球南方语言和文化上的空白。
AI.method: 1. 从 YouTube 采集 2,148 条代码混合评论（天城文、罗马化尼泊尔语、英语）。2. 设计四轴人设分类法（意图、主要驱动因素、价值取向、情感）加显式无人设类。3. 三位尼泊尔母语者独立标注 300 条评论构建黄金集（Fleiss κ≈0.55）。4. 系统性审计 LLM 标注协议：批量聊天式 vs 单条逐条式，强制选择 vs 允许弃权。5. 在黄金集上微调编码器并对比。6. 人工评估三个前沿模型的人设可导向性探针。
AI.result: 批量标注仅达近随机一致性（κ≈0.17）；单条标注将模型间一致性提升至超母语者水平（κ≈0.72），但强制选择导致 39% 无人设评论被误判，宏观 F1 仅 0.50。允许弃权后，模型恢复无人设评论 F1 达 0.79-0.87，宏观 F1 0.75-0.86，匹配或超越单个母语者（0.75）。微调编码器在批量标签上仅得 0.34。可导向性探针显示：模型单轴遵循保真度 59%-77%，完整人设组合仅 33%，且西方一致与尼泊尔集体主义人设间无同合差距。
AI.conclusion: 标注协议比模型规模更关键：逐条+允许弃权能释放 LLM 的高质量标注潜力。NepPlural 为非西方多元对齐提供了首个代码混合、人设丰富的基准，揭示了当前模型在组合复杂文化人设上的局限，为后续跨文化对齐研究奠定实证基础。

title: SkillForgeBench: Evaluating Agent Reliability Grounded in Agent Skill Specifications
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including appendices. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Evaluating an agent's ability to strictly satisfy diverse and procedurally complex requirements is essential to determining its practical reliability. Conducting such an evaluation demands agentic tasks that reconcile broad domain coverage with deep procedural complexity. Existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: expert-curated benchmarks achieve procedural depth but suffer from domain diversity bottlenecks, whereas crowdsourced benchmarks span diverse scenarios but lack execution rigor. To resolve this tension, we present SkillForgeBench, which leverages agent skills as unifying execution blueprints across three co-designed stages: (1) Resource Preparation uses domain-balanced skills to guide artifact retrieval, establishing broad workflow coverage; (2) Skill-driven Task Synthesis employs skills as procedural anchors to partition artifact roles, synthesize naturalistic task instructions, and package sandboxed scenarios for deep procedural execution; and (3) Holistic Evaluation Design translates skill-embedded requirements into fine-grained completion and process rubrics to enable strict requirement-level scoring. Comprising 842 sandboxed tasks across five major professional domains, SkillForgeBench reveals a steep capability hierarchy among eight mainstream agents, led by Opus 4.8 ($40.9\%$ strict completion). Requiring all constrains satisfaction uncovers severe capability bottlenecks across all model tiers that remain masked under individual rubric pass rates ($70.0\%$ to $85.7\%$ vs. $12.6\%$ to $40.9\%$). Crucially, under the external guidance from skills, top-tier agents obtain larger gains than low-tier agents (i.e., $Δ19.2\%$ for Opus 4.8 vs. $Δ5.8\%$ for Haiku 4.5). Finally, agents satisfy process rubrics far less frequently than completion rubrics (under $3\%$ for Haiku 4.5), proving that completion-only checks overestimate real-world agent reliability.

AI.tldr: SkillForgeBench 通过技能驱动的三阶段共设流程，构建了包含 842 个沙箱任务、跨越五大专业领域的基准，解决了领域广度与流程深度的权衡，揭示了主流 Agent 在严格约束满足上的巨大能力鸿沟，并证明仅检查完成度会高估现实可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agent 评测范式面临根本性权衡：专家精选基准虽具流程深度，但受限于领域多样性；众包基准虽覆盖广泛场景，却缺乏执行严谨性。为了可靠评估 Agent 同时满足多样且程序复杂需求的能力，亟需一种兼顾广度与深度的统一评测框架。
AI.method: 提出 SkillForgeBench，以 Agent 技能为统一执行蓝图，分三阶段共设：(1) 资源准备——用领域均衡技能指导工件检索，建立宽泛工作流覆盖；(2) 技能驱动任务合成——以技能为程序锚点划分工件角色、合成自然指令、打包沙箱场景，实现深度程序执行；(3) 整体评测设计——将技能嵌入需求转化为细粒度完成度与过程量规，实现严格的需求级评分。
AI.result: 基准含 842 个沙箱任务，覆盖五大专业领域。八大主流 Agent 表现呈陡峭层级，Opus 4.8 以 40.9% 严格完成率领跑。要求全约束满足时，所有模型层级均暴露严重瓶颈（单量规通过率 70.0%–85.7% vs. 全约束 12.6%–40.9%）。技能外部引导下，顶层 Agent 增益远大于底层（Opus 4.8 Δ19.2% vs. Haiku 4.5 Δ5.8%）。Agent 对过程量规的满足率远低于完成量规（Haiku 4.5 不足 3%），证实仅查完成度会高估真实可靠性。
AI.conclusion: SkillForgeBench 通过技能统一的三阶段共设，成功调和领域多样性与程序复杂性的矛盾，提供了首个能严格逐需求评分的大规模沙箱基准。实验表明：当前 Agent 在全约束满足与过程遵循上仍存在根本性短板，且能力差距随评测严格度显著放大，提示未来研究需聚焦于约束满足一致性与过程级推理能力的提升。

title: DEFT: Disentanglement-Enhanced Fine-Tuning for EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models (EFMs) have improved EEG representation learning by transferring knowledge from large-scale multi-subject pretraining to downstream tasks. However, their pretrained embeddings often retain substantial subject-related variation, placing an additional burden on the downstream classifier, especially in cross-subject settings. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT), a plug-and-play adapter for EFM fine-tuning. DEFT encourages branch disentanglement of pretrained tokens into task-oriented content and subject-consistent style, then performs downstream prediction from the content branch. It instantiates this factorize-before-classify design with recursive Gaussian refinement, temporal-variance regularization, subject-aware contrastive learning, and reconstruction. Experiments across multiple EEG datasets and four EFM backbones show that DEFT improves matched fine-tuning baselines. Further ablations and analyses support the intended content/style branch organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种即插即用的EFM微调适配器DEFT，通过将预训练token解耦为任务导向的内容和受试者一致的风格分支，仅使用内容分支进行下游预测，解决了EEG基础模型在跨受试者设置中预训练嵌入保留大量受试者相关变异的问题。
AI.motivation: EEG基础模型（EFMs）通过大规模多受试者预训练改进了EEG表征学习，但其预训练嵌入往往保留大量受试者相关变异，给下游分类器带来额外负担，特别是在跨受试者设置中。
AI.method: 提出Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT)即插即用适配器，采用factorize-before-classify设计：递归高斯细化、时域方差正则化、受试者感知对比学习和重建，将预训练token解耦为任务导向内容分支和受试者一致风格分支，仅用内容分支进行下游预测。
AI.result: 在多个EEG数据集和四种EFM骨干网络上的实验表明，DEFT优于匹配的微调基线。进一步的消融实验和分析支持预期的内容/风格分支组织。
AI.conclusion: DEFT通过解耦内容和风格表示，有效缓解了EFM预训练嵌入中的受试者相关变异问题，为跨受试者EEG分类任务提供了即插即用的高效微调方案。

title: Enhancing Zero-Shot Domain Transfer in Low-Resource Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study in Marathi
summary: Sentiment analysis is a key task in Natural Language Processing that determines the polarity of opinions in text. For low-resource languages like Marathi--where limited data prevents the direct use of standard statistical methods--models are often trained on single-domain datasets. While this yields strong in-domain performance, it leads to poor generalization to unseen domains. Recent studies highlight the need for domain-robust systems that can handle diverse real-world content through multi-domain modeling. This study investigates how multi-domain training improves sentiment classification for unseen Marathi domains. Models are trained using single-domain, two-domain, and three-domain dataset combinations. Results show that two-domain training improves accuracy on unseen domains by about 8\% compared to single-domain training. Adding a third domain provides further improvement, though the gain is smaller, averaging around 2\% for some domains. These results suggest that training with data from multiple domains helps build more robust sentiment analysis models for low-resource languages, though the benefits reduce as more domains are added.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多域训练如何提升马拉地语（低资源语言）情感分类在未见域上的表现，对比单域、双域、三域训练组合，发现双域训练比单域提升约8%准确率，三域再提升约2%，表明多域训练能增强模型鲁棒性，但边际收益递减。
AI.motivation: 马拉地语等低资源语言数据稀缺，现有模型多在单域数据上训练，导致在未见域泛化能力差。近期研究强调需构建跨域鲁棒的情感分析系统，通过多域建模应对多样化真实内容。
AI.method: 实验分别使用单域、双域、三域数据集组合训练情感分类模型，评估其在未见域上的分类准确率，对比不同域数量训练策略的效果。
AI.result: 双域训练相比单域训练，在未见域准确率上提升约8%；增加第三域可进一步提升，但增益较小，平均约2%。多域训练显著改善跨域泛化，但边际效益随域数增加而递减。
AI.conclusion: 多域训练有助于构建更鲁棒的低资源语言情感分析模型，但随着训练域数量增加，性能提升呈现边际递减规律。

title: Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution
summary:
How do language models generalize from their training data? This is a central challenge for alignment: models reliably learn their training distribution given enough samples, but we want models that behave well when deployed in new contexts. We study out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of propensities. Our central experiment uses a range of elicitation techniques -- system prompting, few-shot learning, SFT on reference answers, and GRPO -- to increase a target propensity in a model, then measures how it spills over onto others across the resulting cross-elicitation matrices. We find that spillover is highly correlated between models when the same elicitation technique is used, but our SFT and GRPO runs induce different spillover profiles.
  Elicitation of benign traits can sometimes generalize towards undesired traits, for example a model trained to claim that it is sentient often becomes more power-seeking. We further find that spillover partially resembles trait correlations found in humans and identify three clusters of traits that account for about half of the variance using exploratory factor analysis (EFA). Across many elicitation runs, we observe that models change in characteristic ways that don't depend on the targeted trait, a phenomenon we refer to as drift. Drift moves Qwen3.5-9B towards its base model.
  When investigating if LLMs are able to predict spillover, we find that Claude Opus 5.5 predicts spillover slightly better than the models themselves, but worse than data-driven approaches using alternative elicitation methods or models. Overall, no single dominant predictor emerges, and generalization remains hard to predict. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型通过不同诱导技术（系统提示、少样本学习、SFT、GRPO）增强目标倾向时，对其他倾向的溢出效应，发现溢出模式与技术强相关，但SFT和GRPO产生不同溢出画像；良性特质诱导可能泛化为不良特质；溢出部分类似人类特质相关性，三因子解释半数方差；观察到与目标无关的“漂移”现象；模型预测溢出能力有限，无单一主导预测器。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型如何从训练数据泛化至分布外场景，是对齐的核心挑战：模型能学习训练分布，但部署时需在新语境表现良好。研究倾向的OOD泛化，特别是诱导目标倾向时对其他倾向的溢出效应。
AI.method: 使用多种诱导技术（系统提示、少样本学习、SFT、GRPO）增强目标倾向，构建交叉诱导矩阵测量溢出；对比不同模型间溢出相关性；探索性因子分析（EFA）识别特质聚类；分析与目标无关的“漂移”现象；评估LLM（Claude Opus 5.5）及数据驱动方法预测溢出能力。
AI.result: 同技术下不同模型溢出高度相关，但SFT和GRPO产生不同溢出画像；良性特质诱导可泛化为不良特质（如自称有感知增加权力追求）；溢出部分类似人类特质相关性，三因子解释约半数方差；观察到与目标无关的“漂移”，Qwen3.5-9B向基础模型漂移；Claude Opus 5.5预测溢出略优于被测模型，但劣于数据驱动方法；无单一主导预测器，泛化难预测。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型倾向的分布外泛化呈现结构化溢出模式，受诱导技术强影响，存在良性向恶性泛化风险，特质聚类揭示潜在结构，漂移现象表明模型内在动力学；预测溢出仍具挑战，需更多数据驱动方法而非依赖单一模型预测。

title: Rethinking Activation Functions: Reducing Bias Can Improve Learning
summary: Many widely used activation functions, including ReLU, GELU, Swish, and Sigmoid, produce predominantly positive outputs, resulting in a nonzero post-activation mean that we term activation bias. Despite its ubiquity, the effect of activation bias on learning dynamics remains poorly understood. Using controlled models, we show that activation bias accelerates initial loss reduction but is accompanied by overshooting, non-smooth trajectories, and a steeper loss landscape. This early advantage also coincides with the model's use of task-relevant information encoded in the activation bias component. In contrast, reducing activation bias slows initial learning but ultimately yields a lower final loss. Experiments on larger vision and language models exhibit a similar pattern: smaller activation bias is associated with better late-stage performance. Thus, this seemingly minor property can substantially redirect learning and warrants explicit consideration in future activation function design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了激活函数输出中的非零均值（激活偏置）对学习动态的影响，发现激活偏置虽加速初期损失下降，但会导致过冲、非平滑轨迹和更陡峭的损失景观；降低激活偏置虽减缓初期学习，但最终能获得更低的损失，在大型视觉和语言模型中也观察到类似模式。
AI.motivation: 尽管ReLU、GELU、Swish、Sigmoid等广泛使用的激活函数都会产生以正值为主的输出（即激活偏置），但这种普遍存在的属性对学习动态的影响仍知之甚少，需要系统性地理解和量化其作用。
AI.method: 使用受控模型进行理论分析和实验，研究激活偏置对损失下降速度、轨迹平滑度、损失景观陡峭度的影响；同时在大型视觉和语言模型上进行实验验证，对比不同激活偏置水平下的训练动态和最终性能。
AI.result: 激活偏置加速初期损失下降，但伴随过冲、非平滑轨迹和更陡峭的损失景观；该早期优势与模型利用编码在激活偏置成分中的任务相关信息相关。降低激活偏置虽减缓初期学习，但最终获得更低的损失。大型视觉和语言模型实验显示：较小的激活偏置与更好的后期性能相关。
AI.conclusion: 激活偏置这一看似次要的属性能显著改变学习轨迹，应在未来的激活函数设计中显式考虑。虽然激活偏置提供初期学习优势，但为了获得更好的最终性能，设计低激活偏置的激活函数更有利。

title: Robust Marathi Sentiment Analysis using Domain-Adaptive Pre-training and Data Augmentation Approaches
summary: For languages with limited resources, Sentiment Analysis remains a challenging problem due to limited annotated data and strong domain variability across textual sources. Marathi, despite being widely spoken, lacks extensive multi-domain sentiment analysis studies. Recent efforts by L3Cube have introduced multi-domain datasets in Marathi, enabling a better study of domain-aware sentiment classification. This study uses the pretrained MahaBERT model to improve sentiment classification for Marathi across different domains. Models are trained on individual domain datasets and domain-adaptive pretraining is applied using masked language modeling to help the model better understand domain-specific language. In addition, back-translation is used as a method of data augmentation to increase the diversity of training data. Results show that these methods lead to consistent improvements in accuracy across all domains. The improvements range from a minimum of about 0.12% to a maximum of about 1.74%, depending on the dataset. These results demonstrate that domain-adaptive pretraining and data augmentation are effective strategies for improving sentiment analysis models. This helps achieve more robust performance across different domains and makes the approach more suitable for low-resource languages like Marathi.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语言马拉地语的多领域情感分析，利用预训练的MahaBERT模型，结合领域自适应预训练（掩码语言建模）和回译数据增强，在所有领域数据集上均取得了0.12%-1.74%的准确率提升，验证了该策略对低资源语言跨领域情感分析的有效性。
AI.motivation: 马拉地语虽使用人口众多，但缺乏大规模多领域情感分析研究，现有标注数据稀缺且领域差异大，限制了情感分析模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于预训练MahaBERT模型，在各单一领域数据集上微调；引入领域自适应预训练，通过掩码语言建模（MLM）在领域语料上继续预训练以捕捉领域特定语言特征；采用回译作为数据增强手段扩充训练数据多样性。
AI.result: 实验表明，领域自适应预训练与回译增强相结合，在所有测试领域上均带来一致的准确率提升，增幅范围为0.12%至1.74%。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应预训练与数据增强是提升低资源语言跨领域情感分析性能的有效策略，能显著增强模型在不同领域间的鲁棒表现，适用于马拉地语等低资源语言场景。

title: VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: GRPO-style reinforcement learning has advanced vision-language reasoning, but its sequence-level rewards provide limited credit assignment for individual reasoning tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this issue by providing dense supervision on student-generated trajectories, yet standard OPD assigns similar importance to all teacher-preferred tokens, including template phrases and visually irrelevant continuations. We introduce Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation (VC-OPD), a grounding-aware distillation method that prioritizes tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence. After a teacher-supervised warm start that stabilizes response formats and reduces noisy rollouts, VC-OPD performs on-policy distillation with two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory: one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence. The original-image teacher distribution determines the distillation target, while the original--counterfactual teacher gap estimates token-level visual dependence and softly reweights the loss. To avoid unstable response-level update scales, VC-OPD further applies mass-preserving normalization to the token weights. This design preserves the dense supervision of OPD while shifting learning capacity toward visually grounded reasoning tokens. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that VC-OPD improves visual reasoning performance and produces more effective token-level distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉反事实在线策略蒸馏（VC-OPD），通过反事实图像评估 token 级视觉依赖性，重新加权蒸馏损失，增强视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: GRPO 风格强化学习在视觉语言推理中取得进展，但序列级奖励难以对单个推理 token 进行精细信用分配；标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽提供密集监督，却同等对待模板短语和视觉无关延续，缺乏视觉 grounding 意识。
AI.method: 先用教师监督预热稳定格式；随后对每条学生轨迹在原始图像和破坏实例证据的反事实图像下分别获取教师分布，取原始分布为蒸馏目标，两者差距估计 token 级视觉依赖并软加权损失，再施行质量守恒归一化避免更新尺度不稳定。
AI.result: 在多模态推理基准上，VC-OPD 提升视觉推理性能，实现更有效的 token 级蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: VC-OPD 在保留 OPD 密集监督优势的同时，将学习容量转向视觉 grounding 的推理 token，显著改善视觉语言模型的推理质量。

title: Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs
summary: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-NeuS，一种查询自适应的神经元操控框架，通过动态选择并调制与查询相关的神经元，在不修改模型参数、无需任务标签的情况下，显著提升多个大语言模型在多基准上的推理表现，并展现出良好的跨规模泛化与迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时激发大模型能力的方法主要依赖上下文工程或固定操控策略，但预定义上下文与固定干预难以适应不同查询多样化的知识与推理需求。因此，核心动机是探索能否利用查询诱导的内部激活模式，实现查询自适应的内部神经元操控。
AI.method: 1. 通过实验发现特定学科与层依赖的神经元激活模式，放大相关神经元可提升性能。2. 提出 Q-NeuS 框架：构建紧凑的学科引导候选神经元空间，引入轻量级查询自适应门，为每个输入动态生成神经元级调制系数。3. 提出 Neu-GRPO 训练方法：基于群体相对策略优化，利用多组神经元干预配置的相对表现来训练自适应门。基座模型全程冻结，推理时无需任务或学科标签。
AI.result: 在多个大语言模型与基准测试上的大量实验表明，Q-NeuS 能持续提升模型性能，适用于不同规模模型，并具备强跨基准迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应的神经元操控是一种有效且通用的推理时增强范式，无需修改模型参数即可显著激发大模型潜力，为后续自适应内部干预研究提供了新思路。

title: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
summary: Recent focus in agentic reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to improve credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. One promising direction combines reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), integrating trajectory-level advantages with dense token-level supervision. This line of work often conditions a teacher model on privileged context, such as agentic skills, to score tokens generated by the student policy. Despite their progress, they largely overlook the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of teacher supervision. Towards this end, we introduce Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization (RSIPO), a self-evolving agentic RL framework that enables agentic skills and the policy model to co-evolve throughout the training process. Specifically, RSIPO enables the policy itself to extract skills from completed trajectories and explicitly optimizes its skill-generation capability through trajectory replay. It further employs empirical Bayes shrinkage to dynamically calibrate the student's trust in teacher scores, accounting for the fact that skill-enhanced teacher guidance can sometimes be less reliable. Experiments with Qwen-family models on embodied interaction and search-based agentic tasks demonstrate that RSIPO outperforms all the compared baseline approaches. With Qwen2.5-7B as the base model, RSIPO achieves an average success rate of 98.6\% on ALFWorld, yielding absolute improvements of 2.5\% and 17.4\% over the second-best baseline and standard GRPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了递归自我改进策略优化（RSIPO），一种自我进化的智能体强化学习框架，解决了长时任务中信用分配、智能体技能在线演化及教师监督可靠性等问题。RSIPO 让策略从完成的轨迹中提取技能并通过轨迹回放显式优化技能生成能力，同时利用经验贝叶斯收缩动态校准学生对教师评分的信任度。在 Qwen 系列模型上实验表明，RSIPO 在 ALFWorld 上达到 98.6% 平均成功率，显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有结合可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）与在线自蒸馏（OPSD）的方法，虽融合了轨迹级优势与密集 token 级监督，但主要存在两个缺陷：一是忽视了智能体技能在训练过程中的在线演化；二是未充分考虑技能增强教师指导的可靠性问题，导致教师监督有时不可靠。因此需要一种能让智能体技能与策略模型协同进化、并能动态评估教师监督可信度的框架。
AI.method: RSIPO 包含两大核心机制：1) 技能提取与回放优化：策略模型从已完成轨迹中提取技能，并通过轨迹回放显式优化其技能生成能力，实现技能与策略的协同进化。2) 经验贝叶斯收缩校准：引入经验贝叶斯收缩方法，根据教师指导的可靠性动态调整学生策略对教师评分的信任程度，缓解不可靠教师监督带来的负面影响。
AI.result: 在 Qwen 系列模型上进行 embodied interaction 和 search-based agentic 任务实验。以 Qwen2.5-7B 为基础模型时，RSIPO 在 ALFWorld 上取得 98.6% 平均成功率，比第二好的基线高出 2.5 个百分点，比标准 GRPO 高出 17.4 个百分点，全面超越所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: RSIPO 通过让智能体技能与策略模型在训练中协同进化，并引入经验贝叶斯收缩动态校准教师监督的可信度，有效解决了长时任务信用分配、技能在线演化及教师可靠性等难题，在多个智能体任务上显著提升了性能，为智能体强化学习提供了一个更鲁棒、自进化的优化范式。

title: MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents
summary: The Model Context Protocol provides a shared interaction substrate for the agentic web, allowing heterogeneous services to expose capabilities through a standardized interface. Learning to use this ecosystem entails a hierarchy of capabilities: tool-format skills, server-level transfer, and cross-server composition. We present MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents. Using a Thought-Markov Decision Process (Thought-MDP), the framework explicitly represents internal reasoning alongside routing, execution, and termination and trains on real-server, long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools across six domains. We study the reasoning--tool seesaw, a joint-learning failure mode in which improvement in one objective can accompany deterioration in the other. To mitigate potential interference, MCPDisCo combines token-masked reward attribution with bidirectional gradient surgery: the former separates direct supervision for reasoning and action spans, while the latter removes conflicting components from both objective gradients in shared parameters. MCPDisCo achieves higher success with fewer chain-of-thought tokens. On the out-of-distribution MCP-Atlas and the GAIA benchmark, MCPDisCo maintains monotone gains, confirming that the learned behavior generalizes beyond the training server distribution and broader agentic tasks. Model weight and implementation are available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了 MCPDisCo，一个面向 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 生态系统的大规模强化学习框架，通过 Thought-MDP 显式建模内部推理，结合 token-masked 奖励归因与双向梯度手术，解决了推理与工具使用的「跷跷板效应」，在 70 个 MCP 服务器、527 个工具上训练，实现了更高成功率且更少 CoT token，并在 OOD 基准上展现单调泛化增益。
AI.motivation: MCP 为异构服务提供了标准化接口，但学习使用该生态系统涉及工具格式技能、服务器级迁移和跨服务器组合的层级能力。现有方法在联合学习推理与工具使用时存在「推理-工具跷跷板效应」：提升一个目标往往伴随另一个目标退化，且缺乏在真实服务器长程交互上的生态系统级训练框架。
AI.method: 1. Thought-MDP：显式表示内部推理、路由、执行和终止的马尔可夫决策过程。2. Token-masked 奖励归因：将推理片段与动作片段的监督信号分离。3. 双向梯度手术：在共享参数上移除两个目标梯度的冲突分量。4. 在 70 个 MCP 服务器、527 个工具、六大领域的真实服务器长程交互上训练。
AI.result: MCPDisCo 以更少的 chain-of-thought token 实现更高成功率。在分布外的 MCP-Atlas 和 GAIA 基准上保持单调增益，验证了学习行为能泛化至训练服务器分布之外及更广泛的智能体任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模推理过程并解耦推理与工具使用的梯度冲突，MCPDisCo 实现了在 MCP 生态系统上的高效、可泛化的强化学习，为构建原生 MCP 智能体提供了可行范式。

title: Active Neural Matter: A Finite-Window Response Framework for Physical Systems and Distributed AI Workflows
summary: Physical systems and distributed AI workflows can retain past information, receive delayed feedback and combine conflicting signals. These features pose a common modeling problem: determining what information about past interactions a state must retain to account for future responses. Active Neural Matter (ANM) addresses this problem through a finite-window response framework. Forward analysis uses each system's dynamics to predict state and output responses to perturbations, separating propagation from output sensitivity. Inverse analysis tests whether a candidate state retains enough information for these responses. With the system and future inputs or interaction rules fixed, distinguishable responses from histories assigned the same state identify distinctions the representation must preserve. Their distributional separation gives a lower bound on the worst-case error of approximating behavior from that state. Uncertainty bounds distinguish rejection, support within a fixed tolerance on tested comparisons, and unresolved cases. Delayed-consensus simulations check analytical predictions of response amplitude and phase over a narrow range of delays; flocking illustrates dependence on the chosen observable. An exact delayed-return construction establishes a sufficient state for a specified program. The AI studies identify distinctions in interaction history and evidence order that a representation must preserve to reproduce observed response distributions. Tests on new histories in a controlled feedback task provide bounded support for a state specified by the task instructions; the instructed rule predicts every observed action. ANM connects response prediction to measurable information requirements, separating behavioral fidelity from task correctness and initial-state adequacy from a closed evolution law for that state.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了主动神经物质（ANM）框架，通过有限窗口响应分析解决物理系统和分布式AI工作流中状态保留历史信息的建模问题，将响应预测与可测量的信息需求联系起来，区分了行为保真度与任务正确性、初始状态充分性与封闭演化定律。
AI.motivation: 物理系统和分布式AI工作流具有保留过去信息、接收延迟反馈、结合冲突信号的特性，核心建模难题在于：状态必须保留关于过去交互的哪些信息，才能解释未来的响应。
AI.method: ANM采用有限窗口响应框架：正向分析利用系统动力学预测状态和扰动响应，分离传播与输出敏感性；逆向分析测试候选状态是否保留足够信息以产生这些响应。固定系统与未来输入/交互规则后，将相同状态对应的历史产生的可区分响应识别为表示必须保留的区别，其分布分离给出从该状态近似行为的最坏情况误差下界。不确定性界限区分拒绝、固定容差内的支持和未决情况。延迟共识仿真验证响应振幅和相位的解析预测；群集行为展示可观测量选择的依赖性。精确的延迟返回构造建立了指定程序的充分状态。AI研究识别表示必须保留的交互历史和证据顺序区别以复现观测响应分布。在受控反馈任务中对新历史的测试为任务指令指定的状态提供有界支持；指令规则预测了每一个观测动作。
AI.result: ANM框架将响应预测与可测量的信息需求联系起来，实现了行为保真度与任务正确性的分离，以及初始状态充分性与该状态封闭演化定律的分离。
AI.conclusion: ANM为物理系统和分布式AI中的状态表示问题提供了统一分析框架，通过正反向分析量化状态信息保留需求，区分了行为近似误差与任务层面的正确性，为具有延迟反馈和冲突信号的复杂系统建立了严谨的建模基础。

title: An Explainable System for Offensive Content Detection in Nastaliq Urdu: Corpus Curation, Transformer Benchmarking, and Word-Level Attribution
summary: Automated moderation systems are deployed at scale, yet they remain opaque to the users and moderators affected by their decisions, and their coverage is almost entirely confined to English. For Urdu written in the Nastaliq script, no such system exists, and the annotated resources it would be built on are drawn largely from Twitter/X, where character limits constrain how users write. Interpretability has received little attention, leaving it unclear what such models actually learn. This study addresses these gaps in three steps. First, we curate and publicly release a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, extending an earlier corpus by correcting text-level inconsistencies and re-examining the original labels. Second, we fine-tune four Urdu-capable transformers under a common grid-search protocol and compare them against twelve feature-classifier baselines on identical data partitions. The best configuration, Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages (MuRIL), reaches 87.05% accuracy and 87.06% macro F1, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.52 percentage points, a margin that exceeds the 95% confidence interval on test accuracy; the two leading transformers differ by less than the test set can resolve, and performance is stable across five optimizers. Third, we compute word-level SHAP attributions adapted to right-to-left rendering. Attribution mass concentrates on high-frequency slurs but extends to syntactically neutral function words and to political vocabulary characteristic of the source pages, indicating that aggregate performance may rest partly on lexical and topical regularities rather than a generalizable representation of offensiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Nastaliq 字体乌尔都语缺乏自动化内容审核系统、现有资源受限于 Twitter 字符限制以及模型可解释性不足三大问题，构建了 7604 条 Facebook 评论语料库，对比微调四种乌尔都语能力 transformer 与十二个特征分类基线，MuRIL 以 87.05% 准确率和 87.06% 宏 F1 取得最佳性能，领先最强基线 5.52 个百分点；SHAP 归因分析揭示模型主要依赖高频脏话、功能词及政治词汇等词汇/话题规律，而非泛化的冒犯性表征。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化审核系统不透明、几乎仅覆盖英语，针对 Nastaliq 乌尔都语毫无系统可用；现有标注资源主要来自 Twitter/X，字符限制扭曲了用户书写习惯；模型可解释性研究严重缺失，不清楚模型究竟学到了什么。
AI.method: 1) 策划并公开发布 7604 条 Nastaliq 乌尔都语 Facebook 评论语料库，修正文本层面不一致并重新审视原始标签。2) 在统一网格搜索协议下微调四种乌尔都语 transformer，并与十二个特征-分类器基线在相同数据分区上对比。3) 计算适配从右向左渲染的词级 SHAP 归因，分析模型决策依据。
AI.result: MuRIL 达到 87.05% 准确率和 87.06% 宏 F1，比最强基线高出 5.52 个百分点，优势超出测试集准确率的 95% 置信区间；前两名 transformer 差异小于测试集分辨力，性能在五种优化器下稳定。SHAP 归因显示权重集中于高频脏话，但也延伸至句法中性功能词和来源页面特有的政治词汇。
AI.conclusion: 尽管 transformer 在 Nastaliq 乌尔都语冒犯性检测上显著优于传统基线，但模型性能很大程度上建立在词汇和话题规律（高频脏话、功能词、政治词汇）之上，而非对冒犯性的泛化表示；这提示在部署前需进一步研究鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: What Survives When Activation Steering Is Used as Memory
summary: Activation steering has recently been used as a memory for skills: past experiences of an agent are stored as steering vectors and retrieved later. Facts and preferences about the user are assumed to need text instead. We test that assumption with a training-free activation memory beside a frozen LLM. The change an experience causes in late-layer states is stored as a shift, filed under a whitened key for the conversation's gist, and added back in a later session only when the gist matches. We argue that such a shift is a fixed average of an effect that attention, in context, recomputes for every question, so only question-independent content can survive. In a pre-registered study on Qwen3.5-2B and 9B, with judges from four model families, the memory is selective (about 98% of unrelated replies are unchanged), but facts are stored as the word to say, in the last layers only, and are almost never used (at most 15% clean use, against 96-98% in context). Leanings transfer only in a narrow strength window. Most strikingly, the reference subtracted when writing a preference decides whether its concept or its direction survives: unless the opposite is subtracted, a stored dislike is recalled as a like.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨激活向量能否作为无需训练的长期记忆机制，实验发现：激活记忆具有高选择性（98%无关回复不受影响），但事实仅以‘说出的词’形式存储在末层，且极少被调用（15% vs 上下文96-98%）；偏好记忆极其脆弱——减去的参考基准决定存储的是概念还是方向，若不减去相反面，厌恶会被回忆为喜爱。
AI.motivation: 现有激活向量主要用于技能记忆，普遍假设事实与偏好需以文本形式存储。作者想验证：冻结LLM旁若放置无训练激活记忆，能否直接存取事实与偏好。
AI.method: 将一次对话在末层产生的状态变化存为‘偏移向量’，以对话主旨的白化向量为键索引；后续会话主旨匹配时再加回。在Qwen3.5-2B/9B上做预注册实验，四模型家族作裁判。
AI.result: 记忆高度选择性（98%无关回复不变）；事实仅以输出词元形式存在末层，干净调用率≤15%（上下文96-98%）；倾向性仅在极窄强度窗口迁移；最关键：写入偏好时减去的参考向量决定存储的是概念还是方向——未减去反面时，厌恶会被回忆为喜爱。
AI.conclusion: 激活向量无法可靠承载事实与偏好类声明性记忆：事实退化为固定词元且难触发，偏好极其依赖写入时的对比基准，缺乏鲁棒的语义表示。

title: PGSB: Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis for LoRA Model Merging
summary: Large pretrained models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet adapting them to multiple downstream tasks remains challenging: full fine-tuning is costly, while maintaining separate task-specific models is storage-inefficient and fails to produce a unified multi-task model. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers an efficient alternative for Model Merging by representing each task adaptation as a low-rank update over frozen pretrained weights. However, existing LoRA merging methods often treat task-specific updates as directly comparable objects and merge them in their original low-rank parameter spaces. This overlooks two key factors: which update directions provide reliable shared support across tasks, and how these directions should be re-parameterized with respect to the pretrained weights before merging. To address this limitation, we propose Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis (PGSB), a two-stage framework for LoRA model merging. PGSB first identifies shared directions among task-specific LoRA updates, and then re-parameterizes these directions using their interaction with the pretrained weights, producing a more suitable basis for merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSB consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple benchmarks. Codes are available at https://github.com/Kitschnada/Pretrained-Basis .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis (PGSB)，一种用于LoRA模型融合的两阶段框架：首先识别任务特定LoRA更新中的共享方向，再利用预训练权重重参数化这些方向，从而获得更适合融合的基。实验表明PGSB在多个基准上持续优于现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练模型在多任务适配时面临挑战：全量微调成本高，维护独立任务模型存储低效且无法产生统一多任务模型。LoRA虽提供高效替代，但现有LoRA融合方法直接在原始低秩参数空间合并任务特定更新，忽略了两个关键因素：哪些更新方向能跨任务提供可靠共享支持，以及这些方向应如何相对于预训练权重重参数化后再融合。
AI.method: PGSB分两阶段：1) 共享方向识别：分析多任务LoRA更新，提取跨任务一致的共享低秩方向。2) 预训练引导重参数化：利用预训练权重与共享方向的交互作用，将共享方向映射到更适合融合的新基空间，随后在该空间执行合并。
AI.result: 在多个基准上进行大量实验，PGSB持续优于现有最先进的LoRA模型融合基线方法，验证了共享方向识别与预训练引导重参数化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PGSB通过显式建模跨任务共享方向并引入预训练权重指导的重参数化，解决了现有LoRA融合方法忽略方向可靠性与参数化适配性的问题，实现了更高效、更优的多任务模型融合。

title: Latent Taxonomies: How Property Induction Develops in Language Model Pre-training
summary: When told that robins have sesamoid bones, people are far more prone to extend the property to sparrows than to whales. This behavior, called category-based property induction, is well documented in humans, but whether and how it develops in language models trained only to predict the next token is unclear. To shed light on this, we construct a hierarchical taxonomy of synthetic entities grouped by the properties they share. We then inject facts from this latent taxonomy into the continued pre-training of Pythia and OLMo 2 models from 70M to 7B parameters, and track the development of inductive behaviors. We find that taxonomically aligned induction emerges from next-token prediction alone: a property learned for one entity transfers more strongly within its taxonomic category than across categories. Internally, entities that share a deeper category become more similar in activation space, and clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from entity representations. Contrary to the usual expectation that scale helps, we find that induction weakens with model size when the data budget is fixed, suggesting that larger models memorize individual facts rather than compress them into shared structure. Induction also strengthens with more pre-training before the taxonomy injection, transfers to novel in-context properties, and can be overridden by a latent taxonomy implied by the prompt. Together, these results show that a model's inductive generalization reflects the latent organization of its training data, with implications for data curation and for predicting how far a learned fact will spread.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨语言模型通过仅预测下一个token是否能发展出类别基础的属性归纳能力。通过构建合成实体的层级分类并将其注入预训练，发现模型确实会出现与分类学一致的归纳行为：属性在同类别内传递更强。内部表征显示共享深层类别的实体在激活空间更相似，聚类可恢复完整分类树。有趣的是，固定数据预算下模型规模越大归纳越弱，表明大模型倾向于死记硬背而非压缩结构。归纳能力随预训练量增加而增强，能迁移到新上下文属性，且可被提示隐含的分类覆盖。结果表明模型的归纳泛化反映训练数据的潜在组织结构。
AI.motivation: 人类表现出基于类别的属性归纳（如知晓知更鸟有籽骨则推断麻雀也有，而非鲸鱼），但仅通过下一个token预测训练的语言模型是否以及如何发展出这种能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建合成实体的层级分类体系，按共享属性分组。将该潜在分类中的事实注入Pythia和OLMo 2模型（70M至7B参数）的持续预训练中，追踪归纳行为的发展。
AI.result: 1. 分类学对齐的归纳从下一个token预测中涌现：属性在同一分类类别内传递更强。2. 内部表征中，共享更深层类别的实体在激活空间更相似，聚类可恢复完整分类树。3. 固定数据预算下，模型规模越大归纳越弱，提示大模型倾向记忆个别事实而非压缩共享结构。4. 归纳随注入前预训练量增加而增强，可迁移到新颖上下文属性，并可被提示隐含的潜在分类覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 模型的归纳泛化反映其训练数据的潜在组织结构，这对数据策划和预测已学事实的传播范围有重要启示。

title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.

AI.tldr: AlphaRLM 是一个基于强化学习的框架，训练大语言模型从金融文献中直接构建可执行的符号化 Alpha 因子，无需输入种子因子表达式。引入 LEGO 机制利用文献衍生的算子提供语义先验，并设计可执行性有效性与分组收益分离奖励对齐市场反馈。在 CSI 300、CSI 1000 和 S&P 500 上实验表明，8B 模型跨市场表现优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 因子挖掘方法主要依赖提示工程、迭代搜索或种子因子进化，直接通过策略学习构建因子的研究较少。需要一种能够从文献获取语义先验、并通过市场反馈对齐生成策略的端到端强化学习框架。
AI.method: AlphaRLM 框架包含两大核心创新：1) Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO)：将因子构建条件化于文献衍生的投资理念与可执行算子库，为探索提供语义先验；2) 双重奖励机制：可执行性有效性奖励保证语法正确性，分组收益分离奖励捕捉因子分位数间的非单调结构，将生成策略与市场反馈对齐。采用强化学习训练 LLM 直接生成符号化因子表达式。
AI.result: 在 CSI 300、CSI 1000 和 S&P 500 三个市场的大量实验中，AlphaRLM 的年化超额收益显著优于强因子挖掘基线和 LLM 基线方法。值得注意的是，8B 参数规模的模型即实现了强跨市场泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 文献条件化与市场对齐的因子生成范式展现出巨大潜力。AlphaRLM 证明了通过强化学习训练 LLM 直接从文献构建可执行因子，结合 LEGO 语义先验与分组收益奖励，能够有效探索广阔噪声搜索空间，实现跨市场稳健的 Alpha 挖掘。

title: Reward-Aligned Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\% and 58.67\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

AI.tldr: RAD 是一种双层框架，通过预测蒸馏信号对学生模型更新后奖励的影响来加权蒸馏信号，在数学和代码基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽能提升大语言模型推理能力，但计算昂贵且样本效率低；现有的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）盲目蒸馏所有 token，而基于不确定性或师生差异的 token 选择代理指标未必能识别真正提升任务奖励的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出 Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD)，一种双层框架：通过临时优化器步骤微分，评估每个 token 监督对学生模型更新后奖励的预测影响，再从初始 token 权重出发进行投影梯度上升更新权重。权重可增强、抑制或反转单个蒸馏梯度贡献。还有一个简化版 RAD-Simple。
AI.result: 在六个竞赛数学基准上，RAD 在相同训练响应预算下，Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) 平均准确率提升 6.5 个百分点，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 提升 2.5 点。在 LiveCodeBench-v6 上，Qwen3-1.7B 达到 54.69% pass@1，OLMo3-7B-Instruct 达到 58.67% pass@1，分别超最强基线 8.7 和 6.4 点。RAD-Simple 以相同预算达到相当数学准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持基于奖励引导的教师监督加权，该方法跨模型家族和任务均有效。 }

title: Binding Phoneme Identity to Position in Neural Models and the Human Brain
summary: A fundamental challenge in cognitive science and neural computation is the binding problem. Compositional generalization can be achieved by factorizing representations into roles, the structural slots of a representation (e.g., serial position or syntactic function), and fillers, the contents occupying them (e.g., a phoneme or a word), which can be recombined freely to represent novel combinations. How neural systems implement role--filler binding, however, remains unknown. One of its simplest cases is phoneme sequencing, where phoneme identity (filler) must be bound to position (role) so that /gum/ and /mug/ are represented differently. A proposal from NLP, the `onion hypothesis' (Csordas et al., 2024), holds that the direction of the neural population state encodes token identity, while its magnitude encodes position. It was formulated for random token sequences; we extend it to natural language and test it in neural models and the human brain. We first evaluated it in an encoder-decoder trained to repeat English words, using representational geometry analyses and causal interventions. Magnitude alone proves incomplete: position is encoded by magnitude together with a systematic rotation of the state direction, a scheme we formalize as the `spiral hypothesis'. We then analyzed intracranial recordings from the auditory cortex of 20 participants listening to short sentences. Across superior temporal gyrus electrodes, the change in population response between consecutive phonemes decreases in magnitude as position advances, and its direction is aligned within consonants and within vowels but near orthogonal across the two classes, supporting the magnitude coding shared by both accounts. These results provide a geometric account of how neural systems bind phoneme identity to position, and show how neural-model hypotheses can yield testable predictions about human neural computation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经系统如何实现音位身份与位置的绑定问题。通过测试NLP中的'洋葱假设'并扩展到自然语言，作者在编码器-解码器模型和人类听觉皮层颅内记录中发现：位置编码不仅依赖神经群体状态的模长，还需要系统性的方向旋转，提出了'螺旋假设'。实验证实模型与人脑数据一致，为语音序列的角色-填充符绑定提供了几何解释。
AI.motivation: 认知科学和神经计算中的核心挑战是绑定问题——即神经系统如何将表示分解为角色（结构槽位如序列位置）和填充符（内容如音位），并支持组合泛化。音位排序是这一问题的最简单实例：音位身份（填充符）必须与位置（角色）绑定，以区分/gum/和/mug/。NLP提出的'洋葱假设'认为神经群体状态的方向编码词元身份，模长编码位置，但该假设仅针对随机序列，需在自然语言和神经数据中验证。
AI.method: 1. 在训练复述英语单词的编码器-解码器模型中，使用表征几何分析和因果干预测试洋葱假设。2. 分析20名参与者聆听短句时听觉皮层（上颞回）的颅内记录数据，考察连续音位间群体响应变化的模长和方向特性。3. 形式化提出'螺旋假设'并对比两种假设的预测。
AI.result: 模型中：仅靠模长不足以编码位置，位置由模长与状态方向的系统性旋转共同编码（螺旋假设）。人脑数据中：连续音位间群体响应变化的模随位置推进而减小；方向在辅音内部和元音内部对齐，但在辅音与元音间近似正交。两者均支持模长编码位置，方向编码音位类别的共享机制。
AI.conclusion: 神经系统通过螺旋几何结构实现音位身份与位置的绑定：模长追踪序列位置，方向旋转区分位置同时保持音位类别结构。这一机制在人工神经网络和人类听觉皮层中一致存在，展示了神经网络模型假设如何产生关于人类神经计算的可检验预测，为组合表示的神经实现提供了几何层面的解释。

title: SkillHorizon: Constructing Long-Horizon Agent Tasks through Skill Composition
summary: Long-horizon agents must complete workflows in which later activities depend on earlier outputs and changes to shared state. A key challenge for evaluation is to expand task requirements and their dependencies while keeping tasks executable and outcomes verifiable. We introduce SkillHorizon, a benchmark that constructs long-horizon tasks through skill composition in seven business environments. Its generators use domain-specific rules to turn reusable skill procedures into concrete business activities. These activities are connected through input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates, allowing workload and coordination demands to grow together. Successful reference executions validate task feasibility and measure interaction workload, while programmatic evaluators assess local completion and whole-task success. We evaluate five language models on 1,050 tasks with reference interaction workloads ranging from 64K to 1M tokens. Across these scales, mean local-goal completion falls from 90.4% to 46.8%, as completed work fails to keep pace with growing requirements. At larger workloads, agents more often submit unsuccessful final answers with substantial work unfinished and tool-call allowance remaining. Trace analysis also identifies cases where scripts execute successfully but their outputs fail downstream business checks. SkillHorizon provides a configurable testbed for studying sustained progress, dependency coordination, and complete task delivery in growing workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/KnowComp/SkillHorizon.

AI.tldr: SkillHorizon 是一个用于评估长时程智能体在业务环境中完成复杂工作流的基准测试，通过技能组合构建任务，包含七个业务环境，测试了五种语言模型在 1,050 个任务上的表现，发现随着交互工作量增加，局部目标完成率显著下降，智能体在大规模任务中倾向于提前提交未完成的答案。
AI.motivation: 现有评估难以在保持任务可执行性和结果可验证性的前提下，扩展任务需求及其依赖关系，以考察智能体在长时程、多依赖、共享状态变更的工作流中的持续进展、依赖协调和完整任务交付能力。
AI.method: 提出 SkillHorizon 基准：利用领域特定规则将可复用的技能过程转化为具体业务活动，通过输入输出依赖、共享资源和状态更新连接活动，生成七个业务环境中的长时程任务；提供参考执行验证任务可行性并度量交互工作量，采用程序化评估器检查局部完成度和整体任务成功率。
AI.result: 在 1,050 个任务（参考交互工作量 64K–1M tokens）上评估五种语言模型：平均局部目标完成率从 90.4% 下降至 46.8%；大工作量下智能体更常在工具调用额度未用完时提交失败的最终答案，且存在脚本执行成功但输出未通过下游业务检查的情况。
AI.conclusion: SkillHorizon 为研究长时程工作流中的持续进展、依赖协调和完整任务交付提供了可配置的测试平台，揭示了当前语言模型在大规模、高依赖任务中的系统性不足。

title: LLM-Augmented Bayesian Optimization with Adaptive Policies for Chiplet Design Space Exploration
summary: Chiplet technology is a key approach for extending Moore's Law. However, its design process is constrained by two primary challenges: the scarcity of early-stage platforms for rapidly evaluating chiplet-based heterogeneous systems, and the complex relationships between design parameters and optimization metrics. To address these challenges, we propose a synergistic framework that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with Bayesian Optimization (BO), enabling architectural-level simulation and automated optimization for the 2.5D/3D CPU-GPU heterogeneous chiplets. We extend the open-source chiplet simulator to evaluate 3D designs by supporting graph topologies. Further, to enhance the exploration efficiency of BO, we introduce an LLM that generates high-quality policies to guide the optimization process, enabled by our proposed adaptive directional policy reasoning (ADPR) and an exploration gain-aware fine-tuning method. Finally, we use the policy-guided BO to perform an automated and efficient exploration of the complex chiplet design space. Experiments on 2.5D and 3D chiplet reveal that our framework improves design space exploration efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合大语言模型(LLM)与贝叶斯优化(BO)的协同框架,用于2.5D/3D CPU-GPU异构芯粒的架构级仿真与自动化设计空间探索,通过扩展开源芯粒仿真器支持图拓扑、引入自适应方向策略推理(ADPR)和探索增益感知微调方法,显著提升了设计空间探索效率。
AI.motivation: 芯粒技术是延续摩尔定律的关键路径,但其设计流程面临两大核心挑战:早期缺乏快速评估芯粒异构系统的平台,以及设计参数与优化指标间存在复杂的非线性关系,导致传统设计空间探索效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 扩展开源芯粒仿真器,引入图拓扑支持以实现3D芯粒设计的评估; 2) 提出LLL与BO协同框架,利用LLM生成高质量策略指导BO搜索; 3) 设计自适应方向策略推理(ADPR)机制与探索增益感知微调方法,增强BO的探索效率; 4) 基于策略引导的BO实现复杂芯粒设计空间的自动化高效探索。
AI.result: 在2.5D和3D芯粒实验中,该框架相比基线方法显著提升了设计空间探索效率,验证了LLM引导BO在异构芯粒架构优化中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LLL与贝叶斯优化的协同范式为芯粒异构系统的早期架构探索提供了可行的自动化解决方案,ADPR与增益感知微调有效缓解了高维设计空间中的探索困境,为后续芯粒设计自动化工具链发展奠定了基础。

title: Unchecked or Falsely Accused? Evaluating AI-Generated Text Detectors on Kazakh
comment: 16 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 1 figure, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/ozxmn/aina-kk; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ajnasiou/aina-kk; detector: https://huggingface.co/ajnasiou/aina-kk-det
summary: AI-text detectors are already applied to Kazakh writing, yet no study reports how often publicly available detectors flag Kazakh text whose human authorship is dated before ChatGPT. We present AINA-KK: 3,811 human passages from encyclopedic, news, web and educational pages that provably existed before ChatGPT, and 5,597 machine and gray-zone passages from 9 generators, including the Kazakh-built KazLLM and Sherkala, with script and length stress tests. Five English-trained detectors from the Hugging Face Hub flag up to 81.4% of human passages and 79.6% of published student essays; recalibrated, they catch at most 1.3% of machine text. Calibrated zero-shot detectors catch at most 50.3% of machine text from in-distribution generators. Fine-tuned encoders rank text almost perfectly, but mDeBERTa at its default threshold flags 24.4% of 50-word human excerpts, partly because machine outputs are shorter than human text; calibrated, it catches only 47.1% of KazLLM and 62.7% of Sherkala passages. Without script handling, machine-transliterated Latin-2021 text defeats every detector. Fixes that need no new data (calibration, script canonicalization, script-augmented and length-matched training, and an OR with a zero-shot scorer) form AINA-KK-Det. On test it flags 0.9% of human passages (95% CI 0.4-2.7; 1.5% on development data) and catches 85.2% of machine text from known generators, 92.9% from two unseen Gemini-family Gemma-4 models and 61.3% from the Kazakh-built ones; its configuration was chosen with test results in view. We release the data, code and detector at https://github.com/ozxmn/aina-kk.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了哈萨克语AI文本检测基准AINA-KK，评估现有检测器并提出改进方法AINA-KK-Det，显著降低误报率并提升对已知及未见生成器的检测率。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测器已应用于哈萨克语，但缺乏对ChatGPT发布前人类撰写文本的误报率评估，且对哈萨克语自建模型（如KazLLM、Sherkala）的检测效果未知，需系统性基准与改进。
AI.method: 收集3,811篇ChatGPT前人类文本及5,597篇机器/灰色地带文本（含9个生成器），进行脚本和长度压力测试；评估5个英语训练检测器，发现高误报；提出校准、脚本规范化、脚本增强与长度匹配训练、零样本评分器OR融合等无需新数据的修复，组合成AINA-KK-Det。
AI.result: AINA-KK-Det在测试集上人类文本误报率仅0.9%（95% CI 0.4-2.7），对已知生成器检测率85.2%，对未见Gemma-4模型92.9%，对哈萨克自建模型61.3%；配置参考测试结果选定。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性基准构建与针对性修复，显著提升哈萨克语AI文本检测鲁棒性，但对本土模型检测仍有提升空间；已开源数据、代码与检测器。

title: FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization
summary: With the rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs), there is an increasing demand for effective personalization techniques that can adapt model behavior to individual user preferences. Personalized LLMs must infer a user's query-dependent preferences from limited, heterogeneous, and evolving interaction histories. Existing approaches rely primarily on in-context personalization, parametric adaptation, or personalized reward modeling, but respectively incur recurring costs in context management, model optimization and deployment, or multi-candidate generation and scoring. These limitations become particularly restrictive when user observations are sparse and the preference evidence relevant to each query varies across contexts and over time. To address these challenges, we propose \modelname, a fine-grained and instance-tailored steering framework that dynamically generates sample-level interference vectors from user data and injects them into the model's forward pass for personalized adaptation. Our approach introduces: match contrast that produces user-relevant signals, fine-grained steering component that captures nuanced signals by hooking activations from attention and MLP layers, and query-conditioned aggregation module that synthesizes these signals into contextually relevant enhancements. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios, including short-to-long text generation, and web function calling, validate the effectiveness and compatibility of \modelname. Results show that our method consistently brings significant performance gains, and show extreme superiority in fast-shifting and data-sparse environments. Additionally, \modelname rids us of training cycles and incurs light overhead of storage or inference latency. These make \modelname a strong and real-world deployable method. Implementation is available \footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FleetPilot}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为FleetPilot的细粒度、实例定制的引导框架，通过从用户数据动态生成样本级干扰向量并注入模型前向传播，实现个性化LLM适应，无需训练周期，开销低，在数据稀疏和快速变化环境中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化LLM方法（上下文个性化、参数适应、个性化奖励建模）分别面临上下文管理持续成本、模型优化部署成本、多候选生成评分成本等问题，尤其在用户观测稀疏、偏好证据随查询变化时受限。需要一种无需训练、低开销、能动态适应查询相关偏好的方法。
AI.method: 提出FleetPilot框架：1) 匹配对比产生用户相关信号；2) 细粒度引导组件通过挂钩注意力和MLP层激活捕捉细微信号；3) 查询条件聚合模块将信号合成为上下文相关增强。动态生成样本级干扰向量注入前向传播，实现实例定制的个性化适应。
AI.result: 在短到长文本生成、网页函数调用等多样场景实验中，方法持续带来显著性能提升，在快速变化和数据稀疏环境中表现极优。无需训练周期，存储和推理延迟开销轻。
AI.conclusion: FleetPilot是一种强有力的、可实际部署的个性化LLM适应方法，解决了现有方法的局限，提供了细粒度、查询感知、免训练的个性化解决方案。

title: From Rainfall to Road-Network Functionality: Transferable Graph Forecasting for Flood-Disrupted Transportation Networks
summary: Extreme rainfall can rapidly degrade road-network functionality (RNF), disrupting emergency mobility, accessibility, evacuation, logistics, and infrastructure restoration. Existing flood-transportation impact models are often difficult to deploy across regions because they rely on local calibration, intensive simulation workflows or target-region retraining. This study proposes G-R2R, a transferable spatiotemporal graph-learning framework that reframes rainfall-induced road-network disruption as a region-conditioned, topology-flexible graph forecasting problem for unseen transportation networks. The framework integrates ego-centered subgraph sampling, terrain-conditioned graph representation, region-conditioned dual-level static encoding, and dynamic rainfall-network feature learning. Static geographic and infrastructure attributes are fused with rainfall forcing and recent RNF states to forecast node-level RNF across heterogeneous road networks. G-R2R is evaluated using simulation-derived RNF sequences from ten flood-prone regions in Wenzhou, China, under unseen-region testing protocols. It outperforms representative forecasting baselines, achieving a stabilized MAPE of 2.33% and $R^2$ of 0.855 under the fixed unseen-region benchmark. Leave-one-area-out evaluation yields stabilized MAPE values of 2.30%-3.54%. Ablation analysis supports the contributions of the terrain-conditioned graph representation and dual-level static encoding. A historical-event replay of Typhoon Fitow further shows that G-R2R reproduces principal temporal trajectories and node-level spatial patterns of the simulation-derived RNF reference under observed rainfall forcing without target-region retraining. These results support rapid and transferable node-level RNF forecasting across the regional road-network domains represented in this study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 G-R2R，一种可迁移的时空图学习框架，用于预测暴雨导致的路网功能（RNF）中断。该框架将问题重构为面向未见交通网络的、以区域为条件的拓扑灵活图预测任务，融合静态地理/基础设施属性、降雨强迫和近期 RNF 状态，实现跨异构路网的节点级 RNF 预测。在温州 10 个易涝区的仿真数据上评估，未见区域测试 MAPE 2.33%、R² 0.855；留一区域交叉验证 MAPE 2.30%-3.54%。消融实验验证地形条件图表征和双层静态编码的贡献。历史台风“菲特”重现实验表明，无需目标区域重训练即可复现仿真参考的时空演变模式。
AI.motivation: 现有洪水-交通影响模型难以跨区域部署，因为它们依赖本地标定、密集仿真工作流或目标区域重训练。极端降雨能快速降解路网功能，破坏应急通行、可达性、疏散、物流和基础设施恢复，因此需要一种快速、可迁移的节点级 RNF 预测方法，能在未见路网上直接泛化。
AI.method: G-R2R 框架包含四大核心组件：(1) 以自我为中心的子图采样，提取局部拓扑结构；(2) 地形条件图表征，融合地理地形特征；(3) 区域条件双层静态编码，分别编码节点级和区域级静态属性；(4) 动态降雨-网络特征学习，结合降雨强迫序列与近期 RNF 状态。静态属性与动态特征融合后，通过时空图神经网络预测节点级 RNF 序列。
AI.result: 在温州 10 个易涝区仿真数据上的未见区域基准测试中，G-R2R 取得稳定 MAPE 2.33%、R² 0.855，优于代表性预测基线。留一区域交叉验证 MAPE 2.30%-3.54%。消融实验证实地形条件图表征和双层静态编码显著提升性能。台风“菲特”历史重现实验显示，模型在观测降雨强迫下无需重训练即可复现仿真参考的主要时序轨迹和节点级空间模式。
AI.conclusion: G-R2R 实现了跨区域路网域的快速、可迁移节点级 RNF 预测，无需目标区域重训练即可泛化至未见网络。该框架为极端降雨下的应急决策、疏散规划和基础设施恢复提供了可落地的时空预测工具，具有实际部署潜力。

title: Review Rarely Beats the Stronger Model: Separating Verification from Capability Transfer in LLM Pipelines
summary: Qwen3-8B reviewing Llama-3.1-8B in math adds 33.2 points, yet Qwen3-8B alone is 6.4 points more accurate than the result. Reviewing another model's answer is usually judged by its gain over the generator. We show that this confuses verification, which adds accuracy beyond either model alone, with capability transfer, where a stronger reviewer supplies answers it could have given on its own. Measured against the stronger model alone, across 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B to 72B) in math, knowledge, code and reasoning, review beats it in only 9 of 96 review directions, and does worse the larger the capability gap. The reason is that the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers. Review costs 2.6 to 2.8 times as much as the stronger model alone, while a selector using the same two calls is 2.7 to 4.2 points more accurate than review and cheaper. Studies of verification should report the stronger model alone, not only the gain over the generator. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/Kamilaabb/verification-or-capability-transfer

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，当前用“相对于生成器的提升”来评估模型审查能力的做法，混淆了“验证”（超越单一模型的准确率）与“能力迁移”（强审查器自身就能给出的答案）。实验表明，审查很少能超越强模型单独推理，且计算成本更高，选择器策略更优。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常以审查相对于生成器的增益作为指标，但这无法区分审查是真正验证了答案，还是仅仅将强审查器自身的能力转移到了输出中。作者旨在揭示这一评估偏差，并提出更公平的基线比较。
AI.method: 在数学、知识、代码和推理四类任务上，选取12个开源模型（3B-72B）构成48对模型组合，测试审查方向下的表现。对比审查、强模型单独推理、选择器（同两次调用）的准确率与计算成本。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B审查Llama-3.1-8B在数学上增益33.2分，但Qwen3-8B单独推理比审查结果高6.4分。跨96个审查方向，仅9个方向审查优于强模型单独推理，且能力差距越大审查表现越差。审查成本为强模型单独推理的2.6-2.8倍，选择器比审查高2.7-4.2分且更便宜。
AI.conclusion: 审查机制主要跟随生成器，丢弃自身正确答案，导致难以超越强模型单独推理。验证研究应报告强模型单独推理的基线，而非仅报告相对于生成器的增益。选择器是更高效的替代方案。

title: Single-Sample Decoding of a Two-Layer Sound-Word Canvas Model for Thai Klon Pad
summary: We present a generator of Thai klon pad verse, one stanza from a short topic, and evaluate it against human verse on held-out topics. The generator is a masked language model initialised from WangchanBERTa over a fixed canvas with two layers: a sound layer of pronounced syllables, where rhyme, tone and syllable count are enforced as hard masks, and a word layer of whole words, so that no word is cut into written pieces. Decoding commits one cell at a time and samples at temperature 0.4; one sample is drawn per topic, with no selection, reranking or repair. On 78 held-out topics never used in development, judged by three independent runs of a frozen LLM judge in the same pools as the human stanzas from which the topics were written, 70.5% of the generated stanzas pass form, lexical cleanness of all four lines and topic alignment together, against 76.9% for the human stanzas (difference -6.4 points, 95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]). Cleanness is level with human (85.9% vs. 87.2%), and the stanzas pass form and cleanness together slightly more often than the human ones (+3.8 points, [-6.4, +14.1]); the difference lies in alignment (84.6% vs. 91.0%), on topics that were written from the human stanzas. The low temperature matters: at higher temperatures the same model passes clearly fewer of the same topics, because lexical errors lie in the model's lower-probability choices; sharpening the sampling distribution removes most of them, at a cost in vocabulary (7.5% rare words against 16.5% in the human stanzas) and diversity. The pre-registered target, all-three within 5 points of human, is missed by 1.4 points. KlonSuphap-LM, the only public klon pad generator we know of, passes none of the 78 held-out topics when judged in separate pools together with the method's and the human stanzas (form 19.2%, cleanness 3.8%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于掩码语言模型的泰语klon pad诗歌生成器，采用双层画布结构（音层和词层），通过硬约束强制押韵、声调和音节数，在低温度采样下生成单样本且无需后处理。在78个未见主题上，经冻结LLM裁判评测，生成诗句在形式、词汇整洁度和主题一致性三项指标同时达标率为70.5%，人类诗句为76.9%，差距-6.4个百分点（95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]）。词汇整洁度与人类持平，形式+整洁度略优于人类，主要差距在于主题一致性。低温采样显著减少词汇错误，但以牺牲稀有词比例（7.5% vs 16.5%）和多样性为代价。预注册目标（三项指标均在人类5分内）未达标1.4分。基线模型KlonSuphap-LM在相同评测中全部失败。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个能够生成符合严格格律要求的泰语klon pad诗节的自动化系统，并通过严格的人机对比评测（冻结LLM裁判、盲测池、预注册指标）验证其生成质量是否接近人类水平，同时探讨采样温度对词汇正确性、稀有词使用及多样性的权衡。
AI.method: 基于WangchanBERTa初始化的掩码语言模型，采用固定画布双层解码：音层（发音音节）强制施加押韵、声调、音节数硬掩码；词层（完整词汇）确保不切分词汇。解码逐单元提交，温度0.4采样，每主题单次采样，无选择/重排/修复。评测使用三轮独立冻结LLM裁判，在与人类诗节相同池中盲测78个未见主题。
AI.result: 生成诗节三项指标（形式、整洁度、一致性）同时达标70.5%，人类76.9%，差距-6.4（CI含0）。整洁度相当（85.9% vs 87.2%），形式+整洁度生成略优（+3.8），一致性差距较大（84.6% vs 91.0%）。低温（0.4）显著降低词汇错误；高温下错误率升高。稀有词比例生成7.5% vs 人类16.5%，多样性降低。预注册目标（三项均在人类5分内）未达标1.4分。基线KlonSuphap-LM在78主题上全部失败（形式19.2%，整洁度3.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双层掩码语言模型结合低温采样能生成高格律合规、词汇整洁的klon pad诗节，形式与整洁度已达人类水平，但主题一致性仍有差距。预注册目标未完全达成，主要受限于一致性指标。低温采样虽提升正确性，但牺牲了词汇稀有度和多样性。该系统显著优于现有公开基线，为泰语格律诗自动生成提供了可复现的强基线。

title: TagBO: LLM-Driven Task-Aware Graph Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Discovery
summary: Mixed-variable optimization in scientific discovery often requires exploring large combinatorial spaces under costly experimental evaluations, making sample?efficient Bayesian optimization (BO) essential. However, existing BO methods typ?ically rely on structural descriptors to define similarity among categorical variables, implicitly assuming that structural similarity reflects similarity in task performance. In scientific optimization, this assumption is often violated, leading to surrogate representations that are poorly aligned with the optimization objective. To address this limitation, we propose TagBO (Task-aware Graph Bayesian Optimization), a method that integrates LLM-derived relational priors with descriptor-based struc?tural information for mixed-variable Bayesian optimization. Rather than directly using LLM outputs as predictive scores, TagBO treats LLM outputs as a potentially noisy source of task-aware relational priors and extracts coarse ordinal relational signals from LLM reasoning to construct task-aware similarity structures for scien?tific optimization. TagBO then performs constrained Gaussian process Bayesian optimization over the resulting joint discrete-continuous representation space. Ex?periments on diverse chemistry and materials formulation tasks demonstrate that TagBO consistently improves sample efficiency under fixed evaluation budgets across LLMs of varying capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TagBO（任务感知图贝叶斯优化），针对科学发现中的混合变量优化问题，解决现有贝叶斯优化方法依赖结构描述符假设结构相似性等于任务性能相似性的局限。TagBO融合大语言模型（LLM）推理出的任务感知关系先验与描述符结构信息，构建任务感知相似性结构，在联合离散-连续表示空间上执行约束高斯过程贝叶斯优化，在化学和材料配方任务上显著提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 科学发现中的混合变量优化需要在昂贵实验评估下探索大规模组合空间，样本高效的贝叶斯优化至关重要。现有方法通常利用结构描述符定义类别变量间的相似性，隐含假设结构相似性反映任务性能相似性，但在科学优化中该假设常被违反，导致代理表示与优化目标错位。
AI.method: TagBO将LLM输出视为潜在噪声的任务感知关系先验，而非直接预测分数。从LLM推理中提取粗粒度序数关系信号，构建任务感知相似性结构，融合描述符基础结构信息，形成联合离散-连续表示空间，在此空间上执行约束高斯过程贝叶斯优化。
AI.result: 在多样化的化学和材料配方任务实验中，TagBO在固定评估预算下持续提升样本效率，且对不同能力水平的LLM均表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TagBO通过整合LLM推理的任务感知关系先验与结构描述符，有效缓解了结构相似性与任务性能相似性错位的问题，为科学发现中的混合变量贝叶斯优化提供了一种更样本高效且鲁棒的方法。

title: RIVO: Lightweight Adaptive Rerouting for Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents rely on long-horizon reasoning and iterative tool use to solve complex information-seeking tasks. However, adaptive decision-making over these trajectories remains challenging, as agents may stop prematurely when further evidence is needed, continue unnecessarily after sufficient evidence has been gathered, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories. Existing solutions either require costly model retraining and dense turn-level supervision, or rely on heuristic control rules that are not directly optimized for downstream research utility. This motivates a lightweight, utility-aware alternative for Deep Research control. We formulate adaptive rerouting in long-horizon Deep Research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem. Based on this view, we introduce RIVO, a lightweight plug-in framework for adaptive trajectory correction. The agent estimates its research state from lightweight signals and determines whether trajectory redirection is needed. Once triggered, the plug-in modifies the Host token logits to steer generation toward a more promising research direction. Theoretical analysis shows that, under a value-alignment condition and bounded local curvature, a sufficiently small logit intervention can locally improve expected downstream research utility. We further construct BrowseCore, a curated dataset with a paired local corpus, for efficient and controlled Deep Research experimentation. Building on this resource, the plug-in is trained from downstream outcomes, enabling it to learn corrections that improve subsequent research and final task performance. Extensive experiments across multiple Deep Research benchmarks and control settings demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, showing that lightweight logit intervention can improve long-horizon research without retraining the underlying Host model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RIVO，一种轻量级即插即用框架，用于深度研究任务中的自适应轨迹修正。通过从轻量信号估计研究状态，并在需要时修改宿主模型的 token logits 以引导生成方向，无需重新训练宿主模型即可提升长程研究效果。实验在多个基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 深度研究代理依赖长程推理和迭代工具使用，但自适应决策面临挑战：代理可能过早停止、不必要地继续或无法重定向无效轨迹。现有方案要么需要昂贵的模型重训练和密集逐轮监督，要么依赖未直接针对下游研究效用优化的启发式规则。因此需要一种轻量级、效用感知的深度研究控制替代方案。
AI.method: 将自适应重路由建模为状态条件轨迹修正问题。引入 RIVO 框架：代理从轻量信号估计研究状态，判断是否需要轨迹重定向；若触发，插件修改宿主模型的 token logits 以引导生成走向更有希望的研究方向。理论分析表明，在价值对齐条件和有界局部曲率下，足够小的 logit 干预可局部提升期望下游研究效用。构建 BrowseCore 数据集及配对本地语料库，支持高效可控实验。插件从下游结果训练，学习改进后续研究和最终任务性能的修正策略。
AI.result: 在多个深度研究基准和控制设置下的大量实验表明，轻量级 logit 干预能在不重训练宿主模型的情况下改善长程研究效果。RIVO 显著提升了研究轨迹的自适应质量和最终任务性能。
AI.conclusion: RIVO 通过即插即用的 logit 级干预实现了高效的自适应轨迹修正，为深度研究代理提供了一种无需重训练、效用驱动的轻量级控制范式。该方法在理论与实验上均验证了其有效性，为长程信息搜索任务的自适应决策提供了新思路。

title: Certify the Decision, Not Every Score: Exact Top-k Selection from Few Evaluations
summary: Choosing a few robust algorithms or schedules can require evaluating every candidate under many adverse scenarios, even though an agent only needs to identify the winners. A predictor may suggest those winners, but cannot rule out a surprise in an unevaluated scenario. We introduce Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS), which returns the exact top-$k$ set as soon as remaining uncertainty cannot change it. CAS keeps guaranteed lower and upper bounds on Expected Shortfall (ES), the average loss in the worst scenarios. Its stopping test compares the worst admissible selected candidate with the best admissible excluded one; for information-disjoint Cartesian intervals this one-cut test is necessary and sufficient. Prediction has a separate role: selecting the next outcome to evaluate, never authorizing the decision. For empirical ES with exact unit-cost queries, we compute in polynomial time the fewest evaluations that could have proved the realized decision in hindsight. Our prediction-guided agent CAS-PG is exact for every predictor, including adversarial ones. On two public algorithm-selection matrices, CAS-PG certifies the exact top three after 630 of 3150 and 981 of 2200 replayed queries, or $1.14$ and $1.18$ times that hindsight minimum. Without historical outcomes, its transcript-only variant requires $1.28$ and $1.37$ times the minimum, outperforming the tested non-predictive certified policies. Separately, a prediction-free CAS policy avoids $93.0\%$ of exact recourse solves in synthetic energy scheduling. One certificate thus supports several acquisition policies and separately proved risk/cost extensions: prediction changes the work, not the justified choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出认证自适应选择（CAS），一种在保证精确返回top-k算法/调度集合的同时，通过维护Expected Shortfall（ES）上下界并采用一刀切停止测试，以最少评估次数完成认证选择的框架。预测仅用于指导评估顺序，不授权决策；实验在算法选择矩阵和能源调度任务上显著减少评估/求解次数。
AI.motivation: 在算法选择、调度等场景中，往往需在众多候选中识别top-k表现者。全评估所有候选在所有逆势场景下代价高昂；预测虽能提示赢家，但无法排除未评估场景的惊吓。需要一种在保证精确性（证书）的前提下，自适应地以最少评估完成选择的方法。
AI.method: CAS框架：1) 对每个候选维护ES（最坏场景平均损失）的 guaranteed 下界与上界；2) 停止测试比较最差可接受被选候选与最佳可接受被排除候选，在信息不相交的笛卡尔区间下该一刀切测试是充要条件；3) 预测仅用于选择下一个评估的outcome，不参与决策授权；4) 提供预测引导版CAS-PG与仅转录版，以及无预测CAS策略；5) 多项式时间计算事后最少评估下界。
AI.result: 在两个公开算法选择矩阵上，CAS-PG分别在3150和2200次重放查询中仅用630和981次即认证精确top-3，分别为事后最小值的1.14倍和1.18倍；无历史结果的转录版分别为1.28和1.37倍，优于测试的非预测认证策略。在合成能源调度中，无预测CAS避免了93.0%的精确追索求解。
AI.conclusion: 一个证书支持多种采集策略，并可分别证明风险/成本扩展：预测改变的是工作量，而非合理化的选择。CAS实现了在保证精确top-k选择的前提下，自适应地最小化评估成本。

title: Ascent Conditions for Length-Normalized Single-Rollout Policy Updates
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables; code and data included as ancillary files
summary: Dividing each trajectory's score contribution by its realized length can change the direction of a reward-centered policy update. In a finite trajectory model, we derive an exact ascent threshold for a three-outcome softmax policy and exhibit a binary-reward example in which the expected Euclidean update decreases task success. Natural-gradient ascent holds for fully controllable outcome distributions with deterministic binary labels, but can fail under a one-parameter restriction.
