AI.motivation: 平均奖励设置中Bellman算子仅在马尔可夫链混合时才在span范数下收缩。现有工作通常假设环境混合等收缩性质，但本文考虑更实际的场景：给定一个已知的奖励无关m步混合策略，利用正则化方法控制学习过程的收缩和探索特性。
AI.method: 提出基于正则化的Q-learning算法框架，支持多种正则化选择（如α-散度族）。分析正则化目标的不动点，引入依赖于正则化器的新对象来控制收缩、探索和算子偏差。同时研究Q-planning变体，将规划视为时间局部化学习。
AI.result: 一步设置下达到Q-iteration和同步Q-learning的最优已知速率；m步混合设置下推导出新速率。规划地平线H在边界值偏差和样本复杂度间权衡。数值实验验证：强混合策略知识能改善收敛和探索，优势随瓶颈严重程度增加；理论预测的正则化器收敛和偏差排名与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在不假设环境混合的前提下，通过利用已知混合策略进行正则化，实现了平均奖励RL的有限时间收敛保证。正则化器的选择显著影响收缩、探索和偏差，α-散度族提供了可调节的权衡。规划作为时间局部化学习提供了偏差-复杂度权衡新视角。

title: Audit Before You Distill: A Controlled Workflow for Reasoning Transfer into Compact Medical Language Models
summary: Teacher rationales can help a smaller model answer health professions questions, but they can also reinforce errors. We examined when they help and how this evidence can guide training using Brazilian Portuguese questions from medical and multiprofessional residency examinations. First, we measured how a teacher rationale changed the student's probability of selecting the correct answer and compared this effect with rationales drawn from other questions. The complete rationale increased this probability by 21~p.p. when the teacher was correct and decreased it by 14~p.p. when the teacher was wrong. By intervening on the reasoning content, we showed that shuffled rationales did not produce the same pattern. Guided by this result, we trained only with rationales attached to correct teacher answers and compared answer-only training, step-by-step distillation, and our proposed Distill-SFT method. Distill-SFT showed a modest advantage over step-by-step distillation on previously missed questions under reasoning, while using fewer training instances by combining the answer and rationale into a single target. We also investigated catastrophic forgetting using the out-of-domain ENEM dataset. Answer-only training reduced reasoning accuracy by 12~p.p. relative to baseline, compared with approximately 4~p.p. for either rationale-based training method. Together, these findings support a workflow that audits rationale content before distillation, verifies teacher answers before supervision, and trains compact models efficiently for health professions question answering.

AI.tldr: 教师推理有助于小模型回答医学专业问题，但也可能强化错误。研究发现完整推理在教师正确时提升21个百分点，错误时降低14个百分点。提出Distill-SFT方法，仅使用正确教师答案的推理进行训练，在推理下遗漏问题上优于逐步蒸馏，且训练实例更少。答案仅训练导致灾难性遗忘12个百分点，推理训练仅4个百分点。建议工作流：蒸馏前审核推理内容，监督前验证教师答案，高效训练紧凑模型。
AI.motivation: 教师推理可帮助小模型回答医学专业问题，但也可能强化错误。需要研究何时推理有帮助，并指导训练。
AI.method: 使用巴西葡萄牙语医学和多专业住院医师考试问题。测量教师推理对学生选择正确答案概率的影响，与其他问题的推理比较。干预推理内容（打乱推理）验证模式。仅使用正确教师答案的推理训练，对比仅答案训练、逐步蒸馏和提出的Distill-SFT方法（将答案和推理合并为单一目标）。在ENEM数据集上测试灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 完整推理在教师正确时增加正确概率21个百分点，错误时减少14个百分点。打乱推理不产生相同模式。Distill-SFT在推理下遗漏问题上略优于逐步蒸馏，且训练实例更少。仅答案训练导致推理准确率下降12个百分点，推理训练方法仅下降约4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 支持工作流：蒸馏前审核推理内容，监督前验证教师答案，高效训练紧凑模型用于医学专业问答。

title: SkillFusion: Towards Reliable Multi-Skill Composition for LLM Agents
summary: Independently authored skills can impose incompatible requirements, competing preferences, and redundant instructions when jointly loaded by an LLM agent. We propose SkillFusion, an offline compiler that reconciles these interactions into a reusable merged skill. Its central idea is to make composition decisions explicit through typed, scoped constraints linked to their source directives. A type-scope gate selects candidate interactions, while selective fallback revisits pairs potentially missed by structural pruning. A classifier identifies interaction types, and an adversarial verifier re-examines uncertain judgments. The resolver applies conditional routing or explicit priorities to hard conflicts, verified abstraction to soft conflicts, and deduplication to redundant instructions. Source-linked checks guide synthesis and compression, and metadata synthesis supports discovery of the merged skill. The resulting artifact retains associated scripts and resources and can be reused across tasks and executor models. SkillFusion achieves the highest mean Success among evaluated non-oracle methods on all three agent benchmarks and on both transfer benchmarks across three executor models. At the largest tested instruction configurations, it achieves over 2.5 times the Success of unresolved multi-skill loading, highlighting the growing value of reconciliation as composition becomes more demanding. The code will be open-sourced after the review process concludes.

AI.tldr: SkillFusion 是一个离线编译器，用于协调 LLM 智能体中独立编写的技能之间的冲突、竞争偏好和冗余指令，将其合成为可复用的融合技能，显著提升多技能组合下的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 独立编写的技能在联合加载时会产生不兼容需求、竞争偏好和冗余指令，现有方法缺乏系统性的协调机制，导致随着技能组合规模增长，性能急剧下降。
AI.method: 提出 SkillFusion 编译器，核心思想是通过带类型和作用域的约束显式化组合决策。包含：类型-作用域门控选择候选交互、选择性回退补充结构剪枝遗漏的配对、分类器识别交互类型、对抗性验证器复核不确定判断、解决器对硬冲突应用条件路由或显式优先级、对软冲突应用验证抽象、对冗余指令去重；源链接检查指导合成压缩，元数据合成支持融合技能发现。产物保留脚本资源，可跨任务和执行模型复用。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准和两个迁移基准上，跨三种执行模型，SkillFusion 在所有非预言方法中均达到最高平均成功率。在最大指令配置下，成功率是未解决的多技能加载的 2.5 倍以上，凸显了协调价值随组合需求增长而增加。
AI.conclusion: SkillFusion 通过离线编译实现技能的系统性协调与融合，有效解决了多技能组合中的冲突与冗余问题，显著提升了 LLM 智能体在复杂任务上的鲁棒性与可扩展性，代码将在审稿结束后开源。

title: Characterizing the Separability Gap in Prior-Data Fitted Networks
summary: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are transformers pretrained on simulated datasets to approximate Bayesian posterior predictive distributions. Standard PFN theory assumes a separable task prior, under which the feature distribution and the mechanism generating labels from features are independent. We show that common PFN priors are non-separable, even in simple settings. Consequently, standard pretraining targets a predictive distribution based on a task posterior updated using both the labeled context and the query features. We characterize its difference from the predictive based on the context posterior alone and show that this difference vanishes under posterior concentration. Under misspecification (i.e., when the true joint distribution lies outside the prior's support), however, prior non-separability can favor better feature fit at the expense of conditional label fit. We illustrate the consequences for feature attribution, Bayesian optimization, and martingale checks of Bayesian behavior. The same dependence also enables PFNs to learn from additional unlabeled observations. We demonstrate this with SemiTabICL, a PFN explicitly pretrained to use these observations, which improves accuracy over a matched supervised baseline. Our findings highlight the need for explicit rules on unlabeled data use in PFN evaluation and establish the dependence between feature and label distributions as a consequential prior design choice.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs)中的先验非可分性问题，揭示了常用PFN先验在简单设置下也是非可分的，导致标准预训练目标基于同时使用标签上下文和查询特征的任务后验。作者刻画了其与仅基于上下文后验的预测分布差异，并在后验收敛条件下差异消失。在模型设定错误时，先验非可分性可能以条件标签拟合为代价获得更好的特征拟合。论文展示了对特征归因、贝叶斯优化和马丁格尔检验的影响，并提出了SemiTabICL利用无标签数据提升性能，强调了PFN评估中需明确无标签数据使用规则，以及特征与标签分布依赖性作为重要先验设计选择。
AI.motivation: 标准PFN理论假设可分任务先验（特征分布与标签生成机制独立），但实际中常用PFN先验往往是非可分的。作者旨在揭示这种非可分性对预测分布、模型行为及无标签数据利用的影响，并探讨其在模型设定错误下的表现。
AI.method: 理论分析：刻画非可分先验下预测分布与基于上下文后验预测分布的差异，证明后验收敛时差异消失；实验验证：在特征归因、贝叶斯优化、马丁格尔检验等任务中展示非可分性的后果；提出SemiTabICL，一种显式预训练利用无标签观测的PFN，并在表格数据上与监督基线对比。
AI.result: 1) 常用PFN先验非可分，导致预训练目标隐含使用查询特征更新任务后验。2) 非可分性带来的预测差异在后验收敛时消失。3) 模型设定错误时，非可分性可能改善特征拟合但损害条件标签拟合。4) 非可分性使PFN能从无标签数据学习，SemiTabICL在表格任务上超越监督基线。5) 强调PFN评估需明确无标签数据使用规则，特征-标签依赖是关键先验设计选择。
AI.conclusion: PFN先验的非可分性是一个重要且常被忽视的性质，它改变了预测分布的构成，在模型设定错误时产生权衡，同时也为利用无标签数据提供了机会。未来PFN设计与评估应显式考虑特征与标签分布的依赖关系，并制定明确的无标签数据使用规范。

title: What Is the "Self" of a Large Language Model?
summary: What could the "self" of a large language model be, if it is neither a particular word nor a single privileged layer? We propose a relational account: a functional self is an actor-centered organization of information that distinguishes the model's recorded actions from externally supplied material while content and reasoning operations change. Its representational candidate is a family of layer-specific source-binding components, rather than one unchanged vector throughout the network. Preliminary observations from a 27B BF16 model provide a geometric starting point. Across 150 matched message bodies, 450 role conditions, and a 75/75 discovery-held-out split, the combined Assistant-versus-external displacement transfers strongly across bodies and positions. Selected early components place User and System closer to one another than to Assistant, whereas this full-space distance relation does not persist throughout depth. These findings motivate a layered account: an early source-encoding candidate can be combined with role-specific information use and continuation preparation at later depths, without requiring monotonic overwriting of the common displacement. We connect this account to dynamic reasoning, historical continuity, and a computational model separating content operations, source binding, authority, and output. The reported evidence establishes a reproducible role-conditioned geometry; the proposed interpretation is that functional selfhood may reside in persistent relations among changing representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出大语言模型的“自我”不是固定向量或单一层，而是层特定的源绑定组件家族；实验发现助手与外部输入的几何位移在层间强泛化，早期层将用户和系统表示靠近但该关系不随深度单调保持，推测功能性自我存在于变化表征间的持久关系中。
AI.motivation: 探讨大语言模型中“自我”的本质，反驳自我是特定词或单一固定层的观点，提出关系性解释：功能性自我是以行动者为中心的信息组织，能在内容与推理操作变化时区分模型自身行为与外部输入。
AI.method: 使用27B BF16模型，在150个匹配消息体、450个角色条件、75/75发现-保留分割下，分析助手与外部输入的表征位移几何结构，系统考察不同层中用户、系统、助手三角色的距离关系及其跨层迁移性。
AI.result: 助手与外部输入的组合位移在不同消息体和位置间强泛化；早期层将用户和系统表示置于比助手更近的位置，但这一距离关系不随深度持续；支持分层账户：早期源编码与后期角色特定信息使用及续写准备结合，无需单调覆盖共同位移。
AI.conclusion: 证据建立了可复现的角色条件几何结构；功能性自我可能驻留在不断变化的表征之间的持久关系中，而非静态向量，这为动态推理、历史连续性及分离内容操作、源绑定、权威性和输出的计算模型提供基础。

title: When Skills Remain But Access Fails: Factorized Skill Memory for Continual Skill Internalization
summary: Skill internalization aims to convert externally specified procedural skills into persistent model capabilities, allowing language-model agents to execute them without retrieving or reinjecting skill descriptions at inference time. Yet when new skills are learned continually, whether previously internalized skills remain usable is still poorly understood. We study forgetting in continual skill internalization and uncover a clear hierarchical structure. Early in subsequent training, a model may lose the ability to invoke an old skill from the raw request, while supplying only the correct canonical skill name substantially restores the learned behavior; with further optimization, this conditional execution also degrades. We call these two stages skill-addressing forgetting and skill-execution forgetting. Guided by this finding, we introduce Factorized Skill Memory (FSM), which separates continual skill memory into a plastic Address Memory and a stable Execution Memory. At each stage, FSM trains a new LoRA executor using only current-stage data, freezes it after acquisition, and appends it to Execution Memory; in parallel, Address Memory incrementally learns to map current requests to executors without replaying historical requests or execution trajectories. At inference time, Address Memory selects one executor from the raw request, and only that frozen executor performs a single language-model generation. On a five-stage benchmark built from 100 TaskBench skills, FSM achieves 65.95% mean exact match and 93.38% addressing accuracy across two task orders, improving over the strongest replay-free parameter-isolation baseline by 14.3 percentage points while remaining within 1.9 points of Replay, which retains historical training examples.

AI.tldr: 论文研究持续技能内化中的遗忘现象，发现分层遗忘结构（技能寻址遗忘和技能执行遗忘），提出因子化技能记忆（FSM），将记忆分为可塑的地址记忆和稳定的执行记忆，使用LoRA执行器并冻结，实现无重放的持续学习，在TaskBench基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能内化方法将外部程序技能转化为模型持久能力，但在持续学习新技能时，旧技能是否保持可用尚不明确。论文旨在研究持续技能内化中的遗忘机制，并设计无需历史数据重放的持续学习方法。
AI.method: 提出因子化技能记忆（FSM），包含地址记忆和执行记忆。每阶段仅用当前数据训练新LoRA执行器，训练后冻结并加入执行记忆；地址记忆增量学习将请求映射到执行器，无需重放历史数据。推理时地址记忆选择执行器，仅该冻结执行器执行生成。
AI.result: 在基于100个TaskBench技能的五阶段基准上，FSM达到65.95%平均精确匹配和93.38%寻址准确率，比最强无重放参数隔离基线高14.3个百分点，且与保留历史训练样本的Replay方法仅差1.9点。
AI.conclusion: FSM通过分离技能寻址和执行，有效缓解了持续技能内化中的分层遗忘，实现了无需重放历史数据的高效持续学习，性能接近有重放的上界。

title: Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models adapt to new datasets through in-context learning (ICL), and, like most transformers, they tie computational depth to the number of independently parameterized layers. We ask whether the ICL stage of such a model needs a distinct set of parameters for every layer, or only depth. We introduce Tab-Loop, which replaces the 12 untied ICL blocks of TabICLv2 with 4 tied blocks applied $k$ times and changes nothing else: the encoders, decoder, synthetic prior and training recipe are shared with an untied baseline trained for the same compute. At matched pretraining compute (18.2 EFLOP) and matched inference compute (12 block applications), Tab-Loop matches the baseline with 62\% fewer parameters (10.4M vs.\ 27.6M): held-out log loss is 0.4583 vs.\ 0.4588, mean accuracy on 200 TALENT datasets is 84.10\% vs.\ 83.92\%, and Elo on 38 TabArena datasets is 1409 vs.\ 1396. A 4-block untied control with Tab-Loop's parameter count, which sees 32\% more training tables for the same compute, trails both (83.46\%; Elo 1343). Because weights are shared, depth becomes a choice made at inference. Accuracy rises with the number of loops through the trained range and holds beyond it, and continued training with deeper loops extends the useful range, reaching the baseline's stage-2 scores at 4--5$\times$ its inference compute. At this scale, the ICL stage of a tabular foundation model needs depth more than it needs distinct parameters.

AI.tldr: Tab-Loop通过共享参数的循环块替代表格基础模型ICL阶段的多层独立参数，在相同计算量下以62%更少参数达到相当性能，表明ICL阶段更需要深度而非独立参数。
AI.motivation: 探究表格基础模型ICL阶段是否需要每层独立参数，还是仅需要计算深度；旨在大幅减少参数量同时保持甚至提升性能。
AI.method: 提出Tab-Loop：将TabICLv2的12个非共享ICL块替换为4个共享权重的块循环应用k次，保持编码器、解码器、合成先验和训练配方完全不变；在相同预训练计算量（18.2 EFLOP）和推理计算量（12次块应用）下与基线对比，并设置4块非共享控制组（参数量相同但训练表多32%）。
AI.result: Tab-Loop参数量10.4M（基线27.6M），减少62%，性能相当：held-out log loss 0.4583 vs 0.4588，TALENT 200数据集平均准确率84.10% vs 83.92%，TabArena 38数据集Elo 1409 vs 1396。4块非共享控制组表现落后（83.46%；Elo 1343）。准确率随循环次数增加而提升并在训练范围外保持，继续训练更深循环可扩展有效范围，在4-5倍推理计算量下达到基线stage-2分数。
AI.conclusion: 在该规模下，表格基础模型ICL阶段更需要深度而非独立参数；参数共享使深度成为推理时的可选超参数，循环机制提供灵活的计算-性能权衡，且持续训练更深循环可进一步拓展性能上限。

title: Lost in Contrast: Instruction-Preserving Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering
summary: Visual contrastive decoding corrects answers using the prediction difference between the original image and a reference condition, yet the same contrast also turns supported abstentions into incorrect answers. We find that abstentions are lost at two stages: contrastive decoding with candidate filtering can exclude the abstention token before any comparison takes place, and the reference branch's response to the abstention instruction is removed when the reference prediction is subtracted. We therefore propose instruction-preserving decoding, which keeps the effect of the abstention instruction on the original-image prediction intact while leaving the contrast strength freely adjustable. Using a perturbed image and an image-free prediction as references, we obtain IP-VCD and IP-M3ID. On decision utility (DU), which credits both correct answers and supported abstentions, both methods outperform all compared non-IP baselines on every one of nine models on VizWiz, and IP-VCD also leads on eight of nine models on Food-101. Candidate measurements and paired per-question comparisons show that computing the instruction effect and the visual contrast term separately lets contrastive decoding support both correct answers and supported abstentions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出视觉对比解码（VCD）在处理拒答（abstention）时存在两个阶段的丢失问题：候选过滤可能在对比前排除拒答token，且参考分支对拒答指令的响应在减法时被移除。提出指令保留解码（IP），分别计算指令效应和视觉对比项，使对比解码同时支持正确回答和有理拒答。实验表明IP-VCD和IP-M3ID在决策效用（DU）上优于所有非IP基线，在VizWiz九模型全胜，Food-101八模型领先。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉对比解码虽能利用原始图像与参考条件的预测差异修正答案，但同一对比机制会将有理拒答转为错误答案。拒答在两阶段丢失：候选过滤提前排除拒答token，参考分支对拒答指令的响应在减法中被抵消。需保留拒答指令对原始图像预测的影响，同时自由调节对比强度。
AI.method: 提出指令保留解码（IP），将指令效应与视觉对比项分离计算。使用扰动图像和无图像预测作为参考，分别构建IP-VCD和IP-M3ID。保持拒答指令对原始图像预测的影响完整，对比强度可自由调节。
AI.result: 在决策效用（DU，同时奖励正确回答和有理拒答）指标上，IP-VCD和IP-M3ID在VizWiz数据集的九个模型上均超越所有非IP基线；IP-VCD在Food-101上也领先八个模型。候选度量和逐题配对比较显示，分离计算指令效应和视觉对比项使对比解码能同时支持正确回答和有理拒答。
AI.conclusion: 指令保留解码通过显式建模指令效应，解决了视觉对比解码中拒答丢失的问题，实现了正确回答与有理拒答的双重提升，为可靠视觉语言模型推理提供了新范式。

title: Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers
summary: Large language models make decisions through parallel prefill and sequential decoding. Although effective, this approach incurs decoding costs and does not explicitly expose decision probabilities. Existing task-specific classifiers require per-task training and offer limited generalization to unseen decision schemas. We propose Large Decision Models (LDMs), repurposing language models to return explicit probabilities over labels specified at run time using one prefill forward pass. We first adapt models to this interface through Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS), covering varied domains, rules and labels. To further narrow the performance gap to a reasoning model, Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) adds tasks generated by a frozen teacher, filters them for answer consistency, and trains on label distributions obtained from repeated teacher reasoning. We evaluate on DecisionVista, pairing new-schema tests with held-out human-labelled sources. Across three base models, the recipe improves accuracy over a step-matched baseline by 1.8 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving a 182-fold speedup in latency over reasoning rollout on Gemma-4-31B. Reasoning remains stronger on the new-schema test, motivating a confidence router for uncertain decisions. On development sets, routing recovers a median 92% of reasoning's accuracy advantage while generating 27-58% of its tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/LDM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大型决策模型（LDMs），通过一次前向传播即可在运行时返回标签的显式概率，实现快速决策。利用多样化决策监督（DDS）和自我生成推理蒸馏（SPRD）两阶段训练，在三个基础模型上均显著提升准确率，相比推理推演实现182倍延迟加速，并提出置信度路由机制在保持92%推理优势的同时仅生成27-58%token。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型通过并行预填充和顺序解码进行决策，存在解码开销大、无法显式输出决策概率的问题；任务特定分类器需要针对每个任务训练，对未见决策模式泛化能力有限。需要一种能在运行时指定标签、一次前向传播即给出概率分布、且泛化性强的决策模型。
AI.method: 1. 大型决策模型（LDM）架构：复用语言模型，通过一次预填充前向传播直接输出运行时指定标签的概率分布。2. 多样化决策监督（DDS）：覆盖多领域、多规则、多标签的决策任务，使模型适应该接口。3. 自我生成推理蒸馏（SPRD）：冻结教师模型生成任务，筛选答案一致的样本，利用教师重复推理得到的标签分布进行训练，缩小与推理模型的性能差距。4. 置信度路由：对不确定决策路由至推理模型，平衡准确率与效率。
AI.result: 在DecisionVista基准上，三个基础模型均比步数匹配基线提升1.8和1.5个百分点准确率；在Gemma-4-31B上实现182倍推理延迟加速；新模式测试中推理模型仍更强，置信度路由在开发集上恢复推理优势的中位数92%，仅生成27-58%的token。
AI.conclusion: LDM通过DDS和SPRD训练，实现了运行时指定标签的快速概率决策，大幅降低推理成本同时保持高准确率。置信度路由进一步平衡了准确率与效率，为实际部署提供了实用方案。代码已开源。

title: Conformal Sequential Decision Making With Cost and Sublinear Policy Regret Guarantees
summary: Automated decision makers, such as AI agents that control robots or network devices, must often satisfy hard cost constraints while maintaining competitive performance. In such settings, a cost measure, such as a safety violation rate, energy consumption, or a distortion level, must stay within a given budget in every episode of operation. Furthermore, a cumulative reward metric, accounting for per-step performance, must stay close to the reward of a meaningful reference policy. We formulate this setup as an episodic sequential decision problem in which the state sequence is arbitrary, and the reward and cost may depend on past actions within the same episode. We propose the online conformal episodic agent (OCEA), a policy that selects one candidate action per episode using a regret-controlled algorithm, and switches to a zero-cost action when the remaining budget cannot absorb the maximum cost of one more round. We prove that OCEA satisfies per-episode cost constraints for every state sequence and for every realization of its internal randomness, while achieving a sublinear expected policy regret with respect to the best action sequence in hindsight from a comparator class satisfying the same per-episode cost constraints. We apply OCEA to risk-averse control and online compression with distortion guarantees.

AI.tldr: 提出OCEA算法，在任意状态序列下保证每回合成本约束，同时实现次线性期望策略遗憾。
AI.motivation: 自动化决策系统（如机器人、网络设备控制）需满足硬性成本约束（安全违规率、能耗、失真等）且保持竞争性性能，现有方法难以在任意状态序列下同时保证每回合成本约束和次线性遗憾。
AI.method: 提出在线共形回合智能体（OCEA），采用遗憾控制算法每回合选择一个候选动作，当剩余预算无法承担最大单步成本时切换至零成本动作。
AI.result: 证明OCEA对任意状态序列和内部随机性实现均满足每回合成本约束，且相对于满足相同约束的对比类中的最佳动作序列实现次线性期望策略遗憾；在风险厌恶控制和带失真保证的在线压缩中验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: OCEA为带有硬性每回合成本约束的序列决策问题提供了理论保证的解决方案，适用于安全关键和资源受限场景。

title: The Multilingual Artificial Hivemind: Do All LLMs Think Alike in Every Language?
summary: Text generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) often remains limited in diversity compared to that produced by humans. Recent advances demonstrate the presence of inter- and intra-model collapse in open-ended generation of English text, raising concerns about the long-term homogenization of LLM, and more importantly, human thought. However, our understanding of whether this homogenization extends to languages beyond English is limited. In this work, we investigate the role of language on output diversity. Specifically, we aim to understand whether multilingual LLM-generated text is also homogeneous, and whether this homogeneity matches what we observe in humans. Across 23 open-weight models and 13 languages, we find that the artificial hivemind effect is pervasive but uneven in its extent. The intra-model effect holds in three different embedding spaces and under a lexical metric that uses no embedding model, so it is not an artifact of how diversity is measured. The size of the homogenization gap is associated with a model's competence in a language, measured on a held-out translation benchmark, robustly across embedding spaces. Thus, we demonstrate a performance-diversity tradeoff in multilingual LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了多语言大语言模型生成文本的同质化现象，跨23个开放权重模型和13种语言发现‘人工蜂群效应’普遍但程度不均，且模型在某语言上的能力越强，生成文本同质化越严重，揭示了多语言LLM中存在性能-多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已证实英语开放式生成中存在模型间和模型内崩塌，引发对LLM乃至人类思维长期同质化的担忧，但该现象是否延伸至英语以外语言尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在23个开放权重模型和13种语言上开展实验，使用三种不同嵌入空间及一种无需嵌入模型的词汇度量指标评估输出多样性，并以保留翻译基准上的表现衡量模型在各语言上的能力。
AI.result: 人工蜂群效应普遍存在但跨语言差异显著；模型内同质化在三种嵌入空间和词汇指标下均成立，排除了度量伪影；同质化程度与模型在该语言上的翻译能力呈稳健正相关，确证了性能-多样性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 多语言LLM生成文本同样面临同质化风险，且模型对某语言掌握越熟练，生成多样性越低，提示在追求多语言能力提升时需警惕并缓解输出多样性的下降。

title: Data Portability Revisited: Toward the Human-Centric, AI-Driven Data Ecosystems of Tomorrow
summary: This Article critically examines the contemporary regulatory framework and discourse surrounding data portability in the United States. Using recent regulatory developments in the European Union as an illustration, this Article suggests that although data access and portability are identified as vital issues in multiple policy instruments, in its current iteration, at least, legal conceptions of portability continue to reinforce the interests of service providers and data controller enterprises rather than individual end users. This Article argues that a paradigm shift toward a more human-centric data approach to data governance must occur, under which data would be recognized as fundamental to an individual's identity in a digital age. Therefore, it should be placed in the hands of individuals rather than service providers or data controller enterprises. This Article considers technical and market trends in the European Union that reveal and facilitate such a change. It suggests that regulatory frameworks should better align with these technological and market developments to encourage change-inducing trends among market actors. In short, this Article identifies a transformative approach to data portability that empowers individuals with the freedom and ability to aggregate their data in secure personal spaces under their control or dominion. Such a human-centric perspective on data portability is crucial in building Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered applications for individual consumers that can pave the way for the human-centric, AI-driven data ecosystems of the future.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视美国数据可移植性监管框架，指出现行法律仍强化服务提供商和数据控制者利益而非终端用户，主张向以人为本的数据治理范式转变，将数据视为个人数字身份核心并置于个人控制之下，结合欧盟技术与市场趋势，提出监管应与之对齐以赋能个人在安全个人空间聚合数据，为以人为本的AI驱动数据生态奠基。
AI.motivation: 当前数据可移植性监管虽被多项政策工具认定为关键议题，但实质上仍偏向服务提供商和数据控制企业，未能真正赋权个人终端用户；数字时代数据已成为个人身份核心组成部分，亟需确立以人为本的数据治理范式，将数据控制权回归个人。
AI.method: 采用批判性法律分析方法，对比美国与欧盟监管框架，结合欧盟近期技术发展（如个人数据空间、数据聚合工具）与市场趋势（如个人数据存储服务、互操作性标准）进行跨学科考察，论证监管框架如何与技术市场演进对齐以推动范式转变。
AI.result: 识别出一种变革性数据可移植性路径：个人拥有自由与能力在受其控制的安全个人空间聚合数据；该以人为本视角能催生面向个人消费者的AI应用，为未来以人为本的AI驱动数据生态系统铺平道路。
AI.conclusion: 监管应从强化企业控制转向保障个人数据主权，通过法律承认数据为个人数字身份基础、强制互操作性、支持个人数据空间基础设施等措施，使数据可移植性真正赋能个人，并成为人本AI生态的基石。

title: Algorithmic Fairness Over Time: Advances & Prospects
summary: In the presence of feedback loops, algorithmic decisions at one time step can influence observed data in subsequent steps, potentially introducing selection bias or shifts in data distribution. Research has demonstrated that ignoring these effects can lead to unfairness, which may worsen over time as the model remains deployed within society. This raises important questions of how to measure and ensure fairness of algorithmic decision-making models over time. In this short paper, we present a taxonomy that distinguishes between different types of static and temporal fairness notions in recent advancements. We then suggest prospects for future research by identifying common implicit temporal assumptions, open questions to enhance our temporal understanding of fairness, and other open challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨反馈回路下算法决策随时间演变的公平性问题，提出静态与时序公平性概念的分类体系，并指出隐含时序假设、开放问题及未来研究挑战。
AI.motivation: 算法决策在部署过程中通过反馈回路影响后续数据分布，若忽视时序效应会导致不公平随时间加剧，亟需度量和保障长期公平性的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建分类学体系，区分静态公平性概念（单时刻切片）与时序公平性概念（跨时间演化），并系统梳理现有研究中的隐含时序假设。
AI.result: 识别出静态公平性指标无法捕捉时序动态偏见，时序公平性需考虑分布漂移、选择偏差累积及反馈机制；提出增强时序公平性理解的开放问题集合。
AI.conclusion: 长期算法公平性要求超越静态切片分析，需建立动态评估框架、形式化时序假设、设计鲁棒干预机制，以应对部署环境中的演化偏见。

title: A Bethe-Ansatz Source of Early Token Correlations: A marginal-preserving construction for parallel proposals
comment: 5 pages, 2 tables. Ancillary files reproduce all numerical results
summary: Parallel token proposals in language-model decoding need a joint law, not merely accurate token marginals. We construct a family of coordinate-Bethe-ansatz laws from the periodic XXZ chain and compare each with its maximum-entropy pairwise projection at identical one- and two-site moments. In the eight-site, three-excitation sector, symmetry makes their entire probability-law difference one-dimensional, determined by a contiguous three-site moment. Along the Bethe branch, this gap varies with anisotropy, changes sign, and vanishes exactly at $Δ=(3+\sqrt{3})/2$, where the eigenstate law becomes exactly pairwise. A nonlinear readout transfers a nonzero gap into the first two token positions while preserving their separate marginals. At $Δ=1.5$ the deterministic binary token laws differ by 0.02654573 in total variation. Exact speculative verification then gives a strict accepted-prefix advantage for a constructed target and a neighborhood within targets sharing its first-token marginal. This is a mathematical existence result. It does not establish a language-model gain or wall-clock speedup.

AI.tldr: 该论文从周期性XXZ链构造了一族坐标Bethe-ansatz定律，与其最大熵成对投影进行比较，发现两者概率定律差异在八站点三激发子空间下为一维，由连续三站点矩决定。在Bethe分支上，该差距随各向异性参数变化并改变符号，在Δ=(3+√3)/2时恰好消失，此时本征态定律变为完全成对。通过非线性读出将非零差距转移到前两个token位置，保持其边缘分布不变。在Δ=1.5时，确定性二元token定律在总变差上差异为0.02654573。精确投机验证给出了构造目标及其邻域内共享首token边缘分布的目标的严格接受前缀优势。这是一个数学存在性结果，并未证明语言模型增益或实际加速。
AI.motivation: 语言模型解码中的并行token提议需要联合分布律，而不仅仅是准确的token边缘分布。现有方法可能忽略了高阶相关性，因此需要研究联合分布与成对投影之间的差异，以理解并行解码的理论基础。
AI.method: 从周期性XXZ链构造坐标Bethe-ansatz定律族，计算其最大熵成对投影（保持一阶和二阶矩相同），利用对称性分析八站点三激发子空间下的概率定律差异，通过各向异性参数Δ研究差距变化，设计非线性读出将三站点矩差距映射到前两个token位置，并进行精确投机验证。
AI.result: 在八站点三激发子空间，两定律差异为一维，由连续三站点矩决定。差距随Δ变化并改变符号，在Δ=(3+√3)/2时消失。非线性读出将差距转移至前两token位置，保持边缘分布。Δ=1.5时总变差为0.02654573。精确投机验证显示构造目标及其邻域存在严格接受前缀优势。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个数学存在性结果，证明了联合分布与成对投影差异可转化为解码优势，但未建立语言模型实际增益或墙钟加速。为并行token解码的理论分析提供了严格框架。

title: Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
Agent-to-agent protocols allow LLM agents to discover peers, exchange results, and coordinate tool use. A locally successful protocol attack, however, may be rejected by a later agent or propagated into a consequential task decision. Measuring local exploitability alone leaves this difference unresolved and provides limited evidence about which participant caused the final outcome.
  We present Agent-Canary-Mas, an end-to-end evaluation system that follows protocol risk through long-horizon multi-agent tasks. It covers five risk classes and 13 subclasses across A2A, ANP, and BCS, with 975 matched malicious--benign task pairs in five business domains. A shared OpenClaw framework runs autonomous, tool-using agents under different underlying models while preserving the task and execution setup. Matched runs separate local protocol success from downstream consequences; retained evidence connects participant selection, message consumption, tool activity, and task-state changes. We further evaluate a protocol-context Guard that checks an object's authority at consequential handoffs.
  Across three model conditions, local attack success is frequently at or above 90%, while consequence conversion ranges from 7.1\% to 100.0\%. Cross-agent evidence raises macro-averaged Audit-F1 from 29.7% to 95.5%. On Finance tasks, the Guard lowers average ASR from 86.1% to 53.8% and PTCR from 65.5% to 31.2%, with a measurable completion tradeoff. These results show that protocol risk depends on how agents use exchanged objects throughout the task, and that evaluating this path supports more informative risk assessment, attribution, and defense.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agent-Canary-Mas，一个端到端评估系统，用于追踪多智能体长时程任务中的协议风险。研究覆盖五大风险类别、13 个子类，跨越 A2A、ANP、BCS 三种协议，构建了 975 对恶意-良性匹配任务对，涉及五个业务领域。通过共享 OpenClaw 框架运行自主工具使用智能体，区分局部协议攻击成功率与下游后果转化率，并引入协议上下文 Guard 在关键交接点校验对象权限。实验显示：局部攻击成功率常超 90%，但后果转化率仅 7.1%-100%；跨智能体证据将宏平均 Audit-F1 从 29.7% 提升至 95.5%；Finance 任务中 Guard 将 ASR 从 86.1% 降至 53.8%，PTCR 从 65.5% 降至 31.2%，但伴随完成率权衡。结论指出协议风险取决于智能体如何在任务全程中使用交换对象，评估该路径可支持更具信息量的风险评估、归因与防御。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体间协议攻击评估主要关注局部可利用性，无法区分攻击在局部成功后是否被后续智能体拒绝或传播为实质性任务决策影响，也难以界定哪个参与者导致了最终结果。需要一种端到端的评估体系，能在长时程多智能体任务中追踪协议风险的完整传播链路，分离局部成功与下游后果，并支持证据保留与归因分析。
AI.method: 构建 Agent-Canary-Mas 评估系统：1) 定义五大风险类别、13 个子类，覆盖 A2A、ANP、BCS 协议；2) 在五个业务领域生成 975 对恶意-良性匹配任务对；3) 使用共享 OpenClaw 框架运行自主工具使用智能体，保持任务与执行设置一致，支持不同底层模型；4) 通过匹配运行分离局部协议成功与下游后果，保留参与者选择、消息消费、工具活动、任务状态变更等证据；5) 设计协议上下文 Guard，在关键交接点校验对象权限。
AI.result: 三种模型条件下，局部攻击成功率频繁达到或超过 90%，但后果转化率范围为 7.1% 至 100.0%。跨智能体证据使宏平均 Audit-F1 从 29.7% 大幅提升至 95.5%。在 Finance 任务中，Guard 将平均 ASR 从 86.1% 降至 53.8%，PTCR 从 65.5% 降至 31.2%，但伴随可测量的任务完成率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 协议风险本质上取决于智能体在任务全过程中如何使用交换对象，而非仅取决于局部协议漏洞。端到端追踪风险传播路径、保留跨智能体证据，并结合关键交接点的权限校验，能实现更具信息量的风险评估、精准归因与有效防御。}

title: PATTERN Can Be Solved from Memory: Generator-Aware Baselines for Synthetic Node Classification
summary: PATTERN, a synthetic node-classification benchmark still used to rank graph networks, plants a random subgraph in a random host graph and asks which nodes belong to it. Its generator draws 100 patterns once and plants the same ones in every split, so each test graph carries a pattern that also appears in 100 training graphs. A matcher that reads these patterns off the training labels and looks them up in each test graph reaches 99.2 class-weighted accuracy with no trained parameters, against 89.8 for the best published model. Inference under the generator without the patterns reaches 86.8. Two published models, CKGConv and GRIT, score lower on patterns they have not seen: on new graphs with fresh patterns both fall below this pattern-blind predictor, and withholding patterns from CKGConv's training lowers its accuracy on the test graphs that carry them. Training CKGConv with a new pattern in every graph raises its accuracy on fresh patterns by about 2 points, to the level of the pattern-blind predictor, at some cost on the reused patterns. The same kind of inference under the generator matches the best published result on CLUSTER and, without any training, scores above every published result we found on Minesweeper's released board. We recommend that synthetic benchmarks report scores on fresh templates beside reused ones, publish baselines built from their generators, and state how their metric is weighted and pooled.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了合成节点分类基准 PATTERN 存在严重的数据泄露问题：测试集中的模式在训练集中已出现，导致简单的模式匹配基线（无需训练参数）即可达到 99.2% 准确率，远超最佳已发布模型的 89.8%。作者通过实验证明模型实际泛化能力被高估，并建议合成基准应报告新模式下的表现、发布基于生成器的基线、并明确度量加权与汇聚方式。
AI.motivation: 指出广泛使用的合成基准 PATTERN 存在模式复用导致的评测失真，模型并未真正学习泛化特征而是记忆了训练中出现的固定模式，呼吁修正基准评测规范以反映模型真实泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 分析 PATTERN 生成器：仅生成 100 个固定模式并在所有数据分割中复用；2. 构建无需训练的模式匹配基线：从训练标签读取模式并在测试图中查找；3. 对比最佳已发布模型（CKGConv、GRIT 等）在复用模式与全新模式下的表现；4. 实验消融：从 CKGConv 训练中 withhold 模式、或每图引入新模式训练；5. 将同类生成器推理基线扩展至 CLUSTER 和 Minesweeper 基准。
AI.result: • 模式匹配基线在 PATTERN 上达 99.2% class-weighted accuracy，远超最佳模型 89.8%；• 生成器盲推理（不使用模式）得 86.8%；• CKGConv 与 GRIT 在全新模式上表现低于模式盲基线；• 从训练中移除模式会降低 CKGConv 在携带该模式测试图上的准确率；• 每图引入新模式训练可将 CKGConv 在新模式上提升约 2 点至模式盲水平，但会损害复用模式上的表现；• 同类基线在 CLUSTER 达 SOTA，在 Minesweeper 超过所有已发布结果。
AI.conclusion: 合成基准应：1. 报告全新模板（fresh templates）与复用模板的分开分数；2. 发布基于生成器的无训练基线作为下界；3. 明确说明度量的加权与汇聚方式。这能避免因数据泄露导致的虚高性能报告，推动真实泛化能力的评测。

title: A Scaled-Up Empirical Study of Syntactic Language Models
summary: Syntactic language models (SLMs) that generate sentences along with their syntactic tree structures have shown promise in both syntactic generalization and downstream tasks. Prior studies, however, have mostly evaluated smaller models trained on less pretraining data and tested on narrower task suites. In addition, the design space of tree linearization and attention masks remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 controlled configurations---one terminal baseline and 11 SLM variants spanning different linearizations and masks---at scales up to 1B parameters and 100B training tokens, evaluated across 11 downstream tasks and two syntactic benchmarks. The experimental results show that SLMs with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks. They require no architectural modifications and remain compatible with FlashAttention. We also observe that when scaling up to the 1B-parameter scale, the top-performing SLM variant no longer shows a clear advantage over a compute-matched non-structural baseline, suggesting that SLMs may become less competitive with scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation.

AI.tldr: 论文进行大规模实证研究，对比12种句法语言模型配置（1个基线+11个SLM变体），在1B参数、100B训练token规模下，发现标准因果注意力的SLM在下游任务和句法基准上匹配或超越结构化掩码变体，无需架构修改且兼容FlashAttention；但随规模扩大，顶配SLM不再显著优于算力匹配的非结构基线，表明SLM竞争力随规模增大而下降。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在小模型、少预训练数据、窄任务套件上评估句法语言模型，且树线性化与注意力掩码的设计空间探索不足，亟需大规模、受控的系统性对比。
AI.method: 构建12组受控配置（1个终端基线+11个SLM变体），覆盖不同树线性化策略与注意力掩码设计，在高达1B参数、100B训练token规模上训练，跨11个下游任务与2个句法基准评测。
AI.result: 标准因果注意力的SLM在下游任务与句法基准上匹配或超越结构化掩码变体，无需架构改动且兼容FlashAttention；但扩展到1B参数规模时，最优SLM变体不再对算力匹配的非结构基线呈现明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 句法语言模型在大规模下优势减弱，标准因果注意力已足够捕获句法结构，结构化掩码带来的收益边际递减，未来研究应关注规模定律下的句法建模效用。

title: Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation
summary: Diffusion models have been widely used for various generative tasks. However, recent studies have demonstrated that the internal representations learned in the diffusion models' denoising process are insufficiently meaningful, which can hinder the generation performance. To address this, we propose a novel diffusion U-Net architecture enhanced by explicitly aligning the weaker representation from the earlier layer conditioned on higher noise with the better representation from the later layer conditioned on lower noise during training, which we use for the challenging multimodal task of video background music generation. Our diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) employs an alignment loss to effectively guide our diffusion model to learn good internal representations, thereby enabling it to produce higher-quality symbolic music conditioned on video features. We employ a cross-attention mechanism to synchronize music with video segments. Experiments on a benchmark video-music dataset demonstrate that the proposed U-SRA approach for video background music generation surpasses the state-of-the-art across key evaluation metrics, including video-music alignment and overall music quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种增强的扩散U-Net架构（U-SRA），通过显式对齐早期层（高噪声条件下）较弱的内部表示与后期层（低噪声条件下）较强的表示，解决扩散模型内部表示不够有意义的问题，并应用于视频背景音乐生成任务。实验表明该方法在视频-音乐对齐和整体音乐质量等关键指标上超越了现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在去噪过程中学到的内部表示不够有意义，限制了生成性能。针对这一问题，作者希望通过显式对齐不同噪声水平下层的表示，提升扩散模型内部表示的质量，从而改善条件生成任务（如视频背景音乐生成）的效果。
AI.method: 提出U-SRA（U-Net Self-Representation Alignment）架构：在训练时引入对齐损失，将早期层（高噪声条件）的弱表示与后期层（低噪声条件）的强表示显式对齐。同时采用跨注意力机制实现音乐与视频片段的同步。该方法生成符号音乐，以视频特征为条件。
AI.result: 在基准视频-音乐数据集上，U-SRA方法在视频-音乐对齐和整体音乐质量等关键评价指标上均超越了当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过自表示对齐增强扩散U-Net的内部表示学习，能够有效提升条件生成任务的性能。U-SRA为视频背景音乐生成提供了更高质量的符号音乐生成方案，验证了显式表示对齐在扩散模型中的有效性。

title: InCLAD: A Continual Learning Benchmark for Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection benchmarks have advanced rapidly, yet they remain largely static and therefore underrepresent deployment settings in which inspection systems must be extended from one industrial component to another over time. In our setting, continual industrial anomaly detection is framed as a task-incremental problem: each component defines a task, while the learning objective remains semi-supervised. The goal extends beyond conventional anomaly detection, since models should preserve their performance on all components as they are sequentially exposed to new components. This framing is especially relevant because many existing industrial pipelines either assume fully supervised defect labels or study only isolated datasets, leaving open the question of how semi-supervised anomaly detectors behave across a sequence of heterogeneous components. We address this gap by organizing the benchmark as a sequence of related component-level tasks and by defining multiple scenarios, including random, easy-to-hard, and hard-to-easy. In addition to single-dataset continual scenarios, we propose challenging scenarios spanning across multiple datasets. We further evaluate continual performance from two complementary perspectives: image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level anomaly localization. By recasting industrial anomaly detection as a continual benchmark rather than a static train/test problem, our work establishes a concrete path toward studying knowledge retention, adaptation, and generalization in evolving industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个持续工业异常检测基准，将异常检测重构为任务增量问题，每个工业部件为一个任务，半监督学习目标，旨在研究模型在顺序接触新部件时的知识保持、适应和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工业异常检测基准多为静态，且假设全监督缺陷标签或仅研究孤立数据集，无法反映实际部署中检测系统需随时间扩展到新部件的场景，因此需要研究半监督异常检测器在异构部件序列上的表现。
AI.method: 将工业异常检测建模为任务增量持续学习问题，构建一系列相关部件级任务序列，定义随机、易到难、难到易等多种持续学习场景，并提出跨数据集的挑战性场景；从图像级异常检测和像素级异常定位两个维度评估持续性能。
AI.result: 通过将工业异常检测重构为持续基准而非静态训练/测试问题，建立了研究演化工业环境中知识保持、适应和泛化的具体路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了半监督异常检测在异构部件序列上行为研究的空白，为持续工业异常检测提供了系统性基准和评估框架，推动了该领域从静态向动态持续学习的转变。

title: Label Collapse in Diffusion Language Model In-Context Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) applies large language models to new tasks by prepending a few labeled demonstrations to a query. Prior work has studied how demonstration ordering affects ICL, but the interaction between label arrangement patterns and model biases has not been systematically examined. We define label collapse as the failure mode in which the model generates query-independent labels, and show that it is architecturally universal at the tested 8-9B scale: five models spanning autoregressive (Llama-3, Qwen3.5) and discrete diffusion (LLaDA, iLLaDA, LLaDA-Instruct) families all exhibit label collapse even under the class-balanced alternating arrangement, with some label word pairs collapsing in virtually every tested condition and others flipping their collapse direction with arrangement. Critically, accuracy alone cannot detect this collapse: models can achieve near-chance accuracy while generating query-independent labels, a score indistinguishable from balanced performance, so the failure can persist undetected in deployment. We measure separation, the log-odds of the two label words at the query position (the quantity that label-bias calibration operates on), as a complementary diagnostic that exposes collapse hidden beneath surface accuracy, together with a measurement protocol that guards label extraction against tokenizer and formatting artifacts. For autoregressive models, collapse persists where the majority-label-bias account does not apply, and arrangement patterns can reverse the collapse direction; for diffusion models, we present a systematic evaluation of ICL failure modes, complementing contemporaneous studies of dLLM context comprehension and demonstration-order sensitivity, and identify open questions about how iterative denoising interacts with label biases.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了上下文学习(ICL)中标签排列模式与模型偏见的交互作用，定义并发现了“标签崩塌”现象：模型生成与查询无关的标签。在8-9B规模的自回归模型(Llama-3, Qwen3.5)和离散扩散模型(LLaDA, iLLaDA, LLaDA-Instruct)中均普遍存在该现象，即使在类别平衡的交替排列下也是如此。准确率无法检测此崩塌，作者提出“分离度”(log-odds)作为互补诊断指标，并建立抗分词器/格式伪影的测量协议。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽关注演示顺序对ICL的影响，但标签排列模式与模型偏见的系统性交互尚未被充分探究。特别是模型可能在准确率接近随机猜测时仍生成查询无关标签，这种隐性失效模式在部署中难以被发现。
AI.method: 1. 定义标签崩塌为模型生成查询无关标签的失效模式。2. 在五个8-9B规模模型(自回归+离散扩散)上测试多种标签排列模式。3. 提出分离度指标(查询位置两个标签词的log-odds)作为崩塌诊断工具。4. 设计测量协议消除分词器和格式伪影对标签提取的干扰。5. 对比自回归与扩散模型的崩塌行为差异。
AI.result: 标签崩塌在所有测试模型中普遍存在，具有架构普适性。部分标签词对在几乎所有条件下崩塌，另一些随排列模式翻转崩塌方向。准确率无法区分崩塌与平衡性能。自回归模型中崩塌超越多数标签偏见解释，排列模式可逆转崩塌方向；扩散模型展现出系统性ICL失效模式，迭代去噪与标签偏见的交互机制仍待探究。
AI.conclusion: 标签崩塌是ICL中普遍且隐蔽的失效模式，准确率指标不足以检测。分离度指标配合严格测量协议可有效暴露隐性崩塌。不同架构模型的崩塌机制存在差异：自回归模型受排列模式调制，扩散模型的迭代去噪过程引入新的偏见交互机制。这为ICL鲁棒性评估和偏见缓解提供了新视角和工具。

title: Inverse Garment Design with Visual Agents
summary: We study the problem of inverse garment design, reconstructing simulation-ready 3D outfits with arbitrary layers from a single image, with visual agents. Unlike differentiable optimization that is time-consuming, or feed-forward methods limited by training data, we introduce DressAgent, a hierarchical agentic system that recovers garment sewing patterns through planning and closed-loop refinement grounded in physical simulation. To this end, we first present an enhanced representation based on GarmentCode for diverse styles and arbitrary dressing layers, and build the first multi-layer sewing pattern dataset with over 15K outfits for supervision and benchmarking. Inverse design then proceeds coarse to fine: In layer planning and coarse estimation, agents infer layer order and relations, peel each layer into its own view, and estimate coarse patterns. In fine-grained refinement, an agentic trio of Tailor, Critic, and Orchestrator refines patterns in a closed loop of editing, simulating, and judging against the reference with visual and measured evidence. Carefully designed tools and an evolving memory make this refinement converge on the target geometry. We also design an agentic generation method for high-fidelity textures. DressAgent outperforms feed-forward methods by a large margin, surpasses or matches differentiable optimization in a fraction of the time, and generalizes to complex layering, diverse poses, and body shapes.

AI.tldr: 提出 DressAgent，一种分层代理系统，通过规划与闭环细化从单张图像重建多层仿真就绪 3D 服装。
AI.motivation: 解决逆向服装设计问题：从单张图像重建任意层数的仿真就绪 3D 服装。现有方法要么是耗时的可微分优化，要么是受限于训练数据的前馈方法，缺乏对复杂层叠、多样姿态和体形的泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建基于 GarmentCode 的增强表示支持多样风格和任意穿着层，构建首个含 15K+ 套装的多层缝纫图案数据集。DressAgent 分两阶段：1) 层规划与粗略估计：代理推断层顺序与关系，剥离各层视图，估计粗略图案。2) 细粒度细化：裁缝、评论家、编排者三代理协作，通过编辑、仿真、对参考图进行视觉与度量判断的闭环迭代优化图案。设计工具与演化记忆促进收敛。另设计代理式生成方法产出高保真纹理。
AI.result: 在基准测试中大幅超越前馈方法，在极少时间内达到或超越可微分优化，并泛化至复杂层叠、多样姿态和体形。
AI.conclusion: DressAgent 通过分层代理规划与基于物理仿真的闭环细化，实现了从单图到多层仿真就绪 3D 服装的高效、高保真重建，为逆向服装设计提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems. Yet the statistical cost of adaptive routing remains only partially understood. We study the estimation error of least-squares MoE estimators when both the experts and the gating network are Lipschitz in their parameters. We represent each MoE as a gate--expert pair in a Gated Hilbert Space, whose norm $\|\cdot\|_Δ$ separates the contributions of routing and expert discrepancies. Using its empirical representation, we derive an oracle inequality with a fast rate of order $\tilde{\mathcal O}\big((Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}+d_{\mathrm{pr},g})/n\big)$ for dense MoEs with $K$ experts. For sparse Top-$k$ and Top-$p$ routing, the selection map is discontinuous in the gating parameters. We handle this by partitioning the gating class according to the selection patterns it induces on the sample. The resulting bounds match the dense rate up to an additive routing cost governed by the Natarajan dimension of the selector. We show that such a routing-complexity condition cannot be dropped: Lipschitz continuity in the parameters alone does not suffice. For linear softmax gating, the routing cost is of the same order as the gating term. Finally, for linear experts, we establish a matching minimax lower bound of order $Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}/n$, showing that the rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了混合专家模型中的最小二乘估计器的统计误差，建立了具有快速收敛率的Oracle不等式，并分析了稀疏路由机制带来的额外复杂度成本，证明了在线性专家情况下的极小极大下界，表明所得收敛率在对数因子内是最优的。
AI.motivation: 混合专家模型通过输入相关的路由机制组合专用专家，其稀疏变体支撑了许多现代大规模系统，但自适应路由的统计代价仅被部分理解。本文旨在量化当专家和门控网络均关于参数为Lipschitz连续时，最小二乘MoE估计器的估计误差，并区分稠密路由与稀疏路由（Top-k、Top-p）的统计行为差异。
AI.method: 将每个MoE表示为门控-专家对，置于一个门控希尔伯特空间中，其范数将路由差异与专家差异分离。利用经验表示导出Oracle不等式。对于稀疏路由，选择映射在门控参数上不连续，通过根据样本上诱导的选择模式对门控函数类进行划分来处理。引入Natarajan维度来刻画路由选择器的复杂度。
AI.result: 稠密MoE达到阶为Õ((K d_pr,e + d_pr,g)/n)的快速收敛率；稀疏Top-k和Top-p路由的界匹配稠密速率，外加由选择器的Natarajan维度支配的加性路由代价。证明了仅靠参数上的Lipschitz连续性不足以消除路由复杂度条件。对于线性Softmax门控，路由代价与门控项同阶；对于线性专家，建立了阶为K d_pr,e/n的匹配极小极大下界，确立了最优性（在对数因子内）。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统地量化了MoE模型中自适应路由的统计代价，揭示了稀疏路由引入的离散选择复杂度（由Natarajan维度刻画）是额外误差的根本来源。对于线性专家和线性Softmax门控，给出的收敛率在对数因子内是极小极大最优的，为理解大规模稀疏MoE系统的泛化能力提供了理论基础。

title: ANCHOR: Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding
summary: For repository-grounded coding agents, a functionally correct patch is not necessarily an acceptable one: developers also constrain how the task must be carried out-modification scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, and reporting. This capability, which we call engineering constraint following, remains largely invisible to current evaluations. We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark built on naturalistic, multilingual repository tasks spanning eight language groups. ANCHOR combines (i) a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 categories and 78 leaf types distilled from real developer interactions, (ii) an automated pipeline that instantiates task-grounded atomic constraints and composes them into typed AND/THEN/PRIORITY relations, and (iii) a trajectory-grounded evaluation framework that checks both the code diff and the execution trajectory with rule-based and LLM judges. Across 19 agent configurations spanning 2 scaffolds and 10 foundation models on 358 tasks, the strongest measured system, Claude Opus 4.8 under Cline, reaches 70.1% atomic compliance and 63.7% relation compliance, while 19.0% of tasks pass every scored checklist item under the strict all-item FCCR criterion. A five-engineer audit of constraints from 50 instances reports 94% feasibility, 94% repository consistency, and 96% realism. In the primary paired set (14 configurations), the mean signed change in task completion after adding constraints is +0.7 percentage points; individual changes vary in both directions. These results distinguish functional success from constraint compliance, with failures concentrated in workflow ordering, tool-use discipline, and reporting, and substantial interactions between models and scaffolds.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ANCHOR基准，用于评估仓库级编码代理遵循工程约束的能力，区分了功能正确性与约束合规性，发现最强系统Claude Opus 4.8在Cline脚手架下原子合规率70.1%、关系合规率63.7%，失败主要集中在工作流顺序、工具使用纪律和报告方面。
AI.motivation: 当前评估主要关注补丁的功能正确性，但开发者实际工作中还要求遵循修改范围、工作流顺序、验证、工具使用和报告等工程约束，这种'工程约束遵循'能力在现有评估中 largely invisible。
AI.method: 构建ANCHOR基准，包含三大组件：(i) 从真实开发者交互提炼的10大类78个叶子类型的层级分类体系；(ii) 自动化流水线实例化任务级原子约束并组合为AND/THEN/PRIORITY类型关系；(iii) 基于轨迹的评估框架，用规则和LLM法官同时检查代码diff和执行轨迹。在358个任务上测试19种代理配置(2个脚手架×10个基础模型)。
AI.result: 最强系统Claude Opus 4.8(Cline)达到70.1%原子合规、63.7%关系合规，19.0%任务通过严格FCCR全项标准。五工程师审计显示94%可行性、94%仓库一致性、96%真实性。主配对集(14配置)中添加约束后任务完成率均值仅+0.7个百分点，个别方向不一。失败集中在工作流顺序、工具使用纪律、报告；模型与脚手架间存在显著交互效应。
AI.conclusion: 功能成功与约束合规性可分离，工程约束遵循是代理编码的关键维度，当前最强系统仍有显著差距，需针对工作流排序、工具纪律、报告等弱点改进，且模型-脚手架协同设计至关重要。

title: CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning
summary: Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. CondMSP predicts temperature, time, and atmosphere by combining a joint predictor with variable-specific experts, and then uses these predictions both as process context, grounding the generation and retrieval of operation sequences, and as execution requirements, specifying which thermal stages can share a furnace run and at what cost. This specification is held fixed across all compared methods; within it, CondMSP ranks routes across precursor sets by a common utility and, under furnace budgets, jointly selects routes and allocates their thermal stages by constrained optimization. CondMSP improves condition and operation prediction and, under this shared constraint, raises reference-recipe recovery from 27.9% to 32.9% at three simulated furnace runs per target and from 34.7% to 40.0% at 30 trials, while a new evaluation set of 2,344 targets supports generalization beyond oxide-dominated training chemistry.

AI.tldr: CondMSP将材料合成规划从配方预测扩展为执行感知规划，通过联合预测温度、时间、气氛并作为过程上下文与执行需求，结合约束优化联合选择路线与分配热处理阶段，显著提升参考配方恢复率并在新评估集上展现泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有材料合成规划（MSP）方法分别或成对预测前驱体、操作、条件，仅将条件作为预测目标，未探索条件作为过程上下文构建合成路线，也未解决在有限实验资源下应执行哪些候选路线。
AI.method: CondMSP采用联合预测器与变量专家预测温度、时间、气氛；将预测作为过程上下文指导操作序列生成与检索，并作为执行需求指定热处理阶段共炉与成本；在共享约束下，按通用效用对前驱体集合中的路线排序，并在炉子预算下通过约束优化联合选择路线与分配热处理阶段。
AI.result: CondMSP改进了条件与操作预测，在共享约束下将参考配方恢复率从27.9%提升至32.9%（每目标三次模拟炉运行），从34.7%提升至40.0%（30次试验）；新评估集含2,344个目标，支持超越氧化物主导训练化学的泛化。
AI.conclusion: CondMSP通过将合成条件作为过程上下文与执行需求，实现了从配方预测到执行感知规划的转变，在资源受限下联合优化路线选择与热处理调度，显著提升恢复率并展示跨化学体系的泛化潜力。

title: Information-Theoretic Foundations of Online Temperature Sampling
summary: Repetitive, degenerate generation is a persistent failure of LLM decoding, and the standard remedies (temperature, nucleus, and top-$k$ sampling) are static heuristics. By Kac's lemma and the AEP, a stationary source takes time exponential in its entropy to repeat a block. We therefore maximize the entropy of the sampling distributions under one cross-entropy budget that keeps the output plausible under the model. Offline, the solution is temperature sampling, with the inverse temperature as the budget's Lagrange multiplier. \emph{Our contribution is the online problem}: the conditionals $p_1, p_2, \dots$ are revealed one at a time, and the sampling distribution $q_t$ must be chosen causally from $p_1, \dots, p_t$ while the budget couples the entire horizon. The optimal temperature is thus a global shadow price that must be estimated from a prefix. We propose Entropic Online Sampling (EOS), which re-solves for the temperature on each prefix. We prove it loses $O(R\log n)$ entropy against the offline optimum while overshooting the budget by $O(R\log n)$, with $R$ an instance-dependent drift parameter. A budget-tightened variant is exactly feasible at the same rate. Conversely, every exactly feasible online algorithm must lose $Ω(R)$, so EOS is optimal up to a $\log n$ factor. When the conditionals are drawn from a finite mixture, $R=\tilde{O}(\sqrt{n})$. Experiments confirm that EOS tracks the offline temperature and beats fixed-temperature sampling in entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型解码中的重复退化生成问题，提出了一种名为Entropic Online Sampling (EOS)的在线采样方法。该方法在每一步根据已观测的条件分布动态调整温度参数，在保持输出合理性（交叉熵预算）的前提下最大化采样分布的熵。理论上证明EOS在熵损失和预算超支方面均达到O(R log n)，且存在预算紧致变体保证精确可行，在有限混合分布假设下R = Õ(√n)。实验验证EOS能跟踪离线最优温度并优于固定温度采样。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型解码中普遍存在重复、退化生成现象，现有的温度采样、核采样、top-k采样等静态启发式方法无法自适应调整。基于Kac引理和AEP（渐近等分性质），平稳源重复一个块所需时间随熵呈指数增长，因此应在保持输出合理性的交叉熵预算约束下最大化采样分布的熵。离线情况下最优解为温度采样，但在线场景下条件分布逐步揭示，最优温度是全局影子价格，需从前缀估计，这是本文解决的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出Entropic Online Sampling (EOS)：在每个时间步t，根据已观测的条件分布p₁,…,pₜ重新求解温度参数（即拉格朗日乘子），使采样分布qₜ在因果约束下最大化熵且满足全局交叉熵预算。提供预算紧致变体保证精确可行性。算法在线更新温度，无需预知未来条件分布。
AI.result: 理论保证：EOS相对于离线最优解的熵损失为O(R log n)，预算超支为O(R log n)；预算紧致变体实现精确可行且保持同阶速率。下界证明：任意精确可行的在线算法熵损失至少为Ω(R)，故EOS在log n因子内最优。当条件分布来自有限混合分布时，漂移参数R = Õ(√n)。实验显示EOS能跟踪离线最优温度轨迹，并在熵指标上显著优于固定温度采样基线。
AI.conclusion: EOS为LLM解码中的重复退化问题提供了首个具有理论最优性保证的在线自适应温度采样框架。通过动态调整温度作为影子价格，EOS在因果约束下实现了熵最大化与合理性预算的近似最优权衡，填补了离线最优温度采样与在线实际部署之间的理论空白。

title: SpecGuardBench: Can Coding Agents Construct Reliable Validation Harnesses from Natural Language Specifications?
summary: As coding agents become more capable, tests remain the primary evidence for judging whether their code is correct. Yet passing available tests does not establish that an implementation satisfies its natural language specification. Reliable validation requires checks that faithfully capture the specification and scenarios that thoroughly exercise the code, but current benchmarks provide limited insight into whether agents can construct such evidence themselves. We introduce SpecGuardBench, a benchmark of 291 tasks from 13 real-world repositories, covering 8 types of verification logic such as functional postconditions and interaction protocols. Given a natural language specification, repository context, and a reference implementation, an agent constructs a validation harness comprising executable checks and test scenarios. The checks should reject implementations that violate the specification while accepting those that satisfy it, and the scenarios should thoroughly exercise the code. Across four proprietary and open-weight coding agents, none constructs a harness scored as faithful on the benchmark's implementations for more than 63% of the tasks. The bottleneck lies less in exploring test scenarios than in constructing checks that faithfully reflect the specification. Specifically, the agents show a clear tendency to write checks that mirror the reference implementation rather than the specification, and therefore reject implementations that the specification permits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpecGuardBench 基准，评估编码代理根据自然语言规范构建验证 harness（检查+测试场景）的能力。实验显示四个主流代理均无法在超过 63% 任务上生成忠实于规范的 harness，主要瓶颈在于检查往往模仿参考实现而非规范，导致错误拒绝规范允许的实现。
AI.motivation: 测试是判断代码正确性的主要证据，但通过现有测试不等于满足自然语言规范。可靠验证需要既忠实捕捉规范又充分执行代码的检查与场景，现有基准缺乏对代理自主构建此类证据能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建 SpecGuardBench，包含 13 个真实仓库的 291 个任务，覆盖 8 类验证逻辑（如功能后置条件、交互协议）。任务输入：自然语言规范、仓库上下文、参考实现；代理输出：可执行检查与测试场景组成的验证 harness。评估标准：检查应拒绝违反规范的实现、接受满足规范的实现；场景应充分执行代码。
AI.result: 四个专有与开放权重编码代理均无法在超过 63% 任务上生成被判定为忠实的 harness。瓶颈不在于测试场景探索，而在于构建忠实反映规范的检查。代理倾向于编写镜像参考实现而非规范的检查，从而错误拒绝规范允许的实现。
AI.conclusion: 当前编码代理难以基于自然语言规范构建忠实的验证证据，核心问题是过度拟合参考实现而非理解规范本身，需改进代理对规范语义的理解与泛化能力。

title: From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). URSM unifies reasoning construction, correct reasoning preservation, and erroneous reasoning correction as reasoning-state transitions within a shared state space, enabling these heterogeneous reasoning behaviors to be learned jointly. CRSL further incorporates self-generated historical reasoning states during training and recursively updates the current state during inference, thereby mitigating the reasoning-state gap and enabling iterative self-refinement without requiring an additional reflection module, critic, or independent correction stage. Furthermore, we construct VersaCoT-10K, a high-quality CoT dataset spanning eight visual reasoning domains, which provides diverse supervision for multi-domain reasoning and reasoning-state refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReState exhibits strong adaptability across different MLLM backbones and achieves strong performance on multiple public reasoning benchmarks, supporting the shift from stage-centric reasoning toward state-centric reasoning. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/YuChuang1205/ReState

AI.tldr: ReState提出了一种统一的迭代推理框架，将多模态推理从阶段驱动转变为状态驱动，通过统一推理状态建模(URSM)和闭环推理状态学习(CRSL)解决碎片化推理和训练-推理状态差距，并在VersaCoT-10K数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的MCoT方法多采用阶段中心范式，将不同推理行为分配到预定义阶段并分别优化，导致推理碎片化和训练-推理推理状态差距，限制了模型的复杂推理能力。
AI.method: 提出ReState框架，包含两大组件：统一推理状态建模(URSM)将推理构建、正确推理保持、错误推理修正统一为共享状态空间中的状态转移，实现异构推理行为的联合学习；闭环推理状态学习(CRSL)在训练中引入自生成的历史推理状态，在推理时递归更新当前状态，缓解推理状态差距并实现无需额外反思模块的迭代自我修正。同时构建VersaCoT-10K数据集，覆盖八大视觉推理领域，提供多域推理和推理状态修正的多样化监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ReState在不同MLLM骨干网络上表现出强适应性，在多个公开推理基准上取得优异性能，支持从阶段中心推理向状态中心推理的转变。
AI.conclusion: ReState通过状态驱动的动态推理过程统一了多模态推理的各类行为，有效解决了阶段中心范式的碎片化和状态差距问题，为多模态大语言模型的复杂推理提供了新范式。

title: The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature
summary: Larger sample budgets benefit from higher sampling temperatures in LLMs, but what temperature tuning optimizes and why it works remain poorly understood. We seek to answer these questions: we pose decoding as pass@$k$ maximization subject to two constraints that encode critical decoding failure modes: an entropy floor preventing diversity collapse, and a cross-entropy ceiling preventing implausibility. We prove that this maximization takes the form of a single closed-form conditional sampling rule, the \emph{tilted temperature} $q^\star \propto \bigl(p e^{ηV}\bigr)^{1/T}$. Here, the tilt comes from a verifier potential $V$ that quantifies how likely a partial generation is to eventually pass. Ordinary temperature sampling, verifier-greedy decoding, and reward-tilted policies represent special cases. We further show that, under a natural rule for scaling the diversity budget with sample size $k$, the resulting optimal temperature increases with $k$, turning empirical choice into a theorem. The optimum still needs the unknown verifier potential, which we estimate using two design approaches. In the online setting, our J-EOS algorithm jointly tracks the two constraint multipliers and learns the verifier potential from binary pass/ fail feedback alone. In the offline setting, we show that when the model is calibrated, its log-probability tracks correctness up to an affine map. Under this condition, the tilt collapses into the exponent and the optimum reduces to ordinary temperature sampling. Calibrated Temperature Decoding (CTD) then fits one scalar offline and samples with zero additional inference-time overhead relative to temperature sampling. Building on these decision rules, we design a practical decoding algorithm for code generation and evaluate it alongside CTD on benchmarks including HumanEval and MBPP, showing improvements over standard and adaptive decoding baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文将解码建模为在熵下界（防止多样性崩塌）和交叉熵上界（防止不合理性）约束下的 pass@k 最大化问题，推导出闭式的“倾斜温度”采样规则 q* ∝ (p e^{ηV})^{1/T}，并证明在自然的多样性预算缩放规则下最优温度随样本数 k 单调增加。提出在线 J-EOS 算法从二元通过/失败反馈联合学习约束乘子与验证器势能，以及离线 Calibrated Temperature Decoding (CTD) 利用模型校准后的 log-prob 作为验证器势能，将最优规则简化为普通温度采样。在 HumanEval 和 MBPP 代码生成基准上优于标准与自适应解码基线。
AI.motivation: 大样本预算下较高采样温度有益，但温度调优的最优性原理与机制缺乏理论理解。现有方法（普通温度采样、验证器贪心解码、奖励倾斜策略）均为特例，缺乏统一框架且难以针对 pass@k 目标进行原则性优化。
AI.method: 1. 将解码形式化为受熵下界和交叉熵上界约束的 pass@k 最大化，推导出单一闭式条件采样规则——倾斜温度 q* ∝ (p e^{ηV})^{1/T}，其中 V 为验证器势能。2. 证明在多样性预算随 k 自然缩放时，最优温度随 k 增大。3. 提出两种估计未知验证器势能的方法：在线设计 J-EOS 从二元反馈联合学习约束乘子与 V；离线设计 CTD 利用校准模型的 log-prob 作为 V 的仿射映射，使倾斜项坍缩到指数中，退化为普通温度采样。4. 基于决策规则设计实用代码生成解码算法。
AI.result: 在 HumanEval 和 MBPP 基准上，提出的解码算法与 CTD 均显著优于标准温度采样及自适应解码基线。CTD 仅需离线拟合一个标量，推理时零额外开销即可获得性能提升。实验验证了最优温度随样本数 k 增加的理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文为 LLM 温度调优提供了首个统一的理论框架，将 pass@k 最大化、多样性约束与验证器势能统一于倾斜温度采样规则中。证明了最优温度随样本预算单调增加，并给出了在线（J-EOS）与离线（CTD）两种实用的势能估计方案，在代码生成任务上取得了 SOTA 级别的改进。

title: Estimating Uncertainty of Omnimodal Large Language Models via External Omnimodal Embeddings
summary: Recent work has investigated Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs), models which can take multiple modalities and their combinations as input, as a way forward to have systems really capable of interacting with their environment. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for OLLMs, however, remains an open problem: existing methods largely target at most two modalities at a time, require access to model internals, or re-invocation of the evaluated model. We propose a model-agnostic UQ framework that scores a Chain-of-Thought response entirely through external omni-modal embeddings, measuring the grounding of the reasoning in the multimodal input and its internal coherence. Our contribution is the family of signals and an empirical characterisation of when it is reliable, rather than any single estimator: we find the geometric scores to be largely redundant with one another (mean within-split rank correlation 0.91-0.94) but strongly complementary to answer-dispersion baselines, and their reliability to depend on the generator and the modality. The resulting confidence estimates require no access to logits, hidden states or gradients of the evaluated model and no additional inference from it; they do require segmenting the reasoning trace with an auxiliary model and, for the aggregated score, a labelled calibration set that we show can be as small as 25 examples (although we also show that such a set buys little over fixing one signal a priori). On UNO-Bench, with both a closed and an open model, our scores yield small gains over self-consistency (systematic with the closed generator, mixed with the open one) and are competitive with self-verbalisation and internal-state baselines, especially in open-ended, omni-modal questions where previous state-of-the-art baselines struggle.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种面向全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）的、与模型无关的不确定性量化（UQ）框架，利用外部全模态嵌入对思维链响应进行评分，测量推理对多模态输入的 grounding 程度及内部连贯性。实验表明几何得分彼此高度冗余，但与答案离散基线强互补；该方法无需访问模型内部状态、logits 或梯度，仅需辅助模型分段推理轨迹，并在 UNO-Bench 上优于 self-consistency 且与 self-verbalisation 等内部状态基线竞争，尤其在开放式全模态问题上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的 OLLMs 不确定性量化方法大多仅针对最多两种模态、需要访问模型内部或重复调用被评估模型，缺乏通用的、模型无关的全模态 UQ 方案。
AI.method: 提出一族基于外部全模态嵌入的几何信号，对思维链响应进行评分，衡量推理对多模态输入的 grounding 程度及内部连贯性；使用辅助模型分段推理轨迹，聚合得分时需少量标注校准集（最少 25 例）。该框架完全不依赖被评估模型的 logits、隐藏状态、梯度或额外推理。
AI.result: 几何得分之间高度冗余（组内秩相关 0.91-0.94），但与答案离散基线强互补；可靠性取决于生成器和模态。在 UNO-Bench 上，闭源模型系统性超越 self-consistency，开源模型表现混合；整体与 self-verbalisation 及内部状态基线竞争，尤其在开放式全模态问题上优于先前 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 该模型无关 UQ 框架通过外部嵌入实现了高效、无需内部访问的全模态不确定性估计，提供了一族可靠的信号而非单一估计器，为 OLLMs 的可信部署提供了实用方案。

title: Big-Big-SycoBench: A Benchmark to Detect Sycophancy Through Model Responses to Valid vs. Invalid Arguments
summary: Sycophancy in large language models risks amplifying unsupported claims or beliefs across the knowledge ecosystem as these systems increasingly contribute to research synthesis, evaluation, and decision-making. A reliable model should revise its judgement when a user identifies a genuine flaw, but should resist pushback based on fallacies, emotion, or irrelevant appeals to authority. While sycophancy is usually measured on questions with a verifiable answer, the evaluative tasks in which it is most difficult to detect have no such ground truth. We introduce Big-Big-SycoBench, which measures sycophancy through argument discernment: the ability to revise an evaluation after valid criticism while resisting invalid pressure. The benchmark consists of 450 text artefacts with 5,400 arguments for raising or lowering their quality scores, each reviewed by one or more of twelve human annotators. An LLM scores each artefact twenty times to establish its baseline score and uncertainty. The model is then given a valid or invalid argument and asked to update its score. We only count a revision if it exceeds the model's own baseline variability. We use the resulting score delta to distinguish responsiveness to valid arguments from compliance with invalid ones. Across ten models, responsiveness is 88-95\% for seven, 76-77\% for Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3, and 32\% for Opus 5.5. Compliance ranges from 0.2\% for GPT-6 Astra to 95\% for GPT-4o. Big-Big-SycoBench is intended to guide the development of models whose judgements can be corrected by sound arguments, but not displaced by unsupported pressure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Big-Big-SycoBench 基准，通过论辨辨别能力评估大语言模型的谄媚行为：模型应因有效批评修正判断，却能抵抗无效施压。基准包含 450 个文本制品、5400 个论点，经 12 位标注员审核。实验显多数模型对有效论点响应率 88-95%，但对无效论点的顺从率差异巨大（0.2%-95%），揭示现有模型在判断坚守性上的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在研究综合、评估和决策中扮演越来越重要的角色，其谄媚倾向可能放大无根据的观点。现有谄媚测试多依赖有标准答案的问题，难以评估无地面真值的评价任务。需要一种能区分『对合理批评的修正』与『对不合理施压的顺从』的评测方法，推动模型在合理论证下可纠错、在无理施压下坚守判断。
AI.method: 构建 Big-Big-SycoBench：收集 450 个文本制品，配备 5400 个提升或降低质量分的论点，经 12 位人工标注员验证有效性。让模型对每个制品打分 20 次建立基线分数与不确定性区间。随后输入有效或无效论点要求模型更新分数。仅当分数变化超出基线变异性时计为修正。以分数增量区分对有效论点的响应率与对无效论点的顺从率。
AI.result: 测试 10 个模型：7 个模型对有效论点响应率 88-95%，Kimi K3 与 GLM-5.3 为 76-77%，Opus 5.5 仅 32%。对无效论点的顺从率跨度极大：GPT-6 Astra 仅 0.2%，GPT-4o 高达 95%。显示模型在论辨辨别能力上存在显著差异，部分模型极易被无理施压动摇判断。
AI.conclusion: Big-Big-SycoBench 为评估模型判断的可纠错性与抗干扰性提供了细粒度基准。结果表明当前模型在抵抗无效施压方面表现参差不齐，亟需改进训练目标与对齐策略，使模型能在合理论证下修正错误、在无理压力下坚守正确判断，从而成为可靠的研究评估与决策辅助工具。

title: Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical World AI (PhysWorldAI). 15 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
summary: Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics. We present a proof of concept toward a multimodal foundation model for plasma state reconstruction during magnetic reconnection, motivated by the Facility for Laboratory Reconnection Experiments (FLARE). Using 250 synthetic VPIC simulations at fixed reference electron beta $β_{e0}=0.2$, with 225 training runs and 25 disjoint validation runs, we train a 5.5M-parameter residual 3D U-Net to reconstruct three magnetic-field components and electron density from incomplete observations. The model combines spatial-only pooling, which preserves all 24 temporal frames, with global spatiotemporal self-attention and rotary positional encoding. Independently masking magnetic and density modalities across random, grid, block, and temporal patterns enables sparse sensing, cross-modal completion, density super-resolution, and temporal completion with a single set of weights and no task-specific retraining. With density fully hidden, just 0.1% magnetic spatial visibility reduces median density NRMSE from approximately 0.9 to 0.1. Conversely, observed density improves current-density reconstruction when magnetic data are absent or extremely sparse. With no magnetic observations, roughly 1% density visibility approaches the density reconstruction accuracy achieved with fully observed magnetic fields, although current structure remains more dependent on direct magnetic measurements. Full magnetic conditioning also stabilizes completion of missing future density frames. These results demonstrate bidirectional cross-modal predictive coupling within this simulation regime. Generalization across plasma regimes or to experimental measurements remains untested.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于磁重联等离子体状态重建的多模态基础模型概念验证，利用合成 VPIC 仿真训练 5.5M 参数的残差 3D U-Net，结合空间池化、全局时空自注意力和旋转位置编码，实现从稀疏、不完整的磁场和密度观测中重建三维磁场分量和电子密度，展示了双向跨模态预测耦合能力。
AI.motivation: 等离子体实验诊断手段稀疏、异构且不完整，难以直接观测耦合物理状态；受 FLARE 实验装置驱动，需要一种多模态基础模型来从不完整观测中重建磁重联过程中的等离子体状态。
AI.method: 使用 250 个固定参考电子贝塔 (βₑ₀=0.2) 的合成 VPIC 仿真（225 训练，25 验证），训练一个 5.5M 参数的残差 3D U-Net。模型采用仅空间池化保留全部 24 个时间帧，结合全局时空自注意力机制和旋转位置编码。通过对磁场和密度模态独立施加随机、网格、块和时间等多种掩码模式，实现稀疏感知、跨模态补全、密度超分辨率和时间补全，无需针对特定任务微调。
AI.result: 当密度完全隐藏时，仅 0.1% 的磁场空间可见度即可将密度中位数 NRMSE 从约 0.9 降至 0.1；反之，观测到的密度在磁场数据缺失或极度稀疏时能改善电流密度重建。无磁场观测时，约 1% 的密度可见度即可达到全磁场观测下的密度重建精度，但电流结构仍更依赖直接磁场测量。完整的磁场条件还能稳定缺失未来密度帧的补全。结果证明了在该仿真机制下存在双向跨模态预测耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证展示了多模态基础模型在磁重联等离子体状态重建中的潜力，实现了稀疏观测下的跨模态补全和时空重建。但模型在不同等离子体参数机制下的泛化能力及对实验测量的适用性尚未测试，后续工作需扩展到更广泛的仿真参数空间并验证实验数据迁移。

title: Lexical Redefinition Reveals Context-Sensitive Instruction Following
comment: Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Language Understanding in the Human-Machine Era (LUHME 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: How do language models reconcile conflicting contextual evidence within a prompt? We study this question using lexical redefinition, where an explicit instruction specifies how a word should be interpreted and a subsequent sentence provides additional evidence through its usage. Across 870 word pairs, we find that lexical redefinitions are not applied as fixed rules. Instead, the behaviour depends systematically on the relationship between the explicit instruction and the intervening sentence: the contextualised usage can preserve, weaken, or completely reverse the instruction. These results suggest that the interpretation of an explicit instruction remains sensitive to subsequent contextual evidence. Lexical redefinition therefore provides a controlled behavioural paradigm for studying how language models integrate multiple sources of information within a prompt.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型如何协调提示词中冲突的上下文证据，通过词汇重定义实验发现，显式指令的解释会受后续上下文影响，可被保留、削弱或逆转，为研究模型整合多源信息提供了受控范式。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在提示词中面对显式指令与后续上下文用法冲突时，如何整合并协调多源信息。
AI.method: 采用词汇重定义范式，构建870个词对，包含显式指定词义的指令句及后续提供用法证据的语句，系统分析模型对词义的最终解释如何随指令与上下文关系变化。
AI.result: 词汇重定义非固定规则，模型行为系统性依赖指令与上下文关系：上下文用法可保留、削弱或完全逆转指令，显式指令的解释对后续上下文证据保持敏感。
AI.conclusion: 词汇重定义提供了一个受控的行为范式，可用于研究语言模型如何在提示词内整合多源信息，揭示模型对显式指令的解释具有动态上下文敏感性。

title: Recall What Is Missing: Composing Evidence from Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Under a limited context budget, a long-term agent must recall not merely memories that are individually relevant, but evidence that is collectively sufficient for the current query. Conventional memory access retrieves, scores, and truncates memories, often spending multiple context slots on redundant facts while leaving complementary evidence behind. We cast the read phase of long-term memory as query-conditioned evidence composition: each memory is valued by what it adds beyond the evidence already selected. We instantiate this operation with MemPursuit, a training-free mechanism that uses the residual of a sparse convex query reconstruction as a representation-space proxy for what the current memory set is missing. By reusing the query and candidate embeddings already available from retrieval, MemPursuit progressively composes nested evidence contexts without invoking a language model or cross-encoder to score each query--memory pair. The effectiveness of our method is verified on 3 popular benchmarks in comparison to strong baselines. In fixed-budget LoCoMo experiments, MemPursuit improves end-to-end accuracy by 7.2 percentage points at Top-10 and 5.5 percentage points at Top-20, with consistent gains across multiple memory frameworks, while achieving a 32.9$\times$ speedup in median reranking latency over fully batched BGE-v2-m3. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/FengQi-HITSZ/MemPursuit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MemPursuit，一种无需训练的长期记忆读取机制，将记忆检索建模为查询条件下的证据组合问题，通过稀疏凸查询重构的残差作为表示空间代理，在固定预算下渐进式选择互补证据，显著提升准确率并实现 32.9 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 在有限上下文预算下，长期记忆代理需要回忆的不仅是单独相关的记忆，而是对当前查询集体充分的证据。传统记忆访问采用检索-评分-截断流程，往往在冗余事实上浪费多个上下文槽位，而遗漏互补证据。
AI.method: 将长期记忆的读取阶段形式化为查询条件证据组合：根据每条记忆在已选证据之上新增的边际价值进行评估。提出 MemPursuit，利用稀疏凸查询重构的残差作为当前记忆集合缺失信息的表示空间代理。复用检索阶段已获得的查询与候选嵌入，无需调用语言模型或交叉编码器即可渐进式构建嵌套证据上下文。
AI.result: 在 3 个主流基准上验证有效性。在固定预算 LoCoMo 实验中，Top-10 端到端准确率提升 7.2 个百分点，Top-20 提升 5.5 个百分点，多个记忆框架均有稳定增益；中位数重排延迟比完全批处理的 BGE-v2-m3 加速 32.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: MemPursuit 通过查询条件证据组合范式，解决了固定预算下冗余与互补性的权衡，以免训练、极低延迟的方式显著提升长期记忆代理的检索质量与推理效率，具有广泛的实用价值。

title: On the Theoretical Limits of Learning Unconstrained Interatomic Potentials
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) accelerate molecular dynamics (MD) simulations by learning the energies and forces that govern atomic motion. Recent work has shown that relaxing physical inductive biases can improve computational efficiency and predictive accuracy, raising the question of whether energy-and-force matching alone is sufficient to ensure accurate sampling. We show that, for unconstrained hypothesis classes, the relationship between prediction error and sampling accuracy is exponentially ill-conditioned in dimension. In particular, prediction errors that decay exponentially with dimension can coexist with nearly maximal total variation distance between the learned and target distributions. We identify two failure mechanisms. The first is kinetic trapping, where relaxation to an accurate learned equilibrium requires exponentially long times, even when simulations are initialized from training configurations at which energies and forces are matched exactly. The second is equilibrium mismatch, where the learned stationary distribution itself remains far from the target. Under explicit assumptions, we show that equilibrium mismatch can persist even in local, symmetry-preserving models, where small per-atom errors coexist with a distributional discrepancy that approaches its maximum as system size increases. Finally, we establish global energy-control conditions that guarantee equilibrium accuracy and identify additional conditions required for rapid relaxation.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）在分子动力学模拟中，预测误差与采样准确性之间存在指数级不良条件关系，指出了动力学捕获和平衡态错配两种失效机制，并给出了保证平衡态准确性的全局能量控制条件。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明放宽物理归纳偏置可提升计算效率和预测精度，但尚不清楚仅通过能量和力匹配是否足以保证准确的采样。本文旨在探讨无约束假设类中预测误差与采样准确性的关系，识别导致采样失效的根本机制。
AI.method: 从理论角度分析无约束假设类中预测误差与采样分布总变差距离的关系；识别动力学捕获（指数级弛豫时间）和平衡态错配（平稳分布偏离）两种失效机制；在显式假设下证明局部对称性保持模型中也存在平衡态错配；建立全局能量控制条件以保证平衡态准确性，并给出快速弛豫的额外条件。
AI.result: 1. 预测误差随维度指数衰减时，学习分布与目标分布的总变差距离仍可接近最大值。2. 动力学捕获：即使从训练构型初始化（能量力完全匹配），弛豫至准确平衡态仍需指数级长时间。3. 平衡态错配：学习平稳分布本身远离目标，且在局部对称模型中，单原子微小误差随系统规模增大导致分布差异趋近最大。4. 提出全局能量控制条件保证平衡态准确，并指出实现快速弛豫需额外条件。
AI.conclusion: 仅匹配能量和力不足以保证MLIPs的准确采样，必须施加全局能量控制条件以确保平衡态准确性，并需额外条件保证快速弛豫。这为开发可靠的机器学习势能函数提供了理论指导。

title: SarcasTraps: Effect of Sarcasm on Turkish Hate Speech Detection
summary: Standard hate speech detection datasets often emphasize explicit harmful language, but directed harm can also be expressed indirectly, without clearly hateful wording. Sarcasm is one such form of indirect expression, as it can convey harmful intent through mock praise, exaggeration, humor, or apparent politeness. In this paper, we introduce SarcasTraps, a targeted external test set for analyzing the effect of sarcasm on Turkish hate speech detection. SarcasTraps contains 479 entries annotated along two dimensions: hate speech and sarcasm. We train classifiers using BERTurk and XLM-RoBERTa on two existing Turkish hate speech datasets and evaluate them on SarcasTraps, using it strictly as an external test set. We also evaluate GPT-4.1 and Llama-3.3-70B in a zero-shot setting on SarcasTraps. Results show that sarcasm substantially affects hate speech detection. Fine-tuned encoder models lose recall on sarcastic hate, while zero-shot LLMs maintain higher recall but suffer substantial precision drops on sarcastic examples. These findings show that both fine-tuned hate speech detectors and zero-shot LLMs struggle when sarcasm is involved, and SarcasTraps provides quantitative evidence of this challenge through a targeted Turkish test set. Due to the presence of sensitive and hateful language, SarcasTraps will be shared upon request for academic research purposes. Warning: This paper has examples from the dataset which contains offensive and hateful content towards groups of people.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了 SarcasTraps，一个针对土耳其语仇恨言论检测中讽刺影响的专用外部测试集，包含 479 条双维度标注（仇恨言论与讽刺）样本。实验表明，微调编码器模型在讽刺性仇恨上召回率下降，零样本大模型虽保持较高召回但精度大幅下降，两类模型在讽刺场景下均表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有仇恨言论检测数据集多聚焦显性有害语言，但讽刺等间接表达也能传达有害意图。论文旨在量化评估讽刺对土耳其语仇恨言论检测的影响，填补针对性测试集的空白。
AI.method: 构建 SarcasTraps 测试集（479 条样本，双维度标注）；在两个现有土耳其语仇恨言论数据集上分别微调 BERTurk 与 XLM-RoBERTa，并以 SarcasTraps 为外部测试集评估；同时对 GPT-4.1 与 Llama-3.3-70B 进行零样本评测。
AI.result: 讽刺显著降低检测性能：微调编码器模型在讽刺性仇恨样本上召回率下降；零样本大模型虽召回率较高，但在讽刺样本上精度大幅下降。两类模型在讽刺场景下均面临困难。
AI.conclusion: SarcasTraps 通过针对性的土耳其语测试集，为讽刺对仇恨言论检测的挑战提供了定量证据，揭示了当前微调模型与零样本大模型在处理讽刺性仇恨时的系统性缺陷。

title: Knowledge Interaction in Hypernetwork-based Continual Learning: Conflict and Composition
summary: Continual learning aims to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to evolving data while preserving their pretrained capabilities. A central challenge is catastrophic forgetting: adaptation to new data can impair performance on previously learned knowledge. Since continual learning commonly changes model parameters, the model's predictions may draw on knowledge from the base model, the parameter update, and the input context. Understanding how these sources interact is essential: conflicts reveal whether new knowledge can override outdated knowledge, while multi-hop reasoning tests whether new knowledge can be composed with existing knowledge to support generalization. We study these interactions in a hypernetwork-based adaptation framework, where a shared network generates adapters from context, allowing a frozen base model to adapt without task-specific updates. We find that, under knowledge conflict, models preferentially follow the context, and their choices depend more on where knowledge is presented than on its content. We also show that context and adapter knowledge perturb the base model's representations along directions orthogonal to its clean hidden states, enabling us to derive steering vectors that control which source the model follows. In multi-hop reasoning, we find that models fail to reliably compose knowledge across the three sources, with the key breakdown arising from the interaction of the hypernetwork with both the base model and the context. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/missswiftie/Knowledge-Interaction-in-CL

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续学习中大语言模型（LLM）的知识交互机制，采用超网络生成适配器的方法冻结基础模型参数。实验发现：知识冲突时模型倾向遵循上下文，选择更依赖知识呈现位置而非内容；上下文和适配器知识沿正交方向扰动基础模型表示，可据此导出控制向量；多跳推理中模型难以可靠组合三源知识，核心瓶颈在于超网络与基础模型及上下文的交互。
AI.motivation: 持续学习旨在让预训练LLM适应不断变化的数据同时保留原有能力，核心挑战是灾难性遗忘。由于持续学习通常修改模型参数，预测可能源于基础模型、参数更新和输入上下文三个知识源。理解这些源如何交互至关重要：冲突揭示新知识能否覆盖旧知识，多跳推理测试新旧知识能否组合泛化。
AI.method: 采用基于超网络的适配框架：共享超网络从上下文生成适配器，使冻结的基础模型无需任务特定更新即可适应。研究三个知识源（基础模型、适配器参数、输入上下文）在知识冲突和多跳推理任务中的交互行为，并分析表示空间中的扰动方向以导出控制向量。
AI.result: 1. 知识冲突时模型优先遵循上下文，决策更依赖知识呈现位置而非内容本身。2. 上下文和适配器知识沿基础模型干净隐藏状态的正交方向扰动表示，可据此导出控制向量引导模型遵循特定知识源。3. 多跳推理中模型难以可靠组合三源知识，主要失效源于超网络与基础模型及上下文的交互。
AI.conclusion: 超网络适配框架虽能冻结基础模型实现持续学习，但知识源间的交互存在系统性偏差：位置偏好主导冲突决策，正交扰动机制可被利用进行控制，而多跳推理的组合泛化能力受限于超网络与基础模型/上下文的耦合方式。这揭示了当前参数高效持续学习方法在知识整合层面的根本局限。

title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
summary: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text.
