This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SwaT（Swarm Telepathy），首个跨家族KV-cache传输方法，实现了多家族多智能体系统中免预填充的智能体间通信。结合KV-cache压缩技术，SwaT在准确性和速度上均显著优于传统文本通信，且能跨模态传输视觉能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统通过文本通信，受限于离散token且计算冗余，限制了带宽和能力。现有KV-cache传输方法要么要求同家族模型，要么无法跨上下文工作（需要接收端预填充文本），亟需一种跨家族、免预填充的通信机制。
AI.method: SwaT训练一个轻量级适配器，将发送端LLM的KV-cache映射到接收端LLM的嵌入空间，实现跨家族KV-cache直接传输。发送端和接收端模型均冻结不微调，仅需<50M tokens和<1 GPU-day训练。结合KV-cache压缩技术进一步提升效率。
AI.result: 在17个基准测试、12个LLM、6个模型家族上实验：结合KV-cache压缩后，准确率平均提升40%，墙钟时间加速4倍。SwaT能将VLM的视觉能力传输给纯文本LLM，且仅在文本数据上训练即可超越文本通信性能。
AI.conclusion: SwaT作为首个跨家族免预填充KV-cache传输方法，以极低训练成本实现了高效、高精度的多智能体通信，并展示了跨模态能力迁移潜力，为多智能体系统通信范式提供了新方向。

title: Event Memory and Narrative Dynamics: A Large Language Model Framework for Multidimensional State Spaces
comment: 60 pages, including supplementary materials. Code and data: https://github.com/joshua-sarinana/narrative-state-spaces
summary: Studying event memory requires defining events and their relationships within remembered experience. Autobiographical narratives provide evidence of this organization, but their analytical units must first be established. This study introduces a large language model framework for constructing event representations from narratives and modeling their structure and dynamics with excerpt-level traceability. Explicit boundary rules and a feature schema informed by hippocampal models of episodic memory and navigation guide event construction. In a proof-of-concept application to interviews from five participants, the framework constructed 256 event-states. Multiple correspondence analysis embedded these states in feature-based spaces, with analyses focused on a selected 4-D geometry and 10-D and 13-D reference geometries. Consecutive event-states were significantly closer than expected under randomized narrative order. In the selected 4-D ten-basin solution, similarity between basin-state feature profiles corresponded with similarity between one-step routing profiles; context, mechanism, and theme differentiated full-system pathway engagement. A successor representation modeled expected basin-state occupancy across successive steps. Correlations between basin-centroid distances and complete successor-profile distances were positive across all five basin solutions, with exploratory tests supporting correspondence in at least two solutions across all three geometries. These findings connect feature-based event representations with observed narrative transitions and modeled multistep organization. The framework translates hippocampal principles into source-linked event boundaries and state representations, providing an analytical basis for testing neural accounts of event segmentation and predictive organization during naturalistic recall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型的框架，从自传体叙事中构建事件表征，并利用海马体情景记忆与导航模型启发的边界规则与特征模式，对事件状态进行建模与动态分析，验证了连续事件状态在特征空间中的邻近性，以及后继表征对多步骤组织的预测能力，为自然回忆中的事件分段与预测性组织的神经机制提供了可追溯的分析基础。
AI.motivation: 研究事件记忆需要定义记忆体验中的事件及其关系。自传体叙事提供了这种组织的证据，但首先必须建立其分析单元。现有方法缺乏将海马体原理转化为可追溯的事件边界与状态表征的系统框架。
AI.method: 引入大语言模型框架，结合显性边界规则和基于海马体情景记忆与导航模型的特征模式，从访谈叙事中构建事件表征并建模其结构与动态。对五名参与者的访谈构建了256个事件状态，采用多重对应分析将其嵌入特征空间，重点分析选定的4维几何及10维和13维参考几何。使用后继表征模拟跨步骤的盆地状态占用期望。
AI.result: 连续事件状态在特征空间中显著比随机叙事顺序更接近。在选定的4维十盆地解中，盆地状态特征剖面的相似性与单步路由剖面的相似性对应；情境、机制与主题区分了全系统路径参与度。后继表征建模的跨步骤预期占用与盆地质心距离在所有五个盆地解中均呈正相关，探索性检验支持在所有三种几何中至少两个解存在对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 研究将基于特征的事件表征与观察到的叙事转换及建模的多步骤组织联系起来。该框架将海马体原理转化为可追溯的事件边界与状态表征，为检验自然回忆中的事件分段与预测性组织的神经解释提供了分析基础。

title: Radioactive Feedback: Tracing Models Trained by Label-Only LLM Supervision
summary: Conventional distillation transfers capability through teacher-generated demonstrations. LLM-as-a-Judge knowledge distillation offers a distinct and increasingly practical alternative. In the label-only variant studied here, the student generates every response and improves from scalar scores alone. Prior work shows that this non-demonstrative feedback can improve student capability, but it creates a fundamentally different provenance problem. No teacher-generated answer enters the student's training set, so any evaluator-specific trace must pass through a low-bandwidth reward signal rather than copied text. Existing watermarks and distillation detectors do not cover this score-only channel. We introduce Radioactive Feedback, which encodes a registered pattern of behavioral preferences in the rewards themselves. The evaluator applies bounded pointwise adjustments to quality-qualified responses, allowing repeated optimization to transfer the pattern to a student trained by another party. Experiments on code and mathematics show that the registered preferences transfer through scores alone and across datasets, enabling black-box detection against a fixed reference pool.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Radioactive Feedback（放射性反馈）方法，在仅使用标量奖励分数的LLM-as-a-Judge知识蒸馏场景中，通过在奖励信号中编码注册的行为偏好模式，实现跨数据集的黑盒蒸馏检测。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-as-a-Judge标签蒸馏仅使用标量分数而非教师生成的演示，创造了新的溯源问题：评估器特有的痕迹必须通过低带宽奖励信号传递，而非复制文本。现有水印和蒸馏检测器无法覆盖这种仅分数的通道。
AI.method: Radioactive Feedback在奖励本身中编码注册的行为偏好模式。评估器对合格质量的响应应用有界逐点调整，允许重复优化将模式转移给由另一方训练的学生模型。
AI.result: 在代码和数学任务上的实验表明，注册的偏好通过分数单独传递并跨数据集泛化，能够针对固定参考池实现黑盒检测。
AI.conclusion: Radioactive Feedback解决了仅分数蒸馏场景下的溯源与检测难题，为LLM-as-a-Judge知识蒸馏提供了可追踪的版权保护和滥用检测机制。

title: Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer new opportunities for controllable text generation. However, their controllability, defined as the ability to satisfy task constraints while preserving their original capabilities, remains underexplored. DLMs' bidirectional attention allows control tokens to guide generation from arbitrary positions in the output sequence, but effective guidance depends on the compatibility between their content and placement. To this end, we propose AnchorDLM, a framework in which an anchor generator produces an anchor consisting of a short output fragment and its position for each query. The anchor is placed as control tokens at the specified position to initialize the output sequence of a frozen DLM and guide subsequent denoising. We train the anchor generator with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly optimize anchor content and placement, using rewards computed from the DLM's generated outputs based on answer correctness and constraint satisfaction. Moreover, through the lens of discrete flow matching (DFM), we interpret anchor placement as helping to reshape the initial velocity field that guides generation. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning across five DLM backbones show that AnchorDLM improves controllability and further yields gains in reasoning performance across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnchorDLM框架，通过锚点生成器产生短文本片段及其位置作为控制令牌，初始化冻结的扩散语言模型（DLM）输出序列并引导去噪过程，利用强化学习联合优化锚点内容与位置，提升DLM的可控性与推理能力。
AI.motivation: DLM的双向注意力允许控制令牌从输出序列任意位置引导生成，但有效引导取决于控制令牌内容与位置的兼容性，现有可控性研究不足，需探索如何联合优化控制内容与位置以增强任务约束满足能力。
AI.method: 设计AnchorDLM：锚点生成器为每个查询生成锚点（短输出片段+位置），将其作为控制令牌放置在指定位置初始化冻结DLM的输出序列，指导后续去噪；采用强化学习训练锚点生成器，奖励基于DLM生成输出的答案正确性与约束满足度；从离散流匹配（DFM）视角解释锚点放置重塑初始速度场以引导生成。
AI.result: 在代码生成与数学推理任务上，跨五种DLM主干模型实验表明，AnchorDLM显著提升可控性，并带来推理性能的普遍增益。
AI.conclusion: AnchorDLM通过联合优化锚点内容与位置，有效利用DLM的双向注意力机制，实现了更强的可控文本生成，同时提升了下游推理任务表现，为扩散语言模型的可控生成提供了新范式。

title: Predicting Mental Health Help-Seeking Behaviour on Reddit: A Survival Analysis of Linguistic and Behavioural Signals
summary: Most prior work on predicting mental health help-seeking treats it as post-hoc classification of users already active in clinical communities, which cannot tell whether someone approaching a transition can be identified in advance. We instead frame help-seeking as a time-to-event problem and ask which Reddit users will eventually seek mental health support, and how imminent that transition is. We build a two-arm cohort: a control frame of 6,337 ordinary users with genuine right-censoring (12.1% transition rate) to answer who will transition, and a clinical frame of 5,023 eventual transitioners to answer how soon. Features come only from posts written before any clinical activity, and user-grouped five-fold cross-validation plus a four-year temporal holdout guard against leakage. We compare TF-IDF, MentalBERT embeddings and behavioural activity features using Cox proportional hazards models, Random Survival Forests and an LSTM sequential model. Behavioural features alone outperform text for predicting who will seek help (C-index 0.797 vs. 0.763), and combining both is best (0.823 under cross-validation, 0.856 on the holdout). The pattern reverses for predicting how soon a known transition will happen: text remains a stable predictor (C-index 0.698) while behavioural features become unstable. Structural engagement patterns therefore carry information about future help-seeking beyond linguistic content, and separating who from when yields a cleaner analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文将心理健康求助预测建模为时间到事件问题，构建双臂队列（对照组6,337名普通用户、临床组5,023名最终求助者），仅使用求助前发帖特征，对比文本（TF-IDF、MentalBERT）与行为特征在Cox比例风险模型、随机生存森林、LSTM中的表现。行为特征单独预测谁会求助优于文本（C-index 0.797 vs 0.763），融合最佳（0.823 CV，0.856保留集）；但预测求助时间迫近度时，文本稳定（0.698）而行为特征不稳定。结构化参与模式包含超越语言内容的预测信息，将‘谁’与‘何时’解耦可得更清晰分析。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将求助预测视为对已活跃于临床社区用户的事后分类，无法提前识别即将发生转变的个体。作者旨在解决‘谁会求助’与‘求助何时发生’两个不同问题，并利用真实右删失数据与时间保留集避免数据泄露，探究行为模式与语言内容的互补预测价值。
AI.method: 构建双臂队列：对照帧（6,337普通用户，12.1%转化率，含真实右删失）回答‘谁会求助’；临床帧（5,023最终求助者）回答‘求助多快’。特征仅取自首次临床活动前的发帖，包括TF-IDF、MentalBERT嵌入、行为活动指标。采用用户分组五折交叉验证加四年时间保留集防泄露。对比Cox比例风险模型、随机生存森林、LSTM序列模型。
AI.result: 预测谁会求助：行为特征单独C-index 0.797优于文本0.763，融合达0.823（CV）与0.856（保留集）。预测求助时间迫近度：文本稳定（C-index 0.698），行为特征表现不稳定。表明结构化参与模式提供超越语言内容的未来求助信息，且将‘谁’与‘何时’分离建模能获得更清晰的分析。
AI.conclusion: 行为参与模式包含预测未来心理健康求助的关键信息，且优于纯文本特征识别潜在求助人群；文本特征则更稳定地预测求助发生的时间迫近度。将求助预测分解为‘谁’与‘何时’两个子问题，并采用生存分析框架与严格的时序验证，能有效避免泄露并揭示不同特征类型的互补作用。

title: FARL: A Fully Automated Pipeline of RL Interface and Solver Design
comment: 43 pages, including references and appendices. Code and recorded experimental results are included as ancillary files
summary: Existing reinforcement learning (RL) largely focuses on optimizing learning algorithms within a pre-defined task formulation, while applying RL to new tasks still relies heavily on human expertise to design the learning pipeline: what an agent observes, how it is rewarded, which algorithm it uses, and how training is configured. Automating these choices is challenging because they are tightly coupled. We introduce FARL (Fully Automated Reinforcement Learning), a framework that automates RL design by jointly searching observation and reward programs, learning algorithms, and training settings. FARL uses training statistics and observed behavior to diagnose failures, propose changes, and test whether they improve learning. Its search preserves diverse candidates and the controls needed for these tests, using a staged budget to screen designs before investing in longer training. Experimental memory records each finding together with its conditions, so an unsuccessful component can be reconsidered in a different combination. Across expert-withheld and expert-available settings, FARL outperforms the evaluated automated baselines on challenging navigation, locomotion, and manipulation tasks. On Adroit Hand Relocate, FARL achieves 97.1% success at 5M training steps per policy, compared with 0% for Eureka and LiMEN and 1.0% for native Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) under the same policy training budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FARL（全自动强化学习）框架，通过联合搜索观测程序、奖励程序、学习算法和训练设置，实现了强化学习流程的全自动化设计。FARL 利用训练统计和观测行为诊断失败、提出修改并验证改进，采用分阶段预算筛选设计并保留实验记忆，使失败组件能在新组合中复用。在导航、运动控制和操作任务上，FARL 在专家隐藏和专家可用两种设定下均超越自动化基线；在 Adroit Hand Relocate 任务上，5M 步策略训练预算下达成 97.1% 成功率，远超 Eureka、LiMEN（0%）和原生 PPO（1.0%）。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习主要集中在预定义任务公式下的算法优化，将 RL 应用到新任务仍严重依赖人类专家设计观测、奖励、算法选择及训练配置等流程。这些选择紧密耦合，自动化难度大，因此需要一个能够联合自动化搜索这些组件的框架。
AI.method: FARL 框架联合搜索观测程序、奖励程序、学习算法和训练设置。核心机制包括：基于训练统计与观测行为诊断失败并提出修改；保持多样化候选并保留对照实验所需的控制变量；采用分阶段预算先筛选再长程训练；建立实验记忆记录每个发现及其条件，使失败组件可在不同组合中重新评估。
AI.result: 在专家隐藏和专家可用两种设定下，FARL 在具有挑战性的导航、运动控制和操作任务上均优于评测的自动化基线。在 Adroit Hand Relocate 任务上，单策略 5M 训练步预算下 FARL 达到 97.1% 成功率，而 Eureka 和 LiMEN 为 0%，原生 PPO 仅 1.0%。
AI.conclusion: FARL 证明了通过联合自动化搜索观测、奖励、算法和训练配置，并结合诊断驱动的迭代改进、分阶段预算筛选与实验记忆机制，可以显著提升强化学习在复杂任务上的自动化设计能力，大幅减少对人类专家的依赖。

title: Random Feature Pruning for Multi-Class Classification
summary: Weighted sums of random kitchen sinks (W-RKS) is a commonly used feature extraction technique for supervised learning tasks. A major drawback of this method is the redundancy and ineffectiveness of many extracted random features. This paper investigates efficient methods for reducing such redundancy in multi-class classification problems. We specifically formulate feature selection as a variant of the sequentially nested model selection problem and introduce the Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX) algorithm. It recursively computes empirical risks to identify the most parsimonious yet informative set of features. We derive an analytical lower bound for the probability of correct feature selection by the SEED-MAX algorithm. This lower bound on the probability of correct feature selection can be made arbitrarily close to one by increasing the training dataset size. To further enhance the rate of pruning, we evaluate the features retained by SEED-MAX using the Fisher test (F-Test). Empirical evaluations on UCR time-series classification datasets show that the sequential application of SEED-MAX with the Fisher test achieves approximately 92 percent rate of pruning with negligible degradation in classification accuracy. Implementations of the SEED-MAX and SEED-MAX-F-Test methods are available at https://github.com/OmidiAmin/seed-max-ftest.

AI.tldr: 本文针对W-RKS特征提取中的冗余问题，提出SEED-MAX算法及结合Fisher检验的改进方法，实现约92%的特征剪枝率且分类精度损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: W-RKS方法提取的随机特征存在大量冗余和无效特征，导致计算效率低下，亟需一种高效的特征选择方法来减少冗余并保持分类性能。
AI.method: 将特征选择建模为序贯嵌套模型选择问题，提出SEED-MAX算法通过递归计算经验风险来识别最简约且信息量最大的特征子集；推导正确特征选择概率的解析下界；进一步引入Fisher检验（F-Test）对保留特征进行评估以加速剪枝。
AI.result: 在UCR时间序列分类数据集上实验表明，SEED-MAX结合Fisher检验可达到约92%的剪枝率，且分类精度几乎无损失；理论分析证明随着训练数据增加，正确特征选择概率可任意逼近1。
AI.conclusion: SEED-MAX及其结合Fisher检验的变体为W-RKS特征冗余问题提供了理论有保证且实践高效的解决方案，显著降低计算成本同时保持分类性能，代码已开源。

title: MENTOR: Procedural Shielding of Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents are increasingly used to automate workflows governed by procedural manuals, such as company rules for booking travel or procuring hardware. These manuals are written in natural language for humans and describe general requirements over such complex workflows. Ensuring compliance of LLM agents with these manuals is difficult, and state-of-the-art techniques use either LLM judges or manually written rules to forbid problematic tool-calls locally at runtime. This is insufficient because (i) only blocking tool calls keeps the agent clueless about how to make correct progress towards fulfilling its task, and (ii) can lead to overly conservative behavior of the agent, as tool calls might only be problematic in certain contexts. To overcome these challenges, we introduce MENTOR, which (i) additionally provides guidance for the agent to make procedural-compliant progress on the task, and (ii) ensures that this compliance is context-aware. We achieve these goals by building a novel history-dependent runtime shield that is obtained from the procedural manual via a multi-step autoformalization pipeline. At its core, MENTOR utilizes a game-based technique to ensure robustness against runtime uncertainty without over-resticting agents' behavior. This yields a formally assisted framework for procedural shielding of LLM agents that improves compliance well beyond existing methods. In particular, MENTOR lifts the compliance of shielded light-weight open-source LLMs above that of non-shielded proprietary models. Since a shield is synthesized once per manual and then serves every task, a MENTOR-shielded agent becomes a viable choice for repeatedly executed workflows, potentially reducing deployment costs when the offline construction cost is amortized over repeated tasks.

AI.tldr: MENTOR 是一个基于程序手册的运行时屏蔽框架，通过自动形式化和博弈论技术为 LLM 智能体提供上下文感知的合规指导，显著提升合规性，使开源模型超越非屏蔽的专有模型，且一次构建可服务多任务，降低部署成本。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅在运行时局部阻止有问题的工具调用，导致智能体不知道如何正确推进任务，且因缺乏上下文感知而过度保守，限制智能体行为。
AI.method: 从程序手册通过多步自动形式化流水线构建历史相关的运行时屏蔽，核心采用博弈论技术保证在运行时不确定性下的鲁棒性，同时避免过度限制智能体行为。
AI.result: MENTOR 显著提升合规性，使屏蔽后的轻量级开源 LLM 合规性超过未屏蔽的专有模型；屏蔽器每个手册仅合成一次即可服务所有任务，适合重复执行的工作流，摊销离线构建成本后可降低部署成本。
AI.conclusion: MENTOR 提供了一个形式化辅助的程序性屏蔽框架，通过上下文感知的指导和博弈论保证的鲁棒性，解决了现有方法的不足，为 LLM 智能体在复杂工作流中的合规部署提供了可行路径。

title: SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications
summary: Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. Improving the specification of one entity can inadvertently degrade the correctness of others, a phenomenon we call output coupling. This creates a whack-a-mole effect in which local improvements cause regressions elsewhere, preventing consistent progress. We introduce SpecForge, a multi-frontier tree search framework that addresses this challenge with three mechanisms: (i) Pareto-guided state selection preserves complementary specification states and prevents premature commitment; (ii) dependency-constrained entity selection prioritizes callee-before-caller refinement; and (iii) error-diversified expansion explores multiple refinements using different subsets of test failures. On DevEval+, SpecForge achieves the best performance across five backbone models, including a 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and a 5.7-percentage-point average improvement over the strongest baseline. The improved specifications also make the agent better at tasks outside the loop: they transfer to cross-language translation and to new-feature implementation, where they outperform the benchmark-provided requirement documents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecForge框架，通过递归自我改进循环优化行为规范（自然语言代码文档），解决冻结语言模型编码代理的性能提升问题，引入三机制解决输出耦合导致的打地鼠效应，在DevEval+上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 冻结语言模型无法更新权重，需通过优化外部上下文提升编码性能。现有方法依赖行为规范指导代码生成，但规范递归优化面临输出耦合挑战：改进某实体规范会无意降低其他实体正确性，导致局部改进引发回归，阻碍持续进步。
AI.method: 提出SpecForge多前沿树搜索框架，包含三机制：(i)帕累托引导状态选择保留互补规范状态，避免过早收敛；(ii)依赖约束实体选择优先被调用者前于调用者优化；(iii)错误多样化扩展利用不同测试失败子集探索多重细化。形成代码生成→执行验证测试→基于失败细化规范的自我改进循环。
AI.result: 在DevEval+基准上，SpecForge在五个主干模型上均达最优，Claude-4.5-Sonnet达到94.9%解决率，平均比最强基线提升5.7个百分点。改进规范还能迁移至跨语言翻译和新特性实现任务，超越基准提供的需求文档。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决规范优化中的输出耦合问题，SpecForge实现了冻结模型编码代理的有效递归自我改进，不仅显著提升基准性能，且生成的高质量规范具有跨任务泛化能力，为无需微调的模型能力增强提供了新范式。

title: RELAGRAM: Recursive Latent Graph Model for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 MLxOR workshop. Paper contains 6 pages (4 main text, 1 references, 1 appendix); 1 figure and 3 tables
summary: Latent recursion repeatedly processes internal representations through the same neural network. Recent work has shown this approach to be effective on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. However, whether latent recursion can support neural routing remains unclear. We introduce RELAGRAM (Recursive Latent Graph Model), a novel approach that brings latent recursion to graph combinatorial optimization. RELAGRAM encodes a capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) instance as edge tokens; a compact transformer recurrently updates the latent representations of these tokens. An output head maps the answer state to an edge heatmap, from which an autoregressive decoder constructs a feasible solution. On CVRP-100 instances, the 0.53M-parameter RELAGRAM achieves gaps to a PyVRP reference of 13.4%, 9.8%, and 8.3% under greedy decoding, eightfold symmetry augmentation, and 256-candidate search, respectively. Trained only on CVRP-100, RELAGRAM generalizes zero-shot to CVRP-500 and CVRP-1000, achieving gaps of 15.6% and 21.7% under 256-candidate search. Together, these results demonstrate that latent recursion is a promising approach to neural routing.

AI.tldr: RELAGRAM是一种递归潜在图模型，将潜在递归应用于图组合优化（如CVRP），通过Transformer递归更新边标记的潜在表示，实现零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 潜在递归在结构化推理任务（如数独、迷宫求解）上有效，但其是否支持神经路由尚不明确，因此提出RELAGRAM将潜在递归引入图组合优化。
AI.method: 将CVRP实例编码为边标记，使用紧凑Transformer递归更新边标记的潜在表示，输出头映射为边热力图，自回归解码器构建可行解。
AI.result: 在CVRP-100上，0.53M参数的RELAGRAM在贪婪解码、八倍对称增强、256候选搜索下与PyVRP参考差距分别为13.4%、9.8%、8.3%；仅在CVRP-100训练，零样本泛化到CVRP-500和CVRP-1000，256候选搜索下差距为15.6%和21.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明潜在递归是神经路由的一种有前景的方法。

title: Beyond Model Bias: Cross-Entropy Based Rankings in Literary and Academic Texts Remain Stable across Small Language Models
summary: While language models provide powerful mechanisms for evaluating textual predictability, it remains unclear whether the relative extents of LM surprisal remain stable across models. This study presents empirical evidence of the invariance of ranking based on cross-entropy related measures (e.g. mean, variance of each data-point), across four distinct small scale transformer-based models, for a given dataset of text sources. We consider two stylistic environments: a corpus of contemporary poetry and a corpus of academic research papers. We demonstrate that mean and variance of cross-entropy maintain robust cross-model rank correlation ($ρ> 0.90$) across both regimes. To test whether this agreement merely reflects generic differences in textual complexity, we compare it against six parameter-free compression baselines. The extent of agreement among language models is found to be substantially higher than that among model-baselines, for most of the measures. Geometric analysis of the structurally constrained academic regime reveals that higher-order moments are sensitive to specific models, although strong agreement persists. The findings suggest that relative extents of textual unpredictability may be independent of the language model they are computed against.

AI.tldr: 该研究实证表明，四个小型Transformer模型在诗歌和学术语料库上基于交叉熵均值、方差的排名具有极高跨模型一致性（Spearman ρ>0.90），且模型间一致性显著高于无参数压缩基线；高阶矩虽对特定模型敏感，但整体强一致性依然存在，提示文本不可预测性的相对程度可能与语言模型无关。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常用于评估文本可预测性，但尚不清楚不同模型计算的惊讶度相对程度是否稳定。本文旨在验证跨模型基于交叉熵度量的排名不变性。
AI.method: 选取四个小型Transformer模型，在两个文体语料库（当代诗歌、学术论文）上计算每个数据点的交叉熵均值、方差等矩，比较跨模型排名的Spearman相关系数；引入六个无参数压缩基线作为对照，并对结构受限的学术语料进行几何分析以考察高阶矩。
AI.result: 均值和方差在两个语料库上的跨模型排名相关性均超过0.90；语言模型间的一致性显著高于模型-基线间的一致性；高阶矩对特定模型敏感，但整体强一致性仍保持。
AI.conclusion: 文本不可预测性的相对程度可能独立于用于计算的语言模型，即基于交叉熵相关度量的排名具有跨模型不变性。

title: Suggested Is Not Superseded: A Pre-Registered Evaluation of a System-One Model as a Memory-Retirement Gate
summary: Long-term memory for assistants needs a gate that decides when a new utterance retires an old stored claim. Benchmark labels for this step mark a pair as changed or not, so they cannot tell a gate that acts on established change from one that acts on a hint. We write a task contract that separates the two (SUPERSEDED vs. NEEDS-CONFIRMATION vs. COMPATIBLE), label 500 test pairs built from STALE (change pairs plus same-user controls) with three LLM annotators and two human adjudicators (one author and a second annotator; provenance reported), and evaluate Jev, a typed "System One" decision model, under pre-registered hypotheses. Of the 179 test pairs STALE marks as changed, 72 meet the contract's bar for an established change. Jev never retired a claim on 141 same-conversation non-changes. Its failure is premature retirement: the binary gate retires 39.2% of claims whose change is only suggested. A three-way decision cuts this to 15.5% at a 15.3-point detection cost, which misses our pre-registered 10-point budget, and it lands on the binary gate's own threshold frontier; these verdicts hold under three readings of the gold labels. On a held-out vault scored against a second annotator's labels, a cascade that escalated uncertain cases to a reasoning model and looked best on development data was indistinguishable from simply raising the threshold (premature retirement 26.8% vs. 6.5% on dev). Part of the gap comes from the gold labels: relative to that annotator's reading, LLM-majority gold shares most of its errors with a same-family escalation model, and an identity for binary labels says how much such shared errors hide. The rest is small-sample selection on development data. For builders this means a binary score should not be wired to delete: route suggested changes to pending evidence, and do not trust a cascade selected on development data of this size.

AI.tldr: 论文提出三分类任务契约（SUPERSEDED、NEEDS-CONFIRMATION、COMPATIBLE）区分确定变更与仅暗示变更，评估二元门控与三元决策在长期记忆更新中的表现。实验显示二元门控过早退休39.2%仅暗示变更的声明，三元决策虽降至15.5%但检测成本超预设预算，且级联模型在留出数据上不优于简单提高阈值。建议：二元分数不直接用于删除，将暗示变更路由至待确认证据，且不应信任小样本开发数据选出的级联模型。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆助手需决定何时用新话语替换旧存储声明，现有基准标签仅标记变更与否，无法区分基于确定变更行动的门控与基于暗示行动的门控，因此需要更细粒度的任务定义与评估体系。
AI.method: 编写三分类任务契约，基于STALE数据集构建500测试对（含变更对与同用户对照），由三个LLM标注员与两人工裁决员（含作者）标注；评估名为Jev的类型化“System One”决策模型，在预注册假设下对比二元门控与三元决策，并在留出保险库上测试级联模型（不确定情况升级至推理模型）与单纯提高阈值的效果。
AI.result: STALE标记的179个变更对中仅72个符合契约的确定变更标准；Jev在141个同对话非变更对上未误退休；二元门控过早退休率39.2%，三元决策降至15.5%但检测成本增加15.3点，超出预设10点预算，且处于二元门控阈值前沿；留出数据上级联模型与提高阈值无显著差异（过早退休率26.8% vs 6.5%），部分差距源于金标签误差共享，部分源于小样本开发数据选择偏差。
AI.conclusion: 构建者不应将二元分数直接连接删除操作，而应将暗示变更路由至待确认证据队列；且不应信任在小规模开发数据上选择的级联模型，需更大规模评估与更稳健的标签体系。

title: scHFBiMamba: a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder for cardiac disease-state classification from single-nucleus RNA-seq data
summary: To evaluate whether a compact bidirectional state-space autoencoder improves joint classification of species, cell type, and disease state from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing profiles in heart failure (HF), while yielding interpretable gene attributions. Building on the dense denoising autoencoder (DAE) and MLP framework of Ruz Jurado et al., we developed scHFBiMamba, combining a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder (BiMambaAE) with an MLP head. BiMambaAE maps 16,545-gene profiles to 350-dimensional latent representations using 13.2M parameters, about 14.6-fold fewer than the dense DAE (192.9M). We compared six encoder-classifier configurations on 38,275 held-out cardiac nuclei using McNemar tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and assessed nine classifiers on frozen representations. Biological relevance was evaluated by comparing SHAP-derived differentially explained genes with differentially expressed genes against curated HF-related Gene Ontology keywords. BiMambaAE+MLP achieved the highest aggregate F1: pooled macro-F1 across 13 outputs was 0.966 versus 0.957 for DAE+MLP, and the mean category macro-F1 was 0.977 versus 0.970. It significantly improved cell-type and disease-state accuracy (adjusted p=7.1e-3 and p=4.8e-6, respectively), with species F1 of 1.000. SHAP-derived differentially explained genes achieved a pathway-enrichment benchmark F1 of 0.105 versus 0.053 for differentially expressed genes. Compact bidirectional state-space autoencoders can outperform substantially larger dense autoencoders for joint cardiac transcriptomic classification while reducing parameters. scHFBiMamba enables accurate multi-task prediction and hypothesis-generating gene-level interpretation. Code: https://github.com/UgoLomoio/scHFBiMamba.

AI.tldr: 本文提出scHFBiMamba，一种紧凑的双向状态空间自编码器，用于心力衰竭单核RNA测序数据的联合分类（物种、细胞类型、疾病状态），在参数量减少14.6倍的情况下优于密集去噪自编码器（DAE），并提供可解释的基因归因。
AI.motivation: 评估紧凑双向状态空间自编码器是否能在心力衰竭单核RNA测序数据上提升物种、细胞类型和疾病状态的联合分类性能，同时减少参数量并提供可解释的基因水平归因。
AI.method: 基于Ruz Jurado等人的密集DAE和MLP框架，开发scHFBiMamba，结合双向Mamba自编码器与MLP分类头。BiMambaAE将16,545基因谱映射为350维潜在表示，参数量13.2M，远少于密集DAE的192.9M。在38,275个保留的心脏核上比较六种编码器-分类器配置，使用McNemar检验并经Benjamini-Hochberg校正；在冻结表示上评估九种分类器。通过SHAP衍生的差异解释基因与差异表达基因对比，基于经筛选的HF相关Gene Ontology关键词评估生物学相关性。
AI.result: BiMambaAE+MLP达到最高聚合F1：13个输出的汇总宏F1为0.966（DAE+MLP为0.957），平均类别宏F1为0.977（DAE+MLP为0.970）。显著提升细胞类型和疾病状态准确性（校正p=7.1e-3和p=4.8e-6），物种F1为1.000。SHAP衍生的差异解释基因在通路富集基准上F1为0.105，优于差异表达基因的0.053。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的双向状态空间自编码器能在参数大幅减少的情况下超越更大的密集自编码器，实现准确的心脏转录组多任务预测，并提供假设生成的基因水平解释。

title: AD4EDU: Benchmarking University Lecture Audio Description across Accessibility Standards, Metrics, and Learner Preferences
summary: Audio description (AD) aims to enhance the accessibility of visual media for blind and low-vision (BLV) persons. However, in higher education, where slide-based lectures are a default mode of teaching, lecture AD remains largely underexplored. The main reason is that existing production guidelines, evaluation metrics, and benchmark datasets are oriented toward entertainment content and do not transfer to lectures, where ADs must complement the lecturer's speech, resolve deictic references, and fit within narrow pauses. In this work, we propose AD4Edu, consisting of an AD benchmark, AD4Edu-Bench, and a rule-diagnosable evaluation metric, AD4Edu-Eval, for generating and evaluating ADs in higher education. Specifically, we consolidated established accessibility guidance, including WCAG 2.2, the DCMP Description Key, and NCAM's STEM description practices. We further collected silver reference ADs, judge-ordered preference pairs, and pairwise preferences from four BLV raters, and post-trained models with direct preference optimization (DPO) for detailed analysis. Our findings indicate that while the metric reliably detects violations of the standard, ADs that comply with it do not necessarily fulfill the subjective preferences of BLV persons, most notably on description length, underscoring the necessity of active participation of BLV persons in co-designing inclusive AI solutions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AD4Edu，包含用于高等教育场景的音频描述基准 AD4Edu-Bench 和规则可诊断评估指标 AD4Edu-Eval，旨在解决现有面向娱乐内容的 AD 指南、指标和数据集无法迁移到幻灯片讲座教学场景的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频描述（AD）制作指南、评估指标和基准数据集主要面向娱乐内容，无法满足高等教育讲座场景的特殊需求：AD 必须与讲师语音互补、消解指示性参照、并适配狭窄的停顿间隙。因此亟需专门针对教育场景的基准与评估体系。
AI.method: 1. 整合 WCAG 2.2、DCMP Description Key 和 NCAM STEM 描述实践等权威无障碍指南，构建规则体系。2. 收集银标准参考 AD、法官排序的偏好对，以及四位盲/低视力（BLV）评分员的成对偏好数据。3. 利用直接偏好优化（DPO）对模型进行后训练，以便深入分析。
AI.result: 评估指标能可靠检测违反标准的行为，但符合标准的 AD 并不一定满足 BLV 用户的主观偏好，最显著的分歧在于描述长度。这揭示了合规性与用户体验之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 必须让盲/低视力人士积极参与共同设计包容性 AI 解决方案，仅依赖标准合规不足以保证实际可用性，用户主观偏好（尤其是描述长度）应纳入评估与生成循环。

title: MedHarnessBench: A Unified Benchmark for Healthcare Agent Evaluation
summary: Healthcare agents must transform longitudinal clinical evidence into reliable actions through heterogeneous tools and stateful workflows, conditions under which model-centric systems may lose context, misuse tools, fail to verify consequential transitions, or cross authorization boundaries. Existing medical-agent benchmarks primarily emphasize terminal task outcomes, making it difficult to determine whether execution failures arise from the agent model, the runtime harness, or their interaction. We present the Medical Harness Protocol, an outcome-preserving framework that independently evaluates seven healthcare-specific process dimensions: Care Action Fulfillment, Clinical Resource Competence, Patient-Evidence Alignment, Clinical Workflow Continuity, Clinical Auditability, Closed-Loop Verification, and Clinical Conduct Boundaries. A normalized intervention trace further tracks whether runtime support is available, activated, delivered, adopted by the agent, and propagated into subsequent behavior. We instantiate the protocol as MedHarnessBench, comprising 342 executable tasks across FHIR/EHR operations, healthcare-administration interfaces, and multimodal clinical tools. Across more than 16,000 controlled task executions, MedHarness yields broad improvements in terminal task success, intermediate subtask completion, and healthcare-specific process quality. We further evaluate MedHarness against multiple general-purpose harnesses and use controlled single-fault perturbations to verify the sensitivity and discrimination of the seven-dimensional evaluation. These results demonstrate that healthcare-specific runtime support can substantially improve both task completion and execution quality, while revealing failures that terminal outcomes alone cannot capture. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Tomry1114/Awesome-Agent-Harness-for-Healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出医疗Harness协议(Medical Harness Protocol)及MedHarnessBench基准，通过七维医疗专用过程评估和标准化干预追踪，解决现有医疗智能体基准仅关注终端结果、无法定位执行失败根因的问题，实验表明医疗专用运行时支持能显著提升任务完成率与执行质量，并揭示终端结果无法捕捉的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗智能体基准主要关注终端任务结果，难以判断执行失败源于智能体模型、运行时框架还是二者交互；模型中心系统在纵向临床证据转化为可靠行动时易丢失上下文、误用工具、未验证关键转换或越权操作，亟需一种保持结果不变的框架独立评估医疗专用过程维度。
AI.method: 提出医疗Harness协议，定义七个医疗专用过程维度：护理动作履行、临床资源胜任力、患者证据对齐、临床工作流连续性、临床可审计性、闭环验证、临床行为边界；构建标准化干预追踪记录运行时支持的可用性、激活、交付、采纳与传播；实例化为MedHarnessBench，包含342个跨FHIR/EHR操作、医疗管理接口、多模态临床工具的可执行任务，开展16000+受控任务执行，并对比通用Harness、采用单故障扰动验证评估灵敏度与区分度。
AI.result: MedHarness在终端任务成功率、中间子任务完成率、医疗专用过程质量上均获广泛提升；对比多个通用Harness显示医疗专用运行时支持显著改善任务完成与执行质量；单故障扰动实验验证七维评估具有高灵敏度与区分度，能揭示仅看终端结果无法捕捉的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 医疗专用运行时支持能实质性提升医疗智能体的任务完成率与执行质量；七维过程评估与标准化干预追踪能精准定位失败根因，弥补终端结果评估的盲区，为医疗智能体的可靠部署提供关键评估基础设施。

title: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
summary: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\mbox{\muT}). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“Ours”的弹性Transformer架构，通过将隐藏维度组织为密集核心和连续外壳，使每个隐藏矩阵呈块下三角结构，从而在一次全宽前向传播中包含所有子网络的精确隐藏状态作为前缀。联合训练保持固定计算图，每步成本仅相当于单独训练最宽子网络。同时引入μE，将最大更新参数化（μP）扩展到弹性架构，其缩放规则可证明同时保持所有子网络最大化更新（μI），且在超网加宽或增加外壳时仍保持此特性；超参数在小型非弹性代理模型上调优后，对弹性家族和更大超网仍近似最优（μT）。单次运行产出的子网络在相同参数量下超越MatFormer和全弹性基线，逼近需数倍步数单独训练的模型性能。
AI.motivation: 基础模型需支持多样化的推理预算，但为每个预算单独训练模型会重复预训练工作。现有弹性模型（在一个权重共享超网内训练多个嵌套子网络）面临三大障碍：1) 可变的逐步工作量阻碍分布式扩展；2) 超参数在不同模型规模间迁移受限；3) 无法保证所有子网络同时获得最大化更新。
AI.method: 1. 架构设计：将隐藏维度组织为密集核心和连续外壳，使每个隐藏矩阵呈块下三角结构，一次全宽前向传播即包含所有子网络的精确隐藏状态作为前缀，联合训练保持固定计算图。2. μE参数化：将最大更新参数化（μP）扩展到弹性架构，推导缩放规则，证明可同时保持所有子网络最大化更新（μI），且在超网加宽或增加外壳时仍保持该性质。3. 超参数迁移：验证在小型非弹性代理模型上调优的超参数，对弹性家族和更大超网仍近似最优（μT）。
AI.result: 单次Ours运行产出的子网络在相同参数量下超越MatFormer和全弹性基线，性能逼近需数倍训练步数单独训练的模型。每步训练成本约等于单独训练最宽子网络。超参数在小型代理模型上调优后，对弹性家族和更大超网仍保持近似最优。
AI.conclusion: Ours通过块下三角结构实现固定计算图的高效弹性训练，μE参数化解决了多子网络同时最大化更新及超参数迁移难题，显著降低了多预算模型部署的训练成本，为基础模型的弹性推理提供了理论和实践双重保障的解决方案。

title: UZHCL_for_the_win at Touche: Encoder Fine-Tuning, Synthetic Augmentation, and an Underpowered Encoder-LLM Comparison
comment: 19 pages. Working notes for Touche at CLEF 2026 (Jena, Germany)
summary: Online discussions on platforms like Reddit are a productive testbed for fallacy detection: short texts, broad topical range, and the full inventory of informal fallacies. The Touche 2026 lab at CLEF formalises this as a shared task on a Reddit-derived corpus that combines fallacy detection with argument-scheme classification. This paper describes our participation in all three subtasks (ST1 binary fallacy detection, ST2 eight-way fallacy classification, ST3 four-way argument-scheme classification) and both evaluation tracks. Our submitted systems are fine-tuned RoBERTa-large encoders with task-specific heads, augmented with a small batch of LLM-generated synthetic contrastive pairs; for ST2 and ST3 on the enhanced track we additionally added confidence-filtered pseudo-labelled examples from the unlabelled pool. A wider backbone comparison spanning additional encoders (DeBERTa-v3, ModernBERT) and an LLM track (four Qwen variants from 3B to 32B, zero-shot through CoT-LoRA) showed no validated benefit over RoBERTa-large at this corpus scale, with 5-fold variance wide enough that we call the comparison underpowered rather than settled. We also characterise how much of the enhanced track's lift reflects organiser-rewritten inputs carrying label information rather than genuine argument clarification. On the official Touche 2026 test set our systems ranked first on both base-track classification cells (ST2 and ST3) and second on both binary-detection (ST1) tracks, with the two enhanced-track classification cells topped by cascaded and multitask systems. We close with the rare-class limitation on ST3 and the most useful follow-ups. Code: https://github.com/psychias/fallacy_detection_clef_2026

AI.tldr: 本文描述了在CLEF Touche 2026实验室共享任务中参与所有三个子任务（ST1二分类谬误检测、ST2八分类谬误分类、ST3四分类论证模式分类）及两条评估赛道的系统。采用微调RoBERTa-large编码器配合任务专用头，并利用LLM生成的合成对比样本增强；增强赛道额外引入置信度过滤的伪标签数据。实验对比了DeBERTa-v3、ModernBERT及多规模Qwen模型，发现RoBERTa-large在当前语料规模下无显著劣势，但五折方差大，判定对比统计功效不足。官方测试集上，该系统在基础赛道分类任务（ST2、ST3）排名第一，二分类检测（ST1）排名第二；增强赛道分类任务由级联/多任务系统夺冠。最后指出ST3稀有类别限制及后续工作建议。
AI.motivation: 在线讨论平台（如Reddit）提供短文本、广泛主题及完整非形式谬误清单，是谬误检测的理想测试床。Touche 2026将谬误检测与论证模式分类结合为共享任务，旨在推动该领域系统化评测。
AI.method: 核心系统为微调RoBERTa-large编码器加任务专用分类头。数据增强方面：所有子任务均引入LLM生成的合成对比样本对；增强赛道的ST2、ST3额外利用无标签池中置信度过滤后的伪标签样本。同时进行主干网络对比实验，涵盖DeBERTa-v3、ModernBERT及四款Qwen模型（3B-32B，零样本到CoT-LoRA），并分析增强赛道性能提升中组织者重写输入携带标签信息的比例。
AI.result: 在官方Touche 2026测试集上，该系统在基础赛道ST2（八分类谬误分类）和ST3（四分类论证模式分类）均排名第一；在ST1（二分类谬误检测）基础赛道与增强赛道均排名第二。增强赛道分类任务由级联和多任务系统获得最优。主干对比实验显示，RoBERTa-large在当前语料规模下无统计显著劣势，但五折方差大，判定对比统计功效不足而非结论确定。同时量化了增强赛道提升中源自组织者重写输入隐含标签信息的比例。
AI.conclusion: RoBERTa-large配合合成对比样本与伪标签增强在该任务上表现强劲，但模型对比受限于语料规模导致统计功效不足。ST3存在稀有类别限制，未来工作建议包括扩大语料规模、改进稀有类别处理、探索更有效的伪标签策略及深入分析增强赛道输入重写带来的标签泄露问题。代码已开源。

title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
summary: Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: \emph{recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage}. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This \emph{training-free, plug-and-play} interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. This recovery adds $\leqslant$0.025% to analytical FLOPs, with persistent context storage approximately 1/2,600 that of a Transformer's full MHA KV cache at matched width, depth, and precision. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoteBank，一种稀疏情景记忆模块，以训练自由、即插即用方式扩展线性注意力模型的长上下文能力，在百万token级别显著提升检索精度，同时保持极低计算开销与存储占用。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型的固定大小循环状态需同时支持持续计算与保存不断增长的历史信息，导致其记忆容量被视为长上下文能力的瓶颈。作者挑战这一假设，认为循环计算无需承担全部长期存储负担。
AI.method: 引入NoteBank稀疏情景记忆：在未知未来查询前归档选定文本，利用主干网络原生特征进行写入与寻址，通过回放在原生前向计算中读取检索证据。无需外部嵌入模型、单独训练的检索器或独立神经阅读器，实现训练自由、即插即用接口。
AI.result: 在1M token下，Gated DeltaNet在六个RULER检索任务平均准确率从1.7%提升至70.3%，4K至1M token无显著检索退化。分析FLOPs增量≤0.025%，持久上下文存储仅为同宽度、深度、精度下Transformer全MHA KV缓存的约1/2600。实验扩展至三个1.3B循环主干、Mamba-2-8B及后训练Qwen3.5-9B，在LongBench v1/v2与MemoryAgentBench上均获增益。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏证据存储与原生回放能大幅拓展预训练线性注意力模型的长上下文能力，同时保持循环计算的高效率。

title: To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts
summary: Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. We establish matching lower bounds, showing that these rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we validate our approach on synthetic instances and real-world question-answering datasets, namely GSM8K, NuminaMath, and MedMCQA, using Qwen LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型(LLM)与人类专家协作中的延迟决策问题：在专家容量有限时，系统需根据LLM的置信度信号决定是直接输出答案还是将查询推给专家。置信度信号的可靠性未知，且专家反馈仅对推迟的查询可观测且因排队而延迟。作者提出KL-PBD算法，利用Kullback-Leibler下置信界引导推迟决策，实现了最优的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统越多结合LLM与人类专家，LLM处理常规查询，不确定情况推给专家。但专家容量有限时，推迟决策必须同时考虑LLM可靠性和专家队列拥塞。置信度信号的可靠性初始未知，需从专家反馈学习，而反馈具有选择性观测（仅推迟查询有标签）和排队延迟的特点。
AI.method: 将问题建模为在线序贯决策问题：每个查询观测LLM答案的置信度信号，决定输出或推迟给容量受限专家。提出KL-PBD算法，对未知可靠性参数使用Kullback-Leibler下置信界指导推迟决策。设置K个置信度层级，时间范围T。
AI.result: KL-PBD在每个置信度层级准确率远离推迟边界时达到O(K log T)的gap-dependent遗憾，最坏情况下达到Õ(√(KT))遗憾。建立了匹配的下界，证明这些速率在对数因子下最优。在合成实例和真实问答数据集（GSM8K, NuminaMath, MedMCQA）上用Qwen LLM验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: KL-PBD算法在专家容量约束、未知可靠性、选择性反馈和排队延迟的挑战下，为LLM-专家推迟问题提供了理论最优且实证有效的解决方案。

title: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
summary: Information extraction models often perform well on the datasets they are trained on, but transferring to new domains and annotation guidelines remains challenging. Supporting user-specified types alone does not resolve this problem. We present CalOn, a unified 0.6B-parameter encoder for entity, relation, and event extraction across datasets and schemas. The model jointly encodes text and type definitions, then directly identifies entity spans, relations between spans, and event triggers and arguments. Its extraction decisions consider the requested types together, using their combined evidence to identify relevant candidates before assigning a type. This gives all three tasks a common probabilistic formulation while keeping every extracted mention anchored to the input text. We train on diverse sources, and supplement supervised learning with a reward that encourages correct extractions and penalises incorrect ones. Across 40 benchmarks, CalOn outperforms the evaluated baselines on most benchmarks. It leads all reported relation extraction benchmarks and achieves the highest average F1 for event triggers and arguments with gold triggers. The same model also performs strongly on aspect sentiment triplet extraction and pronoun resolution through its span-pair formulation. A correction for the probability bias introduced during training improves confidence estimates for entities, relations, and event arguments after calibration, with little change in F1.

AI.tldr: CalOn 是一个 0.6B 参数的统一编码器，通过联合编码文本与类型定义，在实体、关系、事件抽取等多任务上跨数据集和模式实现强泛化，经多源监督训练与奖励机制优化，在 40 个基准上超越基线，且经校准后置信度估计显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有信息抽取模型在训练数据集上表现良好，但难以迁移到新领域和新标注规范；仅支持用户指定类型不足以解决该问题，需要一个统一模型跨数据集和模式处理实体、关系、事件抽取。
AI.method: CalOn 联合编码输入文本与类型定义，直接识别实体跨度、跨度间关系、事件触发词及论元；三个任务共享概率公式，所有抽取提及锚定在输入文本；训练融合多源监督数据，并引入奖励机制鼓励正确抽取、惩罚错误抽取；采用跨度对公式统一处理实体、关系、事件及方面情感三元组抽取、代词消歧。
AI.result: 在 40 个基准测试中，CalOn 在大多数基准上超越对比基线；在全部关系抽取基准上领先；在给定金标准触发词条件下，事件触发词和论元抽取平均 F1 最高；同一模型在方面情感三元组抽取和代词消歧上也表现强劲；训练引入的概率偏差经校准修正后，实体、关系、事件论元的置信度估计显著改善，F1 几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: CalOn 证明了统一的小参数量编码器通过联合建模文本与类型定义、多任务共享概率框架、多源监督与奖励训练，可实现跨领域、跨模式的鲁棒信息抽取，且校准机制进一步提升了预测置信度的可靠性。

title: Visible but Not Avoided: State-Dependent Re-Proposal of Rejected Candidates in Catalog-Based LLM Optimization Loops
summary: LLM optimization loops often show the proposer the candidates it has already tried and rejected, but leave it to the proposer to avoid them. We ask whether avoidance measured in a static probe predicts avoidance in the states an optimizer's own trajectory produces. In catalog-based loops where three open LLMs improve a GUI agent by naming one of 40 edits, a re-proposal is identified exactly by the edit's name. Clean base-state probes underpredict re-proposal in the proposers' own loops (macro-averaged loop-minus-probe rate 0.32 [0.27, 0.37]), and proposals of already evaluated harness-edit pairs consume 28-63% of valid proposer iterations. The two settings reject different edits: a probe's rejected edits are mostly ones the proposer did not choose, whereas a loop's are its own earlier choices, which remain preferred when the history is removed. Ordinary history lowers re-proposal for two proposers but raises it for the third, and the effects of failure evidence are model-specific. Stating the rejection status in one sentence lowers re-proposal in every model (-0.16 [-0.22, -0.09] relative to a neutral list of the same IDs). For catalog-based loops with exact edit identities, rejection avoidance should be measured on the rejected sets the loop produces.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM优化循环中提议者对已拒绝候选的避免行为，发现静态探针测量的避免率显著低估了实际循环中的重复提议率（宏平均差值0.32），且两种设置拒绝的编辑类型不同：探针拒绝的是提议者未选的编辑，而循环拒绝的是自身早期选择。在目录式循环中，明确标注拒绝状态可显著降低所有模型的重复提议率（-0.16），结论是拒绝避免应在循环实际产生的拒绝集合上测量。
AI.motivation: LLM优化循环通常向提议者展示已尝试并拒绝的候选，但依赖提议者自行避免。现有工作使用静态基态探针测量避免能力，但未验证这种静态测量是否能预测优化器自生成轨迹中的实际避免行为。作者想了解静态探针测量与动态循环实际表现之间的差距，以及如何改进拒绝避免的测量方法。
AI.method: 采用目录式优化循环，三个开源LLM通过命名40个预定义编辑之一来改进GUI代理。重复提议通过编辑名称精确识别。对比静态基态探针与动态优化循环中的重复提议率，分析普通历史记录和失败证据的影响，并测试在提示中明确标注拒绝状态（用一句话）对重复提议率的影响。
AI.result: 1. 静态探针显著低估循环中的重复提议：宏平均loop-minus-probe率为0.32 [0.27, 0.37]。2. 已评估的harness-edit对占有效提议迭代的28-63%。3. 两种设置拒绝不同编辑：探针拒绝提议者未选的编辑，循环拒绝自身早期选择（即使移除历史仍偏好）。4. 普通历史对两个提议者降低重复提议，对第三个提升。5. 失败证据效果模型特异。6. 明确标注拒绝状态在所有模型中降低重复提议（-0.16 [-0.22, -0.09]）。
AI.conclusion: 对于具有精确编辑身份的目录式循环，拒绝避免能力应在循环实际产生的拒绝集合上测量，而非静态基态探针。静态探针无法捕捉优化器自生成轨迹中的偏好模式，且简单明确地标注拒绝状态比依赖模型从历史推断更有效。

title: When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (non-archival). Extended version: adds a cross-architecture containment comparison on Mamba-2 and corrects two claims in the workshop version. Code and project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/dynamic-scaling-fails/
summary: Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. Yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely, yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost, so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. The remainder is a resolution problem that locating outliers does not solve, since every outlier-aware scheme here loses to plain persistent scaling. Allocating bits across layers does help, but under article-disjoint splits a learned allocation collapses onto the trivial rule of protecting the first few layers. Run out to 32K, group-wise INT4 is worth no more than discarding the state. Contain the scale rather than locate outliers, and report the decode horizon at which a bit-width was certified.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究线性注意力和状态空间LLM中循环状态的量化问题，发现INT4量化在长序列解码中因量化器尺度与状态的反馈导致误差累积，数值不稳定与功能退化可分离，异常值感知方案不如持久缩放，层间比特分配趋向保护前几层，32K长度下组量化INT4不优于丢弃状态，建议控制尺度而非定位异常值，并报告比特宽度认证的解码步长。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力和状态空间模型通过固定大小循环状态携带长上下文，量化该状态可降低长解码成本，但状态每步重写，量化器在循环内导致误差累积，需研究量化对长序列性能的影响。
AI.method: 分析量化器尺度与状态的反馈机制，将尺度锚定至全精度参考消除范数爆炸，对比异常值感知量化与持久缩放，探索层间比特分配策略，在32K上下文评估组量化INT4。
AI.result: INT4在合成回忆任务上初期完美但千步后崩溃；锚定尺度仅恢复5.4 nats损失中的1.8 nats，证实数值不稳定与功能退化分离；异常值感知方案均败于持久缩放；学习比特分配在文章不相交分割下退化为保护前几层；32K时组量化INT4不优于丢弃状态。
AI.conclusion: 量化循环状态应控制量化器尺度而非定位异常值，并需报告比特宽度被认证的解码步长，以确保长上下文下的可靠性。

title: Gluing Local Contexts into Global Meaning: A Sheaf-Theoretic Decomposition of Transformer Representations
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Poster, ICLR Unifying Concept Representation Learning
summary: Existing interpretability tools do not test whether a representation keeps the same content when only the phrasing changes. We treat each paraphrase pair as a local witness that two activations should agree and build a cellular sheaf over the paraphrase graph; its Laplacian $L_\mathcal{F}$ answers the question on a frozen model with no training. The kernel $H^0$ is a content subspace: at 20 dimensions it beats the preserved subspace of the concept eraser LEACE on held-out CounterFact fact retrieval across eight architectures by a mean $+17.1$\,pp, and constraining all paraphrases of a fact jointly adds a further $+6.5$\,pp. The spectral complement concentrates causal influence: ablating the most paraphrase-variable coordinates, a coordinate-wise proxy for it, changes model outputs $5.6$ to $26.5\times$ more than ablating coordinates of matched per-coordinate variability, across nine models from 124M to 13B parameters. Stacking layers into a grid creates $b_1 = N(L-1)$ algebraic 1-cycles, and the resulting model-derived harmonic mass varies by nearly three orders of magnitude across six architectures and ranks them as their steering fragility does (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$, exact one-sided permutation $p = 0.014$). The same paraphrase graph yields the content subspace, the influence directions, and the fragility measure. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/gluing-lc-page/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于细胞层的方法，利用释义图来识别神经网络表示中的内容子空间和因果影响方向，无需训练即可在多种架构上超越现有方法，并揭示了模型脆弱性的代数拓扑度量。
AI.motivation: 现有的可解释性工具未能测试表示是否在措辞改变时保持相同内容，即缺乏对释义不变性的系统性检验。
AI.method: 将每个释义对视为局部见证，构建释义图上的细胞层，利用其拉普拉斯算子 $L_mathcal{F}$ 的核 $H^0$ 作为内容子空间；谱补集中因果影响；将层堆叠成网格产生代数1-循环，计算谐波质量作为脆弱性度量。
AI.result: 在八种架构上，20维内容子空间在保留的CounterFact事实检索上比LEACE平均高出17.1个百分点；联合约束所有释义再增6.5个百分点。谱补的坐标代理消融改变模型输出5.6至26.5倍于匹配变异性坐标。跨六种架构，模型导出的谐波质量变化近三个数量级，与转向脆弱性高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 同一释义图同时产出内容子空间、影响方向和脆弱性度量，展示了细胞层方法在无需训练情况下统一解释表示不变性、因果性和鲁棒性的潜力。

title: Google Earth AI Geospatial Reasoning Agent: Capabilities and a Systematic Evaluation
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables (10 main tables, 1 appendix table)
summary: Google Earth AI is a family of geospatial AI models, together with an agent that orchestrates them. We present this agent, Google Earth AI's Geospatial Reasoning agent (GRA), a Gemini-powered research system that combines geospatial data sources, foundation models, and tools to answer questions about our planet. GRA organizes these into modular domain skills and pairs them with upfront geospatial planning to decompose complex queries into multi-stage workflows. Evaluating such systems is hard: real-world problems admit multiple valid workflows, require data discovery across large catalogs, and rely on evolving ground truth. We introduce two benchmarks and release their development splits. GeoExpertQueries poses complex analytical problems grounded in practitioner use cases and refined by geospatial experts; each is paired with a consensus golden workflow from three independent experts and scored by a human-validated, tool-agnostic autorater. GeoKTools consists of templated queries with deterministic reference solvers that systematically vary the number of required tool types. We also use two external benchmarks, CBGB and UnivEARTH; the latter we find to be saturated. To isolate the contribution of GRA's tools and its agentic orchestration, we compare four configurations, each with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash: a standalone LLM, the LLM with basic tools, the LLM with GRA's skills and tools but without its upfront planning and execution guidance, and GRA itself. With at most basic tools, an advanced model recovers much of the answer on templated queries but satisfies only a small fraction of the expert workflows on open-ended problems; GRA performs well on both. The largest step comes from GRA's skills and tools; on open-ended problems, its planning and execution guidance add a further gain with Gemini 3.8 Flash, letting Flash match or exceed Pro at lower cost.

AI.tldr: Google Earth AI推出了地理空间推理代理（GRA），这是一个由Gemini驱动的研究系统，结合地理空间数据源、基础模型和工具来回答关于地球的问题。GRA通过模块化领域技能和前置地理空间规划，将复杂查询分解为多阶段工作流。论文引入两个新基准GeoExpertQueries和GeoKTools，并在四种配置上评估Gemini 3.1 Pro和3.8 Flash，发现GRA的技能和工具贡献最大，规划执行指导能让Flash匹配或超越Pro且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在处理复杂地理空间问题时面临挑战：真实世界问题允许多种有效工作流，需要跨大型目录进行数据发现，且依赖不断演变的真值。现有评估基准不足以全面衡量此类系统的能力，特别是缺乏专家级开放式问题和系统性工具组合变化的基准。
AI.method: 1. 构建GRA系统：模块化领域技能+前置地理空间规划，编排地理空间数据源、基础模型和工具。2. 引入两个基准：GeoExpertQueries（专家级复杂分析问题，配共识黄金工作流和人工验证的工具无关自动评分器）；GeoKTools（模板化查询，确定性参考求解器，系统变化所需工具类型数量）。3. 使用外部基准CBGB和UnivEARTH（后者发现已饱和）。4. 消融实验对比四种配置：纯LLM、LLM+基础工具、LLM+GRA技能工具但无规划、完整GRA，均测试Gemini 3.1 Pro和3.8 Flash。
AI.result: 1. 仅有基础工具时，先进模型能在模板化查询恢复大部分答案，但在开放式专家工作流上仅满足小部分。2. GRA在两类基准上均表现优异。3. 最大性能提升来自GRA的技能和工具；在开放式问题上，规划和执行指导带来额外增益，使Flash匹配或超越Pro且成本更低。4. UnivEARTH基准已饱和，不再具备区分度。
AI.conclusion: GRA通过模块化技能、工具集成和前置规划，有效解决了复杂地理空间推理问题。技能和工具的集成是核心贡献，而规划机制进一步释放了小模型潜力，实现了高性能与低成本的平衡。新基准GeoExpertQueries和GeoKTools为该领域提供了更严格、更全面的评估标准。

title: Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for Spiking Language Models
comment: Accepted to AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 4 pages + appendix, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Spiking neural networks target energy-efficient language modeling through sparse, binary activations, but the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff of spiking language models is uncharacterized at scale. We present the first Chinchilla-style IsoFLOP scaling study of a spiking language model, sweeping SpikeGPT-family models (RWKV backbone) from width 384 to 1536 across compute budgets from $3\times10^{17}$ to $10^{19}$ FLOPs on FineWeb-EDU. We report two findings. First, the compute-optimal frontier is $N_{opt} \propto C^{0.56}$, close to the 0.50 that Hoffmann et al. report for dense Transformers, so spiking does not change how parameters and data should be traded off under a compute budget. Second, against non-spiking RWKV and Transformer baselines trained the same way, the loss gap splits into a backbone cost of about 0.16 nats that does not change with compute and a spiking cost that falls from 0.34 to about 0.23 nats and then levels off. These results give the first compute-optimal recipe for spiking language models and quantify the accuracy cost of their sparsity.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对脉冲语言模型进行了Chinchilla风格的IsoFLOP缩放研究，研究了基于RWKV骨干网络的SpikeGPT系列模型。主要发现：最优计算前沿遵循N_opt ∝ C^0.56，接近密集Transformer的0.50，表明脉冲机制不改变参数与数据在计算预算下的最优权衡；损失差距分解为固定的骨干网络成本（约0.16 nats）和随计算量先下降后趋稳的脉冲成本（从0.34降至约0.23 nats）。这为脉冲语言模型提供了首个计算最优配方，并量化了其稀疏性带来的精度代价。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络通过稀疏的二值激活旨在实现节能语言建模，但在大规模下其效率-精度权衡尚未被表征。
AI.method: 采用Chinchilla风格的IsoFLOP缩放研究方法，在FineWeb-EDU数据集上，将基于RWKV骨干的SpikeGPT系列模型宽度从384扩展到1536，计算预算从3×10^17到10^19 FLOPs进行系统扫描。
AI.result: 两个核心发现：1) 计算最优前沿呈现N_opt ∝ C^0.56，接近Hoffmann等人报告的密集Transformer的0.50，说明脉冲机制不改变计算预算下参数与数据的最优权衡；2) 相对同训练设置的非脉冲RWKV和Transformer基线，损失差距分解为不随计算变化的骨干网络成本（约0.16 nats）和随计算从0.34下降至约0.23 nats后趋稳的脉冲成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了脉冲语言模型的首个计算最优配方，并量化了其稀疏性带来的精度损失，为脉冲语言模型的大规模训练提供了理论指导。

title: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones
comment: 17 pages, including references and appendices. Demo: https://d2-duplex-demo.github.io/
summary: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

AI.tldr: 提出Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2)框架，将预训练的半双工语音语言模型(HD-SLM)转换为细粒度时间颗粒度的全双工模型(FD-SLM)；在12.5Hz更新率下，Qwen3-Omni-D2实现99.2%轮转成功率、521ms延迟、99.5%打断成功率，并达到VoiceBench 70.1的最新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型支持同时听说，但通用能力常落后于半双工模型；需要一种方法在不大幅牺牲通用能力的前提下，将现有高性能半双工模型高效转换为具备实时全双工交互能力的模型。
AI.method: D2框架包含两阶段：(1) 通过无解码器表示蒸馏将原始音频编码器适配为流式编码器；(2) 通过监督微调学习全双工交互行为。系统研究了块大小(chunk size)对全双工交互、通用能力和推理计算的影响。将方法应用于Qwen3-Omni和LLaMA-Omni 2两种不同架构的HD-SLM。
AI.result: 在12.5Hz更新率(80ms chunk)下，Qwen3-Omni-D2达到99.2%轮转成功率、521ms端到端延迟、99.5%打断成功率，且在VoiceBench基准上获得70.1分的SOTA成绩；LLaMA-Omni 2-D2也展现出类似提升。
AI.conclusion: D2框架证明了通过表示蒸馏和监督微调可高效将半双工语音语言模型转换为高性能全双工模型，在保持甚至提升通用能力的同时实现低延迟、高成功率的实时双向交互，为构建实用全双工语音助手提供了可行路径。

title: Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as teams, yet they fail in characteristically social ways: information holders stay silent, dominant speakers anchor groups on wrong answers, and norm violations go unsanctioned. We present Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams. Under fixed personas, agents' emotional states and directed, asymmetric relationships are updated every round by a unified external LLM judge and shape their subsequent interactions. Across six LLM backbones and five social scenarios, we assess social fidelity through classical social-theory patterns and agreement with human judgments. The resulting trajectories exhibit structured social patterns and model-specific differences. We then introduce Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR), which diagnoses group-dynamic failures from interaction transcripts and social trajectories and recasts agent personas before rerunning the task. Across four collaborative benchmarks, TPR improves performance from both heterogeneous and randomly initialized agent persona compositions, yielding up to 83.3%p of accuracy improvement over the initial casting. On representative distributed-information cooperation and mixed-motive bargaining tasks, we outperform SOTOPIA and AgentVerse in three of four comparisons, by up to 37.5%p in Pareto rate. These results show that validated social trajectories provide actionable signals for repairing LLM agent teams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agent Sociodrama 框架，通过外部 LLM 法官建模和验证 LLM 智能体团队中的动态社会关系，并引入轨迹引导人设重铸 (TPR) 方法，根据交互轨迹诊断团队失效并重铸人设，显著提升协作任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体团队在部署时表现出典型的社会性失效模式：信息持有者保持沉默、主导发言者将群体锚定在错误答案、规范违规未受制裁。现有方法缺乏对演化社会动态的建模与验证机制。
AI.method: 1. Agent Sociodrama：固定人设下，统一外部 LLM 法官每轮更新智能体的情绪状态和有向非对称关系，塑造后续交互。2. Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR)：从交互记录和社会轨迹诊断群体动态失效，重铸智能体人设后重跑任务。
AI.result: 跨六种 LLM 主干和五种社会场景验证社会保真度；TPR 在四个协作基准上提升性能，最高准确率提升 83.3%p；在分布式信息合作和混合动机讨价还价任务中，三项对比超越 SOTOPIA 和 AgentVerse，Pareto 率最高提升 37.5%p。
AI.conclusion: 经过验证的社会轨迹为修复 LLM 智能体团队提供了可执行的信号，证明了建模和干预社会动态对提升多智能体协作效果的关键作用。

title: Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing
summary: Distribution-system state estimation is a growing necessity for the modern power grid as the addition of local storage and generation add system complexity that an operator or aggregator is not able to directly monitor. Classical methods work well when all system elements are time-synchronized and at least partly observable, but multi-rate monitoring of sparse heterogeneous sensors typically relies on machine learning approaches. It is a common practice in the literature to structure this task as a two-stage pipeline, first fusing data from disparate sensors and then feeding the fused pseudo-measurements to a separately trained state estimator. We propose a heterogeneous latent graph ODE in which measurement functions and sampling processes are typed and localized on specific buses, paired with a graph- transformer state estimator solving DSSE specifically for multi-rate heterogeneous sensor placements, and demonstrate its effectiveness across multiple IEEE standard topologies as observability degrades.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种异构潜在图ODE与图Transformer状态估计器相结合的方法，用于解决配电系统状态估计中多速率异构传感器布局问题，在观测性下降的情况下仍有效。
AI.motivation: 现代电网中分布式储能和发电增加了系统复杂性，运营商无法直接监控；经典方法要求时同步和部分可观测，而多速率稀疏异构传感器监测通常依赖机器学习，现有两阶段流水线方法存在局限。
AI.method: 异构潜在图ODE，将测量函数和采样过程类型化并定位到特定节点，配合图Transformer状态估计器，专门针对多速率异构传感器布局求解DSSE。
AI.result: 在多个IEEE标准拓扑上验证了方法的有效性，即使在观测性下降的情况下也能工作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过端到端建模异构传感器的测量和采样过程，结合图Transformer，为配电系统状态估计提供了更鲁棒的解决方案，适应多速率异构传感器布局。

title: ToolHACE: A Dataset for Detecting Hallucinations in Tool-Based LLM Responses
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 21 pages, 7 tables
summary: Tool-augmented language models ground their responses in external tool outputs, improving reliability beyond parametric knowledge alone. However, even when the correct tool is called and returns accurate information, models may still contradict such outputs, omit critical details, or generate unsupported claims. Existing hallucination benchmarks for tool-augmented dialogue primarily focus on the tool-calling stage, evaluating whether the correct tool and arguments are selected, while overlooking errors that arise during post-tool response generation. To address this gap, we introduce ToolHACE, a span-level benchmark for hallucination detection in tool-augmented LLM responses, covering five fine-grained hallucination categories. Through extensive experiments with modern hallucination detectors, we show that post-tool-call hallucinations are widespread and remain challenging to detect. Our results further demonstrate that effective detection requires training on specialized tool-augmented corpora, while transfer from tool-agnostic hallucination datasets performs poorly in this setting. These findings highlight the need for dedicated benchmarks and models for reliable hallucination detection in tool-augmented language systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ToolHACE，一个针对工具增强型大语言模型响应中幻觉的跨度级基准，涵盖五类细粒度幻觉类别。实验表明，工具调用后的幻觉普遍且难以检测，有效检测需在专用工具增强语料上训练，迁移自无工具幻觉数据集效果差。强调需建立专用基准和模型以保障工具增强语言系统的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强对话的幻觉基准主要关注工具调用阶段（如工具选择、参数正确性），忽视了工具调用后响应生成阶段的错误（如与工具输出矛盾、遗漏关键细节、生成无支持声明）。需填补这一空白，专门评估后工具调用幻觉。
AI.method: 构建ToolHACE基准，采用跨度级标注，覆盖五类细粒度幻觉类别。在该基准上对现代幻觉检测器进行广泛实验，对比专用工具增强语料训练与无工具幻觉数据集迁移的效果。
AI.result: 后工具调用幻觉普遍存在且极具挑战性；在专用工具增强语料上训练的检测器表现显著优于从无工具幻觉数据集迁移的模型，后者在此设定下表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强语言系统需要专用的幻觉检测基准和模型，通用幻觉检测方法无法有效迁移，未来研究应聚焦于针对工具增强场景的可靠幻觉检测。

title: Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering Researches (ICECER 2026)
summary: Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. Failure analysis revealed tests that omitted requirements, adopted candidate-defined schemas, used nondiscriminating fixtures, or repeated the implementation's incorrect logic. Fresh generation on ten targeted tasks produced 0/30 reference matches and 25/25 false passes among test-passing runs. These findings are diagnostic rather than causal: the pipelines differ in feedback, grounding, call budgets, and editing permissions, and the study uses one model and one primary generation per eligible task. Because pre-adjudication human labels were not retained, inter-rater agreement cannot be reconstructed and the mechanism analyses remain exploratory. Overall, increasingly successful self-generated tests did not establish semantic correctness, even after excluding unreproduced references.

AI.tldr: 论文研究代码生成中的“解释性锁定”现象，即错误理解在计划、实现和测试中持续存在。在30个DataFrame任务上对比三种方法，测试通过率虽提升但无生成方案匹配参考输出，揭示自生成测试无法确立语义正确性。
AI.motivation: 探究规划和修订过程中的解释性锁定风险，即错误的任务理解如何在生成流程中固化，导致即使测试通过也无法保证语义正确性。
AI.method: 在TPC Benchmark DS衍生的30个DataFrame任务上，对比Frozen One-Pass、Test-Guided Revision和PlanAudit-Guided Revision三种流程，使用单一模型和单次主生成，分析测试通过数、参考输出匹配、SQL重执行复现率、代码评分和测试覆盖率变化，并进行失败案例分析。
AI.result: 测试通过数从22/30提升至29/30和30/30，但0/30生成方案匹配参考输出；评估器控制57/57返回预期结果；SQL重执行复现28/30参考；所有77次测试通过运行仍失败参考一致性；PlanAudit在3/30任务提升代码分，11/30提升测试覆盖，但中位数配对变化均为零；失败分析显示测试遗漏需求、采用候选定义模式、使用非区分性固件或重复实现错误逻辑；针对性重新生成10任务产生0/30参考匹配和25/25假阳性通过。
AI.conclusion: 越来越成功的自生成测试无法确立语义正确性，即使排除不可复现参考。发现具有诊断性而非因果性，受限于流程差异、单模型、无预裁决人工标签，机制分析仍属探索性。

title: Beyond Adjacent Layers: Graph-Guided Layer Fusion for Compressing Large Language Models
summary: Existing depth-compression methods for large language models (LLMs) score layers individually or group only adjacent or contiguous layers, implicitly assuming that functional redundancy is local. We test this assumption by computing full pairwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity matrices for thirteen LLMs from six architecture families (1.6B-14B parameters). Non-adjacent layers have 3.6-15.9x more high-similarity pairs than adjacent ones, a structure that prior similarity-based layer merging has not systematically exploited. We propose Fusion via Community Mining (FCM), which builds the full L x L similarity graph, uses spectral community detection to find clusters of functionally equivalent layers, keeps the highest-Block-Influence layer in each cluster, and applies LoRA recovery; a pre-specified rule computed only on calibration data chooses between cosine and CKA similarity. At 2x compression, FCM lowers mean perplexity below ShortGPT on twelve of thirteen models, significantly on ten (Welch's t-test with Holm-Bonferroni correction; up to 50% on Qwen3-4B), with Mistral-7B the only loss (+13.4%). Against FlattenGPT, SWM, and DeltaLLM under matched calibration and recovery, FCM gives the best perplexity on ten of thirteen models (mean rank 1.15), and it also outperforms MKA on three anchor models. FCM matches or exceeds ShortGPT on 15 of 20 zero-shot reasoning cells and also improves MMLU, LAMBADA, HumanEval pass@1, and free-form generation quality. The 2x-compressed Qwen2.5-7B has 46% fewer parameters, 42% lower peak VRAM, and 84% higher decode throughput on a single A100. Spectral grouping outperforms Fisher contiguous segmentation by 41% and uniform partitioning by 51%, and FCM's advantage grows beyond a 2x crossover up to 3x and persists at the 14B scale. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion

AI.tldr: 论文提出融合社区挖掘 (FCM) 方法压缩大语言模型深度，打破了层冗余局限于相邻层的假设，通过谱聚类发现功能等价层簇并保留最高影响力层，配合 LoRA 恢复。在 2× 压缩下，FCM 在 12/13 个模型上超越 ShortGPT，平均排名 1.15 超过 FlattenGPT、SWM、DeltaLLM，且在零样本推理、MMLU、HumanEval 等指标上表现优异，推理吞吐提升 84%。
AI.motivation: 现有深度压缩方法假设层冗余仅存在于相邻层，但作者通过 13 个模型的全对 CKA 相似度矩阵发现：非相邻层的高相似度对数量是相邻层的 3.6-15.9 倍，说明功能冗余呈全局分布，亟需一种能利用全局相似结构的压缩方法。
AI.method: FCM 包含四步：(1) 构建 L×L 全层相似度图（余弦或 CKA，由校准数据预设规则选择）；(2) 谱社区检测挖掘功能等价层簇；(3) 每簇保留 Block-Influence 最高的层；(4) 对保留层施加 LoRA 微调恢复性能。
AI.result: 2× 压缩时：平均困惑度在 12/13 模型上低于 ShortGPT，10 个显著（Welch t 检验 + Holm-Bonferroni，Qwen3-4B 降 50%）；对比 FlattenGPT/SWM/DeltaLLM 取得 10/13 最优，平均排名 1.15；15/20 零样本推理任务匹配或超越 ShortGPT；MMLU、LAMBADA、HumanEval pass@1 及生成质量均提升。Qwen2.5-7B 压缩后参数 -46%，显存峰值 -42%，解码吞吐 +84%。谱分组比连续分割、均匀分区分别强 41%/51%，优势延伸至 3× 及 14B 规模。
AI.conclusion: FCM 通过全局相似度图谱聚类有效利用非局部层冗余，实现了更激进的深度压缩并保持甚至提升下游性能，展示了社区挖掘在 LLM 结构压缩中的通用性与可扩展性。

title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck
comment: Dilara*, Mike*, Akshat*, Shubham* contributed equally to this work
summary: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. In real settings, a single true evaluation, such as a full benchmark or serving trace, can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful of true evaluations. We present DuoDiscover, a search system that jointly discovers what to optimize and how to evaluate progress efficiently, through three mechanisms. First, each worker in a fleet of coding agents co-discovers an optimization target and a fast, tailored proxy evaluator, which we call a yardstick. The agent then hill-climbs the yardstick rather than the true evaluation. Second, since search can exploit gaps between a yardstick and the true objective, fidelity tests continually recheck each yardstick's ranking and invalidate any that drift. Third, the fleet is bottom-up, with no central decomposition of the problem. A lightweight orchestrator spawns and terminates agents, briefs running ones, and seeds new agents with others' confirmed work. DuoDiscover enables autonomous optimization from software to chip architecture. We demonstrate DuoDiscover on two repository-level benchmarks and four GPU and TPU kernel suites covering hundreds of kernels. On SWE-fficiency, it doubles the average speedup of human experts. On SOL-Exec, it ranks first on 121 of 235 kernels and in the top three on 212. On the heavily optimized vLLM and SQLite engines, DuoDiscover achieves 1.92$\times$ and 1.38$\times$ gains over the base code. On a CPU microarchitecture optimization task with evaluations of up to 28 hours, DuoDiscover surpasses both AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and the best human design, with 1.65$\times$ ArchAgent v2's gain in 16.7 days versus more than 40 days, advancing the frontier of autonomous chip design.

AI.tldr: DuoDiscover 是一个自主发现系统，通过编码代理群协同发现优化目标与快速代理评估器（yardstick），结合保真度测试与轻量级编排器，在软件到芯片架构层面实现高效自主优化，在多个基准上超越人类专家与现有自动化方法。
AI.motivation: 自主发现在现实工程挑战中面临根本瓶颈：真实评估（如完整基准测试或服务追踪）耗时数小时，导致搜索只能负担极少量的真实评估，严重限制了自主发现的规模化应用。
AI.method: DuoDiscover 采用三大机制：1) 编码代理群协同发现优化目标与定制化快速代理评估器，在代理评估器上爬山而非真实评估；2) 保真度测试持续复核代理评估器的排序一致性，失效则作废；3) 自底向上的代理群架构，轻量级编排器负责生成/终止代理、简报运行中代理、用已验证成果播种新代理，无中心化问题分解。
AI.result: 在 SWE-fficiency 上平均加速比达人类专家 2 倍；在 SOL-Exec 上 235 个内核中 121 个排名第一、212 个进入前三；在 vLLM 与 SQLite 等高度优化引擎上分别实现 1.92× 与 1.38× 加速；在 CPU 微架构优化任务（单次评估长达 28 小时）中，以 16.7 天超越 AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 与最佳人类设计，增益为后者的 1.65 倍。
AI.conclusion: DuoDiscover 通过联合发现优化目标与高效评估机制，打破了自主发现中的评估成本瓶颈，在软件工程与芯片架构设计任务上均显著超越人类专家与现有自动化方法，推动了自主芯片设计与代码优化的前沿。

title: Attention Sinks in VLMs Are Borrowed, Not Seen
summary: We study how to detect and mitigate visual attention sinks in vision-language models (VLMs). Visual attention sinks are image tokens that absorb a large share of attention over the image regardless of the query or task, and they mislead methods that treat attention maps as a record of where the model ``looked.'' Prior work has detected sinks through massive activation dimensions and proposed redistributing their attention, but none have addressed what makes a token become a sink. Comparing six candidate detectors on ten VLMs from four families, we find that only the centered cosine similarity between an image token's key and the key of the language model's text-sink detects visual sinks. Thus, a visual sink is an image token whose key aligns with the text-sink's key. Moving a sink's key component along this direction to the median of the image keys sends its attention back to the text-sink (\textbf{Are Borrowed}) while leaving model answers unchanged~(\textbf{Not Seen}). Building on this, we propose a training-free, entropy-triggered re-look that first cleans the attention map, then crops the most-attended region of the cleaned map and inserts it into the reasoning trace. Cleaning adds negligible computation to the forward pass, and the re-look improves accuracy with a mean gain of $+4.3$ points on fine-detail VQA benchmarks across model families.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中的视觉注意力汇聚点（visual attention sinks）检测与缓解方法。作者发现只有图像token的键与语言模型文本汇聚点键的中心余弦相似度能可靠检测视觉汇聚点，并提出一种无需训练的基于熵触发的“重看”机制：先清理注意力图，再裁剪清理后最高注意力区域插入推理轨迹，在细节型VQA基准上平均提升4.3点准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将注意力图视为模型“注视位置”的记录，但视觉注意力汇聚点（即无论查询或任务如何都吸收大量注意力的图像token）会误导这种解读。先前工作仅通过巨大激活维度检测汇聚点并重新分配注意力，未探究token为何成为汇聚点的根本原因。
AI.method: 1. 在四大模型家族的十个VLM上比较六种候选检测器，发现仅图像token键与语言模型文本汇聚点键的中心余弦相似度能准确识别视觉汇聚点。2. 证明视觉汇聚点本质是其键与文本汇聚点键对齐的图像token；将汇聚点键沿此方向移至图像键的中位数，可使其注意力回流至文本汇聚点（Are Borrowed）且不改变模型答案。3. 基此提出训练自由、熵触发的重看流程：清理注意力图（计算开销可忽略），裁剪清理后最高注意力区域并插入推理轨迹。
AI.result: 提出的重看机制在细节型VQA基准上跨模型家族平均提升准确率+4.3点，且清理注意力图仅增加微小前向计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 视觉注意力汇聚点可通过键空间对齐文本汇聚点键来精确定义和检测；基于此的无训练重看策略能有效缓解汇聚点干扰，显著提升VLM在细粒度视觉问答任务上的表现。

title: LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications
summary: Canonicalization resolves the rotational and permutation ambiguity of 3D point clouds by selecting a unique orbit representative, maintaining their geometric information while allowing standard architectures, such as Transformers, to operate on them. Existing canonicalizations, however, exhibit discontinuity jumps on molecular configurations and non-trivial invariance errors in popular molecular datasets, which lead to ambiguity in their representation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LexiCan, a canonicalization that is provably invariant under either $O(3)$ or $SO(3)$, empirically invariant to rotations to within $\sim 10^{-6}$ angstroms on the QM9 and QM-sym molecular datasets, and mitigates discontinuity jumps on QM-sym, while running orders of magnitude faster than an existing canonicalization. Finally, non-invariant models perform better on QM9 property prediction and ModelNet40 shape classification with LexiCan than with that canonicalization.

AI.tldr: LexiCan 是一种新的规范化方法，用于 3D 点云，具有可证明的 O(3)/SO(3) 不变性，在分子数据集上实现极高精度的旋转不变性（~10^{-6} 埃），消除不连续跳跃，且速度更快，能提升非不变模型在分子性质预测和形状分类任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的规范化方法在分子构型上存在不连续跳跃，且在常用分子数据集上存在非平凡的不变性误差，导致表示模糊，限制了标准架构（如 Transformer）在 3D 点云上的应用。
AI.method: 提出 LexiCan，一种可证明在 O(3) 或 SO(3) 下不变的规范化方法，通过选择唯一的轨道代表来消除旋转和排列歧义，保持几何信息。
AI.result: 在 QM9 和 QM-sym 数据集上，LexiCan 实现了 ~10^{-6} 埃级别的旋转不变性，缓解了 QM-sym 上的不连续跳跃，运行速度比现有规范化快数个数量级。使用 LexiCan 的非不变模型在 QM9 性质预测和 ModelNet40 形状分类任务上优于使用现有规范化的模型。
AI.conclusion: LexiCan 解决了现有规范化方法的不连续性和不变性误差问题，提供了一种高效、精确且理论保证的规范化方案，显著提升了下游任务性能。

title: Soft Teacher Forcing
summary: Soft tokens have so far been used to replace discrete chain-of-thought in latent reasoning methods. These approaches typically require multi-stage training and, in some cases, auxiliary modules, yet they still underperform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on <input, chain-of-thought, output> triples. In this paper, we ask whether soft tokens can be used to improve SFT itself, instead of as an avenue for latent reasoning. We introduce Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF), a simple training algorithm that combines teacher-forced embeddings with soft tokens through random convex combinations. The soft tokens are computed in a single parallel forward pass over the ground-truth sequence. Soft-TF adds no parameters, no external model and no curriculum, and leaves inference unchanged. Experiments show that Soft-TF improves over SFT on GSM8K, MATH, MathQA and AQuA, by +2.1 to +4.1 points on GSM8K across seven Gemma, Llama and Mistral models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF)，一种简单的训练算法，通过将教师强制嵌入与软标记随机凸组合，在不增加参数、外部模型或课程学习的情况下提升监督微调（SFT）性能，在多个数学推理基准上取得+2.1到+4.1点的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在推理方法使用软标记替代离散思维链，但通常需要多阶段训练和辅助模块，且性能仍不如标准SFT。作者探索软标记是否能直接改进SFT本身，而非作为潜在推理的替代方案。
AI.method: Soft-TF将教师强制嵌入与软标记通过随机凸组合融合。软标记通过对真实序列的单次并行前向传播计算获得。该方法无额外参数、无外部模型、无课程学习，推理阶段保持不变。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、MathQA和AQuA四个数学推理基准上，Soft-TF在七个Gemma、Llama和Mistral模型上均优于标准SFT，GSM8K上提升+2.1至+4.1点。
AI.conclusion: Soft-TF是一种轻量级、即插即用的训练技术，通过简单的嵌入插值有效增强SFT在数学推理任务上的表现，为软标记在监督微调中的应用提供了新范式。

title: Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory
summary: A stored fact may stop being valid when a user changes a preference or an event replaces an earlier one. We study whether a language model can learn these changes in its parameters and answer correctly from only a question and the current time. Engram Injection stores facts in LoRA adapters and supplies the clock through FiLM conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model. We compare it with additive clock conditioning, prompting with the full dated history, and retrieving four dated records. We train six matched adapters across three seeds after fixing a sampler that could admit test-age examples into training. The training audit reports no such examples among 127,760 evaluated training inputs. On 62 pairs of questions asked before and after an update, at an elapsed age of seven days excluded from training, both adapter methods answer zero pairs correctly under the primary blinded assistant review with order code 1 held fixed.
