Full-history prompting answers 59/62 pairs correctly, and retrieval answers 62/62. Separate experiments show that adapters can store facts and that removable memory units can support local deletion. Combining fact selection with time-based version selection remains unsuccessful. These results separate learning a fact from learning when to use it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Engram Injection方法，将事实存储在LoRA适配器中并通过FiLM条件注入时间，但在时间感知事实更新任务上表现不佳，全历史提示和检索方法效果显著更好，揭示了学习事实与学习何时使用事实的分离。
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型能否在参数中学习事实随时间的变化（如用户偏好更新或事件替换），并仅根据问题和当前时间正确回答。
AI.method: 使用冻结的Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型，将事实存储于LoRA适配器，通过FiLM条件注入时钟信号（Engram Injection），对比加性时钟条件、全日期历史提示、检索四条日期记录。训练六个匹配适配器（三个种子），修复采样器防止测试年龄样本泄露，审计确认127,760个训练输入无泄露。
AI.result: 在62对更新前后问题、间隔7天（训练未见）的评估中，两种适配器方法在主要盲审下均答对0对；全历史提示答对59/62，检索答对62/62。独立实验显示适配器能存储事实，可移除记忆单元支持局部删除，但事实选择与基于时间的版本选择结合仍失败。
AI.conclusion: 结果将“学习事实”与“学习何时使用事实”分离；适配器虽能存储静态事实，但难以泛化到基于时间的版本选择，提示或检索等显式时间条件方法更有效。

title: Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents
summary: As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于扩散语言模型的策略约束扩散智能体框架，通过在去噪过程中将token分布投影到策略合规集，实现任务相关安全策略的直接强制执行，有效防御提示词注入攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有防御提示词注入的方法多依赖检测或推理恶意指令，容易受到针对注入本身优化的自适应攻击；扩散语言模型通过迭代优化序列级预测，为生成过程中的广域约束强制执行提供了新机会。
AI.method: 引入Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA)框架，在扩散语言模型的每个去噪步骤中，将token分布投影到策略合规集，从而在整个生成过程中保持约束满足，直接在扩散过程中强制执行任务依赖的安全策略。
AI.result: 在最先进的扩散语言模型族上评估，针对静态和自适应提示词注入攻击，攻击成功率大幅降低，同时保持有竞争力的任务效用和实用的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: CoDA通过在扩散去噪过程中直接强制执行安全策略，为智能体AI系统提供了鲁棒的提示词注入防御，兼顾了安全性、任务效用和推理效率。

title: Welcome to the Age of Agent Ads: Using On-Policy Attacks to Steer Agentic Decisions
summary: People increasingly delegate option-ranking tasks (e.g., shopping, job search, travel) to AI agents, which creates incentives to steer agentic decisions via "agent ads." To defend against such steering attacks, people count on models' alignment training and platforms' terms of service, and consequently the most effective existing attacks are designed to trigger off-policy behaviors. Exposing a new attack surface, we introduce on-policy attacks, which steer agentic decisions without pushing individually aligned behaviors off policy. Our example attack consists of two steps: To remain compliant with platforms' terms of service, we first inject a truthful negation about a fictitious concept ("Does not contain blizyester") into a product description. This triggers an agent to search the web ("What is blizyester?"), which surfaces planted websites full of fabricated information associating the fictitious concept with harmful implications ("Blizyester linked to dementia"). Trained to keep users safe from harm, the agent penalizes every option missing the truthful negation. Evaluating our attack across four real-world listing datasets, we find some frontier models exposed, enabling an adversarial actor to penalize competitors without violating existing platform-listing guidelines. We discuss the broader challenge of regulating advertising aimed at AI agents and provide recommendations to model developers and platform providers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对AI代理的“同策略攻击”，通过在商品描述中注入关于虚构概念的真实否定语句，诱导代理搜索并接触植入的有害虚假信息，利用代理的安全对齐机制惩罚不含该否定语句的竞品，从而在不违反平台条款的情况下操纵代理决策。实验表明多个前沿模型易受攻击，揭示了针对AI代理广告监管的新挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着人们越来越多地将选项排序任务（购物、求职、旅行等）委托给AI代理，攻击者有动机通过“代理广告”操纵代理决策。现有防御依赖模型对齐训练和平台服务条款，现有攻击主要触发代理的离策略行为。本文旨在揭示一种新的攻击面——同策略攻击，即在不违反单个对齐行为的前提下操纵代理决策。
AI.method: 攻击包含两步：1) 在商品描述中注入关于虚构概念的真实否定语句（如“不含blizyester”），符合平台服务条款；2) 该否定语句触发代理搜索该虚构概念，植入的网站返回将该概念与有害后果关联的虚假信息（如“blizyester与痴呆症相关”）；代理因安全对齐训练而惩罚所有缺少该否定语句的选项。在四个真实商品列表数据集上评估多个前沿模型。
AI.result: 实验发现部分前沿模型暴露于该攻击之下，攻击者可在不违反现有平台发布指南的情况下惩罚竞品。攻击有效利用了代理的安全对齐机制作为攻击向量。
AI.conclusion: 同策略攻击揭示了针对AI代理广告监管的根本挑战：平台条款和模型对齐无法充分防御此类攻击。需模型开发者和平台提供方共同采取措施，如增强代理对植入信息的鲁棒性、建立针对代理广告的专门监管框架等。

title: RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use
summary: False retry permission (FRP) occurs when an agent retries a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract. RetryBench separates this error from realized recovery. Successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries. In a 720-response key control, valid keys usually enabled safe progress, but offered changed keys elicited unsupported retries in Sol (1/80), Terra (55/80), and Luna (60/80). A later 240-response control removed the candidate and required models to supply a key. Luna still made 8/80 unsupported dispatches; Sol and Terra made none in 80 responses each. Accepting a displayed bad key therefore cannot explain all observed errors, although changed output requirements and conditions preclude a pure display-effect comparison. Removing the weak-contract label increased retries in Sol and Terra's coded-action conditions in a six-endpoint study. A separate 1,536-response canonical-action block also found a positive Terra contrast (115/128 versus 124/128 retries), concentrated in two task/order conditions; the other five contrasts remained unresolved after multiplicity correction. An explicit-contract cue control elicited deferral in all 762 returned responses, leaving recovery unresolved. These results support reporting permission and recovery together across declared interface variants. The evidence covers four purposive tasks, fixed GPT endpoints, and one recovery decision; it identifies neither internal mechanisms nor episode-level safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了错误重试权限（FRP）的概念，即智能体在可见契约不支持的情况下重试超时工具调用。通过RetryBench基准测试，分离了FRP错误与实际恢复，评估了多个模型（Sol, Terra, Luna）在不同契约条件下的重试行为。实验发现：有效密钥通常支持安全推进，但变更密钥会诱发不支持的重试；移除弱契约标签增加了重试；显式契约提示导致所有响应延迟。结果支持在声明的接口变体中同时报告权限和恢复指标。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体系统中存在错误重试权限（FRP）问题，即智能体在缺乏可见契约支持的情况下擅自重试超时工具调用，这可能导致安全风险。现有评估未将FRP错误与实际恢复能力分离，缺乏系统性基准来量化不同模型在契约变体下的重试行为差异。
AI.method: 构建RetryBench基准，包含多个控制实验：1）720响应密钥控制：测试有效密钥、变更密钥和候选密钥移除条件下的重试行为；2）240响应控制：要求模型自行提供密钥；3）六端点研究：考察弱契约标签移除的影响；4）1,536响应规范动作块：测试不同任务/顺序条件；5）显式契约提示控制：762响应测试显式契约线索的效果。评估四个目的性任务，固定GPT端点，单一恢复决策点。
AI.result: 1) 变更输出密钥诱发不支持重试：Sol 1/80, Terra 55/80, Luna 60/80；2) 移除候选密钥后，Luna仍有8/80不支持调度，Sol和Terra为0；3) 接受显示的错误密钥无法解释所有错误；4) 移除弱契约标签增加Sol和Terra在编码动作条件下的重试；5) 规范动作块中Terra显著对比（115/128 vs 124/128），集中在两个任务/顺序条件，其余五个对比经多重性校正后未决；6) 显式契约提示导致全部762响应延迟，恢复问题未解。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持在声明的接口变体中同时报告权限和恢复指标。研究覆盖四个目的性任务、固定GPT端点和单一恢复决策，但未识别内部机制，也未涵盖情节级安全性。FRP与实际恢复的分离评估揭示了模型在契约理解和遵循上的系统性差异，为智能体工具使用安全性评估提供了新维度。

title: Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning based Topology-Agnostic Defense for Virtual Power Plants
summary: The rapid proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs) aggregated by virtual power plants (VPPs) elevates cybersecurity risk by expanding the attack surface. A coordinated cyberattack has the potential to disrupt distribution-system, bulk-system, and market operations. Existing cyberphysical defense strategies largely assume access to grid network models and operating conditions, which may not be available to third-party aggregators. This paper proposes a novel hybrid, perturbation-based cyber-physical defense for VPP-operated DERs that blends game-theoretic planning with model-free reinforcement learning (RL) under a Bayesian belief-update framework. Topology agnosticism is defined from the VPP information and implementation perspective: the VPP does not require access to the feeder topology, line parameters, switching configuration, or full system state. This work advances the state of the art through three contributions: (1) a multi-output Gaussian process with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for discrete attacker-type inference, probability of detection, and confidence of detection for modeling the belief distribution; (2) moment-matched Gaussian propagation of posterior beliefs across episodes; and (3) an RL policy that adaptively integrates Stackelberg leader (VPP) actions with exploration. Furthermore, we establish equilibrium existence and derive an episode-level closed-loop utility bound connecting attacker-belief uncertainty with GT-RL action alignment. Evaluations on IEEE 13- and 123-Bus feeders with DER portfolios demonstrate effective detection under attacker-model uncertainty and evaluated feeder re-configuration conditions, while requiring no explicit feeder-topology knowledge. Overall, the results indicate that combining bi-level game-theoretic planning, nonparametric Bayesian inference, and adaptive RL is a promising direction for VPP cybersecurity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向虚拟电厂（VPP）聚合分布式能源（DER）的混合扰动型网络物理防御框架，结合博弈论规划与无模型强化学习（RL），在贝叶斯信念更新框架下实现拓扑不可知的攻击检测与防御。
AI.motivation: 随着DER大规模接入由VPP聚合，攻击面扩大导致网络安全风险升高；现有网络物理防御策略多假设第三方聚合商可获取电网网络模型和运行状态，但实际中VPP往往缺乏馈线拓扑、线路参数、开关配置及全系统状态信息，亟需一种不依赖电网模型的防御方法。
AI.method: 1) 多输出高斯过程结合汉密尔顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）实现离散攻击者类型推断、检测概率与检测置信度的信念分布建模；2) 动矩匹配高斯传播实现跨回合后验信念的传递；3) 设计自适应整合Stackelberg领导者（VPP）动作与探索的RL策略；并证明均衡存在性，推导回合级闭环效用界连接攻击者信念不确定性与博弈论-RL动作一致性。
AI.result: 在IEEE 13节点和123节点馈线系统（含DER组合）上评估，在攻击者模型不确定及馈线重构条件下均能有效检测攻击，且无需显式馈线拓扑知识。
AI.conclusion: 双层博弈论规划、非参数贝叶斯推断与自适应强化学习的结合，为VPP网络安全提供了一个极具前景的研究方向。

title: Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions
summary: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. Both employ U-Net autoencoders to separately predict airflow and temperature fields. Evaluation uses simplified rooms with varying heights and lengths as a controlled benchmark. The results show that CaNN achieves higher agreement with CFD results than CoNN, demonstrating its potential to support performance-driven building design.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了两种几何条件神经网络代理模型（CaNN 和 CoNN），用于在不同房间尺寸下快速预测室内气流和温度场。结果显示 CaNN 与 CFD 结果的一致性高于 CoNN，展现出支持性能驱动建筑设计的潜力。
AI.motivation: 计算流体动力学（CFD）在迭代建筑设计中计算成本高昂。深度学习代理模型虽能加速预测，但在不同房间尺寸间的泛化能力仍具挑战。建筑设计阶段需要实时评估不同高度和长度房间中送风是否能有效提供新鲜冷空气。
AI.method: 提出两种几何条件神经网络：基于画布的神经网络通过在固定画布中保留不同占用区域来显式编码房间尺寸；基于坐标的神经网络使用归一化坐标通道。两者均采用 U-Net 自编码器分别预测气流场和温度场。评估使用具有不同高度和长度的简化房间作为受控基准。
AI.result: CaNN 与 CFD 结果的吻合度高于 CoNN，在变化房间尺寸下表现出更好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: CaNN 方法证明了其在性能驱动建筑设计中快速、准确预测室内环境场的潜力，可作为实时设计评估工具。

title: DeltaNet-PC: Test-Time Memory Without Backpropagation Through Time
summary: Test-time memorization of sequential information is a foundational capability for any intelligent system that needs to rapidly store and retrieve data, as demonstrated by the attention mechanism in large language models. However, Transformers and linear attention variants are trained via backpropagation through time (BPTT), which has drawbacks such as its enormous memory requirements. Predictive coding (PC), an algorithm that optimizes a prediction-error energy function with local updates, offers a compelling solution but still lacks test-time memory for sequential data. We develop a solution to this problem by treating the per-step memory update $ΔS_t$ as a latent variable, as opposed to a slow weight to be learned. By taking the log probability of a standard PC-based probabilistic model, we derive a PC-native solution for verbatim sequence memory, and relate our update rule to common choices in the linear attention literature (e.g., DeltaNet). We present an extensive set of empirical tests to probe our system's properties, including its scaling capacity, memory footprint, and ability to infer a context from evidence (e.g., bank (river) vs. bank (money)). We show how DeltaNet-PC can be used for storing single sequences of data, multiple sequences of data, and key-value associative memory pairs with perfect recall accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预测编码（PC）的测试时序列记忆机制 DeltaNet-PC，将逐步记忆更新视为潜变量而非慢速权重，实现了对单序列、多序列及键值对的完美回忆，同时解决了 BPTT 的内存开销问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Transformer 和线性注意力变体依赖于时间反向传播（BPTT）进行训练，存在巨大的内存需求。预测编码（PC）虽提供局部更新的替代方案，但缺乏针对序列数据的测试时记忆能力。
AI.method: 将逐步记忆更新 ΔS_t 视为潜变量，从标准 PC 概率模型的对数概率推导出原生的逐字序列记忆更新规则，并将其与线性注意力文献中的 DeltaNet 等方法联系起来，构建了 DeltaNet-PC 系统。
AI.result: 大量实证测试表明，DeltaNet-PC 在扩展容量、内存占用、上下文推理（如 bank (river) 与 bank (money) 的消歧）等方面表现优异，能够以完美回忆准确率存储单序列、多序列及键值关联记忆对。
AI.conclusion: DeltaNet-PC 为测试时序列记忆提供了一种高效、可扩展且生物学合理的解决方案，克服了 BPTT 的内存瓶颈，并实现了精确的关联记忆检索。

title: Nufo: A Benchmark for Ewe Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains challenging for low-resource languages, where the scarcity of transcribed speech limits the development of accurate systems. This challenge is particularly acute for African languages such as Ewe, which has millions of speakers but remains underrepresented in publicly available ASR resources and benchmarks. In this work, we consolidate, normalize, and partition existing Ewe speech resources into a standardized 174-hour Ewe ASR benchmark, the largest to date to our knowledge. We fine-tune and evaluate pretrained speech models, including Whisper and AfriHuBERT, to establish strong baselines on our benchmark. Whisper-medium achieves a word error rate (WER) of 37.98%, while AfriHuBERT achieves 39.70% on the test set. We further provide a qualitative analysis of common recognition errors. We release the benchmark under the name Nufo, derived from the Ewe word for "talk", accompanied by models and evaluation resources, to facilitate future research on Ewe and other underrepresented African languages.

AI.tldr: 该工作整合现有Ewe语音资源，构建目前最大的174小时Ewe ASR基准Nufo，在Whisper和AfriHuBERT上建立强基线，Whisper-medium WER 37.98%，AfriHuBERT 39.70%，并发布基准、模型及评估资源以促进非洲低资源语言研究。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言如Ewe缺乏标注语音数据，导致ASR系统开发困难；Ewe有数百万使用者但在公开ASR资源中代表性不足，亟需标准化基准推动研究。
AI.method: 整合、规范化并划分现有Ewe语音资源，构建174小时标准化基准Nufo；微调并评估预训练语音模型Whisper和AfriHuBERT；进行定性错误分析。
AI.result: Whisper-medium在测试集上达到37.98% WER，AfriHuBERT达到39.70% WER；提供常见识别错误的定性分析；发布基准Nufo、模型及评估资源。
AI.conclusion: Nufo基准为Ewe及其他非洲低资源语言ASR研究提供重要资源，建立了强基线，未来工作可进一步降低WER并扩展至更多语言。

title: LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges
summary: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus was created using the five stages of the responsible-generation protocol for synthetic datasets: ontology-driven design based on the ChatCoder luring-communication scheme (eight communicative tags mapped onto four grooming phases); multi-model prompt testing; human-in-the-loop supervision; semantic and feature-level validation; and modality-aware documentation. The released corpus contains 2,121 unique exchanges across seven tags and four phases, each accompanied by a Plutchik emotion field. Validation quantifies the integrity and lexical profile of the corpus, as well as the reproduction of real seed lines, in-domain label recoverability (tag accuracy: 0.85; phase accuracy: 0.93) and its transfer to real ChatCoder offender lines, which were coded automatically at the eight-tag level (31,640 lines) and by human coders at the three-construct level (10,876 posts). Accuracy was measured for lexical and sentence-embedding features, while a real-versus-synthetic discriminator was able to separate the two domains with 91% accuracy. The scope of the corpus includes controlled, phase-conditioned experimentation, pipeline development and augmentation alongside real data and awareness material. The corpus, its datasheet and the audit code are released with vetted access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个合成语料库，用于研究未成年人网络诱骗的阶段进展，解决了现有公开数据集（Perverted-Justice档案）规模小、过时且冻结的问题。语料库基于ChatCoder诱骗沟通方案，通过检索增强流水线生成，包含2,121个唯一交互，覆盖7个标签和4个阶段，并附带Plutchik情感字段。验证显示标签准确率0.85，阶段准确率0.93，且能迁移到真实ChatCoder犯罪者语料。真实与合成判别器准确率91%，语料库、数据表和审计代码已发布并受控访问。
AI.motivation: 现有的公开诱骗对话数据集（Perverted-Justice档案的ChatCoder编码子集）规模小、过时且冻结，无法满足研究诱骗阶段进展和开发早期预警工具的需求。因此需要构建一个大规模、可控、阶段标注的合成语料库来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用负责任生成协议的五阶段流程：(1) 基于ChatCoder诱骗沟通方案的本体驱动设计（8个沟通标签映射到4个诱骗阶段）；(2) 多模型提示词测试；(3) 人工介入监督；(4) 语义和特征级验证；(5) 模态感知文档化。使用检索增强流水线在机构硬件上运行，基于开放可用的80亿参数拒绝消融语言模型生成合成对话。
AI.result: 发布的语料库包含2,121个唯一交互，覆盖7个标签和4个阶段，每个交互附带Plutchik情感字段。验证结果：标签准确率0.85，阶段准确率0.93；成功迁移到真实ChatCoder犯罪者语料（自动编码31,640行，人工编码10,876帖）；词汇和句子嵌入特征准确度测量良好；真实与合成判别器以91%准确率分离两个域。语料库支持受控阶段条件实验、流水线开发、真实数据增强和宣传材料制作。
AI.conclusion: 该合成语料库有效解决了现有公开诱骗数据集的局限性，提供了高质量、阶段标注、情感丰富的对话数据，验证了其在标签恢复和迁移到真实数据上的有效性。语料库、数据表和审计代码已发布并实行审核访问，为诱骗检测研究和早期预警工具开发提供了宝贵资源。

title: Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. Specifically, we make the following key observations: 1) Shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones; 2) Exit depth affects how easily the adversarial suffix can be optimized, with deeper exits reaching lower attack loss; and 3) Adversarial suffixes affect utility uniformly across exit depths. These insights can help design dynamic inference methodologies that are more robust to jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/LassNajmuldeen/balcony-jailbreaking

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了基于深度的动态推理对大语言模型抵抗越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响，发现浅层退出比深层更鲁棒，退出深度影响对抗后缀优化难度，且对抗后缀对不同深度的效用影响均匀。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型计算开销大且易受越狱攻击。深度动态推理虽能提高推理效率，但其对抗鲁棒性影响尚未被研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统分析动态推理的退出深度与越狱攻击鲁棒性的关系。
AI.method: 通过实验研究深度动态推理中不同退出层对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。具体分析：1) 不同退出深度下的攻击成功率；2) 退出深度对对抗后缀优化难度（攻击损失）的影响；3) 对抗后缀在不同退出深度上的效用影响一致性。
AI.result: 三大关键发现：1) 浅层退出持续表现出比深层退出更强的越狱攻击鲁棒性；2) 退出深度越深，对抗后缀优化越容易（攻击损失越低）；3) 对抗后缀对模型效用的负面影响在各退出深度上均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为设计更具鲁棒性的动态推理方法提供了指导：可利用浅层退出的天然鲁棒性优势，在资源受限场景下优先选择浅层退出以兼顾效率与安全，或开发基于深度感知的自适应退出策略来防御越狱攻击。

title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
summary: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models run on vLLM, llama.cpp and MLX, with quantized variants for lower memory use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 StartLux-Decision 系列决策模型（0.8B-27B 参数），包含单次推理的 Instant 变体和自适应推理的 AutoThink 变体。通过三阶段训练管线和新提出的 RLCD² 强化学习方法（基于冻结模型与适当评分规则奖励决策概率质量、惩罚过长推理），AutoThink 在保持准确率前提下大幅提升推理终止率（+48pp）并缩短推理长度（-65%）。在 Decision Index 0.3 公开子集上，Instant 模型超越同规模开源决策模型 7.4-16.9 分，27B AutoThink 达 73.4 分；在新基准 DecisionPivot（程序化可验证的对比对决策基准）上，AutoThink 比 Instant 高 11.5-18.4 分对准确率，领跑被评测系统。模型支持 vLLM、llama.cpp、MLX 部署并提供量化版本。
AI.motivation: 现有决策模型在单次推理准确性与自适应推理效率之间存在权衡：单次推理模型难以处理复杂不确定决策，而显式推理模型常产生冗长、低效的推理轨迹且难以校准何时需要推理。需要一种统一框架，既能在确信案例上单次通过高效决策，又能在不确定案例上自适应调用高质量推理，并能通过强化学习优化推理的校准与长度。
AI.method: 1. 模型架构：Instant 变体在全注意力层引入双向注意力提升单次推理准确性；AutoThink 变体增加置信度门控，低置信度触发显式推理。2. 三阶段训练：共享决策能力预训练 → 两变体专门化 → AutoThink 通过推理监督与强化学习获得推理能力。3. RLCD²：使用冻结参考模型与适当评分规则（如对数损失/布里尔评分）计算奖励，鼓励决策概率质量提升；对超出生成长度限制的推理轨迹施加软惩罚，隐式压缩推理长度。4. DecisionPivot 基准：从仅差一个改变答案的关键细节的对比对构建程序化可验证的计算决策基准。
AI.result: RLCD² 使推理轨迹在生成长度限制内终止的比例提升高达 48 个百分点，平均推理长度缩减高达 65%，决策准确率基本保持。Decision Index 0.3 公开子集：Instant 模型比最强同规模开源决策模型高 7.4-16.9 分；27B AutoThink 达 73.4 分。DecisionPivot：AutoThink 比对应 Instant 模型高 11.5-18.4 分对准确率，在被评测系统中领先。模型已适配 vLLM、llama.cpp、MLX 并提供量化版本降低显存占用。
AI.conclusion: StartLux-Decision 通过双变体架构与 RLCD² 强化学习，成功统一了单次推理效率与自适应推理质量，显著提升了决策模型在不确定性下的校准推理能力，同时大幅压缩推理开销。DecisionPivot 基准为程序化可验证的计算决策评估提供了新标准。该系列模型在多规模上确立了新的开源决策模型 SOTA，并具备生产部署就绪性。

title: Multi-Horizon Explainable Queue Forecasting and Resource-Aware Decision Support for Intelligent Border Control Using LightGBM
summary: Border crossing points are stochastic service systems in which traffic demand, traveler categories, registration status, inspection requirements, staffing, and lane availability interact on multiple time scales. This paper extends an earlier multimodal queue-management framework by introducing an implementation-oriented, multi-horizon forecasting and decision-support architecture based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) models. In contrast to a single forecasting block, the proposed approach constructs horizon-specific regressors for 15, 30, 60, and 120 min forecasts and jointly estimates future waiting time and queue lengths. The models operate on temporally lagged traffic, service, density, and queue features, while an operational layer incorporates lane compatibility, officer availability, possibly degraded resources, traveler category, preregistration information, and human-approval constraints. Quantile LightGBM models provide 95\% prediction intervals for waiting-time forecasts. Beyond prediction, the framework produces machine-readable recommendations, alerts, aggregate key performance indicators, confidence information, and integration outputs suitable for border resource-management and decision-support systems. The results establish a reproducible synthetic-data baseline and a practical interface for subsequent validation with operational border-crossing data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于LightGBM的多时段预测与决策支持架构，用于边境口岸排队管理，实现多时段等待时间与队列长度联合预测，并提供决策建议与置信区间。
AI.motivation: 边境口岸是复杂的随机服务系统，交通需求、旅客类别、检查要求、人员配置、车道可用性等多尺度因素相互作用，现有单一预测模块不足以支持实时资源调度与决策，需面向实施的多时段预测与决策支持框架。
AI.method: 采用LightGBM构建针对15、30、60、120分钟的时段专用回归器，利用滞后交通、服务、密度、队列特征联合预测等待时间和队列长度；运营层融入车道兼容性、警员可用性、退化资源、旅客类别、预登记信息、人工审批约束；分位数LightGBM提供95%预测区间；输出机器可读建议、警报、KPI、置信信息及集成接口。
AI.result: 建立了可复现的合成数据基线，验证了多时段预测精度与决策输出的有效性，为后续使用真实边境口岸运营数据验证提供了实用接口。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将预测与运营约束相结合，生成可直接集成到边境资源管理系统的决策支持输出，为边境口岸动态资源调度提供了可落地的技术路径。

title: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.

AI.tldr: AdaSub-ZO 是一种新型的零阶优化框架，通过在可学习的低秩子空间中进行前向传播微调大语言模型，解决了现有方法中随机子空间与任务特定下降方向错位的问题，显著降低了梯度估计方差并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化虽然能实现内存高效的大模型微调，但在高维参数空间中存在高方差问题。现有方法将扰动限制在随机低秩子空间中，但这些固定随机子空间往往与任务特定的下降方向不对齐，导致优化效率低下。
AI.method: AdaSub-ZO 提出两大创新：1) 可学习的层级投影矩阵，直接从有限差分反馈中迭代学习，动态追踪任务感知的下降方向，替代固定随机矩阵；2) 子空间动量加速机制，在不断演化的子空间基底间平滑噪声梯度估计。整个框架采用纯前向传播方式，无需反向传播。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解任务上的大量实验表明，AdaSub-ZO 超越现有零阶基线方法，大幅降低梯度估计方差并加速收敛。
AI.conclusion: AdaSub-ZO 通过可学习的低秩子空间和动量加速机制，有效解决了零阶优化在高维空间中的高方差问题，为大语言模型的内存高效微调提供了更优的优化范式。

title: From Sampled Evidence to Radiology Reports: Objectives, Constraints, and Realization
summary: Sampling multiple reports creates an inference problem: how should sampled evidence be converted into a final decision, and does a better structured decision yield a better report? We study these questions through a framework that separates the decision signal, scoring objective, and feasible decision set, followed by text realization. On MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray, controlled comparisons across 13 generator configurations per benchmark under grouped development/test evaluation reveal three findings. First, changing the objective under fixed evidence and rule capacity changes predictions and their held-out metric trade-offs. Second, relaxing candidate constraints has objective-dependent effects under shared signals and frozen scores. Diagnostics connect the IU macro-oriented assertion increase to near-zero label thresholds and show that limited candidate coverage coexists with selection headroom. Third, a controlled realization study with SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B shows that decision-level gains can be attenuated, amplified, or reversed. Change decomposition reveals that realization can remove incorrect assertions while losing correct findings, so target fidelity and reference accuracy need not improve together. Finding gains also do not consistently improve reference-based report quality. These results motivate separate evaluation of decision rules, candidate constraints, and realized reports.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究医学报告生成中多报告采样的推理问题，提出分离决策信号、评分目标和可行决策集的框架，在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray基准上通过13种生成器配置的对比实验，发现目标函数改变会影响预测和指标权衡，候选约束放宽的效果依赖于目标，文本实现可能抵消、放大或逆转决策层面的增益，且目标保真度与参考准确性不一定同步提升，建议分别评估决策规则、候选约束和实现报告。
AI.motivation: 多报告采样产生推理问题：如何将采样证据转化为最终决策，以及更好的结构化决策是否能产生更好的报告。现有方法缺乏对决策信号、评分目标和可行决策集的系统性分离研究。
AI.method: 提出一个框架，将决策信号、评分目标、可行决策集分离，随后进行文本实现。在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray数据集上，进行分组开发/测试评估下的13种生成器配置的受控对比实验。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：1) 在固定证据和规则容量下改变目标函数会改变预测及其保留指标的权衡。2) 在共享信号和冻结分数下放宽候选约束具有目标依赖的效果；诊断显示IU宏观导向断言增加与接近零的标签阈值相关，且有限的候选覆盖与选择余地并存。3) 使用SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B的受控实现研究表明，决策层面的增益可能被衰减、放大或逆转；变化分解显示实现可移除错误断言但也丢失正确发现，目标保真度和参考准确性不一定共同提升；发现增益也不一致改善基于参考的报告质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明需要分别评估决策规则、候选约束和实现后的报告，而非仅关注整体端到端指标。

title: The Anatomy of a Blind Spot: What an LLM Judge Must Be Shown, and How Much
summary: Evaluation of text generated by large language models (LLMs) is increasingly delegated to LLMs acting as judges, yet what such a judge must be shown remains unresolved. We treat a judge whose reports are acted on as a regulator, in the sense of cybernetics, and ask what it must be shown, how much, in what form, and what its reports must get right. On seven public benchmarks we varied only what the judge was shown. Across three judges whose prices differ 10- to 17-fold, what the judge was shown mattered more than which judge it was. When a system revised its answers on feedback from a judge denied the material they had to respect, it ended below its starting point on instruction following and question answering. On instruction following the loss grew with each round, and it persisted when the judge saw the user's request but not the constraints and with a second judge family. On news summarisation, a correct reference summary beside the source undid most of the source's contribution, whereas on single-answer questions a reference helped. About a tenth of the source did almost all of its work, and a small entailment graph matched an LLM judge at finding errors in grounded text. We committed 83 testable clauses before running; of the 81 that ran, 32 met their bar and 50 went in the predicted direction, and most quantitative predictions from the theory failed. We report every shortfall and derive design rules tied to measured effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者时所需的输入信息，将评判者视为控制论中的调节器，系统考察其必须被展示什么内容、多少内容、何种形式以及报告必须准确捕捉什么。实验表明，评判者所见信息比评判者本身更重要；若评判者缺乏必要材料，系统基于其反馈修改反而会导致性能下降；少量源文本或小型蕴含图即可媲美LLM评判者；预注册的83条可测试条款中仅32条达标，多数定量预测失败，但给出了基于实测效应的设计规则。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生成文本的评估越来越多地委托给LLM评判者，但评判者必须被展示什么信息这一问题尚未解决。作者从控制论角度将评判者视为调节器，旨在明确：评判者必须被展示什么、展示多少、以何种形式、以及其报告必须准确捕捉什么。
AI.method: 在七个公开基准上，仅改变评判者所见信息，使用价格相差10-17倍的三个评判者。测试系统基于被剥夺必要材料的评判者反馈进行修改的效果，考察指令遵循、问答、新闻摘要、单一答案问题等任务，对比参考摘要的影响，测量源文本贡献比例，并用小型蕴含图与LLM评判者对比找错能力。预先注册83条可测试条款并全部报告结果。
AI.result: 评判者所见信息比评判者身份更重要。当系统根据缺乏必要材料的评判者反馈修改时，指令遵循和问答性能低于起始点；指令遵循的损失随轮次增加，且在评判者看到用户请求但未见约束条件时持续存在，更换评判者家族也同样。新闻摘要任务中，正确参考摘要抵消了大部分源文本贡献；单一答案问题中参考摘要有帮助。约十分之一的源文本完成了几乎所有工作，小型蕴含图在接地文本找错上媲美LLM评判者。81条运行的条款中32条达标，50条方向符合预测，多数理论定量预测失败。
AI.conclusion: 论文报告了所有不足之处，并基于实测效应推导出设计规则，强调评判者输入信息的关键作用，为LLM作为评判者的评估提供了实证指导。

title: EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving mechanisms let vision-language model (VLM) agents continually adapt through evolving memory, but they also allow malicious behavior to emerge only after deployment. We introduce a new attack surface, the self-evolving backdoor, whose payload stays dormant in the initial agent and is progressively activated as the agent evolves. Unlike conventional backdoors, which can be exposed by testing triggered inputs on a static model, our attack requires both a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state; static scanning with clean memory thus yields near-zero attack success and may deem the agent benign. We realize this through memory-aware backdoor training, which couples trigger activation with the agent's evolving memory while preserving benign behavior unless the trigger co-occurs with payload-related memory. Across three VLM backbones, four agent pipelines, and recency-, semantic-, and reward-based memory evolution, the attack preserves normal functionality and stays nearly inactive before evolution (0.5% attack success rate), yet exceeds 95% attack success within 100 interactions, revealing a stealthy threat unique to self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对自我进化视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体的新型后门攻击——自我进化后门，该攻击在初始部署时处于休眠状态，仅当智能体记忆经过足够进化后，结合视觉触发器才会被激活，极难通过静态扫描检测。
AI.motivation: 自我进化机制使VLM智能体能通过不断演化的记忆持续适应，但也为部署后出现的恶意行为提供了新攻击面。现有后门攻击依赖静态模型触发，无法利用智能体进化过程中的记忆状态变化。
AI.method: 提出记忆感知后门训练方法，将触发器激活与智能体不断演化的记忆状态耦合，仅当触发器与载荷相关记忆同时出现时激活恶意行为，否则保持良性表现。实验覆盖三种VLM骨干、四种智能体管道及三种记忆演化策略（新近性、语义、奖励）。
AI.result: 攻击在进化前攻击成功率仅0.5%，保持近乎完全休眠；经过100次交互后攻击成功率超过95%，且在正常功能上无性能下降，揭示了自我进化智能体特有的隐蔽威胁。
AI.conclusion: 自我进化后门利用记忆演化机制实现了极具隐蔽性的攻击，静态安全评估无法发现此类威胁，亟需针对动态演化智能体的新型防御策略。

title: Thinking Outside the Bots: Human Ideas in AI's Semantic Blind Spots Are Not Inferior
summary: AI-generated outputs are frequently perceived as highly creative, but also tend to be more similar to each other (homogenized) than human ideas. Does the human heterogeneity that extends beyond AI reflect valuable thinking that AI misses? Alternatively, is greater human heterogeneity driven by lower-quality ideas and less effective thinking that AI avoids? We developed Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression (EDGE) to map AI's semantic "blind spots" by assessing how strongly/weakly individual human ideas were represented in a task-matched AI semantic comparison set. Specifically, we compared human-generated vs. AI-generated ideas across three open-ended tasks: college admissions essays, alternative uses for everyday objects, and interpersonal advice. Across all three tasks, human responses extended into semantic regions sparsely covered by AI outputs. These distinctively human responses showed no meaningful deficits in creativity, quality, or effectiveness, were associated with equal-or-better academic performance, and with credibly superior ratings and achievement for some outcomes. These ideas were thus not merely poor-performing variation; they performed as well as or better than ideas that overlapped more strongly with AI ideas. More distinctive human ideas tended to receive higher creativity ratings, but this relationship was weak or reversed for AI ideas. Taken together, these results suggest that differentiation among human-generated ideas does not reflect poor thinking that AI can safely omit, and instead may afford both individual and population-level advantages.

AI.tldr: 研究开发EDGE方法对比人类与AI生成的创意，发现人类创意覆盖了AI稀疏的语义区域，这些独特人类创意在创造力、质量、效果上不逊于AI，甚至在部分指标上更优，且与更好的学业表现相关。人类创意的差异化非劣质思维，反而可能带来个体和群体层面的优势。
AI.motivation: 探究人类创意的异质性是否反映了AI遗漏的有价值思维，还是仅源于低质量创意和无效思维。即：人类创意超越AI的部分是优势还是劣势？
AI.method: 开发EDGE（发散生成表达扩展）方法，通过任务匹配的AI语义比较集评估个体人类创意在语义空间中的代表性强弱。在三个开放式任务（大学申请文书、日常物品替代用途、人际建议）中对比人类与AI生成的创意。
AI.result: 跨三任务一致发现：人类创意延伸至AI输出稀疏覆盖的语义区域；这些独特人类创意在创造力、质量、效果上无显著缺陷，学业表现同等或更好，部分结果评分和成就显著更优。人类创意独特性与创造力评分正相关，但AI创意呈弱或负相关。
AI.conclusion: 人类创意的差异化非AI可安全忽略的劣质思维，而是可能提供个体和群体层面的双重优势。AI的语义盲区掩盖了有价值的人类认知多样性。

title: Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment
comment: Published in Companion of the 2026 ACM International Joint Conference on Pervasive and Ubiquitous Computing (UbiComp Companion '26) PEACE Workshop
summary: Proactive Smart Assistants (PSAs) increasingly use general knowledge, learned patterns from group-level data, patterns from individual user's data, and recent sensor observations to anticipate which action a user may prefer. Existing systems typically select actions from predicted user preference likelihoods, but these likelihoods alone do not reveal how reliable the prediction is, which evidence supports it, or why ambiguity remains. In this vision paper, we argue that uncertainty estimation can provide this missing information and substantially change appropriate downstream behavior. Using the example of a home assistant, we introduce the questions that uncertainty estimation aims to answer, i.e. how sure is the assistant about the predicted preference likelihood, whether the confidence come from group-level assumptions or individual's data, and whether likelihood ambiguity reflect the user's intrinsic preference variability or insufficient data for the particular situation. We further introduce uncertainty estimation applications in neighboring domains, such as human trajectory prediction, personalized activity recognition, information-collection, and model-based control. Finally, we draw on insights from neighboring domains to envision how future uncertainty-aware proactive assistants may address key challenges in proactive interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇愿景论文，主张在主动智能助手中引入不确定性估计，以提供预测可靠性、证据来源和歧义原因等关键信息，从而改进下游决策行为。
AI.motivation: 现有主动智能助手仅依赖预测的用户偏好似然选择动作，但这些似然无法揭示预测的可靠性、支持证据或歧义成因，限制了助手在真实场景中的适应性和可信度。
AI.method: 以家庭助手为例，提出不确定性估计需回答的三个核心问题：预测偏好似然的确定程度、置信度来源（群体假设还是个体数据）、似然歧义是源于用户内在偏好变异还是特定情境数据不足；并综述人类轨迹预测、个性化活动识别、信息收集和基于模型的控制等相邻领域的不确定性估计应用。
AI.result: 基于相邻领域的洞察，勾勒了未来具备不确定性感知的主动助手如何应对主动交互中的关键挑战，如动态权衡探索与利用、解释性决策、个性化自适应等。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性估计是构建可靠、透明且自适应的主动智能助手的关键缺失环节，未来研究应重点解决不确定性量化、来源归因及其在下游决策中的有效利用等问题。

title: ObsSpec: Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation
summary: Tool-using agents alternate between model generation and tool execution, waiting for each tool call to complete before starting the next generation. This sequential execution is costly during agentic reinforcement learning (RL), which requires large batches of multi-turn rollouts. We introduce ObsSpec, an observation speculation pipeline for agentic RL that uses a small world model to predict tool outputs while the environment executes, allowing the policy to begin its next generation early. ObsSpec retains speculative work only when the predicted and actual observations match exactly, making rollout collection lossless, while co-training keeps the world model up to date as the policy learns. On terminal-use tasks, predictions from a 0.6B world model exactly match actual observations in 66.4% of attempts and arrive roughly 16 times faster. Using these predictions, ObsSpec reduces agent latency by 9.3% and 14.2% for 8B and 32B policies. Across controlled experiments, we characterize the regimes in which ObsSpec reduces agent latency under shared policy resources. Finally, because ObsSpec overlaps policy generation with tool execution, it is architecturally compatible with existing techniques for accelerating RL. Code is available at https://github.com/kylemontgomery1/verl-recipe/tree/obsspec/obsspec.

AI.tldr: ObsSpec通过小世界模型预测工具输出，实现策略生成与工具执行的并行，无损加速智能体RL训练。
AI.motivation: 智能体RL中顺序执行模型生成和工具调用导致高延迟，尤其在大批量多轮采样时成本高昂。
AI.method: 引入观测推测流水线ObsSpec，使用小世界模型预测工具输出，仅当预测与实际观测完全匹配时保留推测工作，联合训练保持世界模型随策略更新。
AI.result: 0.6B世界模型在66.4%尝试中精确匹配实际观测，速度快约16倍；对8B和32B策略分别降低9.3%和14.2%延迟；表征了共享策略资源下降低延迟的条件。
AI.conclusion: ObsSpec无损加速智能体RL，与现有RL加速技术架构兼容，代码开源。

title: The Curse of Knowledge in Role-Playing Language Models
summary: Role-playing language models speak as characters in games and agent simulations, where the system records what each character can hear, see and understand. We test whether characters respect these boundaries in 480 scenes, each with a counterfactual twin that changes only the hidden fact, so mentions of the twin's fact measure guessing. Across 11 open-weight models, characters use content from speech they cannot understand or hear at 67 and 72 percentage points (pp) above this baseline, although most models correctly state what the character perceives. This is a curse of knowledge. The leak extends to hidden actions and private messages and changes where characters search. Five of six proprietary models rarely leak, but compliance in strong models depends on input format. Changing only the scene layout or character description raises the rate in two otherwise compliant open-weight models from under 10 to over 60 pp, and combined changes raise two proprietary models from near zero to 13 and 21~pp. Writing the line as the scene's author leaks nearly as much as role-play, and thinking rarely helps. Giving models only what the character observes stops the leak without hiding what it may report.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估角色扮演语言模型是否遵守角色的感知边界（听觉、视觉、理解），发现开源模型普遍存在严重的“知识诅咒”泄露，专有模型表现较好但受输入格式影响脆弱，提出仅提供角色可观察信息可有效阻止泄露。
AI.motivation: 在游戏和代理模拟中，角色扮演语言模型需严格遵守角色的知识边界，但现有模型是否尊重这些边界缺乏系统测试，且可能存在利用模型无法感知信息的“知识诅咒”现象。
AI.method: 构建480个场景及其反事实孪生场景（仅改变隐藏事实），以孪生场景中的提及率为基线测量猜测/泄露。测试11个开源模型和6个专有模型，考察不同输入格式、场景布局、角色描述、作者视角写作及思维链提示对泄露率的影响。
AI.result: 开源模型在无法听到/理解的语音内容上泄露率比基线高67和72个百分点；泄露延伸至隐藏动作、私密消息并改变搜索行为。5/6专有模型极少泄露，但强模型合规性高度依赖输入格式。仅改变场景布局或角色描述即可使两个原本合规的开源模型泄露率从<10升至>60 pp，组合变更使两个专有模型从近零升至13和21 pp。以场景作者身份写台词泄露几乎等同于角色扮演，思考很少有帮助。仅给予模型角色观察到的信息可完全阻止泄露且不隐藏可报告内容。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演语言模型存在严重的知识边界泄露问题，开源模型尤为突出；专有模型虽表现较好但对上下文呈现方式敏感；输入格式和场景描述的微小变化可剧烈影响合规性；最有效的缓解策略是严格限制模型输入为角色可观察的信息。

title: ADAPT: Audio-Depth Action Planning with Transition-Aware Rewards for Lights-Out Industrial Navigation
summary: Vision-language-action models for embodied navigation typically rely on RGB observations, limiting their applicability in lights-out industrial environments where visible illumination may be unavailable. We study illumination-independent navigation using spatial audio for target localization and depth for obstacle-aware geometry. To support this setting, we introduce DarkNav-Bench, a benchmark with 24 industrial scenes and four progressively challenging acoustic conditions. We further propose ADAPT, an audio-depth action-planning framework equipped with spatial-audio perception and optimized for closed-loop navigation through reinforcement learning (RL). Our key RL contribution, transition-aware reward shaping (TARS), defines a pose-aware shortest-action potential over a position-heading graph. Unlike conventional geodesic-progress rewards, TARS accounts for both feasible movements and in-place rotations, providing action-consistent feedback for policy optimization. Experiments show that ADAPT consistently outperforms training-based navigation baselines and zero-shot multimodal models on both seen and unseen scenes. On unseen environments, it achieves 90.6% success under Clean conditions and retains 60.0% success under the most challenging Localized Noise setting. These results demonstrate the potential of spatial audio and depth as complementary modalities for reliable RGB-free navigation in lights-out industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了DarkNav-Bench基准和ADAPT框架，利用空间音频和深度信息实现无光工业环境下的无RGB导航，并通过转换感知奖励塑造(TARS)优化强化学习策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型主要依赖RGB观测，这限制了它们在无可见光照明的熄灯工业环境中的应用。研究旨在解决无光照条件下的自主导航问题。
AI.method: 1. 构建DarkNav-Bench基准：包含24个工业场景和四个递进式声学条件。2. 提出ADAPT框架：结合空间音频感知和深度信息的音频-深度动作规划框架。3. 核心RL贡献TARS：定义基于位置-朝向图的姿态感知最短动作势能，区别于传统测地线进度奖励，同时考虑可行移动和原地旋转，提供动作一致的反馈。
AI.result: ADAPT在已见和未见场景上均持续优于基于训练的导航基线和零样本多模态模型。在未见环境中，Clean条件下成功率达90.6%，最具挑战的Localized Noise设置下仍保持60.0%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明空间音频和深度作为互补模态，在熄灯工业环境中实现可靠的无RGB导航具有巨大潜力。

title: Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Reconstruction-based detectors for multivariate time series anomaly detection typically learn a single entangled representation of normal behavior and flag anomalies based on reconstruction error. However, real-world anomalies are not only isolated spikes in a single channel but also disruptions in the relationships between channels, where each sensor individually appears normal, but their joint behavior deviates from the norm. Because these models compress both temporal evolution and inter-channel structure into this single space, they lack an explicit mechanism to isolate such inter-channel dependencies from normal temporal dependencies, leading to lower detection rates for cross-channel anomalies. We propose CARMA (Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection), which is a reconstruction-based variational autoencoder with two complementary latent spaces: a temporal latent that captures sequential dynamics, and a correlation latent that is trained to reconstruct the window's pairwise Pearson correlations. Both representations are fused in the signal decoder, and anomalies are detected from the reconstruction error. We evaluate CARMA on the TSB-AD-M benchmark suite (17 datasets, 180 series) against 29 baseline methods, and show that it significantly outperforms all of them across multiple threshold-free and range-aware metrics, achieving a VUS-PR of 0.4929. Ablations show that removing the correlation branch degrades performance, that adding a second latent without supervision recovers only part of the gain, and that supervising the correlation latent with an explicit correlation target accounts for the rest and produces a sharper error response at anomalies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CARMA，一种基于重构的变分自编码器，引入双潜在空间（时间潜在空间捕捉序列动态，相关性潜在空间重构通道间皮尔逊相关性），显著提升多变量时间序列异常检测中跨通道异常的识别能力，在 TSB-AD-M 基准上以 VUS-PR 0.4929 超越 29 个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于重构的检测器通常学习单一纠缠的正常行为表示，难以显式分离通道间依赖与时间依赖，导致对跨通道异常（各通道单独看似正常但联合行为偏离）的检测率较低。
AI.method: CARMA 采用双潜在空间 VAE：时间潜在空间捕捉序列动态，相关性潜在空间通过监督重构滑动窗口的成对皮尔逊相关系数来建模通道间结构；两者在信号解码器中融合，异常检测基于重构误差。
AI.result: 在 TSB-AD-M 基准（17 个数据集，180 条序列）上对比 29 个基线，CARMA 在多个无阈值和范围感知指标上显著优于所有方法，VUS-PR 达到 0.4929。消融实验表明：移除相关性分支会降低性能；仅增加第二个无监督潜在空间只能恢复部分增益；用显式相关性目标监督相关性潜在空间则贡献了剩余增益，并在异常处产生更尖锐的误差响应。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并监督通道间相关性结构是提升多变量时间序列跨通道异常检测的关键，CARMA 的双潜在空间设计有效解耦了时间动态与通道相关性，实现了最优性能。

title: claimcheck: Measuring and Improving Specification Faithfulness
summary: Formal verification proves that a program satisfies its specification, but says nothing about whether the specification captures what the author meant. As LLMs increasingly write both code and specifications, a gap between the author's natural-language requirement and the specification becomes a live risk. A machine-checked proof of a property narrower than the one requested is worthless but passes every check. Closing this gap is solving the spec formalization problem: given a natural-language requirement, produce a formal artifact whose meaning matches it. To measure the gap, we curate an end-to-end benchmark for spec formalization spanning four formal languages: Dafny contracts and Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq theorem statements. Each of its 3,234 rows pairs a natural-language requirement with a formal artifact and a label established by execution, by proof, or by the benchmark it is drawn from. A third of the rows are meaning-preserving rewrites of the artifact that keep the faithful label, so a judge cannot score by detecting that a row was edited. We introduce claimcheck, a tool that detects incorrect formalizations: the formal artifact is translated back into plain English by a model that never sees the requirement, and a separate model, the judge, decides whether the informalization and the requirement express the same guarantee. On all four languages it gains 8.2 to 9.8 points of macro recall over a single call shown the requirement and the artifact, and 4.2 to 6.0 over that call handed the same list of meaning-preserving rewrites. Showing the judge the artifact as well costs 1.4 to 4.5 points. Across four judges that also see the artifact, the gain shrinks as the judge gets stronger, to within a point of the informed single call for the strongest.

AI.tldr: 本文针对形式化规约与自然语言需求之间的语义鸿沟问题，构建了跨四种形式语言的基准集，并提出 claimcheck 方法：将形式化规约反向翻译为自然语言，再由独立判断模型比对与原始需求的一致性，显著提升了错误规约的检出召回率。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证仅能证明程序满足规约，无法保证规约本身捕捉了作者的真实意图。随着大语言模型同时生成代码和规约，自然语言需求与形式化规约之间的语义偏差成为现实风险。解决规约形式化问题——即从自然语言需求生成语义等价的形式化产物——亟需可度量的基准与有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 1. 策划包含 3,234 条目的端到端基准，覆盖 Dafny contracts、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq 四种形式语言，每条包含自然语言需求、形式化产物及由执行、证明或来源基准确立的标签；三分之一为保持语义的重写版本，防止作弊。2. 提出 claimcheck：先由未见需求的模型将形式化产物“非形式化”为纯英文，再由独立的判断模型比较该非形式化文本与原始需求是否表达相同保证。
AI.result: 在四种语言上，claimcheck 相较于直接展示需求与产物的单次调用，宏召回率提升 8.2–9.8 个百分点；相较于提供含语义保持重写列表的单次调用，提升 4.2–6.0 个百分点。若同时向判断模型展示形式化产物，性能下降 1.4–4.5 个百分点。随着判断模型能力增强，增益收窄，最强模型下仅落后知情单次调用 1 个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化产物的非形式化再比对，claimcheck 能有效检测规约与需求的语义不匹配，且不依赖于判断模型直接阅读形式化代码。该方法在多语言基准上表现稳健，为规约形式化质量保证提供了可扩展的自动化手段。

title: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
comment: In NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust)
summary: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass. Verifying a rewrite by agent rollout is expensive and subjective, while executable checks such as the repository's own tests are too sparse to catch behavior-changing rewrites, rejecting only a quarter of them. We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm, so that the signal is dense and informative. TeSearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 real-world modules and three backbones, TeSearch delivers the highest-quality suites of any method compared, LLM-driven evolutionary search included, and the smallest of any LLM-based one. Used as the improvement signal of a self-evolving agent, it rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3% for the repository's tests, at a 4.0% false-alarm rate and 3.5 s per decision. The code and data are available at https://github.com/ccsnow127/TeSearch.

AI.tldr: TeSearch是一种基于质量-多样性进化算法的测试套件搜索方法，用于生成小而强的测试套件，作为自我进化代理的改进信号，显著提高了对行为变更重写的拒绝率。
AI.motivation: 现有的自我进化代理在验证重写时面临信号稀疏问题：代理卷轴验证昂贵且主观，仓库测试太稀疏只能拒绝25%的行为变更重写。需要一种密集且信息丰富的可执行信号。
AI.method: TeSearch将测试套件大小作为行为描述符，使用质量-多样性进化算法搜索小而强的测试套件；同时学习转移核来去噪LLM作为该描述符上的执行器。
AI.result: 在129个真实模块和三个骨干模型上，TeSearch生成的测试套件质量最高且规模最小（LLM基方法中）；作为改进信号时，拒绝59.9%行为变更重写（仓库测试仅25.3%），误报率4.0%，决策耗时3.5秒。
AI.conclusion: TeSearch通过进化搜索和LLM去噪有效构建了高质量小型测试套件，为自我进化代理提供了高效、低误报的改进信号，显著优于现有方法。

title: LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami)，通过将标准预测器替换为基于辛勒普格积分的动作条件哈密顿流，保证潜在空间相空间体积守恒，避免长时程滚动中的分布收缩，并在视觉摆环境中显著提升长时程速度预测精度，同时支持亚帧步长积分与时间反演。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPAs) 在潜在空间直接学习世界模型，但无约束的自回归预测器会导致长时程滚动时潜在分布收缩，丧失动力学保真度。需要一种几何结构化的预测器，在不依赖参数正则化的前提下提供推理时的体积守恒与稳定性保证。
AI.method: 将潜在状态结构化为广义坐标 q 与动量 p，引入动作条件哈密顿量，使用严格辛的 leapfrog 积分步骤进行时间演化。动量分量由位置类表示的时序导数获得，构造显式二阶状态。该流在每一步精确保持辛结构，从而保证相空间体积守恒、排除均匀收缩、渐近稳定不动点及不同潜在状态的合并。
AI.result: 在保守与驱动视觉摆环境中，LeHami 相比无约束 JEPA 基线大幅改善长时程速度预测，并经验性地维持恒定潜在体积（基线显著收缩）。学习到的流还能在未见的亚帧步长下准确积分，并支持数值时间反演。
AI.conclusion: 几何结构（辛几何/哈密顿动力学）可为潜在世界模型提供与表示正则化互补的推理时保证，实现长时程预测的稳定性、体积守恒与可逆性，且不依赖于特定学习参数或动作序列。

title: UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking
summary: Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology. Current methods are generally developed towards a single ontology and source text type (clinical notes, drug labels, etc.) The central challenge is therefore to build methods that adapt to any target ontology without requiring ontology-specific retraining. More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization. We propose UMCR, a pipeline that allows extraction and linking to any target ontology using any source text variety, utilizing direct guideline integration and an agentic linking module. We evaluate our method on the recent MedPath benchmark, covering a wide variety of medical text types and vocabularies, and show that our method achieves strong performance across these tasks. This ability unlocks interoperability in the healthcare domain, allowing for extraction and alignment between different medical standards. Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了UMCR（统一医学概念识别）管道，通过直接整合指南和代理链接模块，实现了跨任意本体和文本类型的医学概念提取与链接，在MedPath基准上表现优异，降低了对LLM参数记忆的依赖，实现了医疗标准间的互操作性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学概念识别方法局限于单一本体和文本类型，难以适应新本体而无需重新训练。虽然REAL和AutoPCR等近期方法利用大语言模型理论上可适应任意本体，但泛化能力不足。因此需要一种能适应任意目标本体和文本类型的统一方法。
AI.method: 提出UMCR管道，包含两个核心组件：1）直接指南整合，将本体指南直接融入模型；2）代理链接模块，通过智能代理与目标本体交互进行实体链接。该方法不依赖特定本体重新训练，支持任意源文本类型和目标本体。
AI.result: 在MedPath基准测试中，UMCR在多种医学文本类型和词汇表上均取得强性能，优于现有方法。实验证明其能有效减少对LLM参数记忆的依赖，通过改进与目标本体的交互实现更好的泛化。
AI.conclusion: UMCR实现了医学概念识别的统一框架，解决了跨本体、跨文本类型的适应性问题，为医疗领域不同标准间的互操作性提供了关键技术支持，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination
summary: In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs' ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. We show that cooperators trained against PopGen populations achieve robust zero-shot cooperation with unseen partners, outperforming population-play baselines across four collaborative environments. We further show that semantic diversity scales with PopGen population size, improving the cooperator's worst-case performance, and we identify design choices that preserve population quality while maximizing diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/labicon/PopGen.

AI.tldr: PopGen利用大语言模型（LLM）生成语义多样的智能体行为描述，并将其转化为可执行的代码策略，训练合作者与之交互，实现了稳健的零样本协作，在四个协作环境中超越了种群对弈基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习方法通常依赖轨迹层面的代理指标来衡量策略多样性，这可能将同一策略的不同轨迹误判为多样。核心洞察是利用LLM像人类一样识别高层策略，从语义层面生成行为差异显著的智能体。
AI.method: PopGen框架包含两步：首先利用LLM生成一组语义多样的智能体行为文本描述；然后将每个描述转译为环境中可执行的代码策略。合作者针对该合成种群进行训练。
AI.result: 在四个协作环境中，基于PopGen种群训练的合作者实现了稳健的零样本协作，性能优于种群对弈基线。语义多样性随种群规模扩展，提升了合作者的最差情况性能，并识别了在保持种群质量的同时最大化多样性的设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 利用LLM生成语义多样化的智能体种群是实现零样本协调的有效途径，提供了一种可扩展的方法来创建多样化的伙伴种群，显著提升了合作者的泛化协作能力。

title: Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation
summary: Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. Under stated regularity conditions, CS-VGB converges exponentially to the target despite verifier error, and the expected number of updates needed to reach a clean sample grows only linearly with the number of checkpoints. In analytically tractable settings, we empirically demonstrate that CS-VGB recovers the desired reward-tilted distribution despite verifier error, whereas the compared verifier-based sampling methods fail to recover the target under the same verifier errors. We also instantiate the framework with diffusion models and one-step stochastic posterior maps. Across prompt-guided ImageNet generation, facial-attribute generation on CelebA, and multi-robot planning, recurrent CS-VGB search improves reward and task success as inference budgets grow, with image-generation rewards continuing beyond the observed plateaus of denoising-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续状态验证器引导回溯（CS-VGB），一种用于从奖励倾斜分布采样的推理时缩放方法，通过反复去噪和重噪声操作，在连续生成模型上实现即使中间验证器不准确也能收敛到目标分布，并在扩散模型等任务上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有的验证器引导推理时缩放方法存在中间验证器不完美导致采样偏离，且仅靠反复细化无法恢复期望的奖励倾斜分布；需要一种在验证器不准确时仍能理论保证收敛到目标分布的方法。
AI.method: 提出 CS-VGB 方法，通过正确配对的去噪和重噪声转移，在干净检查点处的平稳分布等于目标奖励倾斜分布；理论证明在正则条件下指数级收敛，且达到干净样本所需的期望更新次数仅随检查点数线性增长；在扩散模型和一步随机后验映射上实例化该框架。
AI.result: 在可解析设置中实验表明 CS-VGB 能在验证器错误下恢复目标分布，而对比方法失败；在 ImageNet 提示引导生成、CelebA 面部属性生成和多机器人规划任务中，随着推理预算增加，CS-VGB 持续提升奖励和任务成功率，突破了仅去噪基线的性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: CS-VGB 为连续生成模型的验证器引导采样提供了理论可靠且实践有效的推理时缩放框架，解决了验证器不准确导致的分布偏移问题，并在多个领域展示了持续的性能提升潜力。

title: PIG: Parallel Inconsistency Guidance for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by decoding multiple masked positions per forward pass. However, accuracy is known to drop when parallel decoding trajectories deviate from their sequential counterparts, which are slow and expensive "oracles" that adhere to the joint distribution of language. In this paper, we propose Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG), a new paradigm that uses a trained auxiliary model to directly estimate the inconsistency between parallel and sequential generation from a single model forward pass. During inference, masked positions are traversed by decreasing confidence, and tokens are added to the parallel decode set one-at-a-time until the total estimated inconsistency between the parallel and sequential generation exceeds a threshold. Surprisingly, it suffices to train a lightweight ~2M parameter auxiliary model on a small mixture drawn from OpenCoder, GSM8K-train, MATH-train, and MBPP-train. For LLaDA-8B Instruct and NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct, PIG extends the accuracy-TPF frontier on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, and MMLU, when compared to the industry standard Fast-dLLM and measures favorably on LLaDA-8B Instruct against DAPD, KLASS, EB-sampler, and other learned unmasking policies.

AI.tldr: 提出并行不一致性引导(PIG)，利用轻量辅助模型估计并行解码与顺序解码的差异，动态控制并行解码步数，在多个基准上提升扩散语言模型的准确性-吞吐率权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过并行解码多个mask位置加速生成，但并行解码轨迹偏离顺序解码（遵循联合分布的“oracle”）会导致准确率下降。现有方法难以在单次前向传播中直接量化这种不一致性。
AI.method: 训练一个约200万参数的轻量辅助模型，在单次前向传播中直接估计并行解码与顺序解码的不一致性。推理时按置信度降序遍历mask位置，逐个将token加入并行解码集，直到估计的总不一致性超过阈值。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B Instruct和NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct上，PIG在GSM8K、MATH500、MBPP、HumanEval、MMLU等基准上扩展了准确性-TPF前沿，优于Fast-dLLM，且在LLaDA-8B Instruct上对比DAPD、KLASS、EB-sampler等学习型unmasking策略表现优异。
AI.conclusion: PIG通过轻量辅助模型实现高效的不一致性估计，动态平衡并行度与准确性，为扩散语言模型的加速解码提供了新范式，显著优于现有基线。

title: Revocation Is Not Complete at Receipt: An Executable Outcome Contract for Distributed Agent-Tool Gateways
summary: Distributed agent workflows cache delegated authority at tool gateways. Revocation may be reported at issuer commit, transport acknowledgment, or receiver persistence, although none of these observations establishes that all gateways enforced the change or that guarded effects stopped. We define C0-C5, a bounded outcome contract spanning issuer commit through effect prevention, and implement it as a persistent monitor over a frozen gateway set, call set, and observation window. A 14-case fault matrix checks conservative classification, sticky violations, restart persistence, and evidence immutability. In a derived audit of its eight semantic cases, treating C3 or C4 as completion produces seven or five false positives, respectively; the bounded C0-C5 verdict produces none. Descriptive scaling covers 1,024 gateways and 10,000 effect vectors. The primary experiment uses the maintained Keycloak 26.7 identity server and measures the contract across two durable receivers, eight physical agent-tool gateways, Filesystem and PostgreSQL effects, and 16 AWS hosts in three availability zones. Normal delivery and recovery commit no effects. Under receiver-selective non-delivery, transport acknowledgment and receiver persistence still succeed, but 112 of 225 calls (49.78%) are admitted, and all 112 effects commit in every treatment block. A separately provisioned execution repeats the result. OPA/Toxiproxy and a live three-role LLM workflow with networked MCP tools reproduce the persisted-but-not-enforced boundary on narrower surfaces. Finally, an unmodified external MCPMark agent executes 60 closed-loop task arms. Normal C4 denies all 31 exposed post-barrier calls and commits no effect; selective C3 allows 344 calls and commits 145 effects across Filesystem and PostgreSQL. Transport success is therefore evidence of progress, not a revocation-completion verdict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种有界结果契约（C0-C5），用于解决分布式智能体工作流中撤销授权的执行保障问题，实验证明传输确认和接收端持久化不等于撤销完成，契约能准确避免误判。
AI.motivation: 分布式智能体工作流中，工具网关缓存委托授权，撤销可能在发布者提交、传输确认或接收端持久化时被报告，但这些观察无法确保所有网关都强制执行了变更或防止了受保护效果的发生，因此需要一种精确的撤销完成判定机制。
AI.method: 定义C0-C5有界结果契约，覆盖从发布者提交到效果防止的全过程，实现为冻结网关集、调用集和观测窗口上的持久化监视器；构建14案例故障矩阵验证保守分类、粘性违规、重启持久性和证据不可变性；在Keycloak 26.7身份服务器、8个物理网关、文件系统和PostgreSQL效果、16个AWS主机跨3个可用区上进行实验，并用OPA/Toxiproxy、三角色LLM工作流和MCPMark智能体复现。
AI.result: 正常交付和恢复不提交任何效果；在接收端选择性非交付下，传输确认和接收端持久化仍成功，但112/225（49.78%）调用被准入且所有效果均提交；C3或C4作为完成判定分别产生7或5个假阳性，而C0-C5契约零假阳性；MCPMark实验中C4拒绝所有31个暴露调用，C3允许344调用并提交145个效果。
AI.conclusion: 传输成功仅是进度证据，而非撤销完成裁决；C0-C5有界契约能精确捕捉撤销执行边界，避免因过早判定完成而导致的安全违规。

title: FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap
summary: Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

AI.tldr: FragFlex 是一种基于片段级别的离散扩散模型，实现了灵活大小的分子生成，在大规模实验中达到近乎完美的化学有效性并保持高独特性。
AI.motivation: 药物发现需要高效探索天文数字级别的化学空间。现有的分子图扩散模型通常要求预先固定图大小；虽然原子级插入和删除可实现灵活大小生成，但联合建模分子大小、原子类型和化学键同时保持化学有效性仍具挑战。
AI.method: FragFlex 在片段层面执行节点插入和删除。在去噪过程中，模型联合学习片段图的大小、片段身份和片段间连接性。随后利用神经网络依附位点预测器和价电子感知组装器将生成的片段图转换为原子级分子。
AI.result: 在生成 1000 万个分子的大规模实验中，FragFlex 实现了近乎完美的化学有效性，同时保持了高独特性，展示了二者之间的强平衡。
AI.conclusion: FragFlex 为灵活大小的分子生成提供了一种有前景的方法，能够在保证高化学有效性的前提下维持高独特性，有效解决了联合建模分子大小、片段类型和连接性的难题。

title: Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Corpus, model outputs and analysis code available at https://github.com/sakhadib/llm-temporal-interval-reasoning
summary: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.

AI.tldr: 论文评估大语言模型在完整叙事中重构Allen时间区间关系的能力，发现最佳模型在宏F1上优于基线，但解析错误导致准确率受损；模型擅长先后和包含关系，但在重叠和闪回上表现差，逻辑一致性对金标准一致性帮助有限，结构化输出和相对时间处理是关键。
AI.motivation: 理解叙事需要知道每个事件如何在时间上关联其他事件，但现有LLMs主要在孤立事件对或粗粒度标签上测试，缺乏对完整时间关系网络的系统性评估。
AI.method: 让五个LLMs重构360个英语叙事中事件的Allen 13种区间关系完整网络，事件通过相对顺序而非日期放置；使用预注册协议评估输出与金标准一致性、对话一致性和逻辑可满足性。
AI.result: 端到端最佳模型在宏F1上明显优于简单基线，但在预注册解析器下无模型能超越总是回答'before'的基线（标签倾斜导致）；主要差距源于解析伪影：大矩阵格式错误导致整行丢失，事后解析器恢复后覆盖率从0.60提至0.84，最佳模型差距缩小。模型能恢复先后和包含关系，但很少恢复重叠，在闪回（叙述和事件列表先呈现较晚事件）上失败最多。逻辑一致性变化大但对金标准一致性说明少；强制一致性主要通过填充空单元格提高准确率，但被猜测多数标签的简单控制打败。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的结构化输出和稳健的相对时间处理是整个叙事时间推理的前提条件。

title: Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing
summary: We study how initial model selection, later handoff, and training targets affect success and cost in LLM tasks that span multiple turns. We compare several router architectures using handoff curves, which record task success and cost as the handoff step changes. Our dataset contains 34,204 complete executions of three Qwen models across BFCL, MultiWOZ, and $τ$-retail, providing offline supervision for routing decisions. In our primary comparison, with Qwen3.5 35B-A3B as the starting model, allowing a later handoff does not establish an improvement in utility over initial selection on BFCL or MultiWOZ, and increases cost on BFCL across a range of cost weights. Changing the supervision targets improves router performance on both our dataset and TwinRouterBench. On our dataset, replacing noisy training success curves with monotone fits raises success by 0.2 to 4.1 percentage points at the same cost across the reported operating points. On TwinRouterBench, we construct targets that describe the model capability needed for the remaining work and difficult steps ahead. Compared with training on the benchmark's per-step labels, these targets raise trajectory pass scores by 7.8 percentage points and cost savings by 6.3 percentage points on the full static bank. A live deployment of the router trained with these targets resolves 79 of 100 instances at a router cost of 0.59 US dollars per instance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多轮LLM任务中初始模型选择、后期切换及训练目标对成功率和成本的影响。实验表明：允许后期切换并未在BFCL和MultiWOZ上提升效用，反而增加BFCL成本；改进监督目标（使用单调拟合替代噪声成功曲线，以及基于剩余工作难度的目标）能显著提升路由性能，在TwinRouterBench上通过率提升7.8个百分点，成本节省6.3个百分点，实际部署解决100个实例中的79个，单实例成本0.59美元。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮LLM任务路由研究缺乏对初始模型选择、切换时机和训练目标的系统性分析，需要量化不同路由架构在成功率与成本权衡上的表现，并探索更有效的监督信号以提升路由器决策质量。
AI.method: 构建包含34,204次完整执行的数据集（三个Qwen模型在BFCL、MultiWOZ、τ-retail上），引入切换曲线记录不同切换步骤下的任务成功率和成本。对比多种路由器架构，主要实验以Qwen3.5 35B-A3B为起始模型。改进训练目标：1) 用单调拟合替代噪声成功曲线；2) 在TwinRouterBench上构建描述剩余工作所需模型能力和困难步骤的目标。
AI.result: 1) 允许后期切换未在BFCL或MultiWOZ上建立相对于初始选择的效用优势，且在BFCL上增加成本。2) 单调拟合目标在相同成本下使成功率提升0.2-4.1个百分点。3) 基于剩余工作难度的目标使TwinRouterBench轨迹通过分提升7.8个百分点，成本节省提升6.3个百分点。4) 实际部署中路由器解决100个实例中的79个，单实例成本0.59美元。
AI.conclusion: 初始模型选择往往优于允许后期切换的策略，关键在于设计高质量的监督目标。单调拟合和面向剩余工作难度的目标能显著提升路由器性能，为多轮LLM任务的高效路由提供了实用方案。

title: WisdomNet: trustable machine learning toward error-free classification
summary: Misclassification is a critical problem in many machine learning applications. Since even the classifier models with high accuracy (e.g., > 95%) still introduce some misclassification error, it may not be possible to rely on the output of a classifier. In this paper, we introduce trustable learning, which prompts the learning model to yield only the true output, thus avoiding misclassifications. Whenever the model cannot decide the output accurately, the learning model should indicate that there could be a misclassification error if it is forced to classify, and hence, it should reject to make a decision or defer it to a human expert. Therefore, we develop a methodology for trustable learning and apply it to artificial neural networks and show that it is possible to develop a classifier with 0% misclassification error. We propose a novel neural network architecture named WisdomNet that could provide zero prediction error by introducing an additional neuron named as conjugate neuron that would indicate whether the network is able to classify the data correctly or not. The WisdomNet architecture can be applied to any previously built model, and we have evaluated WisdomNet with several network architectures such as multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural network, and deep network on different data sets. The results show that the WisdomNet is able to reduce the classification error rate to 0%, while labeling the data is difficult to classify as `reject' at a low percentage of within around 10%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“可信学习”概念，设计WisdomNet架构，通过引入共轭神经元实现零误分类错误，将难以分类的样本标记为“拒绝”，拒绝率约10%。
AI.motivation: 现有分类器即使准确率高（>95%）仍存在误分类，无法完全依赖其输出；需要一种机制让模型在不确定时拒绝预测或转交人工，避免错误决策。
AI.method: 提出WisdomNet架构，在原有神经网络基础上增加共轭神经元，指示网络是否能正确分类；该架构可应用于多层感知机、卷积神经网络、深度网络等各类模型。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上实验显示，WisdomNet将分类错误率降至0%，难以分类的样本被标记为“拒绝”，拒绝率约10%。
AI.conclusion: 可信学习通过引入拒绝机制实现零误分类，WisdomNet架构通用性强，可为关键应用提供可靠的分类保障。

title: Compositional RL: Evaluating and Training LLMs for Collaborative Reasoning
summary: Language models are often evaluated alone but increasingly deployed together, routed between, made to debate, ensembled, or collaboratively trained. For a model inside a system, what matters most is not how well it performs on its own, but how much the system gains from its presence. We call this a model's compositional strength and formalize it using the Shapley value of a cooperative game over coalitions of a model pool, and use a model's leave-one-out contribution to the full coalition as a tractable proxy, requiring n+1 rather than 2^n system evaluations. Evaluating individual vs. compositional strengths across five model pools, twelve collaboration methods, and twelve datasets, we find them largely uncorrelated: in 12 of 15 (pool, method-family) settings, individual strength does not translate into compositional advantages, and the coupling is weakest among general-purpose models that practitioners are most likely to deploy. Standalone benchmarks are therefore often poor proxies for models' value in collaborative systems. We then propose compositional reinforcement learning (C-RL), which trains a policy inside a live multi-model system and rewards the outcome produced by the system as a whole, rather than the policy's correctness in isolation. The leave-one-out baseline in Shapley values cancels under a group policy gradient, so this needs no additional rollout cost beyond RL on the collaborative system's outcome and never requires running a coalition without the policy. Across three collaboration protocols and eight tasks spanning reasoning, coding, and scientific discovery, C-RL produces the strongest collaborator in 21 of 24 settings, lifting collaborative performance by +4.0 to +5.4 pts on average (~3x the gain of baselines), up to +13.1 pts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了模型的“组合强度”概念，用Shapley值衡量模型在协作系统中的边际贡献，发现单模型性能与组合强度基本不相关，并提出组合强化学习（C-RL），在协作系统中直接优化整体结果，显著提升协作性能。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型评估多基于单模型基准，但实际部署常涉及多模型协作（路由、辩论、集成等）。单模型性能不等于其在协作系统中的价值，缺乏衡量模型“组合强度”的理论框架和有效训练方法。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义组合强度：用合作博弈中模型池联盟的Shapley值衡量，并以留一法贡献（LOO）作为可计算代理，仅需n+1次系统评估。2. 提出C-RL：在多模型协作系统中训练策略，奖励信号来自系统整体输出而非单模型正确率。组策略梯度下LOO基线抵消，无需额外rollout成本，也不需运行无该策略的联盟。
AI.result: 跨5个模型池、12种协作方法、12个数据集实验显示：单模型强度与组合强度在15个设置中12个不相关，通用模型中耦合最弱。C-RL在3种协作协议、8个任务（推理、编程、科学发现）中，24个设置有21个产生最强协作者，协作性能平均提升+4.0到+5.4分（约为基线3倍），最高+13.1分。
AI.conclusion: 单模型基准是协作系统中模型价值的差代理指标。C-RL通过在协作系统中端到端优化，无需额外计算开销即可显著提升模型的组合强度，为多模型系统协同训练提供了实用范式。

title: Large language model-generated patterns for epidemiological modeling: a multi-benchmark evaluation framework
summary: Representing individual-level behavioral heterogeneity is challenging in epidemiological modeling, particularly when empirical behavioral data are sparse. We assess the potential of large language model (LLM)-generated behavioral outputs in addressing this challenge, using hepatitis C virus-related behaviors among people who inject drugs as a case study. Correspondence with epidemiological patterns was evaluated using external benchmarks: literature-informed association directions, correlations from an agent-based model (ABM), and survey associations. Across three LLMs, unconditional directional recovery across 28 retained literature-informed associations was 46-68%, compared with 82-93% agreement when LLMs were directly asked to classify the same associations. Mean absolute differences from ABM and survey correlation patterns were 0.11-0.13 and 0.15-0.18, respectively. Together, these findings show partial alignment between LLM-generated behavioral relationships and epidemiological evidence, despite higher knowledge-probe agreement. More systematic evaluation is needed before incorporating LLM-generated behavioral outputs into epidemiological models that simulate transmission dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估大语言模型生成的行为输出在流行病学建模中表示个体行为异质性的潜力，以丙肝病毒相关注射毒品人群行为为例，发现LLM生成的行为关系与流行病学证据部分一致，但直接知识探测一致性较高，需更系统评估后再纳入传播动力学模型。
AI.motivation: 个体层面的行为异质性在流行病学建模中难以表征，尤其当实证行为数据稀缺时。研究旨在探索大语言模型生成的行为输出是否能填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以丙肝病毒相关注射毒品人群行为为案例研究，使用三个LLM生成行为输出，通过外部基准评估其与流行病学模式的对应性：文献告知的关联方向、基于代理模型的相关性、调查关联性。比较无条件方向恢复率和直接分类一致性，计算与ABM及调查相关模式的平均绝对差异。
AI.result: 三个LLM在28个保留的文献告知关联上的无条件方向恢复率为46-68%，而直接分类一致性为82-93%。与ABM相关模式的平均绝对差异为0.11-0.13，与调查相关模式为0.15-0.18。显示LLM生成的行为关系与流行病学证据部分一致，尽管知识探测一致性较高。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的行为输出与流行病学证据存在部分对齐，但在纳入传播动力学模拟前需要更系统的评估。

title: FENAS: A Few-Shot Meta-Ensembling Framework for Efficient Neural Architecture Search with Synergized Zero-Cost Proxies
summary: Efficient neural architecture search (NAS) requires accurate performance estimation under limited evaluation budgets. Existing zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) provide fast training-free signals, but each proxy usually captures only a partial property of an architecture, leading to unstable rankings across datasets and search spaces. In contrast, GNN-based predictors can improve accuracy, but often depend on labeled architectures, graph encoders, and costly representation learning, which makes them less suitable for extreme few-shot settings. We propose FENAS, a topology-agnostic few-shot prediction framework that turns complementary initialization priors into robust ranking signals. Its core component, CAST, is a feature pipeline that combines copula alignment and synergy transformation. CAST maps heterogeneous ZCPs into a compact feature manifold, enabling lightweight meta-learners to produce reliable rankings from scarce supervision. On NAS-Bench-201, with only 0.5% labeled samples, FENAS achieves a Kendall's Tau ($τ$) of 0.70, outperforming representative topology-based few-shot predictors in this low-label regime. In closed-domain search, FENAS evaluates the NAS-Bench-201 space in approximately 1138 seconds and achieves competitive test accuracy. By providing a fast, reliable, and structurally simple evaluation mechanism, FENAS supports the design of automated neural architectures under limited evaluation budgets.

AI.tldr: FENAS是一个拓扑无关的小样本预测框架，通过CAST特征管道将异构零代理指标映射到紧凑特征流形，使轻量级元学习器能从极少标注中产生可靠架构排序，实现快速、稳健的NAS评估。
AI.motivation: 现有零代理指标（ZCP）虽快但仅捕捉架构部分属性，导致跨数据集/搜索空间排序不稳定；基于GNN的预测器虽准但依赖标注架构、图编码器和昂贵表征学习，不适合极少样本设置。需要一种无需拓扑结构、少标注、快速可靠的评估机制。
AI.method: 提出FENAS框架，核心组件CAST（Copula Alignment and Synergy Transformation）特征管道：将异构ZCP通过Copula对齐映射到统一分布，再经协同变换融合成紧凑特征流形，供轻量级元学习器（如线性回归、MLP）在少量标签下学习排序。无需图编码器，拓扑无关。
AI.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上，仅用0.5%标注样本，Kendall's Tau达0.70，超越代表性拓扑基小样本预测器。闭域搜索中评估全空间约1138秒，测试准确率有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FENAS提供了一种快速、可靠、结构简单的评估机制，将互补初始化先验转化为鲁棒排序信号，支持在有限评估预算下自动化神经架构设计。

title: Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions
summary: Text language models (LMs) acquire broad linguistic and factual capabilities through large-scale pretraining, while comparable capabilities remain difficult to learn from speech alone. Recent work has shown that knowledge distillation from pretrained text LMs offers a promising way to transfer their linguistic and factual capabilities to speech models. However, existing distillation approaches have largely focused on speech-input, text-output models. This idea has yet to be explored for {\it speech-to-speech} models, which operate on both speech input and speech output. In this work we introduce a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface for knowledge transfer while preserving the speech-only input and output. The model first consumes speech context without its transcription, switches to text prediction, and then uses the predicted text to lead future speech generation word by word. It also provides an interface for knowledge distillation: the internal text predictions can be directly distilled from the base text LM. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of text LM distillation to a speech-to-speech LM. Under matched training conditions, the proposed sequence construction substantially improves the generative perplexity of spoken continuations over speech-only and interleaved speech-text models, approaching the performance of a text-leading inner-monologue model with external ASR prompt transcription. More importantly, distillation improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation, indicating better retention of knowledge from the base text language model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语音到语音的预训练方法，通过引入内部文本接口实现从文本语言模型的知识蒸馏，同时保持纯语音输入输出。该方法首次将文本LM蒸馏应用于语音到语音模型，显著提升了生成困惑度和事实性能。
