Inspired by the second-moment transformation in WUSH, we consider a WUS transform constructed jointly from activation and weight statistics. We show that under positive-definite second moments, WUS transform minimizes the local reconstruction loss over all invertible changes of basis. In the resulting basis, the activation and weight second moments are simultaneously diagonalized and balanced, causing the deletion error to decompose into independent spectral contributions and yielding a principled criterion for coordinate selection. Guided by this result, we develop a scalable pruning method based on blockwise WUS transformations and compact input projections. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models from 8B to 72B parameters show consistent improvements over structured pruning baselines across language modeling, knowledge, commonsense reasoning, mathematics, and code generation benchmarks, while also delivering practical reductions in inference latency and memory usage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WUSPruner，一种基于变换的结构化剪枝框架，通过 WUS 变换（联合激活与权重统计量）选择最优基底以最小化剪枝重构损失，在 Llama/Qwen 8B-72B 模型上显著超越基线，并在语言建模、知识、推理、数学、代码生成等任务上取得一致性提升，同时降低推理延迟和内存占用。
AI.motivation: 结构化剪枝通常在模型原始表示中决定移除哪些维度，但坐标删除的效果根本上依赖于剪枝所用的基底。这引出核心问题：如何专门为坐标删除选择最优基底？现有方法缺乏 principled 的基底选择准则，导致剪枝性能受限。
AI.method: 将基底选择建模为局部线性重构问题，直接最小化剪枝导致的重构损失。受 WUSH 中二阶矩变换启发，构建联合激活与权重统计量的 WUS 变换。证明在正定二阶矩条件下，WUS 变换在所有可逆基变换中最小化局部重构损失。在该基底下，激活与权重二阶矩同时对角化且平衡，使删除误差分解为独立的谱贡献，从而得到坐标选择的 principled 准则。进而开发基于分块 WUS 变换和紧凑输入投影的可扩展剪枝方法。
AI.result: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列模型（8B 至 72B 参数）上实验，WUSPruner 在语言建模、知识问答、常识推理、数学推理和代码生成等全套基准上持续优于结构化剪枝基线，同时带来实际推理延迟降低和内存节省。
AI.conclusion: WUSPruner 通过最优基底选择将结构化剪枝转化为最小化重构损失的 principled 问题，WUS 变换提供理论最优的坐标系，实现了高效、可扩展的大模型剪枝，兼顾性能保持与部署效率提升。

title: Pushback in a Haystack: Language Models Respond to Factual Errors Ambiguously and Ineffectively
summary: The sycophancy of language models, or their failure to push back against faulty user input, is now widely studied. However, if LMs do push back, is sycophancy solved? We show that LMs vary in how they present pushback, and thus vary in how effectively they correct user beliefs. We introduce a phrase-level, human-validated response labeling framework to uncover fine-grained insights into how LMs push against and/or affirm false inputs. We develop and apply our framework on model responses in five languages: English, German, Chinese, Hindi, and Yoruba. We find that when models do push back against users' false assertions, they tend to use indirect phrasing and mix in affirmation, with more indirectness in Hindi and Yoruba than in other languages considered. In a large-scale human study (n = 300), we find that the pushback ambiguity we identified may fail to correct and prevent users' factual misconceptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型如何反驳用户的错误输入（即谄媚性问题）。引入短语级人工验证标注框架，在英、德、中、印地语、约鲁巴语五种语言中分析模型反驳方式，发现模型倾向使用间接措辞并混合肯定语气，印地语和约鲁巴语更间接。大规模人类研究（n=300）表明这种模糊反驳无法有效纠正用户的事实误解。
AI.motivation: 虽然谄媚性已被广泛研究，但模型真正进行反驳时，其反驳的呈现方式及有效性尚不明确。论文旨在探究模型是否以及如何通过反驳来纠正用户错误信念，以及跨语言差异。
AI.method: 开发短语级、经人工验证的响应标注框架，细粒度分析模型如何反驳和/或肯定错误输入。将框架应用于五种语言的模型响应，并开展大规模人类研究（n=300）评估反驳对纠正事实误解的效果。
AI.result: 模型反驳时倾向使用间接措辞并夹杂肯定成分，印地语和约鲁巴语比其他语言更间接。人类研究证实：这种模棱两可的反驳方式可能无法纠正和预防用户的事实误解。
AI.conclusion: 仅有反驳行为不足以解决谄媚性问题；反驳的直接程度、是否混合肯定等呈现方式至关重要，直接影响纠正用户错误信念的效果，且不同语言存在显著差异。

title: Uncovering Robustness Weaknesses in LLM Agents via Persona Evolution with Task-Integrity Constraints
summary: Interactive-agent evaluations commonly rely on standardized LLM-based user simulators that exhibit broadly cooperative behavior, potentially overlooking failures that arise under diverse but realistic user interactions. This can lead to overly optimistic estimates of agent robustness and provide limited failure signals for training agents that generalize across users. Existing approaches largely rely on predefined user behaviors, which may miss agent- or domain-specific weaknesses, while failure-oriented search can reduce task success by invalidating the underlying task rather than exposing genuine robustness failures. To fill this gap, we introduce TIPER, a task-integrity-preserving persona evolution method that automatically discovers agent-specific user policies exposing robustness weaknesses while keeping the underlying task valid and solvable. TIPER evolves persistent user personas through reflection-guided behavioral mutations and task-wise Pareto selection under a task-integrity constraint. Across four interactive-agent benchmarks, TIPER yields lower held-out avg@3 scores in all 12 GPT-5.4 settings, with observed reductions of 5.8 to 33.7 percentage points, and in all 28 agent-domain pairs spanning seven agents, with a median observed reduction of 22.9 points. Further analysis yields a behavior-to-failure taxonomy that connects discovered user behaviors to recurring agent failure modes. Together, these results show that TIPER enables more diagnostic robustness evaluation of interactive agents and provides informative failure analysis for future agent robustness improvement. Code repository: https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/TIPER.

AI.tldr: TIPER 是一种保持任务完整性的人设演化方法，通过自动发现针对特定智能体的用户策略来暴露鲁棒性弱点，同时保持任务的有效性和可解性。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式智能体评估依赖标准化的 LLM 用户模拟器，表现出广泛的合作行为，可能忽略在多样化但真实的用户交互下出现的故障，导致对智能体鲁棒性的过度乐观估计，并为训练跨用户泛化的智能体提供有限的故障信号。
AI.method: TIPER 通过反思引导的行为变异和任务级帕累托选择，在任务完整性约束下演化持久的用户人设，自动发现暴露智能体鲁棒性弱点的用户策略，同时保持底层任务的有效性和可解性。
AI.result: 在四个交互式智能体基准上，TIPER 在所有 12 个 GPT-5.4 设置中均降低了 held-out avg@3 分数，观测到 5.8 到 33.7 个百分点的下降；在涵盖七个智能体的所有 28 个智能体-领域对中，中位观测下降 22.9 个百分点。进一步分析产出了行为到故障的分类学，将发现的用户行为与反复出现的智能体故障模式联系起来。
AI.conclusion: TIPER 实现了更具诊断性的交互式智能体鲁棒性评估，并为未来智能体鲁棒性改进提供了信息丰富的故障分析。

title: GA-SVD: Generation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for LLM Compression
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generalization across a broad range of reasoning and generation tasks, but their large parameter counts impose substantial memory and computation costs, hindering deployment in practical resource-constrained settings. One-shot low-rank compression is a promising solution since it reduces model size and inference cost effectively. However, existing SVD-based methods primarily target multiple-choice benchmarks and often fail to preserve performance on generation tasks. Moreover, their rank allocation strategies are typically heuristic. We propose GA-SVD, a generation-aware low-rank compression framework for LLMs. First, we introduce Generation-Aware Weight Whitening (GAWW), which leverages gradients from on-policy knowledge distillation to construct whitening transformations aligned with generative behavior. Second, we develop an evolutionary global rank allocation method that searches for effective layer-wise rank allocation under a given global compression ratio. Across extensive experiments on Mistral-7B, Qwen3 series, and Llama-3.3 models, evaluated on both multiple-choice and generative benchmarks, GA-SVD consistently outperforms existing SVD-based baselines and achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) results. We further demonstrate scalability by applying our method to models with up to 70B parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出GA-SVD，一种面向生成任务的低秩压缩框架，通过生成感知权重白化（GAWW）和进化全局秩分配，在Mistral-7B、Qwen3、Llama-3.3等模型上实现多选与生成基准的SOTA压缩效果，并验证了70B规模的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型参数量大导致内存和计算开销高，难以在资源受限环境部署。现有基于SVD的一次性低秩压缩方法主要针对多选基准，难以保持生成任务性能，且秩分配策略多为启发式，缺乏针对生成行为的优化。
AI.method: GA-SVD包含两大核心组件：1) 生成感知权重白化（GAWW），利用在线策略知识蒸馏的梯度构建与生成行为对齐的白化变换；2) 进化全局秩分配，在给定全局压缩率下通过进化搜索确定各层最优秩分配。
AI.result: 在Mistral-7B、Qwen3系列、Llama-3.3模型上，跨多选与生成基准的广泛实验表明，GA-SVD持续超越现有SVD基线，达到最优压缩性能；并展示了在70B参数模型上的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GA-SVD有效解决了现有SVD压缩方法在生成任务上性能下降及秩分配启发式的问题，为LLM在资源受限场景的部署提供了实用的低秩压缩方案。

title: Understanding Machine Taste: Aesthetic Agreement Across Foundation Models in K-pop
summary: As foundation models enter creative industries, understanding their aesthetic preferences becomes an important step toward AI-assisted creative decision making. In this work, we investigate how foundation models evaluate creative content and characterize their ``machine taste'' using K-pop songs and music videos as a testbed. We formulate aesthetic evaluation as a pairwise ranking problem and systematically examine pairwise inter-model agreement, group-level consensus, and cross-modal preference alignment. Our results reveal stronger pairwise inter-model agreement and group-level consensus in visual evaluation than in audio evaluation, while preferences across the two modalities remain weakly aligned. We further examine how visual consensus rankings relate to real-world popularity using historical YouTube viewership data, finding positive but varying correlations across artist groups. These findings provide initial insights into machine aesthetic preferences and lay the groundwork for future AI-assisted creative decision making that considers creative content, artist identity, audience preferences, and market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨基础模型在创意产业中的审美偏好（机器品味），以K-pop歌曲和MV为测试床，将审美评估建模为成对排序问题，系统分析模型间一致性、群体共识及跨模态偏好对齐。发现视觉评估中模型间一致性与群体共识显著强于音频评估，但音视频偏好仅弱对齐；视觉共识排名与YouTube播放量呈正相关，但相关性随艺人群体差异。为AI辅助创意决策提供初步洞见。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型进入创意产业，理解其审美偏好是实现AI辅助创意决策的关键前提。
AI.method: 将审美评估形式化为成对排序任务，系统考察成对模型间一致性、群体层面共识及跨模态（音频/视觉）偏好对齐；以K-pop歌曲和MV为测试床；进一步引入历史YouTube观看数据，分析视觉共识排名与现实流行度的关联。
AI.result: 视觉评估中成对模型间一致性与群体共识均显著强于音频评估；音频与视觉模态的偏好仅呈弱对齐；视觉共识排名与YouTube播放量呈正相关，但相关性强弱随艺人群体而异。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了机器审美偏好的初步图景，为未来整合创意内容、艺人身份、受众偏好及市场动态的AI辅助创意决策奠定基础。

title: Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction
summary: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES.

AI.tldr: 论文提出交互式4D体积液体预测任务：预测固体物体穿过液体时，未来密集3D液体速度场的时空演化。针对现有方法无法处理移动固体诱导的全域液体响应这一局限，提出两级循环预测框架TIDE/TIDES，其中TIDE隔离局部接口驱动预测，TIDES引入传感耦合和显式稳定化减少累积误差。实验表明TIDES在多种基线、消融、OOD测试和长时域评估中均达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有流体预测工作主要针对静态或预设固体几何，或合成视觉上合理的流体运动，缺乏对交互式液体动力学的覆盖——即无法预测移动固体如何诱导未来的全域液体响应。预测难点在于流体动力学效应集中在不断演化的液固界面附近，但预测目标却是全局时空展开。
AI.method: 提出两级循环预测框架：TIDE（第一级）隔离局部接口驱动的预测，专注于液固交互界面处的局部动力学；TIDES（第二级）在此基础上添加传感感知耦合和显式稳定化机制，以减少长时域展开中的累积误差，实现全域时空预测。
AI.result: 在改编的邻近基线、受控组件消融实验、运动/尺寸分布外测试和长时域评估中，TIDES均达到最佳预测性能。消融实验确认：局部交互建模、传感耦合、显式稳定化是性能提升的三大关键贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过任务形式化、基准建立和TIDE/TIDES研究，为移动固体条件下的密集液体预测奠定了受控基础。代码已公开。

title: Harnessing VLM in Embodied RL: From Reward Regressor to Success Detector via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating
summary: VLMs provide promising solutions to embodied reward design. Most current methods that train VLMs as reward regressors not only require extensive annotations but are also primarily designed for finetuning pretrained policies, and perform less well in the more challenging from-scratch RL setting. This issue stems from a fundamental mismatch: regressing precise rewards is misaligned with what VLMs naturally excel at. We posit that it is more aligned with VLMs' inherent multi-modal VQA capabilities for the models to function as success detectors, and propose VLM success reward via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating (VLMeg) to well harness VLM for embodied reward design. As the core of VLMeg, the proposed exploration-augmented key-observation gating first determines whether the current RL episode is judgment-worthy based on its similarity to a generated success trajectory. Then, the key observation with the lowest confusion from the judgment-worthy episode will be selected for VLM evaluation as episodic reward. This gating mechanism not only avoids redundant calls but also enables higher detection accuracy of VLM. Considering the sparsity of judgment-worthy episodes, the advanced exploration incentives based on the generated trajectory are introduced, enabling more efficient exploration toward judgment-worthy trajectories for more VLM reward triggers and thus gaining higher RL efficiency. Extensive experiments in MetaWorld demonstrate VLMeg achieves state-of-the-art from-scratch RL, outperforming advanced VLM-based baselines on 12 challenging reward-free tasks. Furthermore, VLMeg also enables effective RL without any ground-truth reward in 3 challenging real-world experiments. Code will be open after acceptance at https://github.com/Raina915/VLMeg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLMeg，一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的成功检测器，通过探索增强的关键观测门控机制，解决现有VLM奖励回归方法在从头开始的强化学习（RL）中表现不佳的问题，实现了无需真实奖励的具身奖励设计。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将VLM作为奖励回归器训练，需要大量标注且主要用于微调预训练策略，在从头开始的RL设置中表现较差。根本原因在于精确回归奖励与VLM天然擅长的多模态视觉问答（VQA）能力不匹配。作者认为让VLM充当成功检测器更符合其固有能力。
AI.method: 提出VLMeg，核心是探索增强的关键观测门控：首先根据与生成的成功轨迹的相似性判断当前RL回合是否值得判断；然后从值得判断的回合中选择混淆度最低的关键观测送入VLM评估作为情节奖励。该门控机制避免冗余调用并提高检测准确率。针对值得判断回合的稀疏性，引入基于生成轨迹的高级探索激励，促进高效探索以触发更多VLM奖励，提升RL效率。
AI.result: 在MetaWorld基准上的大量实验表明，VLMeg在12个具有挑战性的无奖励任务上实现了最先进的从头开始RL性能，优于先进的基于VLM的基线。此外，在3个具有挑战性的真实世界实验中，VLMeg也实现了无需任何真实奖励的有效RL。
AI.conclusion: VLMeg通过将VLM作为成功检测器而非奖励回归器，结合探索增强的关键观测门控机制，有效解决了具身奖励设计中从头开始RL的难题，显著提高了样本效率和泛化能力，为无奖励RL提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Geometric Structure Predicts Per-Example Neighborhood Loss Under PCA Truncation
summary: Dimensionality reduction can preserve the average performance of text embeddings even when a substantial fraction of their dimensions is removed. Aggregate metrics, however, do not reveal whether degradation is distributed uniformly across examples. We study per-example neighborhood stability under PCA truncation across static word embeddings and modern sentence encoders. Per-item neighbor retention varies widely and is predictable from geometric properties of the representation and its alignment with the retained PCA subspace. The fraction of centered-vector energy retained by the truncated subspace is strongest for CBOW and RI, with neighborhood contrast leading on SkipGram and the modern/Matryoshka settings (GTE approximately tied), while local density is associated with retention in marginal analysis but adds little unique information once energy and contrast are controlled (R-squared increments 0.001 to 0.010). Local intrinsic dimensionality accounts for more variation than density on modern sentence encoders in pairwise comparison. On SciFact, query density predicts retrieval degradation under aggressive compression; on NFCorpus the primary 32d association does not replicate, and a direct variance-restriction test leaves that null unresolved. Average compression performance conceals systematic per-example variation that geometry makes visible.

AI.tldr: 降维虽能保持文本嵌入的平均性能，但聚合指标掩盖了逐样本的性能差异；本文通过几何属性预测PCA截断下的邻域稳定性，发现能量保留率、邻域对比度等几何因素能解释不同嵌入模型下的样本级保留差异。
AI.motivation: 聚合指标无法揭示降维对单个样本邻域稳定性的影响是否均匀，需要理解逐样本层面的几何特性如何预测降维后的性能变化。
AI.method: 对静态词嵌入（CBOW、SkipGram、RI）和现代句子编码器（包括Matryoshka/GTE）进行PCA截断实验，分析逐样本邻域保留率与几何属性（中心向量能量保留率、邻域对比度、局部密度、局部内在维度）的关系，并在SciFact和NFCorpus检索任务上验证。
AI.result: 不同模型下的最强预测因子不同：CBOW/RI由能量保留率主导，SkipGram和现代编码器由邻域对比度主导；局部密度在边际分析中相关但控制能量和对比度后贡献极小（R²增量0.001-0.010）；局部内在维度在现代编码器上比密度解释更多变异；SciFact上查询密度预测激进压缩下的检索退化，但NFCorpus上32维关联未复现，方差限制测试未能解决该零结果。
AI.conclusion: 平均压缩性能掩盖了系统性的逐样本差异，几何属性使这些差异显现，为理解和预测降维对单个样本的影响提供了依据。

title: ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts
comment: 42 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Accepted by NeurIPS'26. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/ZyFanTJ/ProCARE
summary: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProCARE 框架，将真实世界研究（RWS）自动化重构为约束编译问题，通过证据契约和强类型中间表示（RWS-IR）解决临床语义隐性导致的模式不匹配、时间错误、粒度不一致和结论无依据等问题，在 36 个 EHR 基准任务上显著优于强 LLM Agent 基线。
AI.motivation: 真实世界研究依赖常规医疗数据（如电子病历、保险索赔）估计治疗效果、监测安全性、识别风险因素。用大语言模型 Agent 自动化 RWS 虽具吸引力但极其脆弱：有效分析依赖数据集特有的临床语义（索引日期、随访窗口、患者/事件级分析单位、结局边界），这些语义常隐性存在于观察性数据中，导致模式不匹配、时间错误、分析粒度不一致和无临床依据的结论。
AI.method: 提出 ProCARE，一个基于画像的框架，将 RWS 自动化重构为约束编译：1) 将异构数据画像转换为证据契约，明确可用变量、时间属性、分布及证据边界；2) 将研究目标编译为 RWS-IR，一种用于变量、时间关系、分析单位和统计任务的强类型中间表示；3) 通过确定性验证与局部修复，在模式映射、队列构建、变量派生、分析和解释五个阶段检查并修正生成的工作流。
AI.result: 在 36 个基于 EHR 的基准任务上，ProCARE 在代码可执行性、语义一致性和结论可追溯性三个维度均优于强 LLM Agent 基线；自动化违规诊断与盲法专家评审呈现中度到实质性一致。
AI.conclusion: ProCARE 通过将临床语义显式化为证据契约与强类型 IR，并引入确定性验证与修复机制，有效解决了 RWS 自动化中的脆弱性问题，实现了可执行、语义一致且可追溯的真实世界研究自动化流程。

title: Riemannian Graph Tokenizer for Structural Knowledge Transfer
summary: Foundation models are at the forefront of artificial intelligence. A tokenizer, converting the raw input into discrete representations that the model can understand, plays an important role to the success of foundation models. Unlike the text tokenizer that is well studied in large language models, graph tokenizer is still at its early stage, facing the challenges of tackling the non-Euclidean structures and capturing the structural semantics. How to design a graph tokenizer for structural knowledge transfer? To this end, we propose a Riemannian Graph Tokenizer (RGT) that bridges the structural knowledge and quantized representations to support cross-domain structural knowledge transfer. The connection is established by Riemannian geometry. Specifically, we first define the geometric vocabulary (trees, cycles and sequences), which captures fundamental structural patterns and reflects the intrinsic geometry of graph. Second, we construct a Riemannian quantizer with Riemannian Straight-Through Estimator to tokenise graph structures across multiple domains into discrete tokens. To ensure consistency and transferability across diverse geometric spaces, RGT further incorporates a geometry-aligned decoder that projects manifold-specific tokens into a unified tangent space. The theoretical analysis and geometric interpretations are provided to support the effectiveness of our proposed method. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that RGT significantly enhances structural knowledge transferability across graph domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼图分词器（RGT），利用黎曼几何桥接结构知识与量化表示，实现跨域结构知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 图分词器尚处早期阶段，面临非欧几里得结构处理和结构语义捕获的挑战，亟需设计支持结构知识迁移的图分词器。
AI.method: 1) 定义几何词汇（树、环、序列）捕获基本结构模式；2) 构建带黎曼直通估计器的黎曼量化器将跨域图结构离散化；3) 引入几何对齐解码器将流形特定token投影到统一切空间保证一致性。
AI.result: 提供理论分析和几何解释，跨多样化数据集的大量实验表明RGT显著增强跨图域结构知识迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: RGT通过黎曼几何连接结构知识与量化表示，有效解决跨域结构知识迁移问题，为图基础模型分词器设计提供新范式。

title: Auditing Failure Attribution: Label Predictability and Judge Behavior
summary: Failure-attribution benchmarks ask an LLM judge which step or agent caused a failure. A high score should mean the judge checked the faulty step against the run (a cross-step check). However, spurious signals (surface cues) that predict the annotation can produce a high score. In this paper, we propose four tests to separate checking from cue use. Input restriction asks whether partial input predicts the annotation. Cue following checks whether moved cues change answers. Residual accuracy scores judges where cue-only predictors fail. Aggregation asks whether the failure mix or metric changes rankings. Real observations motivate these tests: on three benchmarks, simple predictors match or beat GPT-4.1. In two Who&When Pro systems, a classifier reading one step's reasoning finds 95-100% of faulty steps, motivating input restriction. In one of them, error injection leaves no reasoning after the faulty step; judges fine-tuned on its labels beat GPT-4.1 by 41 points. Adding task-related reasoning after that step moves this cue: fine-tuned judges lose 31-99 points, but zero-shot judges lose at most 9, motivating cue following. On Aegis, blaming every agent matches GPT-4.1 on micro-F1 but trails by 19 points in exact-set accuracy, motivating aggregation. We recommend reporting these tests when developing failure-attribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对故障归因基准中LLM裁判可能利用虚假表面线索而非真正跨步检查的问题，提出四项测试（输入限制、线索跟随、残余准确率、聚合）以区分检查与线索利用，并在三个基准上实证表明简单预测器可匹敌或超越GPT-4.1，建议开发此类基准时必须报告这些测试。
AI.motivation: 当前故障归因基准的高分可能源于裁判利用虚假表面线索（如特定步骤的推理模式）而非真正进行跨步检查，导致评估不可靠。需开发方法区分真实检查能力与线索利用。
AI.method: 提出四项测试：1) 输入限制测试：检查部分输入（如单步推理）是否能预测标注；2) 线索跟随测试：移动线索位置观察裁判答案是否改变；3) 残余准确率：在仅靠线索的预测器失效的样本上评分；4) 聚合测试：检验故障混合比例或指标变化是否改变排名。在Who&When Pro、Aegis三个基准上用简单分类器、微调裁判、零样本裁判等进行实证。
AI.result: 实证发现：1) 简单分类器仅读单步推理即能以95-100%召回率定位故障步骤，验证输入限制必要性；2) 错误注入导致故障步骤后无推理，微调裁判比GPT-4.1高41分，但添加任务相关推理后微调裁判跌31-99分而零样本裁判最多跌9分，验证线索跟随；3) Aegis上“全怪所有代理”在micro-F1上与GPT-4.1持平但在exact-set accuracy落后19分，验证聚合测试必要性。简单预测器在三基准上匹敌或超越GPT-4.1。
AI.conclusion: 故障归因基准开发必须报告这四项测试，以确保高分反映真实跨步检查能力而非虚假线索利用，提升基准的评估效度。

title: Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification
summary: Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. Online, hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval first identifies the top-$K$ candidate labels and then selects up to $M$ input-relevant boundary rules connecting candidate-label pairs. A lightweight LLM performs the final classification in a single call using the retrieved definitions and rules. Across three public benchmarks and a real-world multilingual book-classification dataset, SLKR achieves the best results on all four datasets with Qwen3.5-4B and on three of four with Ministral-3-3B, while using compact input contexts and no task-specific labeled examples. Boundary ablations further show that retrieving a small set of input-relevant rules preserves performance close to using all boundaries with substantially less context, supporting efficient reuse of flagship-generated label knowledge for lightweight classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SLKR（语义标签知识检索），一种面向零样本文本分类的标签中心检索增强生成框架，通过离线用旗舰大模型构建可复用的标签知识库（定义、检索关键词、易混标签对的边界规则），在线用混合语义/词法检索召回候选标签及相关边界规则，再由轻量级大模型单次调用完成分类。在三个公开基准及一个真实多语言图书分类数据集上，SLKR 配合 Qwen3.5-4B 在全部四个数据集取得最优结果，配合 Ministral-3-3B 在三个数据集最优，且上下文紧凑、无需任务特定标注数据。消融实验表明仅检索少量输入相关边界规则即可保持接近全量边界的性能，验证了旗舰模型生成的标签知识可高效复用于轻量级分类。
AI.motivation: 旗舰大语言模型虽具备丰富常识与强推理能力，但推理成本高、延迟大，难以大规模用于数据标注。现有零样本分类方法常依赖任务特定标注样本或分类器反馈，缺乏对标签语义与易混边界的显式建模，且难以在轻量模型上高效复用旗舰模型知识。
AI.method: SLKR 分离离线知识构建与在线轻量推理：离线阶段，旗舰大模型独立为每个标签生成定义、检索关键词，并为潜在易混标签对生成边界规则，形成可复用的标签知识库（一次性成本可摊销）；在线阶段，混合语义与词法检索先召回 top-K 候选标签，再为候选标签对选取至多 M 条输入相关的边界规则，最后由轻量级大模型在单次调用中利用检索到的定义与规则完成分类。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准（如 AG News, DBpedia 等）及一个真实多语言图书分类数据集上，SLKR 搭配 Qwen3.5-4B 在全部四个数据集达到最优，搭配 Ministral-3-3B 在三个数据集最优。方法使用紧凑输入上下文、无需任务特定标注样本。边界规则消融显示，仅检索少量输入相关规则即可保持接近使用全部边界规则的性能，大幅减少上下文长度。
AI.conclusion: SLKR 通过标签中心的离线知识构建与在线检索增强，实现了旗舰大模型语义知识向轻量级模型的高效迁移与复用，在零样本文本分类任务上以极小推理开销达到了最优或近最优性能，为大规模低成本数据标注提供了可行路径。

title: Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization for Robust Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
summary: Context-based offline meta-reinforcement learning (COMRL) has advanced almost entirely through better task representations, which separate task identity from artifacts of the behavior policy so that the latent reflects the task alone. The implicit expectation has been that a clean representation will transfer to out-of-support (parameter-extrapolation) tasks. On such a task, however, the encoder produces a latent outside the training support, where the policy has never been trained. We address this gap with Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization (PLATO), which exposes the policy to off-support latents during training. PLATO assumes a mild manifold hypothesis: task latents lie on a low-dimensional manifold, and out-of-support tasks lie farther from the training centroid. It exploits this geometry by perturbing inferred latents outward from the centroid to synthesize counterfactual tasks. A learned decoder ensemble then rolls out short trajectories at each perturbed latent, and the policy is updated on the imagined transitions under a pessimism weight that down-weights steps on which the ensemble disagrees. We prove that the perturbation leaves the training support by a controllable margin and that the out-of-support generalization gap is bounded by the same perturbation reach, and we give explicit conditions, verified empirically, under which the epistemic disagreement at the perturbed latent stays bounded away from zero. On eight MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, PLATO consistently improves out-of-support returns over strong COMRL baselines while remaining competitive on in-distribution tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/deephoony/plato.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PLATO（Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization）方法，针对基于上下文的离线元强化学习（COMRL）在分布外任务上的泛化问题，通过将推断的潜变量向外扰动生成反事实任务，并利用解码器集合进行悲观策略更新，显著提升了分布外任务的回报，同时保持了分布内任务的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有的 COMRL 方法主要通过学习干净的任务表示来分离任务身份与行为策略伪影，但隐含假设干净的表示能泛化到分布外（参数外推）任务。然而，在分布外任务上，编码器会产生训练支持集之外的潜变量，而策略从未在这些潜变量上训练过，导致泛化性能下降。
AI.method: PLATO 假设任务潜变量位于低维流形上，分布外任务距离训练质心更远。利用这一几何性质，将推断的潜变量从质心向外扰动以合成反事实任务；训练解码器集合在每个扰动潜变量上展开短轨迹；在悲观权重下更新策略，该权重对集合模型出现分歧的步骤进行降权。理论上证明了扰动以可控边界离开训练支持集，且分布外泛化间隙由扰动范围界定，给出了在扰动潜变量上认知分歧保持有界的显式条件。
AI.result: 在八个 MuJoCo 连续控制基准测试中，PLATO 在分布外任务上持续优于强基线，同时在分布内任务上保持竞争力表现。
AI.conclusion: PLATO 通过显式地在训练中暴露策略于分布外潜变量，并结合悲观集合机制，有效解决了干净任务表示与分布外泛化之间的鸿沟，提供了理论保证和实证改进。

title: Connecting the Dots: Enduring Performance Gaps in ASR Systems Between Standard and Minority English Varieties
comment: Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026. 11 pages including appendix, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/smfsamir/longitudinal-asr-eval
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system evaluations have consistently revealed performance disparities along lines of race, gender, socioeconomic status, and language variety. While these disparities are well-documented, they are often (implicitly or explicitly) treated as issues that subsequent, larger, and more universal models will correct. We challenge this assumption of steady progress in reducing accent-related performance disparities, conducting a longitudinal evaluation of 16 prominent systems released between 2021-2025 across 8 datasets representing diverse English accent varieties. We find that the performance disparity between Mainstream US English (MUSE) and minority accents is stubborn, not reliably declining as a function of time. Specifically, while systems are reliably performant on MUSE, minority accents are subject to risks of large performance degradations between generations of systems, sometimes worsening by 65% absolute Word Error Rate. We argue that standard ASR benchmarks enact an implicit language policy privileging Mainstream US English varieties. As such, these performance disparities reflect systemic failures of language technology development infrastructure that disproportionately affect underrepresented speaker populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了“更大、更通用的ASR模型会自动减少口音相关性能差异”的假设。通过纵向评估2021-2025年间发布的16个主流ASR系统在8个多样化英语口音数据集上的表现，发现主流美式英语（MUSE）与少数族裔口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，未随时间可靠下降。少数族裔口音在系统迭代中面临巨大性能退化风险，绝对词错误率（WER）最高恶化65%。论文指出标准ASR基准隐含语言政策，偏袒主流美式英语，这种差异反映了语言技术开发基础设施的系统性失败，不成比例地影响代表性不足的讲者群体。
AI.motivation: ASR系统在种族、性别、社会经济地位和语言变体等维度上存在性能差异已有充分文献记录，但这些差异常被隐性或显性地视为后续更大、更通用的模型将自动修正的问题。本文旨在挑战这种关于减少口音相关性能差异稳步进步的假设。
AI.method: 对2021年至2025年间发布的16个主流ASR系统进行纵向评估，测试集覆盖8个代表多样化英语口音变体的数据集。
AI.result: 主流美式英语（MUSE）与少数族裔口音之间的性能差距顽固存在，未随时间可靠下降。系统在MUSE上表现稳健，但少数族裔口音在系统代际迭代中面临巨大性能退化风险，绝对词错误率（WER）最高恶化达65%。
AI.conclusion: 标准ASR基准实施了一种隐含语言政策，特权化主流美式英语变体。这些性能差异反映了语言技术开发基础设施的系统性失败，不成比例地影响代表性不足的讲者群体。

title: Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces
summary: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance. Matched dialogue-state evaluations reveal that local field construction largely preserves Jev's correct states but reduces Qwen's mean-turn accuracy, highlighting task- and interface-dependent differences. Sequence-level confidence and request-cost analyses further characterize completed outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Choice2Seq 基准，量化模型在选择正确答案与通过序列化本地决策构建答案之间的正确性保留差距。实验显示 Jev 等模型在选择任务上准确率极高，但在序列化构建时正确率大幅下降（算术 33.0%、词汇检索 2.1%）。限制本地选项为候选字符、显式位置索引等干预措施能提升构建保真度。对话状态评估揭示不同模型在任务与接口层面的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有模型常能在选择题设置中选出正确答案，但若要求其通过一系列局部决策（如逐字符生成）序列化构建答案，则可能失败。缺乏系统性基准来度量这种“选择-构建”一致性，以及区分任务正确性、计划保真度与输出合规性。
AI.method: 构建 Choice2Seq 诊断基准：在相同问题与候选集上，分别进行完整答案选择与序列化构建两次独立运行。引入序列组合率（SCR）指标，衡量正确被选项目中通过局部构建也能答对的比例。在算术与词汇检索任务上评测 Jev、StartLux、Qwen 等模型；测试限制局部选项为候选支持字符、显式位置索引等干预；进行匹配对话状态评估、序列级置信度与请求成本分析。
AI.result: Jev 选择准确率分别达 97.1%（算术）和 99.5%（词汇检索），但 SCR 仅 33.0% 和 2.1%。StartLux 与 Qwen 亦存在显著差距，Qwen 直接逐字符生成时亦如此。限制局部选项至候选字符可提升构建正确率；显式位置索引能改善复制保真度（甚至对错误选择）。对话状态评估显示局部字段构建基本保留 Jev 正确状态，但降低 Qwen 平均轮次准确率，凸显任务与接口依赖差异。序列置信度与成本分析进一步刻画完整输出特性。
AI.conclusion: 选择与序列化构建之间存在显著正确性保留鸿沟，且随模型、任务、交互接口而异。干预措施能分离任务正确性、计划保真度与输出合规性三个维度。Choice2Seq 为诊断模型序列化推理能力提供了细粒度基准。

title: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
summary: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpecWM，一种基于谱表示学习的 JEPA 框架，通过目标相似性核显式指定观测间的期望关系，控制世界模型保留何种信息；实验表明时间谱对齐显著提升了 CEM 规划在多个基准上的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型难以控制其保留哪些信息（如物理状态与干扰信息）；作者希望通过显式指定表示几何来引导模型保留对控制有用的信息。
AI.method: 引入 SpecWM：采用目标相似性核定义观测间的期望关系，训练编码器使其嵌入几何复现这些关系；核的选择从物理状态监督到完全自监督的时间核；理论分析全局最优、线性可恢复性及对无关信息的不变性，并将时间核相似性与行为继任测度联系起来。
AI.result: 核的选择强烈决定哪些物理量可从表示中线性恢复；时间谱对齐使 CEM 规划成功率在 OGBench Cube 上从 52% 提升至 68%，OGBench Scene 上从 49% 至 77%，CALVIN 上从 29% 至 51%。
AI.conclusion: 显式指定表示几何（通过相似性核）提供了一种简单有效的方式，引导潜在世界模型保留对控制至关重要的信息。

title: Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the <think> tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just ~2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.

AI.tldr: RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization) 通过仅优化初始根 token（如是否调用 <thinking> 标签）的策略，利用组相对奖励和组内优势，让大型推理模型 (LRM) 自主决定何时进行显式推理，以约 2% 的训练算力实现难度感知的自适应思考，大幅降低训练开销和显存占用。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型 (LRM) 通过外化显式推理链取得强性能，但存在过度思考问题：对不同难度的查询分配均匀的大量计算。专有模型虽通过不透明路由缓解，但开源 LRM 因训练成本高昂且训练配方披露有限，缺乏高效内化自适应推理的机制。
AI.method: RPO 框架仅训练关键的分支决策点——初始根 token（例如是否触发 <thinking> 标签）。采用组相对奖励 (group relative reward) 与组内优势 (group-wise advantages) 进行策略优化，聚焦于这一决定性枢纽，从而极大地减少参与训练的参数量和显存消耗。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族和规模上实验表明，RPO 以仅约 2% 的前代自适应推理方法的训练算力，成功学会难度感知的自适应思考能力，显著降低了训练开销和 VRAM 占用。
AI.conclusion: RPO 通过极简的根 token 策略优化，为开源大型推理模型提供了一种高效、低成本的自适应推理内化路径，解决了过度思考与训练成本的矛盾，推动了开源 LRM 向实用化部署迈进。

title: OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/one_shot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ONESHOT 方法，利用单个确认的异常标签对检测器池进行加权集成，而非选择单一检测器。在 152 个单变量和 73 个多变量时间序列上，ONESHOT 超越了最强单一检测器、池均值集成以及基于确认事件选取最佳检测器的策略。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测不存在通用最优检测器，最佳选择取决于具体序列。现有方法要么为每个序列选择单一检测器，要么对检测器池进行均值集成，但两者都假设永远不会获得标签。实际上，部署的监控系统会在操作员确认告警时获得标签，这些标签可被利用来改进检测。
AI.method: ONESHOT 方法：利用单个确认的异常事件对检测器池中的每个检测器进行评分，将这些评分作为权重，构建整个检测器池的软混合（加权集成）模型。无需训练，仅需一次标签即可自适应调整集成权重。
AI.result: 在 152 个单变量和 73 个多变量时间序列数据集上的实验表明，ONESHOT 仅凭单个确认异常即可接近该序列的最优检测器性能。其表现优于：最强单一检测器、整个检测器池的均值集成、以及基于确认事件选择最佳检测器的策略。
AI.conclusion: 单个确认的异常标签足以通过加权集成显著提升异常检测性能，ONESHOT 提供了一种简单、无需训练且有效的在线自适应方案，填补了部署环境中标签利用的空白。

title: Split Conformal Interval Length under Huber Contamination
summary: Existing analyses of interval length in split conformal prediction largely focus on clean data. However, how contamination at the training and calibration stages alters interval length relative to the corresponding clean population oracle remains understudied. In this paper, we consider Huber contamination and derive a finite-sample upper bound that holds uniformly over contaminating distributions, with leading terms scaling as $L(δ_1+n_1^{-1/2}) +(n_2^{-1/2}+δ_2)/((1-δ_2)r_0)$, in addition to a clean-sample estimation term. We further establish a minimax lower bound matching the upper-bound rate up to constant factors on a regular asymmetric location submodel. For calibration contamination, we obtain an exact worst-case characterization of the population interval-length deviation. We also extend the upper-bound results to conformalized quantile regression and adaptive residual scores. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets provide empirical support for our theoretical findings on training and calibration contamination.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在Huber污染模型下，分裂共形预测的区间长度受训练阶段和校准阶段污染的影响，给出了有限样本上界、极小极大下界以及校准污染的精确最坏情况表征，并将结果推广到共形分位数回归和自适应残差评分，实验验证了理论发现。
AI.motivation: 现有分裂共形预测的区间长度分析主要针对干净数据，而训练和校准阶段的污染如何改变区间长度相对于相应干净总体oracle的表现尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 考虑Huber污染模型，推导在污染分布上一致成立的有限样本上界，建立在正则非对称位置子模型上的极小极大下界，给出校准污染下总体区间长度偏差的精确最坏情况刻画，并将上界结果扩展到共形分位数回归和自适应残差评分。
AI.result: 上界主导项为$L(δ_1+n_1^{-1/2}) +(n_2^{-1/2}+δ_2)/((1-δ_2)r_0)$加上干净样本估计项；极小极大下界在常数因子上匹配上界速率；校准污染获得精确最坏情况表征；合成和真实数据实验支持理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次系统量化了Huber污染对分裂共形预测区间长度的影响，建立了匹配的上下界，揭示了训练和校准污染的不同作用机制，并将理论扩展到更广泛的共形化方法，为鲁棒不确定性量化提供了理论基础。

title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
summary: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.

AI.tldr: 论文针对Reddit推荐线程中多回复场景，指出现有Rank-GRPO方法仅随机选取单一回复计算奖励，导致优势函数85%方差来自回复选择而非列表质量。提出ReMaRk方法：对所有回复标题取并集一次性评分，并按请求均匀采样。实验显示ReMaRk在七种骨干模型和三个数据集上，仅用25-53%的步数即达Rank-GRPO 2000步的验证召回率，且最终性能不落后、部分更优且训练更省算力；在ProtoQA（百人回答）上同样有效，揭示多有效人工答案时应联合奖励的简单规则。
AI.motivation: 在Reddit推荐任务中，每个请求对应多个不同标题的回复，现有RL方法（Rank-GRPO）每个训练样本只选取一个回复计算奖励，导致优势函数主要反映“抽到了哪个回复”（占85%方差），而非生成列表的真实质量，且训练开销大。
AI.method: 提出ReMaRk：将同一请求下所有回复的标题取并集构建统一奖励集合，对每个生成列表仅计算一次奖励（基于并集），并对每个请求进行均匀采样训练。这样消除了单回复选择的方差，降低计算成本，适用于多有效答案场景。
AI.result: 在七个骨干模型和三个数据集上，ReMaRk仅用Rank-GRPO 25-53%的训练步数即达到其2000步的验证召回率，并在该预算下领先；完全收敛后从未显著落后Rank-GRPO，且在7对模型中有4对以更少GPU小时达到Rank-GRPO最优。ProtoQA实验（每问题约100人回答）同样验证了联合奖励的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对于存在多个有效人工答案的RL任务，应将所有答案联合起来一次性计算奖励（取并集），而非单独对每个答案训练。此简单规则能显著提升样本效率、降低训练成本，且不损害最终性能。

title: Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks
summary: As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction. Within this framework, we study whether LLMs can self-learn generalized facilitation strategy offline to real-time interventions. We first collect multi-party human interactions guided by task-specific expert LLM facilitators (N=432 conversations). We then employ a self-learning method in which an LLM induces an actionable strategic playbook from conversations and iteratively refines it using feedback from an LLM judge aligned with human annotators (N=20), developing a single generalized facilitator that outperforms the three task-specific expert facilitators on held-out conversations 61.4% win rate. Finally, we evaluate these improvements empirically; in a real-time online empirical study, the self-learned generalized facilitator preserves facilitator performance and group productivity, improves speaking comfort and reduces interpersonal friction, while using 24.7% fewer turns and 29.0% fewer words than the expert prompts. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLMs can learn generalizable, task-agnostic social facilitation from task-specific human interactions, on-par with hand-crafted task-specific prompts across diverse group settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过自学习方法从任务特定的专家LLM促进器引导的人类交互中学习通用促进策略，开发出单一泛化促进器，在保持任务表现和群体生产力的同时，提升发言舒适度、降低人际摩擦，并显著减少交互轮次和词数，超越三个任务特定专家促进器。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM促进器多针对特定任务微调，缺乏能适应不同任务类型和多样群体动态的泛化促进方法。需开发跨多方语境的通用LLM促进框架，同时兼顾客观任务结果与心理安全、感知摩擦等主观指标。
AI.method: 1) 收集由三个任务特定专家LLM促进器引导的432场多方人类交互数据。2) 采用自学习方法：LLM从对话中归纳可执行的策略手册，并利用与人类标注者对齐的LLM裁判反馈迭代优化，训练单一泛化促进器。3) 在保留对话上评估胜率，并进行实时在线实证研究对比专家提示词。
AI.result: 泛化促进器在保留对话上以61.4%胜率超越三个任务特定专家促进器。实时在线研究显示：保持促进器表现和群体生产力，提升发言舒适度，降低人际摩擦，交互轮次减少24.7%，词数减少29.0%。
AI.conclusion: 实证证据表明，LLM能从任务特定人类交互中学习可泛化、任务无关的社交促进能力，在多样群体设置中与手工设计的任务特定提示词相当，验证了自学习泛化促进的可行性。

title: Revisited Support Vector Machines: A Unified Joint Optimization Framework with Nyström Approximation for Scalable Adaptive Learning
summary: The theoretical elegance of Support Vector Machines (SVMs), grounded in statistical learning theory, establishes them as a reference for robust classification. However, in the era of Big Data, classical SVMs face two major bottlenecks: the prohibitive cubic complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ of training and the rigidity of static kernels. Traditional methodologies treat kernel selection as a discrete, "brute-force" GridSearch problem, effectively decoupling the learning of data representation from the optimization of the decision boundary. This paper proposes a paradigm shift with a so-called "Revisited SVM", a unified framework that recasts the learning process as a continuous %bi-level joint optimization problem. We derive a novel objective function $J(α, θ)$ that allows for the simultaneous optimization of dual Lagrange multipliers and kernel hyper-parameters. To solve this challenging non-convex problem efficiently, we introduce a hybrid Block Coordinate Ascent (BCA) algorithm, tightly integrated with Nyström-based low-rank approximation, which drastically reduces computational complexity to $\mathcal{O}(Nm)$. Extensive experiments conducted across four heterogeneous domains (Bioinformatics, Finance, Cybersecurity, and Computer Vision) demonstrate that our approach not only matches but often exceeds exhaustive GridSearch accuracy, while delivering training speedups of up to 100x. Notably, on the complex NSL-KDD intrusion detection dataset, our adaptive kernel approach achieves 96.25\% accuracy compared to a mere 50\% for standard baselines, proving its unique ability to model complex non-linear manifolds in high-dimensional spaces. We validate our results using rigorous statistical tests and provide a theoretical convergence analysis of the proposed algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 'Revisited SVM'，一种统一框架，将核选择与决策边界优化重构为连续的双层联合优化问题，通过混合块坐标上升算法配合 Nyström 低秩近似，将训练复杂度从 O(N³) 降至 O(Nm)，在四大领域实验中达到甚至超越网格搜索精度，且加速高达 100 倍；在 NSL-KDD 入侵检测数据集上准确率达 96.25%，远超基线 50%。
AI.motivation: 经典 SVM 在大数据时代面临两大瓶颈：训练复杂度 O(N³) 过高，且静态核函数缺乏适应性；传统核选择采用离散网格搜索，将特征表示学习与决策边界优化割裂，无法实现端到端联合优化。
AI.method: 1. 提出连续双层联合优化目标函数 J(α, θ)，同时优化对偶拉格朗日乘子 α 和核超参数 θ。2. 设计混合块坐标上升 (BCA) 算法求解该非凸问题。3. 引入 Nyström 低秩近似加速核矩阵计算，将复杂度降至 O(Nm)。4. 提供算法收敛性理论分析。
AI.result: 在生物信息学、金融、网络安全、计算机视觉四个异构领域实验表明：精度匹配或超越穷举网格搜索，训练速度提升高达 100 倍。NSL-KDD 数据集上自适应核方法达 96.25% 准确率，基线仅 50%，展现对高维复杂非线性流形的建模能力。通过严格统计检验验证显著性。
AI.conclusion: Revisited SVM 通过将核超参数学习纳入统一优化框架，解决了 SVM 大规模场景下的计算与建模双重瓶颈，实现了高精度、高效率、强适应性的分类器，为核方法在大数据时代的应用提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
summary: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出HopToM基准来评估大语言模型的高阶心智理论(ToM)推理能力，揭示现有基准存在阶数虚高问题；并提出HopTrace推理方法，通过编码交互为视角记录，显著提升4-5阶推理准确率且大幅减少token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM评估常将信念嵌套深度等同于推理阶数，导致名义上的高阶问题可通过低阶捷径解决，存在普遍的阶数虚高(order inflation)现象，需要更严格的评估框架和有效的推理方法。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义有效阶数，通过支持连续信念前缀的独立事件来认证问题阶数；2. 构建HopToM基准，包含认证的全阶数问题和低阶替代控制；3. 提出HopTrace即插即用推理方法，将每次交互编码为视角记录，确定性解决嵌套查询。
AI.result: 四个前沿LLM在直接提示下准确率从一阶73.5%骤降至四阶20.0%，人类也表现困难；因果干预揭示错误源于较浅信念前缀证据；HopTrace在认证叙事问题上将四阶和五阶准确率分别提升22.0和38.5个百分点，token消耗仅为多调用方法的1/20-1/39。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了高阶ToM评估的严格标准，揭示当前模型在深层视角推理上的根本局限，HopTrace为交互式智能体提供了实用且高效的视角推理增强方案。

title: ScreenASR-Bench: A Tiered Benchmark for Speech Recognition with Visual Context
summary: Current ASR models perform well on general benchmarks but still struggle with acoustically ambiguous words. Visual context can aid recognition in screen-based scenarios, yet existing benchmarks provide limited insight into the benefits of different types of visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ScreenASR-Bench , a tiered benchmark with three progressively challenging levels: Explicit Textual Evidence (ETE), based on direct on-screen text; Explicit Visual Evidence (EVE), using visible content rather than on-screen text; and Implicit Semantic Evidence (ISE), requiring scene-level inference. Extensive experiments on ASR models, Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) and Omni models show that incorporating visual context substantially improves recall over the audio-only setting across all three model families. The gains are largest for ETE and smallest for ISE, indicating that models leverage direct visual evidence more effectively than indirect semantic cues. To facilitate future research on visually grounded speech recognition, we publicly release ScreenASR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScreenASR-Bench，一个分层基准，用于评估视觉上下文对语音识别的帮助，包含三个难度递增的层级：显式文本证据（ETE）、显式视觉证据（EVE）、隐式语义证据（ISE）。实验表明视觉上下文能显著提升 ASR、LALM 和 Omni 模型的召回率，其中直接视觉证据（ETE）增益最大，间接语义线索（ISE）增益最小。
AI.motivation: 现有 ASR 模型在通用基准上表现良好，但在声学歧义词上仍吃力。视觉上下文可辅助屏幕场景下的识别，但现有基准缺乏对不同类型视觉证据效用的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenASR-Bench，包含三个层级：ETE（直接屏幕文本）、EVE（可见非文本视觉内容）、ISE（需场景级推理的语义线索）。在 ASR、大型音频-语言模型（LALM）和全模态模型上进行大量实验，对比仅音频与音频+视觉设置。
AI.result: 所有三类模型引入视觉上下文后召回率均显著提升。增益随证据直接性递减：ETE 最大，EVE 次之，ISE 最小，表明模型更擅长利用直接视觉证据而非间接语义线索。
AI.conclusion: 视觉上下文对语音识别有显著帮助，但模型对不同类型视觉证据的利用能力存在差距。ScreenASR-Bench 为视觉接地语音识别研究提供了系统评估平台，已公开发布。

title: CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff
summary: KV caches make long-context serving efficient by reusing past computation, but model switching breaks this reuse and forces the receiver to prefill the context again. We study \emph{zero-prefill cross-model context handoff}: translating a sender cache into a receiver-compatible state so that the receiver can continue directly without prefilling same context. Existing affine transport methods show that receiver KV states can be substantially reconstructed from sender caches. However, through extensive analyses, we find that reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility. Similar K/V reconstruction errors can lead to substantially different attention patterns, predictive distributions, and downstream accuracy, because conventional reconstruction objectives overlook the query-dependent functional importance of K and V in receiver attention. We thus introduce CACHELINK, which learns a coupled K/V correction through the receiver behavior directly. Across four independently trained sender--receiver pairs and seven evaluation panels, CACHELINK improves the equal-weight mean over all methods for every pair. In matched diagnostics, CACHELINK changes K/V squared error by less than 0.4% while substantially changing receiver attention and next-token behavior. At 32K context, it reduces handoff latency by up to $7.27\times$ relative to receiver re-prefill. Our findings verify that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient and that preserving the receiver computation induced by the transported cache is important for effective cross-model KV transport.

AI.tldr: 本文研究零预填充跨模型上下文切换，提出 CACHELINK 方法，通过直接学习耦合的 K/V 修正来保持接收模型的注意力行为，而非仅追求重建保真度。实验表明该方法在四对独立训练的发送-接收模型上均显著优于现有方法，32K 上下文下切换延迟降低高达 7.27 倍，验证了保持接收模型计算行为比重建精度更关键。
AI.motivation: KV 缓存通过复用历史计算实现长上下文高效服务，但模型切换会破坏这种复用，迫使接收模型重新预填充上下文。现有的仿射传输方法虽能从发送缓存重建接收模型的 KV 状态，但重建保真度与接收模型实际效用关联较弱——相似的 K/V 重建误差可能导致截然不同的注意力模式、预测分布和下游准确率，因为传统重建目标忽略了 K 和 V 在接收模型注意力中的查询依赖性功能重要性。
AI.method: 提出 CACHELINK 方法，直接通过接收模型的行为学习耦合的 K/V 修正。不同于以重建误差为目标的仿射传输，CACHELINK 优化目标为保持接收模型注意力计算的功能等价性，使传输后的缓存能直接被接收模型用于后续推理而无需预填充。
AI.result: 在四对独立训练的发送-接收模型和七个评估面板上，CACHELINK 在所有方法的等权平均指标上均取得最优。匹配诊断显示，CACHELINK 仅改变 K/V 平方误差 0.4% 以内，却显著改变接收模型的注意力模式和下一词预测行为。在 32K 上下文长度下，相较于接收模型重新预填充，切换延迟降低高达 7.27 倍。
AI.conclusion: 重建保真度本身不足以衡量跨模型 KV 传输的有效性，保持传输缓存所诱导的接收模型计算行为才是关键。CACHELINK 通过直接优化接收模型的功能行为，实现了高效的零预填充上下文切换。

title: GENDIS: Gender-Related Discourse and Stance in Multilingual YouTube Comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria
comment: 23 pages. Accepted at the Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Research on gender-related online content is often operationalized through harm-centered tasks that collapse non-harmful gender-related and unrelated content, while existing datasets remain concentrated in high-resource languages and Global North settings. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GENDIS, a dataset of 9,600 multilingual, human-annotated YouTube comments from India, Kenya, and Nigeria (3,200 per country), annotated using a two-level framework that first identifies whether gender is referenced and then classifies gender-related content as negative, positive, or neutral. This separation provides a denominator for gender-related discourse independent of harm, enabling both prevalence estimation and characterization of its evaluative range. In the uniform random stratum, 23.8-35.0% of comments are gender-related, and among those with a resolved stance, 82% are neutral or positive. Across models, gender-reference detection is substantially easier than stance classification, especially for positive and neutral speech. Lightly supervised classifiers match frontier zero-shot large language models at substantially lower cost and outperform generic toxicity detection, while cross-country transfer remains limited. GENDIS provides a locally grounded resource for measuring when gender is invoked online and how that reference is framed.

AI.tldr: 本文引入GENDIS数据集，包含来自印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚的9600条多语言YouTube评论，采用两级标注框架分离性别引用检测与立场分类，发现性别相关评论占比23.8%-35.0%，其中82%为中性或正面，轻量监督模型性能媲美大模型零样本且成本更低，跨国家迁移能力有限。
AI.motivation: 现有性别相关在线内容研究多聚焦有害内容，将非有害性别相关内容与无关内容混淆，且数据集集中于高资源语言和全球北方国家，缺乏多语言、全球南方视角的细粒度性别话语分析资源。
AI.method: 构建GENDIS数据集：从印度、肯尼亚、尼日利亚各抽取3200条YouTube评论，采用两级人工标注框架——第一级判断是否涉及性别引用，第二级将性别相关内容分类为负面、正面、中性。对比轻量监督分类器、零样本大语言模型及通用毒性检测模型的性能，并评估跨国家迁移能力。
AI.result: 均匀随机抽样中23.8%-35.0%评论涉及性别；有明确立场的性别相关评论中82%为中性或正面。性别引用检测显著易于立场分类，尤其对正面/中性言论。轻量监督分类器性能匹敌前沿零样本大模型且成本大幅降低，优于通用毒性检测；跨国家迁移效果有限。
AI.conclusion: GENDIS提供了一个本地化落地的多语言资源，能够分离性别引用的普遍性与其评价框架，为测量在线性别话语的出现频率及表达方式奠定基础，推动超越伤害中心范式的性别话语研究。

title: Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/imaboybut/TGQ-MambaSR
summary: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Token-Group Quantization (TGQ)框架解决Mamba超分辨率模型低比特后训练量化(PTQ)难题，通过轻量预测器静态分组token并采用组级裁剪边界表，配合频域保真损失(FPR)保留高频细节，在多种设置下超越现有基线并在边缘设备上实现2.23倍加速。
AI.motivation: Mamba的选择性扫描算子导致不同空间token的激活范围差异大，单一层级裁剪范围无法匹配所有token，使得低比特PTQ极具挑战性。现有方法需运行时动态统计或后扫描分组，不利于硬件部署。
AI.method: 1. Token-Group Quantization: 离线校准阶段聚类后扫描激活描述符生成伪标签，训练轻量预测器从前扫描特征推断token组别；推理时冻结预测器映射预扫描特征到组，查表获取组级裁剪边界，无需运行时统计。2. Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR): 引入傅里叶幅度和相位对齐损失，使量化学生模型输出在频域逼近全精度教师模型，保留高频结构。
AI.result: 跨PTQ协议、比特宽度、骨干网络和任务均超越Mamba和SR PTQ基线；迁移至Transformer SR和Vision Mamba分类；可与旋转量化组合；在Jetson Orin Nano上比FP16快2.23倍。
AI.conclusion: TGQ提供了一个硬件友好的静态低比特量化方案，通过预测器实现无运行时开销的token分组裁剪，结合频域损失有效缓解低比特量化的性能下降，为Mamba类模型的高效部署提供了通用范式。

title: SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning
summary: Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. A \emph{Bias Shift Compensation} step corrects systematic activation drift in post-LayerNorm architectures that would otherwise cause perplexity collapse at high sparsity. Experiments across six models from two architecture families (gated and non-gated FFN) at 15--40\% sparsity show that SARATHI achieves competitive perplexity and matches or exceeds existing structured pruning baselines on zero-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SARATHI 框架，通过解耦神经元选择与权重重构、采用无数据的 NMF 残差子空间探测器、自适应 OBS 重构以及偏移补偿机制，实现了高稀疏度下结构化剪枝的内存高效且性能优越的大语言模型压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝后训练方法将神经元选择与权重重构耦合并依赖共享校准数据集，导致域偏差并在高稀疏度下出现内存溢出(OOM)失败。
AI.method: SARATHI 包含三大核心组件：(1) 无数据的 NMF 残差子空间探测器，利用内在权重几何打分神经元，无需校准数据，与 Robust PCA 有理论联系；(2) 自适应 OBS，采用局部校准批次重构剪枝权重，峰值显存 O(d²) 每层，消除全局内存瓶颈；(3) 偏移补偿，修正后 LayerNorm 架构中的系统性激活漂移，防止高稀疏度下的 perplexity 崩溃。
AI.result: 在两大架构族（门控与非门控 FFN）的六个模型上，稀疏度 15%–40% 范围内实验表明，SARATHI 实现了具有竞争力的 perplexity，且在零样本准确率上匹配或超越现有结构化剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: SARATHI 通过解耦选择与重构、无数据神经元评分、内存高效的自适应 OBS 及偏移补偿，有效解决了高稀疏度结构化剪枝的域偏差、内存瓶颈与激活漂移问题，为大语言模型压缩提供了可扩展且高性能的解决方案。

title: Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
summary: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.

AI.tldr: Diffuplex 是一种基于离散扩散的全双工口语语言模型，通过将“何时说话”与“说什么”在训练层面解耦，实现了语言智能与响应效率的前所未有的平衡。思考模式下每前向传递 13.0 token、1872 token/s，显著超越自回归模型；无思考模式下首音频延迟持平现有全双工模型且语言智能更强。推理时用自回归交互策略跟踪用户语音，并行扩散生成并精炼回复内容，使语义计算不再受感知音频帧率限制，确立了可持续实时对话并并行计算智能回复的新范式。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工口语模型将感知、决策、生成压缩在单一自回归时间线上，导致语义计算受限于音频帧率，智能与响应速度难以兼得。论文旨在打破这一瓶颈，实现智能与实时性的同时提升。
AI.method: 训练层面分离‘何时说话’（交互策略）与‘说什么’（内容生成），采用离散扩散建模内容生成；推理时，自回归交互策略持续跟踪用户语音决定发言时机，并行扩散过程独立生成并迭代精炼回复内容，语义计算与音频感知解耦。
AI.result: 思考模式下每前向传递 13.0 token，平均 1872 token/s，解码速度大幅超越前沿自回归模型；无思考模式下首音频延迟与现有全双工模型持平，但语言智能显著更强。验证了智能与响应效率可同步提升。
AI.conclusion: Diffuplex 确立了全双口语代理新范式：通过解耦交互时机与内容生成，利用并行扩散实现语义计算不再受音频帧率束缚，从而在维持实时对话的同时投入并行算力进行智能回复生成。训练代码与检查点即将发布。

title: agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents
comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, registrations, and logs: https://github.com/yzhao062/agent-risk
summary: Before changing a deployed AI agent (a stricter safety gate, a new model), organizations must approve the change, starting from existing logs. Extending classical risk analysis to partial records and partial changes to running systems, agent-risk replays logged episodes, assuming nothing else changes and the agent does not anticipate the change. The log settles episodes acting as before, a declared stop value settles stopped ones, and the rest need logged support, a saved-state rerun, or a bound. We prove what logs must record for exact replay and which saved states serve a gate family. For independent episodes, we bound the reruns a decision needs and tolerable drift from live behavior. In a bash sandbox, a 7,200-episode log alone decided neither of two retry gates, which let the agent act after refusals the log never shows. Rerunning only each gate's blocked episodes from saved states reached both live decisions at half the agent calls of a live test sized post hoc for them, given the log. Without per-step harm, a stopping gate's certified harm ceiling rose up to 2.5-fold, since the log hides whether harm preceded the stop. Approval thus needs evidence designed in advance: log fields, saved states, targeted reruns.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于日志重放和状态重跑的代理风险分析框架，用于在部署前评估AI代理变更（如更严格的安全门控、新模型）的风险。通过形式化证明日志记录要求、保存状态选择及重跑边界，该方法在bash沙箱实验中以一半的代理调用量达成实时决策，并揭示了日志缺失导致的风险认证上限膨胀问题。
AI.motivation: 组织在变更已部署的AI代理（如收紧安全门控、替换模型）前必须基于现有日志进行风险审批。传统风险分析难以处理部分记录和部分系统变更，且代理不预期变更的假设下，日志仅能部分还原行为，需要系统化方法量化变更风险并最小化验证成本。
AI.method: 扩展经典风险分析至部分记录场景：1) 形式化定义精确重放所需的日志字段及服务于门控族的保存状态；2) 对独立回合，给出决策所需重跑次数上限及可容忍的实时行为漂移界；3) 实验中使用bash沙箱，对比7,200回合日志单独决策、保存状态重跑阻塞回合、以及事后实时测试三种方式。
AI.result: 日志单独无法判定两个重试门控（允许拒绝后重试）的决策；仅重跑各门控阻塞回合即以实时测试一半的代理调用量达成相同决策；无逐步危害记录时，停止门控的认证危害上限上升2.5倍，因日志隐藏危害是否发生在停止前。
AI.conclusion: 变更审批需要预先设计的证据体系：完整的日志字段、关键保存状态、针对性重跑策略。论文证明了风险认证的理论边界，并实证展示了有针对性的重跑比全量实测更高效，但也揭示了日志盲区导致的风险高估问题。

title: OceanFlow: Coherent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Ocean Modeling
summary: Probabilistic ocean modeling is essential for risk-aware marine operations, climate analysis, and scientific decision-making, where downstream decisions depend on the conditional distribution of future ocean states rather than a single deterministic trajectory. Recent data-driven ocean models have made deterministic global ocean modeling increasingly accurate and efficient, but probabilistic ocean modeling remains underdeveloped. Specifically, perturbation-driven ensembles can create spread without explicitly optimizing the joint distribution of their members, often yielding poor calibration and physical inconsistency. To address these issues, we propose OceanFlow, a coherent flow matching framework for probabilistic global ocean modeling. OceanFlow first establishes a sharp, stable mean anchor for the conditional ensemble. Flow matching then learns a coherent state-conditioned pathwise law that jointly reshapes the residual distribution around this anchor at each transition, preserving the predictive center while refining state-dependent uncertainty. We further introduce a Factorized Dynamics Operator (FDO), which combines factorized transitions with a learned state-conditioned response to parameterize the mean anchor and residual-flow velocity. Extensive experiments show that OceanFlow improves ensemble-mean accuracy, probabilistic reliability, and physical-consistency diagnostics over competitive baselines, supporting coherent flow matching as an effective route toward data-driven probabilistic ocean modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/OceanFlow.

AI.tldr: OceanFlow提出了一种连贯流匹配框架用于概率性全球海洋建模，通过建立稳定的均值锚点并利用流匹配学习状态条件下的路径定律，联合重塑残差分布，同时保持预测中心并细化状态相关不确定性，引入因子化动力学算子（FDO）参数化均值锚点和残差流速度，显著提升了集合均值精度、概率可靠性和物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 确定性海洋模型已变得越来越准确高效，但概率性海洋建模仍欠发达。现有基于扰动的集合方法虽能产生分散度，但未显式优化成员联合分布，导致校准差和物理不一致，无法满足风险感知海洋作业、气候分析和科学决策对未来海洋状态条件分布的需求。
AI.method: 提出OceanFlow连贯流匹配框架：首先建立锐利稳定的均值锚点作为条件集合的预测中心；然后利用流匹配学习状态条件下的连贯路径定律，在每次转移中联合重塑锚点周围的残差分布，保持预测中心的同时细化状态相关不确定性；引入因子化动力学算子（FDO），结合因子化转移与学习的状态条件响应，参数化均值锚点和残差流速度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OceanFlow在集合均值精度、概率可靠性和物理一致性诊断指标上均优于竞争基线，验证了连贯流匹配作为数据驱动概率性海洋建模的有效路径。
AI.conclusion: 连贯流匹配框架OceanFlow通过显式建模联合分布动力学，解决了现有集合方法校准差和物理不一致的问题，为数据驱动的概率性全球海洋建模提供了有效解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Where Words Begin and End
summary: Forced aligners locate each word of a known transcript in the audio, and many speech pipelines depend on them. In our own data, a widely used CTC aligner inserts a pause at nearly every word boundary, and we found almost no aligner evaluated on telephone audio. We compare nine aligner configurations against human word boundaries on read, conversational and telephone English. The Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) is the most precise, while CTC aligners consistently start words late, because most frames inside a word go to the blank token. We then fine-tune Whisper with LoRA to predict each word's start and end as timestamp tokens, training only on boundaries placed by people: 47 hours in 87 languages. The resulting aligner is more precise than MFA on every English test condition, and than MFA's own Korean and Dutch models. With FA-Bench's protocol and code on TIMIT, its word-boundary error is 11.6 ms, against 18.2 ms for the best published system. Two choices matter most on telephone conversations: placing the timestamp slots after the word they time, and training on noisy transcripts, which also makes the aligner nearly insensitive to errors in the transcript. The released model reaches 16.0 ms on real landline calls, against 36.5 ms for MFA. The models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/force-alignment

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Whisper+LoRA微调的强制对齐模型，在多种英语语料（朗读、对话、电话）及韩语、荷兰语上均超越Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA)，在TIMIT上达到11.6ms词边界误差（SOTA），真实固定电话通话上16.0ms对比MFA的36.5ms。关键创新：时间戳槽位置放在词后、使用含噪转录训练使模型对转录错误具鲁棒性。模型已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有CTC对齐器在几乎每个词边界插入停顿，且缺乏在电话音频上的评测。MFA虽精确但仍有提升空间。需要一种更精确、鲁棒、多语言的强制对齐方法，尤其适用于嘈杂、会话式、电话语音场景。
AI.method: 将Whisper用LoRA微调，使其预测每个词的起止时间戳token。仅使用人工标注的词边界训练：47小时、87种语言。关键设计：1) 时间戳槽置于对应词之后；2) 使用含噪转录训练，增强对转录错误的鲁棒性。对比了9种对齐器配置。
AI.result: 提出的对齐器在所有英语测试条件（朗读、对话、电话）上均优于MFA，亦优于MFA自带的韩语、荷兰语模型。FA-Bench TIMIT协议下词边界误差11.6ms，优于已发表最佳系统18.2ms。真实固定电话通话上16.0ms，MFA为36.5ms。模型对转录错误近乎不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 基于Whisper+LoRA的时间戳预测范式显著提升强制对齐精度与鲁棒性，尤其在电话、会话等挑战性场景。时间戳槽位置与含噪训练是关键。开源模型为多语言语音处理管线提供了更可靠的对齐基石。

title: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
summary: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REVEAL框架，通过逆向工程前沿模型的Agentic Latents（锚定状态与动态反馈-响应轮廓），在无需训练、冻结目标模型的前提下，利用成功/失败轨迹的对比提取目标专用的引导方向，应用于每次响应前，显著提升三个基准上的任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM智能体虽能完成复杂交互任务，但推理成本高昂；现有蒸馏与潜在通信方法通常需要目标模型训练或访问源模型内部，限制了可复用性。研究旨在探索如何仅用文本轨迹为冻结的小型开源智能体提供可复用的局部控制。
AI.method: 受协议逆向工程启发，定义Agentic Latents（锚定状态与动态反馈-响应周期轮廓）。REVEAL框架三步走：1) 重放源模型轨迹于目标模型以采集轮廓；2) 基于任务结果匹配并筛选同任务、同源模型的成功/失败回滚中的局部事件；3) 计算响应-转移对比得到目标专用引导向量，在每次生成前注入作为局部激活控制。全程无需训练、不访问源模型内部。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1与Humanity's Last Exam（带工具）两个基准上，对三个目标模型均显著优于未修改基线；表征分析与行为案例研究进一步证实前沿模型经验可作为局部激活控制被有效复用。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭文本轨迹即可逆向出可迁移的Agentic Latents，通过对比成功与失败的局部动态差异生成即插即用的引导向量，为冻结小模型提供低成本、高泛化的能力提升路径，验证了“经验即局部控制”的可行性。

title: Sensitivity Fidelity Reveals Physical Dependencies Beyond Forecast Accuracy in Deep-Learning Earth-System Models
summary: Deep-learning models increasingly rival numerical simulation in Earth-system forecasting, yet forecast error alone cannot determine whether their learned input-output dependencies are physically consistent. Here we introduce sensitivity fidelity as an additional criterion: alongside prediction error, model responses to input perturbations should be examined against a trusted reference or established physical knowledge. In an idealized Rayleigh-Bénard convection benchmark, four surrogate architectures achieved low forecast errors yet encoded markedly different sensitivities. Quantitative comparison with a matched adjoint distinguished the models far more sharply than forecast accuracy and showed that predictive skill and sensitivity fidelity need not coincide, while finite-perturbation experiments further linked these differences to the propagation of initial-condition uncertainty. We then applied this strategy to El Niño-Southern Oscillation prediction, where no adjoint reference exists and learned sensitivities showed event-wise robustness, validity under finite perturbations, and consistency with established precursors. These results identify gradient-based evaluation as a discriminating complement to forecast-error metrics, providing a practical test of whether data-driven Earth-system models learn physically credible dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“敏感度保真度”作为评估数据驱动地球系统模型的新标准，指出仅依靠预测误差无法判断模型学到的输入输出依赖是否物理合理。通过理想化雷利-贝纳对流基准和厄尔尼诺-南方振荡（ENSO）预测两个案例，展示梯度基评估能比预测精度更敏锐地区分模型，且预测技巧与敏感度保真度不一定一致。研究为检验数据驱动模型是否学习到物理可信依赖提供了实用测试。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在气象预报中表现日益接近数值模拟，但仅用预测误差无法确定其学到的输入输出关系是否符合物理规律。需要一种额外的评价标准，检验模型对输入扰动的响应是否与可信参考或已知物理知识一致。
AI.method: 1. 引入敏感度保真度概念，要求模型对输入扰动的响应与可信伴随模型或已建立的物理先验一致。2. 在理想化雷利-贝纳对流基准上，对比四种代理模型架构的预测误差与伴随模型计算的梯度敏感度。3. 进行有限扰动实验，关联敏感度差异与初始条件不确定性传播。4. 将该策略应用于无伴随参考的ENSO预测，检验学习到的敏感度在事件层面的鲁棒性、有限扰动下的有效性及与已知前兆的一致性。
AI.result: 在雷利-贝纳对流基准中，四种模型预测误差均低，但敏感度差异显著；伴随模型对比比预测精度更能区分模型，揭示预测技巧与敏感度保真度不重合。有限扰动实验进一步将敏感度差异关联到初始不确定性传播。在ENSO预测中，学习到的敏感度表现出事件级鲁棒性、有限扰动下的有效性，并与已建立的ENSO前兆一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于梯度的敏感度评估是预测误差指标的有力补充，能实际检验数据驱动地球系统模型是否学习到物理可信的输入输出依赖。该方法为模型选择和物理一致性验证提供了新工具。

title: BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}---where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0\% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8\% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Method的可验证运行时控制框架，解决多智能体协作中的‘交接故障’问题，通过故障归因管道Dataset和来源图动态修复交接，显著提升任务成功率且开销极低。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作虽是处理复杂长程任务的关键范式，但智能体间协作接口的系统性故障（即‘交接故障’）仍是普遍瓶颈：关键任务上下文被遗漏、错路由或忽略，尽管各智能体局部响应合理。现有协调协议难以在运行时检测并修复此类跨智能体依赖断裂。
AI.method: 提出Method框架，核心包含：1）Dataset故障归因与校准管道，解耦执行依赖并注入反事实交接扰动以提供经验监督；2）运行时将可观测交互追踪编译为来源图，无需访问私有状态即可定位未解决依赖；3）经验门控评估候选修复，权衡预期收益与干扰风险；4）仅当形式化局部后置条件成立时执行修复。
AI.result: 在SILO-BENCH上任务成功率提升12.3个百分点，TeamBench上提升11.1个百分点；两种骨干模型下边际Token开销仅2.0%；在MAST基准562条交接相关追踪上单次通过F1达69.8%，确立了可验证协调修复的可靠操作边界。
AI.conclusion: Method通过显式依赖图上的选择性干预，实现了可验证的运行时交接修复，在保持极低计算开销的前提下显著提升多智能体系统的协作鲁棒性，为解决跨智能体协作故障提供了实用且理论可靠的方案。

title: Memory-Efficient Integer-Only Training of Deep Neural Networks
summary: Training neural networks in reduced precision can yield significant efficiency gains, yet all existing methods that scale to standard computer vision benchmarks retain floating-point in at least one stage, typically the weight update or optimizer state. We present a training algorithm that scales to modern deep neural networks, in which every tensor (weights, gradients, and activations) is stored as INT8, and every operation (forward pass, backward pass, weight update, optimizer update) is performed in integer arithmetic. Specifically, tensors are stored as signed integer mantissas paired with explicit power-of-two exponents, on which integer-only operations are performed using five custom composable building blocks (products, sums, divide-by-constant, nonlinear functions, and weight updates). This allows complete implementation of trainable integer layers, including convolutions, batch and layer normalization, softmax, and GELU. A per-group velocity mechanism with independent exponent tracking preserves gradient precision across neurons and channels with diverse magnitudes. As every tensor fits in INT8, training memory is roughly 4x smaller than the FP32 baseline. We validate our training algorithm on CNNs (ResNet-18/34/50/101, MobileNetV2) and Vision Transformers (ViT-Ti / B), demonstrating for the first time that training neural networks with INT8 tensors and integer arithmetic can achieve competitive accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet at a reduced memory budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种完全基于INT8整数运算的神经网络训练算法，实现了权重、梯度、激活值全张量INT8存储，前向、反向、权重更新、优化器更新全流程整数运算，在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet上首次达到与FP32相当的精度，显存占用降低约4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有低精度训练方法在标准计算机视觉基准上至少保留一个阶段（通常是权重更新或优化器状态）使用浮点数，无法完全消除浮点运算，限制了内存和计算效率的进一步提升。
AI.method: 采用带符号整数尾数与显式2的幂指数表示张量，设计五个可组合的整数运算构建模块：乘积、求和、除常数、非线性函数、权重更新。实现整数化的可训练层（卷积、BN/LN、Softmax、GELU）。引入分组速度机制与独立指数跟踪，保持不同量级神经元/通道的梯度精度。
AI.result: 在ResNet-18/34/50/101、MobileNetV2、ViT-Ti/B等模型上验证，CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet训练精度与FP32基线相当，训练显存约为FP32的1/4。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明纯INT8张量与整数算术可在大规模视觉任务上实现有竞争力的训练精度，为极低内存预算下的高效训练提供了可行路径。

title: UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags
summary: We introduce UNISON, a unified framework that bridges multiple instance learning and recommendation systems by treating both as instances of learning from scored bag collections of (item, score) pairs. Unlike traditional approaches that address bag-level classification and personalized recommendation as separate problems, UNISON decomposes learning into three interconnected stages: (1) learning universal item representations, (2) modeling bag-specific preference patterns through lightweight personalized parameters, and (3) inferring bag-level characteristics from learned preferences. We justify the architectural choice of linear bag-specific scoring through a first-order analysis: when item embeddings are sufficiently smooth in the score, a linear function approximates the score up to a Taylor remainder controlled by the curvature of the underlying preference function. For cold-start scenarios, we show that the cold-bag fitting problem reduces to ridge-less linear regression with a closed-form solution, and provide convergence guarantees for the iterative variant. Empirically, UNISON matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse domains: entertainment (books, movies), immunology (T cell receptor (TCR) based classification), and microbiome, offering superior computational efficiency and interpretability. A controlled synthetic experiment further confirms that the bag-specific parameters ($w_j, b_j$) recover the latent factors that drive item scores even when the projection $φ$ has no access to the original scoring mechanism (AUC > 0.998). UNISON is available at https://github.com/louzounlab/UNISON.

AI.tldr: UNISON 是一个统一框架，将多实例学习与推荐系统桥接，把两者视为从带分数的包集合中学习，通过三阶段分解实现通用物品表示、个性化包偏好建模与包级特征推断，提供冷启动闭式解和理论保证，在娱乐、免疫学、微生物组等领域达到或超越 SOTA，且具高计算效率与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将包级分类与个性化推荐视为独立问题，缺乏统一建模；需要一个能同时处理多实例学习和推荐的通用框架，并解决冷启动、可解释性及计算效率挑战。
AI.method: UNISON 将学习分解为三个相互关联的阶段：(1) 学习通用物品嵌入表示；(2) 通过轻量级个性化参数建模包特定的偏好模式，采用线性打分函数，并用一阶泰勒分析证明其合理性；(3) 从学习到的偏好推断包级特征。冷启动场景下，包拟合问题简化为无岭线性回归，给出闭式解与迭代算法收敛保证。
AI.result: 在图书、电影推荐、TCR 分类、微生物组等多领域实验中，UNISON 匹配或优于现有最佳方法，计算效率更高且可解释性更强。合成实验显示包特定参数能以 AUC > 0.998 恢复潜在评分因子，即使投影 φ 无法访问原始评分机制。
AI.conclusion: UNISON 提供了一个理论扎实、实用高效的统一范式，将多实例学习与推荐系统融合，线性包特定打分由平滑性假设保证，冷启动有闭式解，跨域实验验证其优越性能与可解释性，代码已开源。

title: Perturbation, Not Provenance: Why Activation Steering Does Not Make a Robust Text Watermark
summary: Linear directions in the activation space of large language models causally and universally influence model behavior. This suggests that they might serve as a basis for a robust text watermark. The idea is to steer the generation along a specific semantic direction and then recover the mark by probing the activations of the re-encoded text.
