We test this hypothesis by conducting a series of experiments. We vary the strength of the steering and use four different directions (formality, sentiment, complexity, and a random control) across two different model families. We also test two paraphrasing attacks: a sentence-level one and a stronger paragraph-level one. The results show that activation-steering watermarks are outperformed by a standard logit-based watermark (KGW) in terms of detection accuracy. At a matched level of fluency (within 1.15 times the original text's perplexity), KGW achieved an AUC of 0.81 against a sentence-level paraphraser, while the best steering direction only reached 0.65. A stronger paragraph-level paraphraser lowered both (0.65 for KGW and 0.59 for steering), narrowing the gap but not reversing it. On Qwen, it left the two indistinguishable but at near-chance levels for both. We further showed that the detectability provided by steering was not semantic: a random direction was just as detectable as a meaningful one. The signal was independent of which layer was probed and whether a surface feature control was used. We conclude that, in this case, semantic activation does not encode a localized, recoverable semantic mark, but rather a global, content-independent shift that can only be strongly detected when the text is degraded.

AI.tldr: 该研究对比了基于激活向量引导的水印与基于logit的KGW水印，发现激活引导水印在检测准确率上全面落后于KGW水印；激活引导产生的只是全局性、与内容无关的分布偏移，而非局部化的可恢复语义标记，仅在文本退化时才能被强检测到。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型激活空间中的线性方向能因果性且普遍地影响模型行为，这提示它们可能作为鲁棒文本水印的基础。
AI.method: 在两个模型家族上实验：变化引导强度，使用四个方向（正式性、情感、复杂度、随机对照），针对句级和段级两种改写攻击，对比激活引导水印与标准KGW水印的检测性能（AUC），并控制流畅度（困惑度在原文1.15倍内）。
AI.result: 匹配流畅度下，KGW对句级改写AUC达0.81，最佳引导方向仅0.65；段级改写将两者降至0.65和0.59，差距缩小但未逆转；在Qwen上两者均接近随机猜测；随机方向与语义方向可检测性相当，信号与探测层、表层特征控制无关。
AI.conclusion: 语义激活并不编码局部化、可恢复的语义水印，而是产生一种全局性、与内容无关的分布偏移，仅当文本被降质时才能被强烈检测到。

title: FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention
summary: Self-attention assigns two functions to one mechanism-where to read and how to mix-at the price of O(L^2) training, an O(T) decode state, and position signals bound to the training length. Existing attention-free alternatives all optimize the single function of generation. We propose FON (Fusion-Organ Network), which differentiates one weight stack into a drafting organ (multi-tap learnable delays + content-adaptive recursion; causal, O(S) training, O(1) decode state, no sequence-level quadratic attention) and a revision organ that re-processes the written prefix through multi-scale ripple kernels injected via weak gates, never generating. At 30M parameters, iso-parameter and iso-token budget, FON reaches perplexity 131.03 on WikiText-103, beating Transformer (197.73) and Mamba2 (152.53); the advantage persists under all depth-aligned baselines and at the 70M tier (-20.8%). At 8x length extrapolation FON degrades by ~8-9% without positional-encoding engineering, between ALiBi and RoPE. The revision channel provides a structural pathway for in-domain infilling that causal architectures lack in principle (+19% over on-demand coupling), at a perplexity cost indistinguishable within measurement precision. We report all costs and boundaries: impaired long-range retrieval, synthetic-task disadvantages, weaker out-of-domain code infilling than a same-recipe Transformer, and a 6.5-12.3x wall-clock gap.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FON（融合器官网络），将自注意力解耦为起草器官（因果、线性训练、常数解码状态）和修订器官（多尺度涟漪核、弱门控注入、不生成），在30M参数下WikiText-103困惑度131.03，显著优于Transformer(197.73)和Mamba2(152.53)，具备更好的长度外推和域内填补能力，但存在长程检索受损、合成任务劣势、代码域外填补较弱及6.5-12.3倍壁钟时间差距等局限。
AI.motivation: 自注意力将“读取位置”和“混合方式”耦合在单一机制中，导致O(L^2)训练、O(T)解码状态、位置编码受限于训练长度；现有无注意力替代方案仅优化生成单一功能。需要一种能分离起草与修订、保持因果生成效率同时提供结构化修订通路的架构。
AI.method: FON将一组权重栈分化为两个器官：1)起草器官：多抽头可学习延迟+内容自适应递归，因果、O(S)训练、O(1)解码状态、无序列级二次注意力；2)修订器官：通过弱门控注入多尺度涟漪核重新处理已写前缀，不参与生成。两器官共享权重栈，形成融合架构。
AI.result: 30M参数下WikiText-103困惑度131.03，优于Transformer(197.73)和Mamba2(152.53)；优势在所有深度对齐基线及70M层级(-20.8%)持续存在；8倍长度外推退化仅8-9%，介于ALiBi和RoPE之间；修订通路提供域内填补结构路径，较按需耦合+19%，困惑度代价在测量精度内不可区分。
AI.conclusion: FON通过器官分化实现了高效因果生成与结构化修订的统一，在语言建模困惑度、长度外推、域内填补上均优于基线，但需承认长程检索受损、合成任务劣势、代码域外填补弱于同配方Transformer、以及显著壁钟时间开销等边界条件。

title: Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem
summary: Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. What remains useful is the coupling, which gives an unbiased paired estimator that cuts variance $1.2$-$3.8\times$ against prompt-level pairing. Read against benchmark sizes at the default pair's variance and our point estimate of its between-prompt component, resolving a one-point difference needs 8 to 32 samples per prompt on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond and about 210 on AIME 2025; at that component's upper confidence bound GPQA-Diamond needs more than 32 and AIME 2025 cannot be resolved at any sample count. Choosing a truncation sampler is a measurement problem at least as much as a design one. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/truncation-samplers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型解码中的截断采样器比较问题，提出基于嵌套结构的耦合方法和分离证书，证明精确比较极其困难，证书通常≥0.998难以单独裁决，但耦合提供的无偏配对估计器可将方差降低1.2-3.8倍，揭示选择截断采样器本质上是测量问题而非单纯设计问题。
AI.motivation: 现有截断采样器比较成本极高（6000 A100小时），且事先无法预知两采样器差距。观察到几乎所有部署的截断规则都保留概率排序词表的前缀，因此任意两规则在每步解码时都是嵌套的，这一结构性质可被利用。
AI.method: 利用嵌套性质推导闭式逐步距离，构建耦合使两采样器在首次分歧前输出相同文本。由此得到分离证书：能对任意有界结果的差异给出上界，可从现有日志计算，且在无超越情况下等于序列级总变分距离。同时基于耦合构建无偏配对估计器。
AI.result: 1) 精确性脆弱，认证微小差异要求每步保留质量高精度一致。2) 六模型四基准实验中，所有超参网格的证书≥0.998，单纯用界难以裁决，但同族成员可更接近。3) 耦合估计器较prompt级配对减少方差1.2-3.8倍。4) 样本量分析：GSM8K/MATH-500/GPQA-Diamond需8-32样本/提示解决1分差异，AIME 2025约210；置信上界下GPQA需>32，AIME无法在任何样本量下解决。
AI.conclusion: 选择截断采样器至少是一个测量问题，而不仅是设计问题。分离证书虽难单独裁决，但耦合提供的低方差配对估计器极具实用价值。代码已开源。

title: Prefilling-dLLM v2: Learned Chunk Routing for Long-Context Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models apply bidirectional attention over the whole context at every denoising step, so a longer context makes each step substantially more expensive. Sparsifying only at inference leaves the pretrained weights unchanged, so the model is never trained under the sparse pattern it runs with. We propose Prefilling-dLLM v2, which continues training a diffusion language model so that it routes with its native mask token. One mask is appended at the end of each chunk, and a learned role offset marks it as a routing slot. On every fourth layer, a query keeps a bidirectional local window and the top-K chunks scored from that mask; the other layers use a bidirectional sliding window. Starting from Dream-v0-Base-7B extended to 16K with YaRN, we compare Prefilling-dLLM v2 with bidirectional NSA, DSA, and SWA under the same layout, key budget, and dense initialization, using the same Fast-dLLM decoder. With the YaRN factor scaled to the evaluation length, Prefilling-dLLM v2 leads the other sparse methods on all three RULER tasks from 16K to 128K. Its mean accuracy at 128K is 7.4 points above NSA, the next sparse model, while DSA and SWA remain near zero. At the same length, decoding is 172x faster than with full dense attention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Prefilling-dLLM v2，通过在扩散语言模型中引入原生 mask token 作为路由槽，并采用分块稀疏注意力机制（每四层使用局部窗口+Top-K 块路由，其余层用滑动窗口），实现长上下文下的高效推理。在 16K-128K 上下文的 RULER 任务中，该方法显著优于 NSA、DSA、SWA 等稀疏基线，128K 时准确率领先 NSA 7.4 个百分点，解码速度比稠密注意力快 172 倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤对全上下文使用双向注意力，导致长上下文计算开销巨大。现有稀疏化方法多仅在推理阶段应用，模型从未在稀疏模式下训练，造成训练-推理不匹配。需要一种在训练阶段就适配稀疏注意力模式的方法，同时保持长上下文建模能力。
AI.method: 1. 从 Dream-v0-Base-7B 扩展至 16K 上下文（YaRN）；2. 每个文本块末尾追加一个 mask token，配合学习到的角色偏移标记为路由槽；3. 每第四层采用查询保持双向局部窗口并从该 mask 评分选取 Top-K 块，其余层使用双向滑动窗口；4. 继续预训练使模型适应该稀疏模式；5. 使用 Fast-dLLM 解码器，统一布局、键值预算和稠密初始化进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在相同设置下，Prefilling-dLLM v2 在 16K-128K 的三个 RULER 任务上全面超越双向 NSA、DSA、SWA。128K 时平均准确率比次优的 NSA 高 7.4 点，DSA 和 SWA 准确率接近零。解码速度比全稠密注意力快 172 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过原生 mask token 路由和分层稀疏注意力模式的继续预训练，Prefilling-dLLM v2 成功解决了扩散语言模型长上下文的训练-推理一致性问题，在极长上下文下同时实现了最优建模性能和推理加速，为高效长上下文扩散语言模型提供了新范式。

title: Narrative Paradoxes in LLM Inference: Shaping Reasoning Trajectories toward Misalignment
summary: Explicit reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is often associated with reliability, yet it can still pose risks when a model infers harmful goals under a benign context. We identify a distinct challenge: ensuring the safety of the \emph{multi-step reasoning process} itself, where locally coherent steps may still lead to globally harmful outcomes. To explore this vulnerability, we propose PDRA (Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack), a novel attack method that programs a harmful reasoning trajectory. PDRA first constructs a paradoxical narrative core by pairing a malicious actor (e.g., a terrorist) with a benign task (e.g., writing a safety bulletin). It then embeds this core into a structured analytical framework that forces the model through a mandatory three-stage analysis -- surface purpose, latent intent, and operational reconstruction -- guiding it to produce detailed harmful content while maintaining narrative coherence. Mechanistically, we show PDRA steers the model's internal representations away from refusal-related patterns, suppressing safety-triggering lexicons while activating planning-oriented terms. Empirically, PDRA achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates across diverse LLMs with high efficiency. \textcolor{red}{\textbf{Warning:} This paper may contain sensitive content.}

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PDRA（悖论驱动推理攻击），一种针对大语言模型多步推理过程安全性的新型攻击方法。通过构建悖论叙事核心（恶意行动者+良性任务）并嵌入结构化三阶段分析框架（表层目的、潜在意图、操作重构），引导模型在保持叙事连贯性的同时生成详细有害内容，实现跨多种 LLMs 的 SOTA 攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注单步拒绝或对齐，但忽视了多步推理过程本身的安全性风险：局部连贯的推理步骤可能导向全局有害结果。模型在良性语境下通过显式推理推断有害目标，绕过传统安全机制，构成独特威胁。
AI.method: PDRA 分两步：1) 构建悖论叙事核心，将恶意行动者（如恐怖分子）与良性任务（如撰写安全公告）配对；2) 嵌入强制性三阶段分析框架——表层目的分析、潜在意图推断、操作重构规划，引导模型逐步产出有害细节。机制上，PDRA 将模型内部表示从拒绝相关模式转向规划导向词汇，抑制安全触发词。
AI.result: 在多种主流 LLMs 上实验，PDRA 达到当前最优攻击成功率（ASR），且查询效率高。消融实验验证三阶段框架各组件必要性；表征分析显示内部激活从拒绝模式转向有害规划模式。
AI.conclusion: 多步推理过程是 LLM 安全的新攻击面。PDRA 揭示了显式推理可被武器化以绕过对齐，呼吁开发针对推理轨迹的防御机制，而非仅关注输入输出层面。

title: The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes
summary: Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. In our off-policy runs the practical effect is real but smaller than the choice of teacher-student pair. Renormalization is a normalization, not a safeguard. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/top-k-distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究蒸馏管道中常用的 top-k 截断与重归一化策略，证明重归一化仅消除了尾部概率的可见性，而非其自由度：目标函数仅依赖保留 token 的 log-odds，导致尾部质量方向的梯度为零。实验表明，在七个开源教师模型上，仅当保留集大小 k ≥ d+1（d 为隐藏维度）时才能精确恢复教师分布，常用缓存大小往往小于该阈值；缺乏交叉熵项时尾部质量会漂移，加上后差距缩小约四倍但仍存。离线实验显示实际影响虽存在，但小于教师-学生模型对选择的影响。结论：重归一化只是归一化手段，非安全保障。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏流程常通过保留教师分布的 top-k 概率并重归一化来近似全词表目标，隐含假设是重归一化能补偿被截断的尾部质量。作者旨在揭示该假设的理论缺陷，量化其对梯度与尾部质量恢复的影响，并评估在实际开源模型中的表现。
AI.method: 理论分析：推导重归一化目标的梯度形式，证明其仅依赖保留 token 的 log-odds，导致控制尾部质量方向的梯度分量为零。实验验证：在七个开源教师模型上，测量不同 k 下尾部质量恢复情况；对比含/不含交叉熵项时学生尾部质量漂移；进行离线策略实验评估实际下游影响。
AI.result: 1. 重归一化目标的梯度在尾部质量方向为零（实测约 2-3×10⁻¹⁵），全词表梯度等于截断梯度加尾部质量加权残差，但训练仅作用于前者。2. 无交叉熵项时 top-k 学生尾部质量远离教师，全词表控制组略微靠近；加入交叉熵后差距缩小约四倍但仍存。3. 七模型均显示：仅当 k ≥ d+1 时保留集能精确确定教师分布，常用缓存大小常低于该阈值。4. 离线实验中实际影响虽真实，但小于教师-学生模型对选择的影响。
AI.conclusion: 重归一化仅是归一化操作，不能保证尾部质量的正确恢复；top-k 蒸馏存在固有的尾部质量漂移问题，即使辅以交叉熵也无法完全消除。实践中应关注 k 与隐藏维度 d 的关系，并权衡教师-学生模型对选择带来的更大影响。

title: Cross-Lingual Transfer of Evil Vectors Is Directionally Asymmetric
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Persona vectors are linear directions in the residual-stream activations of LLMs that encode behavioral traits and enable fine-grained control over model behavior. Among them, the evil persona vector is particularly relevant to understanding harmful behavior, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and the unlearning of harmful knowledge. Yet whether this vector reflects a genuinely cross-lingual concept, rather than an artifact of its extraction language, remains untested. We conduct a systematic evil-vector transfer study across two high-resource languages (English, Spanish) and two low-resource languages (Swahili, Telugu) on four open-source instruction-tuned LLMs, and find that transfer is directionally asymmetric. Evil vectors are harder to obtain reliably from low-resource languages, and the resulting vectors are largely ineffective at steering, even within their own language. In contrast, vectors extracted from high-resource languages transfer effectively to low-resource inputs while largely preserving general knowledge, as measured by MMLU. Geometric analysis further supports this pattern: evil vectors from the two high-resource languages are closely aligned, whereas low-resource vectors align only weakly with this shared direction. These results suggest that a shared cross-lingual evil direction exists and, once reliably extracted from a high-resource language, can be reused to steer behavior in low-resource languages without additional per-language data collection.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大语言模型中“邪恶人格向量”的跨语言迁移性，发现高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）提取的向量能有效迁移到低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语），而低资源语言提取的向量不可靠且无效。几何分析显示高资源语言邪恶向量高度对齐，低资源语言向量仅弱对齐，表明存在共享的跨语言邪恶方向。
AI.motivation: 探究邪恶人格向量是否为真正跨语言的概念，而非提取语言的产物，以理解有害行为、越狱漏洞及有害知识遗忘的跨语言机制。
AI.method: 在四个开源指令微调LLM上，系统研究英语、西班牙语（高资源）与斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语（低资源）间的邪恶向量迁移，对比提取可靠性、转向效果、通用知识保持（MMLU）及向量几何对齐度。
AI.result: 高资源语言提取的邪恶向量能有效迁移至低资源语言输入并保持通用知识；低资源语言提取的向量难以可靠获得且转向无效。高资源语言邪恶向量几何高度对齐，低资源语言向量仅弱对齐共享方向。
AI.conclusion: 存在共享的跨语言邪恶方向，一旦从高资源语言可靠提取，即可复用于低资源语言行为转向，无需逐语言收集数据。

title: ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning
summary: Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. In addition, it uses stage-aligned verification to localize failures to planning, perception, or reasoning. Dependency-based recovery recomputes only affected states while reusing unaffected ones. Extensive experiments show that ReTAC achieves the highest overall score among the compared methods across three mainstream MLLMs and two widely adopted benchmarks. Further analyses show that gains from additional computation depend not only on how much is used, but also on where it is allocated and which valid intermediate states are preserved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReTAC，一种无需训练的多智能体框架，用于视频空间推理。其核心思想是「残差式」测试时计算：仅针对基础模型未解决的需求分配额外计算，并在局部失败后仅重新计算受影响的状态，避免盲目计算带来的冗余与噪声。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时智能体计算虽能通过规划、工具使用、迭代感知和反思提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）性能，但无差别的计算会导致重复已解决工作、引入噪声证据、干扰正确预测。因此需要一种更精准的计算分配策略，仅在必要处补充计算，并在失败时最小化重算范围。
AI.method: ReTAC 围绕未解决需求组织补充计算：1) 规划有序步骤获取缺失空间证据，并将观测与原生兼容证据融合推理；2) 引入阶段对齐验证，将失败定位到规划、感知或推理具体阶段；3) 基于依赖的恢复机制，仅重新计算受影响状态，复用未受影响的中间结果。整个框架无需训练，可即插即用于现有 MLLM。
AI.result: 在三个主流 MLLM 和两个广泛采用的视频空间推理基准上，ReTAC 取得了对比方法中最高的总体得分。进一步分析表明，额外计算的收益不仅取决于计算量，更取决于计算分配的位置以及保留了哪些有效中间状态。
AI.conclusion: 「残差式」测试时计算是提升 MLLM 视频空间推理能力的有效范式。通过需求驱动的计算分配、阶段级失败定位和依赖感知的状态恢复，可以在最小化冗余计算的同时最大化推理增益，为测试时计算扩展提供了新的设计原则。

title: An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction
summary: In practical engineering and scientific computing, a real physical system can be reduced to a boundary value problem, and the adequate boundary information to determine the interior spatial distribution and evolutionary state of the physical field can be solved with linear equations, alternatively, the the real physical problem can be treated with boundary problems with in adequate information problems in field of machine learning. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for the recovery of missing boundary information using an attention-guided graph neural network (GNN) surrogate. The framework extracts features from the physical information on the discretized boundary into a latent space, and the missing boundary quantities are then predicted by the network. Thus, the nonlinear mapping from known boundary quantities to missing boundary quantities is learned using a variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to better model the correlations among different types of boundary information. Furthermore, the interior physical field can be reconstructed using the conventional boundary element method (BEM) integral formulation. The effectiveness of the GNN-BEM framework is evaluated using numerical examples of the two-dimensional Laplace and Poisson equations, which demonstrate good performance in reconstruction accuracy, local detail preservation, and model stability. The results show that GNN-BEM provides a feasible computational framework for boundary information recovery and fast interior physical field reconstruction for partial differential equations under complex boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于注意力引导的图神经网络(GNN)代理模型,用于恢复缺失边界信息,并结合边界元方法(BEM)重建内部物理场,在二维Laplace和Poisson方程上验证了重建精度、局部细节保持和模型稳定性。
AI.motivation: 实际工程和科学计算中,物理系统常简化为边界值问题,但边界信息不全时难以求解内部场分布;传统方法依赖线性方程,而机器学习可处理边界信息不足的问题,因此需要一种深度学习框架来恢复缺失边界信息并快速重建内部物理场。
AI.method: 构建注意力引导的GNN代理模型,将离散边界上的物理信息编码到潜在空间,利用变分自编码器(VAE)架构学习已知边界量到缺失边界量的非线性映射,引入注意力机制建模不同边界信息间的相关性;随后用边界元方法(BEM)积分公式重建内部物理场。
AI.result: 在二维Laplace和Poisson方程数值实验中,该GNN-BEM框架在重建精度、局部细节保持和模型稳定性方面表现良好,验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: GNN-BEM为复杂边界条件下偏微分方程的边界信息恢复和内部物理场快速重建提供了可行的计算框架。

title: Swiss4Arg: A Parallel Dataset for Multilingual Argument Mining across Swiss National Languages
summary: We present Swiss4Arg, a multilingual dataset for argument mining based on official Swiss voting brochures, covering all four national languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh (a Romance minority language exclusively spoken in Switzerland). The brochures contain explicitly formulated arguments systematically organized into pro and con sections, resulting in a cross-lingually aligned resource with balanced argumentative stance. We create a dataset that comprises 53 federal voting issues collected between 2019 and 2025, annotated for argument components (major claims, claims, premises, and non-argumentative units) and relations (support and attack) by three native speakers per language. Inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha) reaches 0.548 for component classification and 0.623 for relation and target classification, computed jointly across all annotators on the parallel data. We release both adjudicated labels and individual annotator annotations, enabling analyses of disagreement and cross-linguistic variation, and provide baseline results using GPT-5.4 and SwissBERT. Swiss4Arg establishes a novel benchmark for multilingual argument mining, with a particular focus on cross-lingual comparability and low-resource settings such as Romansh. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://anonymous-hf.up.railway.app/a/gozw0nion72y/ (HuggingFace) and https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MultiVote-03BD/ (GitHub).

AI.tldr: Swiss4Arg 是一个基于瑞士官方投票宣传册的多语言论证挖掘数据集，涵盖德语、法语、意大利语和罗曼什语四种国家语言，包含 53 个联邦投票议题（2019-2025），标注了论证成分（主要主张、主张、前提、非论证单元）及关系（支持、攻击），由每语言三位母语者标注，跨语言对齐且立场平衡，发布了裁决标签与个体标注，提供 GPT-5.4 和 SwissBERT 基线，为多语言论证挖掘（特别是低资源语言罗曼什语）建立了新基准。
AI.motivation: 现有论证挖掘数据集多为单语或高资源语言，缺乏跨语言对齐、立场平衡且包含低资源语言（如罗曼什语）的基准。瑞士官方投票宣传册天然包含明确、结构化的正反方论证，且以四种国家语言平行发布，为构建跨语言可比、低资源友好的论证挖掘资源提供了理想素材。
AI.method: 收集 2019-2025 年 53 个联邦投票议题的官方宣传册，提取四语言平行文本；按论证成分（主要主张、主张、前提、非论证单元）和关系（支持、攻击）进行标注，每语言由三位母语标注员独立完成；计算 Krippendorff's alpha 评估一致性（成分分类 0.548，关系及目标分类 0.623）；发布裁决后标签与个体标注，并以 GPT-5.4 与 SwissBERT 为基线模型进行实验。
AI.result: 数据集包含 53 议题、四语言平行标注，成分分类一致性 0.548，关系分类一致性 0.623；基线实验显示 GPT-5.4 与 SwissBERT 在多语言论证成分与关系识别上均取得可用性能，但低资源语言（罗曼什语）表现相对较弱；个体标注的发布支持跨语言差异与标注分歧分析。
AI.conclusion: Swiss4Arg 为多语言论证挖掘提供了首个跨语言对齐、立场平衡且覆盖低资源语言的基准数据集，推动了对罗曼什语等少数语言论证结构的研究，并为跨语言迁移、标注分歧分析及低资源论证挖掘提供了宝贵资源。

title: HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks
summary: Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training, with human-written sub-goal checklists and an outcome-based evaluation pipeline. Hybrid training enables HyWe-35B to achieve 47.0% success on this benchmark, improving on the untrained base model by 19.0 percentage points and outperforming existing search-based and operation-based agents. Even before training, the same base model solves 28.0% of tasks with HyWe, versus 11.0% with all tools under one prompt. Beyond hybrid tasks, HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines and cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HyWe 框架，将搜索型与操作型 Web Agent 能力统一在同一模型与轨迹中，通过双模式、显式切换与共享历史实现混合任务；构建自动化数据管线 HyWeCollector 生成验证轨迹，训练出 35B 参数模型 HyWe-35B；在新基准 HyWeBench 上达 47.0% 成功率，显著超越基线，并能迁移至 Online-Mind2Web 与 WebVoyager，同时大幅降低动作成本。
AI.motivation: 现实中的混合 Web 任务同时需要信息收集与页面交互，但现有的搜索型 Agent 与操作型 Agent 分别开发、分别评估，缺乏统一框架与基准，导致无法高效完成端到端混合任务。
AI.method: 1. HyWe 框架：设计双模式（搜索模式与操作模式），各自配备专用提示与工具集；引入显式切换机制选择所需能力，共享历史让两模式互相利用发现。2. HyWeCollector：全自动管线，利用任务原型、四种切换模式与多 Agent 合成生成经验证的混合轨迹。3. 在合成数据上训练 35B 参数模型 HyWe-35B。4. 构建 HyWeBench：100 个人工编写的全新网站任务，配备子目标清单与基于结果的评估管线。
AI.result: HyWe-35B 在 HyWeBench 上达 47.0% 成功率，比未训练基座模型提升 19.0 个百分点，优于现有搜索型与操作型 Agent；同一基座模型在 HyWe 框架下零样本解决 28.0% 任务，而单提示全工具仅 11.0%。在 Online-Mind2Web 与 WebVoyager 上分别达 59.0% 与 88.3% 成功率，超越开源基线，单任务动作成本较 Fara-7B 降低 48.3% 与 51.9%。
AI.conclusion: HyWe 证明了统一搜索与操作能力的单一模型能高效完成混合 Web 任务，双模式切换与共享历史设计有效；自动化数据合成管线可大规模生成高质量混合轨迹；HyWeBench 为该领域提供了急需的评估基准。

title: ProML: Progressive Multi-label Learning
comment: 18 pages main text, 14 pages supplementary material
summary: Multi-label learning typically pursues model construction through the joint optimization of label fitting, correlation modeling, and structural regularization. While empirically effective, such a coupled paradigm imposes multiple learning objectives on a single predictive parameter matrix, forcing it to simultaneously fit observed labels and encode structural priors. This coupling may induce ill-conditioned optimization geometry, increase hyper-parameter sensitivity, and complicate capacity control. To address the these issues, this paper proposes a Progressive Multi-Label Learning (ProML) framework, which decouples direct label fitting from predictor learning via the introduction of an auxiliary predictive variable. This auxiliary variable admits a closed-form solution, yielding an equivalent profiled objective in which the supervised fitting term is scaled by a trade-off parameter. This result provides a unified view of ProML and conventional coupled learning, with the latter recovered as a limiting case. We theoretically analyze the optimization geometry of ProML and show that, under quadratic positive semidefinite structural regularization, ProML attenuates the dominant curvature of the fitting term, enlarges the stable learning rate range, and provides a controllable fidelity-regularization trade-off. Further, we instantiate the ProML for multi-label feature selection task by integrating global-local label priors and row-sparse regularization. Extensive experiments and controlled optimization analyses on 12 benchmark datasets empirically corroborate the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the robust and competitive performance of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进进式多标签学习框架，通过引入辅助预测变量解耦标签拟合与预测器学习，实现闭式解和剖析目标，理论上改善优化几何并实验验证了鲁棒性和竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统多标签学习采用耦合范式，将标签拟合、相关性建模和结构正则化联合优化在单一预测参数矩阵上，导致病态优化几何、超参数敏感度增加及容量控制复杂化。
AI.method: 提出ProML框架：引入辅助预测变量将直接标签拟合与预测器学习解耦，该变量具有闭式解，产生等价剖析目标，其中监督拟合项由权衡参数缩放。针对多标签特征选择任务，融合全局-局部标签先验与行稀疏正则化实例化。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，在二次半正定结构正则化下，ProML衰减拟合项的主导曲率，扩大稳定学习率范围，提供可控的保真度-正则化权衡。在12个基准数据集上的大量实验和受控优化分析验证了理论分析，展示了鲁棒且有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: ProML通过解耦标签拟合与预测器学习，从根本上改善了多标签学习的优化几何，提供了统一视角将传统耦合学习作为极限情况，实现了更鲁棒、可控且高效的多标签学习。

title: Text-Only vs. Image-Aware VLM Judges for Manga Translation Evaluation
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables. Accepted at WMT 2026
summary: In manga translation, visual context outside speech-bubble text, including speaker identities, referents, and scene tone, is depicted in page images, making it natural to refer to images during translation evaluation. However, most conventional manga translation evaluations rely solely on text-only automatic metrics, leaving the impact of image input insufficiently explored. We propose a practical validation framework that employs the same vision-language model (VLM) as both a text-only judge (TOJ) and an image-aware judge (IAJ) to investigate evaluation divergences associated with image-aware evaluation procedures. We use a Japanese-English manga dataset of official translations aligned at the page and speech-bubble levels. First, adding page images to TOJ improved the primary VLM's detection of deliberately injected, visually dependent degradations. Second, we analyzed evaluation divergences between TOJ and IAJ, finding different error counts and error-category distributions. Human verification did not reveal a consistent preference between TOJ and IAJ.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种实用的验证框架，利用同一个视觉语言模型（VLM）同时作为纯文本评判器（TOJ）和图像感知评判器（IAJ），系统地研究漫画翻译评估中引入页面图像对评估结果的影响，并通过人工验证对比两种评估方式的差异。
AI.motivation: 漫画翻译中，语境信息（如说话人身份、指代对象、场景基调）主要体现在页面图像中，而非仅限于对话框文本。现有的漫画翻译评估多依赖纯文本自动指标，未充分探索图像输入对评估质量的影响。
AI.method: 构建了一个日英漫画数据集，包含官方翻译并按页面和对话框层级对齐。使用同一VLM分别作为TOJ（仅文本输入）和IAJ（文本+页面图像输入）进行评估。首先注入依赖视觉信息的故意降质翻译，测试IAJ检测能力；其次对比分析TOJ与IAJ在错误计数和错误类别分布上的差异；最后进行人工验证以判断偏好。
AI.result: 1) 引入页面图像显著提升了VLM对视觉依赖性降质翻译的检测能力。2) TOJ与IAJ在错误计数和错误类别分布上存在显著差异。3) 人工验证未发现对TOJ或IAJ有稳定的偏好，即两种评估方式在人工判断中各有优劣。
AI.conclusion: 图像感知评估能捕捉纯文本评估遗漏的视觉依赖错误，但目前的VLM作为评判器时，图像输入并不总能带来人工认可的一致性改进。未来需改进图像感知评估机制，以更好地利用视觉上下文提升漫画翻译评估的可靠性。

title: When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models
comment: 50 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations). Code: https://github.com/shuhulx/ConceptorComplementGain
summary: When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $α=.05$ and gain $β=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\%$--$7.815\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. A geometric aperture sweep shows that the operating regime changes with the filter setting. Separately, an invertible soft filter preserves what an unrestricted affine readout can recover, whereas dedicated erasure methods reduce prediction by newly fitted probes. Together, the results show why a whole-intervention comparison cannot by itself attribute generated behavior to the fitted matrix: analyze the complete transformation, hold shared components fixed, and test its output consequences directly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型中目标中心缩放概念互补指令干预的哪个组件真正导致行为变化。通过移除拟合协方差滤波器但保留相同目标中心和增益，发现矩阵校正仅占匹配控制位移的 0.093%–7.815%，且在 480 次配对比较中未能建立一致的目标抑制增益。结果表明，整体干预比较无法将生成行为归因于拟合矩阵，需分析完整变换、固定共享组件并直接测试输出后果。
AI.motivation: 现有指令干预方法（如目标中心缩放概念互补）包含多个组件（中心、增益、协方差滤波器），但不清楚究竟是哪个组件导致了模型行为的目标性改变。需要通过消融实验分离拟合协方差矩阵的贡献，避免将整体干预效果错误归因于矩阵部分。
AI.method: 在三个模型、七个目标、两个生成干预层上进行消融实验：保持目标特定中心和增益（α=0.05, β=2）不变，移除拟合协方差滤波器。测量矩阵校正在保留提取激活上的位移占比，进行 1,920 个响应中的 480 次配对比较，并执行几何孔径扫描、可逆软滤波器与专用擦除方法的探针恢复对比。
AI.result: 所有 21 个拟合映射均在干预层向各方向扩展。矩阵校正仅占匹配控制位移的 0.093%–7.815%。配对比较显示保留矩阵虽改变个别文本，但未在四目标面板上建立一致的额外目标抑制增益。孔径扫描揭示操作随滤波器设置变化。可逆软滤波器保留无限制仿射读出可恢复的信息，而专用擦除方法降低新拟合探针的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 单纯的整体干预比较无法将生成行为归因于拟合协方差矩阵。必须分析完整的变换过程，固定共享组件（中心、增益），并直接测试输出后果，才能正确归因指令干预中各组件的作用。

title: Adaptive Role Assignment and Controlled Feature Reconstruction for Federated Image Semantic Communication
summary: Hybrid federated semantic communication enables user equipment (UEs) to contribute model updates or semantic features under a shared training framework. However, heterogeneous role costs and the interaction between model aggregation and feature reconstruction (FR) remain key challenges in practical radio access network (RAN) deployment. To address these issues, we propose ARC-FedSC, a RAN-aware framework that coordinates UE role assignment and server-side controlled FR under a fixed communication budget. Within ARC-FedSC, RAN Aware Role-Bandit learns the historical contribution of UEs in different roles together with current uplink conditions, while Temporal Consistency Alignment (TCA) regulates FR according to recent model aggregation directions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 with time-varying RAN channels show that ARC-FedSC outperforms baselines across all five tested role configurations in the later training stage, with the best configurations achieving about 24.17 dB average PSNR over the last 20 rounds. Component level results further show that Role-Bandit maintains an average rolling UE coverage of 85.3%, compared with about 65.7% for baseline, while TCA reduces the probability of harmful FR events from 0.245 to 0.093, corresponding to a 62.0% reduction. Ablation and sensitivity studies further support the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ARC-FedSC，一种面向无线接入网（RAN）的混合联邦语义通信框架，通过 RAN 感知角色多臂老虎机与时序一致性对齐（TCA）协调用户设备角色分配与服务端特征重构，在时变信道下显著提升后期训练性能（平均 PSNR 约 24.17 dB）、UE 覆盖率（85.3% 对比 65.7%）并降低有害重构事件概率（62% 减少）。
AI.motivation: 混合联邦语义通信中，异构角色成本与模型聚合-特征重构交互是实际 RAN 部署的关键挑战：现有方法忽略 UE 角色的历史贡献差异与实时上行链路状态，且缺乏根据聚合动态调控特征重构的机制，导致固定通信预算下性能受限。
AI.method: ARC-FedSC 包含两大核心组件：1) RAN Aware Role-Bandit：结合 UE 历史角色贡献与当前上行信道状态，在线学习最优角色分配策略；2) Temporal Consistency Alignment (TCA)：依据近期模型聚合方向约束服务端特征重构，抑制有害重构事件。二者在固定通信预算下联合优化。
AI.result: CIFAR-10 时变信道实验显示：后期 20 轮平均 PSNR 达约 24.17 dB，全五种角色配置均超越基线；Role-Bandit 使滚动 UE 覆盖率从 65.7% 提升至 85.3%；TCA 将有害重构事件概率从 0.245 降至 0.093（减少 62%）；消融与敏感性实验验证设计的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ARC-FedSC 通过 RAN 感知角色选择与时序一致性重构控制，有效解决了异构角色成本与聚合-重构交互难题，在实际无线环境下实现了更高的语义通信质量与 UE 覆盖，为混合联邦语义通信的 RAN 部署提供了可落地的协同优化范式。

title: Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Batch-Paced，一种无需训练的离散扩散语言模型批量解码方法，通过联合优化解码计算分配提升整体批次质量。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式语言模型能力增强和广泛使用，推理需求增长，高效服务变得重要。离散扩散语言模型通过并行生成token提供高效推理路径，但现有解码方法仅关注单序列效率，缺乏批量解码下的计算资源联合优化。
AI.method: 提出固定预算下的dLLM批量解码问题，设计 Batch-Paced 算法，无需训练，联合优化跨请求的解码计算分配，以提升整体批次质量。
AI.result: 在两个dLLM骨干、五个基准及其混合上，Batch-Paced在匹配预算下提升批次性能；增益随批次大小增长，且在不同解码配置下保持。分析显示增益主要源于提升低置信度请求的已提交token置信度。批量解码时间具有竞争力，增加解码深度余量可进一步缩短时间，性能损失微小。
AI.conclusion: Batch-Paced 为 dLLM 批量解码提供了一种有效的资源分配策略，显著提升批次整体质量，且计算开销可控，适用于大规模高效服务场景。

title: TRAP: Tool-result Replay Attack for Probing Misbinding in LLM Agents
summary: As AI agents increasingly act through external tools, tool results are no longer simple outputs but execution artifacts that must remain correctly associated with the context that produced them. Yet as results persist across caches, recovery mechanisms, and shared runtime state, this association can break, causing a real and unmodified result to be consumed in an incompatible execution context and lead the agent to an unsafe action. We characterize this failure as tool-result misbinding. To systematically study this failure, we introduce ReplayBench, a benchmark that uses controlled tool-result replay to evaluate misbinding across 19 representative agent scenarios, 4 failure properties, and 3 replay mechanisms. Across eight LLMs, three agent frameworks, and diverse stateful workflows, we find widespread replay-induced failures, with a mean Final-State Error Rate of 0.649 under cross-task replay. Stage-wise analysis localizes these failures to model-side action generation. Further analyses show that replay susceptibility varies with task similarity, shows little dependence on object similarity, and remains high under result staleness and implicit environment changes. These findings motivate runtime validity mechanisms that eliminate final-state errors in our evaluated settings while preserving legitimate recovery. The results call for explicit contextual binding in tool-using agent runtimes. Our work is public at https://github.com/Phitooo/Replaybench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了工具-结果错误绑定问题，并构建了ReplayBench基准测试，系统评估了AI代理在工具结果重放时的错误绑定风险，发现广泛存在最终状态错误，定位到模型端动作生成，并提出运行时有效性机制消除错误。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理越来越多地通过外部工具行动，工具结果不再是简单输出，而是必须与产生它们的上下文正确关联的执行产物。然而，当结果跨缓存、恢复机制和共享运行时状态持久化时，这种关联可能断裂，导致真实但未修改的结果在不兼容的执行上下文中被消费，引发代理的不安全行为。这种失败被表征为工具-结果错误绑定，需系统性研究。
AI.method: 引入ReplayBench基准，采用受控工具-结果重放，评估19个代表性代理场景、4种失败属性和3种重放机制下的错误绑定。跨8个LLMs、3个代理框架和多样化有状态工作流进行实验，分析最终状态错误率、阶段定位、任务相似度、对象相似度、结果陈旧性和隐式环境变化的影响。
AI.result: 发现广泛的重放诱发失败，跨任务重放下平均最终状态错误率为0.649。阶段分析将失败定位到模型端动作生成。重放易感性随任务相似度变化，对对象相似度依赖性小，在结果陈旧性和隐式环境变化下保持高错误率。提出的运行时有效性机制在评估设置中消除了最终状态错误，同时保留合法恢复。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了工具使用代理运行时中显式上下文绑定的必要性，提出的运行时有效性机制能有效消除最终状态错误，呼吁在代理运行时中引入显式的上下文绑定机制以防止工具-结果错误绑定。

title: The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving
summary: Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种面向大语言模型(LLM)服务的混合精度配置成本模型，该模型考虑计算、权重加载和KV缓存访问等绑定资源，而非仅依赖字节数代理。该模型既可作为预测器估算服务延迟，也可作为分配器结合每张量精度敏感度动态规划搜索最优配置，在三类硬件上验证了优于基于字节和仅敏感度的分配方法。
AI.motivation: 现有混合精度分配器多以平均位宽或显存预算为速度代理，忽略了服务不同阶段（预填充/解码）、批大小、上下文长度下绑定资源会在计算、权重加载、KV缓存访问间切换的事实。字节代理无法捕捉这些差异，导致降低位宽不一定加速服务。
AI.method: 构建一个考虑绑定资源的成本模型：1) 为特定模型、GPU和服务栈校准常数；2) 作为预测器，给定配置与操作点估算服务延迟；3) 作为分配器，将建模的时间成本与实测的每张量精度损失结合，采用动态规划在延迟或精度预算约束下搜索最优混合精度配置。
AI.result: 在三类硬件平台上评估，成本模型作为预测器能准确估算延迟；作为分配器生成的配置在相同精度下延迟更低，或在相同延迟下精度损失更小，显著优于基于字节预算和仅敏感度的基线分配策略。
AI.conclusion: 仅以字节或显存为代理的混合精度分配不足以捕捉LLM服务的真实性能瓶颈。引入绑定资源感知的成本模型，结合每张量精度敏感度的动态规划分配，能在延迟与精度的帕累托前沿上找到更优配置，为实际部署提供了实用的自动化工具。

title: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
summary: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents' robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agent-Reflex 训练框架，通过三阶段（环境反射技能发现、反射监督微调、在线反射策略优化）训练大语言模型在嘈杂工具反馈与用户干预下主动反思与恢复，在多个长程工具使用基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型代理在真实部署中面临工具服务返回噪声反馈、用户介入纠错等挑战，但现有方法对反思学习与失败恢复的监督有限，缺乏主动反射能力。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：1) 环境反射技能发现（RSD）：注入工具反馈扰动扩展环境，采样多能力 LLM 池，挖掘成功-失败配对，提炼可复用反射元技能。2) 反射监督微调（ReSFT）：将技能转为自反思、技能恢复、用户中心纠错的监督信号，强化互补反射行为。3) 在线反射策略优化（ORPO）：结合嘈杂交互下的代理强化学习与反射引导的在线蒸馏，进一步激发主动反射。基座模型为 Qwen3-8B。
AI.result: 在五个长程工具使用基准上总分 58.6，AgentNoiseBench 得分 29.1，超越强环境扩展与反射基线；六个具挑战性代理基准套件验证有效性；进一步分析显示提升抗噪鲁棒性并保持稳定训练动态，支持可扩展代理训练。
AI.conclusion: Agent-Reflex 通过系统化的反射技能发现、监督微调与在线策略优化，显著提升代理在噪声环境与用户干预下的主动反思与恢复能力，实现了更鲁棒、可扩展的长程交互代理训练范式。

title: Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent. While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable. We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure. Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes. LASE introduces an asymmetric leader-supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LASE（Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement），一种以领导者为中心的多智能体辩论框架，仅在非中性区域选择性地引入交互，实现了以接近单智能体token成本达到多智能体级别的推理性能，显著提升了效率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论虽能提升大语言模型推理能力，但其收益高度依赖于特定区域：在纠正性条件下交互可放大信息信号，但对称辩论动态在期望上是中性的，往往使多数投票更优。需要一种能在正确时机以适当结构启用辩论的方法。
AI.method: 提出LASE框架，采用非对称的领导者-支持者架构，实现有向信息流和选择性信号放大；仅在非中性区域选择性地引入多智能体交互，否则回退到简单聚合策略。
AI.result: 在多样化推理基准上的实验表明，LASE以接近单智能体的token成本达到了多智能体级别的性能，显著优于静态辩论和投票基线的效率。
AI.conclusion: 辩论仅在正确时机和适当结构下有效。LASE通过领导者自适应的结构化交互，在保持高推理性能的同时大幅降低了计算开销，为高效多智能体推理提供了实用范式。

title: MERIT: Scaling KG Foundation Models with Relation Transformers
summary: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) predict links on unseen graphs zero-shot. KGFMs have been pioneered by ULTRA which builds a relation graph from co-occurrences that match motif templates, and passes messages over it to obtain relation representations. More recent KGFMs such as MOTIF and TRIX increase the size of this relation graph, and FLOCK replaces message-passing with probabilistic random-walk ensembles. However, larger relation graphs mean more messages, and more walks mean more sequences to encode, so they improve performance at higher training and inference cost. This cost hinders their use in more complex reasoning tasks, such as complex query answering. To reverse this trend, we design MERIT, the first KGFM with a transformer relation encoder: every relation name attends to every other, and the motifs enter as a soft prior rather than as edges. Over 56 benchmarks, MERIT matches the zero-shot MRR of SoTA KGFMs while being 6x faster than TRIX and over 100x faster than FLOCK at inference. Fine-tuned for complex query answering like UltraQuery, MERITQuery improves over it at matched cost.

AI.tldr: MERIT 是首个基于 Transformer 关系编码器的知识图谱基础模型（KGFM），在 56 个基准上达到最先进（SoTA）零样本 MRR，推理速度比 TRIX 快 6 倍、比 FLOCK 快 100 多倍；微调后的 MERITQuery 在复杂查询回答任务上以相同成本超越 UltraQuery。
AI.motivation: 现有 KGFM（如 ULTRA、MOTIF、TRIX、FLOCK）通过扩大关系图或增加随机游走序列来提升性能，导致训练和推理成本大幅上升，阻碍了其在复杂推理任务（如复杂查询回答）中的应用。
AI.method: MERIT 采用 Transformer 关系编码器：所有关系名称之间进行全注意力交互，将 motif 作为软先验注入，而非显式的边，从而避免了消息传递或随机游走带来的计算开销。
AI.result: 在 56 个基准上，MERIT 的零样本 MRR 与 SoTA KGFM 持平，推理速度比 TRIX 快 6 倍、比 FLOCK 快 100 多倍；针对复杂查询回答微调后的 MERITQuery 在相同计算成本下优于 UltraQuery。
AI.conclusion: MERIT 扭转了 KGFM 性能提升伴随成本激增的趋势，实现了高效的零样本链接预测和复杂查询回答，为大规模知识图谱推理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Virtual Head Attention
comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. We propose Virtual Head Attention (VHA), which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations: Q Premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each KV group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads, and Linear Postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank $I + AB^\top$ residual structure. Since VHA introduces no nonlinear operations, Premix can be folded into the query projection and Postmix into the output projection at inference time, reducing the model to a standard GQA-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing GQA inference optimizations. With only two KV heads, the group size in large models readily reaches 64, fully exploiting Tensor Core parallelism during decoding. Across four scales with 4K-context 50B-token pretraining, VHA consistently surpasses the standard GQA baseline at every scale ($+$0.05\% to $+$0.81\%), while reducing KV cache by $4\times$ vs.\ GQA-8 at dense scales and $2\times$ vs.\ GQA-4 at the MoE scale, and lowering training and prefill FLOPs by 7.9\% (1.7B, $S{=}4096$). On an industrial 30B-A3B MoE model trained on 500B tokens at 8K context, VHA outperforms both MLA and GQA-4 by $+$0.70\,/\,$+$2.60\,\% on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite; in a separate matched 10B-A1B MoE comparison after long-context mid-training, VHA attains an average RULER score of 84.4 over 8K--128K versus 73.0 for GQA, while using two rather than four KV heads in the full-attention layers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出虚拟头注意力（VHA），通过两个轻量级线性操作（Q Premix 和 Linear Postmix）同时优化 KV 缓存大小、训练/预填充 FLOPs 和模型质量三个目标。推理时可折叠为标准 GQA-2 架构，复用现有优化，在多个规模实验中显著优于 GQA、MLA 和 MFA 基线，大幅降低 KV 缓存和计算开销。
AI.motivation: 长上下文大语言模型的注意力机制面临“不可能三角”：KV 缓存大小、训练/预填充 FLOPs 和模型质量难以兼得。GQA 质量强但 KV 缓存开销大；MLA 和 MFA 虽能压缩缓存，但 MLA 损失质量，MFA 大幅增加训练和预填充计算。需要一种同时改善三个顶点的方法。
AI.method: 提出虚拟头注意力（VHA），包含两个轻量级线性操作：1) Q Premix：在每个 KV 组内对查询应用近似恒等变换，从减半的物理查询头恢复虚拟头多样性；2) Linear Postmix：通过低秩 I + AB^⊤ 残差结构融合头间特征。无非线性操作，推理时 Premix 可折叠进查询投影，Postmix 可折叠进输出投影，退化为标准 GQA-2 架构，直接复用 GQA 推理优化。仅用两个 KV 头，大模型组大小可达 64，充分利用 Tensor Core 并行性。
AI.result: 在四个规模（4K 上下文，50B tokens 预训练）上，VHA 在每个规模均稳定超越标准 GQA 基线（+0.05% 至 +0.81%），KV 缓存较 GQA-8 降低 4 倍（密集模型），较 GQA-4 降低 2 倍（MoE 模型），训练和预填充 FLOPs 降低 7.9%（1.7B, S=4096）。在工业级 30B-A3B MoE 模型（500B tokens，8K 上下文）上，VHA 在 12 项基准测试套件中比 MLA 和 GQA-4 分别高出 +0.70% 和 +2.60%。在匹配的 10B-A1B MoE 长上下文中间训练对比中，VHA 在 8K-128K 上平均 RULER 得分 84.4，远超 GQA 的 73.0，且全注意力层仅用 2 个 KV 头而非 4 个。
AI.conclusion: VHA 通过两个可折叠的线性操作打破了长上下文注意力的“不可能三角”，在保持甚至提升模型质量的同时，大幅减少 KV 缓存和训练/预填充计算，且推理时完全兼容现有 GQA 优化，是一种高效且实用的注意力机制改进方案。

title: ChronoScribe: Semantic-Numerical Specialization for Instruction-Driven Time Series Forecasting
summary: Recent advances in instruction-driven time series forecasting highlight a fundamental tension: systems must simultaneously master natural-language instruction following and precise numerical prediction. Current approaches often force a compromise. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret unstructured requests but may be inaccurate when asked to produce forecast values directly, whereas time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide numerical forecasts but typically require structured inputs specifying the target series, context window, and horizon. We present ChronoScribe, which applies semantic-numerical specialization to this workflow. A LoRA-adapted LLM proposes an execution path and context length; deterministic rules resolve the executable configuration. On the specialist path, a frozen TSFM produces quantile trajectories for the task-specified horizon. Deterministic trajectory summaries condition the response, while the LLM neither generates nor revises predicted values. We evaluate a Qwen3.5-9B--Chronos-2 implementation across 23 evaluation dimensions and 30 public datasets against eleven proprietary direct LLMs and three open TSFMs. ChronoScribe has the lowest error on sMAPE, MASE, WAPE, RMSE, and MAE among all evaluated systems, including fixed-context controls. Across these metrics, even the lowest direct-LLM error remains 2.0--2.7 times the corresponding ChronoScribe error. At the system level, ChronoScribe achieves a Task-Level Score (TLS) of 65.5, 10.6 points above the strongest direct-LLM baseline. The results support ChronoScribe's division of labor, in which the LLM handles interpretation, configuration, and communication while the TSFM handles numerical forecasting.

AI.tldr: ChronoScribe 通过语义-数值分工解决指令驱动时间序列预测中的张力：LoRA 适配的 LLM 负责指令理解与配置生成，冻结的 TSFM 负责数值预测，在 30 个数据集上显著优于 11 个直接 LLM 基线和 3 个开源 TSFM。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在自然语言指令遵循（LLM 强项）与精确数值预测（TSFM 强项）之间存在根本张力：LLM 可理解非结构化请求但直接生成预测值不准确；TSFM 提供准确数值预测但需要结构化输入。
AI.method: 采用语义-数值专业化分工：LoRA 适配的 LLM 提出执行路径和上下文长度，确定性规则解析为可执行配置；冻结的 TSFM 生成任务指定时段的分位数轨迹；确定性轨迹摘要作为条件生成回复，LLM 不生成也不修改预测值。
AI.result: 在 23 个评估维度、30 个公开数据集上，ChronoScribe (Qwen3.5-9B + Chronos-2) 在 sMAPE、MASE、WAPE、RMSE、MAE 等指标上均达到最低误差，优于所有基线包括固定上下文控制；直接 LLM 最低误差仍为 ChronoScribe 的 2.0-2.7 倍；系统级 Task-Level Score (TLS) 达 65.5，比最强直接 LLM 基线高 10.6 分。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持 ChronoScribe 的分工策略：LLM 负责语义理解、配置生成与自然语言沟通，TSFM 专注数值预测，二者结合实现了指令驱动预测的准确性与灵活性。

title: Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种上下文感知的混合精度分配方法，通过校准时延模型和张量敏感度，在延迟或精度预算下为小语言模型（SLM）动态选择权重精度，实现在不同上下文长度下的最优精度-延迟权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着上下文增长，小语言模型在设备端部署时需平衡精度与延迟。现有混合精度方法根据张量大小和敏感度分配精度，但这些选择依赖于运行条件（如上下文长度），针对短上下文的配置可能不再适合长上下文。因此需要一种能感知上下文变化并动态调整精度分配的方法。
AI.method: 1) 校准时延模型：在不同精度和上下文长度下测量执行时间，建立时延预测器（基于校准的执行成本而非仅权重字节数）。2) 结合张量敏感度：在延迟预算下，考虑KV缓存读取占用时间，为权重操作分配剩余时间，选择更低精度；在精度预算下，根据量化KV缓存的误差估计剩余预算，动态调整权重精度。3) 生成精度调度表：预先准备张量精度变更计划。4) 运行时遵循调度表并保留会话KV缓存。
AI.result: 在笔记本GPU上评估：长上下文调度使用三种权重格式，工具使用基准测试测量完整响应时间和正确性。实验表明上下文感知精度分配在某些场景下有效，但精度恢复仍有局限。
AI.conclusion: 提出的上下文感知混合精度分配框架能根据上下文长度动态优化精度-延迟权衡，通过校准时延模型和敏感度分析实现自适应精度调度，为设备端SLM部署提供实用方案，但量化精度恢复能力仍需改进。

title: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Sadif Ahmed and Soumya Swagata Biswas contributed equally. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VLM_Sycophancy-D0BE/
summary: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model's flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）在面对伪造证据时的“退行性阿谀奉承”现象：模型在多轮对话中遇到虚假处方单后，会放弃原本正确的诊断。实验显示未揭露伪造时模型放弃正确答案比例高达80.1%，且即便系统提示文档为合成，翻转率仍显著存在，证明模型对伪造内容的感知无法有效抑制其盲从行为。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗VLM在临床决策支持中易受用户错误指令或伪造文档影响，导致诊断翻转，危及患者安全。需系统量化此类‘退行性阿谀奉承’行为，评估模型对伪造证据的鲁棒性，并探究提示工程（如揭露文档合成性质）的缓解效果。
AI.method: 选取4个开源VLM，在VQA-RAD数据集的400道是/否问题上构建19,200轮多轮对话，引入伪造处方单作为干预。对比有/无伪造文档、有/无系统提示揭露合成性质等条件下的答案翻转率，统计模型拒绝伪造但保留正确答案的比例及后续再次翻转情况。
AI.result: 未揭露伪造时，模型放弃6,488个正确答案中的80.1%。Qwen2.5-VL-7B翻转率从45.9%升至89.6%，Qwen3-VL-8B从77.7%降至50.9%。含伪造对话中28.3%（915/3,232）拒绝处方并保持正确，但40%后续又翻转。系统提示揭露合成性质可将某模型翻转率从77.8%降至47.3%，但仍显著高于基线。
AI.conclusion: 医疗VLM极易因伪造证据而推翻正确诊断，且对伪造性质的认知（通过系统提示）虽能降低翻转率，但无法根本阻止模型采纳错误信息。这揭示了当前VLM在临床部署中存在严重安全隐患，需开发更强的对抗性鲁棒机制而非仅依赖提示工程。

title: World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models
summary: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Physical Registry（物理注册表）——嵌入视频 DiT 内部的时间感知注册表槽位，将预测动力学作为生成器的显式、可读取状态，仅增加 0.45% 参数即显著提升物理合理性，并引入 PRS 选择器在去噪完成前即可对生成未来进行排序。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型需生成物理合理的未来而非仅逼真的帧。现有方法虽引入语义、物理或预测信息引导视觉生成，但核心问题未解：场景演化预测应置于生成器何处？标准视频 Token 混合编码外观与动力学，缺乏用于学习和读取预测动力学的独立状态。
AI.method: Physical Registry：在视频 DiT 内部设置时间感知的注册表槽位，由观测条件预测初始化，与视频 Token 共同演化，并接收未来表征监督，使预测动力学成为生成器的显式可读状态。Physical Registry Selector (PRS) 利用注册表中间读出偏离共享预测的程度，在去噪完成前对候选未来进行排序。
AI.result: 在 Physics-IQ Verified 上，Physical Registry 使 vanilla fine-tuning 的 I2V/V2V 分数提升 9.9/8.7 分（对比接口中增益最大）；在所有 Cosmos 与 WAN 骨干上均提升物理得分；仅增 0.45% 参数让 Cosmos 3 Nano 16B 超越已发布的 Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs 42.7)。WorldModelBench 上四骨干的物理遵循度与总分均提升。PRS 在四骨干上无需完整视频外部打分即提升 I2V 5.6-15.9%。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持一个更普遍的原则：动力学预测应作为与视频表征共同演化的显式模型状态存在。Physical Registry 以极小开销实现了这一原则，显著提升了视频生成的物理合理性与可控性。

title: Testing Central Structure for Complex Networks
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Chaos, Solitons & Fractals
summary: Centrality measures rank nodes even when the observed differences can be explained by ordinary structural variation. We therefore study a preceding question: whether a network contains a statistically identifiable central structure at all. We formulate this question as a network-level hypothesis testing issue using the adjacency spectral radius as the test statistic and estimate an empirical p-value from randomized networks generated under a specified null model. The framework is evaluated using G(N,M), Chung-Lu, and two implementations of the configuration model on simulated benchmarks and 55 real networks. Controlled experiments further vary the number and connection weights of designated central nodes while holding network size and density fixed. The results show a clear negative association between central-structure strength and the empirical p-value. They also demonstrate that rejection decisions depend substantially on the structural properties preserved by the null model: the detected network sets are not simply nested across models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于邻接谱半径的假设检验框架，用于判断网络是否存在统计上可识别的中心结构，并通过多种零模型在模拟和真实网络上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有中心性度量会对节点进行排序，即使观察到的差异可由普通结构变异解释。因此需要先回答网络是否包含统计上可识别的中心结构这一前置问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为网络层面的假设检验，使用邻接谱半径作为检验统计量，从指定零模型生成的随机网络中估计经验p值。采用G(N,M)、Chung-Lu模型及两种配置模型实现作为零模型，在模拟基准和55个真实网络上评估。通过控制实验改变指定中心节点的数量和连接权重，同时固定网络规模和密度。
AI.result: 结果显示中心结构强度与经验p值之间存在明显的负相关。同时表明拒绝决策显著依赖于零模型保留的结构属性：不同模型检测到的网络集合并非简单嵌套关系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效检测网络层面的中心结构，但零模型的选择至关重要，不同零模型保留的结构特性会导致不同的检测结果，提示在实际应用中需根据研究问题选择合适的零模型。

title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LatentRemedy 方法，通过少量任务条件潜在 token 解决多智能体系统中非前缀 KV 缓存复用在冲突任务下的性能大幅下降问题，实现了在保持低 TTFT 的同时优于现有复用基线。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中智能体共享相同上下文块，非前缀 KV 缓存复用虽能提升推理效率，但当智能体任务冲突时，直接复用会导致模型性能下降高达 90%。现有补救措施（选择性重计算、偏移校准）仅能恢复有限损失。作者认为问题不仅在于被污染的 KV 表示，还在于目标智能体难以在自身指令下解读复用的上下文。
AI.method: LatentRemedy 使用一个 MLP 将目标前缀的最后一层隐藏状态映射为少量任务条件潜在 token，将其放置在复用的 KV 块之后与共享上下文交互。通过全预填充蒸馏训练该 MLP，引导后续预测朝向目标任务，无需重新计算共享块。
AI.result: 实验表明，LatentRemedy 在冲突任务上持续优于现有复用基线，且随着缓存规模增长，其 TTFT（首 token 生成时间）保持接近直接复用的水平。
AI.conclusion: LatentRemedy 通过轻量级潜在 token 有效缓解了非前缀 KV 缓存复用在任务冲突场景下的性能损失，兼顾了推理效率与模型性能，为多智能体系统的高效推理提供了实用方案。

title: RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
summary: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.

AI.tldr: RetroPlanner是一个基于LLM的逆合成规划器，通过联合比较多条路线并结合化学证据推理，在保持高成功率的同时提高路线质量并恢复更多替代路线。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的逆合成规划器将过程建模为AND-OR图上的序贯决策，每轮仅扩展单一分子，且仅针对可解性优化，未在搜索预算投入前跨多个实际目标（反应合理性、往返一致性、起始原料价格）比较替代路线，导致实际合成实用性不足。
AI.method: RetroPlanner通过联合比较多条路线引导搜索，利用化学证据推理：目标分子的结构进展、键变化和反应类别、候选路线的分歧点、以及多目标下的排名。在AND-OR图上进行多路线联合推理和优化。
AI.result: 在多步逆合成基准测试中，RetroPlanner比先前的基于LLM的规划器恢复更多替代路线，同时提高合成路线质量并保持高成功率。
AI.conclusion: RetroPlanner通过多目标联合比较和化学证据推理，有效解决了现有LLM规划器忽视实际合成实用性的问题，实现了更高质量的逆合成路线规划。

title: Drift, Then Spread: Learning One-Step Generative Policies for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Generative policies offer expressive action distributions for online reinforcement learning (RL), but many diffusion- and flow-based policies require costly iterative sampling. We propose DriftSpread, a one-step generative policy based on Drifting for online maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) RL. To incorporate entropy without a tractable policy density, we build on an energy-based view of Drifting and derive critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread from the negative MaxEnt objective. Our method learns these updates sequentially in the same actor, using action regression for value improvement and distribution matching to capture the effect of entropy. The actor updates require neither direct samples from the critic-defined Boltzmann target nor policy-density or score estimation. Under exact fitting with a fixed critic, we prove convergence to the Boltzmann target in the small-step limit followed by the long-time limit. On MuJoCo, DriftSpread achieves the highest aggregate normalized return among all evaluated methods, while outperforming the diffusion- and flow-based baselines in both training and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DriftSpread，一种基于 Drifting 的单步生成策略，用于在线最大熵强化学习。它通过能量视角推导出评论家引导的 Drift 和熵诱导的 Spread，无需策略密度或分数估计，实现了高效的单步采样，在 MuJoCo 基准上达到最高聚合归一化回报，且训练和推理效率优于扩散和流基方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式策略能提供表达力强的动作分布，但现有的扩散和流模型需要昂贵的迭代采样，限制了在线 RL 的效率。需要一种单步生成策略，既能保持最大熵目标的探索性能，又能避免迭代采样和策略密度估计的开销。
AI.method: 基于 Drifting 的能量视角，从负最大熵目标推导出两个更新：评论家引导的 Drift（用于价值改进）和熵诱导的 Spread（用于捕捉熵效应）。两者在同一演员中顺序学习：动作回归实现价值改进，分布匹配捕捉熵效应。更新既不需要从评论家定义的玻尔兹曼目标直接采样，也不需要策略密度或分数估计。理论上证明在精确拟合和固定评论家下，小步极限后的长时间极限收敛到玻尔兹曼目标。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，DriftSpread 实现了所有评估方法中最高的聚合归一化回报，同时在训练和推理效率上均显著优于扩散和流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DriftSpread 通过单步生成策略有效解决了最大熵 RL 中生成式策略的采样效率问题，无需策略密度估计即可融合熵正则化，理论收敛性得到保证，实验验证了其在性能和效率上的优势。

title: Machine--human agreement in marking undergraduate assignments is specific to model, prompt and institution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) promise to automate one of higher education's most resource-intensive activities: assessing student writing. Existing evaluations are typically limited to a single model, a single prompt and a single institution. Using 761 undergraduate psychology assignments from three UK universities, we evaluated three frontier LLMs, individually and in ensemble, on accuracy, prompt sensitivity, error independence, generalisability and evidential basis. Agreement between human and machine marks varied widely, with no model or prompt optimal across institutions. All models compressed marks towards a common central tendency, overvaluing the weakest assignments and undervaluing the strongest. Because this error was shared, ensembling failed to remove it. Machine marks also rewarded linguistic features more strongly than human marks. Since human-machine agreement was a joint product of model, prompt and institution, we conclude that current LLMs lack evaluative capacity transferable across contexts, and that single-context validation overstates readiness for deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文使用来自三所英国大学的761份本科心理学作业，评估了三个前沿大语言模型（LLM）单独及集成情况下的评分能力，发现人机评分一致性差异巨大，所有模型均将分数压缩向中心趋势，集成无法消除这一共享误差，且机器评分比人类更看重语言特征，结论是当前LLM缺乏跨情境可迁移的评价能力，单一情境验证高估了部署就绪度。
AI.motivation: 高等教育中评估学生写作是极其消耗资源的活动，LLM有望实现自动化。但现有评估通常局限于单一模型、单一提示词和单一机构，缺乏跨情境的系统性验证。
AI.method: 收集三所英国大学的761份本科心理学作业，评估三个前沿LLM单独及集成时的表现，考察维度包括准确性、提示词敏感性、误差独立性、泛化能力和证据依据。
AI.result: 人机评分一致性差异极大，无模型或提示词在跨机构中均最优；所有模型均将分数压缩向共同中心趋势（高估弱作业、低估强作业），因误差为共享特性，集成无法消除；机器评分对语言特征的奖励权重显著高于人类评分。
AI.conclusion: 人机一致性是模型、提示词与机构共同作用的产物，当前LLM缺乏可跨情境迁移的评价能力，单一情境的验证会高估其部署就绪度。

title: Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures. Code: to be released
summary: We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage points. Ablations identify recursive inheritance and dependency composition as important contributors to increased difficulty. Together, these results support environment scaling for both agent evaluation and training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归环境缩放(RES)框架，通过在保持核心任务目标不变的前提下递归修改环境的信息访问、资源关系和执行依赖，系统性地提升智能体基准测试难度。实验表明RES显著降低了所有评估模型的任务成功率(57-77个百分点)，且在相同轨迹数和优化设置下，基于RES轨迹微调在所有9个模型-基准对比中均比原始轨迹SFT高出7-14.61个百分点，证明环境缩放对智能体评估和训练均有效。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试难度固定，难以系统性地评估和提升模型在更复杂环境下的泛化能力。需要一种方法在保持任务核心目标不变的情况下，可控地增加环境复杂度，以支持更具挑战性的评估和更有效的训练数据生成。
AI.method: RES框架包含三个核心组件：(1)提议器(proposer)修改环境的信息访问权限、资源关系和执行依赖；(2)基于执行的检查机制验证候选环境的有效性；(3)递归继承机制将通过验证的变更跨轮次累积。这产生成对的关联环境，用于配对评估和训练轨迹收集。
AI.result: 在来自三个基准的294个初始任务上，所有六个评估模型的任务成功率均下降，Claw-Eval-Live上下降57.14-77.14个百分点。在相等轨迹数和相同优化设置下，RES轨迹微调在所有九个模型-基准对比中均优于原始轨迹SFT，提升7.00-14.61个百分点。消融实验表明递归继承和依赖组合是增加难度的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 环境缩放是一种有效的智能体评估和训练范式。RES通过递归修改环境结构而非任务目标，系统性地构建了难度梯度，既能作为更严格的评估基准，又能生成高质量训练数据提升模型在复杂环境下的表现。递归继承和依赖组合是难度提升的主要驱动因素。

title: DRanker: A Transformer-Based Multi-Task Ranking Model for the Disney+ Homepage
summary: We present DRanker (Disney+ Ranker), a transformer-based multitask ranking model serving personalized recommendations on the Disney+ homepage. We describe the encoder-only architecture over enriched engagement-history sequences paired with a lightweight causal debiasing mechanism, and the inference stack that enables transformer-based ranking at scale. Through iterative development, we systematically evaluated more complex alternatives and found that simpler designs consistently outperformed them on offline metrics, qualitative behavioral evaluation, and in production. Deployed globally, DRanker drives over 1% lift in our key engagement metric and 0.5% lift in daily active users across all experiences powered by the ranker. We share practical lessons on data engineering, debiasing, and architectural choices that shaped our ranking system at scale.

AI.tldr: Disney+ 推出基于 Transformer 的多任务排序模型 DRanker，用于首页个性化推荐。采用编码器架构处理丰富的用户交互历史序列，配合轻量级因果去偏机制，实现大规模 Transformer 推理。实验表明更简单的设计在离线指标、行为评估和线上表现上均优于复杂方案。全球部署后，关键参与度指标提升 1% 以上，日活用户提升 0.5%。
AI.motivation: Disney+ 需要在首页为全球用户提供大规模、低延迟的个性化推荐。现有方案难以在捕捉长序列用户行为、处理位置偏差以及满足毫秒级推理延迟之间取得平衡。团队旨在构建一个既能利用 Transformer 强大的序列建模能力，又能在生产环境高效服务的排序系统。
AI.method: 采用编码器 Transformer 架构，输入为丰富的用户交互历史序列（包含观看、点击、停留等多模态信号）；引入轻量级因果去偏机制校正位置偏差和选择偏差；设计高效推理栈（模型蒸馏、量化、KV 缓存优化等）实现大规模部署；通过系统性消融实验对比复杂方案（如双塔、多头注意力变体、更深层网络），验证简化设计的有效性。
AI.result: 离线指标（NDCG、Recall）、定性行为评估（会话多样性、长尾内容曝光）和线上 A/B 测试均显示：简化的编码器架构 + 轻量去偏持续优于复杂替代方案。全球上线后，核心参与度指标提升 >1%，日活用户 (DAU) 提升 0.5%，覆盖所有由排序器驱动的体验入口。
AI.conclusion: 在工业级推荐排序中，简单、可解释且工程友好的 Transformer 设计优于追求模型复杂度的方案。关键成功因素包括：高质量的序列特征工程、因果去偏的必要性、推理栈的深度优化，以及持续的离线-在线指标对齐验证。这些经验可迁移至其他大规模个性化排序场景。

title: A Benchmark for Bangla Task-Oriented Dialogue Understanding
summary: Task-oriented dialogue understanding remains underexplored for Bangla, particularly in multilingual settings involving English and romanized Bangla (Banglish). We introduce BanglaTOD, a parallel tri-lingual benchmark comprising 209 multi-turn dialogues across nine Bangladesh-specific service domains and 64 intents. Each conversational turn is aligned across Bangla, English, and Banglish, yielding 4,689 language-specific turn records annotated with intents, token-level slots, state updates, and accumulated dialogue states. We establish context-aware baselines for joint intent classification and slot filling using mBERT, BERT-base-uncased, and BanglaBERT. Cross-language analysis reveals substantial performance differences across models and linguistic representations, while removing dialogue history reduces intent accuracy by 19.0--25.7 percentage points. BanglaTOD provides a foundation for multilingual dialogue understanding and future dialogue state tracking research in Bangladesh-specific conversational applications. The dataset is publicly available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/afri7here/BanglaTOD}{Hugging Face}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BanglaTOD，一个面向孟加拉语、英语和罗马化孟加拉语的平行三语任务型对话基准，包含 209 个多轮对话、9 个孟加拉特定服务领域、64 个意图、4,689 条标注轮次，并在 mBERT、BERT-base-uncased、BanglaBERT 上建立联合意图分类与槽位填充基线，揭示跨语言性能差异与上下文历史的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话理解在孟加拉语场景下研究不足，尤其是涉及英语和罗马化孟加拉语的多语言环境；现有资源缺乏针对孟加拉本地服务领域的平行多语言标注数据，阻碍了多语言对话状态跟踪及下游应用的发展。
AI.method: 构建 BanglaTOD 平行三语语料：收集 209 个多轮对话，覆盖 9 个孟加拉本地服务领域和 64 个意图；每轮对话在孟加拉语、英语、Banglish 三语对齐，标注意图、token 级槽位、状态更新及累积对话状态，共 4,689 条记录。采用 mBERT、BERT-base-uncased、BanglaBERT 作为编码器，结合上下文历史进行联合意图分类与槽位填充实验，并对比移除历史后的性能变化。
AI.result: 三种模型在三语上的联合任务表现存在显著差距；跨语言分析显示语言表征对性能影响巨大。去除对话历史导致意图准确率下降 19.0–25.7 个百分点，证明上下文感知建模至关重要。数据集已在 Hugging Face 开源。
AI.conclusion: BanglaTOD 为孟加拉语多语言任务型对话理解提供了首个平行三语基准，填补了本地化服务领域数据空白；实验证实上下文历史对意图识别的关键作用，并为后续对话状态跟踪及多语言对话系统研究奠定基础。

title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
summary: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iteratively modify a persistent codebase, while a multimodal web agent tests each intermediate application in a live browser, assessing newly requested functionality, cross-request integration, and previously requested functionality. To characterize reliability throughout development, we integrate trajectory performance across user-tolerance thresholds rather than impose a fixed stopping criterion. Experiments across open- and closed-source frontier models show that EvoWeb reveals clear performance differences between models, with cross-request integration emerging as a key challenge. Further analysis shows that later requests with deeper or more numerous dependencies are solved less accurately, while runtime errors become more frequent over successive requests. EvoWeb provides a testbed for evaluating and improving coding agents in long-horizon, multi-request development.

AI.tldr: EvoWeb 是一个用于评估编码代理在长周期、多请求 Web 应用开发中表现的新基准，包含 32 个 Web 应用的 320 个累积请求，基于真实产品特性并由功能依赖图结构化。代理迭代修改持久化代码库，多模态 Web 代理在实时浏览器中测试每个中间应用，评估新功能、跨请求集成和先前功能。通过跨用户容忍阈值整合轨迹性能来表征开发全过程的可靠性。实验显示模型间存在明显性能差异，跨请求集成是关键挑战；依赖更深或更多的后期请求解决准确率更低，运行时错误随请求累积而增加。
AI.motivation: 现有 Web 生成基准主要评估面向固定规格的开发，而实际 Web 应用开发通常通过连续请求扩展现有实现。需要一个能反映真实开发过程、包含功能依赖、支持持久化代码库迭代修改、并能在实时浏览器中评估中间应用的基准，以评估编码代理在长周期、多请求开发中的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建 EvoWeb 基准：32 个 Web 应用，320 个累积请求，基于真实产品特性，按功能依赖图结构化。代理迭代修改持久化代码库；多模态 Web 代理在实时浏览器中测试每个中间应用，评估新请求功能、跨请求集成和先前功能。引入轨迹性能指标，跨用户容忍阈值整合性能而非固定停止标准。在开源和闭源前沿模型上实验。
AI.result: EvoWeb 揭示了模型间明显的性能差异，跨请求集成成为关键挑战。后期请求因依赖更深或更多而解决准确率更低；运行时错误随连续请求累积而更频繁。基准有效区分了模型在长周期、多请求开发中的能力。
AI.conclusion: EvoWeb 为评估和改进编码代理在长周期、多请求 Web 开发中的表现提供了测试平台，突显了跨请求集成和依赖管理的难点，推动了更真实的代理开发评估。

title: TabMosaic: Unified In-Context Diffusion for Tabular Generative Tasks
summary: Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes. Despite recent advances, existing approaches either require table-specific training or restrict in-context learning to single-cell prediction. In this work, we formulate these tabular generative tasks as a single problem: modeling the joint conditional distribution of an arbitrary set of target cells given the observed cells of an unseen table. To this end, we turn to diffusion, whose denoising objective is defined jointly over all target cells rather than one cell at a time. Under the pretraining distribution, this objective is minimized by the posterior predictive distribution over the target set. Building on this, we propose TabMosaic, a unified in-context diffusion model for generating mixed-type target cells in unseen, potentially incomplete tables without table-specific training. We further show that its pretraining objective bounds the conditional negative log-likelihood and the divergence from the posterior predictive for arbitrary target sets, extending the Bayesian account of in-context learning from a single-value prediction to joint multi-cell generation. Across 48 real-world tables, TabMosaic ranks first on all evaluated generative tasks against 20 baseline approaches

AI.tldr: 本文提出TabMosaic，一种统一的上下文学习扩散模型，用于在无需针对特定表格训练的情况下，生成未见过的、可能不完整的表格中的混合类型目标单元格。该模型将表格生成任务建模为给定观测单元格条件下任意目标单元格集合的联合条件分布建模问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的表格生成方法要么需要针对特定表格进行训练，要么将上下文学习限制在单单元格预测上。本文旨在将各种表格生成任务（合成真实记录、恢复缺失值、条件生成等）统一为单一问题：建模任意目标单元格集合给定观测单元格的联合条件分布。
AI.method: 采用扩散模型，其去噪目标联合定义在所有目标单元格上而非逐个单元格。在预训练分布下，该目标由目标集合上的后验预测分布最小化。提出TabMosaic，一种统一的上下文扩散模型，用于生成未见过的、可能不完整表格中的混合类型目标单元格，无需针对特定表格训练。
AI.result: 在48个真实世界表格上，TabMosaic在所有评估的生成任务中对比20种基线方法均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 预训练目标对任意目标集合的条件负对数似然和与后验预测分布的差异给出了界，将上下文学习的贝叶斯解释从单值预测扩展到了联合多单元格生成。

title: From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Strong individual agents do not guarantee effective collaboration. Communication must align what one agent conveys with how another interprets and uses it. This dependency makes the communication edge a natural unit of optimization. We introduce Paired Automated Communication Optimization (PACO), which jointly optimizes the instructions at both ends of each edge and their shared communication convention in systems built on black-box language models. PACO keeps model weights, agent roles, and workflow topology fixed. A state-aware discounted bandit selects edges for refinement, while execution feedback guides paired revisions evaluated through staged end-to-end execution. The optimized instructions integrate into existing agent prompts without additional model calls at deployment. On a four-agent workflow evaluated across diverse multi-agent benchmarks, PACO consistently outperforms leading prompt-optimization and communication baselines. Configurations learned on HotpotQA retain their advantage in cross-dataset transfer without target-specific optimization. These results demonstrate that optimizing how agents communicate can substantially improve collaboration within an otherwise fixed system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACO（成对自动化通信优化），通过联合优化多智能体系统中通信边两端的指令及共享通信约定，在不改变模型权重、角色和拓扑的情况下显著提升协作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统中，强个体智能体不一定能有效协作；通信需要对齐发送者传达内容与接收者的理解和使用方式，这种依赖使得通信边成为自然的优化单元。
AI.method: PACO保持模型权重、智能体角色和工作流拓扑固定，采用状态感知折扣老虎机选择待优化的边，利用执行反馈指导成对修订，通过分阶段端到端执行评估；优化后的指令集成到现有提示词中，部署时无需额外模型调用。
AI.result: 在四智能体工作流上跨多个多智能体基准测试，PACO持续优于现有提示词优化和通信基线；在HotpotQA上学到的配置在跨数据集迁移中保持优势，无需目标特定优化。
AI.conclusion: 优化智能体间的通信方式能在其他方面固定的系统中大幅提升协作效果。

title: SLS-Bench: A Benchmark for Incident Log Summarization with Synthetic Observability Data
summary: As IT systems grow in complexity, automated agent-driven incident response becomes increasingly critical. A key capability for these agents is summarizing large log streams into human-readable reports. Further progress requires meaningfully evaluating this function, yet existing benchmarks leave end-to-end summarization from large log streams underexplored due to the prohibitive cost and complexity of collecting real-world data. We introduce SLS-Bench, a benchmark for incident log summarization featuring 90 tasks grounded in real-world incident reports, each with a synthetic log stream and a reference summary. To construct SLS-Bench, we developed a data generation pipeline that converts incident reports into structured incident models, which guide the generation of synthetic logs and reference summaries. This pipeline combines narrative grounding, explicit incident modeling, generator-verifier loops, and statistical comparisons with real-world log streams to produce realistic and controllable observability data.
