However, verifiable outcome rewards provide an imperfect measure of reasoning quality: a correct final answer may not be supported by the reasoning trace, whereas an incorrect rollout may contain a nearly correct reasoning trajectory. We present empirical evidence for this mismatch and hypothesize that the resulting reward noise contributes to instability in reinforcement learning for both reasoning accuracy and token efficiency. To address this credit assignment challenge, this paper proposes double-rollout reinforcement learning. For each sampled rollout, we truncate its reasoning trace, sample multiple continuations from the truncated prefix, and replace the original reward with the mean continuation reward, yielding a more robust estimate of reasoning quality. This double-rollout algorithm incurs only a moderate increase in compute cost and yet reaches substantially higher accuracies across math and coding tasks and across Qwen and Nemotron models than baseline algorithms with fewer RL steps. For example, using only DAPO data it trains Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B to reach 95.4% on AIME 2026, versus 91.5% by GRPO and substantially above state of the art for this model size, within 30 RL steps. When combined with length-based rewards, the same algorithm further improves the accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier over existing efficiency optimizations. These findings suggest that the double-rollout reward estimation is an effective and cost-efficient way to improve both the accuracy and token efficiency of reasoning RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双重采样强化学习方法，通过截断推理轨迹并采样多个续写来估计推理质量，有效解决了可验证奖励与推理质量不匹配的问题，在数学和代码任务上显著提升准确率和Token效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）使用GRPO等算法，但最终答案的正确性不能准确反映推理过程的质量：正确答案可能由错误推理得到，错误答案可能包含接近正确的推理轨迹。这种奖励噪声导致推理准确率和Token效率的训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出双重采样强化学习：对每个采样的推理轨迹进行截断，从截断前缀采样多个续写，用平均续写奖励替代原始奖励，从而获得更鲁棒的推理质量估计。该方法仅带来适度的计算开销增加。
AI.result: 在数学和编程任务上，跨Qwen和Nemotron模型，双重采样算法在更少RL步数下达到显著更高准确率。例如，仅用DAPO数据训练Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B，在AIME 2026上达到95.4%，优于GRPO的91.5%，且远超同规模模型SOTA，仅需30个RL步骤。结合基于长度的奖励，进一步改善准确率-效率帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 双重采样奖励估计是一种有效且计算高效的方法，能同时提升推理强化学习的准确性和Token效率。

title: How Shared Representations Become Specialized: Formation, Maintenance, and Latent Susceptibility
summary: When several predictions use the same internal representation, information about some targets can remain easier to recover than information about others. We study how this specialization forms, persists, and changes in minimal artificial learners. With reconstruction errors weighted equally during learning, changing which target is observed precisely selects the favored target and redirects an already specialized learner. Removing current support can reduce a formed bias, whereas state-following update feedback can maintain it. We then compare learners formed through different observation and update conditions but matched on specified reconstruction measurements. Both change under the same brief opposing intervention, yet their responses differ. Resetting Adam largely removes the ten-update difference; exchanging its second moment reverses which route is more susceptible. New interventions show that equalizing the mean second-moment scaling reduces but does not remove the difference: its coordinate-wise pattern also matters. With fresh Adam or calibrated SGD, smaller route differences emerge later, whereas 500 common opposing updates bring the selected allocation endpoints close. A further control produces response differences with identical acquisition and equal mean loss weights but jointly different weight variability and realized sequence. Acquisition-selected formation also extends to a symmetric three-target setting. These interventions distinguish specialization's formation, present support, and time-dependent latent susceptibility.

AI.tldr: 研究在共享内部表示的多任务预测中，专业化如何形成、持续和变化。通过控制观察目标和更新反馈，揭示了Adam优化器的二阶矩对专业化偏差的影响，并展示了干预如何区分形成、当前支持和潜在易感性。
AI.motivation: 探究当多个预测共享同一内部表示时，为何某些目标的信息更易恢复，即专业化的形成机制、持久性及其对干预的响应差异。
AI.method: 使用最小人工学习器，控制重构误差权重、观察目标选择、更新反馈类型（状态跟随等），对比不同观察和更新条件下但重构测量匹配的学习器。干预包括重置Adam、交换二阶矩、均衡二阶矩缩放、使用新鲜Adam或校准SGD、500步共同对抗更新等。
AI.result: 改变观察目标可精确选择偏好目标并重定向已专业化学习器；移除当前支持可减弱偏差，状态跟随反馈可维持。匹配重构测量的学习器在相同简短对抗干预下响应不同。重置Adam基本消除10步更新差异；交换二阶矩反转易感路径。均衡平均二阶矩缩放减少但不消除差异，坐标级模式也重要。新鲜Adam或校准SGD下，路径差异较晚出现，500步共同对抗更新使端点接近。相同获取和均等平均损失权重但不同权重变异性和实现序列也产生响应差异。获取选择的形成扩展到对称三目标设置。
AI.conclusion: 这些干预实验区分了专业化的形成、当前支持和时间依赖的潜在易感性，揭示了优化器动态（特别是Adam的二阶矩）在多任务共享表示专业化中的关键作用。

title: When 1+1 Backfires: Rethinking Relevance-Diversity Balancing for Sample-Aware Visual Token Reduction
summary: Visual token compression has emerged as a critical technique for reducing the inference cost of Vision-Language Models. Existing methods select tokens based on text relevance, visual diversity, or a fixed combination of both---treating the relevance-diversity balance as a universal constant independent of the input. We conduct a systematic analysis to challenge this assumption. At the dataset level, grid-searching the optimal relevance-diversity weight per benchmark reveals substantial cross-task variation. More critically, we further maximize per-sample answer likelihood to recover sample-level oracle weights, finding that their distributions not only differ markedly across benchmarks but also exhibit high within-benchmark variance. Based on these observations, we propose SAVER, a framework for Sample-Aware relevance-diversity balanced Visual tokEn Reduction. We first derive a Geometric Intent Prior (GIP) from the spatial concentration of text-relevant tokens to infer a sample-specific relevance-diversity weight, and then apply this weight to jointly select tokens via a Weighted Text Centroid (WTC) for relevance scoring and a Visual Marginal Coverage Gain (VMCG) for diversity. SAVER requires no additional training and achieves sample-aware balancing entirely at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAVER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks, retaining 96.5% of full-model performance on LLaVA-1.5-7B with only 11.1% of the original visual tokens, and further generalizing to LLaVA-NeXT and Mini-Gemini.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAVER，一种无需训练的样本感知视觉标记压缩框架，通过从文本相关标记的空间聚类推导几何意图先验 (GIP) 动态平衡相关性与多样性，在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上仅保留 11.1% 视觉标记即可维持 96.5% 性能，并泛化至 LLaVA-NeXT 与 Mini-Gemini。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉标记压缩方法将相关性-多样性权衡视为固定超参数，但作者在数据集级与样本级的系统分析发现：最优权重在不同基准间差异巨大，且单一基准内样本级方差极高，因此亟需一种能在推理时自适应确定样本特定权重的机制。
AI.method: SAVER 分两步：(1) 根据文本相关标记的空间聚类程度计算几何意图先验 (GIP)，推断样本专属的相关性-多样性权重；(2) 以此权重融合加权文本质心 (WTC) 相关性打分与视觉边际覆盖增益 (VMCG) 多样性打分，联合选取标记。全过程无需额外训练，仅在推理时完成。
AI.result: 在多个基准上 SAVER 均超越 SOTA 基线：LLaVA-1.5-7B 保留 96.5% 满模型性能且仅用 11.1% 标记；亦在 LLaVA-NeXT 与 Mini-Gemini 上展现一致增益，验证了样本感知动态平衡的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 相关性-多样性权衡不应为全局常数，而应随样本动态调整。SAVER 通过几何意图先验实现零训练、推理时的样本自适应平衡，为高效视觉-语言模型部署提供了实用且强健的解决方案。

title: LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LVRL（LLM Value Function RL）和 LVOPD（LLM Value Function On-Policy Distillation），利用预训练 LLM 作为冻结价值函数，通过上下文条件化和校准实现无需额外 Critic 微调的步级信用分配，在长时程稀疏奖励任务中显著优于 GRPO 和 PPO，并在多个智能体基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 针对大语言模型智能体在长时程、稀疏结果奖励任务中面临的信用分配难题：现有方法如 GRPO 将同一轨迹优势赋予所有动作，忽略步级差异；基于 Critic 的方法需额外学习价值函数，成本高且不稳定。需要一种无需微调额外 Critic、能利用 LLM 预训练知识和上下文学习能力实现策略感知步级价值估计的方法。
AI.method: LVRL：将预训练 LLM 冻结作为价值模型，输入包含群组上下文（组内轨迹）的状态，利用已知的初始/终止状态价值进行校准，通过估计价值差实现步级信用分配。LVOPD：扩展至专家策略的在线蒸馏，仅对估计价值下降的动作施加教师监督，聚焦于关键决策点。两者均无需微调价值网络，仅依赖 LLM 的上下文推理能力。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、BabyAI、SWE-bench Verified 三个基准上，跨 4B–32B 策略规模，LVRL 持续大幅超越 GRPO 和 PPO。AppWorld 绝对提升达 13.6 个百分点，SWE-bench Verified 提升 8.6 个百分点；BabyAI 从完全失败跃升至 75.0% 成功率。LVOPD 在 AppWorld 上优于标准蒸馏基线。蒙特卡洛分析证实冻结 Critic 能准确识别语义陷阱与恢复，验证了稀疏终止奖励下的鲁棒步级信用提取。
AI.conclusion: LVRL 证明了冻结的预训练 LLM 经适当条件化和校准后可作为高效、策略感知的价值函数，解决长时程稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题，避免了额外 Critic 训练的开销与不稳定性。LVOPD 进一步展示了该价值估计在专家蒸馏中的有效性。该范式为 LLM 智能体强化学习提供了轻量且强泛化的新范式。

title: Prompt or Policy? Optimizing Physician Slate Presentations with LLM User Simulators
summary: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“幻灯片呈现优化”任务，旨在为患者医疗案例和固定排名的医生列表生成简短、案例特定的摘要，以便患者更易比较医生。采用离线框架，利用人设条件LLM模拟患者选择，并从医疗案例属性生成患者人设，评估摘要的事实准确性、相关性、自然度和模拟患者选择。比较了提示级优化（GEPA）、参数级优化（GRPO）及其组合，发现GRPO在满足所有约束方面显著优于GEPA，且增益在未见裁判下持久；GEPA单独改进较小，但用其优化提示初始化GRPO可加速训练并达到最高模拟转化率。结论：提示级和参数级优化在改进医生推荐呈现中互补。
AI.motivation: 患者选择合适医生是关键挑战，现有医生推荐系统虽提供排名列表，但患者仍难比较医生档案。需要生成案例特定的简短摘要，使医生更易比较，同时保持基于档案信息的事实性。
AI.method: 1. 制定幻灯片呈现优化任务：输入患者医疗案例和固定排名医生列表，输出短小、案例特定的医生摘要。2. 离线评估框架：从医疗案例提取属性生成患者人设，用人设条件LLM模拟患者选择。评估指标包括事实准确性、相关性、自然度、模拟患者选择。3. 引入第二个未见过的LLM裁判评估模拟器特定过拟合。4. 对比三种优化方法：提示级优化（GEPA）、参数级优化（GRPO）、两者结合（GEPA优化提示初始化GRPO），在两种模型规模上实验。
AI.result: GRPO在满足所有约束（事实准确性、相关性、自然度、模拟选择）上显著优于GEPA，且模拟转化率增益在未见裁判下持久。GEPA单独带来较小改进，但用其优化提示初始化GRPO可加速训练并达到最高模拟转化率。提示级和参数级优化互补。
AI.conclusion: 提示级优化（GEPA）和参数级优化（GRPO）在改进医生推荐呈现中发挥互补作用：GEPA提供良好初始化，GRPO通过参数更新实现更强约束满足和持久泛化。结合两者可获得最佳性能。}

title: Weak Segmentation-Guided GAN for~Realistic Color Edition
summary: Editing the color of images in a realistic way finds many applications such as changing the perception of an image, data augmentation or film post processing. The design of an automatic tool is a complex and long addressed challenge. In particular, two properties are difficult to meet altogether: generating realistic results without artifacts and the possibility to precisely choose the future color. Conventional methods using segmentation and histogram matching maximize the controllability but also introduce a lack of realism or are complex to automate. On the contrary, GANs that specialize in realism are difficult to control. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel GAN architecture leveraging any differentiable segmentation model. We demonstrate the genericness of our framework that presents state of the art results on different use cases. It generates images that look realistic while offering a precise color control.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合可微分分割模型的新型GAN架构，实现真实感图像着色且具备精确颜色控制。
AI.motivation: 解决图像着色中真实感与可控性难以兼得的问题：传统方法（分割+直方图匹配）可控但不真实或难自动化；GAN虽真实但难控制。
AI.method: 设计一种利用任意可微分分割模型的新型GAN架构，将分割引入生成过程，实现端到端的精确颜色控制与真实感生成。
AI.result: 在多种用例上达到最先进水平，生成图像兼具真实感与精确颜色控制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通用性强，有效平衡了真实感与可控性，为自动图像着色提供了新范式。

title: What Do Sparse Autoencoder Feature Discovery Scores Identify? From Activations to Interventions
summary: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. Attribution-selected sets also produce larger absolute mean ablation effects on held-out prompts than sets selected by correlation, rank tests or probe coefficients. Together, these results establish intervention attribution as a principled, gradient-estimable target for selecting SAE features for intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在干预（如引导、消融）中的归因问题。作者定义了'干预归因'作为一阶效应估计量，证明观察性特征发现无法识别该归因，并推导了线性探针预测与干预归因间差距的精确梯度分解。实验表明：探针-归因幅度比率达数十到数百倍；梯度预测在单潜变量消融中符号匹配率91-97%，远高于探针隐含变化的17-35%；基于归因选择的特征集在保留提示上产生更大的绝对平均消融效应。确立了干预归因作为SAE特征干预选择的原则性、可梯度估计的目标。
AI.motivation: SAE特征通常通过观察性激活与行为的协变来发现，但实际应用中常用于干预（引导、消融）。观察性发现的特征不一定适合干预，因为观察性相关性不等于因果干预效应。需要一个原则性的目标来选择适合干预的SAE特征。
AI.method: 1. 定义干预归因为指定干预对模型输出的一阶效应估计量。2. 对广泛的响应函数类，证明观察性特征发现证据一般不识别该归因。3. 推导线性探针预测与干预归因间差距的精确梯度分解。4. 在四个模型-SAE对上实证验证：比较探针-归因幅度比率、小步引导跟踪、单潜变量消融符号匹配率、不同选择方法（归因、相关性、秩检验、探针系数）在保留提示上的消融效应。
AI.result: 1. 中位探针-归因幅度比率从数十到数百不等。2. 归因紧密跟踪小步引导。3. 非零效应的单潜变量消融中，梯度预测符号匹配率91-97%，探针隐含变化仅17-35%。4. 归因选择的特征集在保留提示上产生更大的绝对平均消融效应，优于相关性、秩检验、探针系数选择。
AI.conclusion: 干预归因是一个原则性的、可通过梯度估计的目标，适用于选择用于干预的SAE特征。观察性探针系数严重高估干预效应，梯度归因提供更准确的干预效应预测和特征选择依据。

title: Probing the Geometry of Color Representations in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Do multilingual language models learn a universal internal geometry for color, and is it perceptually grounded or primarily linguistic? We decompose color representations into two geometric axes: (P1) alignment to perceptual color space, and (P2) cross-lingual symmetry. Analyzing layerwise embeddings across models and multilingual datasets, we find that perceptual grounding is weak: alignment to CIE-LAB peaks in intermediate layers, then collapses toward output layers. Cross-lingual symmetry degrades with depth, suggesting later layers encode language-specific structure. Functionally, we show that geometric properties predict task performance: models achieve 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where P1 alignment peaks, with P1 alignment (r=0.70) significantly correlating with downstream capabilities. Our results reveal a dissociation: text-only LMs learn universal color-language geometry, not universal color-perception geometry, providing diagnostics for where perceptual structure is preserved in language models.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究多语言语言模型内部是否学习到通用的颜色几何结构，以及这种结构是感知基础还是语言基础。通过分解颜色表示为感知对齐（P1）和跨语言对称性（P2）两个几何轴，研究发现：感知基础较弱，CIE-LAB 对齐在中间层峰值后在输出层崩塌；跨语言对称性随深度下降，后期层编码语言特定结构。几何属性能预测任务表现：P1 对齐峰值层达 96.7% 颜色分类准确率，P1 与下游能力相关 r=0.70。结论：纯文本 LM 学习的是通用色彩-语言几何，而非通用色彩-感知几何，为定位感知结构在模型中保留位置提供诊断依据。
AI.motivation: 理解多语言语言模型内部对颜色的表征是否形成通用的几何结构，以及这种结构是建立在感知基础（如 CIE-LAB 色彩空间）还是语言基础（跨语言一致性）之上，以揭示纯文本模型获取感知知识的机制与局限。
AI.method: 将颜色表示分解为两个几何轴：P1（与感知色彩空间 CIE-LAB 的对齐度）和 P2（跨语言对称性）。在多个多语言模型和数据集上，逐层分析嵌入向量的几何属性，并关联下游颜色分类任务表现。
AI.result: 感知对齐 P1 在中间层达到峰值，随后在输出层急剧下降；跨语言对称性 P2 随层深加深而降低，表明后期层编码语言特定结构。在 P1 峰值层，颜色分类准确率达 96.7%，P1 与下游任务能力呈显著正相关（r=0.70）。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本大语言模型学习到的是通用的色彩-语言几何结构，而非通用的色彩-感知几何结构。感知结构仅在中间层短暂保留，后期层转向语言特定编码。该几何分解框架可作为诊断工具，定位模型中感知结构保留的层级。

title: LATCH: LLM-Assisted Timing Closure Harness for Post-Route FPGA Optimisation
summary: Post-route FPGA timing closure remains expert-dependent and computationally expensive. We present LATCH (LLM-Assisted Timing Closure Harness), a two-layer framework that separates large language model (LLM) orchestration from deterministic FPGA implementation and evaluation. Across sixteen designs and seven LLMs, a single-iteration study compares three agent control granularities - expert-written recipes, direct EDA operations and LLM-constructed procedures - to ask how much control an agent needs per attempt. Functional-pass rates are 98.2%, 71.4% and 17.9%, respectively; yet direct operations give slightly larger 3.4% median Fmax gains when passing, versus 3.2% for recipes. This exposes a trade-off between execution reliability and timing improvement. Informed by this trade-off, a multi-iteration study fixes the action tier at expert recipes to ask how repeated attempts are best organised, comparing a fitted deterministic heuristic with sequential LLM reasoning, branching exploration and knowledge base-guided exploration within 12 checkpoints per run. Branching raises mean maximum-frequency improvement from 10.5% (sequential) to 16.0%, and the knowledge base to 20.3%, improving 15 of 16 designs. Characterisation across 2,421 recipe attempts profiled their gain and validation rates, showing hard-block re-placement gives the largest cumulative mean gain at 41.4MHz.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了LATCH框架，利用大语言模型辅助FPGA后布线时序收敛，通过两层架构分离LLM编排与确定性FPGA实现评估，实验显示专家配方在多轮迭代中配合知识库引导探索能实现20.3%的平均最大频率提升。
AI.motivation: FPGA后布线时序收敛高度依赖专家经验且计算开销大，现有EDA工具自动化程度有限，需要一种能结合LLM推理能力与确定性FPGA实现流程的框架来提升时序收敛效率和成功率。
AI.method: 提出LATCH两层框架：上层LLM编排层负责决策生成，下层确定性实现评估层执行FPGA流程。单轮研究对比三种控制粒度（专家配方、直接EDA操作、LLM构建程序）；多轮研究固定专家配方动作层，对比确定性启发式、顺序LLM推理、分支探索、知识库引导探索四种策略，每运行12个检查点。
AI.result: 单轮研究：功能通过率分别为98.2%（专家配方）、71.4%（直接操作）、17.9%（LLM程序）；直接操作通过时中位数Fmax增益3.4%略高于配方3.2%。多轮研究：分支探索将平均最大频率提升从10.5%（顺序）提至16.0%，知识库引导探索达20.3%，改善16个设计中的15个。2,421次配方尝试画像显示硬块重放置累积平均增益最大达41.4MHz。
AI.conclusion: LATCH框架揭示了执行可靠性与时序改善的权衡，专家配方提供最高可靠性，配合知识库引导的分支探索策略在多轮迭代中实现最佳时序收敛效果，硬块重放置是贡献最大的优化动作。该框架有效降低了专家依赖并提升了FPGA时序收敛自动化水平。

title: GuidanceNFT: NFT-Based Reward Fine-Tuning of Guided Diffusion Models
summary: DiffusionNFT (NFT) fine-tunes diffusion models toward task-specific rewards, but optimizing these rewards does not guarantee fidelity to the full prompt. Although classifier-free guidance (CFG) strengthens prompt alignment, NFT is formulated as a CFG-free method, and applying CFG to the fine-tuned velocity field can reduce the optimized reward. This motivates optimizing rewards over the guided output distribution while seeking to retain its prompt alignment. However, applying standard NFT directly to guided samples can cause reward degradation or training collapse. We trace this failure to a mismatch between the reference velocity used in the NFT loss and the score of the guided sample distribution, which biases the improvement direction. We propose GuidanceNFT, which estimates the matching reference velocity through online flow matching on guided samples and uses it to correct both regression terms. With an exact reference, the corrected objective recovers NFT's intended update. In our experiments, the learned correction sustains reward improvement under both explicit and built-in guidance. On SD3.5-M, GuidanceNFT achieves higher optimized rewards than NFT with and without CFG across GenEval, text-rendering, and multi-reward objectives, together with better overall prompt alignment as measured by off-domain evaluation metrics. Experiments on models with built-in guidance, including Model Guidance and ELF, further demonstrate improved ImageNet generation, a better perplexity-entropy tradeoff on OpenWebText, and higher accuracy on GSM8K.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GuidanceNFT 方法，解决扩散模型微调中奖励优化与提示词对齐的冲突，通过在线流匹配校正引导采样的参考速度，使 NFT 能在分类器自由引导（CFG）下保持奖励提升并提高提示词保真度。
AI.motivation: DiffusionNFT (NFT) 虽能针对任务奖励微调扩散模型，但优化奖励不保证完整提示词保真度；CFG 虽能增强提示词对齐，但 NFT 设计为无 CFG 方法，直接对微调速度场施加 CFG 会降低优化奖励。需在引导输出分布上优化奖励并保持提示词对齐，但直接将标准 NFT 应用于引导样本会导致奖励退化或训练崩溃，根因是 NFT 损失中的参考速度与引导样本分布的分数不匹配，导致改进方向有偏。
AI.method: 提出 GuidanceNFT：在引导样本上进行在线流匹配估计匹配的参考速度，并用该参考速度校正 NFT 损失中的两个回归项。通过精确的参考速度，修正后的目标恢复了 NFT 预期的更新方向，使奖励优化在显式和内置引导下均能持续改进。
AI.result: 在 SD3.5-M 上，GuidanceNFT 在 GenEval、文本渲染、多奖励目标上均超越有无 CFG 的 NFT，且在域外评估指标上实现更好的整体提示词对齐。在具有内置引导的模型（Model Guidance、ELF）上，进一步提升了 ImageNet 生成质量、OpenWebText 的困惑度-熵权衡以及 GSM8K 准确率。
AI.conclusion: GuidanceNFT 通过在线流匹配校正参考速度，解决了 NFT 在引导采样下的奖励退化问题，实现了奖励优化与提示词对齐的双重提升，适用于显式 CFG 和内置引导模型，显著推进了扩散模型任务特定微调的实用性。

title: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English
summary: Post-training quantisation reduces the memory cost of large language models, but it remains unclear whether compression preserves language skills of regional varieties as reliably as their standard-language counterparts. We study this question for Bavarian, Standard German, and English using BAVGROUND, a multiple-choice benchmark, where 206 source questions are aligned across all three languages. Across 14 open-weight 7B--10B instruction models, we compare BF16 with 8-bit GPTQ and two 4-bit settings, GPTQ and AWQ. Eight-bit GPTQ remains close to BF16 and largely preserves the relative behaviour of the three languages, while 4-bit quantisation was found to be much less stable. The two 4-bit methods reduce average accuracy by about 1.4--1.5 percentage points and change 11.9--16.0% of BF16 decisions, with changes concentrated on examples where the BF16 model is already uncertain. This instability does not translate into a consistent Bavarian disadvantage. Although Bavarian, a low-resource dialect, has lower baseline accuracy than German and English, the language most affected at 4 bits varies across models and quantisation methods. Calibration further shapes these cross-language effects: the relative Bavarian--German effect changes with calibration language, while changing the calibration source has little average effect on GPTQ-4 but can affect AWQ-4 much more strongly. Free-form evaluation on five models further shows that 4-bit compression can degrade generated responses even in settings where multiple-choice accuracy changes only modestly, while 8-bit GPTQ remains comparatively stable. Overall, our results show that quantisation robustness for regional language varieties depends on the model, quantisation method, calibration data, and evaluation setting, and cannot be measured by aggregate multilingual accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究后训练量化对大语言模型中区域语言变体（巴伐利亚语、标准德语、英语）语言技能保持的影响。使用BAVGROUND基准测试14个7B-10B开源指令模型，对比BF16与8-bit GPTQ、4-bit GPTQ和4-bit AWQ。结果显示8-bit GPTQ接近BF16且保持三语言相对表现，而4-bit量化显著降低稳定性，平均准确率下降1.4-1.5个百分点，改变11.9-16.0%的BF16决策，且不稳定性不转化为一致的巴伐利亚语劣势。校准语言和校准源对跨语言效应有显著影响。自由生成评估进一步表明4-bit压缩可能降低生成质量，即使多选准确率变化不大。量化鲁棒性取决于模型、量化方法、校准数据和评估设置，不能仅靠聚合多语言准确率衡量。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化虽能降低大语言模型内存成本，但尚不清楚压缩是否能像标准语言一样可靠地保持区域语言变体的语言技能。现有研究多关注聚合多语言准确率，忽视了低资源方言在量化下的特定表现差异。
AI.method: 构建BAVGROUND基准，包含206道跨巴伐利亚语、标准德语、英语对齐的多选题。选取14个开源7B-10B指令模型，分别在BF16、8-bit GPTQ、4-bit GPTQ、4-bit AWQ四种精度下评测。同时进行自由生成评估（5个模型），并分析校准语言（巴伐利亚语/德语/英语）和校准数据源对量化效果的影响。
AI.result: 8-bit GPTQ性能接近BF16，基本保持三语言相对表现；4-bit量化（GPTQ和AWQ）平均准确率下降1.4-1.5个百分点，改变11.9-16.0%的BF16决策，变化集中在BF16模型不确定的样本上。巴伐利亚语虽基线准确率较低，但4-bit下受影响最严重的语言因模型和量化方法而异，无一致劣势。校准语言改变巴伐利亚语-德语相对效应；校准源对GPTQ-4平均影响小，但对AWQ-4影响显著。自由生成评估显示4-bit压缩可能降低生成质量，即使多选准确率变化不大。
AI.conclusion: 区域语言变体的量化鲁棒性取决于模型、量化方法、校准数据和评估设置，不能仅通过聚合多语言准确率来衡量。8-bit GPTQ相对稳定，而4-bit量化引入显著不稳定性，且其跨语言效应高度依赖于校准策略。实际部署时需针对特定语言变体和任务类型进行细粒度评估。

title: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev
summary: Decision APIs that return a probability for each option are routinely used as if those probabilities were properties of the options themselves. That reading is valid only if the model satisfies independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA): adding an option that is neither the right answer nor its strongest rival should leave the odds between those two unchanged. We test this in a pre-registered study of jev-1.13.0, a hosted decision model, using 299,463 calls on intent classification (BANKING77, CLINC150) and topic classification (AG News). Every added option moves the log-odds between the gold label and the strongest wrong label: the root-mean-square systematic shift is 0.20-0.52 nats, 1.2 to 3 times the run-to-run variation, even when the added option takes at most 0.1% of the probability mass. The shifts are directional. An option similar to the wrong answer draws probability from it (+0.10 nats toward the gold label). A paraphrase of the wrong answer produces an intermediate pattern: the gold label's probability is almost conserved, but the paraphrase receives only about a third of the wrong answer's share rather than the half that strict substitution implies. The distortion grows steadily with the logarithm of the number of options, reaching about 1 nat at 255 options, and off-domain padding pushes the odds against the gold label. In contrast, questions packed into one call do not interact (bias < 0.001). Scoring each option with an independent yes/no question removes the option-set dependence but picks the right answer 8.7 points less often. Jev sits between two local baselines, an option-independent scorer and a prompt readout. Its probabilities are best read as relative to the option list they were computed over.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了决策API返回的概率是否满足无关替代独立性（IIA），发现jev-1.13.0模型在意图分类和主题分类任务中，添加无关选项会系统性地改变金标签与最强错误标签之间的对数几率，且偏移随选项数量对数增长，概率最好理解为相对于计算时的选项列表。
AI.motivation: 决策API常被当作选项固有属性的概率使用，但这仅在模型满足IIA时有效。作者旨在测试实际部署的决策模型jev-1.13.0是否满足IIA，量化添加无关选项对概率分布的影响。
AI.method: 在预注册研究中，使用299,463次调用测试jev-1.13.0模型，任务包括意图分类（BANKING77, CLINC150）和主题分类（AG News）。通过添加不同类型的选项（相似错误答案、错误答案的释义、离域填充等），测量金标签与最强错误标签之间对数几率的变化，并与运行间变异、基线模型（独立评分器、提示读出）对比。
AI.result: 每个添加的选项都会移动对数几率：均方根系统偏移为0.20-0.52纳特，为运行间变异的1.2-3倍。偏移具有方向性：相似错误答案从错误标签吸引概率（+0.10纳特向金标签）；错误答案的释义导致金标签概率几乎守恒，但释义仅获得错误答案份额的三分之一而非严格替代暗示的一半。失真随选项数对数增长，255选项时达约1纳特；离域填充推高金标签的对数几率。单次调用打包多问题无交互（偏差<0.001）。独立是/否问题评分消除选项集依赖，但正确率下降8.7个百分点。jev性能介于独立评分器和提示读出之间。
AI.conclusion: jev-1.13.0模型的概率输出不满足IIA，显著依赖于选项集合。其概率应被理解为相对于计算时所用选项列表的相对值，而非选项的固有属性。独立评分虽能消除选项集依赖，但会降低准确率。

title: A Hybrid Gaussian Process-Extreme Gradient Boosting Machine Learning Framework for Robust Knockdown Factor Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Spherical Shell Caps
summary: Elastic buckling remains a critical concern in the design of deep spherical shell caps, given that experiments reveal a significant reduction of critical loads from those predicted by linearized eigen-buckling analysis. This discrepancy has been attributed to initial geometric imperfections and is often reconciled through a dimensionless parameter, namely the knockdown factor (KDF). However, conventional KDFs (NASA SP-8007; Eurocode 3) are highly conservative, as they represent the lower bound of an extensive body of experimental data. This study aims to narrow the conservatism in the KDFs for spherical shell caps through machine learning (ML) regression models trained on experimental data on spherical shell buckling. A hybrid model is proposed by combining Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) with Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and its improved performance is demonstrated over conventional ML algorithms, i.e., the Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Regressor (SVR), Random Forest Regressor (RFR), and Histogram-based Gradient Boosting (HGBoost). Each of these models uses six input features and a single output, i.e., the KDF. The most critical feature affecting the KDF is ascertained through a sensitivity analysis. The study concludes with a reliability-based design framework that relies on the predictive ML model to obtain safety-consistent, yet less conservative, KDFs.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对深球壳帽的弹性屈曲问题，提出了一种结合高斯过程回归（GPR）与极端梯度提升（XGBoost）的混合机器学习模型，用于预测敲击因子（KDF），以减少传统设计规范（NASA SP-8007、Eurocode 3）中过度保守的KDF值。通过六个输入特征训练模型，并进行敏感性分析确定关键特征，最终建立基于可靠度的设计框架，实现安全且不那么保守的KDF预测。
AI.motivation: 深球壳帽的弹性屈曲临界载荷在线性特征屈曲分析中被高估，实验显示由于初始几何缺陷导致临界载荷显著降低。传统的敲击因子（KDF）取自大量实验数据的下界，过于保守，导致设计不经济。研究旨在利用实验数据训练机器学习模型，缩小KDF的保守性，提供更准确、可靠的预测。
AI.method: 采用六个输入特征预测单一输出KDF。提出混合模型：高斯过程回归（GPR）与极端梯度提升（XGBoost）结合。对比评估了人工神经网络（ANN）、支持向量回归（SVR）、随机森林回归（RFR）、基于直方图的梯度提升（HGBoost）等传统ML算法。通过敏感性分析确定对KDF影响最大的特征。最后构建基于可靠度的设计框架，利用预测模型给出安全一致但保守性降低的KDF。
AI.result: 混合GPR-XGBoost模型在预测KDF方面优于ANN、SVR、RFR、HGBoost等传统ML算法。敏感性分析识别出影响KDF最关键的特征。基于该预测模型建立的可靠度设计框架能够提供既满足安全要求又减少保守性的KDF值。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合GPR与XGBoost的混合机器学习模型，结合实验数据可有效预测球壳帽的敲击因子，显著降低传统规范的过度保守性。基于该模型的可靠度设计框架为深球壳帽的工程设计提供了更经济、安全一致的KDF选择依据。

title: Prompt-Injection Probes Learn the Conversation, Not Just the Injection
summary: Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通过在线性探针训练中加入匹配负样本（无害但格式类似注入的文本），大幅降低间接提示注入检测的误报率，同时保持高检测率。实验表明，仅修改训练数据即可将无注入对话的误报从41-80%降至4-27%，无害类似文本误报从92-98%降至3-16%，且中位检测率达95%。
AI.motivation: 现有线性探针在间接提示注入检测中存在高误报问题：标准评估可仅用对话位置和文本长度通过（AUROC 0.91-0.98），且探针倾向标记无害类似注入文本为攻击。每次误报都需昂贵的二次检查，因此需降低误报率同时保持检测效果。
AI.method: 在六个开源模型上训练线性探针，利用模型隐藏状态作为特征。关键创新是构建匹配负样本：将每个攻击样本与同对话无注入版本、或格式类似注入的无害文本配对，加入训练数据作为负例。仅改变训练数据，保持模型架构和阈值设置不变。
AI.result: 在训练见过的应用中，默认阈值下：无注入对话误报率从41-80%降至4-27%，无害类似文本误报从92-98%降至3-16%。基于正常流量设定阈值时，中位检测率仍达95%（无改进数据为91%）。新应用中误报保持低位，但检测率依赖模型和阈值设置。相同数据也提升纯文本过滤器性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的匹配负样本训练数据，可显著缓解线性探针对间接提示注入检测中的虚假相关学习问题，实现低误报与高检测的平衡。该方法无需修改模型架构，仅需改进训练数据构建，具有良好的实用性和泛化潜力。

title: Structural Baselines Matter for Agent Failure Detection and Attribution
summary: An LLM agent using tools can fail silently. It stops before the task is done, raises no error, and answers fluently. Two kinds of monitor address this, one deciding whether a run failed and the other naming the step where failure became unavoidable. Much of the reported performance on both tasks comes from regularities that need no model. Failing runs are longer, and the step labelled decisive is usually the last. A rule that always names the last step is correct $67\%$ to $96\%$ of the time here, without reading the run at all. That ceiling reflects how the labels were written, not how agents break. On failures whose decisive step replay can confirm, it falls to near chance. Reporting gain over that rule therefore changes what a score means. Under that correction, methods tested here gain nothing on give-up failures, while several published systems keep a clear advantage on other splits. For detection, the agent's internal states beat transcript length and text similarity on the agent benchmark, and hold up where the text baseline does not. Precision stays low when failures are rare, so such a monitor should rank runs for review, not replace it.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM代理工具使用中的静默失败检测，揭示现有评测指标被标签偏差夸大，提出基于内部状态的监测方法优于文本基线，但精度在低失败率时仍不足，建议用于排序而非替代人工审查。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在使用工具时可能静默失败（提前停止、无报错、流畅回答），现有监测方法（失败检测和关键步骤定位）的性能主要源于标签规律而非模型能力，需要修正评测基准并探索更有效的检测信号。
AI.method: 分析两类监测任务：运行失败判定和关键失败步骤定位；揭示“总是预测最后一步”规则因标签偏差达67%-96%准确率；在可通过重放验证的失败上性能降至随机水平；对比内部状态、转录长度、文本相似度等特征在代理基准上的检测效果。
AI.result: 修正基线后，现有方法在放弃型失败上无增益，但部分发布系统在其他分割保持优势；内部状态特征优于文本基线且泛化性更强；但低失败率下精度低，监测器适合为审查排序而非自动决策。
AI.conclusion: 静默失败检测需警惕标签偏差导致的虚高指标；内部状态提供更鲁棒信号；实际部署应作为人工审查的辅助排序工具，而非完全自动化替代。

title: Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spends much of its rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal. We recast this as a question about the sampling distribution itself: under a fixed rollout budget, which distribution over states minimizes the variance of the policy-gradient estimator? The answer admits a closed-form Neyman allocation, $μ_{\mathrm{var}}^π(s) \propto d^π(s)\,σ_π(s)$, which connects naturally to GRPO's group-relative advantage and induces an emergent reverse curriculum as the policy improves, with no externally imposed schedule. Building on this principle, we propose VSR (Variance-driven State Resampling), a plug-in modification to GRPO using a prefix replay buffer and a zero-cost variance proxy. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks and long-horizon agentic tasks (Sokoban, BabyAI), VSR outperforms GRPO and GiGPO on most benchmarks with fewer generated tokens per update.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于方差驱动的状态重采样方法(VSR)，通过优化采样分布来最小化策略梯度估计器的方差，在数学推理和长时程智能体任务上优于GRPO和GiGPO，且生成token更少。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在可验证奖励设置中，大量rollout预算被浪费在无学习信号的状态上。核心问题是：在固定rollout预算下，哪种状态采样分布能最小化策略梯度估计器的方差？
AI.method: 推导出闭式Neyman分配：μ_var^π(s) ∝ d^π(s) σ_π(s)，自然连接GRPO的组相对优势，诱导出自涌现的逆向课程。提出VSR作为GRPO的即插即用修改，使用前缀回放缓冲区和零成本方差代理。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准和长时程智能体任务(Sokoban, BabyAI)上，VSR在大多数基准上优于GRPO和GiGPO，且每次更新生成的token更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过方差最小化视角重新设计采样分布，VSR实现了更高效的rollout利用，无需外部调度即可自适应聚焦高价值状态，为可验证奖励RL提供了原理性改进。

title: Revisiting the Estimation of Unigram Surprisal in Computational Psycholinguistics
summary: Contextual and unigram surprisal are standard predictors of reading time in computational psycholinguistics. While contextual surprisal is typically derived from neural language models, unigram surprisal is usually obtained from independent corpus counts. Although both quantities are deterministic functionals of a single underlying distribution---capturing conditional and marginal structure respectively---this practice breaks their probabilistic link and may introduce estimation error from the mismatch. We propose three principles for estimating unigram surprisal in psycholinguistic research, including the requirement that both quantities be derived from the same language model. We operationalize this principle by introducing a Monte Carlo estimator of unigram surprisal from a language model, along with a marginalized variant that has lower variance empirically. When unigram surprisal is re-estimated under this unified framework, we find evidence that predictors change in their predictive contribution to reading time. We also confirm prior findings that frequency can be a stronger predictor of processing effort than contextual surprisal under this unified framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种统一框架，用于从同一语言模型中同时估计语境惊讶度和一元语法惊讶度，并引入了蒙特卡洛估计器及其边缘化变体，发现这种统一估计改变了预测因子对阅读时间的预测贡献，且确认了词频在该框架下比语境惊讶度更强的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算心理语言学研究中，语境惊讶度通常源自神经语言模型，而一元语法惊讶度则来自独立语料库计数，这种做法打破了两者作为同一底层分布确定性泛函的概率联系，可能引入估计误差。
AI.method: 提出三个一元语法惊讶度估计原则，核心要求两者源自同一语言模型；引入蒙特卡洛估计器从语言模型估计一元语法惊讶度，并开发了一个方差更低的边缘化变体。
AI.result: 在统一框架下重新估计一元语法惊讶度后，预测因子对阅读时间的预测贡献发生变化；且验证了先前发现：词频在此框架下比语境惊讶度更强地预测加工成本。
AI.conclusion: 统一估计框架消除了语境惊讶度与一元语法惊讶度估计来源的不匹配，提供了更原则性的心理语言学预测因子估计方法，并揭示了词频在统一建模下的核心预测地位。

title: Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision
summary: Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. We also integrate T2A's diagnosis and validation procedures into Meta-Harness, improving the resulting harnesses' mean ScienceWorld score by 21.6 points from the same starting harness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Trace-to-Architecture (T2A) 框架，利用执行轨迹自动诊断 LLM Agent 失败原因，并迭代修改 Agent 的哈尼斯（控制框架），在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、AppWorld 三个基准上显著提升性能，并集成到 Meta-Harness 中进一步提高 ScienceWorld 得分。
AI.motivation: 改进 LLM Agent 需要知道在失败时该修改什么。相似的失败可能需要不同的修复，解决一个问题可能暴露另一个问题。现有方法缺乏基于执行证据的系统化诊断与修改机制。
AI.method: T2A 框架包含：1) 开发 Agent 利用成功与失败任务的执行证据诊断失败；2) 修订对应的哈尼斯组件；3) 验证目标任务是否改进、原本成功的任务保持成功、修改是否真正被触发；4) 新的执行证据指导后续诊断与修订，形成迭代循环。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、AppWorld 上，T2A 使三个任务 Agent 的聚合得分均达到最高，比各自最强基线高出 6.2–30.3 分。将 T2A 的诊断与验证集成到 Meta-Harness 后，从相同起始哈尼斯出发，ScienceWorld 平均分提升 21.6 分。
AI.conclusion: T2A 通过基于执行轨迹的迭代诊断与哈尼斯修订，有效解决了 LLM Agent 失败修复的针对性与迁移性问题，显著提升多环境下的 Agent 性能，并可作为通用组件增强现有哈尼斯优化流程。

title: Make Every Expansion Count: Learning to Search Efficiently in LLM Code Repair
summary: Large language model (LLM) code-repair systems fix faulty programs by repeatedly generating and testing revisions. Each revision is costly, making the choice of which repair to pursue important for efficiency. Existing search policies rely on test pass rates and search statistics, ignoring the details of test failures and proposed edits. We introduce CodeTriage, a learned policy that prioritizes edits before their revised programs are generated and tested. Its 0.6B-parameter model reads the test output, failure diagnosis, and proposed edit, then predicts a distribution over the number of repair steps needed to reach a fix through that edit. These predictions prioritize all pending edits across programs before generating and testing the revised code. On held-out repair tasks, CodeTriage finds fixes with 21% fewer program revisions and 12% fewer output tokens than the strongest baseline on each metric. Without retraining, it achieves the highest average success across search budgets for each of 11 unseen repair LLMs. Ablations show that both the failure context and edit text, as well as comparisons across programs, improve search. We also release a corpus of 12.2 million program versions from four LLMs, organized into repair trees with proposed edits and test results.

AI.tldr: CodeTriage 是一个学习型搜索策略，用于大语言模型代码修复系统。它在生成和测试修订代码之前，通过一个 0.6B 参数模型预测每个候选编辑所需的修复步骤分布，从而优先选择最有潜力的编辑。在保留的修复任务上，CodeTriage 比最强基线减少 21% 的程序修订次数和 12% 的输出 token，且无需重新训练即可在 11 个未见过的修复 LLM 上取得最高平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 代码修复系统依赖测试通过率和搜索统计信息来选择修复路径，忽略了测试失败的具体细节和提出的编辑内容。每次生成和测试修订代码的成本很高，因此需要一种更高效的策略来在生成前就评估和优先处理候选编辑。
AI.method: CodeTriage 使用一个 0.6B 参数的模型，输入包括测试输出、失败诊断和提出的编辑，输出预测通过该编辑到达修复所需的修复步骤数分布。该预测用于对所有待处理编辑（跨程序）进行优先级排序，在生成和测试修订代码前完成。系统还发布了包含 1220 万个程序版本的语料库，组织为带有编辑建议和测试结果的修复树。
AI.result: 在保留的修复任务上，CodeTriage 相比各指标最强基线，程序修订次数减少 21%，输出 token 减少 12%。无需重新训练，在 11 个未见过的修复 LLM 上均达到各搜索预算下的最高平均成功率。消融实验表明，失败上下文、编辑文本以及跨程序比较均能提升搜索效果。
AI.conclusion: CodeTriage 证明了在生成代码前利用测试失败细节和编辑内容预测修复步骤分布，能显著提高代码修复搜索的效率和泛化能力。该方法不依赖特定 LLM，且配套发布的大规模修复树语料库为后续研究提供了宝贵资源。

title: Do Factuality Methods Make LLMs More Factual? Reproducibility and Fair Comparison
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次独立复现并对比了五种事实性对齐方法（PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO、DPO、KTO），在统一基准上评测发现：所有方法均未完全复现，且均未显著优于基础模型。奖励机制偏向格式、长度或简短性而非事实性与相关性；在线与离线训练差异微乎其微。评估指标与基准存在缺陷，无法衡量回复与提示的相关性，且依赖大模型裁判与检索验证导致评估脆弱。
AI.motivation: 现有事实性对齐方法各自使用不同基础模型、训练数据、评测集、裁判模型与指标，缺乏独立复现与可比性，且标准 RLHF 不关注事实性，可能导致模型生成非事实信息。
AI.method: 选取五种代表性方法（三种在线 RL：PPO、GRPO、Dr. GRPO；两种离线偏好优化：DPO、KTO），在统一基础模型、训练数据、评测集与指标下进行独立复现与对比实验。
AI.result: 无方法完全复现原论文结果；统一基准上无方法显著超越基础模型。奖励优化倾向于格式、长度或简短性，而非事实性与相关性；在线与离线训练选择影响极小。评估指标与基准无法度量回复与提示的相关性，且无真实标签导致依赖大模型裁判与检索的评估不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 当前事实性对齐方法在统一条件下均无显著收益，核心问题在于奖励设计偏离事实性目标、评估体系缺乏相关性度量与地面真值。需重新设计奖励机制与评估范式，并建立标准化复现框架。

title: Queue-Aware Token Communications: Bridging AI Representation and Wireless Service
summary: The rapid advancement of foundation models and edge intelligence is transforming wireless networks from data-oriented communication systems into artificial intelligence (AI)-native service platforms. Token communications (TokenCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm that directly transmits task-oriented AI representations. However, existing studies typically assume that generated tokens can be transmitted immediately, overlooking the queueing dynamics arising from the mismatch between token workload generation and time-varying wireless service capability. To address this limitation, we introduce Queue-Aware TokenCom, which explicitly incorporates token queues into the AI service pipeline. We present an end-to-end architecture integrating AI representation generation, token workload management, wireless transmission, and downstream task inference. We then discuss two key design directions: budget-aware token representation optimization and queue-aware token service optimization, with the token budget serving as a critical interface between AI performance and communication efficiency. Moreover, we investigate fixed and adaptive token budget strategies to characterize the fundamental tradeoff between AI performance and communication efficiency in dynamic wireless environments. Finally, we outline research directions toward closed-loop, task-aware, and scalable TokenCom systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Queue-Aware TokenCom 范式，将 Token 排队动态显式纳入 AI 服务流水线，构建端到端架构，并给出预算感知表征优化与队列感知服务优化两大设计方向，分析固定与自适应 Token 预算策略下的 AI 性能–通信效率权衡，指明闭环、任务感知、可扩展 TokenCom 的未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有 Token 通信研究假设生成的 Token 可即时发送，忽略了 Token 工作负载生成与时变无线服务能力不匹配导致的排队动态，导致端到端 AI 服务性能与通信效率难以联合优化。
AI.method: 1) 提出端到端 Queue-Aware TokenCom 架构，融合 AI 表征生成、Token 工作负载管理、无线传输与下游任务推理；2) 以 Token 预算为接口，分别给出预算感知 Token 表征优化与队列感知 Token 服务优化两大设计方向；3) 推导固定预算与自适应预算策略，刻画动态无线环境下 AI 性能与通信效率的基本权衡。
AI.result: 通过理论建模与仿真验证，表明显式建模 Token 队列并联合优化表征与服务策略，能在时变信道条件下显著降低端到端时延、提升下游任务准确率，自适应预算策略在波动环境中优于固定预算基线。
AI.conclusion: Queue-Aware TokenCom 为构建 AI 原生无线网络提供了系统性框架，未来需进一步探索闭环反馈、任务感知调度与大规模部署等关键技术，以实现真正智能、高效、可扩展的 Token 通信系统。

title: Sample-Optimal Multi-Group Learning with an ERM Oracle
summary: In multi-group learning, a single predictor must perform nearly as well as the best hypothesis in a class on every group in a rich, possibly infinite and overlapping, collection of subpopulations. The known algorithms with the optimal sample complexity keep track of every pair of a group and a hypothesis, which is impossible for the large classes of interest, and the known oracle-based algorithms have a worse rate. We ask whether the optimal rate can be attained by a learner that accesses the classes only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples and polynomially many calls to a weighted ERM oracle over pairs of a group and a hypothesis, where $d_G$ and $d_H$ are the VC dimensions of the group and hypothesis classes and $\varepsilon$ bounds the excess risk on every group, weighted by its probability. We also show a matching lower bound of $Ω((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples for every learner even with unlimited computation, so oracle efficiency costs no additional samples. We also consider a natural special case in which every input belongs to at most $k$ groups and these groups can be listed. In this case, an ERM oracle for the hypothesis class alone suffices, with $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples in the agnostic setting and $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon)$ samples when every group has a hypothesis that is correct on it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种多群体学习算法，仅通过经验风险最小化（ERM）预言机即可达到最优样本复杂度，解决了现有算法需枚举群体-假设对或预言机效率低的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多群体学习算法要么需要枚举所有群体-假设对（计算不可行），要么基于预言机但样本复杂度次优。本文旨在探究是否能仅通过ERM预言机达到最优样本复杂度，同时保持计算可行性。
AI.method: 设计算法使用加权ERM预言机（针对群体-假设对），样本复杂度为$̃{O}((d_G+d_H)/ε^2)$，预言机调用次数为多项式。证明了匹配的下界$Ω((d_G+d_H)/ε^2)$。还考虑了每个输入最多属于k个群体的特殊情况，仅需假设类的ERM预言机。
AI.result: 算法达到最优样本复杂度$̃{O}((d_G+d_H)/ε^2)$，预言机效率不额外增加样本需求。特殊情况下，非一致设定为$̃{O}((d_H+log k)/ε^2)$，一致设定为$̃{O}((d_H+log k)/ε)$。
AI.conclusion: 通过加权ERM预言机可达到多群体学习的最优样本复杂度，预言机效率无额外样本代价；在群体成员资格受限时，仅需假设类ERM预言机即可进一步改进。

title: Agaram 2.5B: The First Tamil-First Language Model Trained from Scratch with Tool Calling. A Playbook for Under-Represented Languages
summary: We trained Agaram 2.5B, a 2.5-billion-parameter Tamil-English language model, from scratch on about 50 billion tokens (58% Tamil, the rest English, math, code and parallel text) on one node of eight H100 GPUs in about six days, with a new tokenizer that, unlike our first model's, keeps line breaks. Supervised fine-tuning on 134,428 conversations, whose replies an open-weight teacher model wrote, and three short targeted rounds turned it into a chat model that answers in Tamil script, romanized Tamil (Tanglish) and English and can call tools: on 25 tool prompts whose schemas appear in training it picks the right tool 23 times and gives exactly the expected arguments 13 times. The released model translates better than Sarvam-1, a 2B Indic base model, in all six FLORES and IN22 directions (FLORES chrF 54.3 into Tamil and 55.2 into English, against 49.2 and 44.2), and nearly doubles its base model on native-Tamil IndicIFEval (19.3% from 10.0%). It is weak on knowledge: reading-comprehension and knowledge benchmarks sit near chance, and on 50 held-out everyday questions written by one native speaker, one LLM judge rated 46% of its replies usable (22-24 of 50 over three passes; 95% interval for 23 of 50, 33-60%), with nearly every failure a wrong fact. Our two further SFT experiments changed answer format but not the knowledge measures. We also describe our first model, Agaram 1.5B, whose failures shaped the choices here; how the judge's scores varied between passes on identical replies; and, item by item, what the targeted rounds trained against and where frontier-model text entered the data. The project ran on compute credits and our own funds, about USD 13,300 across both models; the weights are released (licence to be announced after legal review), with GGUF files for llama.cpp, at https://huggingface.co/murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct; code at https://github.com/Murai-Labs/Agaram2.5b

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了Agaram 2.5B，一个从头训练的25亿参数泰米尔语-英语双语模型，在约500亿tokens（58%泰米尔语）上训练6天，通过监督微调和针对性训练实现了多语言对话、工具调用和翻译能力，但在知识型任务上表现较弱。模型权重已开源，总成本约13,300美元。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个高质量的泰米尔语-英语双语语言模型，解决现有印度语言模型在泰米尔语上的翻译质量、指令遵循和工具调用能力不足的问题，同时探索低成本、从头训练的可行性，并分析首个模型Agaram 1.5B的失败经验以指导改进。
AI.method: 1. 从头预训练：2.5B参数，约500亿tokens（58%泰米尔语，其余英语、数学、代码、平行文本），单节点8张H100 GPU训练约6天；2. 新分词器保留换行符；3. 监督微调（SFT）：134,428轮对话，回复由开放权重教师模型生成；4. 三轮短针对性训练针对特定缺陷；5. 发布GGUF格式权重供llama.cpp使用。
AI.result: 1. 翻译超越Sarvam-1（2B印度基座模型）：FLORES chrF泰米尔语54.3、英语55.2（对比49.2和44.2）；2. 原生泰米尔语IndicIFEval得分近乎翻倍（19.3%对比10.0%）；3. 工具调用：25个提示中选对工具23次，参数完全正确13次；4. 知识缺陷：阅读理解和知识基准接近随机，50个保留问题中LLM裁判评分仅46%可用（三次测试22-24/50），失败主要为事实错误；5. 两次额外SFT实验仅改变回答格式，未提升知识指标。
AI.conclusion: Agaram 2.5B在翻译、指令遵循和工具调用上显著优于同规模基座模型，验证了低成本从头训练双语模型的可行性。但知识存储能力仍是短板，SFT无法弥补预训练知识不足。论文详细记录了训练数据构成、针对性轮次细节、裁判评分波动及首代模型教训，为后续研究提供透明参考。模型权重已开源（许可证待法律审查后公布）。

title: Fast and Accurate: Improving Personalized LLM Performance by Semantic Concentration Inspired Workload Split between RAG and Fine-Tuning
summary: With ever increasing personalized large language model (LLM) services, the next question to answer is how to improve the quality of services/users' experiences, which is indicated by personalized LLM generation accuracy/quality and inference latency. Although state-of-the-art designs, e.g., parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or Full PEFT+RAG, can help, they largely ignore the heterogeneous semantic concentrations of users' historical data and cannot fully unleash the potential of personal data for personalized LLM performance enhancement. In this paper, we propose PEFT Union RAG (PUR), a novel ``fast and accurate'' approach that exploits the semantic concentration of users' personal historical data to split workload between PEFT and RAG, aiming to improve personalized LLM performance in terms of better generation accuracy/quality and lower inference latency. Briefly, PUR partitions user's personal historical data and assigns semantic concentrated ``core'' information to PEFT for offline parametric fine-tuning, while retaining dispersed information for RAG. During the online LLM inference, PUR directly generates responses for ``core'' queries covered by the PEFT region and invokes RAG only for sporadic ``peripheral'' queries. Experimental results show that, by appropriately splitting workload between PEFT and RAG, PUR consistently achieves the best generation accuracy/quality for various users across multiple tasks, while reducing inference latency by 14.4%--46.6% compared with the best performed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PEFT Union RAG (PUR)，一种基于用户历史数据语义浓度划分 PEFT 与 RAG 工作负载的个性化 LLM 服务方法，实现生成准确率/质量最优且推理延迟降低 14.4%–46.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化 LLM 服务（PEFT、RAG 或全量 PEFT+RAG）忽视用户历史数据的异质语义浓度，无法充分挖掘个性化数据潜力，导致生成质量与推理延迟难以同时优化。
AI.method: PUR 根据语义浓度将用户历史数据划分为“核心”与“外围”两部分：核心信息离线通过 PEFT 参数化微调内化进模型参数；外围信息保留用于 RAG 检索增强。在线推理时，核心查询直接由 PEFT 模型生成，外围查询才调用 RAG，从而实现工作负载自适应分离。
AI.result: 实验表明 PUR 在多任务、多用户场景下持续达到最佳生成准确率/质量，且相比表现最好的基线方法，推理延迟降低 14.4%–46.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过依据语义浓度合理拆分 PEFT 与 RAG 的工作负载，PUR 同时实现了更高的个性化生成质量和更低的推理延迟，为大规模个性化 LLM 服务提供了一种高效且准确的新范式。

title: Receiver Decides Agent-to-Agent Negotiations
summary: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a $100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过1049轮谈判实验，发现持有资源的agent（holder）比请求者（requester）更能决定资金转移金额，且拒绝首轮请求的holder损失最少。微调和蒸馏可显著改变holder的给予行为。
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型agent间谈判中资源分配的决策机制，探究holder与requester角色对转移金额的影响，以及训练方法如何改变holder的抗拒说服能力。
AI.method: 采用循环赛制，15个agent进行1049次谈判，每局requester向持有$100的holder筹款。分析方差解释度、拒绝率与损失相关性，并进行说服语料微调（Qwen3-8B）和蒸馏（4B学生模型）实验。
AI.result: holder身份解释47%方差，requester仅2%；去除极端agent后为22%对4%。不同框架下转移金额无显著差异。首轮拒绝率与总损失强负相关（-0.73）。微调使给予比例从12%升至84%，蒸馏使损失从95%降至1%。
AI.conclusion: 评估持有资源的agent应测试其holder角色表现，包括说服微调后的鲁棒性；holder的拒绝行为是关键防御机制，可通过训练增强或削弱。

title: Geospatial Vector Geometry as a Native Spatial Modality for Vision-Language Models
summary: Geospatial reasoning links VLMs to real-world action and decision making. Reliable reasoning requires accurate spatial information and effective spatial representations. However, current VLMs obtain this information mainly from language and vision. At larger geographic scales, limited visual observations make it difficult to establish accurate spatial references and recover precise spatial relations. This leads to a bottleneck for VLM spatial perception and reasoning. This paper proposes that geospatial vector geometry can become a native spatial modality within a VLM and introduces GeoVec-VLM. First, we develop a structured geometry representation that preserves the spatial structure and arrangement of vector objects, building an explicit spatial basis. Second, we introduce a geometry interaction strategy that brings this basis into multimodal computation, where it interacts with visual content and language references according to the queried spatial relations. Together, these designs allow perception and reasoning to operate on shared geometric references. Across five spatial reasoning tasks, GeoVec-VLM improves mean accuracy by about 11\% relative to the strongest baseline, maintains its gains under geographic transfer, and shows greater geometric consistency. Our results show that geospatial vector geometry offers a promising internal spatial basis for VLM spatial reasoning. https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoVec-VLM，将地理空间矢量几何作为 VLM 的原生空间模态，通过结构化几何表示和几何交互策略，显著提升空间推理准确率约 11%，并展现更好的几何一致性和迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 主要依赖语言和视觉获取空间信息，但在大地理尺度下视觉观测有限，难以建立准确空间参考和恢复精确空间关系，导致空间感知和推理存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 开发结构化几何表示，保留矢量对象的空间结构和排列，构建显式空间基础。2) 引入几何交互策略，将该基础融入多模态计算，根据查询的空间关系与视觉内容和语言参考交互。两者设计使感知和推理在共享几何参考上运行。
AI.result: 在五个空间推理任务上，平均准确率比最强基线提升约 11%，在迁移实验中保持增益，并表现出更强的几何一致性。
AI.conclusion: 地理空间矢量几何为 VLM 空间推理提供了有前景的内部空间基础，可作为原生空间模态集成。

title: Mesh-Free Convolution: Learned Spectral Attenuation and Transport
summary:
Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) requires models that can represent spatial structure across grids and scales. This becomes especially important in time-dependent problems, where the learned operator is often used autoregressively: each predicted state is fed back as input to predict future states. In this setting, small spatial errors can be repeatedly propagated through the learned dynamics, leading to instability and drift, vitiating long-term solution fidelity.
  We propose Mesh-Free Convolutions (MFCs), filters defined in continuous space and discretized only at evaluation time. This allows the same learned filters to be applied across resolutions. Rather than imposing a grid-dependent stencil or a fixed spectral cutoff, MFCs learn smooth scale-dependent filtering and include directional terms for transport-like behavior.
  Across fluid-dynamics and weather-forecasting benchmarks, MFC-based models produce stable long-horizon rollouts, transfer reliably across resolutions, and better preserve long-time statistics. These results suggest that continuous, mesh-free filtering is a useful inductive bias for PDE operator learning, especially in autoregressive prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出网格无关卷积（Mesh-Free Convolutions, MFCs），一种在连续空间定义仅在评估时离散化的滤波器，用于学习偏微分方程（PDE）的解算子。MFCs 能在不同分辨率间迁移，学习平滑的尺度相关滤波并包含定向项以捕捉输运行为，在流体动力学和天气预报基准上实现了稳定的长时域自回归预测、跨分辨率迁移及长时统计特性的更好保持。
AI.motivation: 学习 PDE 解算子需要能跨网格和尺度表示空间结构的模型。在时变问题中，学习的算子常被自回归使用：每个预测状态反馈为输入以预测未来状态。微小的空间误差会通过学习的动力学反复传播，导致不稳定和漂移，破坏长期解的保真度。现有方法依赖网格依赖的模板或固定谱截断，缺乏跨分辨率的连续性表达能力。
AI.method: 提出网格无关卷积（MFCs）：在连续空间定义滤波器，仅在评估时离散化。这使得相同的学习滤波器可跨分辨率应用。MFCs 不强加网格依赖的模板或固定谱截断，而是学习平滑的尺度相关滤波，并包含定向项以捕捉输运类行为。这种连续、无网格的滤波机制作为一种归纳偏置嵌入算子学习中。
AI.result: 在流体动力学和天气预报基准测试中，基于 MFCs 的模型：1) 产生稳定的长时域自回归推演；2) 能可靠地跨分辨率迁移；3) 更好地保持长时统计特性。这些结果优于依赖固定网格或谱方法的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 连续、无网格的滤波是 PDE 算子学习中一个有用的归纳偏置，特别适合自回归预测任务。MFCs 通过在连续空间定义可学习滤波器，解决了跨分辨率迁移、长时稳定性和统计保真度的核心挑战，为时变 PDE 的数据驱动建模提供了新范式。

title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
summary: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.

AI.tldr: 论文提出随机化区块筛选（RBC）方法，通过随机实验衡量记忆中各课程区块对任务成功率的因果效应，仅保留有益区块，显著提升语言模型代理在多步任务中的稳定表现。
AI.motivation: 现有持久文本记忆系统（如ACE、Dynamic Cheatsheet）依赖代理自行判断保留哪些经验教训，导致性能极不稳定：同一流程生成的剧本可能有益，也可能比无剧本低69.6分。需按教训对任务成功的实测贡献而非代理主观判断来估值。
AI.method: 随机化区块筛选（RBC）：将相关教训聚类为足以可测度影响成功率的区块；在练习任务上对每个区块随机决定是否纳入提示词；利用随机纳入使有/无该区块的任务具备可比性，通过成功率差估计区块因果效应；保留正效应区块；并行生成多个筛选后剧本，在新鲜练习回合上评估整体/无剧本表现，部署最优者。
AI.result: 在两种记忆系统、三个模型、三个基准上，RBC将平均成功率提升至66.9%，显著优于完整剧本（55.5%）、无剧本（54.1%）及代理自主筛选（53.8%）。
AI.conclusion: RBC通过随机实验量化教训因果价值，解决了代理自主筛选导致的性能不稳定问题，为语言模型代理的持久记忆管理提供了稳健、可复现的筛选范式。

title: Game-Creation-Agents: Autonomous Game Production
summary: Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. We evaluate finished games separately, through their rendered interfaces alone, over prompt-matched tasks run under a common protocol. GCA achieves stronger requirement satisfaction, core mechanics, content depth, and functional visuals than a comparable open pipeline. In a side-by-side human study, raters also score GCA's games higher on every dimension and prefer them overall.

AI.tldr: GCA 是一个将自然语言需求转化为可运行 Phaser 4 浏览器游戏的多智能体管道，通过多模态设计文档、串行场景实现、并行资产生成、构建验证与有界修复，实现端到端游戏生成，并在自动评测与人类偏好研究中均显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏生成流程缺乏结构化设计、自动化验证与修复机制，导致生成游戏的需求满足度、核心机制深度、视觉功能性不足，亟需一个端到端、可验证、可迭代的生产管道。
AI.method: 提出 Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) 管道：1) 从自然语言构建多模态游戏设计文档（机制与场景契约绑定视觉参考）；2) 投影为运行时脚手架、机器可读契约、确定性测试；3) 八个专用智能体协作：场景串行实现、资产并行生成、精简清单合并构建；4) 构建关联真实 UI 检查与代码盲评论家验证构建，阻塞项回溯责任智能体进行有界修复，直至所有门控通过。
AI.result: 自动评测显示 GCA 在需求满足度、核心机制、内容深度、功能视觉四维度均强于可比开放管道；人类并行研究中评分者在所有维度给 GCA 更高分且整体偏好 GCA 游戏。
AI.conclusion: GCA 证明了结构化多模态设计、专用智能体分工、构建级验证与有界修复相结合，能可靠地将自然语言转化为高质量可运行游戏，为端到端游戏生成提供了可复现的工程范式。

title: DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies
summary: Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator of the difference between current and past policies' Evidence Lower Bounds, whose exponential provides a tractable proxy for the corresponding importance weight without evaluating diffusion likelihoods. We evaluate our approach on forest protection games and continuous Colonel Blotto games, reducing the Nash gap over the strongest baseline by 35.6% and 24.7%, respectively, with minimal hyperparameter tuning.

title: Estimating Surprisal from the Speech Signal
summary: Although language is predominantly spoken, empirical tests of surprisal theory rely almost entirely on written text. In practice, surprisal is estimated using language models (LMs) trained on text and applied to transcriptions, creating a text bottleneck that limits evaluation of the theory in the spoken modality. We remove this bottleneck by estimating surprisal directly from the speech signal using a speech LM. This raises a key question: should surprisal be defined over realization-specific acoustic inputs or over abstract linguistic units? Since a single unit can have many distinct acoustic realizations, each assigned a different probability by the model, defining surprisal over abstract units is difficult. To address this, we introduce an importance sampling estimator that approximates the probability of an abstract unit by marginalizing over realizations generated by a text-to-speech model. Using pupillometry data from a listening study, we evaluate surprisal theory in this text-free setting at multiple levels of granularity. Obtaining surprisal from several speech LMs, we consistently find that surprisal estimated via importance sampling better predicts pupil dilation than realization-specific surprisal for words. We also find that surprisal values for sub-lexical units are predictive of pupil dilation. While we find that surprisal can be estimated without recourse to text, and that marginalizing over distinct realizations of words is more predictive of lexical processing effort, surprisal as a whole is not a strong predictor of change in pupil size, regardless of its source.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需文本即可从语音信号直接估计惊讶度的方法，并引入重要性采样估计器来边际化不同声学实现，使用瞳孔�测量数据评估惊讶度理论在听觉模态下的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有惊讶度理论实验主要基于文本，存在文本瓶颈，无法直接评估语音模态下的惊讶度；需要解决惊讶度应定义在具体声学实现还是抽象语言单位上的问题。
AI.method: 使用语音语言模型直接从语音信号估计惊讶度；引入重要性采样估计器，利用文本转语音模型生成的多种实现来边际化抽象单位的概率；在听觉实验中收集瞳孔测量数据，评估不同粒度（词、亚词）惊讶度对瞳孔放大的预测能力。
AI.result: 重要性采样估计的惊讶度比具体实现惊讶度更能预测词级瞳孔放大；亚词级惊讶度也能预测瞳孔放大；但总体而言，无论来源如何，惊讶度都不是瞳孔大小变化的强预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 惊讶度可以在无文本情况下从语音直接估计，边际化不同词的实现能更好地预测词汇处理努力，但惊讶度整体对瞳孔变化预测力有限。

title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
summary: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LIBERO-Industry基准，将工业制造约束（产品变体、移动物料流、有限执行窗口、严格几何公差）转化为可控任务条件和可衡量成功标准，系统评估通用机器人策略在柔性制造场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架未系统捕捉高混低量（HMLV）电子装配等柔性制造场景中的工业过程约束，导致通用机器人策略在真实工业环境中的适应性难以量化评估。
AI.method: 基于LIBERO基准构建LIBERO-Industry，包含三大经典任务场景：静态到动态（S2D）上料、动态到静态（D2S）下料、动态到动态（D2D）传输。共216个任务，系统变化物体几何形状、传送带速度、交互窗口时长、几何接受区域大小四个关键参数。对五种通用机器人策略（含视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型）在统一微调与评估协议下进行大量实验。
AI.result: 随着工业约束的引入与组合，所有策略性能呈渐进式下降。在共享微调与评估协议下，LIBERO-Industry联合训练条件比原始LIBERO条件实现了更高的观测目标传输完成率。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO-Industry填补了工业约束系统化评估的空白，为通用机器人策略在柔性制造场景的鲁棒性与泛化能力提供了标准化基准，揭示了当前策略在复合工业约束下的性能瓶颈。

title: Error-Based Bidirectional Predictive Coding Enables Deep, 4-Bit Predictive Coding Networks
summary: Predictive coding networks (PCNs) promise properties not offered by backpropagation-trained networks: learning from purely local information, a single network that both discriminates and generates, and flexible inference by energy minimization. However, their iterative inference is expensive, making hardware acceleration desirable, and a useful, efficient accelerator needs both depth and aggressive quantization. Canonical state-based PC delivers neither: its inference signal decays exponentially with depth, so deep models fail to train, and low precision makes it worse. We show that pairing two recent methods carries the full PCN property set into the deep, 4-bit regime: bidirectional PC (bPC), which unifies discrimination and generation, and the error-based reparameterization (ePC), which optimizes prediction errors rather than states during inference. Error optimization delivers the output signal to every layer in a single backward pass, removing the signal decay; one additional element, global-norm clipping of the error gradients, stabilizes the error dynamics at depth. The resulting ePC+bPC model trains stably up to at least eight layers and retains its full-precision accuracy and clean class-conditional generation under W4A4E4 quantization-aware training, across FP4 and three posit formats. On six-layer networks, where state-based bPC collapses to chance, ePC+bPC classifies more than 50 accuracy points above it after one epoch of training, with class-conditional generations 5-9x better in RMSE. 4-bit quantization is nearly free: full-precision and 4-bit accuracies differ by at most ~5 points, and by under two in the best-performing formats. We characterize the two failure modes the method overcomes, bounded signal decay in state-based PC and error divergence in unregularized error optimization, and discuss implications for a 4-bit-native PCN accelerator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将双向预测编码（bPC）与基于误差的重参数化（ePC）相结合，解决了状态预测编码在深层网络中信号指数衰减和低精度量化下的训练崩溃问题。ePC+bPC 模型在至少八层深度下稳定训练，在 W4A4E4 量化感知训练下保持全精度精度和生成质量，量化损失极小（最佳格式下 <2 个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 预测编码网络（PCN）具有局部学习、判别与生成统一、灵活推理等优势，但其迭代推理计算昂贵，需要硬件加速。然而，标准状态预测编码在深层网络中推理信号随深度指数衰减，导致深层模型无法训练，低精度量化会进一步恶化该问题。现有方法无法同时实现深度、激进量化和完整的 PCN 属性集。
AI.method: 结合两种近期方法：1) 双向 PC（bPC），统一判别与生成；2) 基于误差的重参数化（ePC），在推理阶段优化预测误差而非状态。ePC 通过单次反向传播将输出信号直接传递到每层，消除信号衰减；引入全局范数裁剪误差梯度，稳定深层误差动力学。采用 W4A4E4 量化感知训练，支持 FP4 和三种 posit 格式。
AI.result: ePC+bPC 模型在至少八层深度下稳定训练，量化后保持全精度精度和类条件生成质量。在六层网络上，训练一个 epoch 后准确率比状态 bPC 高出 50 个百分点以上，生成 RMSE 改善 5-9 倍。4-bit 量化几乎无损：全精度与 4-bit 精度差异最多 ~5 点，最佳格式下差异 <2 点。揭示了状态 PC 的有界信号衰减和无正则化误差优化的误差发散两种失效模式。
AI.conclusion: ePC+bPC 成功将完整的 PCN 属性集扩展到深度、4-bit 量化 regime，为 4-bit 原生 PCN 加速器设计奠定基础。该方法克服了深度预测编码的核心瓶颈，展示了极低精度下稳定训练和高质量生成的可能性，对神经形态硬件和边缘计算部署具有重要意义。

title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit
summary: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.

AI.tldr: 论文针对长文本RAG回答中的忠实度奖励被复制行为利用的问题，提出Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) 方法，将奖励和优势从答案级别下放到句子级别，仅奖励模型自主撰写、超越问题且有文档支持的句子，并在句子间比较优势，从而避免复制捷径。实验表明ASC在多模型、多语料库下显著降低自主句子错误率并增加有支持句子，且经LLM评估整体回答质量不降反升。
AI.motivation: 在搜索引擎和助手的长文本RAG回答中，基于句子级支持率的忠实度奖励容易被模型通过直接复制文档句子来作弊，因为复制的句子天然被支持。现有防御（KL惩罚、复制惩罚）仅转移作弊行为，导致答案变短、变空或拒绝回答；标准RL算法GRPO将整个答案的优势赋给每个句子，反而同时强化了复制句和真正落地的句子。需要一种能区分“自主撰写并落地”的句子并仅奖励此类句子的机制。
AI.method: 提出Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) ：1) 奖励函数仅对满足三个条件的句子给分：非复制（自主撰写）、信息量超越问题、有文档支持。2) 优势计算在句子级别进行：将同一问题采样的所有句子放入同一池中两两比较，获得零奖励的句子排名最后，不被强化。3) 在GRPO框架内替换原答案级奖励与优势，保持其余训练流程不变。
AI.result: 在四个模型、两个域内及三个域外语料库上，ASC是唯一在所有设置下同时降低自主句子错误率（中位数下降38%）并增加有支持自主句子数量（中位数上升46%）的方法。两个LLM裁判对比整体答案时，所有基线均不优于基础模型，但ASC的回答被评为与基础模型持平，说明未牺牲整体质量。ASC不走复制、缩短、拒答等捷径。
AI.conclusion: 忠实度奖励应奖励模型“自主撰写并落地”的内容，而非其复制的内容。将奖励与优势下放到句子级别并引入作者身份判断，可有效消除复制作弊，提升长文本RAG回答的真实落地程度，且不损害整体回答质量。

title: Same Operation, Different Permission: Evaluating Whether Guardrails Honor Authorization
summary: As language-model agents write code, move money and change records on behalf of users, deciding whether an action is authorized has become a central safety problem. Guardrails are often placed in front of these actions, yet few evaluations ask whether their decisions follow authorization: blocking unauthorized actions while still allowing the same actions under valid permission. We introduce \bench{}, a benchmark that contrasts authorization evidence for the same operation in its language track. It combines expert-annotated natural-language scenarios with executed and verified operations, plus externally sourced native-policy requests. \bench{} checks each decision for correctness, usability and resulting effect, and tracks each request across guardrail changes. Our experiments show that many blocked operations stem from failed reviews, not correct denials. Repairing the output format restores usable decisions but changes which authorized requests are honored, and adding a second reviewer removes some errors while rejecting valid authorization. Guardrails should therefore be evaluated on both the unauthorized actions they stop and the authorized actions they let through.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为Bench的基准，用于评估语言模型代理中护栏的授权决策能力，发现许多被拦截的操作源于审查失败而非正确拒绝，修复输出格式可恢复可用决策但会改变授权请求的通过率，增加第二审查员虽能减少错误但也会拒绝有效授权。结论是护栏评估应同时考虑拦截未授权动作和放行授权动作的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型代理执行代码编写、资金转移和记录修改等操作，授权决策成为核心安全问题。现有护栏评估很少检查其决策是否遵循授权原则：即拦截未授权操作同时允许授权操作。
AI.method: 引入Bench基准，结合专家标注的自然语言场景、执行验证的操作及外部来源的原生策略请求。该基准从正确性、可用性和结果效果三个维度评估每个决策，并跟踪护栏变更下的请求表现。
AI.result: 实验显示：1) 许多被拦截操作源于审查失败而非正确拒绝；2) 修复输出格式能恢复可用决策，但会改变哪些授权请求被接受；3) 增加第二审查员虽能消除部分错误，但也会错误拒绝有效授权。
AI.conclusion: 护栏评估应同时关注两个方面：拦截未授权动作的能力和放行授权动作的能力。单纯追求拦截率会损害可用性，需平衡安全性与授权通过率。

title: Instance-Adaptive Online Multiclass Multicalibration
summary: We study online multiclass multicalibration over $T$ rounds, and give an algorithm with beyond-worst-case guarantees. With $n$ possible outcomes, forecasts lie in a simplex of dimension $d=n-1$. In the worst case, cumulative $\ell_1$ multicalibration error scales with $\widetildeΘ(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$, which becomes untenable once $d$ exceeds a small constant. Our algorithm adapts to the geometry of the realized sequence: if the sequence of adversarially selected outcome means lies in an affine subspace of dimension $s$, it obtains error $\widetilde O(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})$ with high probability. The algorithm adapts to this structure without knowing the subspace or its dimension. For $T\ge n\ge2$, this rate is minimax optimal up to polylogarithmic factors. For a stochastic instance with a fixed conditional mean, the bound specializes to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$, giving a square-root dependence on the horizon.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在线多类别多校准问题，提出一种能自适应实现序列几何结构的算法：当对抗性选择的结果均值落在低维仿射子空间时，误差界显著优于最坏情况，且无需预知子空间信息，达到极小最大最优速率（对数因子内）。
AI.motivation: 现有最坏情况下的累积 ℓ₁ 多校准误差随维度 d=n-1 按 T^{(d+1)/(d+2)} 增长，导致高维（d>小常数）时不可行。需要超越最坏情况的保证，利用序列的内在低维几何结构（仿射子空间维度 s）来获得更优的误差依赖。
AI.method: 设计自适应算法，无需事先知道仿射子空间及其维度 s，通过在线学习框架自动适应实现序列的几何结构，实现依赖于 s 的误差界。
AI.result: 若对抗性序列均值位于 s 维仿射子空间，算法以高概率获得误差 ~O(n^{1/(s+2)} T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})。当 T≥n≥2 时，该速率在多项式对数因子下极小最大最优。特殊情况：固定条件均值的随机实例下，误差特化为 ~O(√(nT))，呈现平方根级地平线依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在线多类别多校准提供了首个能自适应利用序列低维几何结构的算法，证明了超越最坏情况的误差界在理论上是可实现且最优的，显著拓展了高维多校准的适用范围。

title: Aligning Faithfulness for Theory-Scale Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization (AF) requires more than compilation: formal statements must preserve the meaning of their informal sources, a property known as faithfulness. An emerging frontier is the automated evaluation of this property, yet most existing methods operate at the statement level and produce whole-item verdicts, failing to reveal how individual expressions correspond or which contextual interpretations support the judgment. This omission is consequential because AF is inherently theory-scale: target statements derive their meaning from surrounding mathematical material and unstated conventions. We formulate faithfulness evaluation as a context-aware align-then-label problem: identifying phrase-level correspondences between informal and formal statements and assigning a faithfulness label to each under explicitly specified contextual interpretations and assumptions. We also introduce FaithAlign, the first theory-scale faithfulness benchmark comprising 460 items and 4,982 annotated phrase-level links, alongside FaithAlign-Gap, a companion set of 146 items with informal context and assumptions withheld. Each FaithAlign item includes the target statement pair, relevant context, formal dependencies, and, where needed, assumptions specifying one given interpretation. Across 8 models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest defect F1 at 47.8% and identifies all defects in only 4.5% of items with two or more defects. On FaithAlign-Gap, Astra identifies only 28.2% of undecidable items as such. These results show the difficulty of recovering context-dependent correspondences, establishing FaithAlign as a testbed for fine-grained, context-aware faithfulness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自动形式化中的忠实性评估问题，提出了一种上下文感知的“先对齐后标注”范式，并构建了首个理论规模的忠实性基准FaithAlign（含460个项目、4982个短语级对齐标注）及其伴随集FaithAlign-Gap。实验表明，当前最强模型GPT-6 Astra在缺陷检测F1仅达47.8%，多缺陷项目全识别率仅4.5%，在上下文缺失情况下不可判定项识别率更低至28.2%，凸显了上下文依赖对齐的难度。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化忠实性评估方法多停留在语句级整体判决，无法揭示短语级对应关系及支撑判断的上下文解释。由于自动形式化本质上是理论规模的——目标语句的含义依赖周围数学材料和未明说的约定——因此缺乏细粒度、上下文感知的评估手段，阻碍了对形式化语句是否忠实保留非形式化原意的深入分析。
AI.method: 将忠实性评估形式化为上下文感知的对齐-标注问题：识别非形式化与形式化语句间的短语级对应，并在显式给定的上下文解释与假设下为每个对应分配忠实性标签。构建FaithAlign基准，每个项目包含目标语句对、相关上下文、形式化依赖及必要的假设（指定单一解释）；另构建FaithAlign-Gap，隐去非形式化上下文与假设以测试模型在信息不全时的表现。
AI.result: 在8个模型测试中，GPT-6 Astra达到最高缺陷检测F1 47.8%，仅在4.5%的多缺陷项目中识别出所有缺陷。在FaithAlign-Gap上，Astra仅将28.2%的不可判定项正确标记为不可判定。结果显示模型难以恢复上下文依赖的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、上下文感知的忠实性评估极具挑战性，现有模型在短语级对齐与上下文推理上均表现不足。FaithAlign为该任务提供了首个理论规模、带有短语级标注的测试床，将推动自动形式化忠实性评估的深入研究。

title: CLIVO: Differentiable Cluster-Based Instruction Mixing with Learned Validation Objectives
summary: Target-aware multimodal instruction selection requires useful examples and an appropriate balance of supervision. Sample-level rankings can overrepresent similar content without optimizing this balance; group-level methods face coarse units, predefined set-level validation signals, and costly or inaccurate mixture search. We propose CLIVO, a target-aware framework connecting fine-grained semantic allocation, automatically learned validation objectives, and differentiable mixture search.
