Relative to established benchmarks such as GIFT-Eval, it emphasizes finer sampling resolutions and a greater prevalence of multivariate forecasting. Evaluating Chronos-2, TiRex-2, and TimesFM-3, we find that TimesFM-3 achieves the lowest source-balanced aggregate nMASE and nCRPS and leads seven of nine sources under each metric; source-specific exceptions reinforce the need for domain-representative evaluation for model selection. These findings also motivate improving domain alignment during pretraining, where real industrial data are often too scarce to close domain-specific gaps directly; we therefore investigate whether a domain's statistical structure can guide simulator design. In a case study on two offshore well-monitoring regimes, we improve a general simulator's coverage using an oscillator-augmented simulation pipeline. This lowers forecasting error in the target domain but reduces performance on the subset of GIFT-Eval with natively univariate targets. A 50/50 mixture of the general and augmented simulation recipes achieves the lowest error among the three training recipes for all four event-metric pairs in the case study while recovering most of the lost GIFT-Eval performance. Together, these results illustrate how domain-representative evaluation can guide model selection and the composition of simulated data while revealing a trade-off between specialization and generality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出IND-Eval基准，评估多模型在工业时序预测任务上的表现，发现TimesFM-3表现最佳，但需领域代表性评估；通过振荡器增强模拟器改进预训练，混合策略平衡专用性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准如GIFT-Eval在采样分辨率和多变量预测方面不足，且真实工业数据稀缺，难以直接缩小领域差距，需要更具代表性的评估基准和模拟数据设计方法。
AI.method: 构建IND-Eval基准，包含跨领域工业时序数据，评估Chronos-2、TiRex-2、TimesFM-3；针对海上井监测领域，设计振荡器增强模拟管线，对比通用模拟器、增强模拟器及50/50混合配方的预训练效果。
AI.result: TimesFM-3在源平衡聚合nMASE和nCRPS上最优，在九个来源中七个领先；振荡器增强模拟器降低目标领域预测误差，但在GIFT-Eval单变量子集上性能下降；50/50混合配方在四个事件-指标对中误差最低，并恢复大部分GIFT-Eval性能。
AI.conclusion: 领域代表性评估能指导模型选择和模拟数据组合，揭示专用化与泛化性之间的权衡。

title: A Node Embedding Framework for Model-Centric Conformance Checking in Process Mining
summary: Evaluating the quality of process models discovered from event logs is a fundamental challenge in process mining. Traditional evaluation relies on conformance metrics such as fitness and precision, which are highly sensitive to noise and deviations in event logs and therefore often fail to give a consistent assessment of discovery algorithms. We introduce a model-centric evaluation framework that combines node embeddings with Procrustes alignment to enable cross-graph comparability, since embeddings derived from different graphs reside in distinct vector spaces. The proposed PetriNetGraph method transforms Petri net process models into graph representations compatible with embedding algorithms. Comparing the node embeddings of ground-truth and discovered models through a parameterized cosine distance yields a unified and bounded metric for evaluating process discovery across datasets and methods. We evaluate the framework under static and context-aware scenarios to examine how prior knowledge of activity existence influences the assessment of structural similarity. The framework also integrates a compliance checking mechanism that localizes deviations at the activity level and an entropy-regularized node distance aggregation function that quantifies global deviations across the model. Experiments on nine publicly available event logs show that the approach provides a reliable embedding-based conformance indicator that reflects the behavior of fitness and precision. Experiments on synthetic logs with controlled noise levels confirm that it is substantially more robust to log deviations than traditional conformance metrics, PetriNet2Vec, and its dynamic-window and Procrustes-aligned variants, while remaining sensitive to process model degradation. All implementation details and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出基于节点嵌入和Procrustes对齐的模型中心评估框架，用于鲁棒评估过程发现算法。
AI.motivation: 传统一致性指标（如适配度和精确度）对噪声和偏差敏感，难以给出一致的发现算法评估，需要一种跨图可比、鲁棒的评估方法。
AI.method: 将Petri网转为图表示（PetriNetGraph），利用节点嵌入和Procrustes对齐实现跨图可比性，通过参数化余弦距离比较真实模型与发现模型的节点嵌入，得到统一有界度量；集成合规检查机制定位活动级偏差，熵正则化节点距离聚合函数量化全局偏差。
AI.result: 在九个公开事件日志上实验表明，该方法提供可靠的基于嵌入的一致性指标，反映适配度和精确度行为；在合成日志控制噪声实验中，比传统一致性指标、PetriNet2Vec及其变体更鲁棒，同时保持对过程模型退化的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为过程发现评估提供了一种鲁棒、跨数据集和方法可比的嵌入式一致性指标，有效解决了传统指标对噪声敏感的问题。

title: Counting with Attention and LayerNorm: Norm Scaling and Representation Geometry
summary: Counting is a simple task on which transformers can nevertheless fail at long sequence lengths. We study the cost of counting in a single attention layer, up to a maximum length $L$, focusing on how softmax attention and layer normalization shape the representation from which the count is recovered. We mainly focus on regression read-out but also consider classification read-out. For regression, we show unnormalized linear attention counts exactly at parameter norms independent of $L$. For softmax attention, regression cannot count exactly with finite parameters; it recovers the count after rounding, but only when the vector parameter norms grow with $L$. We measure this cost by $B_{\min}$, the smallest bound that can be placed on every trainable vector to ensure exact counting after rounding, and derive tight rates. At fixed model dimension, $B_{\min}$ grows as $L$ without normalization, as $L^{3/2}$ under bare post-normalization, and as $L^{3/4}$ with learned post-normalization. The last rate is unexpected: post-normalization discards the magnitude that carries the count and might be expected to make counting harder, yet with a learnable gain it counts at a smaller norm than softmax without normalization. Bare pre-normalization is different: it bounds the attention scores, so beyond a finite length no parameter norm suffices. A classification read-out keeps every norm bounded under every placement, but a dense head stores one output vector per count and costs more in storage. Experiments on the post-normalized model reproduce this split between the two read-outs. Together, our theoretical and empirical findings characterize how self-attention, layer-normalization placement, and read-out choice shape the representation geometry and parameter cost of counting in the minimal single-head architecture studied here.

AI.tldr: 论文研究单头注意力层中计数任务的参数代价，分析softmax注意力和层归一化位置对表示几何和参数范数的影响，发现回归读出需要参数范数随序列长度增长，而分类读出保持有界但存储成本更高。
AI.motivation: 理解Transformer中计数这一简单任务为何在长序列上失败，量化注意力机制、层归一化位置和读出方式对计数表示几何和参数代价的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析单层单头注意力架构，推导回归和分类读出下的最小参数范数界B_min，研究无归一化、前归一化、后归一化（裸和可学习增益）四种设置，并通过实验验证。
AI.result: 线性注意力无需范数增长即可精确计数；softmax注意力回归读出需范数随L增长：无归一化为L，裸后归一化为L^{3/2}，可学习后归一化为L^{3/4}；前归一化有限长度后无解；分类读出范数有界但存储成本高。实验验证了后归一化模型中两种读出的差异。
AI.conclusion: 自注意力、层归一化位置和读出选择共同决定计数任务的表示几何和参数代价；后归一化虽丢弃幅度信息，但配合可学习增益反而降低参数范数需求；分类读出以存储换取参数有界性。

title: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
summary: Training graphical user interface (GUI) agents with reinforcement learning suffers from sparse outcome rewards, leading to inefficient learning. Process rewards offer a promising direction for credit assignment to intermediate actions; however, accurately evaluating an action requires identifying evidence across long-horizon GUI trajectories, as its value may depend on information beyond its immediate state and observation. In this paper, we propose an adaptive-group process reward framework that dynamically partitions a GUI trajectory into semantically coherent subgoal groups, enabling process reward estimation at both the action and group levels. At the action level, a critic evaluates each action based on the visual changes and subsequent actions within the group for action correctness and contribution to the subgoal. At the group level, the framework aggregates action-level evaluations to assess subgoal completion and contribution to the overall task, and further refines these assessments by leveraging the context of all groups in the trajectory. The process reward of each action is obtained by combining its action-level evaluation with the refined group-level evaluation. We further augment GRPO's outcome advantage with the proposed process rewards to provide finer-grained guidance for GUI agent training. Experiments on process reward benchmarks and downstream RL training demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应分组过程奖励框架，用于解决GUI智能体强化学习训练中稀疏结果奖励导致的低效学习问题。该框架动态将GUI轨迹划分为语义连贯的子目标组，在动作级和组级进行过程奖励估计，并将过程奖励与GRPO的结果优势相结合，为GUI智能体训练提供更细粒度的指导。
AI.motivation: 使用强化学习训练图形用户界面（GUI）智能体面临稀疏结果奖励的问题，导致学习效率低下。过程奖励为中间动作的信用分配提供了有希望的方向；然而，准确评估一个动作需要识别长时程GUI轨迹中的证据，因为其价值可能取决于超出其即时状态和观察之外的信息。
AI.method: 提出自适应分组过程奖励框架，动态将GUI轨迹划分为语义连贯的子目标组。在动作级，评论家基于组内的视觉变化和后续动作评估每个动作的正确性和对子目标的贡献。在组级，框架聚合动作级评估以评估子目标完成度和对整体任务的贡献，并利用轨迹中所有组的上下文进一步优化这些评估。每个动作的过程奖励通过结合其动作级评估和优化后的组级评估获得。进一步将提出的过程奖励与GRPO的结果优势相结合，为GUI智能体训练提供更细粒度的指导。
AI.result: 在过程奖励基准测试和下游强化学习训练实验中，证明了所提出框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应分组过程奖励框架通过提供自适应的、层级化的过程奖励，有效捕捉长时程依赖关系，解决了GUI智能体强化学习中的稀疏奖励问题，提高了训练效率和性能。

title: Guidance Without Labels: Flow Matching from Coupled Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Flow matching models are typically trained to transport a Gaussian source to the data distribution, with source and target samples paired independently. We replace the source with a fitted Gaussian mixture and couple each data point to a mixture component through an entropic optimal transport problem. We show that the resulting transport reduces to the standard Gaussian-source problem up to a guidance-like correction, which enables the reuse of a pretrained velocity field. This correction is a closed-form function of the fitted mixture plus a term that we learn with a small correction network. We test our model on published checkpoints for CIFAR-10 and CelebA-HQ. It improves FID at every step count, and on CelebA-HQ it reaches the quality of the baseline with about half the steps. The closed-form term alone, with no training, already delivers most of this improvement; the small correction network accounts for the rest.

AI.tldr: 使用高斯混合替代高斯源，通过熵正则最优传输耦合数据点，得到闭式修正项加小网络，复用预训练速度场，显著提升采样效率。
AI.motivation: 标准流匹配使用独立配对的高斯源，导致传输路径次优；希望通过更好的源分布和耦合减少采样步数。
AI.method: 将源分布替换为拟合的高斯混合模型，通过熵正则最优传输将每个数据点耦合到混合分量，推导出包含闭式修正项和可学习小修正网络的修正速度场，复用预训练模型。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和CelebA-HQ上，所有步数下FID均提升；CelebA-HQ上仅需约一半步数达到基线质量；闭式项免训练即贡献大部分提升，小网络补足剩余。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过高斯混合源和最优传输耦合，以极低额外成本显著加速流匹配采样，闭式修正已足够有效，小网络进一步优化。

title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECG-RSI，一种递归自我改进框架，结合验证的波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索，在七个基准上将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的问答准确率从 34.57% 提升至 56.04%，分类 F1 从 24.27 提升至 34.03，并发现监督偏好从直接强化转向困惑聚焦对比，后续增益递减。
AI.motivation: 现有心电图模型缺乏针对动态弱点且忠实于波形证据的监督机制，需要一种能持续诊断错误并生成有效干预的自我改进框架。
AI.method: ECG-RSI 采用递归自我改进：利用信号重测验证波形编辑，构建错误指导生成器修复，学习器错误驱动干预生成，并在独立选择集上对比干预效果，实现反馈引导的干预搜索。
AI.result: 三轮迭代后，七个基准上平均问答准确率提升 21.47 个百分点，平均分类 F1 提升 9.76 点；监督偏好从直接强化转向困惑聚焦对比；持续反馈修正带来的外部增益逐渐递减。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将错误诊断与干预选择分离，并需验证反馈集上的增益是否能迁移至独立基准，为心电图模型的持续自我改进提供新范式。

title: Compression Through Time: An Interplay of Separability, Stationarity and Capacity
summary: Information-theoretic and geometric compression have been widely studied as possible explanations for generalization. Yet their temporal dynamics in recurrent networks remain largely unexplored. Using discretized LSTMs, whose finite embedding space enables direct estimates of information quantities, we observe pronounced compression across the final timesteps of many datasets. We explain this effect through three competing mechanisms: (i) class separability permits stronger compression at the final timestep; (ii) shared recurrent dynamics propagate this pressure across timesteps with similar activation states, making its extent depend on temporal stationarity; and (iii) limited representational capacity opposes prolonged compression because it restricts information available for subsequent computation. We systematically test these mechanisms through controlled synthetic interventions and real-world sequence tasks. Our results identify class separability, temporal stationarity, and network capacity as key determinants of temporal compression, and suggest that compression acts as a regularizer-potentially beneficial when excess capacity is available, but harmful to generalization when it consumes memory needed for the task.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了循环神经网络中信息压缩的时间动态，利用离散化LSTM观察到最后时间步的显著压缩，提出了三种竞争机制解释压缩，并通过实验验证了类别可分性、时间平稳性和网络容量是关键决定因素，指出压缩可作为正则化器，在容量充足时有益，在消耗任务所需内存时有害。
AI.motivation: 信息论和几何压缩被广泛研究作为泛化的解释，但其在循环网络中的时间动态鲜有探索。
AI.method: 使用离散化LSTM（有限嵌入空间可直接估计信息量），观察多个数据集最后时间步的压缩现象，提出三种竞争机制：类别可分性允许更强压缩、共享循环动力学跨时间步传播压力、有限表示容量对抗长期压缩，并通过受控合成干预和真实序列任务系统测试。
AI.result: 识别出类别可分性、时间平稳性、网络容量为时间压缩的关键决定因素；压缩作为正则化器，在过剩容量时有益，在消耗任务所需记忆时有害。
AI.conclusion: 压缩的时间动态由类别可分性、时间平稳性和网络容量共同决定，压缩可作为正则化器，其对泛化的影响取决于网络容量与任务需求的匹配。

title: Keep Your Receipts: Trustworthy Cleanup of Agent-Built Knowledge Graphs
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Agents build knowledge graphs as memory, and building them has become easy. Maintaining them has not. When a source is retracted, overruled, or erased, everything built on top of it (entity merges, entailed edges, community summaries) must be re-examined, and the maintainer must choose between deleting too much and too little. Deployed pipelines delete only the directly extracted facts: on our corpus that reduces contaminated queries from 32.2% to 28.0% under a real retraction and changes nothing under predicate revocation. Rebuilding is no repair for a constructor that samples: two builds of the same 300-document corpus differ in 29,475 artifacts, five times the 6,248 that removing the 61 retracted documents changes. PolyGraph instead asks the constructor for receipts: for every artifact, alternative bundles of source evidence, each claimed sufficient on its own, emitted in the call that creates it. Cleanup is then set arithmetic over the receipts, with no model calls. Because receipts are the model's own self-report, a re-derivation audit checks them by deleting the cited evidence and testing whether the constructor still produces the artifact. The audit finds that a receipt is trustworthy when it is shaped like the claim it backs. Merge receipts, each backing one narrow claim, agree with re-derivation 68% and 85% of the time. Summary receipts, elicited per sentence but stored as one flat list for the whole text, are wrong about two thirds of the time, almost always by keeping dead content. One receipt per sentence instead is 100% and 88% faithful and lets cleanup keep 33 of 35 touched summaries. The result holds under a second oracle model, a claim-blind prompt, ten further deletions, a second domain and a second constructor. Distrusting the summary layer cuts contaminated queries to 0.4% and 0.8% at 99.8 to 100% of the recall a perfect maintainer would return.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolyGraph 方法，通过让构造器为每个知识图谱工件生成“收据”（即足以支持该工件的替代证据包），将维护问题转化为集合运算，避免重建带来的非确定性差异。实验表明：合并类收据可信度 68%-85%，摘要类收据若按句子粒度生成则可达 100% 和 88% 忠实度，拒绝不可信摘要层后污染查询降至 0.4%-0.8%，召回率保持 99.8%-100%。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱构建易但维护难：当源文档被撤回、推翻或擦除，基于其构建的实体合并、蕴含边、社区摘要等均需重新审视。现有流水线仅删除直接抽取事实，污染查询仅从 32.2% 降至 28.0%；完全重建因构造器采样导致非确定性差异（同一语料两次构建相差 29,475 个工件，远超撤回 61 文档带来的 6,248 变化），并非有效修复。
AI.method: PolyGraph 要求构造器在创建每个工件时同步输出“收据”：多个互为替代的证据包，每包自称足以单独支持该工件。清理阶段仅对收据做集合运算，无需模型调用。通过“重推导审计”验证收据可信度：删除收据引用的证据，测试构造器是否仍产出该工件。发现合并收据（支撑窄声明）与重推导一致率 68%-85%；摘要收据若按整文本扁平存储则三分之二错误（多为保留失效内容），改为逐句生成一条收据则忠实度达 100% 和 88%，并能保留 35 个受影响摘要中的 33 个。
AI.result: 在真实撤回与谓词撤销两种场景下，拒绝不可信摘要层后，污染查询分别降至 0.4% 和 0.8%，召回率维持在完美维护者的 99.8%-100%。结论在第二个预言模型、盲声明提示、十次额外删除、第二个领域及第二个构造器下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 通过收据机制将维护降维为集合运算，并结合粒度细化的摘要收据与审计机制，PolyGraph 实现了无需重建、低污染、高召回的知识图谱增量维护，为不可靠构造器下的可靠知识管理提供了通用范式。

title: Making LoRA Identifiable: Orthogonal Alignment for Continual Learning
summary: There is growing interest in applying Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to Continual Learning, as it enables faster training, mitigates catastrophic forgetting, and facilitates better adaptation to new tasks. Prior approaches have explored a range of strategies, including extending new LoRA branches for each incoming task, training under orthogonal loss objectives across all task-specific LoRA modules, and employing gating mechanisms to integrate new and existing LoRA modules. However, these methods incur memory costs that grow linearly with the number of tasks, limiting their scalability. More recent approaches investigate training a single LoRA by leveraging asymmetries in its parameterization; however, they often suffer from insufficient representational alignment across the LoRA parameter space. To address these limitations, we propose Stiefel Optimization and Aligned Rotation (SOAR), a two-stage framework for continual LoRA learning. First, we constrain the A matrix to lie on the Stiefel manifold, thereby reducing coordinate misalignment to the space of orthogonal rotation matrices. Second, we introduce an Orthogonal Procrustes alignment procedure for the B matrix to estimate the optimal rotation, coupled with a per-rank retention merging strategy that quantifies directional agreement between representations of new and previously learned tasks. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks, demonstrating that SOAR achieves strong continual learning performance without incurring additional memory overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SOAR（Stiefel 优化与对齐旋转），一种用于持续 LoRA 学习的两阶段框架，通过将 A 矩阵约束在 Stiefel 流形上并利用正交 Procrustes 对齐 B 矩阵，结合逐秩保留合并策略，实现了无额外内存开销的强持续学习性能。
AI.motivation: 现有将 PEFT 应用于持续学习的方法要么为每个任务扩展新的 LoRA 分支、要么引入正交损失或门控机制，导致内存成随任务数线性增长，难以扩展；而单 LoRA 方法则因参数空间表示对齐不足而性能受限。
AI.method: SOAR 包含两阶段：第一阶段将 LoRA 的 A 矩阵约束在 Stiefel 流形上，将坐标错位简化为正交旋转矩阵空间；第二阶段对 B 矩阵引入正交 Procrustes 对齐过程以估计最优旋转，并设计逐秩保留合并策略，量化新旧任务表示间的方向一致性以实现知识保留与融合。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准上的大量实验表明，SOAR 在不增加额外内存开销的情况下，取得了优异的持续学习性能。
AI.conclusion: SOAR 通过流形约束与正交对齐有效解决了单 LoRA 持续学习中的表示对齐问题，提供了一种可扩展、内存高效的持续 LoRA 学习范式。

title: Upstream Influence, Downstream Re-Anchoring in LLM Agent Chains
summary: People act on evaluative judgments produced by LLM agents, and in multi-agent systems those judgments pass through several agents before reaching a person. We show that a workflow's information architecture---source access, handoff format, and which model reads the untrusted content---governs how much of a coordinated manipulation reaches the end. On 32 Taiwan~2025 recall cases, ten authentic Threads comments shown to one agent move its stance by $+0.171$ toward the injected position, and a mirrored set moves it the other way. Passing that judgment down a chain removes more than half of the shift by the third agent; keeping the comments in front of every agent sustains more of it. The reduction is not attrition in transit: each receiver discounts the inherited stance in proportion to how far it sits from its own reading of the evidence, returning to what that evidence implies for the case rather than to neutrality---consistent with partial re-anchoring. Handoff format is a second lever: a stance relayed without its reasoning is largely discounted. Susceptibility at the exposed seat varies fourfold across models, while the chain's arrangement does not matter at all. None of this is visible in the transcripts---the injected claims are almost never restated, so reasoning-trace audits miss the attack.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体LLM系统中评估判断的传播机制，发现信息架构（源访问、交接格式、读取非受信内容的模型）决定了协同操纵到达终端用户的程度。实验表明：单智能体受注入内容影响立场偏移+0.171；传递链中第三个智能体可消除超过一半偏移；保持注释在每个智能体前可维持更多偏移；减少非衰减而是部分重锚定；无推理的立场交接被大幅折扣；模型易感性差异四倍；链路拓扑无影响；攻击在推理轨迹中不可见。
AI.motivation: 人们基于LLM智能体产生的评估判断行动，多智能体系统中判断经多个智能体传递后才到达人类。需要理解协调操纵如何通过信息架构在智能体链中传播、放大或衰减，以及现有审计方法为何失效。
AI.method: 在32个台湾2025罢免案例上实验，向单智能体展示10条真实Threads评论（注入内容）测量立场偏移；构建智能体链测试传播衰减；对比保持/移除源注释、带/不带推理的交接格式；跨模型测试易感性；分析推理轨迹中注入内容的重述情况。
AI.result: 单智能体立场向注入位置偏移+0.171；链式传递至第三智能体消除>50%偏移；全程保持源注释可维持更多偏移；衰减源于部分重锚定——接收智能体按自身证据阅读距离折扣继承立场，回归证据蕴含而非中立；无推理的立场交接被大幅折扣；暴露席位模型易感性差异四倍；链路拓扑无显著影响；注入主张在轨迹中极少被重述，推理审计无法发现攻击。
AI.conclusion: 信息架构是控制多智能体系统中操纵传播的关键杠杆。保持源证据访问、要求推理完整交接、选择低易感性模型可显著缓解攻击。链式结构配合部分重锚定机制天然具备防御能力。现有基于推理轨迹的审计方法因注入内容不被重述而根本失效，需开发新型检测机制。

title: Feature-Context Consistency: Unsupervised Adversarial Detection with Drift Stability on Attributed Graphs
summary: Adversarial detection on evolving attributed graphs faces two challenges: fraud labels arrive late or not at all, and natural distributional drift erodes any trained decision boundary. Modern detectors can reach strong detection rates when labels are available and the distribution is stationary; sustaining that quality without labels and under drift is the open problem. We identify feature-context consistency -- the alignment between a node's attributes and its aggregated neighborhood attributes -- as a single structural signal that addresses both. We formalize it as the Context Boost (CB) score within a Restricted Boltzmann Machine framework (CB-RBM) and prove two complementary worst-case guarantees: a strict separation between the expected CB of legitimate and adversarial nodes, with gap growing linearly in model capacity, whenever the adversary's context stays far enough from legitimate neighborhood context; and a Wasserstein-Lipschitz bound on how far the CB distribution moves under natural drift. We validate on XBlock Ethereum phishing (~153K nodes) and Reddit banned-user detection (~11K nodes), with two further datasets in the appendix spanning diverse domains. With zero labels, CB-RBM achieves AUROC >= 0.96 on four adversarial attacks and keeps FPR close to its calibrated 5% target under drift -- outperforming supervised GNNs (hundreds of labels), unsupervised graph-anomaly baselines, and a standard RBM whose FPR collapses to 89-100%. What typically requires separate mechanisms -- label-free operation and drift stability -- here follows from a single structural regularity of the data. Code: https://github.com/serval-uni-lu/CB-RBM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CB-RBM（Context Boost Restricted Boltzmann Machine），利用节点属性与其邻域聚合属性之间的“特征-上下文一致性”这一单一结构信号，同时解决演化属性图上对抗检测的两大难题：标签稀缺/缺失与分布漂移。理论上证明了合法节点与对抗节点CB期望的严格分离（差距随模型容量线性增长）及CB分布在自然漂移下的Wasserstein-Lipschitz界。实验在以太坊钓鱼图(~153K节点)和Reddit封禁用户图(~11K节点)上验证：零标签下AUROC≥0.96，漂移下FPR稳定在校准的5%左右，显著优于监督GNN、无监督图异常基线和标准RBM（后者FPR崩塌至89-100%）。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗检测器在有标签且分布平稳时表现优异，但在真实演化图中面临两大挑战：1) 欺诈标签到达滞后甚至完全缺失；2) 自然分布漂移会侵蚀训练好的决策边界。需要一种无需标签且能抵抗漂移的统一检测机制。
AI.method: 识别“特征-上下文一致性”（节点自身属性与其聚合邻域属性的对齐度）为核心结构信号，将其形式化为受限玻尔兹曼机框架中的Context Boost (CB) 分数，构建CB-RBM模型。理论上给出两大最坏情况保证：(1) 当对抗者上下文与合法邻域上下文距离足够远时，合法与对抗节点的期望CB严格分离，差距随模型容量线性增长；(2) CB分布在自然漂移下的移动受Wasserstein-Lipschitz常数约束。
AI.result: 在四个跨域数据集（主文两个：以太坊钓鱼~153K节点、Reddit封禁用户~11K节点；附录两个）上验证：零标签条件下对四种对抗攻击AUROC≥0.96；分布漂移下FPR维持在校准的5%目标附近。性能显著优于监督GNN（需数百标签）、无监督图异常基线及标准RBM（后者FPR崩塌至89-100%）。
AI.conclusion: 特征-上下文一致性这一单一结构规律性，天然同时实现了无标签操作与漂移稳健性，无需分离机制。CB-RBM为演化属性图上的对抗检测提供了理论有保证、实证强有力的统一解决方案。

title: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
summary: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline. With GPT-5.6 Sol, it reaches 0.96 F1 versus Gandalf's 0.92 at 23% lower cost, with a wider margin on process criteria. On a paired fault-injection suite covering 13 families, several of which simulate reward hacking, Sauron detects 97% of injected failures while flagging only 2% of clean controls, outperforming baselines even when they are given the full trace. On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.

AI.tldr: Sauron是一种证据优先的智能体验证器，通过同时调查环境状态和执行轨迹，独立验证声明后再依赖其，解决了长时程半可验证任务中基于评分规则评估的证据分散、裁判易忽略证据或接受无支持声明的问题。实验表明Sauron在多个基准上F1最高、成本更低，且在故障注入和真实错误检测任务中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程、半可验证的智能体任务常采用基于评分规则的评估，但评估所需证据分散在环境状态和执行轨迹中。裁判可能忽略证据或接受无支持的声明（包括智能体自我报告的成功），当评分规则判决用作强化学习奖励时，此类错误会强化不良行为。现有验证器缺乏系统性的证据调查与独立验证机制。
AI.method: 提出Sauron，一种证据优先的智能体验证器：1）同时调查环境状态和执行轨迹；2）仅在独立验证声明与其来源一致后才依赖该声明；3）采用有界查询和相关准则联合调查，减少上下文使用和冗余工作；4）每个判决附带可审计的证据凭证。
AI.result: 在100个个人助手回合的2586个人工标注准则上，Sauron在所有八个骨干模型上F1最高且成本低于最强基线Gandalf。使用GPT-5.6 Sol时达0.96 F1（Gandalf 0.92），成本降低23%，在过程准则上优势更大。在覆盖13类故障的配对故障注入套件（含模拟奖励黑客）中，Sauron检出97%注入故障，仅误报2%干净对照，即使基线获得完整轨迹也优于它们。在检测和定位真实智能体错误的TRAIL基准上，Sauron在三个质量指标上均领先Gandalf和TRAIL自带裁判。
AI.conclusion: Sauron通过证据优先、独立验证和可审计凭证，有效解决了长时程智能体任务评估中的证据分散和裁判失误问题，在准确性、成本和鲁棒性上均显著优于现有验证器，为基于评分规则的强化学习奖励提供了更可靠的评估基础。

title: Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Language models have recently solved open Erdős problems and achieved gold-medal level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. But their solutions, written in natural language, cannot yet be verified by proof assistants. An erroneous reasoning step can invalidate every step that comes after, so it is advantageous to detect errors early. Several methods have been proposed to detect erroneous reasoning quickly based on the features of the forward pass of the language model that performs reasoning. In this work, we study whether the directed Forman curvature of that model's attention graph, a local quantity computed at an edge from the attention weights around it, carries information about a step's correctness. To do so, we evaluate four per-step verifiers on ProcessBench with and without the curvature appended to their input. Appending curvature values improves the overall mean performance of all four verifiers. ReProbe, the verifier that takes every token of a step as input, shows the largest improvement. Adding the curvature increases the time of the language model's forward pass by 18% on average.

AI.tldr: 研究利用有向 Forman 曲率作为注意力图的局部特征，辅助逐步验证器在 ProcessBench 上检测推理错误，实验表明添加曲率特征能提升所有验证器的平均性能，其中 ReProbe 提升最大，但会增加约 18% 的前向传播时间。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在数学问题上表现优异，但其自然语言解答无法被证明助手直接验证，推理步骤中的错误会传播导致后续步骤失效，因此需要早期检测错误。现有方法利用前向传播特征检测错误，本文探索注意力图的有向 Forman 曲率是否蕴含步骤正确性信息。
AI.method: 在 ProcessBench 上评估四个逐步验证器，分别在输入中拼接有向 Forman 曲率特征（基于注意力权重计算的局部边级量）与不拼接两种设置，对比性能差异。
AI.result: 拼接曲率特征后，所有四个验证器的整体平均性能均有提升；以逐 token 为输入的 ReProbe 验证器提升幅度最大；引入曲率计算使语言模型前向传播时间平均增加 18%。
AI.conclusion: 有向 Forman 曲率作为注意力图的局部几何特征，能有效增强逐步验证器的推理错误检测能力，尤其对细粒度验证器效果显著，但需权衡计算开销。

title: Safety for Whom? Benchmarking Understanding Beyond Refusal in Egocentric Multimodal Assistants
summary: Egocentric multimodal assistants see through the user's eyes and guide what the user does next, so their outputs directly shape physical actions, including those that affect bystanders. Yet existing safety evaluations do not distinguish whom a response would harm, and score only whether a model refuses. Pooling all harms into one refusal rate hides two failures: a model may protect one target but not another, and it may refuse without understanding the risk, or understand it and comply anyway. We present STOU, a benchmark of 2,902 egocentric video-audio and video-text queries whose potential harm targets the user (Self), co-present individuals (The Others), or society at large (Others). Our evaluation decouples safety understanding from refusal behavior: beyond refusal, we score whether the model recognizes the user's intent, the presence and target of harm, and its downstream consequences. Across 10 open and closed source omnimodal and multimodal LLMs, we find that refusal varies systematically with the harm target, and that models often recognize a harm yet still assist with it. These results show that refusal rates alone cannot certify an assistant as safe, and that safety alignment must account for who would be harmed. Project page: https://onedayoneyeah.github.io/safety-for-whom

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STOU 基准，包含 2,902 个以自我为中心的视频-音频和视频-文本查询，按危害对象分为用户自身、共在他人和社会大众三类。评测将安全理解与拒答行为解耦，考察模型对用户意图、危害存在及目标、后果的识别。实验发现 10 个多模态大模型的拒答率随危害对象系统性变化，且模型常在识别危害后仍予以协助，证明单纯拒答率无法认证安全性，安全对齐必须考虑危害对象。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评测未区分危害作用于谁（用户、旁观者、社会），仅统计拒答率，掩盖了两类失效：对不同对象的保护不均衡，以及“拒答不代表理解风险”或“理解风险却仍配合”的脱节。自我中心多模态助手直接影响物理动作，需更细粒度的安全评估。
AI.method: 构建 STOU 基准（2,902 条自我中心视频-音频/视频-文本查询），按危害目标标注为 Self、The Others、Others。设计四维评测指标：用户意图识别、危害存在性识别、危害目标识别、下游后果识别，并与拒答行为解耦。在 10 个开/闭源全模态/多模态 LLM 上进行系统评测。
AI.result: 拒答率随危害目标系统性变化；模型常能识别危害却仍提供协助；不同模型在三类危害目标上的理解-行为一致性差异显著。拒答率无法单独作为安全认证指标。
AI.conclusion: 安全评测必须区分危害作用对象，并将安全理解与拒答行为解耦考量。未来安全对齐需针对不同危害目标设计差异化策略，而非依赖单一拒答率指标。

title: Learn from Move: the Next Step for GUI Agents
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/ti-mm/LearnFromMove ; Benchmark and training data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/OpenMOSS-Team/LatentGUIWorld
summary: Existing benchmarks for GUI agents primarily focus on increasing task difficulty by extending task horizons. Besides, enabling agents to explore unfamiliar environments and successfully complete tasks within them is also a critical yet challenging problem. We introduce LatentGUIWorld, a benchmark of six tasks in three matched pairs organized by the evidence needed for control: $I_0$ uses prior knowledge and available observations, $I_1$ requires interaction that directly reveals hidden semantics, and $I_2$ identifies dynamics from action-response relationships. Frontier models struggle especially on $I_2$ tasks. We introduce MOVE, which separates movement from button events and exposes intermediate visual feedback, together with demonstrations of iterative exploration and control. Ablations show that both action granularity and multi-step demonstrations improve performance. After SFT, LatentLearner-9B achieves 50.0% overall success on LatentGUIWorld, comparable to several frontier models. Joint RL further raises egocentric Drag and Ten-Choice success to 92.0% and 75.3%. Behavioral analysis reveals multi-step exploration. In egocentric Drag, RL increases Pearson correlation between error-normalized commands and ideal gain compensation from 0.610 to 0.803. Together, these behaviors show that models learn to explore through interaction and adapt their control to environment dynamics. The same format improves GUI grounding after RL, reaching 67.37% mean accuracy across five benchmarks versus 66.72% for conventional RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LatentGUIWorld基准测试，评估GUI智能体在未知环境中的探索与控制能力，引入MOVE方法分离移动与按钮事件并提供中间视觉反馈，结合SFT与RL训练LatentLearner-9B模型，在LatentGUIWorld上达到50%整体成功率，RL进一步提升特定任务性能，并展现出多步探索与自适应控制行为，同时改善GUI定位任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体基准主要通过延长任务时长增加难度，但缺乏对智能体在陌生环境中探索并完成任务能力的系统评估；需要按所需证据类型组织任务，研究智能体如何通过交互发现隐含语义和识别环境动力学。
AI.method: 构建LatentGUIWorld基准，包含六个任务按证据需求分为三类（I0先验知识+观察，I1交互揭示隐含语义，I2从动作-响应识别动力学）；提出MOVE架构，将移动与按钮事件解耦并暴露中间视觉反馈，提供迭代探索与控制演示；采用SFT微调LatentLearner-9B，再结合联合RL训练。
AI.result: SFT后LatentLearner-9B在LatentGUIWorld整体成功率50.0%，接近前沿模型；联合RL将自我中心拖拽任务成功率提至92.0%，十选一任务至75.3%；行为分析显示RL显著提升误差归一化指令与理想增益补偿的皮尔逊相关性（0.610→0.803），证实模型学会多步探索并自适应调整控制；同格式RL在五个GUI定位基准上平均准确率达67.37%，优于传统RL的66.72%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过分离动作粒度、提供中间反馈与多步演示，结合SFT与RL，可使模型在未知GUI环境中学会主动探索、识别动力学并自适应控制，该范式不仅提升基准任务性能，还能泛化改善GUI定位等下游任务。

title: DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?
summary: End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. DuplexAct contains 4,691 test instances spanning casual conversation, meetings, customer service, and interviews, including 2,531 instances derived from real-world conversational recordings. Together, DuplexAct provides a structured and real-world-grounded framework for systematically assessing how E2E FD-SLMs participate in ongoing spoken interaction.

AI.tldr: DuplexAct是一个用于评估端到端全双工口语模型(E2E FD-SLMs)交互动作执行能力的基准，包含三层动作分类法、八种交互动作、24种交互条件，以及即时执行和后续跟进两个维度的评估指标，涵盖4,691个测试实例，其中2,531个来自真实对话录音，覆盖闲聊、会议、客服、面试等场景。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏结构化的动作层面定义，通常只评估动作发生而非成功与否，且真实对话场景覆盖有限，无法系统评估E2E FD-SLMs在持续口语交互中的表现。
AI.method: 提出DuplexAct基准，定义三层动作分类法（8种交互动作、24种交互条件），将成功动作执行表征为即时执行和后续跟进两个维度，开发针对各动作的专用评估指标，并构建包含4,691个测试实例的数据集（含2,531个真实对话衍生实例），覆盖闲聊、会议、客服、面试四大场景。
AI.result: DuplexAct为E2E FD-SLMs提供了结构化、基于真实世界的评估框架，能够系统评估模型在持续口语交互中参与交互动作的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了现有评估体系的空白，为全双工口语模型的交互动作研究提供了标准化测试平台，推动更自然、更有效的口语交互系统发展。

title: Before Attention Sinks Form: Hidden-State Geometry Reveals and Modulates Their Formation
summary: Attention sinks are usually studied after they have formed. We ask whether a measurable hidden-state change appears beforehand and whether changing that geometry alters what happens later. To remove network depth as a shortcut, we compare prompts in the same model and at the same layer. When sink timing varies across prompts, simple spectral summaries of the hidden states add information beyond current attention, with the clearest prompt-specific signal in a short window about two to three layers before sink formation. The predictive strength varies across cohorts, so we treat the spectrum as a readout of a pre-sink state change rather than a universal warning statistic. The signal is broader than one measured extreme activation. We then modify only the singular values of the post-layer hidden states after current attention has already been computed. These interventions change later sink behavior in Qwen2.5, GLM-Z1, and GPT-OSS relative to norm-matched random spectral perturbations. In Qwen2.5, the immediate suppressive effect is accompanied by a reduction in next-layer query--key preference for position~0, and the learned spectral directions remain stable when estimated from substantially less training data. Together, the results show that attention sinks are preceded by a short spectral reorganization of hidden states, and directly perturbing this geometry can causally alter subsequent sink formation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究注意力汇聚形成前的隐藏状态谱重组现象，发现汇聚前2-3层存在预测性谱信号，通过仅修改奇异值的干预可因果性地改变后续汇聚行为，且学习到的谱方向具有数据效率稳健性。
AI.motivation: 注意力汇聚通常在形成后被研究。本文旨在探究：汇聚形成前是否存在可测量的隐藏状态几何变化？改变该几何是否能因果性地改变后续汇聚行为？
AI.method: 1. 在同一模型、同一层比较不同提示词，消除网络深度作为捷径的影响。2. 利用隐藏状态的谱摘要（奇异值分析）捕捉汇聚前信号，发现最强预测窗口在汇聚形成前2-3层。3. 仅在注意力计算后修改后层隐藏状态的奇异值（保持范数匹配），进行因果干预实验。4. 在Qwen2.5、GLM-Z1、GPT-OSS三个模型上验证，并分析Qwen2.5中下一层query-key对位置0的偏好变化及谱方向的数据稳健性。
AI.result: 1. 汇聚时间随提示词变化时，隐藏状态谱提供超越当前注意力的提示词特异性信号，最清晰窗口在汇聚前2-3层。2. 预测强度随群体变化，谱应视为汇聚前状态变化的读出而非通用预警统计量。3. 信号比单一极端激活更宽泛。4. 仅修改奇异值的干预能显著改变三模型的后续汇聚行为，优于范数匹配的随机谱扰动。5. Qwen2.5中表现为即时抑制效应及下一层query-key对位置0偏好的降低。6. 学习到的谱方向在大幅减少训练数据时仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 注意力汇聚之前存在短暂的隐藏状态谱重组，直接扰动这一几何结构可因果性地改变后续汇聚形成，揭示了汇聚机制的前驱动态与可干预性。

title: Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover scientific equations from experimental data. Such a discovery system has two parts that must work together: a library of executable computational tools and the model's tool-use policy. The tools supply the solving capability, from diagnosing structure in the data to fitting candidate equations; the policy plans and orchestrates their use. Yet existing systems adapt only one part, keeping either the toolset or the model fixed, which leaves the corresponding failures uncorrectable. We develop a coupled evolution framework that improves both parts from the same verifiable fit-error signal. In the tool-evolution phase, an agent grows an executable tool library from a small set of generic numerical operations by diagnosing its own failures: it authors a new tool when a capability is missing and revises its selection rules when the right tool went unused. In the policy-evolution phase, a small open model (roughly 3B active parameters) is fine-tuned on successful tool-use trajectories collected with the frozen library, on training formulas screened to be disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. Ablations show the two phases are complementary: with no tool library at all the same model solves almost nothing, the tools account for most of the gain, and trajectory training adds a further gain that is largest on the most difficult problems. The full system solves 79.1/71.3\% of LSR-Synth problems at fit tolerances $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$, reaches 63.8\% pooled accuracy on the distributionally different SRSD-Feynman panel, and obtains a normalized CP3-28 aggregate of $-7.27$. These results suggest a broader recipe for scientific agents: let the model and its instruments improve each other under verifiable feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种耦合进化框架，用于从实验数据中自动发现科学方程。该框架同时优化可执行工具库和模型的工具使用策略，两者通过可验证的拟合误差信号相互改进。在工具进化阶段，智能体从通用数值运算出发，通过诊断自身失败来生成新工具或修正选择规则；在策略进化阶段，利用冻结工具库收集的成功轨迹微调小规模开放模型（约3B活跃参数）。实验表明，工具库贡献了主要性能提升，轨迹训练在难题上增益最大。完整系统在LSR-Synth上达到79.1%/71.3%（容差10⁻²/10⁻³），在SRSD-Feynman上池化准确率63.8%，CP3-28归一化聚合分-7.27。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学方程发现系统要么固定工具库只优化策略，要么固定模型只扩展工具，导致另一部分的失败无法纠正。作者旨在开发一种耦合进化机制，使工具库和工具使用策略能在同一可验证反馈信号（拟合误差）下共同改进，从而构建更鲁棒的科学智能体。
AI.method: 框架包含两个交替阶段：1) 工具进化阶段：智能体从少量通用数值操作出发，通过诊断自身失败（能力缺失时编写新工具、正确工具未被使用时修正选择规则）自动增长可执行工具库。2) 策略进化阶段：冻结工具库，收集成功的工具使用轨迹，在与评测基准不相交的训练公式上微调约3B参数的开放模型。两阶段以拟合误差为统一反馈信号耦合迭代。
AI.result: 消融实验显示：无工具库时模型几乎无法求解；工具库贡献主要增益；轨迹训练提供额外增益，且在最难问题上增益最大。完整系统在LSR-Synth上拟合容差10⁻²/10⁻³下分别解决79.1%/71.3%问题；在分布差异较大的SRSD-Feynman面板上池化准确率63.8%；CP3-28归一化聚合得分-7.27。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明了一种更通用的科学智能体构建配方：让模型及其工具在可验证反馈下相互改进。耦合进化框架同时优化工具库与策略，有效解决了单边固定导致的失败不可纠正问题，显著提升了科学方程发现的性能和泛化能力。

title: NFMap: Topographic 2D Manifold Learning with Invertible Normalizing Flows
summary: We present NFMap, a dimensionality reduction method for 2D visualisation that extends Generative Topographic Mapping (GTM) with a bijective normalizing flow. Like GTM, NFMap places a fixed mixture grid prior over a 2D latent map, giving a parametric embedding, an explicit likelihood, and the ability to project new points onto an existing map; the likelihood is an effective out-of-distribution signal on chemical datasets. Unlike GTM, whose latent-to-data mapping is an RBF network of bounded flexibility, NFMap's mapping is a normalizing flow, and is therefore fully invertible: any location on the map can be carried back to data space. To alleviate map crowding on large datasets, NFMap additionally supports heavy-tailed Student-t mixture components. NFMap maps data to a latent space of the same dimension, split into a 2-dimensional navigable map and an off-manifold residual. Because the flow is bijective and its objective penalises volume contraction, variance squeezed out of the residual must reappear in the navigable map. The residual scale is the main control between local neighbourhood fidelity and global distance fidelity; its effect depends on the dimensionality of the data and is coupled to the extent of the latent grid.

AI.tldr: NFMap 是一种基于生成拓扑映射（GTM）并结合双射正则化流的二维可视化降维方法，通过固定混合网格先验、可逆流映射和重尾学生 t 分布组件，实现参数化嵌入、显式似然、新点投影及局部/全局保真度的可控平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 GTM 方法虽提供参数化嵌入和显式似然，但其潜在到数据的映射基于 RBF 网络，灵活性受限且不可逆。需一种既能保留 GTM 优势（如参数化嵌入、似然计算、新点投影、异常检测），又能实现完全可逆映射、缓解大数据集拥挤、并允许在局部邻域保真与全局距离保真间灵活权衡的降维方法。
AI.method: NFMap 扩展 GTM：1) 在二维潜在图上放置固定混合网格先验（支持高斯或学生 t 分布组件）；2) 使用双射正则化流作为潜在到数据的映射，保证完全可逆；3) 将潜在空间拆分为二维可导航图和流形外残差维度；4) 目标函数惩罚体积收缩，迫使从残差挤出的方差重现于可导航图；5) 通过残差尺度参数控制局部与全局保真度的权衡，该参数与数据维度和潜在网格范围耦合。
AI.result: NFMap 在化学数据集上展示了有效的分布外检测能力；可逆流映射使任意图上位置可回溯至数据空间；学生 t 混合组件缓解了大数据集的拥挤问题；残差尺度提供了局部邻域保真与全局距离保真之间的主要控制手段，其效果随数据维度和网格范围变化。
AI.conclusion: NFMap 结合了 GTM 的参数化嵌入优势与正则化流的完全可逆性，通过引入残差维度和重尾分布，实现了灵活的局部/全局保真度权衡，为高维数据的二维可视化提供了具有显式似然、可投影新点、可逆映射及拥挤缓解能力的统一框架。

title: Instructions Are Evidence, Not Objectives: Measuring Outcome Alignment of Agents
summary: Large language model agents can follow complex human instructions to solve real-world tasks. In practice, however, initial instructions are often incomplete. In our analysis of 100 user-agent trajectories from SWE-chat, 56\% of initial instructions omit requirements that later emerge as necessary, and 52\% of the useful follow-up requirements could have been inferred from the project. A user states requirements from their own understanding of the task, and these \textbf{stated requirements} often differ from the \textbf{true requirements} that completing the task imposes. An agent should therefore treat the instruction as evidence rather than as the objective, inferring the true requirements from the instruction and the environment and satisfying them even when the user is not yet aware of all of them. We call this ability \textbf{outcome alignment}. In this work, we construct \textbf{TiGanEval}, a benchmark of software engineering and research tasks. In every task the user genuinely lacks part of the requirements, each requirement stays discoverable from the code and runtime behaviour of the environment, and requirements the agent infers are separated from those the user adds after observing delivered work. These properties together make outcome alignment measurable. Evaluating eight frontier models including GPT-5.6-Sol, we find outcome alignment broadly missing: the models lose 53 to 67 points of success rate when moving from the full specification to the partial instruction, and consequence feedback across four submissions does not close the gap. Furthermore, a plan-mode harness cannot compensate for the missing ability of the model itself, which places outcome alignment among the abilities the next generation of models should be developed for.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了'结果对齐'概念，指LLM代理从不完整指令和环境中推断真实需求的能力，而非仅遵循用户陈述的需求。构建了TiGanEval基准测试8个前沿模型，发现结果对齐能力普遍缺失：从完整规范转为部分指令时成功率下降53-67分，后续反馈无法弥补差距，规划模式也无法补偿模型自身缺陷。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中初始指令常不完整（SWE-chat中56%指令遗漏后续必要需求，52%有用后续需求本可从项目推断）。用户陈述需求（stated requirements）常与完成任务所需的真实需求（true requirements）不同。代理应将指令视为证据而非目标，从指令和环境推断真实需求并满足它们。
AI.method: 构建TiGanEval基准，包含软件工程和研究任务。每个任务中用户真正缺乏部分需求，每个需求均可从代码和运行时行为发现，代理推断的需求与用户观察交付后添加的需求分离。评估8个前沿模型（含GPT-5.6-Sol），对比完整规范与部分指令下的表现，测试后果反馈（4轮提交）和规划模式的补偿效果。
AI.result: 所有模型结果对齐能力普遍缺失：从完整规范转为部分指令时成功率下降53-67个百分点。4轮后果反馈无法缩小差距。规划模式 harness 无法补偿模型自身缺失的结果对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果对齐是下一代模型应重点开发的核心能力。当前前沿模型在面对不完整指令时无法有效从环境推断真实需求，单纯增加交互轮次或规划机制无法解决根本问题，需要模型内在具备从指令和环境联合推断真实目标的能力。

title: Is the Platform Part of the Measurement? A Protocol and Simulation Study for Cross-Platform Equivalence of Machine-Labelled Policy Sentiment
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. Includes an original 500-replication simulation study. Code: https://github.com/asadfix/platform-measurement (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23105129)
summary: Comparing machine-labelled sentiment across social media platforms is now routine: differences in classifier scores between platforms are read as differences in public opinion. These comparisons rest on an assumption that the classifier measures the same construct, on the same scale, on every platform. Some studies check a classifier's validity platform by platform, but to our knowledge none has modelled the platform as a facet of the classifier's measurement. We adapt the psychometric equivalence toolkit (generalizability theory, measurement invariance and differential item functioning, and score linking) to machine-labelled policy sentiment, treating the platform as a survey mode, and specify a six-step protocol with anchor events fixed in advance, an anchor-density audit, and a two-classifier convergence control. A simulation with known ground truth illustrates what the assumption can cost in one generating configuration fixed in advance: across 500 replications, because the platforms measure through different functions, a pooled index that takes platform scores at face value reports the wrong sign of aggregate sentiment on nearly a quarter of days, whereas an index adjusted with each platform's known measurement function does so on under one day in sixty on average. A case study of the instrument from the first author's MSc dissertation, a fine-tuned BERT classifier over 255,446 UK economic-policy comments from Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, and Quora, motivates the design and illustrates the instrument-dependence the protocol addresses. The full four-platform application, under fresh collection with the pre-specified design, is the designated follow-up study. The protocol lets a researcher test whether pooling platforms is defensible in a given corpus, or whether platform scores must be linked before any average is taken.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨社交媒体平台的机器标注情感比较问题，指出直接汇总不同平台分类器得分的做法假设测量等价性，但缺乏心理测量学验证。作者引入心理测量等价工具包（一般化理论、测量不变性、差异项目功能、分数链接），将平台视为调查模式，提出六步验证协议。模拟实验显示：未调整的汇总指数在近四分之一天报错情感符号，调整后不足1/60。案例研究基于255,446条英国经济政策评论（BERT微调分类器），验证协议可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常直接对比不同社交媒体平台的机器标注情感得分，视其为公众意见差异，但这依赖于一个未经验证的假设：分类器在各平台测量同一构念、同一量表。虽然部分研究逐平台验证分类器效度，但尚无研究将平台建模为分类器测量的一个侧面。
AI.method: 改编心理测量等价工具包：一般化理论、测量不变性与差异项目功能（DIF）、分数链接。将平台视作调查模式，设计六步协议：预先固定锚定事件、锚定密度审计、双分类器收敛控制。通过已知真值的模拟实验（500次重复）评估假设违背的代价；案例研究使用首作者硕士论文工具（微调BERT），覆盖Twitter/X、Reddit、YouTube、Quora四平台255,446条英国经济政策评论。
AI.result: 模拟显示：若平台通过不同函数测量，直接汇总平台得分的指数在近25%天数报错聚合情感符号；经各平台已知测量函数调整后，错误率降至平均不足1/60。案例研究阐释了协议解决的工具依赖性问题。完整四平台应用（按预注册设计重新采集）为后续研究。
AI.conclusion: 该协议使研究者能在给定语料中检验跨平台汇总是否合理，或必须先进行分数链接才能取平均。强调跨平台情感比较需心理测量学严谨性，避免直接解释原始分类器得分差异为意见差异。

title: Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Asia-Pacific Solar Research Conference (APSRC 2026), Canberra, Australia, 1-3 December 2026
summary: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.

AI.tldr: 提出Tricorder系统：融合LiDAR-SLAM、几何校准RGB/热成像与机器学习目标检测分割，实现光伏板下资产（MC4连接器、连接状态、热异常、螺栓/螺母/扭矩管等）的3D视觉-热成像自动化检测与空间定位，将缺陷关联至具体资产及其三维位置。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模光伏巡检以空中航测为主，仅能识别组件级热斑，对面板下关键部件（连接器、电缆、紧固件、结构件）可见性极低；这些资产难以大规模一致性检测，缺陷空间尺寸小、常被遮挡且难以从孤立图像定位。
AI.method: 结合LiDAR-惯性SLAM重建三维环境，几何校准RGB与热成像，利用机器学习目标检测与分割识别资产；将检测结果关联至三维重建模型，实现多视角视觉与热观测的空间融合与精确定位。
AI.result: 在实用规模光伏数据上验证：MC4连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别、结构组件（螺栓、螺母、扭矩管）检测均取得有效结果。
AI.conclusion: 展示了从基于图像的检测迈向空间定位自主检测的路径：缺陷不仅被检出，更被关联至光伏电站内具体资产及其三维位置，为大规模资产管理提供空间化依据。

title: Relational Learning as World Modeling
summary: Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. Given executions from an unseen world, TabWM uses them as context to predict the sparse structured edits caused by a new action without parameter updates. Across 512 held-out worlds, complete-edit F1 rises from 0.016 with no observed executions to 0.685 with 64, where a correct edit must match its operation, relational location, and value. Because these predictions are explicit relational edits, they can be applied recursively to imagine candidate futures and compare actions before they are taken. Broader search over these predicted futures improves the realized return of selected action sequences. Together, these results suggest that relational dynamics can be learned in context, broadening relational learning from modeling system state to modeling how that state changes under action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 TabWM（表格世界模型）和 WorldRel（关系世界生成器），通过上下文学习预测关系数据库在动作下的结构化编辑，实现了从建模系统状态到建模状态如何随动作变化的转变。
AI.motivation: 传统关系学习侧重于从数据库状态进行预测，但决策制定需要回答：状态在动作作用下将如何变化？运营系统中这种动态往往不可见于数据库本身，因此需要模型从观察到的执行轨迹中推断系统行为。
AI.method: 构建了 WorldRel 生成器创建可执行的关系世界用于预训练。TabWM 利用观察到的执行轨迹作为上下文，无需参数更新即可预测新动作导致的稀疏结构化编辑（操作、关系位置、数值）。
AI.result: 在 512 个保留世界上，完整编辑 F1 从无观察执行时的 0.016 提升至有 64 条执行时的 0.685。预测的显式关系编辑可递归应用以想象候选未来、比较动作，更广泛的搜索能提升选定动作序列的实际回报。
AI.conclusion: 关系动态可通过上下文学习习得，将关系学习从建模系统状态扩展到建模状态如何在动作下演化，为决策制定提供了新的范式。

title: Memory Echo in Single-Agent Long-Term Memory: Lifecycle Evaluation and Provenance-Guided Mitigation
summary: Long-term memory supports agents across sessions. Repeated retrieval and write-back can let one historical claim occupy multiple retrieval positions and influence current answers without independent evidence. Existing work examines retrieval, updating, and question answering, leaving same-source record accumulation and post-correction persistence underexplored. Motivated by research in social cognition and memory psychology on repeated exposure, retrieval, and revision, we define \emph{Memory Echo} as the excess retrieval exposure gained by historical information from the same source without additional independent evidence, and introduce MEchoBench to evaluate its emergence, correction resistance, persistence, and effect on answers. To address this phenomenon, we introduce the Family--Provenance--Authority framework (FPA). Specifically, FPA selects one representative per source family, conditions the eligibility of old records for the answer context on verified corrections, and constrains final answers with authoritative evidence. In paired replay on 190 fixed questions across four memory frameworks, FPA raises accuracy from 0.825 to 0.920 with DeepSeek V4 Flash and from 0.782 to 0.916 with Kimi K2.6; mean Decision Contamination Effect falls from 0.106 to 0.030 and from 0.109 to 0.038, respectively. These results show that agent memory can preserve traceable history without allowing repeated historical information to govern current decisions. The code is available at https://github.com/OrcasSam/memory-echo-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Memory Echo 现象，指同源历史信息在无独立证据下获得过度检索曝光，并构建 MEchoBench 评估基准，提出 Family-Provenance-Authority (FPA) 框架缓解该问题，实验显著提升准确率并降低决策污染效应。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆支持跨会话代理，但重复检索和写回导致同源历史声明占据多个检索位置，无独立证据即影响当前答案。现有工作关注检索、更新和问答，忽视了同源记录累积和修正后持久性问题。受社会认知和记忆心理学中重复暴露、检索和修正研究启发，定义 Memory Echo 并构建基准评估其涌现、抗修正性、持久性及对答案的影响。
AI.method: 提出 Family-Provenance-Authority (FPA) 框架：每个源家族选取一个代表，旧记录进入答案上下文的资格取决于经验证的修正，最终答案受权威证据约束。在四个记忆框架上进行 190 个固定问题的配对重放实验，使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 Kimi K2.6 模型。
AI.result: FPA 将 DeepSeek V4 Flash 准确率从 0.825 提升至 0.920，Kimi K2.6 从 0.782 提升至 0.916；平均决策污染效应分别从 0.106 降至 0.030 和从 0.109 降至 0.038。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明代理记忆可以保留可追溯历史，同时避免重复历史信息主导当前决策。代码已开源。

title: Efficient Preconditioned Optimization Methods with Frequent Directions
summary: Adaptive optimization methods have received considerable attention in recent years due to their strong empirical performance. However, they generally require maintaining a preconditioning matrix, which incurs prohibitive computational overhead in large-scale applications. To address these limitations, we investigate the acceleration of preconditioned optimization methods through frequent directions (FD), a widely used matrix sketching technique. We first propose FTSL by integrating FD with adaptive subgradient methods under the primal-dual framework and adding back the cumulative information discarded by FD. FTSL obtains a tighter regret bound than existing state-of-the-art results. We then apply a doubling trick that further reduces the time complexity of FTSL, while maintaining the same regret guarantee. We also consider optimization over matrix-valued decision variables and exploit their structural properties to construct sketched preconditioners. We develop FTSL-Shampoo by adapting FD to Shampoo and give a novel analysis under the primal-dual framework. To further mitigate its computational complexity, we design one-sided variants of FTSL-Shampoo under both mirror descent and primal-dual frameworks. Our algorithms not only reduce the computational cost of FTSL-Shampoo, but also achieve tighter regret bounds. We extend our methods to offline stochastic convex optimization and exploit smoothness to achieve faster convergence rates. Finally, we introduce practical variants of our algorithms and empirically demonstrate their efficiency and effectiveness across a broad range of tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于频繁方向（FD）矩阵草图技术的自适应优化算法，解决大规模应用中预条件矩阵的计算开销问题。主要贡献包括：1）FTSL算法结合FD与自适应次梯度方法，在原始对偶框架下恢复被丢弃的累积信息，获得更紧的遗憾界；2）利用倍增技巧降低时间复杂度；3）针对矩阵值决策变量开发FTSL-Shampoo及其单侧变体，进一步降低计算复杂度并改进遗憾界；4）扩展到离线随机凸优化，利用光滑性实现更快收敛；5）提供实用变体并在多任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 自适应优化方法（如AdaGrad、Shampoo）在经验上表现优异，但维护预条件矩阵在大规模问题上计算开销过大。现有矩阵草图技术（如FD）虽能压缩矩阵，但会丢弃累积信息导致性能下降。需要在保持理论保证的前提下，大幅降低预条件优化的计算复杂度。
AI.method: 1）FTSL：在原始对偶框架下将FD与自适应次梯度法结合，并将FD丢弃的累积信息加回预条件矩阵。2）倍增技巧：周期性重置草图以减少奇异值分解频率。3）FTSL-Shampoo：针对矩阵值变量，利用其结构性质构造草图预条件器，提供原始对偶框架下的新分析。4）单侧变体：在镜像下降和原始对偶两个框架下仅草图一侧矩阵，进一步降低复杂度。5）离线随机凸优化扩展：结合光滑性假设加速收敛。
AI.result: 理论上：FTSL获得优于现有最先进结果的遗憾界；倍增技巧保持相同遗憾界下降低时间复杂度；FTSL-Shampoo及其单侧变体在降低计算成本的同时实现更紧的遗憾界；利用光滑性在离线随机设置中达到更快收敛率。实验上：实用变体在广泛任务上展示出计算效率和优化效果的双重优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过将频繁方向草图技术深度融入自适应优化框架，并针对矩阵值变量设计结构化预条件器，本文成功在理论上改进遗憾界、在计算上大幅降低复杂度，提出的算法族在大规模优化问题中兼具理论保证与实用高效性。

title: Agentic4PDM: Host-Governed Evidence Admissibility for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: We study industrial fault diagnosis as a classification task that assigns sensor time-series windows to predefined health states or fault types. Scarce labels and changing operating conditions make repeated training of specialized classifiers costly. Yet structures such as periodicity, trends, and transients can remain diagnostically informative and be examined through reusable analytical tools. LLM agents can select and interpret these tools, but fixed rules or training-derived guidance may not resolve each signal's ambiguity, while unconstrained interpretation may overstate weak or conflicting results. We introduce Agentic4PDM, a framework that separates adaptive investigation from control over evidence use. LLM agents compare each signal with labeled references from every candidate class, identify unresolved distinctions, and propose follow-up measurements. A deterministic software controller, called the host, enforces contract-checked gated adjudication (CCGA): it checks requests, requires commitment to a complete tool batch before results are observed, and assigns evidence roles based on tool checks against labeled references. These roles distinguish corroborative support from advisory information. The Judge Agent proposes a diagnosis, while the controller checks protocol compliance and records the investigation. Agentic4PDM supports training-free diagnosis using pretrained representations and labeled references without task-specific diagnostic models, and a standard setting that additionally investigates trained-model predictions. Experiments on selected bearing and motor diagnosis challenges and an unfiltered industrial test set supplied by our customer show gains in aggregate macro F1 over the evaluated diagnostic and agentic baselines. Ablations further support the value of the governed workflow.

AI.tldr: Agentic4PDM 是一个用于工业故障诊断的框架，通过将自适应调查与证据使用控制分离，利用 LLM 代理与确定性控制器协作，实现无需任务特定训练的诊断，并在多个基准测试中提升宏平均 F1 分数。
AI.motivation: 工业故障诊断面临标签稀缺、工况变化导致专用分类器重复训练成本高的问题。虽然周期性、趋势、瞬态等信号结构仍具诊断价值，但固定规则或训练引导的指导难以消除每个信号的歧义，而无约束的解释可能夸大弱证据或冲突结果。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic4PDM 框架：LLM 代理将待测信号与各候选类别的标签参考信号对比，识别未解决的差异并提出后续测量建议；确定性软件控制器（宿主）强制执行合同检查门控裁决（CCGA）：检查请求、要求在观察结果前承诺完整工具批次、基于工具对标签参考的检查分配证据角色（佐证支持与参考信息）；裁判代理提出诊断，控制器验证协议合规并记录调查过程。支持使用预训练表示和标签参考的无训练诊断，也可结合训练模型预测。
AI.result: 在选定的轴承和电机诊断挑战及客户提供的未过滤工业测试集上，Agentic4PDM 的聚合宏平均 F1 优于评估的诊断基线和代理基线。消融实验进一步证明了受控工作流的价值。
AI.conclusion: Agentic4PDM 通过结构化的代理-控制器协作，有效解决了工业故障诊断中标签稀缺、工况漂移和证据评估不可靠的问题，实现了免训练的高性能诊断，且受控工作流设计被证明对性能提升至关重要。

title: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning. While \emph{value evolution along trajectory} characterizes relative token-level credit, yet standard critics often fail to track it under sparse terminal rewards. To model this evolution, we analyze the relation between successive prefix values and show that they admit a Bayesian decomposition with additive updates in log-odds space. We use this additive structure to construct Tracking-Value PPO (\method), a cumulative value parameterization that sums position-wise scalar outputs into value logits. These outputs are learned through terminal-outcome supervision on the reconstructed values. \method improves aggregate mathematical reasoning scores over PPO by 7.0 and 8.4 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively, while improving out-of-distribution generalization. Gains extend to Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B and to countdown, and scientific coding tasks. Further analysis shows more accurate tracking of value evolution and more reliable advantage estimates. Our code is publicly available in https://github.com/LINs-lab/TPPO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Tracking-Value PPO (TPPO)，通过累积值参数化解决稀疏终端奖励下值演化追踪问题，在数学推理任务上显著提升PPO性能。
AI.motivation: 标准PPO中的Critic难以在稀疏终端奖励下追踪轨迹上的值演化，导致token级信用分配不准确，影响推理任务性能。
AI.method: 分析连续前缀值关系，发现其在log-odds空间具有贝叶斯分解的加性更新结构；构建TPPO，将位置标量输出累积求和为值logits，通过终端结果监督重构值进行学习。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base上数学推理分别提升7.0和8.4分，泛化到其他模型（Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B）和任务（倒计时、科学编码），价值演化追踪更准确，优势估计更可靠。
AI.conclusion: TPPO通过累积值参数化有效解决了稀疏奖励下的值演化追踪问题，显著提升了语言模型推理能力的RL训练效果，具有广泛的泛化性。

title: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
summary: Edge-cloud collaboration combines the lower inference overhead and greater data locality of edge-side execution with the stronger capabilities of cloud-hosted models. However, as LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon scenarios, cloud participation becomes interleaved throughout execution rather than a one-shot decision for each query. Such interleaved participation introduces trajectory-level effects that remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution. It provides executable digital-workspace agent tasks and a unified evaluation framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure. Using this benchmark, we empirically study diverse forms of edge-cloud collaboration. Our study reveals three findings. First, collaboration achieves a favorable balance among task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure compared with edge-only and cloud-only execution. Second, as edge models become stronger, collaborative execution approaches cloud-only performance, and performance differences across strategies shrink, while privacy exposure remains strongly strategy-dependent. Third, stronger edge capability shifts preferred collaboration from externally controlled cloud participation and direct cloud execution toward more edge-controlled collaboration. Further analyses identify cloud-invocation decision-making and instruction following as important edge-side abilities for effective collaboration. These findings provide a systematic understanding of edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution and insights for designing future edge agents that effectively collaborate with cloud models. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/EC2-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EC2-Bench，首个用于评估长时程智能体执行中边缘-云协作的基准，并通过实证研究揭示了边缘-云协作在任务性能、资源消耗和隐私暴露之间的权衡规律，以及边缘模型能力增强对协作策略偏好的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在长时程场景中的应用增加，云端参与变得贯穿整个执行过程，而非单次查询决策。这种交织参与引入的轨迹级效应尚未被充分理解，现有缺乏系统评估边缘-云协作的基准和实证研究。
AI.method: 构建了EC2-Bench基准，包含可执行的数字工作空间智能体任务和统一评估框架（任务性能、资源使用、隐私暴露）。利用该基准，对多种边缘-云协作形式进行实证研究，分析不同边缘模型能力下的协作表现。
AI.result: 三大发现：1) 协作在任务性能、资源使用和隐私暴露三者间达到有利平衡，优于纯边缘或纯云端执行。2) 随边缘模型增强，协作性能逼近纯云端，策略间性能差异缩小，但隐私暴露仍强依赖策略。3) 边缘能力增强使首选协作从外部控制的云端参与和直接云端执行转向边缘控制的协作。进一步分析指出云调用决策和指令遵循是边缘侧有效协作的关键能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究为长时程智能体执行中的边缘-云协作提供了系统性理解，揭示了边缘模型能力对协作策略偏好的决定性影响，为设计能有效与云端模型协作的未来边缘智能体提供了关键洞见。

title: One-Layer Transformers Provably Learn In-Context K-Nearest Neighbor Prediction with Chain-of-Thought
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) enables transformers to solve complex reasoning tasks by generating intermediate reasoning steps. Despite strong empirical success, the mechanisms by which such reasoning abilities emerge during training remain poorly understood, particularly from a theoretical perspective. In this work, we study this question in a stylized yet fully analyzable setting: in-context $\mathrm{K}$-nearest-neighbor ($\mathrm{K}$-NN) prediction with a one-layer transformer. Earlier work has demonstrated that one-layer transformers can be trained to perform $1$-NN without CoT (Li et al., 2024a) by having the softmax attention attend to the nearest neighbor in context. However, this result on $1$-NN cannot be extended to $\mathrm{K}$-NN for $K>1$, as softmax attention is much less naturally suited to attending to the 2nd through $K$-th nearest neighbors. We first give a rigorous negative result showing that this limitation already appears on a well-separated class of binary classification tasks for odd $K>1$. We then give an explicit construction of a one-layer transformer, and show that it can solve $\mathrm{K}$-NN via CoT reasoning. We further prove that, under a stylized training setup, gradient descent can recover this construction, thereby showing that transformers can acquire the capability to solve $\mathrm{K}$-NN through training. In addition, we show that the resulting trained model applies to a broader test class than that assumed in the training analysis. Our results shed light on how CoT expands the ability of transformers to learn and solve tasks that are otherwise hard to solve.

AI.tldr: 本文研究思维链(CoT)如何扩展Transformer的推理能力，在一层Transformer的K近邻预测设定中，证明了无CoT时softmax注意力难以处理K>1的K-NN，但引入CoT后可通过显式构造和梯度下降训练实现K-NN，且泛化到更广测试类。
AI.motivation: 理解CoT如何在训练中涌现推理能力，尤其是从理论角度解释Transformer为何能通过CoT解决原本难以直接用注意力机制完成的任务（如K>1的K-NN）。
AI.method: 在风格化的上下文学习K-NN预测任务中，分析一层Transformer：首先证明无CoT时的负面结果；然后显式构造带CoT的一层Transformer解决K-NN；再在风格化训练设定下证明梯度下降能恢复该构造；最后展示训练模型的泛化能力。
AI.result: 1) 无CoT时，一层Transformer无法在良好分离的二分类任务上实现奇数K>1的K-NN；2) 引入CoT后，存在显式构造的一层Transformer可解决K-NN；3) 梯度下降训练可恢复该构造；4) 训练得到的模型适用于比训练分析假设更广的测试类。
AI.conclusion: CoT通过引入中间推理步骤，扩展了Transformer的学习和求解能力，使其能掌握原本仅靠注意力机制难以实现的任务（如K>1的K-NN），理论上揭示了CoT增强推理的机制。

title: Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents
summary: Existing approaches to training and evaluating search agents focus heavily on final-answer quality, largely neglecting how generated answers map back to retrieved evidence. Recent methods track citations to enforce grounding, but citation support alone does not establish source independence or whether an answer appropriately handles conflicting evidence. We argue that credibility in open-web retrieval depends on principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and systematically attributes and adjudicates conflicting evidence, while hierarchical judgments of these grounding decisions provide a unified signal for training and evaluation. To this end, we propose an evaluation framework, Cross-Source Evidence Grounding (CSEG), that employs a fine-grained, six-layer decision tree over the complete search trajectory. We introduce CSEG-Bench and trainable reward models to provide targeted supervision following this framework. Our approach helps eliminating the severe data skew of natural trajectories by providing targeted coverage over complex, deep-layer decision paths, such as cross-source conflict resolution and nuanced attribution, that standard rollouts fail to capture. Specifically, (1) we define the hierarchy at label, node, and path levels; (2) we construct 1,160 verified trajectories over nine canonical paths by rewriting answers on real retrieved document pools, with independent frontier judges reproducing the entire gold path and human experts deciding inclusion; (3) we train CSEG-RM, which reaches 83.9% exact accuracy on our benchmark while lying on the performance-token efficiency Pareto frontier. Experiments that use this reward alone to supervise a frozen-retrieval answer policy raise the independently judged mean label from 2.83 to 4.19, and show that learning the hierarchy generalizes across layers at a fraction of frontier-judge cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了跨源证据接地(CSEG)评估框架，包含六层决策树、CSEG-Bench基准和CSEG-RM奖励模型，解决搜索智能体训练中忽视证据溯源、源独立性及冲突证据裁决的问题。实验显示CSEG-RM达83.9%准确率，仅用该奖励监督冻结检索策略即将独立评判均分从2.83提升至4.19，且层级泛化成本远低于前沿评判员。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索智能体训练与评估过度关注最终答案质量，忽视生成答案如何映射回检索证据。引用追踪虽强制接地，但无法确立源独立性或恰当处理冲突证据。开放网检索的可信度取决于 principled 的跨源证据接地，需系统性归因与裁决冲突证据，而层级化判断可为训练与评估提供统一信号。
AI.method: 提出CSEG框架，采用细粒度六层决策树覆盖完整搜索轨迹；定义标签、节点、路径三级层级；构建1,160条经验证轨迹覆盖九条典型路径，基于真实文档池重写答案，由独立前沿评判员复现全金标路径、人类专家决定纳入；训练CSEG-RM奖励模型提供针对性监督，解决自然轨迹严重数据倾斜，覆盖跨源冲突解决与细粒度归因等深层决策路径。
AI.result: CSEG-RM在基准上达83.9%精确准确率，位于性能-令牌效率帕累托前沿。仅用该奖励监督冻结检索的回答策略，独立评判均值标签从2.83升至4.19。层级学习在远低于前沿评判员成本下实现跨层泛化。
AI.conclusion: CSEG框架通过结构化跨源证据接地评估，填补了搜索智能体训练中证据溯源、源独立性及冲突裁决的空白。其奖励模型与基准有效解决数据倾斜，以低成本实现复杂决策路径的覆盖与层级泛化，显著提升回答策略的可信度与证据接地质量。

title: DASS: A Solver-Adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy for Symbolic Regression
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover interpretable mathematical expressions from data and plays a key role in scientific discovery. However, existing methods face a common bottleneck: the enormous search space and severe combinatorial explosion make it difficult to achieve a favorable trade-off between accuracy and algorithmic efficiency. We argue that, in addition to designing increasingly complex solver-specific SR strategies, an equally promising direction is to equip them with a shareable auxiliary strategy that can provide reliable search guidance. To this end, we propose DASS, a solver-adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy that improves SR by constructing and refining a high-potential auxiliary search subspace. DASS represents the auxiliary search space as a functional subspace spanned by a set of high-potential basis function terms. It estimates term utility through multi-environment evaluation, filters unstable guidance, and updates term potential scores with a Gibbs posterior, thereby calibrating the subspace to provide more reliable guidance for downstream solvers. The high-quality solutions produced by the solver are used to update the set of basis terms. This forms a virtuous closed-loop optimization process: the subspace guides the downstream solver, and the solver feedback reshapes the subspace for subsequent exploration. DASS can be easily integrated with various types of SR solvers. Extensive experiments on LLM-SRBench show that DASS significantly improves the accuracy of original solvers with a manageable increase in runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DASS的求解器自适应动态辅助搜索策略，用于改进符号回归（SR）。DASS通过构建和动态优化一个高潜力的辅助搜索子空间，为下游求解器提供可靠的搜索指引，并形成闭环优化：子空间指引求解器，求解器反馈再重塑子空间。实验表明DASS能显著提升多种SR求解器的精度，且运行时间增长可控。
AI.motivation: 符号回归面临巨大的搜索空间和组合爆炸问题，现有方法难以在精度和算法效率之间取得良好平衡。作者认为，除了设计越来越复杂的求解器特定策略外，为求解器配备一个可共享的辅助策略以提供可靠的搜索指引是一个同样有前景的方向。
AI.method: DASS将辅助搜索空间表示为由一组高潜力基函数项张成的函数子空间。它通过多环境评估估计项效用，过滤不稳定指引，并利用Gibbs后验更新项潜力分数，从而校准子空间以提供更可靠的指引。求解器产生的高质量解被用来更新基项集合，形成子空间指引求解器、求解器反馈重塑子空间的良性闭环优化过程。DASS可轻松集成到各类SR求解器中。
AI.result: 在LLM-SRBench基准上的大量实验表明，DASS能显著提升原始求解器的精度，且仅带来可接受的运行时间增加。
AI.conclusion: DASS作为一种求解器无关的动态辅助搜索策略，通过构建和动态优化高潜力辅助搜索子空间，有效缓解了符号回归中的搜索空间爆炸问题，实现了精度与效率的更好权衡，为科学发现中的符号回归任务提供了一个通用且高效的增强框架。

title: Learning Adaptive Deliberation Control for Reliable Recognition with Multi-Agent Language Models
comment: 33 pages, including references and technical appendices. Supplementary data included in the ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent deliberation can improve recognition by criticizing and revising candidate answers, but fixed controls cannot respond to changes in disagreement or reasoning quality. We present an adaptive multi-agent controller (ADMA) that learns continuous policies for proposal, challenge, arbitration, and coordination while keeping the task model frozen. Shared trace features describe quality, agreement, and progress, while role-specific features support decentralized control during inference. One controller trained on legal and financial reasoning is transferred without policy updates to four textual and multimodal benchmarks and two successive task-model versions. With Qwen3.5 held fixed, ADMA-Full improves accuracy by 6.2-14.2 percentage points over Direct and by 2.8-3.0 points over ADMA-Fixed. Paired bootstrap ranges for the Full-Fixed comparison are positive on three tasks. Outcome decompositions show that recoveries exceed introduced errors, while process assessment records fewer false-consensus events and more supported correct outcomes. Transfer to Qwen3.6 remains task dependent, which bounds the generality of the learned policy. Median token and latency ratios are 14.3-18.7 and 7.8-16.5 relative to Direct. These results show that adaptive deliberation can improve fixed-model recognition when its task-dependent gains justify the additional computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应多智能体控制器（ADMA），通过学习连续策略实现提案、质询、仲裁和协调，在保持任务模型冻结的情况下提升识别准确率。ADMA 在法律和金融推理任务上训练后，无需策略更新即可迁移至多个文本和多模态基准及两个版本的任务模型，显著提高准确率，但迁移到 Qwen3.6 时表现依赖任务，且带来额外计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体审议方法虽能通过批评和修正候选答案提升识别，但固定控制机制无法动态响应分歧程度和推理质量的变化，限制了其适应性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 设计自适应多智能体控制器（ADMA），学习提案、质询、仲裁和协调的连续策略，任务模型保持冻结。利用共享轨迹特征描述质量、一致性和进度，结合角色特定特征支持推理时的去中心化控制。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5 固定条件下，ADMA-Full 相比 Direct 提升准确率 6.2-14.2 个百分点，相比 ADMA-Fixed 提升 2.8-3.0 个百分点；配对 bootstrap 区间在三个任务上为正。结果分解显示恢复错误多于引入错误，过程评估显示虚假共识事件减少、支持的正确结果增加。迁移至 Qwen3.6 仍具任务依赖性。Token 和延迟中位数比率分别为 Direct 的 14.3-18.7 倍和 7.8-16.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 自适应审议能在任务相关收益超过额外计算成本时改进固定模型的识别性能，但学习策略的泛化性受限于任务模型版本。

title: DTA-GT: Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer for Neural Network Representation Learning
summary: Architecture attribute predictors reduce the cost of neural architecture search by estimating accuracy or latency from a small set of evaluated candidates. The key difficulty is that neural architectures are operation-labeled DAGs: edge direction defines computational flow, but existing predictors often treat direction as a local structural cue. We propose DTA-GT, a Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer based on encoder-wide directional consistency, which preserves directed computational semantics across node initialization, global spectral encoding, pairwise interaction, and feature update. DTA-GT realizes this principle with direction- and topology-aware node initialization, Magnetic Laplacian spectral encoding, direction-dual structural attention, and a Direction-Sensitive MoE-FFN. Across accuracy and latency prediction on NAS-Bench-101 and NAS-Bench-201, DTA-GT consistently outperforms representative sequence-, GNN-, Transformer-, and hybrid predictors under limited-budget settings. Ablations and Magnetic spectral controls show that the improvements come from coordinated direction-aware stages and edge-orientation-sensitive spectral information, while mechanistic diagnostics confirm that the modules exhibit the intended directional behavior. These results support encoder-wide directional consistency as an effective design principle for architecture DAG representation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种方向和拓扑感知的图Transformer (DTA-GT)，通过编码器全局的方向一致性保留有向计算语义，在NAS-Bench-101/201上实现了最优的准确率和延迟预测性能。
AI.motivation: 神经架构是带操作标签的有向无环图(DAG)，边的方向定义了计算流，但现有预测器通常将方向仅视为局部结构线索，难以充分保留有向计算语义。
AI.method: DTA-GT基于编码器全局方向一致性，包含四个方向感知组件：方向和拓扑感知的节点初始化、磁拉普拉斯谱编码、方向对偶结构注意力、方向敏感的MoE-FFN，在节点初始化、全局谱编码、成对交互和特征更新四个阶段保留有向计算语义。
AI.result: 在NAS-Bench-101和NAS-Bench-201的准确率和延迟预测任务中，DTA-GT在有限预算设置下持续优于序列、GNN、Transformer和混合预测器；消融实验和磁谱控制表明改进源于协调的方向感知阶段和边方向敏感的谱信息；机制诊断确认模块表现出预期的方向行为。
AI.conclusion: 编码器全局的方向一致性是架构DAG表示的有效设计原则，DTA-GT通过全方位保留有向计算语义显著提升了架构属性预测性能。

title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
summary: Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). Across three model pairs on shared families, interleaved guidance outperforms expert authoring and post-hoc teaching. Process analysis links guidance to Student writing and package revision; a case study shows the Student testing and refining a proposed procedure for later reuse. As demand for new lessons falls, the cost of fixed-window review grows. Issue-Guided SSL tracks unresolved questions across Skill revisions to select and focus review, reaching 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL on the main cohort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出苏格拉底技能学习（SSL），通过专家指导与学生实践交织，让学生作为唯一环境操作者和技能作者，能够质疑、测试和调整建议。构建了SkillTransferBench基准，实验显示Fixed-Window SSL在主测试集上达到0.801效用，优于无技能、Trace2Skill和SKILL-KD基线。进一步提出Issue-Guided SSL，跟踪未解决问题以聚焦复盘，在效用略增至0.805的同时，大幅减少Educator令牌（61.7%）和总获取令牌（16.9%）
AI.motivation: 现有Agent技能学习方法难以在会话间复用任务知识，且成功的任务尝试往往留下未测试的过程证据和使用条件。需要一种机制让专家指导与学生实践相结合，使学生能主动探究、测试和修正技能，从而学到可迁移的技能
AI.method: 提出Socratic Skill Learning (SSL)：Educator指导调查，Student作为唯一环境操作者和技能作者，可质疑、测试、调整建议。构建SkillTransferBench（35任务族，408可执行案例）。实现Fixed-Window SSL（固定窗口复盘）和Issue-Guided SSL（跟踪未决问题跨版本选择聚焦复盘）。与无技能、Trace2Skill（轨迹蒸馏）、SKILL-KD（对比蒸馏）及专家编写、事后教学基线对比
AI.result: 主测试集（22族，155案例）上，Fixed-Window SSL效用0.801，显著高于无技能（0.723）、Trace2Skill（0.761）、SKILL-KD（0.751）。跨三对模型共享族，交织指导优于专家编写和事后教学。过程分析显示指导促进学生编写和包修订；案例研究展示学生测试并细化提议过程以便后续复用。Issue-Guided SSL达0.805效用，Educator令牌减少61.7%，总获取令牌减少16.9%
AI.conclusion: SSL通过专家指导与学生实践的交织，有效学习可迁移技能。Issue-Guided SSL进一步通过问题驱动的复盘选择，显著降低获取成本同时保持甚至提升性能，为Agent技能的高效获取和复用提供了可行路径

title: Mean Accuracy Is the Wrong Estimand for a Release Decision
summary: A release decision about a fine-tuned model is an operational commitment about the \emph{next} rerun of its training recipe. Yet standard benchmark reporting gives only the mean accuracy of past seeds. These target fundamentally different questions: release decisions depend on catastrophic tail risk, whereas standard evaluation reports only central tendency. Because fine-tuning induces bimodal mode collapse, high average accuracy frequently conceals severe failure rates. Auditing $2\,124$ fine-tuned models across eleven language models, we show that shipping models based on mean accuracy violates a $10\%$ deployment failure budget $48.0\%$ of the time. Common heuristics like $\bar b - 2σ$ prove equally dangerous: by underestimating variance on small samples, they become most permissive when evidence is weakest. We introduce \textbf{recipe cards}, an evaluation framework that directly certifies rerun tail failure rates using exact finite-sample binomial bounds. Recipe cards reduce held-out budget violations to $0.6\%$, enforce a mathematical sample floor ($N \ge 22$) that prevents certification on thin evidence, and explicitly refuse unverified claims under domain and task shifts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“recipe cards”框架，用精确有限样本二项界认证微调模型重跑尾部失败率，解决平均准确率掩盖灾难性尾部风险的问题，将部署预算违规率从48%降至0.6%。
AI.motivation: 微调模型发布决策关乎下一次训练重跑的尾部风险，但标准基准仅报告历史种子平均准确率，无法捕捉灾难性失效率；微调导致双峰模式崩塌，高平均准确率常掩盖严重失败率。
AI.method: 审计2124个微调模型，跨11个语言模型；提出recipe cards评估框架，使用精确有限样本二项界直接认证重跑尾部失败率；强制执行数学样本下限（N≥22），拒绝域迁移和任务迁移下的未验证声明。
AI.result: 基于平均准确率发布模型违反10%部署失败预算的比例为48.0%；常见启发式（b̄-2σ）同样危险；recipe cards将held-out预算违规降至0.6%，并强制样本下限防止薄弱证据认证。
AI.conclusion: 标准评估报告中心趋势无法满足发布决策对尾部风险的需求；recipe cards提供数学严谨的认证框架，有效控制部署失败率，并明确拒绝在分布偏移下做未验证声称。

title: ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
comment: 32 pages, including references and technical appendices
summary: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%.
