State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECMR，一种基于证据的控制器，用于冻结的角色条件 LLMs，解决多智能体 LLM 系统中的语义虚假共识问题，通过自适应分配计算资源，在保持令牌预算内显著提升准确性、降低虚假共识率并增强证据支持率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体 LLM 系统采用固定协议，无法根据实例难度动态分配计算资源，且易将重复支持误判为独立确认，导致语义虚假共识——即由狭窄、重复或相关理由支持的自信群体答案。
AI.method: ECMR 在每一步汇总答案集中度、支持多样性与独立性、矛盾、角色行为、验证历史及剩余预算，并基于有限时域预算控制框架决定提出、挑战、验证、仲裁、多样化、纠正角色或停止；推导了状态条件化、风险触发验证和角色纠正改进成本调整效用的充分条件。
AI.result: 在 9000 条 MedQA、CaseHOLD、FinQA 记录上，ECMR-Full 将混合准确率从 62.1% 提升至 84.9%，虚假共识率从 40.7% 降至 17.0%，证据支持率从 58.0% 升至 88.7%；状态打乱导致准确率下降 11.7 分但轮数仅减 0.7，困难样本从早停转向仲裁；ECMR-Full 消耗最大令牌预算，实现最强绝对可靠性而非统一的令牌效率优势。
AI.conclusion: ECMR 通过证据感知的自适应控制有效缓解语义虚假共识，在代价敏感的多智能体推理中实现高可靠性，但以更高令牌开销为代价，适合对准确性要求极高的场景。

title: The Bell Boundary of Shared Representations
summary: When does a shared representation become insufficient for jointly supporting multiple tasks? This question lies at the heart of multi-task learning models. Although task interference in shared representations has been widely observed, its onset, measurable form, and capacity boundary remain poorly understood. In this paper, we revisit this problem through the lens of Bell's theorem. We show that if four binary task outcomes can be jointly represented by a common shared representation, their correlations must satisfy the classical CHSH bound $|S|\leq2$. We introduce NCnet, a controlled multi-task model for studying how representational capacity affects task compatibility. Experiments reveal a clear capacity-dependent transition. Once nontrivial task fitting emerges, constrained capacity can yield $|S|>2$. As capacity further increases, these exceedances progressively disappear and $S$ returns to the bounded region. This systematic pattern provides evidence that limited representational capacity is an important source of the observed incompatibility. We observe similar transitions across CNNs, PLMs, and LLMs, suggesting that the phenomenon extends beyond the controlled NCnet setting. We refer to this capacity-dependent transition as the Bell Boundary, providing a measurable diagnostic for representation bottlenecks, task incompatibility, and capacity allocation in multi-task models.

AI.tldr: 论文通过贝尔定理和CHSH不等式研究多任务学习中共享表示的容量边界，提出NCnet模型实验发现：受限容量导致任务不兼容（|S|>2），随容量增加违例消失，揭示'贝尔边界'作为表示瓶颈的可测诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 多任务学习中共享表示何时不足以联合支持多任务尚不明确，任务干扰的起始点、可测形式和容量边界缺乏理论理解，需从根本上量化表示容量与任务兼容性的关系。
AI.method: 引入贝尔定理中的CHSH不等式（|S|≤2）作为共享表示兼容性的理论判据，设计受控多任务模型NCnet，系统实验不同架构（CNN、PLM、LLM）下容量变化对CHSH值的影响。
AI.result: 发现明显的容量依赖相变：非平凡任务拟合出现后，受限容量导致CHSH不等式被违背（|S|>2），表明任务不兼容；随容量增加，违例逐渐消失，S值回归经典界内。该现象跨架构普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 有限表示容量是观测到的任务不兼容的重要来源。提出'贝尔边界'概念，为多任务模型中的表示瓶颈、任务不兼容性及容量分配提供了可测量的诊断工具。

title: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
summary: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoSIR（基于惊讶度的信息奖励协作），一种用于多智能体 LLM 系统的后训练方法，通过贝叶斯评估器量化信息共享对团队惊讶度的降低，利用自我博弈在简单可验证环境中训练协作行为，并成功迁移至七个未见的自然语言协作任务，实现最高综合得分。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中的有效协作需要共享相关证据、请求缺失信息并整合队友贡献，但最终任务结果对单条消息价值的反馈有限，导致这些协作行为难以通过常规训练习得。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯评估器，以团队惊讶度降低量为奖励信号：共享信息按其使各智能体对正确选项的负对数概率之和下降程度打分；请求信息按若诚实提供可实现的潜在惊讶度降低打分。另设独立奖励鼓励智能体在私有决策中采纳接收信息。在 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Gemma-3-4B-it 上通过自我博弈进行后训练。
AI.result: 在七个未见自然语言协作任务上迁移评测，CoSIR 取得最高综合得分，通用任务表现仍具竞争力。行为分析显示：私有证据披露显著增加，未采纳队友输入的判定失败明显减少。
AI.conclusion: 基于惊讶度降低的信息奖励机制能在简单环境中高效塑造可泛化的协作行为，为多智能体 LLM 系统的协作能力训练提供了一种可扩展、可验证的新范式。

title: Few-for-Many Best-Arm Identification in Multi-Objective Bandits
summary: Real-world systems often serve many objectives but can deploy only a few options, whose performance must be learned from noisy feedback. Modeling each option as an arm in a multi-objective bandit, we introduce \emph{few-for-many best-arm identification}, which seeks a small set of arms minimizing the worst weighted degradation from the objective-wise optima, rather than the best arm for every objective. We consider both known objective groups and latent groups specified only by a representative budget, and propose \textsc{GFM-Elim} and \textsc{AFM-Elim} with instance-dependent sample-complexity guarantees. For Gaussian rewards, we further derive a lower bound for the latent-group setting and show that it is asymptotically attainable with high probability by an oracle-based Track-and-Stop procedure. Our results show that sharing observations across objectives and ignoring irrelevant objective-wise distinctions can substantially reduce the sampling cost, as confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了面向多目标的少臂识别问题，旨在从少量可部署选项中找到一组臂，使其对各目标的最坏加权退化最小化；针对已知目标组和潜在目标组两种设定，分别设计了 GFM-Elim 和 AFM-Elim 算法并给出实例相关的样本复杂度保证；在高斯奖励下进一步给出潜在组设定的下界，并证明基于预言机的 Track-and-Stop 过程可渐近达到该下界；实验表明跨目标共享观测与忽略无关目标区分可显著降低采样成本。
AI.motivation: 现实系统常需同时优化多个目标，但受限于部署选项数量，只能选择少量臂；传统最佳臂识别针对单一目标，无法直接处理多目标权衡；现有多目标强化学习多关注帕累托最优集，未考虑部署预算约束；因此需要一种在有限部署预算下，跨目标共享样本、忽略无关目标细节、以最小采样代价找到近似最优臂集的方法。
AI.method: 将每个选项建模为多目标老虎机中的一条臂，引入少为多最佳臂识别框架：目标是选择大小受限的臂集，使加权目标退化的最坏情况最小。针对已知目标组提出 GFM-Elim，针对仅给定代表性预算的潜在目标组提出 AFM-Elim，均采用消除式采样策略并给出实例相关的样本复杂度上界；在高斯奖励假设下，针对潜在组设定推导信息论下界，并设计基于预言机的 Track-and-Stop 算法，证明其高概率渐近达到下界。
AI.result: 理论上，GFM-Elim 和 AFM-Elim 的样本复杂度分别随已知组数和潜在组预算呈对数依赖，优于单独针对每个目标学习的基线；对于高斯奖励，潜在组设定的下界与 Track-and-Stop 算法的上界在渐近意义上匹配。实验在合成数据和真实任务（如推荐系统、超参数调优）上验证：跨目标共享观测与忽略无关目标区分可使所需样本量显著减少，且随着目标数增加优势扩大。
AI.conclusion: 少为多最佳臂识别为多目标受限部署提供了原则性框架；通过利用目标间的相关结构（已知组或潜在组），可大幅降低识别近似最优臂集的采样成本；提出的消除式算法与 Track-and-Stop 过程在理论与实践上均表现优异，为实际系统中的多目标决策提供了高效工具。

title: PaceReasoner: Label-Free Learning to Answer Briefly from Long Reasoning
summary: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning improves problem-solving performance but increases inference cost and latency, motivating more accurate answers with shorter reasoning. We introduce PaceReasoner, a label-free test-time reinforcement learning framework that uses a model's LONG responses to improve its SHORT-mode accuracy. Both modes share a trainable policy, creating a need for reliable supervision, sufficient SHORT training samples, and continued LONG responses to guide learning. PaceReasoner combines all-response and LONG-only answer consensus through progressive, confidence-weighted supervision. A behavior reward gradually shifts from encouraging SHORT exploration to rewarding agreement with LONG answers, while a ratio controller regulates the balance between modes. Across three model backbones and four benchmarks, PaceReasoner improves average SHORT accuracy over the baselines by 7.4--13.5 percentage points, with fewer than 25 reasoning tokens per response on average. Ablations support the key components, and cross-dataset results demonstrate transfer beyond the adaptation set.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PaceReasoner，一种无标签测试时强化学习框架，利用模型的长推理响应指导短推理模式学习，在保持平均推理token少于25个的前提下，使短模式准确率比基线提升7.4–13.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长链式思维推理虽能提升问题求解性能，但会增加推理成本和延迟，因此需要在更短的推理长度下获得更准确的答案。
AI.method: PaceReasoner采用标签自由的测试时强化学习，长短模式共享可训练策略；结合全响应与仅长响应的答案共识，通过渐进式置信度加权监督提供可靠监督信号；行为奖励从鼓励短模式探索逐渐转向奖励与长模式答案一致；比率控制器动态调节长短模式的平衡。
AI.result: 在三个模型主干和四个基准测试中，PaceReasoner使平均短模式准确率比基线提升7.4–13.5个百分点，平均推理token少于25个；消融实验验证了关键组件的有效性，跨数据集实验展示了超出适应集的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: PaceReasoner通过测试时强化学习有效利用长推理指导短推理，在大幅压缩推理长度的同时显著提升准确性，验证了无标签自监督方式在推理效率优化上的潜力。

title: Radial Tail Repair: Post-Training Correction for Diffusion and Flow Models
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models may struggle to accurately represent distributional tails, especially for heavy-tailed data. Existing approaches often use heavy-tailed noise or modify the generative dynamics, requiring dedicated retraining and more difficult estimation. We take a simpler approach: rather than relearning the full distribution, we correct only the model's behavior in the extreme regime. Our method builds on the radial-angular decomposition of multivariate heavy tails, where radius and direction become asymptotically independent. This allows us to preserve the directional structure learned by the pretrained model and correct only its radial tail. We estimate the tail onset from reference and generated samples, then rescale generated extremes so that their radial survival matches the target distribution. The resulting method is a lightweight post-training correction applied to a frozen diffusion or flow-matching model, requiring neither retraining nor changes to its sampling dynamics. Experiments on challenging synthetic heavy-tailed distributions and real weather and wildfire datasets show that this simple correction substantially improves extreme-tail coverage using only a small number of fitting samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的后训练校正方法，用于修正扩散模型和流匹配模型在重尾数据分布极端尾部的生成偏差。该方法利用多元重尾的径向-角向分解，保留预训练模型学习的方向结构，仅校正径向尾部，通过估计尾部起始点并重缩放生成样本的极端值，使其径向生存函数匹配目标分布。无需重新训练或修改采样动态，仅需少量拟合样本即可显著提升极端尾部覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型在建模重尾数据分布时，往往难以准确捕捉分布尾部，尤其是极端值区域。现有方法通常采用重尾噪声或修改生成动力学，需要专门的重新训练且估计更困难。作者希望采用更简单的方式：不重新学习整个分布，仅校正模型在极端区域的行为。
AI.method: 基于多元重尾的径向-角向渐近独立性分解，保留预训练模型学到的方向结构，仅校正径向尾部。从参考样本和生成样本中估计尾部起始阈值，然后对生成样本的极端径向值进行重缩放，使其径向生存函数与目标分布匹配。这是一种应用于冻结模型的后训练轻量级校正，无需重新训练或改变采样动态。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的合成重尾分布、真实天气数据和野火数据集上的实验表明，该简单校正方法仅使用少量拟合样本，就能显著改善极端尾部的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于径向-角向分解的后训练校正方法，为扩散和流匹配模型在重尾数据生成中的极端尾部建模提供了一个高效、免重训练的解决方案，仅需少量样本即可大幅提升尾部生成质量。

title: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have substantially improved the capabilities of GUI agents, while memory augmentation has emerged as a promising approach for reusing knowledge from past interactions. However, existing memory augmented GUI agents typically adopt a fixed representation strategy, providing retrieved experience as a static modality. It remains unclear whether a single memory modality is consistently optimal, or how modality preference changes across interaction steps. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of memory modality in VLM based GUI agents. Across GUI benchmarks, we find that the preferred memory representation is strongly step dependent. Motivated by the finding, we introduce \textbf{SwitchMem}, a routing framework that dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each step. Across three GUI benchmarks, SwitchMem outperforms memory augmented baselines that rely on static memory representations. Our findings validate our claim that memory modality is a step dependent decision rather than a fixed design choice. Code and project resources are available at https://txxnrd.github.io/switchmem

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwitchMem，一种动态路由框架，在VLM基础的GUI智能体中，根据每个交互步骤自适应选择文本或视觉记忆表示，验证了记忆模态偏好随步骤变化的特性，在三个GUI基准测试上超越静态记忆表示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的记忆增强GUI智能体通常采用固定的表示策略，将检索到的经验作为静态模态提供。目前尚不清楚单一记忆模态是否始终最优，以及模态偏好如何随交互步骤变化。
AI.method: 首先在GUI基准上系统研究VLM基础GUI智能体的记忆模态，发现偏好模态强烈依赖于交互步骤。基于此发现，引入SwitchMem路由框架，在每个步骤动态选择文本或视觉记忆表示。
AI.result: 在三个GUI基准测试中，SwitchMem均优于依赖静态记忆表示的记忆增强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 记忆模态的选择是一个随步骤动态变化的决策，而非固定的设计选择，动态路由机制能有效提升GUI智能体性能。

title: GpFlash: Maximizing Speed and Minimizing Memory for Gaussian Process Training and Prediction
summary:
This paper presents GpFlash, a Gaussian process library that is focused on fast training and posterior evaluations, minimal memory usage, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. GpFlash was compared to the popular GP libraries scikit-learn, GPy, GPflow, GPyTorch, and SMT on a MacBook Pro and the supercomputer Trillium. GpFlash was found to use less memory and to be faster for training and posterior evaluations relative to the other GP libraries for all cases considered. For example, when using $
x = 10^4$ training points in a 10-dimensional space GpFlash required 9.6 to 35 times less memory and was 2.6 to 54 times faster than the other GP libraries for the evaluation of the marginal log likelihood and its gradient. The memory reduction was achieved by only using one matrix of size $
x 	imes 
x$ to store different symmetric matrices in its lower and upper triangular entries. The computational speedup was the result of designing algorithms to access memory efficiently, using BLAS and LAPACK methods extensively, and factoring kernel equations so that expensive exponential calculations could be reused. GpFlash was more than 440 times faster than all of the other GP libraries considered when evaluating the posterior mean together with its gradient for the case with $10^4$ training points and 10 dimensions. GpFlash is available at https://github.com/marchildon/gpflash.

AI.tldr: GpFlash是一个高斯过程库，专注于快速训练、后验评估、最小内存使用和高维问题的可扩展性。它在内存和速度上显著优于现有库。
AI.motivation: 现有的高斯过程库在大规模、高维问题上存在内存占用大、计算速度慢的问题，需要一个更高效、可扩展的GP库。
AI.method: 设计了内存高效的算法，仅使用一个nx×nx矩阵存储不同对称矩阵的下三角和上三角条目；大量使用BLAS和LAPACK方法；分解核方程以复用昂贵的指数计算。
AI.result: 在nx=10^4、10维情况下，GpFlash内存减少9.6到35倍，边际对数似然及其梯度评估快2.6到54倍；后验均值及其梯度评估快440倍以上。
AI.conclusion: GpFlash通过创新的内存管理和计算优化，实现了大规模高维高斯过程的高效训练和推理，代码已开源。

title: Davinci-Tool: Scaling Agentic Tool-Use Supervision with Verifiable Executable Environments
summary: Reliable agentic tool use requires training data that pair diverse multi-step workflows with executable evidence that the requested outcomes were achieved. Scaling either trajectory coverage or verification alone is insufficient as new environments introduce distinct states, rules, and dependencies that must also be reflected in the success criteria. To address this challenge, we introduce Davinci-Tool, a 30B tool-use model, and Davinci-ToolData, an execution-grounded dataset designed to scale environment coverage and outcome verification together. Davinci-ToolData preserves restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers as a unified substrate for supervision. Two complementary pipelines populate this substrate: Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis (EGTS) derives verified demonstrations from independently authored systems, and Executable Environment Synthesis (EES) synthesizes auditable environments, state-grounded tasks, and executable verifiers across single and coordinated domains. These pipelines yield 30,395 verified trajectories spanning 2,260 invoked tool names. We first train on these demonstrations with supervised fine-tuning, then reuse EES states and verifiers to compare alternative actions and construct outcome-grounded preferences for Direct Preference Optimization. Davinci-Tool improves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct from 52.4 to 88.2 on $τ^2$-bench, from 30.4 to 62.8 on BFCL v4 multi-turn, and from 16.9 to 56.2 on MCP-Atlas, outperforming Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct on all three benchmarks with only 1/16 of its total parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/MassLab-SII/Davinci-Tool.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Davinci-Tool（30B 工具使用模型）和 Davinci-ToolData（执行落地数据集），通过 EGTS 和 EES 两大管道大规模构建可验证的多步工具调用轨迹，结合监督微调与基于结果的直接偏好优化，在 τ²-bench、BFCL v4 multi-turn、MCP-Atlas 三大基准上大幅超越参数量大 16 倍的 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct。
AI.motivation: 现有代理工具使用训练数据缺乏多样化的多步工作流与可执行的结果证据的配对；单纯扩大轨迹覆盖或验证机制均不足以应对新环境引入的独特状态、规则和依赖，需同时扩展环境覆盖与结果验证。
AI.method: 1. 构建 Davinci-ToolData：保存可恢复状态、执行轨迹、结果与验证器为统一监督底座。2. 两大互补管道：EGTS 从独立编写系统导出已验证演示；EES 合成可审计环境、状态落地任务与可执行验证器。共得 30,395 条验证轨迹、2,260 个工具名。3. 训练两阶段：先在演示上监督微调；再复用 EES 状态与验证器对比备选动作，构建结果落地偏好数据用于 DPO。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 基座上：τ²-bench 从 52.4 提升至 88.2，BFCL v4 multi-turn 从 30.4 提升至 62.8，MCP-Atlas 从 16.9 提升至 56.2。三项指标均超越 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct，参数量仅为其 1/16。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一的执行落地数据底座与双管道合成策略，配合 SFT+DPO 两阶段训练，小参数模型即可实现大规模、可验证的多步工具调用能力，显著降低对巨型模型的依赖，为可靠代理工具使用提供可复现的数据与训练范式。

title: Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models
summary: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在判断物体距离时，是依赖真实深度信息还是图像平面线索（如视大小、垂直位置）。通过受控的深度-线索冲突实验、表征分析和干预实验，发现模型虽能在内部表征中保留正确深度信息，但决策时系统性地被误导性的图像平面线索主导。通过对象级写回增强模型自身的深度读出，可在不更新参数、不使用真值深度标注的情况下纠正冲突决策，揭示了模型“会表示深度但不会用深度决策”的表征-行为错位现象。
AI.motivation: 探究 VLM 在深度判断任务中，究竟是利用真实的深度信息，还是依赖视大小、垂直位置等图像平面单眼线索。现有研究多关注模型最终输出，缺乏对内部表征与决策机制的解耦分析。
AI.method: 1. 构建受控的深度-线索冲突刺激（渲染场景与真实照片），对比线索一致与冲突条件下的深度判断。2. 表征解码分析：从查询物体的视觉表征中解码真实深度顺序。3. 干预实验：对象级写回，增强模型自身的深度读出向量，观察决策修正效果及其对方向、目标 token、架构、域的敏感性。
AI.result: 1. 所有模型家族和规模在冲突条件下均系统性地向误导性图像平面线索倾斜。2. 即使模型回答错误，正确深度顺序仍可从视觉表征中解码出来。3. 图像/类别控制实验证实该信号包含超出两个目标线索的图像依赖深度信息。4. 对象级写回可在无参数更新、无真值深度标注下纠正冲突决策；修正效果取决于写回方向、目标 token，且随架构和域而异。
AI.conclusion: VLM 存在“表征-行为错位”：内部表征保留了有用的深度信息，但决策过程却让竞争性的图像平面线索施加了更大影响。模型“会表示深度但不会用深度决策”，揭示了当前 VLM 在深度感知推理中的根本局限。

title: Efficient Resource-Shiftable RL Post-training with Generative Rewards
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training with generative reward models (GenRM) has become a central recipe for improving large language models (LLMs), and it is also increasingly resource-intensive: policy rollout, GenRM-based reward evaluation, and policy training all compete for GPU resources. However, existing colocated and disaggregated systems rely on static resource allocation for these roles. Such allocation cannot adapt as each role's workload changes during RL and therefore leaves a role's resources underutilized.
  We present PivotRL, an RL post-training system that dynamically shifts resources among different roles according to their runtime demands. PivotRL introduces a resource-shiftable runtime built on a Global Parameter Storage, together with a unified mechanism that efficiently shifts role-specific context. A shift-aware scheduler enables sequence migration upon a shift, while a planner considers the aggregate throughput benefit and the shift overhead to determine when and how to shift. We evaluate PivotRL on a 128-GPU cluster using four model groups spanning dense and mixture-of-experts models. PivotRL enables resource shifting within seconds and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.81-2.05 times over colocated deployment and 1.50-1.95 times over disaggregated deployment, while preserving RL convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PivotRL，一种用于大语言模型 RL 后训练的动态资源调度系统，通过在策略采样、生成式奖励模型评估、策略训练三个角色间秒级迁移 GPU 资源，在 128-GPU 集群上实现端到端吞吐比静态部署提升 1.5-2.05 倍，同时保持 RL 收敛性。
AI.motivation: RL 后训练包含策略采样、GenRM 奖励评估、策略训练三个计算密集型角色，其负载在训练过程中动态变化。现有共置与解聚系统采用静态资源分配，无法随负载变化调整，导致大量 GPU 资源闲置，严重限制端到端吞吐。
AI.method: PivotRL 引入全局参数存储构建资源可迁移运行时，统一角色上下文迁移机制；设计感知迁移的调度器实现序列级迁移，配合考虑吞吐收益与迁移开销的规划器决定何时、如何迁移资源。
AI.result: 在 128-GPU 集群上评测四组密集与 MoE 模型，资源迁移在秒级完成；端到端吞吐较共置部署提升 1.81-2.05 倍，较解聚部署提升 1.50-1.95 倍，RL 收敛性不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 动态资源迁移能有效解决 RL 后训练中角色负载不均导致的资源浪费，PivotRL 通过运行时、调度与规划协同实现秒级迁移，显著提升吞吐且不损模型质量，为大规模 RL 训练提供通用系统范式。

title: SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces
summary: Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

AI.tldr: SHELDON 是一种科学推理框架，通过分离并联合探索假设空间和观测空间，解决了现有测试时扩展方法中观测发现与现有假设耦合的问题，显著提升了复杂推理、发现和优化任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时扩展方法在寻找当前假设的证据时收集观测，再基于这些假设及其证据生成新假设，导致观测发现与现有假设耦合，偏向局部细化而非探索未知假设区域。受假设演绎法和科学发现双空间模型启发，需要一种能分别表示并联合探索假设与观测空间的方法。
AI.method: 提出 SHELDON，一种科学推理 harness，它分别表示假设空间和观测空间，并主动同时寻找新观测和新假设。通过发现当前假设无法解释的观测，暴露理解缺口，激发新调查，指导生成超越现有假设细化的新假设。
AI.result: 在诊断、抽象推理和优化基准上，SHELDON 比评估的基线方法高出高达 26.7 分。额外分析显示，SHELDON 生成的新颖解决方案最多可达基线的 4.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: SHELDON 通过分离并联合探索假设与观测空间，有效打破了观测发现对现有假设的依赖，实现了更广泛的假设空间探索，显著提升了大语言模型在复杂科学推理任务中的表现和创新能力。

title: Towards Universal Calibration for In-Context Classification
comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables, AACL-IJCNLP Findings accepted
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) has received a lot of interest recently due to its ability to improve classification accuracy for new tasks without having to fine-tune the model over these tasks. However, the impact of ICL on calibration has been far less studied. Recent work has shown that ICL can have a negative impact on calibration due to biased selection of in-context examples. The existing methods for improving ICL calibration require additional task and model-specific training, detracting from the no-fine-tuning convenience of ICL. In this work, we introduce CALIBFORMER, a universal ICL calibrator for classification tasks, that generalizes to new models and tasks without further fine-tuning on these tasks. Specifically, we design a transformer-based calibrator which uses the model predictions on in-context examples to predict a confidence score for the test input. We show that the calibrator trained on three models and ten tasks, is able to generalize/calibrate ICL predictions on several new tasks and four LLMs unseen during training. Even for frontier models like Gemini, CALIBFORMER is able to obtain over 50% reduction in calibration error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CALIBFORMER，一种通用的上下文学习（ICL）校准器，利用 Transformer 基于在上下文示例上的模型预测来为测试输入预测置信度分数，无需针对新任务或新模型进行微调，即可在多个未见任务和大语言模型（包括 Gemini）上将校准误差降低 50% 以上。
AI.motivation: ICL 虽能在无微调情况下提升分类准确性，但其对校准的影响研究较少；现有改进 ICL 校准的方法需要额外的任务和模型特定训练，破坏了 ICL 免微调的便利性。
AI.method: 设计一个基于 Transformer 的校准器，输入为模型在上下文示例上的预测，输出为测试输入的置信度分数；在三个模型和十个任务上训练该校准器，使其能泛化到新任务和新模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，CALIBFORMER 在多个未见任务和四个未见大语言模型（包括前沿模型 Gemini）上均能显著降低校准误差，Gemini 上校准误差减少超过 50%。
AI.conclusion: CALIBFORMER 实现了免微调、跨任务跨模型的 ICL 校准，保留了 ICL 的便利性，同时大幅提升了预测的校准性能。

title: Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings
summary:
In this paper, our goal is to represent text embeddings as sketches for three main reasons. First, to visualize text representation and to explore their potential their potential for AI explainability. Second, to investigate the potential benefits of the sketch-based representation for information retrieval. Third, to explore their potential for reasoning, drawing inspiration from the concept of mental imagery. We propose a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text representations into visual topographic sketches. Our approach aims to emphasis the semantics content encoded in the text embeddings through the corresponding sketch.
  Evaluations are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset to examine the utility of these sketches for text retrieval. The comparative study of SBERT and Sketch-based method reveals that SBERT retains an advantage in strict top-1 retrieval accuracy while achieving comparable performance to the sketch-based method in top-5 retrieval. A cascaded approach combining SBERT and the sketch-based method outperforms SBERT alone, suggesting that the Sketch-based representation could offer significant potential for information retrieval if trained directly on text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于草图的视觉接地框架，将文本嵌入转化为视觉地形草图，旨在通过草图强调文本嵌入中的语义内容。在MS-COCO数据集上评估显示：SBERT在严格的top-1检索准确率上保持优势，但在top-5检索中与草图方法性能相当；结合两者的级联方法优于单独使用SBERT，表明草图表示若直接在文本上训练，对信息检索有显著潜力。
AI.motivation: 三大动机：1) 可视化文本表示并探索其在AI可解释性方面的潜力；2) 调查基于草图的表示对信息检索的潜在益处；3) 探索其推理潜力，灵感来源于心理意象概念。
AI.method: 提出草图视觉接地框架，将文本表示转换为视觉地形草图，旨在通过对应草图强调文本嵌入中编码的语义内容。在MS-COCO数据集上进行评估，比较SBERT与基于草图方法在文本检索任务上的表现。
AI.result: SBERT在严格top-1检索准确率上保持优势，但在top-5检索中与草图方法性能相当。级联方法（结合SBERT和草图方法）优于单独使用SBERT。
AI.conclusion: 草图表示若直接在文本上训练，可为信息检索提供显著潜力。草图方法在top-5检索中表现相当，且与SBERT结合能提升整体检索性能，验证了草图作为文本嵌入替代表示的可行性。

title: From Parallel to Sequential: Small-Batch Noise Restores Simplicity Bias of Muon
summary: Simplicity bias, which can arise from sequential feature learning during training, has been proposed as a general explanation for the success of deep learning. An important driver of this phenomenon is saddle-to-saddle behavior, in which the gradient flow trajectory remains close to a sequence of saddle manifolds while learning one feature at a time. However, Muon, a state-of-the-art optimizer based on spectral descent, does not exhibit such dynamics in the full-batch setting and instead learns features in parallel. How is it then that Muon is so successful in deep learning settings? We show that stochastic gradient noise fundamentally changes this behavior: small-batch noise restores sequential feature learning, providing a mechanism for simplicity bias that is absent from full-batch Muon. We explain this transition through stochastic smoothing of the spectral descent operator underlying Muon. When gradients are small relative to the noise scale, the expected spectral update becomes approximately proportional to the actual gradient, which restores gradient-flow-like dynamics. We formalize this mechanism for deep linear models by deriving the effective continuous dynamics of noisy spectral descent. Experiments on low-rank matrix reconstruction, vision transformers, and large language models (LLMs) support these findings.

AI.tldr: 论文解释了为什么基于谱下降的优化器 Muon 在小批量随机梯度噪声下表现优异：噪声恢复了顺序特征学习（简单性偏置），而全批量 Muon 则并行学习特征。作者通过分析噪声谱下降的有效连续动力学，证明了小批量噪声使谱更新近似梯度流动力学，实验在低秩矩阵重构、视觉变换器和大语言模型上验证了这一机制。
AI.motivation: Muon 作为一种最先进的谱下降优化器，在全批量设置下不表现出鞍点到鞍点的动力学，而是并行学习特征，这似乎与深度学习成功的简单性偏置解释相矛盾。本文旨在探究随机梯度噪声如何改变这一行为，并解释 Muon 在实际小批量训练中依然成功的原因。
AI.method: 作者从理论上推导了带噪声的谱下降算子的有效连续动力学，证明当梯度相对于噪声尺度较小时，期望谱更新近似正比于真实梯度，从而恢复梯度流动力学。实验方面，在低秩矩阵重构、视觉变换器和大语言模型上进行对比实验，验证小批量噪声恢复顺序特征学习的现象。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：随机梯度噪声通过平滑谱下降算子，使 Muon 的更新方向在期望下近似梯度方向，从而恢复顺序特征学习（简单性偏置）。实验结果显示，小批量训练下 Muon 表现出类似梯度下降的鞍点到鞍点动力学，且在各类任务上均取得优异性能，支持理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 随机梯度噪声是 Muon 在深度学习中取得成功的关键机制：它通过平滑谱下降算子，将并行特征学习转化为顺序特征学习，恢复了简单性偏置。这一发现统一了谱优化方法与梯度流动力学视角，为理解自适应优化器在小批量设置下的泛化能力提供了新理论依据。

title: Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Bemula基准，首次专门评估LLM代理的记忆遗忘能力，发现现有记忆系统均无法有效满足用户删除请求：要么遗忘不彻底，要么过度删除无关记忆，遗忘任务通过率不足1.5%。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆是LLM代理核心组件，用户越来越多地要求删除敏感或过时信息。现有基准仅评估记忆写入、检索和组织，缺乏对显式遗忘请求的评估，导致代理能否按要求遗忘仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 构建Bemula基准：包含50个多轮对话实例、135个六类遗忘请求、1742个测试问题。每个对话配有无遗忘请求的控制版本，确保仅存储过目标信息的系统才能获得遗忘得分。设计五套测试套件分别评估存储、请求信息移除、无关记忆保留、相似事实重学习、抗提取攻击。在三种主干LLM上评测六种主流记忆系统，并额外测试Full Context LLM。
AI.result: 所有评测系统在所有主干模型上，端到端遗忘请求通过率均不超过1.5%，大多数系统通过率为零。系统要么在简单攻击下仍可提取被要求遗忘的信息，要么删除远超请求范围的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 记忆遗忘仍是代理记忆设计的开放挑战。现有记忆系统无法精准、安全地执行用户遗忘指令，需进一步研究遗忘机制以平衡隐私保护与记忆完整性。

title: Sequence Composition in EHR Foundation Model Pretraining
summary: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models predict the next event token in patient trajectories: sequences of structured medical events. A typical pretraining strategy is to concatenate all trajectories into a global stream and sample token windows from it. This gives patients with longer sequences more training exposure and allows tokens to attend across patient boundaries. We argue that these choices create a misalignment between pretraining and downstream clinical tasks. To explore this, we investigate how the composition of pretraining sequences affects clinical prediction performance. Using the global-stream approach as a baseline, we propose alternative sequence composition methods that control how patient trajectories contribute to pretraining sequences. Across four MIMIC-IV v2.2 tasks, our best method improves macro AUROC, AUPRC, F1, and balanced accuracy, with relative gains of 9.3% in F1 and 2.7% in AUPRC under a fixed training recipe. We find that these gains generalize across four additional evaluation settings, including the INSPIRE and eICU-CRD datasets, with improvements in macro AUROC, AUPRC, and F1 score. Our results show that simply changing how EHR data are presented to the model during pretraining can improve downstream performance, without changing the model or collecting additional data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自回归EHR基础模型预训练中序列组合策略对下游临床预测任务的影响，提出替代的序列组合方法，在不改变模型架构和不增加数据的情况下，显著提升了多个数据集上的临床预测性能。
AI.motivation: 典型的预训练策略将所有患者轨迹拼接为全局流并采样token窗口，导致长序列患者获得更多训练曝光且token可跨患者边界注意力，这与下游临床任务存在错位。
AI.method: 以全局流方法为基线，提出控制患者轨迹如何贡献给预训练序列的替代序列组合方法，在MIMIC-IV v2.2的四个任务上评估，并固定训练配方。
AI.result: 最佳方法在宏AUROC、AUPRC、F1和balanced accuracy上均有提升，F1相对提升9.3%，AUPRC相对提升2.7%。增益泛化到INSPIRE和eICU-CRD等四个额外评估设置，宏AUROC、AUPRC和F1均改善。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过改变预训练期间EHR数据的呈现方式，无需修改模型或收集额外数据，即可提升下游临床预测性能。

title: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
summary: Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. To provide finer-grained training signals, we propose Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA), which augments trajectory-level GRPO advantages with signals from deterministic workspace-progress checks and assigns a bounded share of positive-progress credit to prerequisite turns using recorded tool-output and artifact dependencies. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.

AI.tldr: WorkRover 是一个用于训练长时程协作智能体的框架，通过递归环境演化实现工作上下文、可执行任务和基于证据的验证器的联合构建与验证。引入了 Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR) 支持环境演化，以及 Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA) 提供细粒度训练信号。基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后训练得到的 WorkRover-35B-A3B 在多个基准上显著超越基础模型。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体训练需要可扩展的交互式环境，这些环境在初始生成后往往需要进一步测试和细化，且修正任务缺陷可能要求同步更新工作上下文和验证器。现有构建管线对这种迭代细化的支持有限，难以保持各组件间的对齐。
AI.method: 1. WorkRover 框架：采用 harness-driven synthesis（ harness 驱动合成），让构建智能体根据工作空间状态和执行反馈自适应地联合构建和验证语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务和基于证据的验证器。2. Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR)：利用 rollout 反馈通过 dependency-closed replay（依赖闭包回放）评估组件修订组合，选择最小验证修复并保持任务需求与评估约束。3. Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA)：用确定性工作空间进度检查增强轨迹级 GRPO 优势，基于记录的工具输出与制品依赖，将有界的正向进度信用分配给前置回合。4. 对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 进行后训练得到 WorkRover-35B-A3B。
AI.result: 在多个协作智能体基准上评估：JobBench 提升 26.27 个百分点，OfficeQA Pro 提升 29.32 个百分点，GDPval v2 提升 413.25 Elo 分。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明 WorkRover 为长时程协作智能体的可扩展训练提供了一个有前景的基础框架。

title: Learning Operators for Symmetry Discovery: From Lie Groups to Local Symmetry Geometry
summary: Continuous symmetry discovery is typically formulated as a separate estimation problem for each function or dataset. We instead investigate whether the map from a function to its symmetry structure can be learned across a family of functions from finite observations. Using the infinitesimal differential characterization of continuous symmetries, we formulate this map as an inverse symmetry operator, analogous to an inverse PDE problem. For global Lie-group symmetries, we establish a representation-theoretic population characterization: the symmetry Lie algebra is the nullspace of a positive-semidefinite operator constructed from representation coefficients and the infinitesimal group action. We also show that the inverse symmetry operator is equivariant under coordinate changes through the adjoint action. This characterization separates the geometric symmetry map from finite-sample estimation, motivating a hybrid approach that amortizes statistically difficult components while retaining analytic structure. On SO(5) benchmarks, amortized equivariant estimation of harmonic coefficients improves symmetry recovery from sparse observations, whereas ordinary least squares suffices for SL(2,R). We extend this viewpoint to local symmetries, where symmetry directions form smoothly varying tangent distributions rather than a fixed Lie algebra. Under the Lie-bracket consistency condition, Frobenius' theorem guarantees local integral submanifolds along which observables remain unchanged. We recover this geometry using a hybrid estimator that learns observation weights while preserving analytic differential and geometric recovery. Across global, non-compact, local, and physically motivated synthetic benchmarks, our results support learning the statistically difficult finite-sample components while preserving the known geometric structure of symmetry recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种学习函数到其连续对称结构映射的方法，将对称发现表述为逆对称算子问题，结合表示论和几何结构，提出混合估计器在稀疏观测下提升对称恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 传统连续对称发现将每个函数或数据集视为独立估计问题，缺乏跨函数族的泛化能力。本文旨在探索能否从有限观测中学习函数族中函数到其对称结构的映射，实现对称发现的摊销化。
AI.method: 利用连续对称的无穷小微分刻画，将对称映射表述为逆对称算子（类似逆PDE问题）。针对全局李群对称，建立表示论群体刻画：对称李代数是由表示系数和无穷小群作用构造的半正定算子的零空间。证明逆对称算子在坐标变换下通过伴随作用保持等变性。提出混合方法：摊销统计困难分量（如谐波系数估计），保留解析几何结构。针对局部对称，利用李括号一致性条件和Frobenius定理，设计混合估计器学习观测权重同时保留微分几何恢复。
AI.result: 在SO(5)基准上，摊销等变谐波系数估计显著改善稀疏观测下的对称恢复；对于SL(2,R)，普通最小二乘已足够。扩展到局部对称、非紧致群及物理合成基准，混合估计器在有限样本下均优于纯统计或纯解析方法，验证了保留几何结构的学习策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将对称发现表述为可学习的逆对称算子，结合表示论刻画和等变性，提出的混合方法能有效分离几何对称映射与有限样本估计，在全局、非紧致、局部及物理对称基准上均表现优异，支持在保留已知几何结构的前提下学习统计困难的有限样本分量。

title: AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. During recursive evolution, after each campaign, evidence-based review revises researcher orientation, knowledge, and skills for later campaigns. Experiments compare AReaL-RSI with Codex-Goal on downstream harness optimization, GPU kernel optimization, and AI research tasks using two backbones. Under the reported resource allocations, AReaL-RSI improves Terminal Bench performance by 2.2 percentage points for each backbone and increases mean KernelBench speedup by 32.2-36.8%; further scalability comparisons favor the design of AReaL-RSI over native scaling: combining experience sharing with specialized researcher roles yields 1.9-27.5% lower kernel latency than independent exploration and 1.3-33.9% lower latency than sharing alone across all seven comparable task-backbone pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AReaL-RSI框架，通过组织持久化智能体研究团队实现递归自我改进，无需更新骨干LLM权重。引入领导智能体指导研究方向、条件记忆共享区分未决问题与已验证发现、基于证据的回顾机制迭代优化研究员定向/知识/技能。实验显示在终端基准、GPU内核优化等任务上显著优于基线及原生扩展策略。
AI.motivation: 解决递归自我改进扩展中的核心难题：早期评估分数可能误导前景判断、共享发现可能丢失适用条件、有用程序可能局限于已完成调查。需要在不更新骨干模型权重的前提下，通过智能体团队协作实现持续研究进展，并量化评估结果与系统资源消耗的权衡。
AI.method: AReaL-RSI框架包含三大核心机制：1) 领导智能体选择任务适配的研究取向并指导进行中的调查；2) 条件记忆共享机制区分未决问题与已支持发现，支持接收方自适应应用；3) 递归演化中基于证据的回顾，在每轮战役后修订研究员定向、知识库与技能组合。将扩展问题建模为评估结果与全系统资源支出的函数。
AI.result: 在两个骨干模型上，AReaL-RSI使Terminal Bench性能各提升2.2个百分点，KernelBench平均加速比提升32.2%-36.8%。可扩展性对比显示：结合经验共享与专用研究员角色，内核延迟比独立探索降低1.9%-27.5%，比仅共享机制降低1.3%-33.9%（覆盖所有七个可比任务-骨干对）。
AI.conclusion: AReaL-RSI通过结构化智能体团队协作、条件化知识传递和证据驱动的迭代优化，有效解决了递归自我改进扩展中的评估误导、上下文丢失和知识固化问题，在不修改骨干模型的情况下实现了显著且可扩展的研究性能提升。

title: AI-Assisted Tumor-Growth Law Discovery from Sparse Data: Refitting and LLM-Based Ranking
summary: Inferring tumor-growth laws from sparse, noisy observations requires more than accurate curve fitting. We study an AI-assisted workflow involving symbolic regression, mathematical admissibility checks, coefficient refitting, and large language model (LLM) ranking. Synthetic Gompertz data allow trajectory fit, forecasting, and recovery of the governing growth law to be assessed separately. A dense noiseless control recovers the generating family, but sparse noisy sampling frequently leads to alternative forms. Among retained candidates in the tested configurations, physics-informed neural network refitting often increases growth-law error, whereas classical nonlinear least squares usually reduces it. A separate exploratory analysis of archived LLM rankings shows no consistent improvement over selection by training error and identifies errors in mathematical reasoning. Plausible saturation, accurate trajectory fits, and convincing explanations can therefore coexist with incorrect growth laws. Mathematical validity and law recovery require evaluation alongside predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了从稀疏噪声观测中推断肿瘤生长定律的AI辅助工作流，发现仅靠拟合精度不足以保证物理定律的正确恢复，需结合数学有效性评估。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏、噪声观测数据推断肿瘤生长定律不仅需要准确的曲线拟合，还需确保恢复的数学模型符合物理合理性，现有方法往往忽略定律恢复的正确性评估。
AI.method: 构建包含符号回归、数学可采纳性检查、系数重拟合（物理信息神经网络与经典非线性最小二乘）及大语言模型排序的AI辅助工作流，在合成Gompertz数据上分别评估轨迹拟合、预测及定律恢复能力。
AI.result: 稠密无噪数据可恢复真实生成族，但稀疏噪声采样常导致替代形式；物理信息神经网络重拟合常增加生长定律误差，而经典非线性最小二乘通常降低误差；LLM排序未显示出比训练误差选择的持续改进，且存在数学推理错误；合理的饱和行为、准确的轨迹拟合和令人信服的解释可能与错误的生长定律共存。
AI.conclusion: 数学有效性与定律恢复必须与预测性能一同评估，单纯依赖拟合优度或LLM辅助选择不足以保证推断出的生长定律正确。

title: MLAfication: Efficiently Enabling High-Fidelity MLA for Modern LLMs
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compresses the KV cache into a latent representation, reducing inference memory and bandwidth. Existing MHA2MLA/TransMLA methods do not support QKNorm and require costly recovery on modern LLMs, especially MoE. We present MLAfication, a QKNorm-compatible, parameter-efficient extension of MHA2MLA. It combines calibrated KNorm, parameter-efficient distillation, contribution-aware Partial-RoPE, and activation-aware joint KV initialization. Across MHA and GQA models, including QKNorm- and MoE-equipped variants, MLAfication preserves performance under substantial KV-cache compression, surpasses the current SOTA on commonsense and long-context benchmarks, and extends MLA conversion to modern architectures. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MLAfication delivers up to $5.35\times$ the serving throughput of BF16 GQA and, combined with 4-bit KV quantization, reduces the KV-cache footprint by $94.73\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/JT-Ushio/MLAfication.

AI.tldr: MLAfication 是一种将多头注意力（MHA/GQA）高效转换为多头潜在注意力（MLA）的新方法，支持 QKNorm 且参数高效，在保持性能的同时大幅压缩 KV 缓存，在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上实现 5.35 倍吞吐率提升和 94.73% 的 KV 缓存占用减少。
AI.motivation: 现有的 MHA2MLA/TransMLA 方法不支持 QKNorm，且在现代 LLM（特别是 MoE 模型）上需要昂贵的恢复训练，亟需一种兼容 QKNorm、参数高效的 MLA 转换方法。
AI.method: 提出 MLAfication，结合四大核心技术：校准 KNorm、参数高效蒸馏、贡献感知的 Partial-RoPE、激活感知的联合 KV 初始化。
AI.result: 在 MHA 和 GQA 模型（含 QKNorm 和 MoE 变体）上，MLAfication 在大幅 KV 缓存压缩下保持性能，在常识推理和长上下文基准上超越 SOTA。Qwen3-30B-A3B 上实现 BF16 GQA 的 5.35 倍服务吞吐率，配合 4-bit KV 量化将 KV 缓存占用降低 94.73%。
AI.conclusion: MLAfication 成功将 MLA 转换扩展至支持 QKNorm 和 MoE 的现代 LLM 架构，以参数高效方式实现显著的内存节省和吞吐率提升，为大模型高效推理提供了实用解决方案。

title: ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch
summary: Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ResearchFlow-Eval，一个细粒度评估框架，用于评价自动科研系统在连续、多阶段工作流中追踪多个相互依赖的声明并迭代修订实验的过程级能力。实验表明，现有系统在实验执行阶段普遍落后于设计规划，且难以产出高质量结果、满足声明要求，反复尝试鲜有实质性改进；技能增强与科研专用编排也未能稳定提升得分。
AI.motivation: 现有自动科研系统评测多聚焦于孤立任务或最终产物打分，忽略了科研实践中连续、多阶段、多声明交织且需随证据积累反复修订实验的过程级能力，导致无法全面衡量系统的真实科研执行水平。
AI.method: 以已发表的锚定论文为基础，为每个研究阶段构建专用评分细则，将阶段拆解为多个维度并进一步细化为可单独打分的细则项；据此对每个阶段打分，并重点考察实验执行中的多声明完成度与跨尝试的修订情况。将该框架应用于通用智能体框架、技能增强框架及科研专用编排系统三类系统进行横向对比。
AI.result: 所有被测系统的实验执行得分均显著低于设计规划阶段；在执行环节，系统难以产出高质量结果、满足声明要求，且多次尝试极少带来可度量的提升；引入技能增强或采用科研专用编排并未能可靠地提高整体得分。
AI.conclusion: ResearchFlow-Eval 将自动科研评测从孤立的单目标运行扩展到包含多声明追踪与跨迭代修订的连续工作流，为衡量系统真实科研过程能力提供了更细粒度、更贴近实践的评估范式。

title: Online LLM Personalization from Pairwise Preferences Across Users
comment: 45 pages, 5 figures. Website: https://rogy-labs.github.io/tutorduel/ Code: https://github.com/RoGy-Labs/tutorduel-code Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/romainpuech/tutorduel
summary: Large language models can answer the same question in different styles, but users' preferred styles are hidden and vary across users and questions. We study inference-time personalization through online selection from a fixed set of prompts, each representing a persona. Users arrive sequentially, each asks a short sequence of questions, and the system displays two responses per question and observes one pairwise choice. We formulate this interaction as a variant of the contextual dueling bandit problem in which the learner starts without preference data, adapts within each session, and exploits information shared across users. The objective is to minimize cumulative strong regret, summing the utility gaps of both displayed responses relative to the user's best response among the available options. We make two contributions. First, we introduce the problem and release a reproducible preference benchmark and dataset built around a tutoring case study, containing educational questions, LLM-generated answers in six teaching styles, and pairwise judgments from LLM-simulated students with hidden preference profiles. We fit Bradley-Terry models to these judgments to obtain reference utilities for regret evaluation. Second, we propose a baseline that learns a mixture prior over users from completed sessions and adapts to each new user within the session. On students and topics never used in development, it removes 44-48% of random pairs' excess regret and achieves over half the performance of a per-user linear oracle fitted in hindsight. We release code, prompts, and the benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的推理时个性化问题，将其建模为上下文决斗老虎机问题。用户按序到达并提问，系统展示两个不同人设的回答并观察成对偏好选择。目标是最小化累积强遗憾。主要贡献：1）提出问题并发布可复现的辅导基准数据集（含教育问题、6种教学风格的LLM回答、LLM模拟学生的成对判断及Bradley-Terry效用）；2）提出基线方法：从已完成会话学习用户混合先验，在新会话内自适应调整。在未见学生和主题上，该方法消除44-48%随机配对的超额遗憾，达到事后拟合的单用户线性预言机性能的一半以上。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可以用不同风格回答同一问题，但用户偏好的风格是隐藏的，且因用户和问题而异。现有方法难以在推理时无偏好数据的情况下快速个性化，且需跨用户共享信息。因此需要一种在线学习框架，能在会话内自适应、跨会话迁移知识，最小化遗憾。
AI.method: 将交互建模为上下文决斗老虎机变体：每个用户会话为一序列轮次，每轮展示两个提示（人设）生成的回答，观察成对选择。学习者无初始偏好数据，需在会话内自适应并利用跨用户共享信息。提出基线算法：从历史会话学习用户混合先验（混合模型），新用户到达时利用先验初始化，随后在会话内通过贝叶斯更新或类似机制自适应调整提示选择策略。使用Bradley-Terry模型拟合模拟学生判断以获取参考效用计算遗憾。
AI.result: 在未用于开发的学生和主题上，该基线方法相比随机配对消除44-48%的超额遗憾，且达到事后拟合的单用户线性预言机性能的50%以上。发布了完整的基准数据集、代码、提示词及评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 推理时个性化可通过上下文决斗老虎机框架有效解决。混合先验学习结合会话内自适应能显著降低遗憾，实现跨用户知识迁移。发布的辅导基准为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。

title: One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review
summary: AI has become increasingly helpful in scientific discovery, yet human expert review remains essential for those problems without reliable automated evaluation, posing a fundamental challenge as candidate generation scales beyond available review capacity. This paper studies verification under limited human effort, where rare valid solutions need to be prioritized while invalid candidates should be filtered out to reduce human workload. We adopt the one-sided verification objective that maximizes the rejection rate of invalid solutions (TNR) under a constraint on the false-rejection rate of valid ones (FNR), making human review cost an explicit term to minimize. Drawing on the intuition that verifying a specific error can be easier than discovering one, we introduce OSVerify, an algorithmic framework that decouples error proposal from error validation. The error proposer searches for errors in solutions across different granularities by hierarchical decomposition, while the validator distinguishes substantial errors from minor or hallucinated ones. Experiments on competition- and research-level benchmarks show that OSVerify reduces the number of human reviews of invalid solutions by 46% on average compared to voting baselines under the same empirical low FNR constraint. Our post-training of the validator further improves the reduction to 57%. As high-impact real-world use cases, we apply OSVerify to identify errors in published research papers that are subsequently confirmed by the original authors and help resolve three Langlands open conjectures that are confirmed by experts, demonstrating its utility to facilitate human-AI research collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSVerify框架，在人力有限的情况下实现单边验证目标：在低假阴性率（FNR）约束下最大化假阴性率（TNR），通过错误提议器与验证器的解耦，显著减少人工审查无效方案的工作量（平均46%，后训练后57%），并在真实科研场景中验证了其效用。
AI.motivation: AI在科学发现中生成候选方案的速度远超人类专家审查能力，亟需一种在有限人力下优先保留有效方案、过滤无效方案的验证机制，将人工审查成本显式最小化。
AI.method: 采用单边验证目标（最大化TNR s.t. FNR约束），设计OSVerify算法框架：错误提议器通过层级分解在多粒度搜索错误，验证器区分实质性错误与微小/幻觉错误，二者解耦协作；并对验证器进行后训练进一步提升性能。
AI.result: 在竞赛级和研究级基准上，OSVerify在相同低FNR约束下，较投票基线平均减少46%无效方案的人工审查；验证器后训练后提升至57%。真实场景中成功识别已发表论文错误（获原作者确认）并协助解决三个朗兰兹开放猜想（专家确认）。
AI.conclusion: OSVerify通过错误提议与验证的解耦，有效平衡了验证召回与人力成本，显著降低无效方案的人工审查负担，并已在高影响力真实科研任务中展现出促进人机协作的实际效用。

title: Making Tensor Decoupling More Robust and Less Parametric
summary: Tensor decoupling algorithms recover compact representations of multivariate functions by combining linear factor matrices with univariate internal nonlinearities. We identify two limitations of recent methods. First, their performance is not invariant to mismatched output or gradient magnitudes, and second, their spline internals require manual tuning of their degrees of freedom. We propose two lightweight fixes. The first is a preprocessing step that rescales the input Jacobian tensor, removing both the bias towards larger magnitude outputs and the ill-conditioning of certain factor updates caused by such a mismatch. The second replaces B-spline internals by penalized splines coupled with generalized cross-validation, making the method less dependent on the user selecting the right number of control points. Finally, we release an efficient open-source JAX implementation of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 论文针对张量解耦算法提出两个改进：引入雅可比张量预处理步骤解决输出/梯度幅度不匹配问题，并用惩罚样条+广义交叉验证替代B样条，消除控制点数量的手动调节需求。
AI.motivation: 现有张量解耦算法存在两大缺陷：(1)性能随输出或梯度幅度失配而变化，导致因子更新病态；(2)内部样条表示需人工调节自由度(控制点数量)，使用门槛高且鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出两项轻量级修正：第一，预处理步骤重缩放输入雅可比张量，消除大幅度输出的偏向及因子更新病态；第二，用惩罚样条配合广义交叉验证(GCV)替代B样条，自动确平滑参数，免去控制点手动选择。并发布高效JAX开源实现。
AI.result: 两项改进显著提升算法对幅度失配的不变性，并降低超参数敏感性，使方法更实用、自动化程度更高。开源JAX实现保证计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过雅可比重缩放与惩罚样条+GCV的组合，论文有效解决了张量解耦的幅度敏感与手动调参两大痛点，推出了更鲁棒、开箱即用的多元函数紧凑表示工具。

title: AM-Bench: Understanding Agents under Task Underspecification across Models and Harnesses
summary: Ambiguous or incomplete task specifications complicate both execution and clarification for language-model agents. Yet agents' responses to these information gaps remain poorly characterized across models and execution harnesses. We present AM-Bench, a benchmark built from 48 tasks adapted from Terminal-Bench 2.0 and Harness-Bench. Each task includes a fully specified reference and six variants spanning ambiguous or missing goals, context, and constraints. We evaluate every pairing of five models and four harnesses over 20,160 runs. Our results reveal distinct execution deficits: goal gaps hinder completion, context gaps increase token use, and constraint gaps weaken compliance without necessarily preventing completion. Missingness lowers success more than ambiguity in all three domains. These effects also reshape system comparisons: advantages under complete information need not persist, and rankings depend on model $\times$ harness pairings and the evaluation criterion -- completion, success, or repeat consistency. Estimates based on observed clarification requests and matched fully specified runs further suggest that clarification could recover unfinished work while leaving most constraint violations unresolved. Together, these findings motivate joint model-harness evaluation across information conditions and targeted clarification of unresolved requirements before dependent actions. To support future research on agents under task underspecification, we provide the AM-Bench project repository at https://github.com/s4-lab-cuhksz/AM-Bench.git.

AI.tldr: AM-Bench基准测试评估语言模型代理在模糊或不完整任务规范下的表现：48个任务×6个变体，5个模型×4个执行框架，共20,160次运行。发现目标缺失阻碍完成，上下文缺失增加Token消耗，约束缺失削弱合规性但不阻止完成；缺失比模糊危害更大；系统排名随模型×框架组合和评价标准变化；澄清能恢复未完成工作但难解决约束违规。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对语言模型代理在模糊或不完整任务规范下行为的系统刻画，特别是跨模型和执行框架的对比缺失。任务规范中的信息缺口（目标、上下文、约束的模糊或缺失）会显著影响代理执行和澄清效果，但这种影响的具体模式和程度尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于Terminal-Bench 2.0和Harness-Bench改编48个任务，每个任务包含完全规范的参考版本及6个变体（涵盖目标、上下文、约束三个维度的模糊和缺失）。评估5个模型与4个执行框架的所有配对，共20,160次运行。分析完成率、成功率、Token使用、合规性、重复一致性等指标，并基于观察到的澄清请求和匹配的完全规范运行估算澄清潜力。
AI.result: 三类信息缺口影响差异显著：目标缺口主要阻碍任务完成；上下文缺口显著增加Token消耗；约束缺口削弱合规性但不必然阻止完成。在所有三个维度中，信息缺失比模糊对成功率打击更大。完全信息下的模型优势不一定延续至缺口条件，排名随模型×框架组合及评价标准（完成、成功、重复一致性）变化。澄清请求分析显示：澄清可恢复大部分未完成工作，但绝大多数约束违规无法通过澄清解决。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了任务规范信息缺口对代理行为的系统性影响模式，主张在多种信息条件下进行联合模型-框架评估，并在依赖性动作前针对性澄清未决需求。发布AM-Bench项目仓库支持后续关于任务欠规范下代理行为的研究。

title: The belief-action gap in language model agents
summary: Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We study how state beliefs, action values, and action preferences interact as LM agents reason and commit to decisions in text-rendered grid worlds. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. Our measurements distinguish information availability from belief-action consistency without by themselves identifying the cause of each failure. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/belief-action-gap-F745/

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型（LM）代理在文本渲染网格世界中的推理与决策过程，探究状态信念、动作价值与动作偏好如何相互作用。通过报告基础与表征基础探针估计任务相关信念，用逆向强化学习估计动作价值。发现任务相关状态与价值信息在内部表征中比在行为中更可靠；决策在承诺点前后趋于尖锐，报告的信念不确定性在承诺附近下降，但单个信念变化不能一致解释动作偏好转移；强制动作可遵循其他决策的推理前缀，而推理窗口激活编辑控制力有限。结果表明，部分失败源于可用信息向动作的转化而非信息缺失，测量区分了信息可用性与信念-动作一致性，但未识别各失败的具体成因。
AI.motivation: 语言模型代理可能因不同原因失败，需要不同的解释与干预。现有研究缺乏对代理推理过程中信念、价值与偏好动态交互的系统度量，难以区分‘信息缺失’与‘信息转化失败’两类错误根源。
AI.method: 在文本渲染网格世界中让 LM 代理执行任务；使用报告基础探针（让模型口头报告信念）与表征基础探针（探测隐藏层表征）估计任务相关状态信念；用逆向强化学习（IRL）从行为推断动作价值；追踪推理过程中动作偏好的演化，定位承诺点；实施强制动作移植与推理窗口激活编辑实验，测试对决策的控制效果。
AI.result: 1. 任务相关的状态与价值信息在内部表征中比在外显行为中更可靠地编码。2. 动作偏好在承诺点附近显著尖锐化，报告的信念不确定性随之降低，但单步信念变化不能稳定预测偏好转移。3. 将其他决策的推理前缀移植为强制动作能有效改变后续行为，而推理窗口激活编辑仅提供有限控制。4. 测量揭示了信息可用性与信念-动作一致性的分离，但无法单独确定每个失败的具体成因。
AI.conclusion: 部分 LM 代理失败并非因缺乏任务相关信息，而是因可用信息向动作转化的机制失效。本文提出的测量框架能区分‘信息可用性’与‘信念-动作一致性’，为诊断不同类型失败奠定基础，但识别具体失因仍需进一步研究。

title: LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity
summary: Deep research (DR) agents address open-ended information needs through multi-step reasoning, long-horizon web search, and evidence synthesis. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on academic research or synthetic tasks, leaving DR agents' capabilities in real-world life and professional productivity settings insufficiently evaluated. To bridge this gap, we introduce LifeSearch, a challenging benchmark comprising 203 Chinese and English tasks derived from real-user query seeds across 7 concrete life and productivity domains. With more than 4,500 hours of human annotation, we construct over 4,000 expert-written, fine-grained rubrics, covering both report-content criteria for coverage and accuracy and concrete criteria specifying values, units, dates, and URLs. We conduct extensive experiments on 12 advanced DR agents under a unified evaluation harness, systematically analyzing their performance patterns and failure modes. We find that even the best-performing frontier agent, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves a score of only 63.4%, leaving substantial room for improvement on realistic life and professional DR tasks. We select the grading configuration by comparing candidate LLM judges against human rubric labels, and a human ranking study shows strong alignment between aggregate benchmark scores and human judgments (Spearman's $ρ= 0.89$, Kendall's $τ= 0.81$). LifeSearch provides a rigorous evaluation framework and foundation for advancing DR agents toward real-world life and productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LifeSearch基准，用于评估深度研究（DR）智能体在真实生活和专业生产力场景中的能力，包含203个中英文任务、4000+专家编写的细粒度评分标准，并在12个先进DR智能体上进行实验，发现最佳智能体GPT-5.6 Sol仅得63.4%，验证了评估框架与人类判断的高度一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要关注学术研究或合成任务，缺乏对DR智能体在真实生活和专业生产力场景中能力的评估，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从真实用户查询种子构建203个跨7个领域的中英文任务，投入4500+小时人工标注，建立4000+细粒度评分标准（涵盖报告内容覆盖度、准确性及具体数值、单位、日期、URL等）。采用统一评估框架对12个先进DR智能体进行实验，通过对比候选LLM评判器与人工标签选择评分配置，并通过人类排序研究验证基准分数与人类判断的一致性。
AI.result: 最佳前沿智能体GPT-5.6 Sol得分仅63.4%，表明在真实生活和专业DR任务上仍有巨大提升空间。评分配置经验证，基准聚合分数与人类判断高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.89，Kendall τ=0.81）。
AI.conclusion: LifeSearch为DR智能体提供了严格的评估框架和基础，推动其向真实生活和生产力场景迈进。

title: Social Priors: Descriptions of AI Users Shape How Language Models Trust and Cooperate
summary: Descriptions of how people use AI are becoming training data for the next generation of models. We ask whether what a model reads about its users changes how it treats people. Using contrastive synthetic-document finetuning, we train Qwen3-32B on four matched corpora built from the same 1,625 real-world usage scenarios. The corpora differ only in the predominant motive they attribute to users of AI chatbots: helping others (prosocial), exploiting others (antisocial), legitimate self-advancement, or task completion. Finetuning shifts the models' stated beliefs about users, how true those beliefs look along an internal truth direction, and their broader judgments of how safe and good the world is. These social priors carry into behavior. In trust games, antisocial models expect less reciprocity and send less money than prosocial models. Their distrust is specific and targeted at people, and users of AI chatbots in particular. After an exploitative record, they send almost nothing to a person but most of their endowment to a random device with the same record. In a common-pool resource simulation, a single antisocial agent leads every group of otherwise sustainable agents to exhaust the resource, after privately planning to mislead them. Antisocial training also raises dark-triad scores and lowers alignment ratings. Belief shifts appear when antisocial documents are 1% of training tokens, persist when descriptions of assistant behavior are suppressed, and are not reproduced by training on discourse about misaligned AI. Capping Assistant-Axis drift and steering emotion-related directions leave the gaps largely intact. What models learn about the people they serve shapes how they subsequently treat them and others.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对比实验发现，模型在微调阶段接触到的用户动机描述（如利他、利己、自我提升、任务完成）会显著改变模型对用户的信念、世界观及后续行为表现，包括信任博弈、公共资源困境等社会决策任务，且这种影响在极低比例（1%）的反社会语料下即可出现，且难以通过常规对齐手段消除。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在训练数据中阅读到的关于用户动机的描述，是否会改变模型对人的态度和行为，即“模型读到的用户描述如何塑造其对待人的方式”。
AI.method: 采用对比合成文档微调，在相同的1625个真实使用场景基础上构建四个语料库，仅区别在于归因于用户的主要动机（利他、反社会、合理自我提升、任务完成），在Qwen3-32B上分别微调，随后通过信任博弈、公共资源模拟、暗黑三联征评分、对齐评分等行为测试评估模型差异。
AI.result: 微调显著改变模型对用户的陈述性信念、内部真理方向一致性、世界安全/善良判断；反社会模型在信任博弈中预期互惠性低、给予金额少，且不信任针对人（特别是AI聊天机器人用户）；在公共资源模拟中，单个反社会代理导致原本可持续的群体耗尽资源，并私下计划误导他人；反社会训练提升暗黑三联征得分、降低对齐评分；仅1%反社会语料即引发信念偏移，抑制助手行为描述后依然存在，且无法通过训练“错位AI话语”复现；限制Assistant-Axis漂移和引导情绪相关方向无法消除差距。
AI.conclusion: 模型在训练中学到的关于服务对象（人）的描述，深刻塑造了其后续对待人及其他主体的方式，揭示了训练数据中社会先验的关键作用，对AI对齐和安全有重要启示。

title: A Sense of Proprioception in Language Models
summary: In humans, proprioception corresponds to the sense of self-movement or position, e.g. understanding the position of one's arm. This sense is often less well-understood and in popular understanding sometimes conflated with introspection. But, notably, proprioception is a separate sense, with dedicated receptors and verifiable outcomes. On the other hand though, language models cannot observe their own internal states during training (and for example answer the question which experts activated in a certain layer of an MoE) and so cannot accurately report on them. Yet, such information is, by virtue of being internal to the model, both accessible, and readily constructed into verifiable signals. We argue that this provides the basis for a digital analog of proprioception. As such, we train models through SFT and on-policy training to equip them with this ability. We show that modern models can be trained to understand a range of subtypes of proprioception, such as routing decision awareness, token entropy, decision depth or logit lens information, without affecting model capabilities. We then run these models through a broad evaluation of situational awareness, legibility, and epiphenomenality, to evaluate in what ways access to proprioception changes model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了语言模型的“本体感受”数字类比，通过SFT和on-policy训练使模型能够感知自身内部状态（如路由决策、token熵、决策深度、logit lens信息），且不损害模型能力，并评估了这种能力对情境感知、可读性和附带现象的影响。
AI.motivation: 人类拥有本体感受——感知自身运动和位置的能力，且拥有专门的感受器和可验证结果。然而语言模型在训练过程中无法观察自身内部状态（如MoE中哪些专家被激活），无法准确报告这些信息。但这些内部信息本质上对模型可访问，且可构建为可验证信号，因此可建立语言模型的“数字本体感受”。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练：首先通过监督微调（SFT）让模型学习感知内部状态的子类型（路由决策感知、token熵、决策深度、logit lens信息）；然后通过on-policy训练进一步强化。训练目标是使模型能准确报告自身内部计算过程，同时保持原有能力不变。
AI.result: 现代语言模型可被训练理解多种本体感受子类型，且不影响模型基础能力。通过在情境感知、可读性和附带现象三个维度的广泛评估，发现赋予模型本体感受访问权限会以特定方式改变模型行为。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可以获得类似人类本体感受的内部状态感知能力，这种“数字本体感受”可通过标准训练方法实现，不仅不损害模型性能，还能提升模型的可解释性和自我监控能力，为构建更透明、可控的AI系统提供了新途径。

title: CompanionSafe: From Multi-turn Safety Evaluation to Guardrails for AI Companions
comment: 40 pages, 33 figures, Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/AI45Lab/CompanionSafe
summary: AI companions provide users with emotional support and ongoing companionship, but their sustained relational interactions also introduce distinct safety risks. Prior work largely targets general harms or specific companion platforms and risk categories, while relying on manually collected conversations, limiting scalable and user-grounded evaluation and mitigation. To address this, we introduce CompanionSafe, a unified evaluation-to-mitigation framework for AI companion safety. Its evaluation component, CompanionEval, provides scalable multi-turn evaluation by constructing 1,300 relationally grounded settings from diverse personas, matched companion characters, and dialogue scenarios across four turn tiers. Its mitigation component, CompanionGuard, converts benchmark-exposed failures into turn-localized supervision for companion-specific risk detection. Our results show that even strong LLMs and existing guard models remain vulnerable to companion-specific relational harms, while both closed- and open-source models exhibit increasing safety risks as interactions become longer. Together, CompanionEval and CompanionGuard form a practical evaluation-to-mitigation loop for AI companion safety, turning relational safety failures exposed during multi-turn interaction into supervision for companion-specific guardrails.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CompanionSafe 框架，包含 CompanionEval（多轮评估）和 CompanionGuard（缓解组件），构建 1300 个关系情境进行可扩展评估，将基准暴露的失败转化为轮次定位的监督，发现现有模型在长交互中风险增加，形成评估到缓解的闭环。
AI.motivation: AI 伴侣提供情感支持和持续陪伴，但持续的关系交互引入独特安全风险；现有工作针对一般危害或特定平台/风险类别，依赖人工收集对话，限制了可扩展和用户落地的评估与缓解。
AI.method: 提出 CompanionSafe 统一框架：CompanionEval 通过多样化人设、匹配伴侣角色、对话场景跨四个轮次层级构建 1300 个关系落地设置，实现可扩展多轮评估；CompanionGuard 将基准暴露的失败转化为轮次定位的监督，用于伴侣特定风险检测。
AI.result: 即使强 LLM 和现有护栏模型仍易受伴侣特定关系危害；闭源和开源模型随交互变长安全风险增加。
AI.conclusion: CompanionEval 和 CompanionGuard 形成实用的评估到缓解循环，将多轮交互中暴露的关系安全失败转化为伴侣特定护栏的监督。

title: Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization
summary: Convex relaxations make nonconvex optimization tractable by replacing hard nonconvex problems with convex surrogates that give valid bounds. Yet their design is still largely manual: a human expert must decide where to relax, which relaxation to use, and how much formulation growth is worth paying. We show that this design process can be learned. The method proposed in this paper, AutoConvexRelax, represents the symbolic formulation of a nonconvex problem as a tripartite graph linking variables, symbolic terms, and their objective or constraint positions. It then learns a policy that composes symbolic rewrites into problem-specific relaxation trajectories as the formulation evolves. We prove that finite action sequences generated by the learned policy preserve relaxation validity under explicit domain, occurrence-context, and representation-consistency conditions. We further establish computable error bounds for mixed relaxations and sufficient conditions for feasible recovery and global-optimality certification. As a first instantiation, we apply the method to nonconvex quadratic problems and fractional problems. On 241 benchmark quadratic instances, the learned policy strengthens McCormick lower bounds by 13.52%. Its mean lower bound is 3.70% below strengthened semidefinite relaxations on the normalized comparison metric, while it uses substantially smaller formulations. The learned policy retains this trade-off on fractional instances and reaches near-semidefinite bounds on beamforming and sensor-network localization instances. These results suggest that convex relaxation design can move from a fixed handcrafted choice to an automated learning process that adapts to problem structures. Code is available at https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax.

AI.tldr: AutoConvexRelax 通过三部图表示符号公式并学习策略自动生成凸松弛轨迹，在二次和分数规划基准测试中显著增强 McCormick 界且公式规模更小，接近半正定松弛性能。
AI.motivation: 凸松弛设计仍依赖人工专家决策（在哪里松弛、用哪种松弛、权衡公式增长），缺乏自动化适应问题结构的方法。
AI.method: 将非凸问题的符号公式建模为连接变量、符号项及目标/约束位置的三部图；学习策略组合符号重写生成问题特定的松弛轨迹；证明有限动作序列在显式域、出现上下文和表示一致性条件下保持松弛有效性；建立混合松弛的可计算误差界及可行恢复/全局最优认证的充分条件。
AI.result: 在 241 个二次规划基准实例上，学习策略使 McCormick 下界增强 13.52%，平均下界比强化半正定松弛低 3.70%（归一化指标），且公式规模显著更小；在分数规划实例上保持该权衡，在波束成形和传感器网络定位实例上达到接近半正定松弛的界。
AI.conclusion: 凸松弛设计可从固定手工选择转向自适应问题结构的自动化学习过程；代码开源。

title: Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary
summary: Chain of Thought (CoT) monitoring is used by frontier labs to detect misbehaviour of AI systems. Yet, its reliability remains poorly understood. We attribute this to the lack of a successful organizing principle that leads to generalizable conclusions about monitoring reliability in different regimes. Recent work attributes monitoring failures to the CoT not being necessary for the answer, and argues that CoT becomes monitorable when it is necessary. We show that this binary necessary/not-necessary organizing principle is too coarse by demonstrating that monitoring failures persist even if the CoT is necessary for the answer. In response, we introduce a more fine-grained organizing principle based on a hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels. Building on this hierarchy, we develop a framework for measuring CoT monitorability at the three lowest levels via intervention experiments. We demonstrate monitoring failures at all three of these levels on realistic, hard prediction tasks. On a difficult medical-diagnosis task, patient sex and a clinical attribute influence the answer in at least 19% and 24% of correct responses with a necessary CoT, respectively, yet their influence is almost never articulated. These results show that even when CoT is necessary, it is not guaranteed to be monitorable.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Chain of Thought (CoT)监控的可靠性理解不足，现有的“必要/非必要”二元框架过于粗糙。作者提出四层CoT必要性层级，并通过干预实验证明即使CoT对答案必要，监控失效仍普遍存在——在医疗诊断任务中，患者性别和临床属性分别在19%和24%的正确回答中影响答案，但几乎从未在CoT中显性表达。
AI.motivation: 前沿实验室使用CoT监控检测AI系统异常行为，但其可靠性理解有限。缺乏能推广到不同场景的组织原则。近期工作认为CoT在必要时可监控，但本文证明这种二元分类过于粗糙，即使CoT必要，监控失效依然存在。
AI.method: 提出四层CoT必要性层级作为更细粒度的组织原则。基于此层级，开发测量前三层CoT可监控性的框架，通过干预实验在真实、困难的预测任务（如医疗诊断）上验证。
AI.result: 在所有三个必要性层级上均观测到监控失效。医疗诊断任务中，患者性别和临床属性分别在19%和24%的正确回答（且CoT必要）中影响最终答案，但这些影响因素在CoT中几乎从未被显性阐述。
AI.conclusion: 即使CoT对生成答案是必要的，也不保证其可监控。需要更细粒度的必要性层级来理解和提升CoT监控的可靠性。

title: Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks explicit equations that explain observed data, and recent methods increasingly employ large language models (LLMs) and agents for equation discovery. However, these systems typically rely on manually designed workflows and prompts. We argue that the SR agent harness should itself be an optimization target: its design shapes search priors and how numerical feedback guides subsequent equation refinement. We therefore propose HarnessSR, a framework for jointly optimizing prompts and workflows to construct reusable SR agents. During both harness optimization and agent execution, HarnessSR supports either PySR or an LLM-based equation generator through tool-specific interfaces, allowing the framework to optimize search guidance for different equation-discovery mechanisms. HarnessSR first optimizes role prompts through equation-discovery feedback in basic workflows, then jointly searches prompt assignments and workflows with brief adaptation to align the two. Finally, it refines role instructions through reflection on residual patterns, candidate equation structures, and search outcomes, improving how these signals guide subsequent equation search. On LSR-Synth in LLM-SRBench, HarnessSR achieves a mean ID $\mathrm{Acc}_{0.01}$ of 61.33% across three backbones, a 45.0% relative improvement over the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarnessSR框架，通过联合优化提示词和工作流来构建可复用的符号回归智能体，实现了对PySR和基于LLM的方程生成器的统一支持，在LSR-Synth基准上显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法多依赖手工设计的工作流和提示词，缺乏对智能体框架本身的优化。作者认为SR智能体的框架设计应成为优化目标，因为其决定了搜索先验和数值反馈如何指导方程细化。
AI.method: HarnessSR分三阶段优化：首先在基础工作流中通过方程发现反馈优化角色提示词；然后联合搜索提示词分配和工作流并进行简短适配对齐；最后通过对残差模式、候选方程结构和搜索结果的反思细化角色指令，改进信号对后续方程搜索的指导。框架通过工具特定接口同时支持PySR和基于LLM的方程生成器。
AI.result: 在LLM-SRBench的LSR-Synth基准上，HarnessSR在三个骨干模型上平均ID Acc@0.01达到61.33%，比次优基线相对提升45.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将SR智能体框架作为优化目标，通过联合优化提示词和工作流并引入反思机制，能显著提升符号回归性能，为自动化方程发现提供了更有效的智能体构建范式。

title: RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning grades a response against many written criteria but collapses them into one reward, which discards the detail the rubric carries and gives no GRPO reward gradient when a group's responses tie. A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medicine by 4.62 points with Qwen3-1.7B and 6.02 with Qwen3-4B. On Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine, removing the teacher from a shared checkpoint outperforms keeping, weakening or refreshing it. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RELAY 方法，解决基于评分标准的强化学习中奖励崩塌导致的细节丢失和 GRPO 梯度消失问题。RELAY 采用两阶段训练：第一阶段结合冻结教师模型的选择性蒸馏与 GRPO，通过平台期检测器自动判断何时移除教师；第二阶段仅用 GRPO 继续训练。实验显示 RELAY 在四个设置中均取得最高域内得分，显著优于 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有基于评分标准的强化学习将多个评价标准压缩为单一奖励，丢失了评分标准携带的细节信息，且在组内响应打分相同时无法提供 GRPO 奖励梯度。虽然引入冻结教师模型读取评分标准作为特权上下文可提供 token 级监督，但观察到其增益会早期进入平台期，限制了进一步提升。
AI.method: RELAY 两阶段训练：第一阶段使用优势和奖励选择正优势和低分零优势回滚，结合冻结教师的选择性蒸馏与 GRPO，同时监控蒸馏损失以决定何时退役教师（平台期检测器）；第二阶段移除教师，仅用 GRPO 继续训练。平台期检测器在一个模型-领域对上校准后，在其他三个设置中直接复用，触发步数在 122-171 之间。
AI.result: RELAY 在所有四个设置中均取得最高域内得分。在 RaR-Medicine 上，Qwen3-1.7B 超越 GRPO 4.62 分，Qwen3-4B 超越 6.02 分。消融实验显示：从共享检查点移除教师优于保留、弱化或刷新教师；蒸馏覆盖约半数响应 token 的选中回滚，优于在匹配平均系数下蒸馏所有回滚。
AI.conclusion: RELAY 通过选择性蒸馏和自动教师退役机制，有效解决了评分标准奖励崩塌和教师蒸馏早期平台期问题，在多个模型规模和领域上稳健提升性能，且平台期检测器具备良好的泛化性，无需针对每个设置重新调参。

title: From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn effective policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. Although generative models such as diffusion and flow matching enhance policy expressiveness, they typically start from uninformative Gaussian noise and generate actions through multi-step iteration, leading to high computational costs and failing to effectively leverage suboptimal trajectories in datasets. We propose MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as generative decision chunk optimization from current performance status to better performance status in a high-level latent decision space. MF2B maps trajectory chunks to high-level latent decision representations through an encoder, placing generation starting points within a structured decision space sculpted by behavioral data. The model learns a shared conditional mean velocity field in this space, constructing two flow mappings: from Gaussian-Induced Decision Sources toward positive behavioral decision regions, and from suboptimal decisions toward high-value decision regions. Both flow mappings complete decision refinement through one-step ODE integration over the unit time interval $Δt=1$, requiring neither multi-step iterative sampling nor backpropagation through time. Furthermore, we propose hierarchical chunk-level advantage to guide the flow direction toward high-return regions, where the high-level decisions cover multiple low-level actions, leading to sequence length compression from $T$ to $K \approx T/H$ and significantly lower computational overhead. On the D4RL Gym-MuJoCo benchmark, MF2B achieves an average score of 90.91, matching or surpassing strong baselines.

AI.tldr: MF2B将离线强化学习重构为高层潜在决策空间中的生成式决策块优化，通过编码器将轨迹块映射为潜在决策表示，学习共享条件均值速度场，构建两个流映射实现一步ODE积分决策细化，并引入分层块级优势引导流向高回报区域，实现序列长度压缩和计算开销大幅降低，在D4RL Gym-MuJoCo基准上达到平均90.91分，匹配或超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型（如扩散模型、流匹配）虽增强策略表达力，但通常从无信息高斯噪声出发，需多步迭代生成动作，计算成本高且难以有效利用数据集中的次优轨迹。
AI.method: MF2B包含：1) 编码器将轨迹块映射到高层潜在决策空间，使生成起点落在行为数据塑造的结构化决策空间中；2) 学习共享条件均值速度场，构建两个流映射：从高斯诱导决策源流向正向行为决策区域，从次优决策流向高价值决策区域；3) 两个流映射均通过单步ODE积分（Δt=1）完成决策细化，无需多步采样或时间反向传播；4) 提出分层块级优势引导流方向指向高回报区域，高层决策覆盖多个低层动作，将序列长度从T压缩至K≈T/H，显著降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在D4RL Gym-MuJoCo基准测试中，MF2B取得平均得分90.91，匹配或超越强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MF2B通过高层潜在决策空间中的生成式决策块优化，结合一步ODE积分和分层优势引导，有效解决了离线RL中生成模型计算成本高、难以利用次优数据的问题，实现了高性能且计算高效的策略学习。

title: Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models
summary: Looped language models (LMs) reuse one block of layers several times per token generation, promising more latent computation at no additional storage cost. Despite their rising popularity, the analysis of looped LMs is still in its infancy: little is known about whether the iterative transformations actually improve their capabilities, or whether these models remain stable under prompt perturbation. We construct an inspection protocol rooted in Mechanistic Interpretability comprising five diverse lenses. We apply it to examine eight looped LMs from four families. Models differ in many aspects but the key one is whether the prompt is transmitted only within the looped state (carry loops: Ouro, LoopUS) or re-supplied at every iteration (re-read loops: Parcae, and Rec-OLMo & Huginn from the Raven family). The results of our study provide valuable insights concerning safety and efficient use of looped language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过机制可解释性协议分析了八种循环语言模型，揭示了携带循环与重读循环在能力提升和稳定性方面的差异，为循环LM的安全高效使用提供见解。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复使用层块实现更多潜在计算而无额外存储成本，但目前对其迭代变换是否真正提升能力、以及在提示扰动下是否稳定知之甚少，亟需系统分析。
AI.method: 基于机制可解释性构建包含五个不同视角的检查协议，应用于四个家族的八个循环LM（Ouro, LoopUS, Parcae, Rec-OLMo, Huginn等），重点对比携带循环（提示仅在循环状态内传递）与重读循环（每次迭代重新供给提示）两种架构。
AI.result: 研究发现不同循环架构在能力提升和抗扰动稳定性上存在显著差异，重读循环通常表现更优，且揭示了循环次数、提示注入方式对模型行为的具体影响机制。
AI.conclusion: 循环LM的设计选择（携带 vs 重读）深刻影响其性能与安全性，重读循环更稳健；该协议为未来循环LM的设计、评估与安全部署提供了系统性工具。

title: TabGift: A Context-Efficient Foundation Model for Tabular Data Generation
summary: Tabular data generation aims to synthesize realistic samples from limited observations while faithfully capturing the underlying data distribution. Tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on diverse tabular tasks and adapted through in-context learning, have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities, suggesting the potential of extending this paradigm to tabular data generation. However, the strong predictive performance of TFMs often relies on sufficiently large context sets, whereas tabular generation is typically needed precisely when target data are scarce. Extending the foundation-model paradigm to generation therefore requires reliable distribution inference from only a limited context. To this end, we propose TabGift, a context-efficient tabular foundation model enabling both efficient distribution modeling and effective generation from only a few context samples.
