Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出为扩散语言模型引入多条持久残差流和自适应路由，实现可见token与掩码token的角色分离，显著降低重构困惑度，并在更大规模模型上验证了机制的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型通常使用单一残差流同时承载可见证据与演化的掩码预测，导致上下文保留与预测细化之间存在冲突，需要更好的机制分离这两种互补角色。
AI.method: 在掩码扩散模型中引入多条跨层持久的残差流，并设计自适应路由机制允许token在流之间动态路由；通过因果干预和状态干预分析路由模式与流的功能分工；进一步尝试角色条件路由训练。
AI.result: 双流模型在验证集上将重构困惑度降低5.71%，在外部语料平均降低5.13%；可见与掩码位置自发学习出不同的路由模式，因果干预揭示其组织了读/写路由；角色条件路由恢复了约一半增益；状态干预表明额外流保留早期token表示供后期复用，同时证据在掩码位置累积；该机制在更大规模模型中依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 持久多残差流配合自适应路由能有效分离上下文保留与预测细化，为扩散语言模型提供了可扩展的架构改进方向，且无需预定义角色即可涌现功能分工。

title: Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents
summary: Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. In snow-model tests, five of five knowledge-guided specifications executed on the first attempt, compared with none of five given only the model name, achieving validation Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.81-0.94 against 0.57 for defaults. Under a common objective, independent GR4J formulations yielded scores within 0.001 NSE; re-evaluating eleven saved parameter vectors reproduced their metrics. In ten paired VIC tests with matched budgets, fixed search was non-inferior to continuing agent proposals (margin, -0.02 NSE; median difference, -0.003). This separation enables end-to-end calibration delegation with inspectable scientific choices and reproducible numerical evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用校准框架（GCH），用于将基于过程的地球科学模型的校准任务端到端地委托给语言模型代理。通过知识基础设施（KI）和验证约定约束代理行为，实现了科学选择的可检查性和数值评估的可复现性。在六个模型家族上的实验表明，知识引导的规范能在首次尝试时成功执行，且校准性能显著优于默认参数；固定搜索策略在给定预算下不劣于持续代理提案。
AI.motivation: 将基于过程的地球科学模型应用于新站点和新问题通常需要专家校准决策。可靠地委托给语言模型代理必须保持科学胜任力和可复现性。现有方法缺乏对代理生成的校准规范的系统性约束与验证机制，难以保证端到端委托的可靠性。
AI.method: 开发通用校准框架（GCH），包含知识基础设施（KI）和验证约定。代理在KI约束下定义参数域、观测映射和目标函数，生成模型特定代码。GCH对照声明检查并冻结这些规范，随后进行无需代理进一步判断的数值搜索与评估。实验涵盖六个模型家族：雪模型、GR4J、VIC等，对比知识引导规范与仅提供模型名称的基线，以及固定搜索与持续代理提案的性能。
AI.result: 雪模型测试中，五个知识引导规范全部首次尝试成功执行，而仅给模型名称的五个规范全部失败；验证期纳什-萨特克里夫效率（NSE）达0.81-0.94，远超默认参数的0.57。独立GR4J规范在相同目标下NSE差异在0.001以内；重新评估十一组保存的参数向量完全复现了其指标。十组配对VIC测试在相同预算下，固定搜索不劣于持续代理提案（边界-0.02 NSE；中位数差异-0.003）。
AI.conclusion: GCH实现了端到端校准委托，分离了科学规范生成与数值搜索评估，确保了科学选择的可检查性和数值评估的可复现性。知识引导的规范显著提高了首次执行成功率和校准性能；固定搜索策略在给定计算预算下具有竞争力，避免了代理持续干预带来的不可控变异。该框架为地球科学模型的自动化、可信校准提供了通用范式。

title: Masked Attention Pooling Is Invariant to Padding and Permutation: A Formal Proof in Lean
summary: Attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) pools a variable-size bag of instance embeddings into one vector. In batched training, bags are padded to a common length, and the pooled output is expected not to depend on how much padding was added or on the order in which instances are stored. This expectation holds only if padded rows are removed from both the numerator and the softmax normalizer. Common implementation idioms meet it only under side conditions. Zeroing padded features alone does not work. Masking logits with $-\infty$ fails on empty bags and on nonfinite padding. Masking with a large negative constant is exact only after floating-point underflow. We define masked attention pooling with a guarded normalizer and prove in Lean 4 with mathlib that it is invariant under any bijective reindexing of rows and under appending any finite number of masked rows with arbitrary real features and logits. We also prove that values at masked positions are irrelevant and that an all-masked bag maps to zero. The theorems hold for arbitrary finite index types and feature dimensions. Using the jax-lean certificate pipeline, we connect these theorems to the Jaxpr traced from the JAX kernel itself. Lean checks translation certificates for two concrete shapes, identifies the generated functions with the generic specification, and transfers both invariances to the imported Jaxpr's real-arithmetic semantics. All audited theorems depend only on Lean's three standard axioms. The results concern ideal real arithmetic. Floating-point execution, XLA, and the JAX tracer and importer remain outside the proof.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种带有保护归一化器的掩码注意力池化方法，并在 Lean 4 中形式化证明了其在行重新索引和追加掩码行下的不变性，同时通过 jax-lean 管道将定理与 JAX 核心的 Jaxpr 表示相连接，验证了理想实数算术下的正确性。
AI.motivation: 在注意力基多实例学习（MIL）中，批量训练需要将变长包填充至固定长度，但现有实现（如零填充特征、负无穷掩码 logits、大负常数掩码）在空包、非有限填充或浮点数下溢等边界条件下失效，导致池化输出依赖于填充量和实例顺序，违背了不变性预期。
AI.method: 定义带有保护归一化器的掩码注意力池化，在 Lean 4 中利用 mathlib 形式化证明其在任意有限索引类型和特征维度下：1）对任意双射行重新索引不变；2）对追加任意有限数量带任意实数特征和 logits 的掩码行不变；3）掩码位置的值无关紧要；4）全掩码包映射为零。随后通过 jax-lean 证书管道，将定理与 JAX 核心追踪出的 Jaxpr 关联，针对两个具体形状检查翻译证书，识别生成函数与通用规范，将不变性传递至导入 Jaxpr 的实数算术语义。
AI.result: 证明了掩码注意力池化在理想实数算术下满足上述不变性，且所有审计定理仅依赖 Lean 的三个标准公理。通过 jax-lean 管道，在两个具体形状上验证了 JAX 核心 Jaxpr 实现与规范一致，并将不变性属性传递至 Jaxpr 语义。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为注意力池化的填充不变性提供了严格的形式化保证，并建立了从高层数学规范到 JAX 可执行内核的可信连接。但证明仅覆盖理想实数算术，浮点数执行、XLA 编译、JAX 追踪器和导入器仍在证明范围之外。

title: Not All Drift Is a Mechanism: Tracing Prompt Adaptation in LLMs
summary: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了三种提示适配方法（离散提示优化、提示微调、前缀微调）在密集模型和专家混合模型中的内部计算差异，发现适配位置决定任务信息传递路径：优化文本主要改变响应构建，输入层提示将影响写入内容表示，逐层前缀通过注意力保持直接控制。在MoE中各方法诱导不同专家路由模式。常用表示层度量对通用上下文变化敏感，不能可靠区分有效适配与安慰剂。作者主张需将表示漂移中与任务计算因果对齐的部分分离出来，为选择、评估和解释提示适配提供实用指导。
AI.motivation: 现有提示适配方法通常仅通过下游性能比较，但相似输出不一定源于相似内部计算。缺乏对不同适配方法如何改变模型内部处理机制的系统性理解，尤其是无法区分表示漂移中真正因果驱动任务的成分与无关噪声。
AI.method: 对比研究离散提示优化、提示微调、前缀微调三种方法在密集语言模型和混合专家模型中的作用机制。分析适配位置如何决定任务信息传递路径，考察MoE中的专家路由模式差异，评估常用表示层度量的可靠性，并提出将表示漂移中与任务计算因果对齐的部分分离的分析框架。
AI.result: 1) 优化文本主要改变响应构建阶段；2) 输入层提示将影响编码进内容表示；3) 逐层前缀通过注意力机制保持对输出的直接控制。在MoE中，三种方法诱导显著不同的专家路由模式。常用表示相似度度量对通用上下文变化强烈响应，无法可靠区分有效适配与匹配的安慰剂提示。
AI.conclusion: 理解提示适配必须将表示漂移中与模型任务计算因果对齐的部分分离出来。这一视角为选择、评估和解释提示适配方法提供了实用指导，强调需关注因果机制而非仅看表层表示变化或下游指标。

title: The Singularity Has a Distribution: Exact Timing Laws and Detection Limits for a Stochastic Intelligence Explosion
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/xiaoyulics/singularity-distribution
summary: Automating AI research creates a positive feedback loop between software capability and research effort. We study a stochastic realisation of this loop in which independent, positive, multiplicative improvements arrive at a rate proportional to a power of current capability. Within this model, randomness leaves the deterministic explosion threshold unchanged but replaces the blow-up date by an explicit distribution. For equal-sized improvements the explosion time is a geometrically weighted sum of independent exponentials; its $q$-series representation gives its transforms, moments and tail behaviour, including a two-term small-time asymptotic. For Lomax-distributed improvement sizes the explosion time is exactly Gamma distributed. Self-similarity implies that, with parameters known, the relative uncertainty about the remaining time does not vanish as explosion approaches. We formulate a fixed-sample test between constant and geometrically increasing idea-arrival rates. If the baseline rate and the alternative log-rate increment $\ell$ are known, the minimum sample size at error level $α$ is asymptotic to $(12z_α^2)^{1/3}\ell^{-2/3}$, where $z_α$ is the upper-$α$ standard normal quantile. Uncertainty about the growth exponent near its critical value produces a $1/t$ tail with an explicit constant, and hence an infinite conditional mean waiting time, although explosion is certain given a positive exponent. Separate extensions show that a fixed deployment delay prevents explosion in the specified delayed-feedback models, that power-law diversion of effort shifts the growth threshold, and that in a deterministic oversight race a fixed allocation share does not change the asymptotic regime, except at a critical equality of exponents. Numerical illustrations, which are not empirical forecasts, show how timing and detectability depend on the granularity of improvements.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了AI研究自动化形成的正反馈循环，建立随机模型分析能力爆炸的时间分布、检测方法及各类扩展情形。
AI.motivation: 探讨AI研究自动化产生的软件能力与研究投入之间的正反馈循环，理解随机改进到达过程中的爆炸临界行为、时间分布及可检测性。
AI.method: 构建随机模型：独立、正向、乘法性改进以与当前能力幂次成正比的速率到达。分析等量改进下的爆炸时间（几何加权指数和）、Lomax分布改进下的Gamma分布、自相似性、固定样本检验（常数与几何增长到达率）、增长指数不确定性、部署延迟、幂律努力分流、确定性监督竞赛等扩展。
AI.result: 随机性保留确定性爆炸阈值但给出显式爆炸时间分布；等量改进时爆炸时间为几何加权独立指数和，Lomax改进时为精确Gamma分布；自相似性导致临近爆炸时剩余时间相对不确定性不消失；固定样本检验最小样本量渐近为(12z_α²)^{1/3}ℓ^{-2/3}；增长指数不确定性产生1/t尾部及无限条件均值等待时间；部署延迟阻止爆炸，幂律分流移动阈值，监督竞赛中固定分配份额不改变渐近机制（临界指数相等除外)。
AI.conclusion: 论文为AI自动化研究的反馈循环提供了严格的随机分析框架，揭示了爆炸时间分布、检测难度、不确定性持久性及各类现实约束对临界行为的影响，数值实例说明改进粒度对时机与可检测性的影响（非经验预测）。

title: OpenDGO: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Organizations Across Diverse Application Domains
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems are increasingly applied across diverse domains, yet different applications require different forms of agent organization. Existing studies typically adopt predefined organizations, such as Star, Chain, and Tree, or learn communication graphs to improve performance on specific tasks. However, these methods are largely designed and evaluated within a limited set of application domains, providing little understanding of whether an organization effective in one domain remains suitable for others with different collaboration requirements. We present \textbf{OpenDGO}, a controlled benchmark and analysis framework covering six real-world domains and three collaboration settings: Sequential Dependency, Parallel Decomposition, and Information Integration. Under matched tasks, agents, tools, and resource limits, OpenDGO compares fixed and learned organizations while separately examining communication graphs, role assignments, input assignments, resource budgets, and component failures. Our results show that there is no ``one-organization-for-all'' solution: preferred organizations vary across applications, and even the same communication graph can yield different outcomes under different role and input assignments. These findings highlight the need for application-dependent organization design, aiming to understand \emph{which organization is suitable for a given application, under what conditions, and why}.

AI.tldr: OpenDGO 是一个用于评估大语言模型多智能体系统组织设计的基准与分析框架，覆盖六大真实领域与三种协作模式，实验表明不存在通用的最优组织，组织效果随应用、角色分配、输入分配等条件显著变化，需面向具体应用设计组织。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多采用预定义组织（如星型、链式、树型）或学习通信图，且仅在有限领域评估，缺乏跨领域、跨协作需求的系统性对比，导致无法判断某组织在一种领域有效是否能迁移到其他协作需求不同的领域。
AI.method: 构建 OpenDGO 基准，包含六个真实应用领域与三种协作设置（顺序依赖、并行分解、信息整合）。在任务、智能体、工具、资源预算均匹配的受控条件下，对比固定组织与学习组织，并分别解耦考察通信图拓扑、角色分配、输入分配、资源预算及组件故障对性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：不存在“一组织适用于所有”方案；不同应用偏好的组织各异，且相同通信图在不同角色分配与输入分配下会产生截然不同的结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了组织设计对应用的强依赖性，呼吁开展面向应用的组织设计研究，明确“哪种组织适合给定应用、在何种条件下适合、以及为何适合”，为自适应多智能体组织生成奠定基础。

title: Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints
summary: External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher's while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher's probability mass. Extensive experiments on BFCL v4 and API Bank demonstrate that SeTPO achieves superior overall performance over supervised fine tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation baselines across all three student scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出选择性教师引导策略优化，解决小语言模型通过外部工具扩展能力时面临的探索困难和教师监督失配问题。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型（SLMs）虽可通过外部工具扩展能力，但仅靠强化学习难以发现有效的工具使用行为；直接教师监督则存在师生行为分布失配，且可能传播错误偏好。
AI.method: SeTPO协调学生探索与选择性教师指导及持续演示监督：在低奖励轨迹上引入基于反向KL的token级教师反馈至策略优势，辅以前向KL监督保留教师演示行为；理论上在理想双向KL目标下证明最优策略期望奖励不低于教师并保留教师概率质量的保证比例。
AI.result: 在BFCL v4和API Bank基准上，SeTPO在所有三种学生规模上均显著优于监督微调、强化学习和蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: SeTPO通过选择性教师引导与持续演示监督的结合，有效解决了小语言模型工具使用中的探索与分布失配问题，实现了优于现有方法的整体性能。}

title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
summary: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

AI.tldr: Thinker-WM 提出一个统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 联合建模 RGB、度量深度和机器人动作，在多个具身 AI 基准上取得 SOTA 成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型在模态建模和功能支持上碎片化，视觉动态、几何结构和可执行动作通常通过分离接口或下游模块耦合，缺乏联合表示与共同演化。
AI.method: 采用统一的动态 Transformer 与模态专用编码器/解码器，在表示层面实现外观、几何和动作的多模态统一：将三者映射为共享动态表示并由共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自输出结构，支持联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频转动作生成及逆动力学等多功能。
AI.result: 在约 20K 小时主观视频、10K 小时真实机器人数据和 1K 小时仿真数据（含 4K 小时带深度监督的真实机器人数据）上训练。Thinker-WM 在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad 和 WorldArena 上均排名第一，消融实验验证了动作条件、几何交互和多功能训练在共享表示中的收益。
AI.conclusion: Thinker-WM 证明了在统一表示中联合建模视觉、几何与动作可显著提升具身世界模型的泛化与多任务能力，为统一具身 AI 世界模型提供了有效范式。

title: FunDM: Cheap & Label-Free Decision Models from Frozen Language Models
summary: Decision models such as Jev score candidate answers or actions. A small decision head trained label-free can recover about 99% of a frozen language model's multiple-choice accuracy while using only two-thirds of its transformer layers. It learns the full model's answer probabilities with KL divergence, without correct-answer labels for training. One backbone pass reads the question and all options together; the head returns probabilities for every option. We call this model FunDM (Fun Decision Model). Using 24 of Qwen3-8B's 36 layers and skipping the LM head, its +1T variant reaches 75.0% mean accuracy over eight benchmarks, versus 75.7% for the full model. On MMLU-Pro, both heads achieve 1.56 to 1.57 times batched vLLM throughput with about one-third lower peak GPU allocator memory. Both heads score higher than released Contrastive Language Models (CLM), fine-tuned CLM, and CLM-shaped heads trained from scratch on the eight multiple-choice benchmarks and coding-agent selection. Separately trained agent heads learn judge probabilities without pass/fail labels and select passing runs for 74.4 to 74.6 of 100 held-out tasks on average, versus 74 for the full-model judge and 52.0 for a CLM-shaped action-trained head. Code is available at: https://github.com/Ujjawal-K-Panchal/FunDM

AI.tldr: 本文提出FunDM（Fun Decision Model），一种无需标签训练的小型决策头，仅使用冻结语言模型2/3的Transformer层（Qwen3-8B的36层中的24层），通过KL散度学习全模型的答案概率分布，即可恢复约99%的多项选择准确率，同时显著提升推理吞吐量并降低显存占用。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在多项选择任务中需完整前向传播所有层并计算LM头，计算开销大、延迟高。现有对比语言模型（CLM）等方法仍需标签微调或从头训练，且性能不如全模型。作者旨在开发一种免标签、轻量级的决策头，直接蒸馏冻结主干的输出分布，实现高效决策。
AI.method: 1. 冻结Qwen3-8B前24层作为共享主干，移除原LM头。 2. 接入轻量级决策头（FunDM），单次前向传播同时编码问题与所有选项，输出各选项概率。 3. 仅用KL散度最小化决策头输出与全模型（36层+LM头）输出分布的差异，无需正确答案标签。 4. 同架构扩展到智能体判断头，蒸馏全模型裁判的通过/失败概率，同样免标签训练。
AI.result: • 八大多项选择基准平均准确率75.0%，全模型75.7%（恢复99%）。• MMLU-Pro上吞吐量提升1.56–1.57×，峰值显存分配降低约1/3。• 显著优于已发布CLM、微调CLM及从头训练的CLM形状头。• 智能体判断头在100个保留任务中平均选中74.4–74.6个通过运行，全模型裁判为74，CLM动作训练头仅52.0。
AI.conclusion: FunDM证明了小型免标签决策头可高效蒸馏冻结大模型的决策能力，以2/3层数实现近无损准确率，同时大幅提升吞吐与显存效率，并泛化到智能体动作选择任务，为大模型高效部署提供新范式。

title: Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery
summary: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RC-DS（readout-canonicalized decision-space）坐标系，消除奇异值增益同时保留决策信息，研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）中读出缩放、数据分布与训练几何对稀疏学习的影响。实验显示：在受控条件下，RC-DS 将稀疏因子恢复率从 0.506 提升至 0.913（条件数 100）；在语言模型检查点上，RC-DS 在全部 18 个任务-稀疏度设置中均实现更高的无增益重构，而 centered-logit SAE 在 17 个设置中输出 logits 重构更优。长训练可将重构差距从 0.0198 缩至 0.0016。结果表明读出缩放、数据分布与训练共同塑造稀疏表示，RC-DS 为分离和控制读出贡献提供了信息保留方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 SAE 训练中，读出层的缩放（奇异值增益）会改变学到的稀疏特征，但去除缩放的收益取决于数据分布。缺乏一种在保留决策信息的同时消除读出增益、并能系统研究读出缩放、数据生成空间与训练坐标系三者相互作用的方法。
AI.method: 1. 引入 RC-DS 坐标：通过正则化读出矩阵的奇异值为 1，保留决策空间信息但移除增益。2. 设计受控坐标匹配实验：在固定读出条件数下，改变因子生成分布（读出缩放前/后），对比不同训练坐标系（RC-DS、centered-logit 等）的因子恢复能力。3. 构建精确封装复现 RC-DS 训练至数值精度，隔离训练几何而非额外信息。4. 在神经策略与三个固定语言模型检查点上评估 logits 重构、无增益重构、标签检测与转向测试。
AI.result: • 受控研究：因子在读出缩放前生成时，RC-DS 将平均稀疏因子恢复率从 0.506 提升至 0.913（条件数 100）。恢复效果最佳当训练恢复因子生成时的空间。• 精确封装验证：RC-DS 提升源于训练几何而非额外信息。• 神经策略：RC-DS 改善平均 logits 重构。• 语言模型：RC-DS 在全部 18 个任务-稀疏度设置中实现更高平均无增益重构；centered-logit SAE 在 17 个设置中输出 logits 重构更优。• 小标签头控制：延长训练将重构差距从 0.0198 降至 0.0016。• 标签检测与转向测试：区分了重构效应与任务特定特征效用。
AI.conclusion: 读出缩放、数据分布与训练几何共同决定 SAE 学到的稀疏表示。RC-DS 提供了一种保留决策信息同时消除读出增益的方法，能系统研究并控制读出层对稀疏学习的贡献。重构质量与任务特定特征效用可分离评估。长训练可缩小不同训练目标间的重构差距。

title: Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了 Autonomous Science Bench，一个用于评估 AI 智能体自主科学发现能力的基准测试套件，包含六个基于真实已发表实验的生物、化学和材料科学领域的预算受限设计-构建-测试-学习闭环任务。实验评估了 8 种智能体配置共 144 次试验，最佳配置成功率为 67%，最难任务仅 24 次中成功 3 次。引入的两个校准门槛（发现门槛和学习门槛）揭示了不同智能体在发现有前景设计 vs 对未见设计进行排序预测方面的差异性弱点。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体基准多为固定数据集或依赖仿真，缺乏真实实验环境下的主动实验决策评估。需要一个能够模拟真实科研流程、包含预算约束、实验测量反馈和预测模型构建的完整闭环基准，以评估 AI 在自主科学发现中的实际能力。
AI.method: 构建了六个跨学科的预算受限设计-构建-测试-学习闭环任务，智能体批量选择设计方案，通过实验室服务获取测量结果，利用结果指导后续实验，最终交付预测模型。设置两个校准评估门槛：发现门槛评估智能体实际测量的设计质量，学习门槛评估其模型对保留集设计的排序预测能力。对 8 种智能体-模型配置进行 144 次试验评估。
AI.result: 最佳配置在 67% 的试验中成功通过两个门槛；最难任务仅在 24 次尝试中成功 3 次。两个门槛揭示了不同弱点：部分智能体能建立准确排序但发现的有前景设计太少；另一些能发现有前景设计但无法预测未见设计表现。整体成功率掩盖了这些差异。已发布 v0.1 版本任务、实验室运行时和公开排行榜。
AI.conclusion: Autonomous Science Bench 为自主科学发现智能体提供了首个基于真实实验的闭环基准，双门槛评估机制能更细致地诊断智能体在探索与利用、发现与预测方面的能力差距，推动该领域更有针对性的方法改进。

title: ModRes: A modification of the ResPlan dataset ready for floor plan analysis and graph machine learning
summary: Floor plan datasets underpin computational analysis of building layouts, spatial connectivity and graph machine learning. However, publicly available datasets often require substantial preprocessing before they can be used reliably. We present ModRes, a cleaned and enriched version of the ResPlan dataset, containing 8,431 valid and unique residential floor plans. Invalid and duplicate floor plans are removed through a dedicated cleaning workflow, producing a ready-to-use dataset. For each floor plan, ModRes provides two-dimensional geometry, images, three-dimensional building representations and three complementary dual graphs in CSV and JSON formats with graph-, node- and edge-level features. Continuous and categorical graph attributes support machine learning workflows. We characterise the dataset using graph-based statistics and demonstrate its utility through a range of case studies. ModRes provides structured geometric, topological and semantic representations needed to automate spatial analysis and support machine learning-based workflows for building design and performance evaluation.

AI.tldr: ModRes 是一个清洗和增强后的住宅平面图数据集，包含 8431 个有效唯一平面图，提供二维几何、图像、三维建筑表示及三种互补对偶图（CSV/JSON 格式），支持图、节点、边级特征，可用于机器学习和空间分析。
AI.motivation: 现有公开平面图数据集通常需要大量预处理才能可靠使用，缺乏现成的、结构化的几何、拓扑和语义表示，阻碍了建筑布局的计算分析、空间连通性研究及图机器学习应用。
AI.method: 基于 ResPlan 数据集，通过专门的清洗工作流移除无效和重复平面图，构建 ModRes 数据集。为每个平面图提供二维几何、图像、三维建筑表示以及三种互补对偶图（CSV 和 JSON 格式），包含图级、节点级、边级特征，支持连续和分类图属性，以适配机器学习工作流。
AI.result: 通过基于图的统计特征表征数据集，并通过多个案例研究展示其效用，验证 ModRes 可支持自动化空间分析和基于机器学习的建筑设计与性能评估工作流。
AI.conclusion: ModRes 提供了结构化的几何、拓扑和语义表示，填补了现有数据集的空白，为建筑布局的计算分析、空间连通性研究和图机器学习提供了可靠的基础数据集。

title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
summary: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.

AI.tldr: 论文发现工具调用评判器在缺乏参考文本时对正确参数值的接受率显著下降，称之为'推导鸿沟'。提出 DeRef 方法：让独立模型读取完整历史生成参考文本供评判器使用，在三个基准测试上显著提升所有评判器的 AUROC，受控测试中将 AUROC 从随机水平提升至 98.40-99.59。
AI.motivation: 工具调用评判器在评估 LLM 代理提出的参数值时，当输入中缺乏明确指示参数取值的参考文本（如默认值、需推导的值、被截断的源文本）时，对正确值的接受率大幅下降。这种'推导鸿沟'普遍存在于七种评判器中，且非单纯截断伪伪影，评判器倾向于跟随可见的错误参考而非隐藏的正确值。
AI.method: 提出 DeRef (Derived Reference) 方法：引入一个独立模型，在不可见候选参数值的情况下阅读完整对话历史，生成参考文本供评判器使用。此举旨在为评判器提供显式的参考依据，弥补推导鸿沟。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试上，DeRef 提升了所有被测评判器的整体参数 AUROC。在受控源重定位测试中，DeRef 将 AUROC 从随机或低于随机水平提升至 98.40 至 99.59 之间。
AI.conclusion: 推导鸿沟是工具调用评判的系统性缺陷，评判器严重依赖输入中的显式参考。DeRef 通过外部模型生成参考文本，有效缓解了这一问题，显著提升了评判器对隐含/默认参数值的判断准确性。

title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
summary: Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides effective recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. Furthermore, we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts. By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, our ReTerm-9B achieves 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base model by 14.6 points. Further analysis shows that our method achieves consistently higher recovery rates across diverse error categories compared with standard GRPO training. All code, data and model are released at https://github.com/twothsnd/ReTerm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReTerm，一种通过从自身失败任务中学习恢复能力的自改进终端代理。构建了 ReTerm-10K 数据集用于 SFT 冷启动，并提出 ReTerm-GRPO 在线强化学习算法，从失败状态分叉生成多个独立恢复尝试，通过任务完成情况自我改进。基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 ReTerm-9B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 34.8% Pass@1，较基础模型提升 14.6 分，且在多种错误类别上恢复率持续优于标准 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 终端代理在复杂编码任务中表现强劲，但在长时运行执行中难以从错误（如命令错误、错误实现）中恢复，导致任务失败。现有方法缺乏针对自我恢复的专门训练机制。
AI.method: 1. 构建定制数据流水线生成 ReTerm-10K 高质量数据集，提供有效恢复演示用于 SFT 冷启动。2. 提出 ReTerm-GRPO 在线 RL 算法：从代理自身失败状态分叉，生成多个独立自我恢复尝试，根据尝试是否成功完成任务进行学习，实现通过自身恢复经验自我改进。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 ReTerm-9B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 34.8% Pass@1，较基础模型提升 14.6 个百分点。进一步分析显示，该方法在多样错误类别上恢复率持续高于标准 GRPO 训练。
AI.conclusion: ReTerm 通过自我恢复训练显著提升终端代理的长时任务鲁棒性。ReTerm-10K 数据集和 ReTerm-GRPO 算法有效解决了代理从错误中恢复的难题，代码、数据和模型已开源。

title: CartoVec: General-Purpose Location Embeddings from Open Map Data
summary: Geographic coordinates are common inputs in applied machine learning, but latitude and longitude describe position rather than the surrounding environment. Image-grounded location encoders learn this context from satellite or ground-level imagery; structured open map data offers another source of supervision whose utility for continuous coordinate encoders remains less explored. We introduce CartoVec, a coordinate encoder trained to predict Overture-derived land cover, land use, transportation, place and connectivity targets at multiple spatial scales, without image inputs or downstream-task labels. We evaluate frozen embeddings on Census outcomes, Airbnb prices and Philadelphia crime in the US Northeast using spatial block cross-validation. CartoVec has the highest mean performance on most Census outcomes and the highest average across the full suite, with several comparisons close across folds. The findings support open map data as a practical source of reusable location representations with a coordinate-to-vector interface that requires no map lookup at inference. The open-weight model is available at https://huggingface.co/gursoyfurkan/CartoVec.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CartoVec，一种仅利用开放地图数据（Overture）训练的坐标编码器，无需图像输入或下游任务标签，通过多尺度预测土地覆盖、土地利用、交通、地点和连通性目标来学习地理位置表示。在美东北部的 Census 结果、Airbnb 价格和费城犯罪预测任务上，冻结嵌入经空间块交叉验证评估，CartoVec 在多数 Census 指标上取得最高平均性能，且在全套任务平均性能最优，证明开放地图数据是可复用位置表示的实用来源，且推理时无需地图查询。
AI.motivation: 地理坐标常作为机器学习输入，但经纬度仅描述位置而非周边环境。现有基于图像的位置编码器（卫星/街景）虽能学习环境上下文，但结构化开放地图数据作为连续坐标编码器的监督信号，其效用尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建 CartoVec：从 Overture 开放地图数据提取土地覆盖、土地利用、交通、地点、连通性等多尺度目标；设计坐标到向量的编码器，仅以经纬度为输入，通过多任务预测这些地图语义目标进行预训练；无需图像输入，也无需下游任务标签。推理时直接将坐标映射为向量，无需实时地图查询。
AI.result: 在美东北部 Census 社会经济指标、Airbnb 租金、费城犯罪率三类下游任务上，采用空间块交叉验证评估冻结嵌入。CartoVec 在大多数 Census 结果上达到最高平均性能，且在全部任务套件的平均性能上排名第一；多次折叠对比中表现接近但稳定领先。
AI.conclusion: 开放地图数据可作为实用、可复用的位置表示监督来源；CartoVec 提供即插即用的坐标到向量接口，推理无需地图查询，开源权重已发布。

title: Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
summary: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DDRG框架，通过基于推理图的分歧驱动验证来改进大语言模型的多步推理，无需扩展采样轨迹库即可实现选择性修正，在五个基准测试上显著超越直接回答、CoT、GoT、GoV和Self-Consistency。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理多步推理任务时，中间步骤的错误会影响最终答案。Self-Consistency（SC）通过对采样的最终答案投票来改进推理，但其投票机制无法解决中间步骤的分歧。需要一种方法能够暴露声明级别的分歧并提供修正证据，且不扩大初始候选轨迹库。
AI.method: DDRG构建源接地声明图，利用图对齐暴露声明级分歧，将局部冲突发送给答案盲验证器。当验证器支持的反驳到达多数答案的支持路径时触发聚焦修复；否则返回精确的SC投票结果。该方法实现了从冻结推理轨迹库的选择性修正。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试中，原生零样本DDRG在宏平均准确率上比直接回答提升8.65和15.83个百分点（分别针对Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B），同时超越CoT、评估的GoT和GoV问答适配版本以及SC。
AI.conclusion: DDRG成功将局部验证与选择性修正联系起来，在不扩大初始候选库的前提下实现了推理质量的显著提升，为多步推理任务提供了有效的分歧驱动修正框架。

title: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
summary: Linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. A fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored, while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. Alternatively, sparse attention with continued pretraining (CPT) can extend the effective context length. Generalization beyond the trained length remains challenging, however, and CPT can be costly. We introduce FreeSolo, a native sparse attention mechanism with a short-range sliding window branch and a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. Its linear-time variant, FS-L, learns to prune the prefix before query-dependent selection through short CPT. FS-B searches balanced trees with $O(N\log^2 N)$ algorithmic cost including radix-sort construction. FreeSolo demonstrates better zero-shot length extrapolation than the baselines without long-context fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: FreeSolo 是一种原生稀疏注意力机制，包含短程滑动窗口分支和长程关键点选择分支，其线性时间变体 FS-L 通过短续训练学习前缀剪枝，FS-B 采用平衡树搜索实现 O(N log² N) 复杂度，在无长上下文微调情况下实现更好的零样本长度外推。
AI.motivation: 线性时间序列模型的固定状态限制信息存储，混合全注意力架构带来二次方复杂度，稀疏注意力虽能延长有效上下文但泛化能力差且持续预训练成本高。
AI.method: 提出 FreeSolo 原生稀疏注意力：短程滑动窗口分支处理局部依赖，长程分支选择关键点单元进行直接 token 注意力。线性变体 FS-L 通过短续训练学习查询相关的前缀剪枝；FS-B 采用基数排序构建平衡树实现 O(N log² N) 检索。
AI.result: FreeSolo 在无长上下文微调条件下，相比基线方法展现出更优的零样本长度外推能力。
AI.conclusion: FreeSolo 通过原生稀疏注意力设计平衡了线性复杂度与长距离建模能力，短续训练即可实现有效的前缀剪枝与关键点选择，为长上下文建模提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Does self-distillation improve reasoning?
summary: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning
